text.body: <1> atha prathamo'dhyāyaḥ śrīyainamaḥ śrīrāmacandrāyanamaḥ śrīmadvikhanasamahāguravenamaḥ śrīmadbhyobhṛgumarīcyatrikaśyapebhyonamaḥ prakīrṇādhikāraḥ athaprathamo'dhyāyaḥ śrautasmārtādikaṅkarma nikhilaṃyenasūtritaṃ | tasmaisamastavedārthavide vikhanasenamaḥ || maṅgalācaraṇa1 || śrutismṛtinadīpūrṇaṃ śāstrakallolasaṃkulaṃ | viṣṇubhaktyudakaṃśuddhaṃ vandevaikhānasārṇavaṃ || maṅgalācaraṇa2 || ṛṣipraśyottaram ṛṣaya ūcuḥ - brahmaputramuniśreṣṭha namastedehināṃvara | tvamevasarvavettāsitvamevavadatāṃvaraḥ || 1.1 || tatojñātuṃhiviṣṇorvai bhūparīkṣādiṣukramaṃ | icchāmastvatprasādena dīnāśśiṣyajanāḥprabho || 1.2 || vistārajñohisarveṣāṃ vistarādvaktumarhasi | kenamārgeṇakairmantraiḥkaṃ devaṃpūjayannaraḥ || 1.3 || kānlokānsamavāpnoti tattvametadvadasvanaḥ | bhṛguruvāca - praṇamyadevadeveśaṃ cakrapāṇiṃkhaḍgadhvajaṃ || 1.4 || vistāreṇapravakṣyāmi śruṇudhvaṃsusamāhitāḥ | muhūrtavicāraḥ sarvāraṃbhepraśastaṃsyādādityecottarasthate || 1.5 || apraśastamitikhyāta mayanedakṣiṇetathā | puṣyamāsādiṣaṇmāsā devānāntudivāsmṛtāḥ || 1.6 || yasminmāsekṛtaṃsarvaṃ vivṛddhyarthamitismṛtaṃ | rātrirāṣāḍamāsādi rayuktassarvakarmasu || 1.7 || prathamācadvitīyāca tṛtīyāpañcamītathā | ṣaṣṭhīcasaptamīcāpi daśamyekādaśītathā || 1.8 || trayodaśīcatithayaḥ paurṇamāsīśubhāssmatāḥ | prājāpatyāśvayukcoṃya tiṣyapauṣṇatriruttarāḥ || 1.9 || maitrādityamaghāsvātī hastāścaśravaṇaṃśubhāḥ | rāśayaścaravarjyāssyurubhītacchobhanaṃsthiraṃ || 1.10 || gurubhārgavasoṃyendu vārāśśreṣṭhatamāsmṛtā | eṣāmaṃśaścadrekkāṇahorādarśanamiṣyate || 1.11 || eṣāmevodayaṃśastaṃ tatrasomodayaṃvinā | krūrecatuṣyanakṣatre vyādhipīḍāṃkarotihi || 1.12 || sūryasauriścasoṃyaścatriṣaḍāyasthitāśśubhāḥ | tadhaivalagnagāḥkuryurvyādhiśokabhayānitu. || 1.13 || aṣṭamasthāgrahāssarve kartuḥkurvantidusthitiṃ | ekādaśagatāssarve kṣemārogyakarāsmṛtāḥ || 1.14 || bhayakṛdbhārgavaḥproktodvisaptadaśamasthitaḥ | dvisaptapañcanavama sthitojīvassuśobhanaḥ || 1.15 || rāṣṭrasyayajamānasya mahatsaukhyaṅkarotihi | sūryavāreśubhoviṣṇu hastapauṣṇatriruttarāḥ || 1.16 || mandavāreśubhauproktā brāhmasvātyaucatattathā | varjayedbudhavāreṇa hastamāśvayujantathā || 1.17 || guruvāreṇa varjyautu tathāsoṃyottarā ubhau | śravaṇañcaivapuṣyañca śukravāreṇavarjayeth || 1.18 || uttarāṣāḍhānakṣatraṃ somavāretu śobhanaṃ | dvitīyābudhayuktāca ṣaṣṭhījīvasamāyutā || 1.19 || soma ekāvaśīyuktaḥ karotiprāṇasaṃśayaṃ | pauṣṇastusaptamīyukto dahatyagnirivaprajāḥ || 1.20 || kāṇastūṇāndhanakṣatra guruviṣīrvivarjayeth | bhūmikaṃpediśāndāhe durdinecaṇḍamārute || 1.21 || aśanidhvaniyogeca ninditandivasaṃsmṛtaṃ | ayaneviṣuvecaiva saṃtyājaṅgrahaṇītathā || 1.22 || ṣaḍaśītimughevāpi kṛtaṃvāstuvinaśyati | evaṃparīkṣyakartavya miccheccecchreya ātmanaḥ || 1.22ḥ1 || karṇādipratiṣṭhāntaṃ karmakuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ | athabhūmiṃparīkṣyaiva pūrvaṅkarṣaṇamārabheth || 1.23 || bhūparīkṣā śvetātubrāhmaṇībhūmī daktātu kṣatriyātathā | pītātuvaiśyākṛṣṇātu śūdrābhūmirudāhṛtā || 1.24 || mokṣadābrāhmaṇīproktā kṣatriyāvijayapradā | vaiśyātudhanadābhūmi śśūdrāputrasamṛddhidā || 1.25 || pratilomādibhirjuṣṭāṃ valmīkāḍhyañcavarjayeth | hastamātraṅkhanitvātu pūrayettattupāṃsunā || 1.26 || adhikepuṣkalābhūmirnyūnevarjyāsamesamā | guptantrirātreṃ'kurati grāhyabhūmistunānyathā || 1.27 || padmaṅkuṃbhasthatoyena pūritetatkṛtāvale | mukhyaṃpradakṣiṇāvarta mudakaṃśāstabudbudaḥ || 1.28 || savyāvartantathāneṣṭa mudakaṃbahubudbudaḥ | uttānapadmakaṅgrāhyaṃ natvadhomukhapadmakaṃ || 1.29 || evaṃparīkṣyagṛhṇīyātpuṇyāhamapivācayeth | evaṃparīkṣyabahudhā kuryātkarṣaṇamuttamaṃ || 1.30 || karṣaṇam śvetau vākapilau vātha nāṅgaṅaīnauvṛṣautathā | athavānānyavarṇau vā arogaubalaśālinau || 1.31 || kṣīravṛkṣayugaṃbaddhvā śamīvṛkṣayutantathā | asanaṅkhadiraṃvātha halaṅkṛtvāsanehakaṃ || 1.32 || yantrayitvāyugenātha govālakṛtarajjunā | tasyapaścimadeśetu prapāṅkṛtvāvidhānataḥ || 1.33 || dhānyapīṭhānikṛtvaiva trivedisahitaṅkramāth | purvandeveśamabhyarcya cakraṃpaścātsamarcayeth || 1.34 || viṣvakcenañcagaruḍaṃ samabhyarcyanivedayeth | vāstuyajñañcahutvātu puṇyāhamapivācayeth || 1.35 || toyadhārāṃpuraskṛtya prādakṣiṇyavaśenatu | acāryo'hatavastreṇa cottarīyāṅgulīyakai || 1.36 || alaṅkṛtyavidhānena śvetamālyānulepanaiḥ | samādāyavṛṣantatra "tvaṃvṛṣabha'' itibruvan. || 1.37 || vṛṣabhandakṣiṇeyojya"saurabheya'' itibruvan | tatassaṃyojayetpaścādbalīvardaibalānvitā || 1.38 || "yugaṃyugaśruṅgam'' itiyojayeccahalaṃpunaḥ | "ṛṣiṅgṛhṇā'' mitimantreṇa ṛṣiṃsamyakpragṛhyaca || 1.39 || "viṣṇurmāṃrakṣa''tvitica svātmarakṣāṃsamācareth | "ye'smindeśejīvanta'' ityāśritāṃścavisarjayeth || 1.40 || "halakṛṣṭe''timantreṇa dārayettāmilāṃśubhāṃ | karṣayedvaiṣṇavairmantraiḥ prāgudakpṛvaṇāṃmahīṃ || 1.41 || tataḥkarṣakamāhūya sarvatraivatukarṣayeth | ayāryaṃpūjayitvātu tathaivasahalauvṛṣau || 1.42 || prathamaṅkarṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā dvitīyaṃ karṣaṇañcareth | bījaṃsarvaṃsamādāya prokṣaṇaiḥprākṣaṇañcareth || 1.43 || "imebījāḥpraro''heti saptagrāmyāṇyataḥparaṃ | vāpayitvātubījāni "devitvayi'' samuccaran || 1.44 || "duhatāṃuhadiva'' mityuktvāto yantatrasamarpayeth | rakṣāṃsamyagvidhāyātra cācāryamabhipūjayeth || 1.45 || "sasyā'' imetimantreṇa sasyaṃpakvaṃpraṇamyaca | viṣvakcenādibhirmantraiśśāntañcāpisamarcayeth || 1.46 || "śuddhā'' imetimantreṇa gobhyassamyaṅnivedayeth || 1.47 || iti śrīvaikhānase bhagavacchāstre bhṛguproktāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prakīrṇādhikāre prathamo'dhyāyaḥ <2> athadvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ śaṅkusthāpanam ataḥparaṃpravakṣyāmi śaṅkusthāpanamuttamaṃ | meṣantathaivavṛṣabhaṅgate sūryedinetathā || 2.1 || kṛtvāsamatalāṃbhūmiṃ gomayenatulevayeth | tadbahibhrāmayetsū tradvayantenai vamānataḥ || 2.2 || prācīsādhanam pūrvāhṇecāparāhṇeca śaṅkuchāyāntulāñchayeth | tatassūtratrayaṃvāthapāti yecchaṅkumathyame || 2.3 || bhrāmayedadhiker'ṣantu nyūnetāvadvivardhayeth | prācīntatsūtramānena madhyamenai vakalbayeth || 2.4 || udaksūtraṃbhavettatra kṛtvātucaturaśrakaṃ | pañcagavyenasaṃprokṣya puṇyāhamapivācayeth || 2.5 || vāstupada devatāpūjanam ekāśītipadānkṛtvāvāstu devānprapūjayeth | īśānādi samabhyarcya dvātriṃśatbadabhāginaḥ || 2.6 || īśānañcaivaparjanyaṃ jayastañcamahendrakaṃ | ādityaṃsatyakaṃbhṛśamanta rikṣañcapūrvagān || 2.7 || agniḥpūṣācavitatha grahākṣatayamāstathā | gantharvobhṛṅgarājarṣī dakṣiṇepadadevatāḥ || 2.8 || paścimenirṛtiścaiva dauvārikastathaivaca | sugrīvaḥpuṣpadantaśca varuṇaścāsurastathā || 2.9 || śoṣaṇaścaivarāgaścate cāṣṭaukadhitāssurāḥ | uttarejavanonāga mukhyaubhallāṭa evaca || 2.10 || somor'galo'ditiścaiva sūridevastathaivaca | brahmānavapadaṃbhuṅkai vāstumadhyeviśeṣataḥ || 2.11 || aryamādaṇḍa bhṛccaivapāśabhṛddhanadastathā | brahmaṇaścacaturdikṣu sthitāṣṣaṭpadabhāginaḥ || 2.12 || apaścaivāpavatsaśca savitāsāvitra evaca | indraścaivatathendrājo rudrorudrāja evaca || 2.13 || etedvipadabhoktāro vidikṣaṣṭausthitāssurāḥ | carakīdevatāriśca pūtanāpāparākṣasī || 2.14 || īśānādiṣukoṇeṣu bāhyasthāḥpadavarjitāḥ | evaṃ vinyasyadevāṃntu vāstu devaṃ prakalpayeth || 2.15 || vāstupuruṣalakṣaṇam - pūjā vāstunaśśira īśānepādau nairṛtikecareth | hastausaritpataujñeyāvagnau bāhurudāhṛtaḥ || 2.16 || apikaṇṭhaitiproktaṃ hṛdayañcāpavatsake | nābhirbrahmaṇisaṃkhyātā kukṣassavitṛsaṃjñake || 2.17 || indraindrājake guhyamūrumūlevidhānataḥ | pārśvantudakṣiṇaṃ proktaṃvāmamevaṃ prakalpayeth || 2.18 || śetevāstubhuvaṃ prāpyavāstudevastvadhomukhaḥ | puṇyāhaṃvācayitvātu prokṣaṇaiḥprokṣaṇañcareth || 2.19 || puṣpairgandhaistathādhūpairdī paiścāpiprapūjayeth | namaskāraiścasaṃyuktaiḥ praṇavādyaissvanāmabhiḥ || 2.20 || śalyaparīkṣā pūjanāntespṛśetkartā yamaṅgantannirīkṣayeth | vāstudehe'pitatraivaśalyaṃ brūyādyathārthataḥ || 2.21 || astiśalyaṃśirassparśe taddhastadvayamānataḥ | kaṇṭhasparśegalecaiva hastamātresamādiśeth || 2.22 || upasparśāttribhirhāstai śśruṅkhalāśalyamādiśeth | hastamātraikarasparśātkhaṭyāpādaṃsamādiśeth || 2.23 || bahusaṃsparśanātkartu raṅgārastutrihastataḥ | gulbhaisarpādibhirduṣṭaṃ vitastidvayamānataḥ || 2.24 || pādekaṇṭakamityuktaṃ ṣaḍvitastipramāṇataḥ | kaniṣṭhāṅguṣṭhayosspṛrśāddhastantatrasamācareth || 2.25 || vyayādhikecaturhāste jānusparśāttataḥparaṃ | śalyaṃviśodhyabhūmintāṃ talaṅkṛtvāsamānataḥ || 2.26 || pañcagavyenasaṃprokṣya vāstudevānprapūjayeth | vāstudevatābaliḥ droṇandroṇārthakaṃvāpitaṇḍulānpācayettataḥ || 2.27 || dadhiguḍājyasaṃyuktaṃ sarveṣāñcabalindadeth | brahmadīnāṃnamostaṃvā svāhāstaṃvābalirbhaveth || 2.28 || kṛtvātu balidānañca puṇyāhamapivācayeth || 2.29 || itiśrīvaikhānase bhagavacchāstre bhṛguproktāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prakīrṇādhikāre dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ <3> atha tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ vimānabhedāḥ athavinyāsarūpāṇi pravakṣanteyathākramaṃ | śrīvatsaṃprathamaṃproktaṃ nandyāvartandvitīyakaṃ || 3.1 || tṛtīyaṃsvastikaṃvindyāccaturthaṃbhadrakaṃsmṛtaṃ | daṇḍakaṃpañcamantvāhurvedikaṃṣaṣṭhamucyate || 3.2 || kuṃbhakaṃsaptamaṃvindyā daṣṭamaṃpadmakantathā | navamaṃsyādrathapadaṃ daśamantuprakīrṇakaṃ || 3.3 || eteṣāmākṛtiṃvakṣye yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ | nyatradaṇḍakātsarvaṃ bahirvīdhīsamanvitaṃ || 3.4 || tasyacāstagantaiścihnaiśśrīvatsādyaṃvidhīyate | ekaprācīnavīdhīka mudīcīnānyavīthikaṃ || 3.5 || śrīvatsamitivijñeyaṃ sarvavidyāsamaṃmataṃ | madhyekoṇaṃ caturdvāraṃ prāgīśādipradakṣiṇaṃ || 3.6 || tannigantojavīthīkaṃ nandyāvartamitismṛtaṃ | svastikantvojavīthyantaṃ bhadraṃmadhyapratolikaṃ || 3.7 || ekaprācīnakandaṇḍaṃ caturaśrantuvedikaṃ | vṛttaṅkuṃbhakamuddiṣṭaṃ padmakaṃsyāddvivedikaṃ || 3.8 || brahmakośāṣṭakadvāravīthīrathapadākṛtiḥ | prāgudakpravaṇañcaiva prakīrṇakamudāhṛtaṃ || 3.9 || dvidvāraṃvācatudvānraṃ manastoyuktitobhaveth | ayuktadvāradevasya bhajanaṃnābhidhīyate || 3.10 || daṇḍakastenamānena yonigrahaṇamucyate | śarīramaṅgaṃpratyaṅgaṃ jñātvāyoniṃprakalpayeth || 3.11 || grāmaṃśarīramaṅgaṃssyāddevadvijaparigrahaṃ | pratyaṅgamaṅgaṃsaṃvṛttaṃ vimānabhavanādikaṃ || 3.12 || daṇḍenapūrvayorvādaṃ hastenānyatradhīyate | daṇḍevistāramāyāma mekaikaṅguṇayettribhiḥ || 3.13 || ekaikaṃṣaṣṭibhihintvā śiṣṭaṃyoniṃsamādiśeth | hastenadvayasaṃsarge triguṇaṃvasubhihanreth || 3.14 || śeṣaṃyoniṃvijāniyāddhvajadhūmādikaṅkramāth | sarvatrakalpayedyoniṃ tayorvargaphalenavā || 3.15 || yonermahādiśāśreṣṭhā divisaptatrigahintā | pravīṇañcaturaśraṃsyācceṣāṇāmāyataṃviduḥ || 3.16 || aṣṭaṣaṭcaturaṃśāssyu ritareṣāṃyathākramaṃ | evamāyāmayogastu pratyaṅgasyaivakalpayeth || 3.17 || aṅgedviguṇamāyāmaṃ pādanyūnamadhādhikaṃ | ardhaṃnavāhayennyūna madhikantuvidhīyate || 3.18 || ātmāvāstuśarīrasya vistārādadhikaṃviduḥ | pādāyāmaśikhāvāpi dviguṇaṃvāviśeṣataḥ || 3.19 || samaṃvāsarvataḥkuryāccarīrandaṇḍakādṛte | vardhayedadhikāyāmaṃ daṇḍaṣoḍaśakenavā || 3.20 || daṇḍe aṣṭaguṇaṅkuryā dāyāmaṃyuktito'thavā | aṅgamāgamavistāro daṇḍabhedo'piyojyate || 3.21 || anyatradaṇḍanechindyāccareṣutuviśeṣataḥ | pātaṃvistārasūtreṣu vidussūtradvaye'pivā || 3.22 || kaṇṭhasūtradvayevāpi pratyaṅgenaiva kārayeth | vidhibhedantukartavyaṃ brahmabhāgeviśeṣataḥ || 3.23 || evaṅkrameṇa śāstrajñaśśarīraṃ saṃprakalpayeth || 3.24 || viṣṇusthāpanam sahasrabhūsurādūrdhve brahmāṃśevāyudeśake | pañcamūrtividhānena sthāpayitvā janārdhanaṃ || 3.25 || vaikhānasai mahābhāgairvaidikārcanatatparaiḥ | vedāntavedibhirviprairañcayetpuruṣottamaṃ || 3.26 || śaṅkarādi sthāpanaṃ īśāna īśvarañcaiva someśānāvathāpivā | paścimekeśavasthāna maiśānyāṃśaṅkarālayaṃ || 3.27 || anukalpaṃvikalpañca kalpañcaivatridhābhaveth | bhūparīkṣādiyatkarma anukalpamitismṛtaṃ || 3.28 || devādīnāṃmunīnāñca kalpayettuvikalpakaṃ | gabhenmṛdālayeyatra pratiṣṭhāyāntukalpakaṃ || 3.29 || evandeśaṃviniścitya mūlasthānañcanirdiśeth | nirmite'travimānasyaco tsedhārthaṃsamantuvā || 3.30 || jalāstaṃvāśilāntaṃ vākhānayeducitaṃsudhīḥ | vistārāyāmasīmāntādbāhyekhātvādṛḍhāyaca || 3.31 || ekahastandvihastaṃvā trihastaṃvādhikaṅkramāth | vālukairviśvataḥpūrya dṛḍhīkaraṇamādiśeth || 3.32 || bālālayantuśaktānāmaśaktānāṃvinābhaveth | dhruvārcāyāḥpratiṣṭhāce dbālāgāraṃnakalpayeth || 3.33 || iti śrīvaikhānase bhagavacchāstre bhṛguproktāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prakīrṇādhikāre tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ <4> athacaturtho'dhyāyaḥ adyeṣṭakā sthāpanam athātassaṃpravakṣyāmi vāstunaḥprathameṣṭakāṃ | sādhayitvāpūrvarātrau catasraḥprathameṣṭakāḥ || 4.1 || śilāyāṃmṛṇmayevātha kuryāllakṣaṇasaṃyutāḥ | śailādoṣavinirmuktāssupakvā athamṛṇmayāḥ || 4.2 || vistāreṇeṣṭakāḥproktā ṣaṭpañcacaturaṅgulāḥ | uttamādikriyādeva vistāradviguṇāyatāḥ || 4.3 || vistārārthaṅghanaṃprokta miṣṭakānāṃpramāṇataḥ | ālayābhimukhecaiva prapāṅkṛtvāvicakṣaṇaḥ || 4.4 || tanmadhyevedikāṅkṛtvā hastamātrapramāṇataḥ | vistārantatsamañcauna mutsethantutadardhakaṃ || 4.5 || sabhyāgniṃ vidhivatkṛtvātu vidhināghoramācareth | bhūmiyajñañcakṛtvātu kalaśaissaptabhiḥkramāth || 4.6 || saṃsnāpyanavavastreṇa cācchādyaśayanopari | kautukaṃbandhayitvātu śayaneśāyayettataḥ || 4.7 || hutvātupauruṣaṃsūktaṃ viṣṇusūktamataḥparaṃ | caturvedādimantrāṃśca śrībhūsūkteyajetkramāth || 4.8 || iṣṭakāvāśilāvātha tannāmādyakṣaraṃsmareth | nṛttaigenyaiścavādyaiścarātriśeṣaṃnayetkramāth || 4.9 || prabhātepūjayetpūrvamācāryaṃśilpibhissaha | ācāryomantrayogyastu śilpibhiḥkarmayogyakaiḥ || 4.10 || dvārasyadakṣiṇepāśenvsthānamasyapraśasyate | sumuhūrtenyasedvidvāniṣṭakāṃścaturaḥkramāth || 4.11 || vinyāsetucaturdikṣu caturvedādimastrataḥ | teṣāṃmadhyetadāgarte pūrayedudakenatu || 4.12 || tatraivanavaratnāni vilyasedanupūrvaśaḥ | gabhannyāsavidhiḥ athavakṣyeviśeṣeṇa gabhannyāsavidhikramaṃ || 4.13 || prāsādogabhansaṃyuktaḥ kurutesarvasaṃpadaṃ | tasmādādauprakartavyaḥ gabhannyāsassamṛddhidaḥ || 4.14 || trayaḥprāsādamūlesyātpūrvantuprathameṣṭake | upānoparimadhyaṃsyātprateruparicāntataḥ || 4.15 || bhūgataṃśūdrajātīnā mupānenṛpavaiśyayoḥ | praterupariviprāṇā mānulomyenakārayeth || 4.16 || sarveṣāṃbhūgataṅkāryaṃ sarvasiddhikaraṃśubhaṃ | aindrapāvakayormadhye prāgdvāreṣuprakalpayeth || 4.17 || dvārasyadakṣiṇekuryātpaścimaipitadhaivahi | kavāṭārgalayogevānya stavyaṅgabhanbhāyanaṃ || 4.18 || phelā tathātāmramayīphelā sphāṭikāvāpraśasyate | pādaviṣkaṃbhavistārāṃ phelāntattvapadāñcitāṃ || 4.19 || khaṇḍasphuṭitavajānysā ........ | ghanaṃviṃśatibhāgaikaṃ tadardhārdhāṃśamevavā || 4.20 || vistārasyacatubhāngaṃ koṣṭhabhittyucchrayaṃbhaveth | uttamantusamotsedhaṃ tripādaṃmadhyamaṃsmṛtaṃ || 4.21 || athamañcārdhamutsedhaṃ trividhantatpracakṣate | tribhāgaikavidhānaṃsyāddvibhāgaṃbhāgikaṃbhaveth || 4.22 || antarecāṃgulāyāmaṃ tadardhaṃbhinnattikaṃ | saṃyogārdhavihīnaṃsyādvidhāne'bhyantaretathā || 4.23 || prakṣālyapañcagavyena viśuddhaṅgabhanbhājanaṃ | ālayātpramukhecaiva maṇṭapesamalaṅkṛte || 4.24 || gomayenopalipyaiva puṇyāhaṃvācayettataḥ | raktabījānidhātūṃśca sannyasenmastravittamaḥ || 4.25 || vaiṣṇavaṃviṣṇusūktañca pauruṣaṃsūktamuccaran | "viṣṇuryoni'mityuktvātu gabhaṃntranidhāpayeth || 4.26 || itiśrīvaikhānase bhagavacchāstrebhṛguproktāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prakīrṇādhikāre caturtho'dhyāyaḥ <5> atha pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ prāsādalakṣaṇam athavakṣyeviśeṣeṇa prāsādānāntulakṣaṇaṃ | prasādaṅkuruteyena prāsādairatikīrtitaṃ || 5.1 || aṅgulabhedaḥ trividhantusamākhyātamaṅgulaṃsyātpramāṇataḥ | mānāṅgulantuprathamaṃ mātrāṅgulamataḥparaṃ || 5.2 || tṛtīyantusamākhyātaṃ dehalabdhapramāṇataḥ | rathareṇvaṇuraṣṭābhirīkṣāyū kāyavāstathā || 5.3 || kramaśo'ṣṭakuṇairviddhi mānāṅgulamitismṛtaṃ | madhyamāṅgulimadhyantu paryamātrāṅguliṃsmṛtaṃ || 5.4 || pratimāyāvibhāgena tālagaṇyena? bhājanaṃ | aṅgulantu samākhyātaṃ dehalabdhapramāṇataḥ || 5.5 || prāsādamaṇḍapānāñca mānāṅgulavidhānataḥ | yāgopakaraṇānāstu mātrāṅgulavidhānataḥ || 5.6 || dehalabdhapramāṇena pratimāṅkārayettathā | aṅgulaiḥkiṣkurityuktaṃ caturviṃśatibhistathā || 5.7 || pañcaviṃśatibhiścaiva prājāpatyamudāhṛtaṃ | ṣaḍvintiśadhannurmuṣṭhi saptaviṃśaddhanugranhaḥ || 5.8 || hastānāṃlakṣaṇaṃproktaṃ mānāṅgulavidhānataḥ | ekatalādikalpanam trihastādisamārabhya navahastāntamevaca || 5.9 || ayugmairathahastaistukuryādekatalaṃbudhaḥ | dvitalantutataḥkuryātsatrayodaśahastakaiḥ || 5.10 || pañcādhikadaśaihanstaiprāsādassyāttribhūmikaḥ | talaṃpratyadhikaṅkuryātṣaḍḍhastantuviśeṣataḥ || 5.11 || ādvādaśatalādevaṃ kuryādvistāramānakaṃ | vistāradviguṇotsedha muttamantupracakṣate || 5.12 || vistāraṃsaptadhākṛtvā dvādaśāṃśantumadhyamaṃ | ekādaśāṃśamadhamaṃ vistāresaptadhākṛte || 5.13 || ādvādaśatalādevamutsedhantuvidhīyate | prāṅmukhodaṅmukhaissūtraiḥ padaṅkuryāttuṣoḍhaśaṃ || 5.14 || gabhangehassamākhyāto madhyamantucatuṣpadaṃ | bāhyatodvādaśapadaṃ bhittyarthamupakalpayeth || 5.15 || ṣaḍbhiṣṣaḍbhistadhāsūtraiḥ padānāṃpañcaviṃśatiḥ | navagabhangṛhaṃmathyebhittyarthaṃ śeṣamucyate || 5.16 || trividhantusamākhyātaṃ? prāsādākṛtayastathā | nāgarandrāviḍañceti vesarañcatridhābhaveth || 5.17 || nthūpyantañcaturaśraṃsyānnāgaraṃsamudāhṛtaṃ | kaṇṭhaprabhṛticāṣṭāśraṃ prāsādandrāviḍaṃbhaveth || 5.18 || kaṇṭhaprabhṛtivṛttaṃya dvesarantatpracakṣate | beraḥpūrvaṃsthitoyatra tatraberavaśādbhaveth || 5.19 || yāvadberantribhāgaikaṃ vistāraṃpīṭhamevahi | pīṭhasyatriguṇaṅgabhaṃngarbhārdhaṃbhittirucyate || 5.20 || gabhangehatribhāgaikaṃ bhittiṃvātatrakārayeth | agratomaṇḍapaṅkuryātprāsādasamavistṛtaṃ || 5.21 || prāsādasya samāyāmaṃ daśāṃśaṃmukhamaṇḍapaṃ | prāsādasyāgratodvāraṃ prakuryāllakṣaṇānvitaṃ || 5.22 || vrateruparisīmāntaṃ dvārasyotsedhaucyate | uttamandvāravistāramutsethārdhamudāhṛtaṃ || 5.23 || utsedhārdha daśāṃśena hīnaṃmadhyamamucyate | viṃśatyāparihīnaṃsyā dvistāramadhamaṃbhaveth || 5.24 || kāyañcāpyanukāyañca kuryādutsedhamānataḥ | bhāgamekamadhiṣṭhānamutse dhovasudhābhaveth || 5.25 || pādāyāmodvibhāgassyādbhāgaḥprastāraucyate | bhāgaḥkaṇṭhaitiproktaṃ dvibhāsaṃśikharaṃbhaveth || 5.26 || bhāgasthyūpiritikhyāta mevamutsedhaucyate | kāmamevaṃsamākhyāta manukāyamadhocyate || 5.27 || kuryātprāsādavistāraṃ caturviṃśatibhāgikaṃ | ekabhāgastuvistāraṃ bhāgamekantalantathā || 5.28 || daśāṅgulaṃscāddvitale tritaledvādaśāṅgulaṃ | yugāṅgulavivṛddhyātu kartavyaṃsyāttalaṃprati || 5.29 || pādamasyatuviṣkaṃbha maṣṭabhāgaṃvihīnakaṃ | staṃbhāgreṇaivagartavya manukāyapramāṇataḥ || 5.30 || upānasyatuviṣkaṃbha magrepādadvayaṃbhaveth | adhiṣṭhānantridhākṛtvā bhāgovaijagatībhaveth || 5.31 || kumudantudvitīyena bhāgenaivatukārayeth | kṛtvāśeṣañcataṃbhānga mekāṃśainapaṭcaṭikāṃ || 5.32 || kuryātsārdhenakaṇṭhantu śeṣaṃvājinamucyate | pādabandhamitikhyātaṃ sarvakāryeṣupūjitaṃ || 5.33 || pratikramaṃvākartavya madhiṣṭhānapramāṇataḥ | jagatīntadvadevātha kumudaṃpṛttamucyate || 5.34 || bhāgenapūrvavatkṛtvā caturthaṃśeṣamācareth | paṭṭikenaivakartavya megamastarikantathā || 5.35 || dvābhyāṃpratimukhaṅkuryātpratikramamidaṃbaveth | adhiṣṭhānamitikhyātaṃ pādamānaṃpravakṣyate || 5.36 || caturaśramathāṣṭāśraṃ vṛttañcaivatridhābhaveth | kuṃbhayuktantathāke citkecitkuṃbhavihīnakaṃ || 5.37 || kaicidvaikuṃbhamaṇībhyāṃ yuktaṃpādaṃsmarantihi | vistāreṇasamaṃvāpi dviguṇaṃvāpimūlataḥ || 5.38 || caturaśramadhohitvā vṛttamaṣṭāśramevavā | kartavyantuyadhāyukta mathavāṣoḍaśāśrakaṃ || 5.39 || pādānāmākṛtiḥproktā kuṃbhalakṣaṇamucyate | pādādhikamadhādhyarthaṃ pādonandviguṇantuvā || 5.40 || dviguṇantusamutsedhaṃ pādaviṣkaṃbhamānataḥ | śrīkarañcandrakāstañca soṃukhyaṃpriyadarśanaṃ || 5.41 || yathākrameṇanāmāni kartavyāniviśeṣataḥ | śrīkaraṃvṛttapādānāṃ kalāśrāṇāntathaivaca || 5.42 || caṃndrakāntamathāṣṭāśraṃ somakhaṇḍamitismṛtaṃ | atibhāreṣu staṃbheṣu priyadarśanamucyate || 5.43 || kṛtvānavāṃśakaṅkuṃbhaṃ bhāgamekaṃhṛducyate | kuṃbhañcaturbhiraṃśaistu kaṇṭhabhāgamudāhṛtaṃ || 5.44 || āsyamekāṃśamityuktaṃ śeṣaṅkuryāddvidaṇḍaṃ | ekenapadmakenaiva vṛttamekenavātathā || 5.45 || vistṛtau staṃbhavistārau dviguṇaukuṃbhamucyate | adhyarthamāsyavistāraṃ hārodhāmūlapādavat? || 5.46 || vistāramevamuktaṃsyānmaṇḍailankṣaṇamucyate | maṇḍaistripādamutsedhaṃ vistārantucatugunṇaṃ || 5.47 || tribhāgaikaṃbhavetpadmaṃ vetramekantathaivaca | bhāgāvāphalakārāmā vetrāvāpādarūpavath || 5.48 || pādāgrakarmamānena skandhaṅkuryādvidhānataḥ | staṃbhāgrasamavistāraṃ vīrakāntantripādataḥ || 5.49 || tadūrdhvepādatāṅkuryādvistāraṃpādavistṛtaṃ | samantripādamardhaṃvā bodhikotsedhaucyate || 5.50 || tridaṇḍamadhamāyāme caturdaṇḍantumadhyamaṃ | uttamaṃpañcadaṇḍaṃsyā dbodhikotsedhaucyate || 5.51 || jagatyantekumudānte paṭṭikānte'thavāpunaḥ | jalaniryāṇamāgaṃnca nālaniganmanaṅkriyāth || 5.52 || haṃsapādantripādaṃvā vitastirvāviśeṣataḥ | pratebānhyaviniṣkrāntyā nālīṃśailamayīntathā || 5.53 || gajoṣṭhasadṛśākārāṃ siṃhākṛtimukhottarāṃ | bhūtasiṃhopamāmūrdhvasāravārādhikārayeth || 5.54 || dvidaṇḍañcatridaṇḍaṃvā gabhangehetuveśmanaḥ | berodayasamaṃvātha dviguṇaṃvādhyarthamevavā || 5.55 || praṇālamūlavistāraṃ tribhāgaikāgravistaraṃ | vyāsatribhāgaṃbhāgonaṃ bahulantutribhāgabhāṃ || 5.56 || vārisaṃcāragaṃbhīratāraṃ jhajhanralakṣaṇaṃ | animnonnatamābhitte stadātyaśraṅkramānnataṃ || 5.57 || sarvavādyasamāyuktaṃ tadāmaṅgalavācakaiḥ | vāstuhomantataḥkṛtvā ācāryavūjayettataḥ || 5.58 || śilpinaṃpūjayetpaścātsumuhūrtesulagnake | ācāryassuprasannātmā vāruṇaṃsūktamuccareth || 5.59 || takṣakasthsāpayennālīṃ susnigdhāṃsudṛḍhāṅkramāth | beraprāsādagabhansya yāvattālasyacāvadhi || 5.60 || dhārāntukevalaṅkuryādbhittautālasyadhīmataḥ? | śreṣṭhamadhyakaniṣṭhāni berasyasthāpanantridhā || 5.61 || dhārādalasamāptautu sthāpanañcottamaṃbhaveth | dvārabandhasyapūrvetu sthāpanaṃmadhyamaṃbhaveth || 5.62 || mūrdhopalasyapūrvetu sthāpanaṃsyātkanīyasaṃ | yaḥkarotyanyathācāsmā dabhicārāyacaivahi || 5.63 || evaṃnālañcasaṃsthāpya prastarañcottarādikaṃ | viṣkaṃbhaṃpādavistāra mutsedhantrividhaṃbhaveth || 5.64 || uttamantusamotsedhaṃ tripādaṃmadhyamaṃbhaveth | adhamañcārdhamutsedha muttamaṃsyādvidhānataḥ || 5.65 || staṃbhāgraikatribhāgaikaṃ tasyordhvepaṭṭikābhaveth | tatsamaṃniganmaṃproktaṃ paṭṭikālakṣaṇantvidaṃ || 5.66 || dvibhāgenatadūrdhvetu kartavyaṃpadmapaṭṭikaṃ | dvidaṇḍantukapotaṃsyā dupānasamaniganmaṃ || 5.67 || śeṣaṃprastāramānantu kartavyaṃpañcabhāgikaṃ | ekenapaṭṭikāṅkuryātkaṇṭhamekenakārayeth || 5.68 || dvābhyāntadūrdhve kartavyamekāṃśenatupaṭṭikāṃ | evaṃprastāramākhyātaṃ toraṇaṃvakṣyate'thunā || 5.69 || pāśvanyoḥpṛṣṭhataścāpi kartavyanto raṇantathā | prateruttarasīmānte toraṇasyāśrayobhaveth || 5.70 || vistārantutadardhaṃsyā dvistāraṃpañcabhāgikaṃ | makarāṃśantriyaṃśena śeṣaṃpādamitismṛtaṃ || 5.71 || pādāntarāgramadhavāvistārantoraṇasyatu | pūrvoktamevakartavyaṃ makarāṃśapramāṇataḥ || 5.72 || pramāṇanto raṇasyoktaṃ nāsikāyāstulakṣaṇaṃ | vakṣyatetupramāṇena yathāśāstraviniścitaṃ || 5.73 || gabhangehārdhavistāraṃ mahānāsītikīrtyate | niganmantutadardhaṃsyāttripādaṃsamamevacā || 5.74 || śikhareṣu caturdhikṣu kuryādekāntunāsikāṃ | vistārantutadardhaṃsyātka poteṣvaṣṭanāsikāḥ || 5.75 || kūṭasyalakṣaṇaṃproktaṃ kūṭaśālaṃvidhīyate | kṛtvāprāsādaṣaḍbhāgamekabhāgaṃvidhīyate || 5.76 || bhāgenakūṭaśālaṃ syādbhāgārdhaṃpañcamaṃbhaveth | caturguṇaṃbhavetkūyaṃ śālāsyādgopurākṛtiḥ || 5.77 || śālāvistāramānena pāśvanyonānsikābhaveth | ekanāsikayāyuktaṃ pañjaraṃsamudāhṛtaṃ || 5.78 || tataḥkaṇṭhārdhamānena śikharaṃvardhayettataḥ | kaṇṭhāddvidaṇḍamityuktaṃ śikharasyatuniganmaṃ || 5.79 || niganmādvartanādbāhye vardhanantutadardhakaṃ | sthūpiṅkubhasamāyuktaṃ kuryāddaṇḍaṃvidhānataḥ || 5.80 || vistārantatpramāṇena śikharantatracocyataṃ | tadūrdhvekaṇṭhamityuktaṃ phalakācatadūrdhvataḥ || 5.81 || krameṇakṛśatāṃ kuryādyānadantastumākṣmataḥ iti śrīvaikhānase bhagavacchāstre bhṛguproktāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prakīrṇādhikāre pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ <6> athaṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ mūdhenṣṭakāvidhiḥ athavakṣyeviśeṣeṇa kramaṃmūrdheṣṭakāvidheḥ | pramukheyāgaśālāñca kṛtvācaivavicakṣaṇa || 6.1 || madhyevediṃprakalpyaiva sthūpikīlapramāṇataḥ | sabhyaṃprakalpyacaprācyā māghāraṃvidhivadyajeth || 6.2 || vedimadhyenyasedvidvānsusnigdhānirvraṇādṛḍhāḥ | vaiṣṇavañcajapitvaivacatasraśceṣṭakāḥkramāth || 6.3 || kiñcidagraṃbhavennimnaṃ mūlevaikiñcidunnataṃ | adhobhāgebhavetpṛṣṭa mūrdhvabhāgemukhaṃbhaveth || 6.4 || śālipiṣṭamayenātha lekhayedakṣarāṇitu | yakāraṃpūrvatolekhya rakārandakṣiṇenyaseth || 6.5 || lakāraṃpaścimelekhyavakāre cottarelikheth | lohajāndārujāṃvātha sthūpintatranyasedbudhaḥ || 6.6 || pādāyāmasamandīghaṃnvistāraṃpādasammitaṃ | agramaṅgulavistāra mānupūrvyātkṛśantathā || 6.7 || caturaśraṃbhavenmūlaṃ tribhāgai kaṃsamaṃyathā | vṛttantadūrdhvataḥkuryācchīlīpādamadhonyaseth || 6.8 || vistāratriguṇāyāmaṃ vistārasamavistaraṃ | taddvayenasamāyojya namaṃśūlaṃsthitaṃyadhā || 6.9 || pañcagavyaissamabhyukṣya puṇyāhamapivācayeth | vāstujomañcahutvaiva paryagnikaraṇañcareth || 6.10 || mūrdheṣṭakāvidhānena homaṅkṛtvāvicakṣaṇaḥ | punaḥprabhātedharmātmā yajamānayutoguruḥ || 6.11 || śilādīnsaṃpragṛhyaiva vimāneropayettadhā | pāṇibhyāṃsaṃpragṛhyaiva prāṅmukhodaṅmukho'pivā || 6.12 || caturvedādimantraiśca śilā indrādiṣunyaseth | dhruvasūktañjapitvātu mathyesthūpiṃnyasettadhā || 6.13 || kāleśilpinamāhūya pūjayitvā viśeṣataḥ | śilādyuparivinyasya dṛḍhīkaraṇamācareth || 6.14 || pādabandhegalecaiva vimāne paritaḥkramātvimānadevāḥ | prācyāṃ viṣṇuṃ prakurvīta yasya garbhagṛhesthitiḥ || 6.15 || dakṣiṇesatyamūrtestu paścimecā cyutasya ca | uttarecāniruddhasya sthitimevaṃ prakalpayeth || 6.16 || galepuruṣamūrtistu dakṣiṇe nārasiṃhakaḥ | paścime tu varāhaśca hayagrīvastathottare || 6.17 || sukhasanasamāluktaṃ sarvālaṅkārasaṃyutaṃ | vyāloddhvakoṇakañcaiva vīśaṃ vātha mṛgeśvaraṃ || 6.18 || vakratuṇḍaṃ ca durgāṃ cāpyagramaṇḍapabhittiṣu | sthitamevaṃ susaṃsthāpya yathālābhaṃ samarcayeth || 6.19 || dvāreṣu dvārapālānāṃ sthitimevaṃ prakalpayeth | prāsādalakṣaṇaṃproktaṃ maṇḍapānāmathocyate || 6.20 || staṃbhaiṣṣoḍaśabhiryuktaṃ maṇḍapaṃ śrīpratiṣṭhitaṃ | dvādaśastaṃbhasaṃyuktaṃ bījāsanamiti smṛtaṃ || 6.21 || dvātriṃśadgātrasaṃyuktaṃ jayabhadretikīrtyate | ṣaṭtriṃśadgātrasaṃyuktaṃ nandyāvartaṃ suśobhanaṃ || 6.22 || caturbhiṣṣaṣṭibhistsaṃbhairyuktaṃśrībhadrakaṃ smṛtaṃ | staṃbhānāṃ tu śatairyuktaṃ viśālamiti saṃjñitaṃ || 6.23 || prāsādavatsamākhyātaṃ prastāraṃ tatpramāṇataḥ | vājinopari kartavyaṃ dhārakastu kalāstathā || 6.24 || staṃbhaviṣkaṃbhamutsedhaṃ caturbhāgenavistṛtaṃ | tulāvistāramānena jayantīsyātsamonnatā || 6.25 || tato daṇḍārdhabāhulya manumārgaṃ tadūrdhvataḥ | iṣṭakābhistadūrdhvaṃ tu chādayedgala kānvitaṃ || 6.26 || pādādhikamadhādhyardhaṃ dviguṇaṃ pādahīnakaṃ | caturvidhamathāyāmaṃ kartavyaṃ maṇḍapasyatu || 6.27 || āyāme tu yathāyuktaṃ staṃbhānāṃ vidhirucyate | dvihastaṃ vātrihastaṃ vā caturhastamathāpivā || 6.28 || staṃbhāntaraṃ prakartavyaṃ yathāyukti viśeṣataḥ | evaṅkramātsamākhyātaṃ prākāramadhunocyate || 6.29 || pākāraṃ paritaḥ kuryātprāsādasya pramāṇataḥ | prākārasyatuvistāraṃ tasyadaṇḍamihocyate || 6.30 || antarmaṇḍalamityāhu radhyardhaṃ daṇḍamānataḥ | antarbhāramitiprostaṃ madhyabhāraṃ dvidaṇḍata || 6.31 || caturdaṇḍapramāṇena yuktā maryādabhittikā | mahāmaryādabhittissyātsaptadaṇḍapramāṇataḥ || 6.32 || adhyardhadviguṇaṃ vāpi triguṇaṃ vā caturguṇaṃ | mukhāyāmamiti proktaṃ prākārāṇāṃ viśeṣataḥ || 6.33 || kapotā ntaṃsamutsedhaṃ bhittihastapramāṇataḥ | kūṭaśālāyutaṃ vāpi kuryātprākārasaṃyutaṃ || 6.34 || mūlajaṃ tu talotsedhaṃ hastamevaṃ vidhīyate | yathālābhonnataṃ vāpi pradhamāvaraṇaṃ smṛtaṃ || 6.35 || ṣaḍaṅgulaṃ kramātkuryānnyūnaprākārakaṃviduḥ | jalaniryāṇamārgaṃ syātpadānte taṭake'pivā || 6.36 || pradhamāvaraṇadvāraṃ pramukhekalpayettathā | dvitīyāvaraṇadvāro vyastaśchennāstidūṣaṇaṃ || 6.37 || vimānotsedhaturyaṃ vā podonaṃ cārthameva vā | pṛdhaggopurasaṃyukta mucchritaṃ tu samantuvā || 6.38 || pañcaprākāramityevaṃ triprākāramathāpivā | triprākāreṣaḍaṅgulyaṃ tridhādhastalanimnagaṃ || 6.39 || prākārehucchrayaṃ vindyātkapotāntaṃ taduttamaṃ | madhyamaṃ cotkarāntena kalaśāntaṃ tathādhamaṃ || 6.40 || evaṃ prākārasaṃgena tūtsedhaṃ trividhaṃ kramāth | utsedhātpañcabhāgaikaṃ caturaṃśakameva vā || 6.41 || ṣaḍbhāgaikena vākuryāttrividhaṃ bhittivistaraṃ atha vā | prāsādabhittistu tatsamaṃ bhittimeva ca || 6.42 || garbhe'ṣṭāṃśocchrayaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ saptabhāgedvimadhyamaṃ | pañcabhāgaikamadhamaṃ balipīṭhaṃ tathābhaveth || 6.43 || garbhapañcatribhāgaikaṃ ... | navāṃśeṣaṭcaturbhāgaṃ madhyamādhamamuttamaṃ || 6.44 || tridhā paiśācikaṃ pīṭhāddhastamātraṃ kramādbhaveth | dvihastāntaṃ trihastāntaṃ caturhastāntamucyate || 6.45 || adhamaṃ madhyamaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tridhā paiśācapīṭhakaṃ | saptaviṃśatibhāgaiśca samamevaṃ samunnataṃ || 6.46 || dvyaṃśaṃ ca pādukā jñeyaṃ caturaṃśaṃ janiṃ viduḥ | tṣaṃśaṃ tu kuṃbhamityāhu ścaturthaṅkaṇṭhameva ca || 6.47 || ṣaḍbhāgaṃ karaṇetyāhurdvyaṃśaṃ valakameva ca | caturaṃśe kapotāśca aṃśecaivāgrapaṭṭikā || 6.48 || adhyardhaṃ padmapuṣpantu ekārdhaṃ padmapuṣpakaṃ | evaṃ samyagviditvātu bhāgebhāge vinirdiśeth || 6.49 || iti śrīvaikhānase bhagavaccāstre bhṛguproktāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prakīrṇādhikāre ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ <7> atha saptamo'dhyāyaḥ parivārālayalakṣaṇam athātaḥ parivārāṇāmālayasya ca lakṣaṇaṃ | vimānātpādahīnaṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā samācareth || 7.1 || varṇayuktaṃ tataśśreṣṭhaṃ kaniyovarṇahīnakaṃ | someśānadvayormadhye viṣvaksenaṃ prakalbayeth || 7.2 || dvārasya dakṣiṇe cendra māgneyyāṃ pacanālayaṃ | tasya paścimadeśetu pānīyasthānamevaca || 7.3 || yāmye śayanamuddiṣṭaṃ tatpūrve yāgamaṇḍapaṃ | aiśānye puṣpadeśantu dakṣiṇe vastrasaṃcayaṃ || 7.4 || īśānasomayormadhye sthāpanaṃ ... tathā | indrāgnyormadhyamecaiva dhānyasthānaṃ praśasyate || 7.5 || sopānamadhye śrībhūtamarcayedbahirānanaṃ | purastādgaruḍaṃ tasya devābhimukhamarcayeth || 7.6 || vimānapālāndikpālānbhāskareṇa samāyutaṃ | cakraṃ dhvajaṃ ca śaṅkhaṃ ca bhūtaṃ vai bhūtanāyakaṃ || 7.7 || prathamāvaraṇe dehustattaddeśe samarcayeth | utsavaṃ balimārabhya anapāyiviśeṣataḥ || 7.8 || amitasyāpi tantatra pradakṣiṇamathācareth | devasya kaṇṭhasīmāntaṃ bāhyantaṃ stanasammitaṃ || 7.9 || nābhyantaṃ vā viśeṣeṇa parivārodayaṃ kramāth | dhātrādibhūtaparyantaṃ parivārānviśeṣataḥ || 7.10 || varṇavāhanaketvādyairnāmanakṣatrapūrvakaṃ | mayākriyādhikāre tu vyaktamuktantulakṣaṇaṃ || 7.11 || beralakṣaṇam - (śailādi bhedaḥ) atha vakṣye viśeṣeṇa beralakṣaṇamuttamaṃ | śailajaṃ ratnajaṃ caiva dhātujaṃ dāravaṃ tathā || 7.12 || mṛṇmayaṃ syāttathaiveti pañcadhāberamucyate | caturvidhaṃ tu śailaṃ syātsaptadhā ratnajaṃ tathā || 7.13 || aṣṭadhā dhātujaṃ proktaṃ dārujaṃ ṣoḍaśocyate | mṛṇmayaṃ dvividhaṃ proktaṃ kramāllakṣaṇamucyate || 7.14 || śailajalakṣaṇam śvetaṃ raktaṃ tathā pītaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ caiva catuṣṭayaṃ | śailajaṃ bhedamākhyātaṃ tasya lakṣaṇamucyate || 7.15 || gokṣīrasannibhācaiva śaṅkhakundendu sannibhā | śīlā śvetā samākhyātā sā tu vaśyapradāyikā || 7.16 || japākusumasaṃkāśā śilā śoṇitasannibhā | bandhūkapuṣpapratimā jātihiṅgulikopamā || 7.17 || śilā raktā samākhyātā jayadā lakṣaṇānvitā | pītā suvarṇasadṛśā rajanīcūrṇasannibhā || 7.18 || śilā lakṣaṇasaṃyuktā dhanadhānyasukhapradā | māṣamudgala?saṃkāśā tathājaṃbūphalopamā || 7.19 || bhṛṅga? mutpalasaṃkāśā prajāvṛddhikarāsmṛtā | śilā kṛṣṇā tu sarveṣāṃ sarvasiddhipradāyikā || 7.20 || viprakṣatriyavaiśyānāṃ śūdrāṇāñca yadhāvidhi | śvetā raktā tathā pītā kṛṣṇā caiva yathākramaṃ || 7.21 || dvijānāṃ ca trivarṇānāṃ śilā raktā jayapradā | śvetā mokṣapradā proktā brāhmaṇānāṃ viśeṣataḥ || 7.22 || etaintudhruvaberantu kārayedyadibhaktitaḥ | māṇikyaṃ ca pravālaṃ ca vaidūryaṃ sbhaṭikaṃ tathā || 7.23 || maratakaṃ puṣyarāgaṃ ca nīlaṃ caiteṣuratnajāḥ | māṇikyaṃ śrīkaraṃ proktaṃ pravālaṃ vaśyakārakaṃ || 7.24 || ākarṣaṇaṃ tu vaiḍhūryaṃ sphāṭikaṃ putravṛddhidaṃ | vidveṣaṇaṃ maratakaṃ staṃbhanaṃ pūṣyarāgakaṃ || 7.25 || nīlaṃ turamaṇaiḥ kāryaṃ ratnajānāṃ phalaṃ bhaveth | eteṣāṃ kautukaṃ kuryā danyeṣāṃ ca vidhīyate || 7.26 || haimaṃ raipyaṃ tathātāmraṃ kāṃsyaṃ caivārakūṭakaṃ | āyasaṃ sīsakaṃ caiva trapukaṃ ceti dhātujaṃ || 7.27 || haimantu śrīpradaṃ proktaṃ raupyaṃ rājyapradāyakaṃ | tāmraṃ putrasamaddhyarthaṃ kāṃsyaṃ vidveṣakārakaṃ || 7.28 || proccāraṇe cārakūṭa māyasaṃ kṣayakāraṇaṃ | sīsaṃ nīraugakaraṇaṃ trapurāyurvināśanaṃ || 7.29 || evaṃ tu lohajaṃ proktaṃ tato dārujamucyate | devadāruśśamīvṛkṣaṃ pippalaṃ nandanaṃ tathā || 7.30 || asanaṃ khadirañcaiva vakulaṃ śaṅkhi vātanaṃ | mayūrapadmaḍuṇḍūka karṇikāraṃ tathaiva ca || 7.31 || nibūkāñjanikācaiva plakṣamauduṃbaraṃ tathā | etairvarjyāstu? catvāro dvijātikramayogataḥ || 7.32 || mṛṇmayaṃ dvividhaṃ proktaṃ pakvāpakvaṃ tathaiva ca | pakvaṃ ca nāśakaṃ caivaṃ apakvaṃ sarvasiddhitaṃ || 7.33 || nimittadarśanam - (śubhanimittāni) yasmindeśe śilāstīti gacchenniścitamānasaḥ | prayāṇakāle śakunā śśubhāśśubha phalapradāḥ || 7.34 || śubhavākyodakuṃbhāsthi gajarājadvijottamāḥ | carmamāṃsadadhikṣīra dundabhidhvanayaśśubhāḥ || 7.35 || (aśubhanimittāni) aśobhanāṃstathāvakṣyeśapamānā yathāyati | vikīrṇakeśāvipraikyaghṛtatailāktadarśanaṃ || 7.36 || riktakuṃbhanirodhokti tailabhājanadarśanaṃ | prayāṇakāle naṣṭāstu viparītaphalapradāḥ || 7.37 || śubhe prayāṇaṃ kartavyaṃ sthitvā śobhanalakṣaṇaṃ | śilāṃ prāpya śubhesthāne vāstuhomaṃ samācareth || 7.38 || vaiṣṇavaṃ pauruṣaṃ sūktaṃ śrībhūsūktaṃ tathaiva ca | pariṣekaṃ tataḥkṛtvā kalaśānpañca sunyaseth || 7.39 || mṛdgandhākṣatajapyāṃśca sarvauṣadhyudakantathā | saṃsthāpyābhyarcya pādyādyai ntattaddevāṃ tsamarcayeth || 7.40 || abhiṣiñcecchilāṃ sūtre? muhūrtekaraṇānvite | atodevādimantreṇa śilāṃ chitvāvicakṣaṇaḥ || 7.41 || adhobhāgaṃ mukhaṃ tatra śira ūrdhva prakalpayeth | pūrvataścottare vātha śirobhāgaṃ prakalpayeth || 7.42 || mukhaṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ tathāpādaṃ pārśvaṃ caiva śirastathā | lāñchayitvā vidhānena tatastakṣaṇa mācareth || 7.43 || bālā ca yuvatī vṛddhājñātavyā lakṣaṇānvitā | snigdhā mṛdvī natā caiva bālā kṣīrasvarātathā || 7.44 || susvarā kā ntisaṃyuktā yuvatī sā śilā smṛtā | asitā jhargharā rūkṣā vṛddhā yā nissvarāśilā || 7.45 || bālā kṣayapradā proktā yuvatī susamṛddhidā | kāryanāśakarī vṛddhā grāhyā jñātvāśilāstathā || 7.46 || mūrdhanastakṣaṇaṅkṛtvā śilādoṣāṃntu lakṣayeth | śilāṃ pralipyakṣīreṇa sarpiṣā sīsagairikaiḥ || 7.47 || ekarātroṣitaśilāṃ saṃprakṣālyāṃbhasātataḥ | śilādoṣaṃ parīkṣyaiva kartavyaṃ vidhicoditaṃ || 7.48 || rekhābinduḥ kalaṅkaśca śilādoṣāḥ prakīrtitāḥ | maṇḍalaṃ tu bhavettatra yatra garbhaṃ vinirdiśeth || 7.49 || site tu maṇḍale sarporaktetu kṛkalāsakaṃ | pīte tu maṇḍale godhā mañjiṣṭhe darduro bhaveth || 7.50 || kapile mūṣikā proktāsitavarṇe tu vṛścikaḥ | śvetaraktavimiśretu vṛścikaśśvetaraktake || 7.51 || raktamiśretu maṇḍūko maṇḍalobhaveth | siṃdūravarṇe khadyotaḥ kapote gṛhagaulikā || 7.52 || guḍavarṇetu pāṣāṇaṃ nissvaśobhe jalaṃ bhaveth | varjayedgarbha saṃyuktāṃ vimalairañcintāṃ tathā || 7.53 || vimalaṃ hemakāṃsyākhyaṃ lohākhyaṃ catridā smṛtaṃ | parīkṣyaivaṃ prakartavyameva meva pramāṇataḥ || 7.54 || prāsādagarbhamānaṃ vā hastamānamathāpi vā | pratyekaṃ tritribhedaṃ syāddvāramānaṃ pravakṣyate || 7.55 || dvārādadhyardhakaṃ caiva dvārātpādādhikaṃ tathā | madhyamaṃ ca kanīyassyāddvāramevaṃ vidhīyate || 7.56 || adhamottamayormadhye tvaṣṭadhā kārayedbudhaḥ | kanīyastrīṇi vijñeyaṃ trīṇi madhyamakaṃ tathā || 7.57 || trīṇi cottamakaṃ vidyādutsedhaṃ navathā bhaveth | staṃbhādadhyardhakaṃ tuṅgamuttamaṃ tu viśeṣuḥ || 7.58 || uttamādhamayormadhye dvāramānena yojayeth | garbhagehasamaṃ madhyaṃ tripādaṃ cādhamaṃ bhaveth || 7.59 || pādādhikaṃ tu vijñeyaṃ śreṣṭhamevaṃ vidhīyate | (uttamādhamayormadhye dvāramānena yojayet) | hastamānaṃ tadhāvakṣye navahastaṃ tadhottamaṃ || 7.60 || ṣaḍaṅgulaissahānyāntu sārdhadvihastakāvadhi | evamutsedhamānantu sthāvarasya praśasyate || 7.61 || jaṅgamānāṃ bhavennāma mūlaberavaśāttathā | biṃbodayaṃ caturviṃśadbhāgānaṣṭāṃśakaṃ tathā || 7.62 || biṃbodayaṃ caturviṃśadbhāgānaṣṭāṃśakaṃ tathā | vedāṃśaṃ tu bhaveduccaṃ jaṅgamasya prakīrtitaṃ || 7.63 || mānāṅgulena saptādi dvidvyaṅgulavidhānataḥ | pañcāśatsavanāṅgulyā vidhissarvovidhīyate || 7.64 || mūlaberāṃgulānmānamārabhyaikādaśāṃgulaṃ | dvidvyaṅgulavivṛddhyātu saṣaṣṭitṣaṅgulaṃ? bhaveth || 7.65 || pratyekaṃ tu tribhedaṃ syāduttamādhamamadhyataḥ | utkṛṣṭaṃ navatuṅgaṃ syānmadhyamaṃ navatuṅgakaṃ || 7.66 || nikṛṣṭaṃ tu tathā proktaṃ saptaviṃśatituṅgakaṃ | etairuttamamānaṃ syāsmadhyamaṃ ca tathaiva hi || 7.67 || karmārcotsavasnānācca yojyaṃ syādanyadhā natu | adhamaistu bhavedyatra baliberaṃ vidhīyate || 7.68 || mātrāṃgulena yanmāraṃ gṛhārcāṇāṃ tu nānyathā || 7.69 || iti śrīvaikhānase bhagavacchāstre bhṛguproktāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prakīrṇādhikāre saptamo'dhyāyaḥ <8> athāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ pīṭhamānam atha pīṭhodayaṃ paścātthsānakasya viśeṣataḥ | bhuvaṅgasya samaṃ vātha adhyarthaṃ triguṇaṃ tu vā || 8.1 || paritaḥ pāvayorasya nītvāvai bhāgamaṅgulaṃ | dhruvārcāyāmaśeṣeṇa ṣaṇmānasahitaṃ śubhaṃ || 8.2 || vakṣyāmi devyormānaṃ tatkaṇṭhāntaṃ nāsikāntakaṃ | hanvastaṃ bāhusīmāntaṃ nābhyantaṃ vādha kārayeth || 8.3 || caturdhaikāṃśakaṃ vāpi tṛtīyaikāṃśakaṃ tu vā | dhruvārcāyāṃ viśeṣeṇa pīṭhamevaṃ prakalpayeth || 8.4 || caturaśraṃ suvṛttaṃ vā dalaiṣṣoḍaśabhiryutaṃ | sthānakaṃ cāsanaṃ vāpi yānakaṃ vā samācareth || 8.5 || garbhāgāratribhāgaikaṃ caturaśraṃ trimekhalaṃ | tasyordhvavedivistāraṃ caturaṅgulameva hi || 8.6 || utsedhaṃ tasya cārdhantuparitaścaturaṅgulaṃ | vistārotsedhamānantu madhyenimnaṃ ṣaḍaṅgulaṃ || 8.7 || udīcyāntu pratīcyāntu vārimārgantu kārayeth | prāṅmukhodaṅmukhaṃ sūtraṃ daśa sapta samarcayeth || 8.8 || madhye kalāpadaṃ brāhmaṃ parito daivikaṃ tathā | vaidāthikāśītipadaṃ mānuṣaṃ ca tathaiva ca || 8.9 || padaṃ syātṣaṇnavatikaṃ ṣaṣṭiḥpaiśācikaṃ bhaveth | arcāsthānaṃ tu brahmāṃśaṃ tridhā kṛtya ca daivikaṃ || 8.10 || tathaiva paścime bhāge madhye vā sthānakāya ca | asanaṃ vāpi ca tadhā devamānuṣamadhyame || 8.11 || śayānaṃ mānuṣe pīṭhe sthāpayitvā viśeṣataḥ | dhruvārcane viśeṣeṇa nāgasūtrānsamarpya ca || 8.12 || koṣṭamekāna pañcāśadbhavati brāhmamandiraṃ | daivikaṃ cāṣṭabhāgantu mānuṣaṃ cārtvijaṃ padaṃ || 8.13 || śeṣaṃ paiśācamevaṃ syācchāntipauṣṭikadaivikaṃ | brahmasthāne viśeṣaṇa sthāpayedyogavīrakau || 8.14 || bhogameva dhruvārcāyāṃ devamānuṣamadhyame | vīrakaṃ sthāpayedvidvānpaiśāce kramaśassudhīḥ || 8.15 || grāmamadhye dhruvārcāyāṃ sthāpayedbhogameva tu | yogapīṭhe dhruvārcā cettadgrāmasya vipadbhaveth || 8.16 || anyeṣāṃ tu dhruvārcāyāṃ bhogaṃ vā yogameva vā | ālayoddakṣiṇe vāpi vūrve vāpi prapāṃ tathā || 8.17 || vediṃ tanmadhyame kuryādbiṃbādhyardhapramāṇataḥ | sabhyāgnikuṇḍaṃ tatprācyāṃ snānavediṃ tathottare || 8.18 || bhūmiyajñaṃ ca kṛtvātu paryagni prokṣaṇaṃ careth | kalaśaissaptabhissnāpya vedyāmāropayettathā || 8.19 || ācchādya navavastreṇa kautukaṃ bardhayettathā | prākṣīraśśāyayettatra śrībhūmyorubhayorapi || 8.20 || mahākāyakṛte bere prokṣayetpañcagavyakaiḥ | anyatsarvakriyāṃ kṛtvāhautraśaṃsanamācareth || 8.21 || ādimūrtyādi sarvāstamāvāhanamathācareth | avāhanakrameṇaiva nirupyājyāhutīryateth || 8.22 || vaiṣṇavaṃ pauruṣaṃ sūktaṃ viṣṇusūktaṃ tathaiva ca | śrībhūsūktaṃ tato hutvā brāhmaṃ raudrantathaivaca || 8.23 || nṛttairgeyaiśca vādyaiśca rātriśeṣaṃ vinīya ca | snātvā prabhāte tvācāryo devamutthāpya cādarāth || 8.24 || garbhāgāraṃ praviśyaiva sthāpite vihite'pi vā | nyasya pīṭhantu tanmadhye ratnādīnvinyasettadā || 8.25 || dhruvasūktena saṃsthāpya ato devādimuccaran | tattanmantreṇa devyādīnsthāpayedvihite pade || 8.26 || vidhinā cāṣṭabandhantu saṃyojyaiva tu pūrayeth | antahomaṃ tato hutvā dadyādācāryadakṣiṇāṃ || 8.27 || śilbinaṃ ca samāhūya śarkarāṃ lepayetkramāth | śilāpratiṣṭhā caivaṃ syāddārusaṃgrahaṇaṃ tataḥ || 8.28 || dārusaṃgrahaṇaṃ candanaṃ khadiraṃ tālamasanaṃ | raktacandanam rājānaṃ ciribilvañca aśokaṃ stimitaṃ tathā || 8.29 || khādiraṃ dhanvinaṃ caivaśirīṣaṃ padmakaṃ tathā | ityevamādayo vṛkṣā gṛhyante berakarmaṇi || 8.30 || caṇḍālasthānapārśve tu duṣṭaprāṇiniṣevite | mātṛsthānasamudbūte? śmaśāne devamandire || 8.31 || kūpavāpītaṭākānte munivāse sahālaye | yogasthānapade dharmaśālāyāṃ mārgamadhyame || 8.32 || pretabhūtālaye corasattvānāṃ ca niṣevite | prasthānaśalabhasthāne kalpāsdhinilaye'pi ca? || 8.33 || sauṣṭābhūtasamudbhūtadeśe? rauṇika deśake | evaṃ sthāne samudbhūtaṃ na gṛhṇanti drumaṃ tataḥ || 8.34 || pādānapāvanaṃ tardhi maśaneryātipīḍanaṃ | asākṣikaṃ sarpanilayaṃ bahuvalmīka saṃyutaṃ || 8.35 || sujanaṃ taruṇaṃ rūkṣaṃ bahupakṣasamākulaṃ | asthiraṃ bahucakraṃ ca suśākhaṃ caikaśākhinaṃ || 8.36 || karmāntaragṛhitaṃ ca karmāntaraprayojanaṃ | evamīdṛgvidhaṃ vṛkṣaṃ varjayedberakarmaṇi || 8.37 || āmūlāgraṃ samaṃ vṛttamṛjuṃ caiva pradakṣiṇaṃ | vistārayāmasaṃpannaṃ śubhāyaiva samāyutaṃ || 8.38 || sumadhyavayasopetaṃ kālapuṣpaphalapradaṃ | īdṛgvidhaṃ mahāvṛkṣaṃ śūlārthaṃ parigṛhṇate || 8.39 || evaṃ lakṣaṇa saṃpannaṃ drumaṃ gatvā prasannadhīḥ | tanmūle gomayenāpi lepayeccaturaśrakaṃ || 8.40 || divyalakṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ drumaṃ kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ | "vanarājebhya' ityuktvāpāyasaṃ ca baliṃ dadeth || 8.41 || paraśaṃ ca samādāya secayetpañcagavyakaiḥ | mūlamantraṃ japitvā tu dhmāyedviṣṇuṃ parātparaṃ || 8.42 || paraśuñca samādāya bhedayettu vicakṣaṇaḥ | payaḥ parisrave tatra śubhamevaṃ vidhīyate || 8.43 || śoṇitaprasrave tatra nirdaśedaśubhaṃ punaḥ | pūrvaṃ tupatanaṃ śastamāgneyyāṃ tu bhayāvahaṃ || 8.44 || yāmyāyāṃ maraṇaṃ vindyānnairṛtyāṃ vyādhimādiśeth | paśmimetu janānāṃ tu kṣutpipāsāvivardhanaṃ || 8.45 || vāyavye ca bhavellābha uttare dhanadhānyakaṃ | aiśānyāṃ śāntikaṃ tatra sarvavṛddhikaraṃ nṛṇāṃ || 8.46 || tadvṛkṣapatane kālekośassarvomṛdurbhaveth | sihavyāghragajādīnāṃ sarvasaṃpatkaraṃ bhaveth || 8.47 || vṛkṣāgraṃ bhevayitvā tu tvacaṃ samyagvyapohya ca | prakṣālyavāriṇā śvetacandanenānulepayeth || 8.48 || śvetavastreṇa saṃdeṣṭya jayamaṅgalaghoṣaṇaiḥ | rathevā śakaṭe vāthaskanthe vā kṣipya veśayeth || 8.49 || grāmaṃ pradakṣiṇaṅkṛtyā svastisūktaṃ samuccaran | śiṣṭacchāyesame deśetālukopariśāyayeth || 8.50 || hemarūpyakṛtaṃ śūlaṃ sarvasaṃpatsamṛddhidaṃ | lohairanyairnakartavya mabhicārasya kāraṇaṃ || 8.51 || viṣṇuśūlaṃ tu keśānāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ paṭṭikameva ca | dhyeyaṃ meḍhrādayaśbordhvaṃ samaṃ bhāgasya yattrayaṃ || 8.52 || ūrukeśāntaparyantaṃ tasyārthaṃ ca takaṃ mukhaṃ | sarandhrayavakaṃ cordhve mānaśūlaṃ śirodharaṃ || 8.53 || hikkāyāṃ ṣaḍyavaṃ pañcāṅgulaṃ nābhyantakaṃ mataṃ | trayodaśāṅgulayavaṃ tato meḍhrantu nābhyadhaḥ || 8.54 || yonernābhesturyādaśraṃ brāhmamaṣṭoṃataṃ tataḥ | hikkāstaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ bhāgaṃ tato vṛttaṃ śivāṃśakaṃ || 8.55 || uṣṇīṣaṃ mātṛkaṃ śūlaṃ sthānādīnāṃ sanātanaṃ | sthānāsanaśayānānāṃ caturaśrāṣṭavartulaṃ || 8.56 || yathākrameṇa yuñjīyādevaṃ vā pūrvamuktavath | sarveṣāṃ devatānāṃ ca sāmānyaṃ ca turaśrakaṃ || 8.57 || caturmātrārdhavistāraṃ śūlamūlaviśālakaṃ | agratāraṃ caturmātramaṣṭāṃśonamathāpi vā || 8.58 || dvātriṃśadaṅgulāyāmaṃ vakṣodaṇḍasya cocyate | tarma? vistṛtayorbāhye mātṛsūtrasamordhayoḥ || 8.59 || vakṣodaṇḍāyataṃ svena mukhena dviguṇaṃ mataṃ | uktvāsamantu bāhyagretatsaptāṃśavihīnakaṃ || 8.60 || tāraṃ saptāṅgulaṃ teṣāṃ yena sārthaṃ trimātrakaṃ | ṣoḍhaśāṣṭa caturmātrāyāmatārasamanvitaṃ || 8.61 || kaṭidaṇḍaṃ bhavettasya pārśvamadhyamanimnakaṃ | kṛtvaiva nimnakaṃ vakṣodaṇḍamadhye prakalpayeth || 8.62 || śeṣayorvaṃśadaṇḍe tu nābhyantaṃ nimnamadhyakaṃ | dakṣiṇe mūlamadhye tu agraṃ kuryāddvayorapi || 8.63 || vakṣodaṇḍasyamūlāgre śikhā sūdasradāyataṃ | kālāṅgulakalātāraṃ kalārdhavipulaṃ mataṃ || 8.64 || evaṃ caturbhujaṃ kṛtvādvibhuje dviśikhaṃ tathā | catasraśśibikā stasmāttasyā mevāṣṭabāhuke || 8.65 || yāvanto bāhavastasmiṃ stāvatyaśca śikhā matāḥ | adhyardhāṅgulavistāraṃ śikhāyāmaṃ tadeva hi || 8.66 || kaṭidaṇḍaṃ śikhāyāmaṃ tāre dvitṣaṅgule kramāth | vina?dvimātrameva syāddviśikhaṃ kaṭidaṇḍakaṃ || 8.67 || śroṇibhāgādadhastena śeṣayedvaṃśadaṇḍakaṃ | ūrudaṇḍālayaṃ saptaviṃśadaṅgulamucyate || 8.68 || jānubhāgaṃ tato jaṅghā pyūrdhvadaṇḍasamāyatā | pādabhāgābhave dūrurjaṅghayorjhānumānakaṃ || 8.69 || āropya mānayejjānudaṇḍasyāsaṃbhavādapi | pādadaṇḍe samāropya mānayettalatuṅgakaṃ || 8.70 || ūrudaṇḍaviśālaṃ syānmūlebhāgaṃ tadaśrake | kalāṅgulaṃ tadekaṃ syājjaṅghāmūlaviśālakaṃ || 8.71 || kalāviśālaṃ jaṅghāgraṃ kalāyāmaṃ daśāṅgulaṃ | trimātrakalamūlasya tāramagre'dhikāṃgulaṃ || 8.72 || saptaviṃśati vāgroṣaṃ daṇḍadīrghaṃ tataḥ kalā | korparassyātprakoṣṭhasya dīrghaṃ daśakalāṅgulaṃ || 8.73 || prakoṣṭhabāhvairāropya korparaṃ jānuvadbhaveth | tṣaṅgulaṃ dvyaṅgulaṃ bāhudaṇḍamūlāgravistaraṃ || 8.74 || prakoṣṭhaṃ daṇḍamūlasya viśālaṃ cadvimātrakaṃ | adhyardhāṅgulamagrasya viśālaṃ lakṣaṇānvitaṃ || 8.75 || vakṣodaṇḍaśikhāmadhye bāhumūlagate śikhe | bāhumūlagatābhyāṃ tu vakṣodaṇḍaśikhāgatāṃ || 8.76 || śeṣayedagrabhāgebhyaḥ korpare śeṣayettataḥ | prakoṣṭhamūlagābhyāṃ tu vakṣodaṇḍaśikhāgatāṃ || 8.77 || kaṭidaṇḍorudaṇḍābhyāṃ taccheṣaṃ bāhudaṇḍavath | jānukorparamuddiṣṭaṃ tasyatu dviśikhemataṃ || 8.78 || śeṣayennalakānāntu prakoṣṭhe tu bhavedbudhāḥ | prasāritānāṃ pādānāṃ jānusandhautu gṛhyatāṃ || 8.79 || tathaiva visṛjānāṃ ca budhānāṃ korparaṃ mataṃ | sthānādīnāṃ kramāschūlasaṃghātaṃ vakṣyate'pi ca || 8.80 || vaṃśadaṇḍaṃ tathā vakṣye daṇḍaṃ ca kaṭidaṇḍakaṃ | jānudaṇḍadvayaṃ caiva pādadaṇḍadvayaṃ tathā || 8.81 || bāhudaṇḍāśca catvāra ścatvāraśca prakoṣṭhakāḥ | tathā caraṇadaṇḍau dvau daṇḍāssapta daśa smṛtāḥ || 8.82 || kaṭidaṇḍārdhamārabhya yāvadāsīnarapi | tārassyātpṛṣṭhaphalakā tāramūrau ca bandhayeth || 8.83 || kaṭidaṇḍādadhastācca vakṣodaṇḍadharastathā | yojayedupayānīlaṃ? pṛṣṭhato vṛttameva vā || 8.84 || vaṃśadaṇḍaṃ tathā tena kleśayedviśikhena tu | śikhāgrasuṣīre kīlaṃ lohaṃ vā skāmathāpi vā || 8.85 || dārḍhyārthaṃ yojayecchūlaṃ sthitaṃ vai śūlakarmaṇi | anyatkīlaṃ tu suṣiraṃ kartavyaṃ kathañcana || 8.86 || evaṃ sthānasya saṃproktamāsanasya pravakṣyate | meḍhramūlādadhomūlaṃ nāhamaṣṭāṃgulaṃ bhaveth || 8.87 || bhāgamāsanamānasya bhāgaṃ śvabhrapraveśanaṃ | meḍhrasūtrasame samyakśeṣayetkaṭidaṇḍakaṃ || 8.88 || kaṭidaṇḍaśikhāhyūru daṇḍamūlaśikhāni ca | āsane śayane caiva jānusandhiḥ praśasyate || 8.89 || ekonaviṃśatiśśūladaṇḍānāṃ tu samākṛtiḥ | neṣyate korpare saṃdhiśayane daṇḍahastake || 8.90 || tasmādatha daśa proktā śūlasaṃkhyā caturbhuje | pañcānye dvibhuje daṇḍa daṇḍā haste caturdaśa || 8.91 || dakṣiṇe vakṣodaṇḍasyāyatamekādaśāṃgulaṃ | śikhā pūrvavaduddiṣṭā bāhumūlaśikhānvitā || 8.92 || tayorupari cābhogaṃ chāyayecchāstravittamaḥ | kaṭīḍaṇḍadvayādanyatsthānasyoktavadācareth || 8.93 || uktaṃ hi śayane yāne vakṣyatetha trivikramaṃ | uddaṇḍasyorudaṇḍasya śikhā bhāgāyate smṛte || 8.94 || tāvatyaḥ kaṭidaṇḍasya śikhāyāssamyaganvaye | tadāyataṃ tu kāryārthaṃ taladaṇḍaṃ tu taddvitaṃ || 8.95 || sthitāṅghristhsitimānproktaśśeṣaṃ cedaṃ śayānavath | evamaṣṭabhujopetaṃ caturbhujasamanvite || 8.96 || śūlasaṃkhyānurūpeṇa yojayettu vicakṣaṇaḥ | śūlaṃ cakratanau vakramavakre vakratāṃ nayeth || 8.97 || strīṇāṃ śūlavibhāgantu lakṣmyādīnāṃ pravakṣyate | nāsāmānavibhāgaṃ ca śūladaṇḍāyataṃ mataṃ || 8.98 || bhāgatāraṃ bhavedvaṃśaṃ daṇḍaṃ taccaturaśrakaṃ | yaduktaṃ bāhuparyantaṃ tāraṃ tasmāddvipārśvayoḥ || 8.99 || bāhumūlaviśālārdhaṃ tyaktvā yāvattadantaraṃ | tāvattu paramaṃ vakṣodaṇḍasyāyāmamucyate || 8.100 || kacchāṃśonaṃ karākāraṃ kaṭidaṇḍāyataṃ mataṃ | ūrutāraṃ tu turyāṃśā dūrudaṇḍaviśālakaṃ || 8.101 || jaṅghādaṇḍaṃ tribhāgaikaṃ tāvaśce?daṣṭāṃśadaṇḍakaṃ | mūlameva mataṃ caiṣāmagramaṣṭāṃśahīnakaṃ || 8.102 || pārśvadaṇḍaṃ na yoktavyaṃ strīṇāṃ śūle kathaṃ cana | puruṣāṇāṃ prayoktavya madhyardhāṅgulivistaraṃ || 8.103 || sarveṣāmasi tālānāṃ śūlamevaṃ vidurbudhāḥ | bhuvaṅgasya samaṃ proktaṃ sthānake pīṭhakonnataṃ || 8.104 || bhuvaṅgoparitālaṃ syāddhruvapīṭhasya connatiḥ | dhruvaberasya pādasya pratidikcaturaṅgulaṃ || 8.105 || vistāramūrdhvavedyāntu padmapatradalairyutaṃ | maṇḍalaṃ caturaśraṃ vā pīṭhaṃ kuryāttadarhakaṃ || 8.106 || daivikaṃ tu tridhā kṛtvā dvibhāgaṃ puratastyajeth | apare sthānakaṃ sthāpya madhyabhāge'tha vā pulaḥ || 8.107 || devamānuṣayārmadhye vā'sanaṃ saṃprakalpayeth | kiṃ ciddaivikasaṃyukte mānuṣe śayanaṃ smṛtaṃ || 8.108 || evaṃ samyagviditvaiva māsane ca pravakṣyate | dhruvaberaṃ tathā kṛtvā cordhvaṃ siṃhāsanocchrayaṃ || 8.109 || tadarhavistṛtaṃ prokta mupadhānena saṃyutaṃ | pādāśrayeṇa pīṭhena padmākārau? ca saṃyutaṃ || 8.110 || yathāsaindaryakaṃ kṛtvā śeṣaṃ yuktyā samācareth | berāyāmaṃ caturbhāgaṃ śayanocchrāyamucyate || 8.111 || tatturīyāṃśakotsedhaṃ śirobhāge viśeṣataḥ | pādayorubhayoścaiva samaṃ tatraiva mūhya ca || 8.112 || śeṣabhogaṃ trirāveṣṭya pañcavarṇasamāyutaṃ | adhaḥpucchaṃ śiraścordhvaṃ sarpadehe tu veṣṭite || 8.113 || tadutsaṃgagataṃ devaṃ śayānaṃ saṃpracakṣate | phaṇānāṃ pañcakaṃ kuryādviṣavegasamanvitaṃ || 8.114 || evameva prakurvīta sthānāsanaśayānakān | pīṭhaṃ kṛtvā prayatnena sthāpanāraṃbhamācareth || 8.115 || aṅkurānarpayitvaiva yāgaśālāṃ prakalpayeth | śilāsthāpanasārgeṇa sarvaṃ kṛtvāprayatnataḥ || 8.116 || athācāryaḥprabhāte tu snātvā nityaṃ samāpya ca | yajamānasamāyukto garbhagehaṃ praviśya ca || 8.117 || sthānāsanaśayānānāṃ padamuktaṃ vicārya ca | pīṭhaṃ tadarhakaṃ kuryādyuktenaiva vidhānataḥ || 8.118 || pratiṣṭhoktakrameṇaiva ratnanyāsaṃ samācareth | ācāryasthāpakādīnāmṛtvijāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadeth || 8.119 || śūle sārthaṃ samādāya gāyatrīṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ japan | sthāpayeddevadevasya śūlaṃ devyostataḥkramāth || 8.120 || ādhāradaṇḍayoḥ paścācchiṣṭadaṇḍānniyojayeth | puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvātu sabhyamagniṃ visṛjya ca || 8.121 || tataśśilpinamāhūya śāstrīyaṃ priyadarśanam? | vastrairābharaṇaiścāpi pūjayitvānvavekṣya ca || 8.122 || rajjubandhādikaṃ karma beroktaṃ tatra kārayeth | atrānuktaṃ tataḥ kuryācchilpaśāstroktamārgataḥ || 8.123 || iti śrīvaikhānase bhagavacchāstre bhṛsuproktāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prakīrṇādhikāre'ṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ <9> atha navamo'dhyāyaḥ rajjubandhanam athātassaṃpravakṣyāmi rajjubandhavidhiṃ kramāth | yathoktaṃ ca mṛdassarvāssamāhṛtya vidhānataḥ || 9.1 || saṃpiṣya śodhayitvaiva yathoktaṃ sarva mauṣadhaṃ | cūrṇāni ca yathoktāni kaṣāyāṇi vidhānataḥ || 9.2 || yojayitvā yathābhāgaṃ gavyairapi ihaivaca | niryāsena kapiddhasya yuktaṃ nādeyavāriṇā || 9.3 || peṣayitvā mṛdā samyaksaṃpiṣya ca vidhānataḥ | sādhayitvātha vā vāmaṃ sārdhaṃvāpi nidhāya ca || 9.4 || nālikerasya sāreṇa trivṛtāṃ rajjumāhareth | sarajjuṃ bandhayecchūlaṃ yathātatsudṛḍhaṃ tathā || 9.5 || bandhayitvāṣṭabandhaṃ ca śūlamālipya sarvaśaḥ | mṛdaṃ ca tāṃ samādāya śūla mālopayettathā || 9.6 || śūlopari pramāṇaṃ yaccaturbhāgaṃ vibhajyaca | tattribhāgaṃ mṛdākuryā drajjubandhasamāyutaṃ || 9.7 || ghaṭaśarkarayā vastramauktikairvarṇakairyutaṃ | pūraye danyabhāgaṃ ca tatpramāṇavidhānataḥ || 9.8 || śarkarāṃ ca samālipya paṭaṃ saṃyojya pūrvavath | mauktikākṛti mālipya bhūṣaṇāni prakalpyaca || 9.9 || yathoktena vidhānena varṇānapi suyojayeth | mṛṇmayaṃ dhravaberaṃ cetkāraye devamaiva tath || 9.10 || ardhacitraṃ na kurvīta dhruvaberaṃ tu mṛṇmayaṃ | śūlārdhaṃ tu dvayaṃ kuryāttāmranālasamāyutaṃ || 9.11 || khādiraṃ tāmradaṇḍaṃ vābhittisthaṃ sudṛḍhaṃ careth | chidraṃ kṛtvātadādhāre śūlaṃ yantreṇa yojayeth || 9.12 || dṛḍhaṃ tadyojayitvaiva berapṛṣṭhasya madhyame | tatpṛṣṭheskandhamadhye ca tadādhāreṇa yojayeth || 9.13 || śūle chidraṃ nakartavyaṃ kuryācchetsa vinaśyati | tāmreṇa dhruvaberaṃ cenmadhūcchiṣṭavidhānataḥ || 9.14 || mṛṇmayaṃ dvividhaṃ prokta mapakvaṃ pakvamityapi | pūrvoktaṃ mṛṇmayaṃ yattadapakva mabhidhīyate || 9.15 || mṛdākṛtvāgvinādagdhaṃ yattatpakvamitīritaṃ | apakvaṃ mṛṇmaye viṣṇoḥ kārayettu vidhānataḥ || 9.16 || yadi pakvaṃ tu kuryācchettadvināśakaṃ bhaveth | yogādisthānāni sthānaṃ caturvidhaṃ vindyādyogaṃ bhogaṃ tathaiva ca || 9.17 || sṛṣṭiḥ saṃhāra ityeṣāṃ sthānabhedaḥ pravakṣyate | sarvato bhadrakaṃ nandyāvartakaṃ śrīpratiṣṭhitaṃ || 9.18 || svastikaṃ parvatākāraṃ vṛttabhedaṃ tathaivaca | pralīnaka mathodyogaṃ padmañcaiva caturmukhaṃ || 9.19 || brahmādīśānaparyantaṃ krameṇaiva niveśayeth | yogakāntaṃ bhavedyogaṃ sthānakasya vidhīyate || 9.20 || caturaśraṃ vṛttagehaṃ prāsādaṃ sthānakasya tu | āsanānāṃ caturbhedaṃ pūrvoktena krameṇa tu || 9.21 || pralīnaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ vimānaṃ vā caturmukhaṃ | viṣṇuchandavimānaṃ ca śrīpratiṣṭhitakaṃ tathā || 9.22 || parvatākṛtikañcaiva nandyāvartaṃ tathaiva ca | mahāpadmavimānaṃ ca pralīnaka vīmānakaṃ || 9.23 || aṣṭāṅgaṃ sarmatobhadraṃ citraśilpaṃ tathaiva ca | mahāpadmaṃ ca vṛttaṃ ca caturmukhavimānakaṃ || 9.24 || evaṃ vimānakaṃ caiva āsanasya vidhīyate | svastikaṃ vṛttabhadraṃ ca vṛttagarbha mavedikaṃ || 9.25 || prekṣya gṛhālpabhūrājachandaṃ ca śrīpratiṣṭhitaṃ | martalaṃ ca śanairyogaṃ mārtāṇḍaṃ ca catuṣphuṭaṃ || 9.26 || gaṇikāviśālaṃ saṃśuddhaṃ svastikaṃ dhvajamānakaṃ | evamākhyāya tantrāṇi vartulādyāyutāni ca || 9.27 || śayānakena yogyāni kathitāni manīṣibhiḥ | āyādivicāraḥ āyavyayādi ṛkṣāṃścayoniḥ paścādvidhīyate || 9.28 || berodayaṃ triguṇitaṃ śiṣṭamāyaṃ nage hṛte | caturbhirguṇitaṃ sapta sauravārādikaṃ dinaṃ || 9.29 || berocca maṣṭaguṇitaṃ saptaviśadibhirhṛtaṃ | śiṣṭa maśvyādibhaṃ vindyāttaccheṣaṃ syāccaturguṇaṃ || 9.30 || randhrehṛte navāṃśaṃ taccheṣaṃ bhāṃśayugairhṛtaṃ | berodayaṃ triguṇitaṃ yonissyā daṣṭabhirhṛtaṃ || 9.31 || āyādhikye śubhaṃ prokta mṛṇavṛddhirvyayādhike | vāreṣu saurisūryārairvinānye śubhadāssmṛtāḥ || 9.32 || taskaraṃ bhuktiśaktī ca dhanaṃ rājyaṃ klibādi ca | nirhṛtya cādhanaṃ preṣyaṃ tannāmasadṛśaṃ phalaṃ || 9.33 || nāmakartṛnṛparkṣādyā nāmarkṣānuguṇaṃ bhaveth | yadākāraṃ dhruvākāraṃ tadākāraṃ ca kautukaṃ || 9.34 || āsane sthānakaṃvāpi śayāne sthāna māsanaṃ | deve sthite na devyau ca āsīne sthānakāsane || 9.35 || viparītaṃ na kurvīta sarvaśāstraviśāradāḥ | tālaniyamaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ prādurbhavaṃ tālaṃ kevalaṃ keśavasya tu || 9.36 || taddevīnāṃ sarasvatyā madhyamaṃ daśatālakaṃ | candrendrānalakīnāśavaruṇānilaśūlinaḥ || 9.37 || ṛṣayo vasavo rudrā mārkaṇḍeyo'mito bhṛguḥ | āryāścaiva guho hīnadaśatālamitā matāḥ || 9.38 || maruto'pi ca yakṣeśadevavadhvaśśubhāgrahāḥ | tadhānyetu tridhā sādhyā navatālamitā matāḥ || 9.39 || daityayakṣeśa? randhāśca siddhagandharvacāraṇāḥ | kujārkarāhava śśreṣṭhanavatālena sammatāḥ || 9.40 || navatālairmunīṃścaiva gaṇāṃścaiva tu mānayeth | uṅgāścāraṇāścānye navatālamitodayāḥ || 9.41 || martyāścāṣṭāyatāḥ proktāḥ pretānāṃ saptatālakaṃ | ṣaḍyamāḥ kubjakāḥ proktā vāmanāḥ pañcatālagāḥ || 9.42 || bhūgatānāṃ catustālaṃ kinnarāstu tritālakāḥ | kūśmāṇḍā dvitayāścaiva kabandhā stvekatālakā? || 9.43 || śreṣṭhamadhyakaniṣṭhāni tritālānāntu tatra nai | pravakṣyāmi madhūcchiṣṭakriyāṃ pratividhānataḥ || 9.44 || yajamānagṛhevāpi ālaye vā manorame | alaṅkṛtya vitānādyaiḥ kuṇḍa maupāsanaṃ kriyāth || 9.45 || āghāraṃ vidhivatkṛtvā vaiṣṇavaṃ ca yajettathā | viṣṇusūktaṃ ca hutvātu brāhmaṃ raudraṃ tathaiva ca || 9.46 || vīśaśaiṣikacakrāṃśca vighneśaṃ ca suhūyate | tasyāgnerdakṣiṇe kuryā dvrīhibhi sthsaṃḍilaṃ tathā || 9.47 || caturaśraṃ tato vṛttaṃ samāstīrya yathā śubhaṃ | cakraśaiṣikavīśāṃśca krameṇaiva supūjayeth || 9.48 || śodhitaṃ tu madhūcchiṣṭa mādāya praṇavena tu | "iṣetvorje'tveti mantreṇa pradhānāṃgaṃ prakalpayeth || 9.49 || akṣarāṇi ca sannyasya caivaṃ dhyātvābhimṛśya ca | vaiṣṇavaṃ ca tato hutvā devā nanyānvisṛjya ca || 9.50 || devyādīnpārṣadāṃ statra tattanmantreṇa hūyatāṃ | tatsiddhaṃ śilpihaste tu nidhāyaiva hariṃsmaran || 9.51 || yathā nagendriyaṃ grāhyaṃ yoniṣveva samarpayeth | tathā tantu gṛhītvaiva sthāpanīyantu garbhakaṃ || 9.52 || mānonmānapramāṇena matimānśilpinācareth | śanairālipya saṃśoṣya mṛdbhiśca bahirāyasaiḥ || 9.53 || paṭṭairābaddhya vidhinā punarālipya śoṣayeth | yajamānānukūlarkṣe pūrvavaddhoma mācareth || 9.54 || tathā tulyaṃ ca saṃsthāpya jalatulyakrameṇa vai | yuktāṃ siddhiṃ ca saṃprāpya taṃ ca garbhaṃ pratāpayeth || 9.55 || śanairmṛdbhedanaṃ kṛtvā vidhinā beramāhareth || 9.56 || iti śrīvaikhānase phagavacchāstre bhṛguproktāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prakīrṇādhikāre navamo'dhyāyaḥ <10> atha daśamo'dhyāyaḥ aṅkurārpaṇam ataḥparaṃ pravakṣyāmi bhūparīkṣādikarmaṇāṃ | devadevasya viṣṇortu vidhinā cāṃkurārpaṇaṃ || 10.1 || navame saptamevāpi pañcame vātṣahe'tha vā | ālayābhimukhe vāpi aiśānye cottare'pi vā || 10.2 || rudrahastaṃ dvijātīnāṃ nṛpāṇāṃ navahastakaṃ | vaiśyānāṃ munihastantu śūdrāṇāṃ pañcahastakaṃ || 10.3 || ṣoḍaśastaṃbha saṃyuktaṃ caturdvārasamāyutaṃ | maṇḍapaṃ vāta kūṭaṃ vā prapāṃ vā vidhinā careth || 10.4 || gomayālepanaṃ kṛtvā "śāmya'ntviti ca? mantrataḥ | śvetatanttulacūrṇaṃ vā sudhācūrṇa mathāpi vā || 10.5 || sūkṣmacūrṇaṃ ca kṛtvā tu vālukairmiśritaṃ tathā | prāgragaṃ cottarāgraṃ ca "somaṃrā'jeti mantrataḥ || 10.6 || yugmaṃ ca srāyitvātu darśanīyaṃ ca sundaraṃ | cakravālādyalaṅkṛtya pālikāṃkuraśobhitaiḥ? || 10.7 || madhyecakraṃ ca kṛtvātu darśanīyaṃ ca kārayeth | vitānaisstaṃbhaveṣṭaiśca darbhamālādyalaṅkṛtaṃ || 10.8 || dharmaṃ jñānaṃ ca vairāgya maiśvaryaṃ ca catuṣṭayaṃ | antastsaṃbha catuṣkośe sthāpayedadhidevatāḥ || 10.9 || bāhyānāṃ dvādaśādityā dvādaśānāntu devatāḥ | arcayitvā yadhānyāyyaṃ tattadvidhimadhācareth || 10.10 || pañcahastaṃ trihastaṃ vā ekahasta mathāpivā | pañcaviṃśatpadaṃ kṛtvā madhye brahmāsanaṃ careth || 10.11 || saṃcārārthaṃ phavantyaṣṭa paritaśca padāni vai | prāgādimadhyamāḥ proktā dvārā ścatvāra evaca || 10.12 || śeṣitārkapade dhīmānpālikānāṃ sthitiṃ careth | vrīhibhi staṇḍulairvāpi paṅktiṃ kuryā dvidhānataḥ || 10.13 || ṣoḍaśāṃgula māyāmaṃ yathālābhasamunnataṃ | trivedisahitaṃ kuryā dvedāśraṃ brāhma māsanaṃ || 10.14 || pūrvadvārottare śeṣaṃ dakṣiṇadvārapūrvake | vakratuṇḍasya pīṭhaṃ syātpaścimadvāradakṣiṇe || 10.15 || paṅktīśa muttaradvāra paścime somapīṭhakaṃ | kuṃbhe vātha samabhyarcyettatpūrveśānta marcayeth || 10.16 || ṣaṇṇāṃ pīṭhaṃ prakalpyaiva brahmaṇa ścoktavaccareth | aindrādica tathaiśāntaṃ jayādyapsarasor'cayeth || 10.17 || āḍhakaṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā pādaṃ vā taṇḍuraiḥ pṛthak | bāhye'ṣṭāṃgulivistāre pīṭhe vā sthaṇḍile'pivā || 10.18 || caturaśraṃ suvṛttaṃ catrikoṇaṃ dhanurākṛti | daṇḍākāraṃ ca padmābhaṃ vasvaśraṃ samavṛttakaṃ || 10.19 || jayādīnāṃ kramātpīṭhaṃ pālikābāhyata śchareth | dikpālānāntuśaktaśce nmaṇḍalāni tu kārayeth || 10.20 || bhūmyāṃ vā pūjayettadvatkuśakūrceṣu satvaraḥ | caturaśraṃ trikāṇaṃ ca suvṛttaṃ vajrameva ca || 10.21 || ardhacandraṃ ca ṣaṭkoṇaṃ vṛttaṃ nūpurameva ca | digīśamaṇḍalākāra manyeṣāṃ caturaśrakaṃ || 10.22 || aśvadthapallavaṃ dūrvāṃ kuśaṃ cābaddhya madhyame | pālikādīnkrameṇaiva mṛdā vāpūrayecchuciḥ || 10.23 || gāyatrīmantramuccārya praṇavenādāyamantravith | medinīmantra muccārya caiśānyādiṣu pālikāḥ || 10.24 || sannyasyaiva tataḥ kuṃbhāndvāravāme ca sannyaseth | "rākāmahaṃ' samuccārya dvāradakṣiṇataḥ punaḥ || 10.25 || "sinīvā'līti mantreṇa ācāryaḥ sannyasetkramāth | jātikrameṇa caiśāstaṃ pālikānāṃ pade pade || 10.26 || brahmaṇo dakṣiṇe pārśva ācārya ścottarāmughaḥ | brāhmamāsana māsthāya devadeva manusmaran || 10.27 || brahmādyānhṛdayātpūrvaṃ praṇidhyāṃ sanniveśayeth | sthaṇḍilopari kūrceṣu pātrā dāvāhayetkramāth || 10.28 || caturmukhaṃ caturbāhuṃ sarvābharaṇa būṣitaṃ | abhayaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ hastaṃ vāmamūrupratiṣṭhitaṃ || 10.29 || kuṇḍikā makṣamālāñca vahantaṃ dakṣavāmayoḥ | padmāsanasthaṃ hemābhaṃ śyāmavastrañca padmajaṃ || 10.30 || mūrtimantraissamāvāhya brahmāṇaṃ prāṅmukhaṃ yajeth | prāgdvāre prāṅmukhaṃ caiva dakṣiṇadvārake tathā || 10.31 || pratyagdvāravimāne'pi cottaradvārake tadhā | abjajaṃ prāṅmukhañcānyānyathāvidhi ca saṃsmareth || 10.32 || bhavanaṃ prāṅmukhādīnāṃ prāṅmukhaśca prajāpatiḥ | paṅktimadhye samabhyarcye dbrāhmamantraṃ samuccaran || 10.33 || hemāṅgaṃ pītavastraṃ ca dvibhujaṃ padmadhāriṇaṃ | sdhitaṃ karaṇḍikāmauliṃ śeṣaṃ tatpaścimāmukhaṃ || 10.34 || anantaṃ sarvanāgānā madhipaṃ vāruṇīpatiṃ | phaṇasaptakasaṃyuktaṃ sitābhaṃ prāñjaliṃ smareth || 10.35 || pravālābhaṃ gajamukha māsīnaṃ cottarāmukhaṃ | kadalīcūtapanasapāśāṃkuśadharaṃ prabhuṃ || 10.36 || ekadaṃṣṭraṃ caturbāhuṃ vagratuṇḍaṃ smaredbudhaḥ | pītāṃbare taṃ śyāmābhaṃ khaḍgakheṭakadhāriṇaṃ || 10.37 || dvibhujaṃ karaṇḍikāmauliṃ paṅktīśaṃ prāṅmukhaṃ smareth | sitaṃ śyāmāṃbaraṃ saunyuṃ dvibhujaṃ daṇḍadhāriṇaṃ || 10.38 || karaṇḍamakuṭasaṃyuktaṃ susthitaṃ dakṣiṇāmughaṃ | abhrābhāṃraktavastrāntāṃ dvihastāṃbujadhāriṇīṃ || 10.39 || sarvabhūṣābhūṣitāṅgāṃ jayāmaindrapader'cayeth | nīlābhāṃ pītavastrāṃ tāṃ dvikarāṃbujadhāriṇīṃ || 10.40 || bhūṣābhūṣitasarvāṅgāṃ vijayā manaler'cayeth | kumudābhāṃ haridvastrāṃ dvikarāṃpaṅkajāṅkitāṃ || 10.41 || nānābhūṣābhūṣitāṅgāṃ vindāṃ yāmyapader'cayeth | dhātakīpatra saṃkāśāṃ nīlanīlāṃbarāvṛtāṃ || 10.42 || dvikarāmaṃbujadharāṃ nandāṃnairṛtipader'cayeth | dhautābhāṃ pītavastrāṃ tāṃ dvihastāṃbujadhāriṇīṃ || 10.43 || puṣpābharaṇasaṃyuktāṃ puṣṭikāṃ vāruṇer'cayeth | svarṇābhāṃ raktavastrāṃ tāṃ dvihastāṃbujadhāriṇīṃ || 10.44 || kumudvatīṃ bhūṣitāṅgāṃ vāyavye cārcayetkramāth | raktābhā mabhrasaṃkāśavasanāṃ bhūṣaṇairvṛtāṃ || 10.45 || dvikarā maṃbujadharāṃ soṃye cotbalakāṃ yajeth | hāṭakābhāṃ haridvastrāṃ padmasaṃyutabāhukāṃ || 10.46 || sarvālaṅkāra saṃyuktāṃ viśogā marcayettataḥ | raktābhāṃ hāṭakābhāṃ ca hariṇīṃ nīlavarṇakāṃ || 10.47 || dhātakīpadra saṃtāśāṃ kumudotpalasannibhāṃ | aśokābhāṃ kramādetā dvibhujāḥ padmadhāriṇīḥ || 10.48 || viparītāṃbaradharāḥ sukhāsīnā stadāsanāḥ | jayādyāssarvabhūṣāṃgā dhyāyedatreti kecana || 10.49 || medinīṃ caiva rākāṃ ca sinīvālīṃ smaredbudhaḥ | medinīṃ pīdavastrāntāṃ śyāmāṅgīṃ dvibhujāṃ sthitāṃ || 10.50 || hastayoḥ pālikāṃ dhṛtvā sukeśīṃ taddigānanāṃ | pūrṇacandrapriyāṃ devīṃ pūrṇacandranibhānanāṃ || 10.51 || hemāṅgīṃ raktavastrāntāṃ rākāṃ kuṃbhadharāṃ sthitāṃ | śeṣaṃ tadvacchinīvālīṃ sitāṃgīṃ śyāmalāṃbarāṃ || 10.52 || śarāvaṃ dadhatīṃ manye medinīsadṛśāṃ tathā | dhyātvātattatpade samyagāsīnāṃ vātha cār'cayeth || 10.53 || bījesomaṃ tathā dhyātvā hastābhyāṃ bījadhāriṇaṃ | sthānakaṃ vāthacāsīvaṃ cottare dakṣiṇāmukhaṃ || 10.54 || evaṃ dhyātvā tatodeva māsanādibhirarcayeth | haviḥ samyaṅmi vedyaiva baliṃ vā dāpaye dbudhaḥ || 10.55 || jayādīnāṃ kramādvarṇaḥ prādakṣiṇyakrameṇatu | vitastiḥ pālikotsedhaṃ tadardhaṃ vipulaṃ mukhaṃ || 10.56 || adhovipulanāhena madhyanāhaṃ daśāṃgulaṃ | kuṃbhodayaṃ tu tattulyaṃ rasamātraṃ mukhāyataṃ || 10.57 || kuṃbhoṣṭhamiva vaktavyaṃ kuṃbhakukṣirdaśāṃgulaṃ | āśramadvāra saṃyuktaṃ śeṣaṃ tatpālikāsamaṃ || 10.58 || tārotsedhaṃ śarāvaṃ syānmukhaṃ tatpālikāsamaṃ | ālayasyottare vāpi aiśānye vā viśeṣataḥ || 10.59 || gomayenopalipyaiva medinīṃ tu samarcayeth | cakraṃ śāntaṃ samabhyarcya harettajjaṭhare mṛdaṃ || 10.60 || kāṃsyapātre nusannyasya śiṣyasya śirasi nyaseth | grāmaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā ālayaṃ vā pradakṣiṇaṃ || 10.61 || pālikādīnprapūryaiva gāyatrīmantra muccaran | aiśānyādiṣu koṇeṣu sthāpayettāśca pālikāḥ || 10.62 || dvāravāme tu kuṃbhaṃ syāccharāvaṃ dvāradakṣiṇe | navavastraissamāveṣṭya pālikādīnsamarcayeth || 10.63 || kaṅkumudgayavāścāpiniṣpāvāḥ sarṣapāstathā | caṇakā stilatilvāśca pātredhānyānicāhareth || 10.64 || haviḥpātraṃ tu saṃgṛhya vāyavye soma marcayeth | puṇyāhaṃ vācya tatkāle tūryaghoṣaṇa mācareth || 10.65 || "imebī'jeti mantreṇa vāpayedaṅkurāṃ stataḥ | viṣṇusūktaṃ samuccārya yajamānayuto guruḥ || 10.66 || "somaṃ rā' jeti mantreṇa vāpayedaṅkurāṃ stataḥ | vāruṇaṃ mantramuccārya jalanekaṃ tu kārayeth || 10.67 || śūdrastu yajamānaścennapapastrairguruṃ punaḥ | saṃpūjya dakṣiṇāṃ datvātatastenaiva vāpayeth || 10.68 || praṇavenārkapatrairvātathā cairaṇḍapatrakaiḥ | ācchādaye dyāvadantaṃ trikālābhyarcanaṃ mataṃ || 10.69 || atra devānvisṛjyaiva guptedeśe nidhāpayeth | vastrairnavaiḥ samācchādya pālikādīnsamarcayeth || 10.70 || amāvāsyāvyavahite kuryātsadyā eṃkurārpaṇaṃ | saṃkramavyavadhāne'pi sadya eveti ke ca na || 10.71 || sadyā eṃkuraścedrātrau vā divāvāpi ca kārayeth | tathā sarvakriyāṃ kṛtvā puṣpairvā taṇḍuraistathā || 10.72 || vāpayetkarmaṇa stasyasadya evatu kārayeth | pātrālābheśarāvevā yathālābhaṃ ca kārayeth || 10.73 || arcayettaṇḍulānśuddhānsadyaḥkālāṃkurārpaṇe | gṛhṇīyātpālikā eva navapañcaikakalpane || 10.74 || brahmaṇo'bhimukhecaikaṃ śeṣāntu paritodiśi | tattaddigīśa mabhyarcya tattanmantreṇacār'cayeth || 10.75 || eṣa eva viśeṣassyā danyatsarvaṃ khiloktavath | lakṣaṇaṃ ca tathaivoktaṃ tatraiva ca guṇāguṇāḥ || 10.76 || ajasradīpadānaṃ tu sarvatra vidhinā careth | karmānte jalamadhyetu nikṣipe dvijayāṃkurān || 10.77 || iti śrīvaikhānase bhagavacchāstre bhṛguproktāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prakīrṇādhikāre daśamo'dhyāyaḥ <11> athaikādaśo'dhyāyaḥ bhagavatpratiṣṭhāvidhiḥ athātassaṃpravakṣyāmi pratiṣṭhāvidhimuttamam supraśaste muhūrte vai pratiṣṭhāṃ kārayedbudhaḥ || 11.1 || ācāryalakṣaṇam vaikhānasena sūtreṇa niṣekādikriyānvitān | viprānvedavidaśśreṣṭhāndhārmikānjñāpatatparān || 11.2 || soṃyānjitendriyānśuddhānviṣṇorārādhane parān | ūhāpohavidhānena dhvastasaṃśayamānasān || 11.3 || patnyapatyayutānśāntānsnānaśīlānsurūpiṇaḥ | āhūya pūjyatatraikaṃ sarvakāryopadeśakaṃ || 11.4 || ācāryaṃ varayitvaiva tenoktaṃ sarva mācareth | bhūmiḥ parīkṣitā yena guruṇā vidhipūrvakaṃ || 11.5 || karṣaṇādipratiṣṭhāntaṃ karma tenaiva kārayeth | ūrdhvepyācāryakarmāṇi tatra tenaiva kārayeth || 11.6 || tadabhāve tu tatputraṃ pautraṃ naptārameva vā | tasyaiva bhrātaraṃ śiṣyaṃ praśiṣyaṃ gurumeva vā || 11.7 || sabrahmacāriṇaṃ vāpi pūrvābhāve tathottaraṃ | tadanujñāta mitara mācāryatve niyojayeth || 11.8 || anyadhā ce nmahāndoṣo rājā rāṣṭraṃ ca naśyati | kṣīyante varṇadharmāśca jāyate varṇasaṃkaraḥ || 11.9 || agnihotrā na sīdanti svādhyāyo na pravartate | viparītāni cānyāni bhaviṣyantyadharottaraṃ || 11.10 || tasmācchāstroktavidhinā sarvakarmāṇi kārayeth | śvetagandhānulepaiśca śvetapuṣpāṃgulīyakaiḥ || 11.11 || ācāryādīnsamaphyarcya namaskṛtya svadaivavath | "karmedaṃ me kuru'ṣveti yāce dācārya mādarāth || 11.12 || śiṣyaḥ samarpayetsarvaṃ bharamācāryapādayoḥ | ācāryaḥ suprasannātmā śiṣyānugrahatatparaḥ || 11.13 || tathaiveti susaṃkalpya kuryāccaivāṃkurārpaṇaṃ | aṅkurārpaṇakādūrdhva māraṃbhadivasādadhaḥ || 11.14 || kūśmāṇḍahoma mabjāgnaukārayedgururatvaraḥ | śuddhadantanakhaścaiva śvetavastrottarīyakaḥ || 11.15 || triṣavaṇasnānanirato haviṣyāśī jitendriyaḥ | evaṃ krameṇavai vidvānṛtvigbhiḥ sārthamācareth || 11.16 || araṇīṃ srukcruvaucaiva juhūmupabhṛtaṃ tathā | maṅgalāni ca darvīṃ ca toraṇāni yathākramaṃ || 11.17 || nyagrodhaplakṣā paśvadthaṃ pitṛvṛkṣayutaṃ tathā | toraṇārthaṃ samāhṛtya lakṣaṇena samanvitaṃ || 11.18 || athāṣṭamaṅgalaṃ vakṣyedvitālāyatameva ca | prādeśavistṛtaṃ kuryātṣaḍaṅgula mathāpi vā || 11.19 || ghanaṃ syāccaturaṅgulya? mata vā dvyaṅgulaṃbhaveth | tasya madhye likhe dvidvāntattadrūpaṃ pṛthakpṛthak || 11.20 || śrīvatsaṃ pūrṇakuṃbhaṃ ca bherī mādarśanaṃ tathā | matsyayugmāṅkuśau śaṅkha māvartaṃ cāṣṭamaṅgalaṃ || 11.21 || āvartalakṣaṇaṃ vakṣye pañcaviṃśatpadaṃ tathā | īśādinairṛtāntantu padaṃ tristriḥkrameṇa ca || 11.22 || pūrvamadhyamapāścātyapadānyevatu yojayeth | vāyuvye tvagnikoṇānta mudaṅmadhyamadakṣiṇe || 11.23 || antarālapadāṃścāṣṭau vinaiva tu vicakṣaṇaḥ | etaiśca saptadaśabhi rāvarta mabhidhīyate || 11.24 || śaṅkhacakragadācāpā asiḥ pañcāyudhānyapi | srucaḥ sruvasya daṇḍaṃ tu prādeśatraya māyataṃ || 11.25 || mūlaṃ prādeśamātraṃ syā dagranāhaṃ tadardhakaṃ | agre bilvaphalākāraṃ prādeśa pratimaṇḍalaṃ || 11.26 || dvyaṅgulaṃ syāttadāsyantu kartaṃ māṣadvayāvadhi | sruvamevaṃ prakurvīta dviprādeśa mathāpivā || 11.27 || juhūdaṇḍasamāyāmaṃ caturviṃśatakāṅgulaṃ | nāhaṃ tadardha mityuktaṃ padmasya mukulopamaṃ || 11.28 || ṣaḍaṅgulaṃ tu tasyāgraṃ nāhaṃ tasya vicakṣaṇaḥ | yugāṅgulāgravistāra maṣṭāṃgula mathāyataṃ || 11.29 || śeṣaṃ tu tṣaśra mityuktaṃ vistṛtonnata maṅgulaṃ | madhyagartānupūrvyeṇa juhvāścaivakramaṃ viduḥ || 11.30 || paścādupabhṛtaṃ kuryātprādeśatraya māyataṃ | prādeśaṃ nāhamityuktaṃ mūlādagraṃ tadardhakaṃ || 11.31 || ānupūrvyātkṛśaṃ daṇḍaṃ galāntamiti saṃjñitaṃ | ūrdhve prādeśamāyāmaṃ caturaśraṃ ṣaḍaṅgulaṃ || 11.32 || tadūrdhver'dhāṅgulāyāmaṃ kaṇṭha mevaṃ pracakṣate | śeṣaṃ tu tṣaśrakaṃ kuryāttatra tenaiva kārayeth || 11.33 || unnatāsyāṅgulārdhaṃ syādbhittyuccamiti kathyate | oṣṭha mekāṅgulaṃ jñātvā tanmadhyenimna mācareth || 11.34 || pūrṇacantrākṛtiṃ kṛtvā prādeśaṃ tasya nāhakaṃ | nimnaṃ caturyavāgāḍha magrāntastu kramādbudhaḥ || 11.35 || atha darvyāstathāyāmaṃ caturviṃśatikāṃgulaṃ | ṣaḍaṅgulaṃ tadagraṃ syātpucchaṃ pañcāṃgulaṃ bhaveth || 11.36 || śeṣaṃ trayodaśāṃgulyādaṇḍa mityucyate kramāth | mūlasthūlaṃ bhavennārī agrasthūlaṃ napuṃsakaṃ || 11.37 || mūlādagraṃ kramādvṛttaṃ puṃrūpa mītikathyate | darbhairmālāṃ ca kṛtvaiva tasyāṃ parvaṇi parvaṇi || 11.38 || dvaudvaudarbhau vivikṣipya dvitālaṃ laṃbayetkramāth | dvitālāyāmasaṃyuktaṃ khādiraṃ daṇḍameva ca || 11.39 || daśāṃgulaparīṇāhaṃ samavṛttaṃ tathaiva hi | śākhāṃgulasamāyuktaṃ mūlādagraṃ tu bandhayeth || 11.40 || tattāmrāyasapaṭṭairvābandhayitvā vicakṣaṇaḥ | tanmūle suṣiraṃ kṛtvā golakaṃ tatpramāṇakaṃ || 11.41 || evantu manthadaṇḍassyātkuryāttacchāstrapāragaḥ | śamījāta mathāśvadtha maraṇyarthaṃ pragṛhya ca || 11.42 || ṣaḍaṅgulaṃ tu vistāraṃ golakaṃ tu ghanaṃ bhaveth | dairghyaṃ tasya dvitālaṃ syātphalakāṃ kārayedbudhaḥ || 11.43 || tathaivopari paṭṭiṃ ca kṛtvā tatra vicakṣaṇaḥ | maiñjyaiva trivṛtāṃ rajjuṃ manthanārthāya kārayeth || 11.44 || daśāṣṭanavabhirhastairvastra māyata mucyate | tricatuḥpañcatālaṃ vāvistṛtaṃ vastramucyate || 11.45 || gavyaṃ ghṛtaṃ cāhareta kāpilaṃ tu gavādiṣu | ājaṃ ca māhiṣaṃ tyājyaṃ pakṣātītaṃ ca varjayeth || 11.46 || pādauprakṣālyacācamya pūrvodaṅmukha evavā | brāhmamāsasa māsthāya vaiṣṇavaṃ mantramuccaran || 11.47 || paristaraṇakūrcādīnsamithādīnpragṛhyaca | kūrcaṃ pradakṣiṇāvartaṃ gṛhṇīyā dvidhivittamaḥ || 11.48 || pramukhe dakṣiṇe vāpi yāgaśālāṃ prakalpayeth | yāgaśālā ṣoḍaśastaṃbhasaṃyuktaṃ maṇḍapaṃ kūṭamevavā || 11.49 || prapāṃ vā tatra kurvīta madhye kūṭaṃ ca kārayeth | nimnonnataṃ vibhajyaiva jalasthalasamīpakaṃ || 11.50 || pūrvoktena vidhānena alaṅkṛtya yathākramaṃ | madhye vediṃ prakalpyaivabiṃbādhyardha pramāṇataḥ || 11.51 || tadbahiḥpūrvabhāgetu sabhyakuṇḍaṃ prakalpayeth | sabhyasya pūrvabhāgetu kuṇḍa māhavanīyakaṃ || 11.52 || uttarevāpunaḥ kuryā daupāsanavidhānataḥ | sabhyasya dakṣiṇe kuṇḍaṃ paiṇḍarīkaṃ prakalpayeth || 11.53 || vedyāstu dakṣiṇekuṇḍamanvāhāryaṃ prakalpayeth | nairṛte devatāsthānaṃ kalpayetta dvicakṣaṇaḥ || 11.54 || vaidyāntu paścime bhāge gārhapatyaṃ prakalpayeth | vāyavye saṃcayasthānaṃ kalpayettadvidhānataḥ || 11.55 || vedyāstathottare bhāge tvāvasadhyaṃ prakalpayeth | aiśānye snāpanaśvabhraṃ kalpayettadvidhānataḥ || 11.56 || sabhyasya paiṇḍarīkasya maikhalātrayamucyate | anyeṣāṃ caiva kuṇḍānāṃ mekhalādvayameva hi || 11.57 || ekaikavedyā vistāra munnataṃ caturaṅgulaṃ | sabhyasya madhyamaṃ pañca padmasyādhaṣṣaḍaṅgulaṃ || 11.58 || aupāsananorthvavedyāssyā dunnataṃ tu dviyaṅgulaṃ | dakṣiṇottarayoścaiva saṃsthānaṃ brahmasomayoḥ || 11.59 || dvādaśāṃgulasaṃyuktaṃ caturaśraṃ suvṛttakaṃ | śalyaloṣṭatuṣāṃgāratṛṇabhasmādihīnayā || 11.60 || mṛdā vā vālukaistatra pṛthakkuṇḍaṃ prakalpayeth | yāgasthānasya pūrvetu prapāṃ kṛtvā vicakṣaṇaḥ || 11.61 || nayanonmīlanār'thāya yāgaśālāṃ prakalpayeth | nayanonmīlanam uktakriyāvasāne tu beramādāyacātvaraḥ || 11.62 || śilpinā śāstramārgeṇa kārayedakṣimocanaṃ | devasya pramukhe kuryāddhānyarāśiṃ viśeṣataḥ || 11.63 || hemaśruṅgāṃ raupyakhurāṃ savatsāṃ kāṃsyadohanāṃ | savatsāṃgāṃ samādāya devasya pramukhe nyaseth || 11.64 || ghṛtaṃ madhudadhikṣīraṃ gṛhītvā kāṃsyabhājane | rukmantatraiva nikṣipya dīpayuktaṃ tu vinyaseth || 11.65 || hemapātraistu sūcībhyāṃ rajatairvāpi cāhareth | hūlikāṃ tāṭanīñcaiva śīlāṃ lohamayasyavai || 11.66 || biṃbasya cottare pārśve vāstuhomaṃ yajettataḥ | paryagni caiva kṛtvātu prokṣayetpañcagavyakaiḥ || 11.67 || uttarābhimukho dehaghuddhiṃ kṛtvā gurustataḥ | hūlikāṃ tāṭanīñcaiva gṛhītvā mantrapūrvakaṃ || 11.68 || "viṣṇustvāṃ rakṣa'tvityuktvā viṣṇusūktaṃ ca saṃsmaran | paṭasya cāntardevasya mūrdhādīnsaṃspṛśetkramāth || 11.69 || viṣṇugāyatrī muccārya tatra karma samācareth | devībhyāṃ ca krameṇaiva tattanmastraṃ japettadā || 11.70 || paścāttupātre sūcībhyāṃ kṛhītvā cākṣimocanaṃ | ṣaṇmaṇḍalāni saṃskuryādadhideva manusmaran || 11.71 || pakṣmavarma ca raktañca śvetaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ ca taijasaṃ | etaistu maṇḍalaṃ dhyātvā dṛḍhīkṛtvātvaraḥ kramāth || 11.72 || hitvār'karāhusaurāṇā mudayantu dvilocane | nayanonmīlanaṃ kuryātsarvasaṃpatsamṛddhaye || 11.73 || andhanakṣatrake kuryātsarvanāśaṃ na saṃśayaḥ | puruṣasūktaṃ japitvaiva dakṣiṇe nayane nyaseth || 11.74 || tadhaiva vāmanetretu vaiṣṇavaṃ mantra muccaran | tatsūktābhyāṃ viśeṣeṇa śrībhūmyośca samācareth || 11.75 || devasyāṃgaṃ spṛśanhutvā maulimālādipūrvakaṃ | tathā devyośca hutvātu dadbhyassyāhādinā pṛthak || 11.76 || vimānaṃ nūtanaṃ cettu sdhūpyādīnāṃ hutaṃ careth | parṣadāṃ mūrtimantreṇa kārayenmantravittamaḥ || 11.77 || vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktañca sviṣṭākāraṃ ca hūyatāṃ | godānasūkta muccārya kavādīnabhimṛśya ca || 11.78 || paṭaṃ paścā dvisṛjyaiva gavādīnsaṃpradarśayeth | gavādidravya mādāya dadyācca gurave tataḥ || 11.79 || kautukādī nviśeṣeṇa pūrvoktena krameṇavai | berapīṭhe ca saṃpādya ratnādīni vinikṣipeth || 11.80 || ratnaṃ dhātūṃśca bījāni suvarṇaṃ cā'tra nikṣipeth | evaṃ saṃsthāpya matimānsaṃtāpyaiva dṛḍhaṃ yathā || 11.81 || dhruvaberoktavatkṛtvā nayanonmīlanaṃ careth | paścājjalādhivāsādīnkuryāttanmantrapāragaḥ || 11.82 || pañcagavyaṃ pragṛhyaiva prokṣayitvā vicakṣaṇaḥ | vasoḥpavitramityuktvātatra kāryaṃ samcareth || 11.83 || paścātkṣīraṃ samādāya prokṣayitvā samāhitaḥ | "śanno devī'ritiprocya tena karma samācareth || 11.84 || arthadarśī pragṛhyaiva devasyāgre nidhāyaca | pradīpa marpaye dvadvānjale tatrādhivāsayeth || 11.85 || evañcātrādhivāsyaiva cāsyabereṣuvai punaḥ | pañcagavyādhivāsaṃ ca tathā kṣīrādhivāsanaṃ || 11.86 || etaddvayaṃ vinā tatra kuryāttoyādhivāsanaṃ | grāme sarvatra tadrātrau prabhūtaṃ nikṣipedbaliṃ || 11.87 || iti śrīvaikhānase bhagavacchāstre bhṛguproktāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prakīrṇādhikāre ekādaśo'dhyāyaḥ <12> atha dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ bhagavatpratiṣṭhāvidhiḥ athapradoṣe dharmātmā jalasthaṃ devamuddhareth | snānadravyāṇi cāhṛtya devaṃ saṃsnāpya mantravith || 12.1 || kṣoṃapaṭṭādinā chādya maṇihemādikaiḥ punaḥ | vividhaiḥ puṣpamālādyairalaṅkṛtya manoharaṃ || 12.2 || yāna māropya deveśaṃ svaktisūktaṃ samuccaran | toyadhārāṃ puraskṛtya nītvā grāmaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ || 12.3 || śvabhrasya paścime bhāge sthāpayitvā viśeṣataḥ | uttare yāgaśālāyāṃ vāstu homaṃ samācareth || 12.4 || mathitvāgniṃ pragṛhṇīyā dvāstu homāgnimeva vā | saṃskṛtya vidhinādāya praṇaye dgārhapatyake || 12.5 || trissaṃskṛto laukikāgnirmathitāgnisamo bhaveth | āghāraṃ vidhivatkṛtvā vaiṣṇavāntaṃ samācareth || 12.6 || tato'nvāhāryakuṇḍe ca paścādāhavanīyake | āvasathyetatassabhye tataḥpadmānalekramāth || 12.7 || sūtroktena vidhānena sarvatrāghāramācareth | dvātriṃśatprasthasaṃpūrṇaṃ ghaṭamādāyacātvaraḥ || 12.8 || "iṣe tvorje'tvādi japantantunā pariveṣṭya ca | "śucī vo havya' ityuktvā kuṃbhaprakṣālanaṃ careth || 12.9 || nadītoyaṃ samādāya samutpūya ca pūrayeth | vastrayugmena cāveṣṭya alaṅkuryātprayatnataḥ || 12.10 || elātakkolakarpūrairgandhośīrākṣataiḥkramāth | anyairgandhayutaiḥ puṣpairvāsayitvā vidhānataḥ || 12.11 || suvarṇaratnadhātūṃśca nyasitvā mantravittamaḥ | govālakuśadarbhaiśca kṛtaṃ kūrcaṃ tu nikṣipeth || 12.12 || atha vā nikṣipetkūrcaṃ kṛtaṃ darbhaistu kevalaiḥ | asthi ratnaṃ sirā stanturmāṃso mṛtsnā prakīrtitā || 12.13 || śoṇitaṃ raktamṛdbhintu jalaṃ medastathaiva ca | śukrantu kūrcamityuktaṃ vastraṃ syāccarma vaiṣṭitaṃ || 12.14 || sapta dhātava ityete kuṃbheṣu karakeṣu ca | eteṣvekaṃ vinākuryānnāsti tatrāsya sannidhiḥ || 12.15 || devasya dakṣiṇe pārśve kuṃbhaṃ tatra niveśya ca | alaṅkṛtastathācāryo vastrābharaṇakuṇḍalaiḥ || 12.16 || sraggandhairveṣṭito dhṛtmā mukhasyoṣṇīṣabandhanaṃ | kuṃbhasya dakṣiṇe bhāge prāṅmukhodaṅmukho'pivā || 12.17 || svastikāsana māsthāya ṛjukāyaḥ samāhitaḥ | lalāṭādiṣu sthāneṣu keśavādīnpraṇamyaca || 12.18 || akārādyakṣaraṃ sarvaṃ nyasitvā sarvasandhiṣu | paścātkuṃbhaṃ susaṃtpṛśya kramātsūktādikaṃ japeth || 12.19 || ātmasūktantato japtvā pauruṣaṃ sūktameva ca | sūktamekākṣaraṃ japtvā viṣṇusūkta mataḥ paraṃ || 12.20 || śrībhūsūktaṃ tato japtvā "sahasraśīrṣaṃ'samuccaran | vaiṣṇavaṃ tu tatojaptvā dhyāyetsamyaksamāhitaḥ || 12.21 || prāṇāyāmaṃ tataḥ kuryātrecapūrakakuṃbhakaiḥ | etatphalaṃ kramādvakṣye trividhaṃ tatpṛthagvidhaṃ || 12.22 || tatraiva recakaṃ pūrvaṃ sarvapāpasyadāhakaṃ | paścāttu pūrakaṃ kuryā damṛtāpyāyanaṃ tataḥ || 12.23 || tṛtīyaṃ kuṃbhakaṃ kuryā damṛtatvaṃ ca saṃsmareth | tasmātsarvaprayatnena recakādīni kārayeth || 12.24 || kuṃbhagantu jalaṃ smṛtvā vāruṇaṃ maṇḍalaṃ budhaḥ | ardhacandrākṛtiṃ smṛtvā tasya bījākṣaraṃ nyaseth || 12.25 || tamoṅkāreṇa saṃveṣṭya bandhayuktaṃ? tu niśmalaṃ | ādityamaṇḍalāntasthaṃ devaṃ tatraiva cāhvayeth || 12.26 || ādibījaṃ suvarṇābhaṃ praṇavaiḥ pariveṣṭitaṃ | paścāddevaṃ samabhyarcya kuryā darghyānta marcanaṃ || 12.27 || biṃbaṃ kuṃbhaṃ ca saṃgṛhya snānaśvabhre niveśayeth | śvabhrasya pūrvabhāge tu daṇḍapaṅktiṃ ca kārayeth || 12.28 || kalaśaiḥ snāpayetsamya kcaturdaśabhirevatu | devaṃ sarvatra saṃsnāpya dīpāntaṃ ca samarcayeth || 12.29 || nairṛte viṣṭare nyasya nameddevāṃ tsamāhitaḥ | evaṃ devyau samādāya snāpaye datvaraṃ budhaḥ || 12.30 || pādyamācamanaṃ datvā devadevaṃ praṇamya ca | pātraṃ tu taṇḍulaiḥ pūrṇaṃ gṛhītvātra viśeṣataḥ || 12.31 || sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ vāpi kautukaṃ tatra nikṣipeth | atha vā tantu māhṛtya nyasitvā taṇḍulopari || 12.32 || tāṃbūlasahite pātre? devasyāgre nidhāyaca | puṇyāhaṃ vācya tatkālesvastisūktaṃ samuccaran || 12.33 || devasya dakṣiṇehaste devyoryai vāmahastayoḥ | "svastidā' vītimantreṇa kautukaṃ bandhayetkramāth || 12.34 || vedamantrajña ācāryo rakṣāmantraṃ samuccaran | ṣaḍdroṇaṃ dhānyamardhaṃ vā vedikopari cāstareth || 12.35 || tadardhaṃ taṇḍulāṃścaiva tadagdhaṃ tu tilānapi | tadagdhaṃ yavamādāya tadardhaṃ tilvameva ca || 12.36 || aṇḍajaṃ muṇḍajaṃ caivaromajaṃ vāmajaṃ tathā | carmajaṃ cāstaretpañca śayanaṃ vedikopari || 12.37 || alābhe tu tathaitaiṣāṃ pañcavastrāṇi vāstareth | mūrdhopadhānaṃ kartavyamūrdhve'nastaṃ samarcayeth || 12.38 || devaṃ devyau samādāya yaddigdvāraṃ tathā śiraḥ | śāyayecchayane vidvān"yadvaiṣṇava'miti bruvan || 12.39 || devyoścāpi tathā kuryāttattatsūktaṃ japetkramāth | uttarācchādanaṃ kuryādgalāntaṃ tatra nikṣipet? || 12.40 || śayyāvedyāstuparitassarvāndevāntsamarcayerth | iśānādikramāddevānbalyantantu samarcayeth || 12.41 || śaṅkaraṃ balirakṣaṃ ca vāgdevīṃ baliśrakrakau | agniṃ pavitraṃ śailūṣaṃ prācyāṃ pratyaṅmukhānkramāth || 12.42 || bhoṃaṃ guhaṃ ca durgāṃ ca yamaṃ mandaṃ ca nairṛtiṃ | rohiṇīṃ saptamātṝśca dakṣiṇe cottarāmukhān || 12.43 || paścime nairṛtādyādīnarcayettadanukramāth | vaiṣṇavīṃ puruṣaṃ caiva budhaṃ jyeṣṭhāṃ tathaiva ca || 12.44 || puṣparakṣakavāyū ca prāṅmukhāṃśca samarcayeth | vāyavyādīśaparyastaṃ dakṣiṇābhimūkhānkramāth || 12.45 || śukraṃ caiva bhṛguṃ śāntaṃ tathā sapta ṛṣīnapi | bhāgīrathīṃ kuberaṃ ca candraṃ bhūtāni cār'cayeth || 12.46 || dvāre dvāre ca dhātrādīndvāradevāntsamarcayeth | vimānaṃ parito bhyarcya nyakṣādīnarcayetkramāth || 12.47 || devasyāgre prasannātmā pūjayedanapāyinaḥ | bhūtadvayaṃ tathā tārkṣyaṃ tathā caivāmitaṃ budhaḥ || 12.48 || cakraśaṅkhāravindāni devasyāgrer'cayedbudhaḥ | vedānadhyāpayeddikṣu "ṛcāṃ prā'cīriti śrutiḥ || 12.49 || saṃbhāravedyāmāstīrya dhānyaṃ vastrovarikramāth | hemādipātre ratnādīṃ tsannyasyaivādhidaivataṃ || 12.50 || viṣṇumabhyarcya vidhinā kārayitvādhivāsanaṃ | viṣṇusūktaṃ samuccārya vastreṇācchādayedbudhaḥ || 12.51 || paścāddhotāramāhūya yathoktaguṇasaṃyutaṃ | pādauprakṣālya cācamya kūrcayuktaṃ samāhitaṃ || 12.52 || alaṅkuryācca puṣpādyaiḥ pañcāṅgocitabhūṣaṇaiḥ | sabhyasya pūrvabhāge tu paścimābhimukhaḥsthitaḥ || 12.53 || sabhyādhvaryuṃ samīkṣyaiva hotā praṇavamuccareth | "hotarehi' pade uktetato hotā samuccareth || 12.54 || "adhvaryo deva'tetyuktvā pādau prakṣālya cācameth | pūrvavattatra casthitvā "oṃ namaḥ pravaktre' bruvan || 12.55 || hotā ca nāma śarmāntaṃ saṃyojyaiva samuccareth | "bhūte bhaviṣya'tītyuktvā brūyād"dhiṃ'kārapūrvakaṃ || 12.56 || "bhūrbhuvassuva' rityeva prāṅmukhaśca pradakṣiṇaṃ | adadhyātsamidho'dhvaryuḥ pratyoṅkāraṃ tato'nale || 12.57 || hotrā"gne mahā'mityukteprabhauḥ pravara iṣyate | rājño vā rājapatmyā vā tathāmātyasya vā bhaveth || 12.58 || grāmaścedyajamānastu vasiṣṭhapravaraṃ vadeth | atha vā kārayedvidvānkāśyapravaraṃ vadan || 12.59 || vaiśyādanyatra jātīyo yajamāno bhavedyadi | tasya tu pravaraṃ hitvā kāśyapapravaraṃ vadeth || 12.60 || tata "āyātu bhagavā'nuktvā paścimadiṅmukhaḥ | viṣṇvādi bhūta paryantaṃ sarvamūrtī stadāhvayeth || 12.61 || nanadhoktena mārgeṇa pārṣadānāhvayedbudhaḥ | āvāhana krameṇaiva nirupyā'jyāhutīryajeth || 12.62 || sabhyāgniṃ ca paristīrya prāṇāyāmādipūrvakaṃ | "svasticai'veti hutvātu tathā caiva "prajāpateḥ' || 12.63 || "agnirdhīmata'yetyuktvā "ādityebhya'stathaiva ca | "viśvebhyo devebhya'ścaiva "marudgaṇebhya'eva ca || 12.64 || "bhūragnaye'caivamādyāścatasro vyāhṛtīryajeth | daśabhiśsataśastvetaissahasrāhutirucyate || 12.65 || sruveṇa srāvayanvidvānavicchinnaṃ samācareth | viṣṇusūktaṃ samuccārya sūktaṃ pauruṣameva ca || 12.66 || śrīsūktaṃ bhūmidaivatya matodevādi vaiṣṇavaṃ | ekākṣarādisūktaṃ tu viṣṇugāyatriyā yutaṃ || 12.67 || etaintu saptabhissūktaiścaturāvartya hūyatāṃ | etatkartumaśaktaścetsakṛdvātra samācareth || 12.68 || aṣṭākṣareṇa mantreṇa dvādaśākṣarakeṇa vā | vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇugāyatrīṃ juhuyāditi ke cana || 12.69 || tataścāhāvanīyāgnikuṇḍe samyagyathākramaṃ | yajetpuruṣasūktaṃ tu ṣoḍaśāvartya yatnataḥ || 12.70 || anvāhārvāgnikuṇḍe tu viṣṇusūktaṃ suhūyatāṃ | brāhmañca vyāhṛtīścaiva jayādīnjuhuyātkramāth || 12.71 || śrīsūktaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ caiva juhuyādgārhapatyake | āvasadthye viśeṣeṇa vaiṣṇavaṃ rudrasūktakaṃ || 12.72 || mahīsūktaṃ ca juhuyatsūktamekākṣarādikaṃ | paiṇḍarīke tu juhuyātpāramātmikasaṃyutaṃ || 12.73 || raktābjaṃ bilvapatraṃ ca śvetābjānāmasaṃbhave | ghṛtenāplutya juhuyādviṣṇugāyatriyā budhaḥ || 12.74 || samidājyaṃ carurlājāḥ sarṣapāśca yavāstathā | tilaṃ tilvaṃ tathā mudgā māṣāssakturguḍaṃ tathā || 12.75 || madhvapūpā dadhi kṣīraṃ homadravyamitīritaṃ | etaissaptadaśadravyairvaiṣṇavaṃ juhuyādbudhaḥ || 12.76 || juhvācaivopajuhvā ca viṣṇusūktaṃ suhūyatāṃ | sabhye ca vaiṇḍarīke ca sviṣṭākāraṃ vinā careth || 12.77 || agniṣvāhavanīyādiṣvantahomaṃ samācareth | ṛgādīṃśca caturdikṣu vedānadhyāpayetkramāth || 12.78 || evamadhyayanaṃ prokta"mṛcāṃ prācī'riti śrutiḥ | nṛttaigenyaiśca vādyaiśca rātriśeṣaṃ nayatkramāth || 12.79 || tataḥprabhāte dharmātmā snātvāsnānavidhānataḥ | brahmayajñaṃ ca kṛtvā tu japetsūktāni dvādaśa || 12.80 || pādau prakṣyālya cācamya devānuddhāpya mantravath | pūrvavastraṃ visṛjyaiva punaranyadvibhūṣya ca || 12.81 || brahmasthāne viśeṣeṇa pīṭhaṃ samyakprakalpayeth | tadūrdhve
