kalpayedvidvānnavabhāgaṃ vibhajya ca || 12.82 || pūrvoktena krameṇaiva ratnanyāse samācareth | sudhayā paripūryaiva kṣoṃenācchādayedbudhaḥ || 12.83 || yajamānastu tatkāle ācāryādīnpraṇamyaca | sapādanavaniṣkaṃ ca gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dadeth || 12.84 || pratyekaṃ sthāpakādīnāṃ pañcaniṣkaṃ dadettadā | sabhyādhvaryorviśeṣeṇa hotuścāpi tathaiva ca || 12.85 || paiṇḍarīkasya cādhvaryoḥ pratyekaṃ pañcaniṣkakaṃ | anyeṣvāhavanīyādiṣvadhvaryūṇāṃ catubhanveth || 12.86 || paṣanddhāmasu cādhvaryoranyeṣāṃ ca pṛthakpṛthak | niṣkaṃ pādādhikaṃ dadyātsaṃpūrṇamiti paṭhyate || 12.87 || ācāryasya niyogena dakṣiṇādānamīritaṃ | yajamānassvatantreṇa na kuryāditi śāsanaṃ || 12.88 || hantyalpadakṣiṇo yajño yajamānaṃ viśeṣataḥ | adakṣiṇaṃ tu yajanaṃ niṣphalaṃ tviti śāsanaṃ || 12.89 || muhūrte samanuprāpte vādyaghoṣasamanvitaṃ | toyadhārāsamāyuktaṃ svastisūktaṃ samuccaran || 12.90 || ācāryaḥ kuṃbhamādāya vrajetpūrvaṃ tataḥkramāth | nayeyusthsāpakāḥ paścāddevaṃ depyādisaṃyutaṃ || 12.91 || pradakṣiṇaṃ śanaigantvā devāgāraṃ praviśya ca | pīṭhasya dakṣiṇe bhāge dhānyapīṭhe prakalpite || 12.92 || ācāryassannyasetkuṃbhaṃ devaṃ cādāyacātvaraḥ | kautukaṃ brahmasthāne tu sthāpayitvā vicakṣaṇaḥ || 12.93 || "bhūrasi bhūṃ' ityuktvā pīṭhe devaṃ suyojayeth | tasya dakṣiṇapāśenvtu śrīdevīṃ sthāpayedbudhaḥ || 12.94 || tathaiva vāmapāśenvtu bhūmiṃ kuryātpratiṣṭhitāṃ | devasya vāmabhāge tu sthāpayedbiṃbamotsavaṃ || 12.95 || snāpanaṃ baliberaṃ ca dakṣiṇe sthāpayedbudhaḥ | viṣṇusūktaṃ ca japtyaiva puruṣasūktayutaṃ tathā || 12.96 || dhruvasūktaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ ca devībhyāṃ ca pṛthakpṛthak | śrībhūsūktaṃ pṛthakjaptvā paścānnyāsaṃ samācareth || 12.97 || "suvabhunvabhūn'rityuktvā cākṣarāṇi viśeṣataḥ | pādayorantare vidvānyakāraṃ vinyasettataḥ || 12.98 || biṃbasya hṛdaye samyaṅnyasedbījākṣaraṃ paraṃ | rukmābhaṃ paramaṃ bījaṃ sarvakāraṇakāraṇaṃ || 12.99 || taruṇārka sahasrābhaṃ brahmeśābhyāṃ namaskṛtaṃ | padmāsanasthaṃ deveśaṃ śrīvatkālaṅkṛtorasaṃ || 12.100 || śaṅkhacakradharaṃ soṃyaṃ sarvābharaṇa bhūṣitaṃ | "o'mityekākṣaraṃ brahma praṇavaḥ paripaṭhyate || 12.101 || "śrī'kāraṃ śriya ityuktvā "la'kāraṃ bhuva ityapi | kūrcenādāya tattoyaṃ kuṃbhasthaṃ śaktisaṃyutaṃ || 12.102 || "idaṃ viṣṇu'ssamuccārya samādāya samāhitaḥ | "āyātu bhagavā'nuktvādhruvaberasya mūrdhavi || 12.103 || viṣṇuṃ ca puruṣaṃ satyamacyutaṃ cāniruddhakaṃ | acale devadeveśo vyāpya tiṣṭhatīti śrutiḥ || 12.104 || "śriye jā'teti mantreṇa śriyamāvāhayedbudhaḥ | "medi'nīti ca mantreṇa hariṇīṃ samyagāhvayeth || 12.105 || kautukecautsavecaiva snāpane baliberake | praṇidhimuddhṛtya tatkāle dīpāddīpamiva kramāth || 12.106 || dhruvaberātsamāvāhya kūrcenāvāhayetkramāth | navadhā mārgamālokya yatheṣṭaṃ karturicchayā || 12.107 || avicchinnār'canaṃ nityaṃ vidhinaiva prakalpayeth | aśaktaścettathākartuṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ naiva kārayeth || 12.108 || āḍhyassarvasamastyāgī cikīrṣurviṣṇumandiraṃ | svārthaṃ kṛtvā tridhaikāṃśaṃ kuṭuṃbārthe vidhāya ca || 12.109 || aṃśābhyāmavaśiṣṭābhyāṃ vimānārcanamārabheth | āpadyapi ca kaṣṭāyāṃ na druhyedātmane budhaḥ || 12.110 || avicchinnā yathā pūjā vidhinā saṃpravartate | tathā prakalpayedvidvānbhūmibhogena vai sthitiṃ || 12.111 || arcakasyār'canār'thaṃ ca kuṭuṃbārthaṃ ca yatnataḥ | atyantapuṣkalāṃ bhūmiṃ bahusasyocitāṃ tathā || 12.112 || karagrahādi rahitāmarcakāya samarpayeth | tataśca tāmrapaṭṭādau lekhya sīmāviniścayaṃ || 12.113 || devanāmnaiva tāṃ bhūmiṃ dadyādarcakajīvikāṃ | idamagre prakurvīti tadadhīnā sthitirhareḥ || 12.114 || pitā haristu bhagavānarcakaḥ putra ucyate | putrasyana likhennāma sannidhāne pituḥkramāth || 12.115 || arcakassuprasannātmā harideva hi kevalaṃ | atha vā vilikhedvidvānnāmnā vā pūjaka sya ca || 12.116 || tathār'cakasya cāvāsamālayasya samīpataḥ | śilābhissudṛḍhaṃ kṛtvā vāsāyāsya praśasyate || 12.117 || akleśena yathā jīvedarcakassusamāhitaḥ | yāvaccandradivānāthaṃ tathā kuryātprayatnataḥ || 12.118 || arcake kleśayuktetu kliśyate bhagavānhariḥ | arcake tu susaṃtuṣṭe tadā tuṣṭo janārdanaḥ || 12.119 || rūpadvayaṃ hareḥ proktaṃ biṃbamarcaka evaca | biṃbe tvāvāhanādarvāksadā sannihitor'cake || 12.120 || punarvicintya dharmātmā yajamāno mudānvitaḥ | śaktilobhamakṛtvaiva karoti vibhavāntaraṃ || 12.121 || pañcaparvasu saṃkrāntau puṇyāheṣvitareṣu ca | viśeṣa pūjanārthañca havirarthaṃ ca yatnataḥ || 12.122 || snapanārthaṃ cotsavārthaṃ prāyaścittārthameva ca | naṭanartakadāsīnāṅgāyakānāṃ caśaktitaḥ || 12.123 || vidyārthināṃ ca bhaktānāmanyasya vibhavasya ca | vṛttiṃ tuparikalpyaiva bhūrūpāṃ purato hareḥ || 12.124 || dadātyācāryahaste tu mantrodakapurassaraṃ | anyeṣāṃ vibhavānāṃ catathaivānyapadārthināṃ || 12.125 || tattannāmnaiva bhūmyādiṃ dāpayeddeśikottamaḥ | ācāryasyāpi tannāmnā kalpayedvṛttimuttamāṃ || 12.126 || evaṃ yaḥ kurute bhaktyā aihikāmuṣmikaṃ phalaṃ | paśubhṛtyādibhogāṃśca vāhanādīnviśeṣataḥ || 12.127 || suvarṇaratnadhānyādīnatyantaṃ samavāpnuyāth | tasya kāyakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tatkṣaṇādeva naśyati || 12.128 || yaṃ yaṃ kāmayate sarvantaṃ tamāpnotyasaṃśayaṃ | pūrvajātigatāstasya pitaraḥ pituranvaye || 12.129 || mātṛpakṣe ca yejātāstasya mātāmahādayaḥ | sarvepi tridivaṃ yānti modante tridive ciraṃ || 12.130 || tato yāsyanti vaikuṇṭhaṃ nissamābhyadhikaṃ mahaḥ | yassamyakpālayedetadadhikaṃ yaśca vardhayeth || 12.131 || ādyeṣṭakādi nirmāṇaphalameva prapadyate | sarvāśubhavināśaṃ ca labdhvāceṣṭamavāpya ca || 12.132 || ante vimānamāruhya viṣṇoryāti paraṃ padaṃ | kiṃ bahūktena vidhinā na daivaṃ keśavātparaṃ || 12.133 || taṃ viṣṇuṃ pūjayennityaṃ sarvasādhanasādhanaṃ | sarvamuktipradaṃ nityaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradaṃ || 12.134 || grāmāgrahārayossamyagarcanaṃ tatra vāsināṃ | sarvasiddhipradaṃ nityaṃ putrapautrapravardhanaṃ || 12.135 || sāmānyamagni hotraṃ syādanagnīnāṃ tapodhanāḥ | sāgnīnāmapyavijñātaprāyaścittāya kalpate || 12.136 || tasmātkuryādavicchinnamarcanaṃ sarvayatnataḥ || 12.136 || iti śrīvaikhānase bhagavacchāstre bhṛguproktāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prakīrṇādhikāre dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ <13> atha trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ navaṣaṭpañcamūrtividhānam ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi navaṣaṭpañcamūrtikaṃ | viṣṇuṃ ca puruṣaṃ satyamacyutaṃ cāviruddhakaṃ || 13.1 || naranārāyaṇābhyāṃ tu vārāhaṃ nārasiṃhakaṃ | evaṃ tu navamūrtistu sthāpayitvā yadhāvidhi || 13.2 || viṣṇvādipañcamūrtīstu adimūrtintathākramāth | sthāpayettatkrameṇaiva ṣaṇmūrtikamihocyate || 13.3 || viṣṇvādīnāṃ tu pañcānāṃ sthāpanaṃ pañcamūrtikaṃ | daśāvatārakalpaḥ matsyaḥ kūrmovarāhaśca nārasiṃho'tha vāmanaḥ || 13.4 || rāmo rāmaśca rāmaśca kṛṣṇaḥ karkirime daśa | sargakāle tu bhagavānsṛṣṭvā vikhanasaṃ guruṃ || 13.5 || vedānupādiśattasmai lokasaṃrakṣaṇakṣamān | purā madhvādayaḥ kāle saṃbhūya bhuvi rākṣasāḥ || 13.6 || apāharaṃstu tānvedānbalātkṛtva vidhiṃ muhuḥ | tadā tu somakaṃ hantuṃ rākṣasaṃ raṇavikramaṃ || 13.7 || antarhitamakūpāre mātsyaṃ bhāvaṃ gato hariḥ | hatvā tu somaṅkaṃ paścādvedānabjabhuve dadau || 13.8 || grāmādiṣu ca sarvatra madhyame paścime'pivā | hastipṛṣṭhavimāne tu kuṃbhākāravimānake || 13.9 || dvitālenottamaṃ kuryānmānametadudāhṛtaṃ | avatārasya sarvasya kautukaṃ syācchaturbhujaṃ || 13.10 || viśeṣamatra vakṣyāmi pradhāne'bjāvale kramāth | hautrapraśaṃsanaṃ kṛtvā devatāvāhanaṃ careth || 13.11 || "matsyaṃ ca jalajaṃ ceti bhadraṃ krīḍātmakaṃ'tathā | evamādibhirāvāhya cānyatpūrvavadācareth || 13.12 || "yassvayaṃ sṛṣṭa'mityuktvā śatamaṣṭottaraṃ yajeth | yathoktenaiva mārgeṇa saṃsthāpya vidhinār'cayeth || 13.13 || kūrmaḥ devāsurārthaṃ mṛte kṛtayuge hariḥ | kacchapassamabhūddhartuṃ mandharaṃ taṃ mahācalaṃ || 13.14 || grāmādau vāstumadhye ca parvatāgre viśeṣataḥ | nandyāvartavimāne vā phelākāravimānake || 13.15 || ekatālena mānena kūrmarūpaṃ vidhīyate | kūrmarūpaṃ dhruvaṃ kuryātkautukaṃ tu caturbhujaṃ || 13.16 || pratiṣṭhāṃ pūrvavatkuryādgārhapatye viśeṣataḥ | hautramatra praśaṃsanti mūrtimastramathocyate || 13.17 || "akūpāraṃ kūrmarūpaṃ viṣṇuṃ ca vasudhādharam' | "akūpāraṃ jalaṃ kūrmaṃ kacchapaṃ'tviti ke ca na || 13.18 || samāvāhya tu taireva nirupyājyāhutīryajeth | "rāyāmīśa'ssamuccārya śatamaṣṭādhikaṃ yajeth || 13.19 || uktavatthsāpayedvidvānvidhinā samyagarcayeth | matsyakūrmau dvidhā proktaukiṃ cidbhedaṃ pracakṣate || 13.20 || dvibhujau kecidicchanti kecidiṣṭabhujau budhāḥ | varāhaḥ devamānuṣatiryañca sthāvarā jaṅgamāstathā || 13.21 || purāsṛṣṭā yathā sarve catvāro bhuvi jantavaḥ | jarāyujāṇḍajodbhijjanvedajāśceti jātitaḥ || 13.22 || evaṃ pravartamāne tu hiraṇyākṣo mahābalaḥ | rasātalamagāddhṛtvā carācaradharāṃ mahīṃ || 13.23 || mahāvarāhavapuṣā tāṃ tadoddhṛtavānhariḥ | varāhastrividhaḥ prokto devasyāviṣkṛtau punaḥ || 13.24 || kramādādivarāhaśca varāhaḥ pralayātmakaḥ | yajñavārāha ityevaṃ trividhissaṃprakīrtitaḥ || 13.25 || vimāne parvatākāre śrīpratiṣṭhitake tathā | daśatālena mānena devaṃ sūkaramācareth || 13.26 || catubānhusamāyuktaṃ śaṅkhacakradharaṃ paraṃ | vāmapādaṃ samākuñcya mahīmuddhṛtya sādaraṃ || 13.27 || dakṣiṇaṃ caṇḍitaṃ kuryānmahīmūrau samācareth | mahīṃ ca śyāmavarṇāṃ tu kuryāccaiva vidhānataḥ || 13.28 || evamādivarāhantu kārayellakṣaṇānvitaṃ | avāntaramanuprāpya yadā tu pralayaṃ hariḥ || 13.29 || tattoyamupasaṃhartuṃ varāhaṃ rūpamāsthitaḥ | tataḥ pralayavārāhaṃ purābhūtaṃ ca kārayeth || 13.30 || śaṅkhacakradharaṃ soṃyaṃ pītāṃbaradharaṃ hariṃ | dakṣiṇaṃ cābhayaṃ hastaṃ vāmaṃ kaṭyavalaṃbitam, || 13.31 || mahīṃ tu dakṣiṇe kuryātsaśyāmanibhāṃ tathā | sukhāsanakrameṇaiva cāsīnāṃ vā svalaṅkṛtāṃ || 13.32 || evaṃ pralayavārāhaṃ kārayettu vicakṣaṇaḥ | hiraṇyākṣaḥpurā rakṣo balavānbalināṃ varaḥ || 13.33 || vareṇa garvāddurbuddhiryajñavidveṣako'vṛdhath | avātarattadā viṣṇuvanrasūkaramūrtimān || 13.34 || hatvā sadaityaṃ sabalaṃ paścādyajñānnyavartayath | tasmādyajñavarāhaṃ tu tañca kuryādvidhānataḥ || 13.35 || śvetaṃ yajñavarāhaṃ tu śrībhūmibhyāṃ sahaiva vā | sukhāsane samāsīnaṃ kuryāllakṣaṇasaṃyutaṃ || 13.36 || trayāṇāṃ ca varāhāṇāṃ sthāpane bheda ucyate | pūrvoktena krameṇaiva sarvaṃ kṛtvā viśeṣataḥ || 13.37 || sabhyāgnikuṇḍe rātrautu hautraśaṃsanamācareth | "varāhaṃ varadaṃ viṣṇumurvīsaṃdhāraṇaṃ tathā || 13.38 || vajradaṃṣṭra'miti procya devamādivarāhakaṃ | "mahīṃ tāṃ pṛthulāmurvī'miti devīṃ mahīṃ kramāth || 13.39 || āvāhayedyathānyāyamanvatsarvaṃ samācareth | "vārāhaṃ pralayaharaṃ bhūteśaṃ viṣṇumeva ca || 13.40 || jagattrayātmakaṃ' coktvā varāhaṃ pralayātmakaṃ | "varāhaṃ devarūpaṃ ca yajñeśaṃ yajñavardhakaṃ || 13.41 || viṣṇuṃ' ceti tathā devaṃ yajñavārāhamāhvayeth | āvāhanādisarvatra pūrvavatkārayedbudhaḥ || 13.42 || "kṣmāmekā'miti mantreṇa yajedaṣṭottaraṃ śataṃ | hareruktavidhānena sarvaṃ pūrvavadācareth || 13.43 || nārasiṃhaḥ hiraṇyakaśipurnāma daityānāṃ prabalo'bhavath | vareṇa garvāddaityendro hiraṇyakaśipustadā || 13.44 || devairmṛgairmanuṣyairvā jīvibhirvāpyajīvibhiḥ | divā vā yadi vā rātrau vadho me na bhavediti || 13.45 || lokānudvejayamāsa tadā taṃ daityasattamaṃ | hantukāmaḥ kṛtodyogaścintayitvā hariḥ prabhuḥ || 13.46 || tatpālitapurādbāhye mahāparvatamastake | rakṣasā pīḍitairdevaiḥ prārthitaḥ karuṇānidhiḥ || 13.47 || narasiṃhavapurbhūtvā divā rātriṃ vyapohya ca | saṃdhyākāle'vadhīttantu bhuvaṅge sa nakhāyathaḥ || 13.48 || bāhyamābhyastaraṃ hitvā jīvājīvairnakhaiśśubhaiḥ | evaṃ daityavadhaṃ kṛtvā parvate'ntarabhūthariḥ || 13.49 || tatastamarcayedbhaktyā vijayārthaṃ vivṛddhaye | parvatākṛtike vāpi śrīpratiṣṭhitake'pivā || 13.50 || daśatālena mānena narasiṃhaṃ prakalpayeth | girijaṃ sthūṇajaṃ caiva sudarśananṛsiṃhakaṃ || 13.51 || tathā lakṣmīnṛsiṃhaṃ ca pātālanarasiṃhakaṃ | tathā pucchanṛsiṃhaṃ ca nṛsiṃhaṃ ṣaḍvidhaṃ viduḥ || 13.52 || siṃhāsane samāsīnaṃ sarvābharaṇa bhūṣitaṃ | nārasiṃhaṃ caturbāhuṃ śaṅkhacakradharaṃ paraṃ || 13.53 || pādau dvau ca samākuñcya nyasya siṃhāsane sthitaṃ | prasārya hastau dvau jānvostayorūrdhve nidhāya ca || 13.54 || vastreṇa corū baddhvaivamāsīnaṃ girijaṃ tathā | śriyaṃ kanakavarṇābhāṃ medinīṃ śyāmasannibhāṃ || 13.55 || brahmeśau vandamānau tu dakṣiṇottarayoḥ kramāth | vāhanaṃ sāmavedaṃ ca pramukhe saṃprakalpayeth || 13.56 || sāma śyāmanibhaṃ kuryātsarvābharaṇabhūṣitaṃ | bhūmīśo nāmagandharvo śaiṣikasthānamāśritaḥ || 13.57 || kārayeduktavarṇantaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaṃ | sthūṇajaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi sthūṇādāvirbabhau hariḥ || 13.58 || vāmapādaṃ samākuñcya dakṣiṇaṃ saṃprasārya ca | caturbhujadharaṃ devaṃ śaṅkhacakreca kārayeth || 13.59 || hastaṃ tu dakṣiṇaṃ pūrvaṃ kuryāddānakaraṃ tadhā | vāmahastaṃ prabaddhyaiva ūrau ca tu suvinyaseth || 13.60 || saṭākandharasaṃyuktaṃ tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭraṃ bhayānakaṃ | śaṅkhakundendudhavalaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣetaṃ || 13.61 || sudarśananṛsiṃhasya lakṣaṇaṃ saṃpravakṣyate | sūryakoṭipratīkāśaṃ cakraṃ vimalamujjvalaṃ || 13.62 || bṛhadbhānupuradvandvaṃ cakramadhye prakalpayeth | cakramadhye samāsīnaṃ nṛsiṃhamaruṇaprabhaṃ || 13.63 || atyantabhīṣaṇākāraṃ bhaktānāmabhayapradaṃ | cakrāyudhaṃ caturbāhuṃ devadevaṃ prakalpayeth || 13.64 || vakṣyelakṣmīrṛsiṃhasya lakṣaṇaṃ munisattamāḥ | vāmapādaṃ samākuñcya dakṣiṇaṃ saṃprasārya ca || 13.65 || vāmorau śriyamāsīnāṃ prāṃjalīkṛtavāstakāṃ | vāmahastena dehyaśca kurvantamupagūhanaṃ || 13.66 || dakṣiṇaṃ tvabhayaṃ kuryātparābhyāṃ śaṅkacakrake | pātālanārasiṃhākhyamāsīnaṃ pūrvavattathā || 13.67 || phaṇaistu pañcabhissamyakchannamūrdhānameva ca | dakṣiṇādakṣiṇaṃ hastaṃ varadaṃ kaṭīkaṃ tathā || 13.68 || vakṣye pucchanṛsiṃhastu pucchayuktaṃ tu kārayeth | abhayaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ hastaṃ vāmamūrupratiṣṭhitaṃ || 13.69 || dakṣiṇaṃ pādamākuñcya sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaṃ | nārasiṃhamidaṃ kṛtvāsthāpanāraṃbhamācareth || 13.70 || tatracāhavanīyāgnau hautraśaṃsanamācareth | "nārasiṃhaṃ taponāthaṃ mahāviṣṇuṃ mahābalaṃ || 13.71 || bhaktavatsala' mityuktvā narasiṃhaṃ samāhvayeth | "taponidhiṃ' samuccārya śatamaṣṭādhikaṃ yajeth || 13.72 || snāpanaṃ cotsavaṃ caiva hareriva vidhānataḥ || 13.73 || iti śrīvaikhānase bhagavacchāstre bhṛguproktāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prakīrṇādhikāre trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ <14> atha caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ daśāvatārakalpaḥ (vāmanaḥ) athātassaṃpravakṣyāmi vāmanasya kramaṃ yathā | vairocanasutohyugro balī ca balināṃ varaḥ || 14.1 || tadbalasyāpahārārthaṃ kāśyapājjāyate hariḥ | harirvāmanarūpo'bhūcchatrī daṇḍī ca vedavith || 14.2 || vaṭabījena sadṛśaḥ kevalaṃ sūtradaṇḍabhṛth | vartamāne mahāyajñe balervairocaneḥ purā || 14.3 || tadyajñaśālāṃ saṃprāpya vaṭurūpo mahāhariḥ | tvaṃ dehi tripadīṃ mahyaṃ gāmityūce svamāyayā || 14.4 || baliśca tripadaṃ tasmaiprādāttoyasamanvitaṃ | hastejale patatyāśu bhadraṃ rūpamavāpya ca || 14.5 || devastraivikramaṃ rūpaṃ sarvaṃ lokaṃ tadāgrahīth | trivikramapratiṣṭhāyāṃ viśeṣassaṃpravakṣyate || 14.6 || vasantvimāne vā bhadrake hastibhadrake | dīrghaśāre mahākūṭe sthāpanaṃ sarvasiddhidaṃ || 14.7 || daśatālena mānena devadevaṃ prakalpayeth | savyaṃ pādaṃ sthitaṃ kuryāddakṣiṇaṃ codthitaṃ bhaveth || 14.8 || caturbhujaṃ prakurvīta saṃyutaṃ vāṣṭabhirbhujaiḥ | dakṣiṇe śārṅgamālaṃbya bhūmyāṃ caiva prasrya ca || 14.9 || śaraṃ ca dakṣiṇe haste khaḍgaṃ caiva tathā bhaveth | gadā vāmakare proktā tathā kheṭakameva ca || 14.10 || cakraśaṅkhetathā kuryādūrdhvabāhorvicakṣaṇaḥ | evameva prakurvīta vasuhastaṃ prakalpayan || 14.11 || sasyaśyāmanibhaṃ kuryāddharṣa vegasamanvitaṃ | sarvābharaṇa saṃyuktaṃ kīrīṭādivibhūṣitaṃ || 14.12 || indraṃ sasyanibhaṃ kuryādvāmapārśve ca susthitaṃ | dakṣiṇe dharmarājaṃ ca puṣpamālādharaṃ punaḥ || 14.13 || dakṣiṇe bhittiporśve tu brahmāṇaṃ ca prakalbayeth | hastābhyāṃ kuṃbhayoścaiva pādaprakṣālanaṃ careth || 14.14 || tasyapādāṃbuje caiva jātāṃ gaṅgāṃ ca sundarīṃ | prāñjalīkṛtya hastābhyāṃ nābherūlrāvaṃ śarīragau || 14.15 || pārśvayorubhayoścāpi candrādityau ca pūrvavath | jāṃbavantaṃ tathā bherīṃ tāḍayastaṃ narākṛtiṃ || 14.16 || indraṃ śyāmanibhaṃ kuryādyamamañjanasannibhaṃ | ādityaṃ cāgni varṇaṃ ca candraṃ śtetaṃ tathā careth || 14.17 || pītavarṇaṃ baliṃ kuryānnīlābhaṃ jāṃbavantakaṃ | brahmāṇaṃ pītavarṇaṃ ca śyāmavarṇāṃ ca jāhnavīṃ || 14.18 || evaṃ varṇakrameṇaiva citrābhāsaṃ ca kārayeth | pūjakau tu prakurvīta tathā śakrabṛhaspatī || 14.19 || śaṅkhaṃ dakṣiṇataḥ kuryāccakraṃ vāme samarcayeth | amūrtaṃ vā samūrtaṃ vā kalpayitvā yathākramaṃ || 14.20 || śukraṃ śuklanibhaṃ kuryātpītavarṇaṃ bṛhaspatiṃ | mahīṃ dakṣiṇataḥ pārśvesthitāmevaṃ prakalpayeth || 14.21 || udaṅmukhīṃ ca kurdīta padmahastāṃ ca dakṣiṇe | vāme prasāritāṃ caiva sarvaratna vibhūṣitāṃ || 14.22 || tasyāḥpūrve tathā kuryātprahlādaṃ cottarāmukhaṃ | jaṭāmukuṭasaṃyuktaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaṃ || 14.23 || hṛdayeṃjalisaṃyuktaṃ śukavatranibhāṃbaraṃ | tasyacottarapārśve tu brahmāsūtrasya dakṣiṇe || 14.24 || asurendraṃ tathāsīnaṃ vinataṃ paścimāmukhaṃ | brahmāñjali samāyuktaṃ kīrīṭādivibhūṣitaṃ || 14.25 || evaṃ vairocaniṃ kuryātpuṣpāṃbaradharaṃparaṃ | namuciṃ ca samāsīnaṃ pādapīṭhāvalaṃbinaṃ || 14.26 || vāmapārśve samāsīnaṃ pūrvabhittisamāśrayaṃ | kalpayitvā yathāmārgaṃ śukraṃ caiva samāgataṃ || 14.27 || vāmapādaṃ samāsīnaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ kuñcitaṃ tathā | abhayaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ hastaṃ vāmaṃ kaṭyavalaṃbitaṃ || 14.28 || sarvābharaṇa saṃyuktaṃ paścimāmukhameva ca | tasya cottarapārśvetu pakṣirājaṃ prakalpayeth || 14.29 || dakṣiṇāmukhasaṃyuktaṃ śukremuṣṭiprahāriṇaṃ | evaṃ garbhagṛhe proktaṃ vidhinā kārayedbudhaḥ || 14.30 || maṇḍape nimnitasthāne anantaṃ cottarāmukhaṃ | hṛdayeṃjalisaṃyuktaṃ sthitamevaṃ prakalpayeth || 14.31 || phaṇaistu pañcabhiryuktaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaṃ | uttare bhittipārśvetu vāsukīṃ ca prakalpayeth || 14.32 || ana ntavattathā kuryāddharṣa vegasamanvitaṃ | evameva vidhānena kalpayitvā yathākramaṃ || 14.33 || śyāmavarṇāṃ tathā devīṃ prahgādaṃ pītameva ca | kanakābhaṃ baliñcaiva namuciṃ ca tathai va ca || 14.34 || śakraṃ tu pūrvavatkuryātpañcavarṇaṃ khagādhipaṃ | anantaṃ pītavarṇaṃ ca vāsukiṃ śyāmameva ca || 14.35 || evaṃ sthānakrameṇaiva kūṭayuktena kārayeth | atha vā bhittipārśve tu citrābhāse'dhamādhamaṃ || 14.36 || trivikramaṃ pravakṣyāmi yathā kuryājjagattraye | ekaṃ jānusamaṃ kuryāddvitīyaṃ nābhitassamaṃ || 14.37 || tṛtīyaṃ tu lalāṭāntaṃ trividhaṃ syāttrivikramaṃ | mahīṃ devīṃ tathā caiva prahlādaṃ tu baliṃ tathā || 14.38 || namuciṃ ca tathā śukraṃ garuḍaṃ ca tathā careth | anantaṃ vāsukīṃ caiva maṣṭāṃgasthāpanaṃ careth || 14.39 || viṣṇuṃ trivikramaṃ ceti trilokeśamataḥ paraṃ | viśveśvaraṃ trimūrti ca sarpādhāra' mitīrayeth || 14.40 || "pītavarṇaṃ guruṃ caiva taiṣyaṃ caiva bṛhaspatim' | "samuciṃ kanakābhaṃ ca pītavāsasamityapi || 14.41 || śyāmalāṅgamiti proktaṃ' mūrtimantraṃ yathākramaṃ | "hariṇīṃ ca tathā pauṣṇīṃ kṣauṇīñcaiva tathā mahīm.' || 14.42 || "prahlādaṃ vīryavittaṃ ca viṣṇu bhaktaṃ mahābalam' | "asurendraṃ baliṃ ceti vadānyaṃ vīra'meva ca || 14.43 || śukrasya pūrvamevoktaṃ garuḍasya vidhānataḥ | "kāśyapaṃ garuḍaṃ caiva vainateyaṃ khagādhipaṃ || 14.44 || "sahasraśīrṣaṃ śeṣaṃ ca nāgarājamitīrya ca | anastaṃ' ca samuccārya śeṣasyāvāhanaṃ careth || 14.45 || "vāsukīṃ nāgarājaṃ ca kādraveyaṃ manoramaṃ | evaṃ mūrtikramaścaiva maṣṭāṃgasthāpane careth || 14.46 || pratiṣṭhoktakrameṇaiva sarvaṃ pūrvavadācareth | trivikramapratiṣṭhāyāmanvāhārye viśeṣataḥ || 14.47 || tathā hautraṃ praśaṃsyaiva mūrtyāvāhanamācareth | juṣṭākāraṃ ca kṛtvaiva pūrvavatsarvamācareth || 14.48 || "yo vā trimūrti'rityevaṃ śatamaṣṭādhikaṃ yajeth | karṣaṇādipratiṣṭhāntaṃ pūrvavatsamyagācareth || 14.49 || iti śrīvaikhānase bhagavacchāstre bhṛguproktāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prakīrṇādhikāre caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ <15> atha pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ daśāvatāra kalpaḥ (rāmaḥ) bhārgavaḥ ataḥ paraśurāmasya sthāpanaṃ vakṣyate'dhunā | bahubhirbalavadbhistu rājabhirdharaṇī hatā || 15.1 || tadvadhāya kṛtodyogo jamadagnisuto hariḥ | bhūtvāvatīrṇo lokesminbhāranirharaṇāya vai || 15.2 || paraśuṃ ca gṛhītvorvyāṃ nṛpānsarvānpragṛhya ca | jaghāna kilabhūyo'pi rāmo bhīmaparākramaḥ || 15.3 || sthāpayecchatrunāśāya rāmaṃ paraśudhāriṇaṃ | śrīpratiṣṭhitake caiva aṅganākāra eva ca || 15.4 || madhyamaṃ daśatālena rāmaṃ dvibhujamācareth | paraśaṃ dakṣiṇe haste dhṛtvācaiva vicakṣaṇaṃ || 15.5 || vāmamuddeśahastaṃ ca jaṭāmukuṭaśobhitaṃ | raktavarṇayutaṃ caiva śvetāṃbaradharaṃ tathā || 15.6 || sarpābharaṇasaṃyuktaṃ sthānakaṃ tatra kārayeth | tadrūpaṃ kautukaṃ kuryādatha vā taṃ caturbhujaṃ || 15.7 || anvāhārye pradhānāgnau hautraśaṃsanamācareth | "rāmaṃ ṛṣisutaṃ viṣṇuṃ paraśupāṇi'mitīrayeth || 15.8 || ityevamuktvā cāvāhya nirupyājyāhutīryajeth | "viṣṇurvariṣṭha' ityuktvā śatamaṣṭādhikaṃ yajeth || 15.9 || utsavasnapanādīni viṣṇuvatsarvamācaretdāśaradhiḥ | rāvaṇo bahubhiḥ krūrai rākṣasaiśca mahābalaiḥ || 15.10 || trīnlokānpīḍayāmāsa varadānena garvitaḥ | devāssaṃpīḍitāssarve munayaścākhilāstathā || 15.11 || tairdevairmunibhissarvaiḥ saṃstuto hariravyayaḥ | tadvadhāya kṛtodyogo mānuṣaṃ rūpamāsthitaḥ || 15.12 || avatīrṇassuto bhūtvā rājño daśarathasya ca' | rāmastu rākṣasānhatvā sarvānlokānapālayate || 15.13 || puṣṭyarthī vijayārthī ca vīrārthī ca viśeṣataḥ | kūṭāgāreṃganākāre phelākāraṃ catuṣphuṭaṃ || 15.14 || svastikaṃ vā vimānastu kṛtvācaiva vicakṣaṇaḥ | rāghavaṃ tu pratiṣṭhāpya yathā vatsaṃprapūjayeth || 15.15 || athātassaṃpravakṣyāmi rāmalakṣmaṇa lakṣaṇaṃ | sītāyā vāyuputrasya bharatasyāsujasya ca || 15.16 || mānonmānapramāṇāni vakṣye saṃkṣepataḥ kramāth | uttamaṃ daśatālena madhyamena yathākramaṃ || 15.17 || uttamaṃ rāghavendrasya madhyamaṃ lakṣmaṇasya ca | antenai va tu māsena sītāyāstūcchrayo bhaveth || 15.18 || navatālena mānena vāyuputraṃ prakalpayeth | adhamaṃ daśatālena bharatasyānujasya ca || 15.19 || evaṃ yuktiyutenaiva kriyate śāstravittamaiḥ | garbhadvāravimānābhyāṃ beramānamihocyate || 15.20 || utsava pratimāyāntu sarveṣāmālayeṣu vai | taddevabhedaṃ mūrtīnāṃ tatpramāṇena yojayeth || 15.21 || iṣyate garbhamānantu puṣyamānaṃ? vibhajya ca | uttamaṃ pañcabhāgaṃ tu caturbhāgaṃ tu madhyamaṃ || 15.22 || tribhāgamadhamaṃ proktaṃ yathāvacchāstravittamāḥ | garbhamānaṃ pravakṣyanti dvāramānantu vakṣyate || 15.23 || saptabhāge caturbhāgamuttamaṃ tu vidhīyate | tṣaṃśaṃ tu madhyamaṃ proktamarthāṃśamadhamaṃ bhaveth || 15.24 || dvāramānamidaṃ proktaṃ kriyāyāntu viśeṣataḥ | rāmasyātha lalāṭāntaṃ nāsāntaṃ lakṣmaṇocchrayaṃ || 15.25 || āsyāntamatha vā kuryādvāyuputrasya lakṣaṇaṃ | bharatasyāmajasyāpi tathā galasamaṃ bhaveth || 15.26 || uṣṇīṣātpādaparyantaṃ caturviṃśacchatāṅgulaṃ | ṣaṣṭidvigolagaṃ vidyādekatṣaṃśatribhāgīkam? || 15.27 || tālāni daśabhāgaikamuttamaṃ daśatālakaṃ | caturbhāgāṣṭabhāgaṃ syāccatustālaṃ tathaiva ca || 15.28 || daśatālasya tṣaṃśena uttamaṃ madhyamādhamaṃ | madhyamādadhamaṃ hīnaṃ mukhe vārdhāṅgulakṣayaṃ || 15.29 || uṣṇīṣamaṅgulaṃ netraṃ śirastṣaṅgulamiṣyate | lalāṭe hanuparyantaṃ trayodaśārdhāṅgulaṃ bhaveth || 15.30 || galaṃ caturyavāḥ proktāgrīvā sārdhatriyaṅgulā | hikkā hṛdayānābhyantaṃ meḍhramūlaṃ mukhatrayaṃ || 15.31 || mukhāyāmaṃ caturmātraṃ liṅgaṃ pañcāṅgulāyataṃ | nābhirardhāṅgulaṃ jñeyaṃ nimnārdhavaritālakā || 15.32 || śroṇī bhāgārdhamevaṃ syātkaṭiḥ pañcāṅgulaṃ bhaveth | meḍhramūlādijānvantaṃ saptaviṃśatikāṃgulaṃ || 15.33 || jānubhāgamiti proktaṃ jaṅghorū susamāyutau | caraṇaṃ caturaṅgulyaṃ manordeśavidhānataḥ || 15.34 || brahmāṅgulamūkhāyāmaṃ trayodaśāṃgulameva ca | kaniṣṭhāṃgulamāyāmamekādaśāṃgulaṃ bhaveth || 15.35 || akṣṇāmuṣṇīṣaparyantaṃ bhāgārdhāṅgulamucchrayaṃ | hikkāsūtrāntamevaṃ svātskandhamūladvayaṃ bhaveth || 15.36 || skandhaṃ bhujasamotsedhaṃ bhujordhvaṃ golakaṃ bhaveth | bhujadvimukhamāyāmaṃ kūrparaṃ ca kalāyataṃ || 15.37 || prakoṣṭhaṃ viṃśadaṅgulyaṃ hastāyāmamiti smṛtaṃ | nāsyāni nābhivāmebhyo rakṣāntaṃ sūtradakṣiṇaṃ || 15.38 || ādisūtramidaṃ proktamanyatsūtraṃ ca kārayeth | īṣatkuñcitamātrantu mātrārdhaṃ samakuñcitaṃ || 15.39 || dvikalākuñcitaṃ jñeyaṃ trividhaṃ kuñcitaṃ bhaveth | pāṣṇonyrantarasaṃyuktaṃ pañcāgulasamanvitaṃ || 15.40 || pādāṅguṣṭhāntaraṃ caiva trayodaśāṃgulamīritaṃ | uṣṇīṣātpārśvakarṇāntaṃ vāmahastocchrayaṃ bhaveth || 15.41 || nīvraṃ kaṇṭhayavānānta dvimukhaṃ vistaraṃ bhaveth | dakṣiṇe laṃbahastantu ūrumūlau samaṃ bhaveth || 15.42 || nīvraṃ pañcāṃgulaṃ caivatrayodaśāṃgulamīritaṃ | hastantu dvyaṅgula ceti kaṭībāhū ṣaḍaṅgulaṃ || 15.43 || triyujā kuñcitaṃ sthityā tribhaṅgāgra virājitaṃ | dakṣiṇe kaṭideśe tu vāmamakṣānvitaṃ bhaveth || 15.44 || dakṣiṇaṃ mukhamāśritya tribhaṅgāṅga mathocyate | śruṅgāraguṇasaṃyuktaṃ kirīṭaṃ vā viśeṣataḥ || 15.45 || vajraṃ pulliṅgavāyuktaṃ makarakuṇḍalamaṃyutaṃ | kirīṭamukuṭau jñeyo hārakeyūrasaṃyutaṃ || 15.46 || uṣṇīṣaṃ keśapṛṣṭhānte trayodaśāṃgulamāyataṃ | grīvāyāṃ madhyamaṃ bhāgaṃ kakudbhāgātkramonnatiḥ || 15.47 || jānakīṃ samabhaṅgena vāmahasteva puṣpadhṛth | dakṣiṇaṃ saṃprasāryaiva rukmavarṇāntu kārayeth || 15.48 || śyāmavastradharāṃ caiva divyastrīmaṇḍanopamāṃ | lakṣmaṇaṃ samabhaṅgena taptakāñcanasannibhaṃ || 15.49 || bharataṃ śyāmavarṇantu śatrughnantu suvarṇakaṃ | lakṣmaṇasyātha vāme tu sthitau bāṇadhanurdharau || 15.50 || hanūmantaṃ piṅgalābhaṃ vārtāvijñāpane paraṃ | evaṃ sāyudhavargantu vakṣyate'tra nirāyudhaṃ || 15.51 || prasāri dakṣiṇaṃ pādamitaraccaiva kuñcitaṃ | dakṣiṇe nābhayaṃ hastaṃ vāmaṃ kaṭikamucyate || 15.52 || sthāpanādikriyāssarvāḥ pūrvavatkārayettataḥ | dakṣiṇāgnau pradhānetu hautraśaṃsanamācareth || 15.53 || "rāmaṃ dāśarathiṃ viṣṇuṃ kākutstha'miti cāhvayeth | "sītāmayonijāṃ lakṣmīṃ vaidehī'miti cāhvayeth || 15.54 || "rāmānujaṃ ca soṃitriṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ lakṣmivardhanam' | "bharataṃ rāmapriyaṃ ceti kaikaiyīsutameva ca || 15.55 || sadvṛtta'miti cāvāhya bharatasya viśeṣataḥ | "śatrughnaṃ sumanaskaṃ ca lakṣmaṇānujameva ca || 15.56 || daśarathodbhava'mityeva śatrughnaṃ ca samāhvayet kapirājaṃ hanūmantaṃ śabdarāśiṃ mahāmatim, || 15.57 || juṣṭākārādisarvaṃ ca pūrvavatkārayedbudhaḥ | "rāyāmī'śeti mantreṇa śatamaṣṭādhikaṃ yajeth || 15.58 || "śriye jāta'śca sītāyā home mantra udīritaḥ | "tanmā yaśogra' mantreṇa bharatasya ca hūyate || 15.59 || "śanno nidhattā'muccārya lakṣmaṇasya hunetsudhīḥ | "bhūmānantogra' ityuktvā śatrughnasya samācareth || 15.60 || "marutaḥ paramā'tmeti mārutasyeva mārute | sarvatra juhuyānmantraṃ śatamaṣṭādhikaṃ budhaḥ || 15.61 || arcanaṃ cotsavaṃ caiva snapane ca hareriva | halī daityānāṃ tu vadhārthāya yaduśreṣṭhaṃ malābalaṃ || 15.62 || balabhadraṃ vidusso'pi vasudevasya saṃbabhau | bhūbhāramocanārthāya viṣṇussabalabhadrakaḥ || 15.63 || hatvānarakakaṃsādīnsarvānlokānapālayath | evaṃ sthāpayituṃ rāmamicchetkārayitaṃ ca yaḥ || 15.64 || somachandavimāne vā hastipṛṣṭhe'tha vābudhaḥ | tṛtīyaṃ rāmamāsthāpya dvibhujaṃ svetavarṇakaṃ || 15.65 || daśatānena mānena kṛtvā rūpaṃ samāhitaḥ | dakṣiṇetarahastābhyāṃ musalaṃ khaḍgameva ca || 15.66 || śroṇīnūtrasamenaiva muṣṭiṃ samusalaṃ dṛḍhaṃ | bāhusūtrasamaṃ kuryāddhalaṃ vāme tathaivaca || 15.67 || tasya dakṣiṇapārśvetu lakṣmīvadrohiṇīṃ careth | evaṃ tu sāyudhaṃ kuryādvakṣye'haṃ tu nirāyudhaṃ || 15.68 || vāmapādaṃ samākuñcya dakṣiṇaṃ saṃprasārya ca | abhayaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ hastaṃ vāmamūrau ca vinyaseth || 15.69 || agnāvāhavanīyetu hautraṃ tatra praśaṃsayeth | "rāmaṃ yaduvaraṃ viṣṇuṃ halāyudha'mitikramāth || 15.70 || "indirāṃ revatīṃ caiva lakṣmīṃ rāmapriyā'miti | evamāvāhanaṃ kṛtvājuṣṭākārādi pūrvavath || 15.71 || "kṣmāmekā'miti mantreṇa śatamaṣṭādhikaṃ yajeth | arcanaṃ cotsavaṃ caiva snapanaṃ ca hareriva || 15.72 || iti śrīvaikhānase bhagavacchāstre bhṛguproktāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prakīrṇa'dhikāre pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ <16> atha ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ daśāvatārakalpaḥ (kṛṣṇaḥ) athātassaṃpravakṣyāmi kṛṣṇasya sthāpanaṃ budhāḥ | kṛṣṇasyālayamuddiṣṭaṃ kuṃbhākāravimānake || 16.1 || kūṭe vā gopure vāpi parvatākṛtike'pivā | kṛṣṇasya bālarūpasya vayasā tālamānakaṃ || 16.2 || ekavarṣaṃ samārabhya yāvatbañcābdamādarāth | tālatrayakrameṇaiva yathāyogaṃ prakalpayeth || 16.3 || vedavarṣaṃ samārabhyaṣaṭtālatrayameva vā | saptavarṣaṃ samārabhya saptatālatrayaṃ tathā || 16.4 || daśavarṣaṃ samārabhya aṣṭatālatrayaṃ tathā | trayodaśa samārabhya navatālatrayaṃ tathā || 16.5 || evaṃ vayaḥkrameṇaiva tālamānaṃ tathocyate | tiṣṭhantamekapīṭhasthaṃ rukmiṇyā satyabhāmayā || 16.6 || kṛṣṇaṃ ca bālavapuṣaṃ śyāmalaṃ pītavāsasaṃ | rukmiṇīṃ kanakābhāṃ tāṃ satyabhāmāṃ ca śyāmalāṃ || 16.7 || vāsudevaṃ guḍākeśaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaṃ | krīḍayaṣṭidharaṃ devaṃ tribhaṅgadhyānasaṃyutaṃ || 16.8 || svastikaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ pādaṃ vāmapādaṃ tu kuñcitaṃ | tiṣṭhantamaṅgulisthāne cāṃguṣṭhasthitimācareth || 16.9 || kiñcitkuñcitajānvantavāmapādasthitirbhaveth | vaktraṃ caiva tathā gātraṃ kaṭibhāgaṃ tathaiva ca. || 16.10 || triṣumārgeṣu bhaṅgitvāttribhaṅgitvaṃ vidhīyate | vaktraṃ dakṣiṇato bhāge madhyabhāgaṃ tu vāmataḥ || 16.11 || kaṭīrdakṣiṇato bhāge bhaṅgatrayamudāhṛtaṃ | dakṣiṇaṃ kaṭikaṃ hastaṃ krīḍāyaṣṭisamanvitaṃ || 16.12 || dakṣiṇe yaṣṭihastantu nābhisūtrādadhonnataṃ | bhūtavedaguṇāṅgulyā vidhinā sahitālataḥ? || 16.13 || vāmaṃ devyorbhujāsaktaṃ vāmahastamadhomukhaṃ | hikkāsūtrādadho vāmaṃ kūrparaṃ syāddaśāṅgulaṃ || 16.14 || ṣaṭsaptāṣṭāṃgulādhikyonnataṃ vā kālayetkramāth | vāmahastatalāgrantu nābhimātrantu yojayeth || 16.15 || veṇuṃ ca taravegaṃ tu hastābhyāṃ pīḍayetkramāth | ūrdhvakāyasamaṃ veṇuṃ krīḍāyaṣṭiṃ tu tatsamaṃ || 16.16 || triṇataṃ śyāmalāṅgaṃ ca dvibhujaṃ raktavāsasaṃ | caturbhujaṃ vā kurvīta śaṅkhacakradharaṃ paraṃ || 16.17 || susthitaṃ vāmapādena dakṣiṇenaiva bandhayeth | sarvābharaṇasaṃyuktaṃ sundaraṃ soṃyalocanaṃ || 16.18 || devībhyāṃ sahitaṃ kuryā drahitaṃ vātra kecana | devasya vāme garuḍaṃ prāñjalīkṛtya nusthitaṃ || 16.19 || pakṣadvayayutaṃ kuryāttālapatrasya mūlavath | navanītanaṭaṃ kuryāttathā kālīyamardanaṃ || 16.20 || pārthasārathirūpaṃ tu devyośca rahitaṃ kramāth | pīṭhaṃ ca pratimotsethaṃ pañcabhāgaṃ tribhāgikaṃ || 16.21 || navāṃśātsaptabhāgaṃ catribhāgadvayamucyate | laukikapratimotsedhaṃ mānāṃgulamiti kramāth || 16.22 || prathamaṃ tu navāṅgulyaṃ dvadvyaṅgulavivardhanaṃ | navasaṃkhyamiti proktaṃ mānamevaṃ vidhīyate || 16.23 || etena tu tribhedaṃ syāduttamādhamamadhyamaṃ | mānaṃpramāṇamunmānaṃ laṃbamānopamānakaṃ || 16.24 || pañcatālamiti proktaṃ laṃbamānaṃ vidhīyate | sāttvikaṃ rājasaṃ caiva tāmasaṃ tu vivarjayeth || 16.25 || dakṣiṇaṃ mānamuddhṛtya nābhisūtrapramāṇakaṃ | kaṭiyonisamaṃ vātha dakṣiṇaṃ pādameva hi || 16.26 || daṇḍahastantu mānena mūrdhni keśākṣameva vā | abhayaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ hastaṃ bhrūmātraṃ kūrparādayaḥ || 16.27 || dakṣiṇena mukhaṃ caiva kiñcitprahasitānanaṃ | keśakaṃbalamityuktaṃ sūtraṃ vāmāśrayaṃ bhaveth || 16.28 || uṣṇīṣasthapade madhye nāsāgre puṭavāmake | nābhimadhyagate vāpi muṣkamālorudakṣiṇe || 16.29 || pāde dakṣiṇapāṇyante agrānmakuṭavāmake | laṃbayenmadhyasūtraṃ cedanyatsūtraṃ na kārayeth || 16.30 || uṣṇīṣamaṅgulārdhaṃ ca mukhamaṣṭāṃgulaṃ bhaveth | galamarthāṃgulaṃ tasya grīvāntaṃ dvyaṅgulaṃ bhaveth || 16.31 || hikkāntaṃ hṛdayāntaṃ ca nābhyantaṃ meḍhramūlakaṃ | aṣṭādaśāṃgulaṃ caiva mūrdhvakāyaṃ vidhīyate || 16.32 || trayodaśāṃgulaṃ caiva mūrudīrṅaṃ vidhīyate | jānussyāddvyaṅgulaṃ caiva jaṅghā coruśca tatsamā || 16.33 || caraṇaṃ dvyaṅgulaṃ caiva mānameva na saṃśayaḥ | hīkkāsūtrāntato bāhurdaśāṅgulamiti smṛtaṃ || 16.34 || prakoṣṭhamaṣṭāṅgulāyāmaṃ saptāṅgulatalāyataṃ | mukhaṃ mukhaviśālaṃ syātkarṇavistāramaṅgulaṃ || 16.35 || grīvāvistāramevaṃ syāccaturaṅgula caturyavaṃ | abhayaṃ bāhumānaṃ caturviṃśatiraṅgulaṃ || 16.36 || kakṣayorantaraṃ caiva caturdaśāṃgula vistaraṃ | ūrurdaśāṃgulaṃ caiva śroṇirekādaśāṃgulaṃ || 16.37 || kaṭivistāramevaṃ syāttrayodaśāṃgulamiṣyate | ūrumūlasuvistāramaṣṭāṃgulamiti kramāth || 16.38 || ṣaḍaṅgulaṃ jānutāraṃ jaṅghātāraṃ ca saptakaṃ | tṣaṅgulārdhaṃ ca vijñeyaṃ nālikāvistaraṃ bhaveth || 16.39 || pādavistāramevoktaṃ sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutaṃ | kalāpakusumaśyāmaṃ śaṅkhacakragadāmbujaṃ || 16.40 || anekaratnaṃ sa channaṃ kaustubhodbhāsi vakṣasaṃ | tārahārāvalīramyaṃ garuḍopari saṃsthitaṃ || 16.41 || devībhyāṃ sahitaṃ kuryātkṛṣṇaṃ bṛndāvane rataṃ | ālola kuntalodbhāsi mukhacandra virājitaṃ || 16.42 || atiraktādharoṣṭhaṃ ca raktapāṇidvayāṃcitaṃ | vāmapādaṃ samākuñcya cottānīkṛtya dakṣiṇaṃ || 16.43 || dakṣiṇaṃ cābhayaṃ hastaṃ navanītayutaṃ tathā | vāmaṃ prasārya cottānaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaṃ || 16.44 || sāṃbaraṃ tu prakurvīta vigatāṃbarameva vā | evaṃ tu vidhinā kuryānnavanitanaṭaṃ budhaḥ || 16.45 || evameva prakurvīta kālīyāhiphaṇopari | nṛtyantaṃ paramātmānamuttānākuñcitāṅghrikaṃ || 16.46 || dakṣiṇe tu kare kuryānnavanītasya khaṇḍakaṃ | ahipucchaṃ kare vāpi kuryātkālīyamardanaṃ || 16.47 || nīlotpaladalaśyāmaṃ pītāṃbarasuśobhitaṃ | caturbhujaṃ śaṅkhacakramūrdhvapāṇidvaye dhṛtaṃ || 16.48 || adhaḥpāṇidvaye veṇuṃ vādayantaṃ mudānvitaṃ | sarvālaṅkārasaṃyuktaṃ garuḍopari saṃsthitaṃ || 16.49 || devībhyāṃ sahitaṃ devaṃ munibhiḥ pariveṣṭitaṃ | kṛṣṇamevaṃ prakurvīta santānārthī viśeṣataḥ || 16.50 || kalāpakusuma śyāmaṃ pūrṇacandranibhānasaṃ | barhibarhakṛtottaṃsaṃ sarvālaṅkārasaṃyutaṃ || 16.51 || yuvatīveṣalāvaṇyaṃ śrīvatsāṃkitavakṣasaṃ | smerāruṇādharanyastaveṇuṃ trailokyamohanaṃ || 16.52 || akṣamālāṃ ca vidyāṃ ca kuryādūrdhvakaradvaye | veṇuṃ karadvaye kuryāccaturbhujayutaṃ hariṃ || 16.53 || tapanīyalasatkāntyābhrājatkamalahantayā | nirīkṣyamāṇacaraṇaṃ vāmapārśvasthayā śriyā || 16.54 || hemasiṃhāsane ramye rājñībhistu niṣevitaṃ | candramaṇḍalasaṃkāśaśvetachatreṇaśobhitaṃ || 16.55 || nāradādyairmunigaṇaijñānnārthibhirupāsitaṃ | indrādidevatābṛndhaiḥ praṇataṃ parameśvaraṃ || 16.56 || evaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ prakurvīta jaganmohanavigrahaṃ | gopībhirāvṛtaṃ gobhiḥ paramānandavigrahaṃ || 16.57 || vyatyasya dakṣiṇaṃ pādaṃ vāme nyasya ca susthitaṃ | caturbhujaṃ śaṅkhacakradharamūrdhvakaradvaye || 16.58 || dhṛtvā vedamayaṃ veṇumanyahastadvayena ca | aṅgulībhirmudā veṇusuṣirāṇi ca pūrayan || 16.59 || divyagāndharvagītārtaṃ tribhaṅgena ca saṃsthitaṃ | evaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ prakurvīta veṇunādanaṭaṃ budhaḥ || 16.60 || sarvabhūṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ brahmasūtrasamanvitaṃ | raktāṃbaradharaṃ caiva śyāmalaṃ kamalekṣaṇaṃ || 16.61 || rukmiṇīsatyabhāmābhyāṃ pārśvayorupaśobhitaṃ | rukmiṇīṃ rukmavarṇābhāṃ satyāṃ śyāmanibhāṃ tathā || 16.62 || vasudevaṃ devakīṃ ca purato dakṣiṇe tathā | yaśodāṃ nandagopaṃ ca deveśaṃ vīkṣya susthitaṃ || 16.63 || pradyumnaṃ ca tathā sāṃbaṃ vāme kuryātsalakṣaṇaṃ | dāmaṃ sumanasaṃ caiva kuryādanyāṃ ca gopikāṃ || 16.64 || karṇāgrāntantu kṛṣṇasya sumantuṃ vāmamāśritaṃ | kakṣabāhusamaṃ vāpi kārayedyuktitaḥ kramāth || 16.65 || navatālena mānena kuryāttānsamalaṅkṛtān | devakīṃ vasudevaṃ ca kṛṣṇavarṇau prakalpayeth || 16.66 || yaśodāṃ gauravarṇāñca karburaṃ nandamācareth | pradyumnaṃ śyāmavarṇaṃ ca sāṃbaṃ kālāñjanaprabhaṃ || 16.67 || dāmaṃ raktanibhaṃ caiva gauraṃ sumanasaṃ tathā | sumantuṃ śvetavarṇaṃ ca kalbayedvidhinā budhaḥ || 16.68 || evaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ prakurvīta līlāmānuṣavigrahaṃ | caturmūrtikramaścaiṣāṃ vāsādhikaraṇoktavath || 16.69 || dhṛtvā puṣpamayīṃ yaṣṭiṃ dakṣiṇevatu pāṇinā | nyasyānyaṃ caiva bhūmistharājadaṇḍasya mūrdhavi || 16.70 || rājārhābharaṇairyuktaṃ rukmīṇyā sahitaṃ prabhuṃ | eve kṛṣṇaṃ prakurvīta rājagopālavigrahaṃ || 16.71 || pītāṃbaradharaṃ devaṃ jñānamudrālasatkaraṃ | veṇumanyakare dhṛtvā sukhāsīnaṃ śucismitaṃ || 16.72 || upāsyamānaṃ munibhirdevībhyāṃ rahitaṃ hariṃ | kṛṣṇamevaṃ prakurvīda jñānagopālavigrahaṃ || 16.73 || svarṇaprabhamudārāṅgamaṣṭabāhuṃ jagatprabhuṃ | ikṣucāpāṃkuśānveṇuṃ śaṅkhārisumasāyakān || 16.74 || bibhrantaṃ ramayā śliṣṭadivyamaṅgalavigrahaṃ | sarvābharaṇasaṃyuktaṃ yogināmamṛtapradaṃ || 16.75 || evaṃ sammohanaṃ kuryātkṛṣṇaṃ gopālavigrahaṃ | gavāṃ gopakumārāṇāṃ gopīnāṃ rakṣaṇāyavai || 16.76 || nagaṃ govardhanaṃ nāma dadhāra bhagavānhariḥ | vāmenoddhṛtahastena bibhrantaṃ nagamuttamaṃ || 16.77 || kaṭinyastānya hastaṃ ca padmahastamadhāpi vā | śaṅkhacakradharaṃ devaṅkuryāccaiva caturbhujaṃ || 16.78 || evaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ prakurvīta govardhanadharaṃ hariṃ | purā mahati saṃgrāme pārthaṃ rakṣitavānhariḥ || 16.79 || pārthaṃ rathasthitaṃ kuryāccharatūṇīrasaṃyutaṃ | samīkṣamāṇaṃ deveśaṃ syandanasthaṃ svapārśvagaṃ || 16.80 || śyāmavarṇaṃ mahābāhu kṛṣṇamudbaddhakuntalaṃ | bibhrantaṃ dakṣiṇe pāśaṃ śaṅkhaṃ vāmakare tadhā || 16.81 || arjunasya mukhaṃ vīkṣya smayamānaṃ mahārathaṃ | evaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ prakurvīta pārthasārathivigrahaṃ || 16.82 || vāmajānusamākuñcya dīrghamanyaṃ prasārya ca | tathai vāvithya sannyasya bhūmyāṃ vāmakaraṃ puraḥ || 16.83 || ākuñcitānyapādeva cāsanasthitiśobhinā | anyahastena saṃdhārya navanītaṃ navaṃ navaṃ || 16.84 || muhurālokayantaṃ taddarśanīyaṃ viśeṣataḥ | evaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ prakurvīta bālagaupālavigrahaṃ || 16.85 || purā saṃdartasamaye saṃhṛteṣu jagatsu ca | vaṭapatre vinidrāṇo babhūva bhagavānhariḥ || 16.86 || vaṭapatre śayānaṃ tu bālarūpaṃ parātparaṃ | ākṛṣya dakṣiṇaṃ pādaṃ vāmahastena līlayā || 16.87 || pādāṅguṣṭhaṃ mukhe nyasya dhāsyantaṃ hasitānanaṃ | dakṣiṇena tu hastena vahantaṃ dakṣiṇorukaṃ || 16.88 || prasāritetarapadaṃ divyālaṅkāraśobhitaṃ | vaṭapatraṃ prakurvīta viśālaṃ cādharāgrakaṃ || 16.89 || vaṭapatraśayānaṃ tu kṛṣṇamevaṃ prakalpayeth | śaṅkhacakragadāpadma pāśāṃkuśalasatkaraṃ || 16.90 || karābhyāṃ veṇumādāya dhamantaṃ sarvamohanaṃ | sūryāyutaśatābhāsaṃ pītāṃbarasuśobhitaṃ || 16.91 || nānālaṅkārasubhagaṃ sūryamaṇḍalasaṃsthitaṃ | evaṃ prakalpayetkṛṣṇaṃ mahāntaṃ sarvamohanaṃ || 16.92 || kṛṣṇarūpamasaṃkhyātaṃsvecchārūpaṃ tu kārayeth | kālīyamardanādau tu nāgakanyādikalpanaṃ || 16.93 || kalpanaṃ bhogabhedasya caivamādīnprakalpayeth | yuktyā buddhyā ca bhaktyā ca yathā syānmanasaḥ priyaṃ || 16.94 || evaṃ rūpaṃ ca kṛtvā tu tadrūvaṃ kautukaṃ careth | athavākautukaṃ biṃbaṃ caturbhujasamanvitaṃ || 16.95 || abhayaṃ varadaṃ pūrvaṃ śaṅkhacakradharaṃ paraṃ | evaṃ caturbhujaṃ kṛtvā sthāpanāraṃbhamācareth || 16.96 || pūrvoktayāgaśālāyāṃ pañcāgnīnparikalpya ca | paiṇḍarīke pradhānāgnau hautraśaṃsanamācareth || 16.97 || "kṛṣṇaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ puṇyaṃ tridaśādhipa'matyapi | "rukmiṇīṃ suṃdarīṃ devīṃ ramā'miti ca rukmiṇīṃ || 16.98 || "satyarūpāṃ satīṃ caiva sannatīṃ ca kṣamā'miti | ityevamuktvā cāvāhya garuḍaṃ pūrvavattadhā || 16.99 || āvāhanakrameṇaiva nirupyājyāhutīryajeth | "satyassatyastha' ityuktvā śatamaṣṭādhikaṃ yajeth || 16.100 || śrībhūmyoriva kuryācca rukmiṇīsatyabhāmayoḥ | pūrvoktena vidhānena sthāpanādīni kārayeth || 16.101 || karkī yugāntasamaye viṣṇuḥ karkī nāma bhaviṣyati | khaḍgakheṭakahastastu mlecchādīnsa haniṣyati || 16.102 || kūṭe vā gopure vāpi parvatākṛtike'pi vā | kalkirūpaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya vimāne tu samarcayeth || 16.103 || madhyamaṃ daśatālena bhinnāṃjanacayaprabhaṃ | aśvānanaṃ mukhaṃ kuryādanyaccaiva narākṛti || 16.104 || caturbhujaṃ ca hasteṣu kramāccaivāyudhānyapi | cakraṃ śaṅkhaṃ ca khaḍgaṃ ca dadhānaṃ kheṭakaṃ tathā || 16.105 || athavā kalpayeddevamaśvārūḍhaṃ dvibāhukaṃ | śuddhasphacikasaṃkāśaṃ khaḍgakheṭaka dhāriṇaṃ || 16.106 || atraiva kautukaṃ kuryādviṣṇurūpaṃ caturbhujaṃ | pūrvoktayāgaśālāyāṃ pañcāgnīnparikalpya ca || 16.107 || paiṇḍarīke pradhānāgnau hautraśaṃsanamācareth | "karkiṇaṃ kāmarūpaṃ ca viṣṇuṃ saṃhārakāraṇam' || 16.108 || evamāvāhya vidhinā nirupyājyāhutīryajeth | "dhūrno vahantā' mityuktvā śatamaṣṭādhikaṃ yajeth || 16.109 || utsavasnapanādīni viṣṇoriva samācareth | viṣṇordaśāvatārāṇāmevaṃ proktaṃ tu lakṣaṇaṃ || 16.110 || anādirbhagavānkālo nāsya cānto'pi dṛśyate | cakravatparivartante sṛṣṭisthityantasaṃyamāḥ || 16.111 || avatārāśca kīrtyante bhūyāṃsaḥ paramātmanaḥ | dharmasaṃrakṣaṇārthāya duṣṭasaṃśikṣaṇāya ca || 16.112 || sadya āvirbhavedviṣṇuryatra bhaktānukaṃpayā | āvirbhāvaṃ tu taṃ vindyātprādurbhāvamathetarath || 16.113 || āvirbhāvantu matsyādyāḥ pañca pañcetarāssmṛtāḥ | gajendramokṣaṇādīnapyāvirbhāvānpracakṣate || 16.114 || antarāle tathā viṣṇordakṣiṇottarapārśvayoḥ | kalpayedrāmakṛṣṇau tu mukhamaṇḍapa eva vā || 16.115 || athāntarmaṇḍape vāpi tathāvaraṇa maṇḍape | saṃsthāpya kautukaṃ beraṃ dvayameveti ke ca na || 16.116 || nārasiṃhaṃ varāhaṃ ca vāmanaṃ ca trivikramaṃ | dhruvaberaṃ vinā kṛtvā kautukaṃ lakṣaṇānvitaṃ || 16.117 || sthāpayitvā tathā viṣṇoḥ pūjayedagramaṇḍape | matsyakūrmavarāhāṇāṃ vāmanasya viśeṣataḥ || 16.118 || kautukaṃ viṣṇurūpaṃ tu kuryāccaiva caturbhujaṃ | dhruvarūpaṃ na kurvīta yatheṣṭamitaratratu || 16.119 || iti śrīvaikhānase bhagavacchāstre bhṛguproktāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prakīrṇādhikāre ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ <17> atha saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ.adimūrtikalpaḥ atha vakṣye viśeṣeṇa keśavādivinirṇayaṃ | keśavaṃ tu prakurvīta soṃyarūpaṃ caturbhujaṃ || 17.1 || śaṅkhacakragadāpadmadharaṃ svarṇābhave va ca | sarvālaṅkārasaṃyuktaṃ muktāhāravibhūṣitaṃ || 17.2 || sthitamevaṃ prakurvīta devībhyāṃ sahitaṃ prabhuṃ | nārāyaṇaṃ prakurvīta ghanaśyāmaṃ caturbhujaṃ || 17.3 || śaṅkhapadmadhakaṃ devaṃ bibhrantaṃ ca gadāmasiṃ | bhūṣitaṃ maṇibhūṣābhiḥ vītavāsasamacyutaṃ || 17.4 || prakuryācca viśeṣeṇa lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ śubhaṃ | uttamaṃ daśatālena mānonmānapramāṇataḥ || 17.5 || siṃhāsane samāsīnaṃ dakṣiṇāṃghriṃ prasārya ca | āsane nihitaṃ vāmaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ pūrvavattathā || 17.6 || lakṣmīṃ sannyasya vāmorau mukhe harṣasamanvitāṃ | prasāritakarāṃ devīṃ pañcatālapramāṇataḥ || 17.7 || prāñjalīkṛtahastāṃ tāṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāṃ | vāmena tāṃ pariṣvajya dakṣiṇenābhayapradaṃ || 17.8 || anyābhyāṃ ca karābhyāṃ ca śaṅkhacakradharaṃ paraṃ | tārkṣyaṃskandhāsanasthaṃ vā anyatsarvaṃ ca pūrvavath || 17.9 || tārkṣyaṃ navārdhatālena ardheṣadbhṛkuṭiṃ? mukhaṃ | dakṣiṇorau sthitāṃ lakṣmīṃ kecidicchantisūrayaḥ || 17.10 || nāgabhoge samāsīnamevaṃ kuryāttu vā hariṃ | saptabhiḥ pañcabhirvāpi phaṇairvistāritairyutaṃ || 17.11 || śeṣaṃ samyakprakurvīta samuttuṅgaśarīriṇaṃ | mādhavaṃ cotpalanibhaṃ cakracāvagadāsibhiḥ || 17.12 || caturbhujadharaṃ kuryāccitramālyāṃbaraṃ hariṃ | govindaṃ pāṇḍurābhaṃ ca caturbhujadharaṃ hariṃ || 17.13 || gadāśaṅkhāripadmāni bibhrantaṃ kārayedbudhaḥ | viṣṇuṃ nīlotpalābhantu śaṅkhāryabjagadābhṛtaṃ || 17.14 || sarvābharaṇa saṃyuktaṃ pītavāsasamacyutaṃ | raktotpalābhaṃ kurvīta devaṃ tu madhusūdanaṃ || 17.15 || śaṅkhāryabjagadāpāṇiṃ caturbhujamanāmayaṃ | trivikramaṃ nīlavarṇaṃ śaṅkhāryabjagadābhṛtaṃ || 17.16 || caturbhujadharaṃ devaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaṃ | vāmanaṃ meghavarṇaṃ tu caturbāhuṃ mahābalaṃ || 17.17 || gadāśaṅkhāripadmāni bibhrantaṃ chalarūpiṇaṃ | atha vā kārayetkuṃbhaṃ dadhyannaṃ ca karadvaye || 17.18 || dadhivāmanamāhustaṃ śvetābhaṃ dvibhujaṃ hariṃ | atha vā vaṭurūpaṃ tu dhṛtvā daṇḍakamaṇḍalū || 17.19 || svarṇacchami bālarūpaṃ dvibhujaṃ kārayeddhariṃ | sitāsitābhaṃ kurvīta śrīdharaṃ tu caturbhujaṃ || 17.20 || koṃodakīśaṅkhacakrapadmadhāriṇamīśvaraṃ | hṛṣīkeśaṃ prakurvīta śyāmābhaṃ ca caturbhujaṃ || 17.21 || gadāśaṅkhāripadmāni bibhrantaṃ harimavyayaṃ | sitamecakavarṇantu padmanābhaṃ prakalpayeth || 17.22 || koṃodakīcakrapadmaśaṅkhapāṇiṃ ramādhavaṃ | dāmodaraṃ prakurvīta sitagaurābhamīśvaraṃ || 17.23 || padmaśaṅkhagadācakradharaṃ devaṃ caturbhujaṃ | saṃkarṣaṇaṃ tu kurvīta śvetavarṇaṃ caturbhujaṃ || 17.24 || śaṅkhāryabjagadāpāṇiṃ sarvādhāraṃ sanātanaṃ | vāsudevaṃ prakurvīta taruṇādityasannibhaṃ || 17.25 || śaṅkhacakragadāpadmadharaṃ sarvadharaṃ vibhuṃ | candrābhaṃ navakundābhamatha vā kālayeddhariṃ || 17.26 || pradyumnaṃ tu suvarṇābhaṃ kuryāddevaṃ caturbhujaṃ | cakraśaṅkhagadāpadmadharaṃ devaṃ mahābalaṃ || 17.27 || aniruddhaṃ hiraṇyābhaṃ sarvālaṅkārasaṃyutaṃ | śaṅkhacakradhanuḥkhaḍgadharaṃ deveśvareśvaraṃ || 17.28 || sitāsitābhaṃ kurvīta deveśaṃ puruṣottamaṃ | śaṅkhacakragadāpadmadharaṃ devaṃ caturbhujaṃ || 17.29 || athokṣajaṃ prakurvīta śaṅkhābhaṃ ca caturbhujaṃ | cakraśaṅkhagadāpadmadharaṃ bhūṣaṇabhūṣitaṃ || 17.30 || nārasiṃhaṃ tu meghābhaṃ sarvālaṅkārasaṃyutaṃ | śaṅkhapadmagadācakradharaṃ bhaktābhayapradaṃ || 17.31 || sitamecakavarṇaṃ tu kurvīta vibhumacyutaṃ | gadābjacakraśaṅkhāṅkaṃ caturbhujavirājitaṃ || 17.32 || janārdanamudārāṅgaṃ nīlavarṇaṃ samācareth | cakraśaṅkhagadāpadmadharaṃ devaṃ sanātanaṃ || 17.33 || atha vā kaṭivinyastavāmahastaṃ prakalpayeth | upendraṃ ghanakṛṣṇābhaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaṃ || 17.34 || śaṅkhacakragadāpadmadharaṃ devaṃ jagatprabhuṃ | hariṃ pāṇḍurakṛṣṇābhaṃ sarvālaṅkāraśobhitaṃ || 17.35 || śaṅkhapadmagadācakradharaṃ kuryānmanoharaṃ | kṛṣṇaṃ tu nīradaśyāmaṃ puṇḍarīkanibhekṣaṇaṃ || 17.36 || śaṅkhacakragadāpadmadharaṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ | sarveṣāṃ tu vimānāni viṣṇoruktavadācareth || 17.37 || sabhyakuṇḍe pradhānāgnau hautraṃ tatra praśaṃsya ca | "keśavaṃ kleśasaṃhāraṃ viṣṇuṃ caiva parātparam' || 17.38 || "nārāyaṇaṃ naraṃ viṣṇuṃ narakāntaka' mityapi | "mādhavaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ viṣṇuṃ sarvātmakaṃ' tviti, || 17.39 || "govindaṃ paramānandaṃ viṣṇuṃ caiva sanātanam' | .viṣṇuṃ vyāpinamīśānaṃ sarvalokādhipaṃ tathā || 17.40 || "madhusūdanamudyogaṃ mahāntaṃ viṣṇu'mityapi | "trivikramaṃ trilokeśaṃ lokādhāraṃ sanātanam' || 17.41 || "vāmanaṃ varadaṃ caiva kāśyapiṃ cāditipriyam' | "śrīdharaṃ puruṣaṃ ceti viṣṇuṃ śrīvatsavakṣasam' || 17.42 || "hṛṣīkeśaṃ jagannāthaṃ viṣṇuṃ viśvamayaṃ' tathā | "padmanābhaṃ sureśaṃ ca viṣṇuṃ caiva jagatpatim.' || 17.43 || "dāmodaraṃ sadādhāraṃ viṣṇuṃ praṇavarūpiṇam' | "saṃkarṣaṇaṃ yaduvaraṃ viṣṇuṃ haladhara'ntathā || 17.44 || "vāsudevaṃ puṇyamūrtiṃ bhadreśaṃ puṇyarūpiṇam' | "pradyumnaṃ jagadīśānaṃ viṣṇu puṇyātmakaṃ' tathā || 17.45 || "aniruddhaṃ mahāntaṃ ca vairāgyaṃ sarvatejasam' | "puruṣottamamānandaṃ viṣṇuṃ pañcātmakaṃ' tathā || 17.46 || "adhokṣajamanādiṃ ca viṣṇuṃ vyāpaka' mityapi | "nārasiṃhaṃ taponāthaṃ mahāviṣṇuṃ mahābalam' || 17.47 || "acyutaṃ cāparimitamaiśvaryaṃ śrīpatiṃ' tathā | .janārdanamanādyantaṃ viṣṇuṃ tejomayaṃ' tathā || 17.48 || "upendramindrāvarajaṃ viṣṇuṃ vaikuṇṭha'mityapi | "hariṃ pāpaharaṃ ceti viṣṇuṃ maṅgalavigrahaṃ || 17.49 || "kṛṣṇaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ puṇyaṃ tridaśādhipa'mityapi | āvāhya tu krameṇaiva nirupyājyāhutīryajeth || 17.50 || "viṣṇornukā'dabhiṣṣaḍbhi"ratodevā'dabhistathā | keśavādidvādaśānāṃ mantrairdvādaśabhirhuneth || 17.51 || nārasiṃhasya kṛṣṇasya mantraḥ pūrvamudīritaḥ | itareṣāṃ daśānāṃ tu daśamantrāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || 17.52 || "viṣṇussarveṣā'mityādi "yaṃ yajñai'rantamīritāḥ | taṃ taṃ devaṃ samuddiśya tattanmantreṇa cātvaraḥ || 17.53 || śatamaṣṭādhikaṃ hutvā śeṣaṃ pūrvavadācareth | evaṃ sarvatra kurvīta devībhyāṃ sahitaṃ vibhuṃ || 17.54 || tadrūpaṃ kautukaṃ kuryātsarvalakṣaṇalakṣitaṃ | karṣaṇādikriyāssarvā viṣṇorina samācareth || 17.55 || lakṣmīkalpaḥ atha vakṣye viśeṣeṇa lakṣmīsthāpanamuttamaṃ | aṣṭadhā procyate lakṣmīḥ prathamā tvanapāyinī || 17.56 || viṣṇorvakṣasthsalekāryā sarvālaṅkārasaṃyutā | dakṣastanasyordhvabhāge vahnyaśredivyamaṇḍale || 17.57 || padmamadhye samāsīnāṃ padmadvayakarāñcitāṃ | varadābhayahastāṃ ca mandasmita mukhāṃbujāṃ || 17.58 || evaṃ rūpāṃ prakurvīta yogalakṣmīstusā matā | yogalakṣmīṃ pratiṣṭhāpya śrīkāmassamyagarcayeth || 17.59 || deveśena samaṃ kuryādasyāsthcāpanamuttamaṃ | kālāntare prakuryāccheddhemarūpyādinā punaḥ || 17.60 || kṛtvā śrīvatsarūpaṃ tu dhārayedviṣṇumavyayaṃ | tattadbiṃbānurūpaṃ ca kuryācchrīvatsalakṣaṇaṃ || 17.61 || bhogalakṣmyassamākhyātā śśrībhūnīlāḥ kramādimāḥ | dhruvādiṣu tu bereṣu śrībhūmyau devapāśanvge || 17.62 || vaikuṇṭhamārgasaṃcārā nīlā nityasamāśritā | śrībhūmyosthsāpanaṃ pūrvaṃ deveśena sahoditaṃ || 17.63 || devībhyāṃ rahite deve kuryātkālāntare punaḥ | pṛdhakpratiṣṭhāṃ śrībhūmyoḥ kuryādāṅgirasoktivath || 17.64 || vīralakṣmīriti proktā pṛthagālayasaṃgatā | alayāddakṣiṇe pārśvekuryāttu pṛthagālayaṃ || 17.65 || daśatālena mānena kuryāddevīna salakṣaṇāṃ | padmadvayakarāṃ caiva vandā bhayadhāriṇīṃ || 17.66 || kirīṭamukucopetāṃ sarvālaṅkāraśobhitaṃ | padmāsane samāsīnāṃ hemābhāṃ sarvamaṅgalāṃ || 17.67 || godāmanyāṃ prakurvīta lakṣmīṃ tu vijayābhidhāṃ | navatāleṃ mānena kuryādanyālayāśritāṃ || 17.68 || dakṣiṇena tu hastena kalhāraṃ dadhatīṃ tathā | prasāritetarakarāṃ baddhadhammillaśobhinīṃ || 17.69 || sarvālaṅkārasaṃyuktāṃ tiṣṭhantīmeva kārayeth | godā bhūmyaṃśajā proktā tanmantreṇācaretkriyāḥ || 17.70 || pākalakṣmīssamākhyātā pacanālayasaṃgatā | aṣṭatālena mānena kuryāttāṃ pacanālaye || 17.71 || padmadvayāñcitakarāṃ varadābhayadhāriṇīṃ | āsīnāṃ vātha tiṣṭhantīṃ kuryādbhūṣaṇabhūṣitāṃ || 17.72 || dvitīya maṇḍapadvāre dvāralakṣmīṃ samācareth | pataṅgapaṭṭikāmadhye sarvālaṅkāraśobhitāṃ || 17.73 || padmadvayāñcitakarāṃ varadābhayadhāriṇīṃ | padmāsane samāsīnāṃ kirīṭādivibhūṣitāṃ || 17.74 || gajai tu pāśanvyoḥkuryāddhemakuṃbhakarau punaḥ | siṃcantau tau mahālakṣmīṃ kuryātkuṃbhajalaistathā || 17.75 || śrībhūmyorvīravijayalakṣmyoreva vidhīyate | dhravaberānurūpeṇa berāntarasamarcanaṃ || 17.76 || tadrūpaṃ kautukaṃ kuryādutsavādi yathecchayā | anyāsāṃnaiva kurvīta dhruvārcāmeva kārayeth || 17.77 || paiṇḍarīke pradhānāgnau hautraṃ tatra praśaṃsya ca | śrībhūmyormūrtimantraiśca krameṇāvāhanādikaṃ || 17.78 || "godāṃ kṛṣṇapriyāṃ lakṣmīṃ rukmiṇī'miti cāhvayeth | āvāhanakrameṇaiva tanmantrairjuhuyātkrarūth || 17.79 || pratiṣṭhoktakrameṇaiva sarvaṃ pūrvavadācareth | navaṣaṭpañcamūrtīnāṃ vimānasyālayasya ca || 17.80 || dvimūrtisthāpanaṃ tadvatrimūrtasthāpanaṃ tathā | anyeṣāṃ parivārāṇāṃ sthāpanaṃ vidhivaccareth || 17.81 || yadyatsamarpyate vastu deveśasya tu mandire | tattatsarvaṃ vidhānena pratiṣṭhāpya samarpayeth || 17.82 || asaṃskṛtaṃ tu na grāhyaṃ na taddevapriyaṃ bhaveth | bhūṣaṇāni ca vā sāṃsi pātrāṇyanyatparicchadaṃ || 17.83 || berālaṅkārayogyāni dhāmālaṅkaraṇāni ca | yathāhaṃnsaṃskṛtānyeva gṛhṇīyātsaphalaṃ bhaveth || 17.84 || tattaddravyādhidaivatyaṃ devatāmūrtimantrakaṃ | juhuyātsarvamanyacca pratiṣṭhoktavadācareth || 17.85 || dravyādhidevatākalbassamyagukto mayākhile || 17.86 || iti śrīvaikhānase bhagavacchāstre bhṛsuproktāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prakīrṇādhikāre saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ <18> athāṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ bhagavadarcanam atha vakṣye viśeṣeṇa viṣṇorarcanamuttamaṃ | "pravaḥ pāntama'ndhetyādi śrutibhirvihitaṃ tathā || 18.1 || yaccoktaṃ guruṇā sūtre samāsena maharṣiṇā | tenaiva vivṛtaṃ śāstre sārdhakoṭī pramāṇataḥ || 18.2 || asmābhistu susaṃkṣiptaṃ cāturlakṣapramāṇataḥ | tadarcanakramaṃ vakṣye śruṇudhvamṛṣisattamāḥ || 18.3 || vaikhānasena sūtreṇa niṣekādi kriyānvitaḥ | ṛtviguktaguṇopetassupuṣṭāṅgassamāhitaḥ || 18.4 || gṛhastho brahmacārī vā bhaktyaivār'canamācareth | dravyairanekaissaṃpādyaṃ tathānantopacārakaiḥ || 18.5 || āśakyaṃ vidhivatkartuṃ brahmādyairapi pūjanaṃ | manuṣyaiḥkimuvaktavyaṃ daridrairadṛḍhātmabhiḥ || 18.6 || yathāśakti tataḥ kuryāttasmādbahubhirarcakaiḥ | bahubhiḥ paricāraiśca tathai vānyapadārthibhiḥ || 18.7 || nirvartyaṃ pūjanaṃ viṣṇośśraddhābhaktisamanvitaiḥ | tasmānnavavidhā grāhyā arcakāḥ paricārakāḥ || 18.8 || uttame tūttamaṃ proktamarcakānāntu viṃśatiḥ | aśītiḥ paricārāṇāmuttame madhyamaṃ tataḥ || 18.9 || paricārāṇāṃ catuṣṣaṣṭidarcakāṣṣoḍaśa smṛtāḥ | uttame tvadhamaṃ proktamarcakā dvādaśa smṛtāḥ || 18.10 || pañcāśatparicārāśca madhyame cottamaṃ punaḥ | catvāriṃśatparicarāḥ pūjakāścāṣṭakīrtitāḥ || 18.11 || madhyame madhyamaṃ proktamacankāṣṣaḍudīritāḥ | pañcaviṃśatparicarā madhyame tvadhamaṃ punaḥ || 18.12 || catvāraḥ pūjakāstatra paricārāstu ṣoḍaśa | trayor'cakāḥ paricarā nava syuradhamottame || 18.13 || pūjakau dvauparicarāścatvāro'dhamamadhyame | ekor'cakaḥ paricarau dvauproktāvadhamādhame || 18.14 || ācāryassyādupadraṣṭā devassānnidhyakārakaḥ | arcanādyakhilaṃ kāryaṃ tanniyogena kārayeth || 18.15 || sa hi kāryasya nirṇetā goptādharmasyadeśikaḥ | arcako devadevasya kuryānmantrāsanādiṣu || 18.16 || upacārānanantāṃśca vidhinā śāstracoditān | arcakasya sahāyantu kiṅkaraḥ paricārakaḥ || 18.17 || bahukāryakarāścaite grāhyāstu paricārakāḥ | sammājannakaraścaiva tathā syādupalepakaḥ || 18.18 || dīpoddīpayitā cauva potraśodhanakārakaḥ | pānīya vāhakaścaiva puṣpāpacayakārakaḥ || 18.19 || dhūpadīpādikartā ca gandhapeṣaṇatatparaḥ | tattatparicchadāhartā tathaiva balivāhakaḥ || 18.20 || evamādīni kāryāṇi kurvanti paricārakāḥ | pācakaḥ paricārassyātpacanālayasaṃgataḥ || 18.21 || haviṣpākavidhānajñaśśaucācāraparāyaṇaḥ | etānvaikhānasāneva vṛṇetsarvānpadārthinaḥ || 18.22 || alābhe tatra sarveṣāmācāryaṃ cārcakānpusaḥ | vaikhānasāneva vṛṇannakyudaryādanyasūtriṇaḥ || 18.23 || avaikhānasa viprastu pūjayedālaye hariṃ | sa vai devalako nāma sarva karmabahiṣkṛtaḥ || 18.24 || paricārāṃntu vṛṇuyādalābhe tvanyasūtriṇaḥ | dīkṣitānevasadvṛttānāgamoktavidhānataḥ || 18.25 || yajamānassadādhyātmarato mokṣārthacintakaḥ | dhanī sarvasamastyāgī bhaktiyuktaḥ prasannadhīḥ || 18.26 || śāstroktena vidhānena viṣṇulāñchanalāñchitaḥ | devasya nityapūjārthamutsavārthaṃ viśeṣataḥ || 18.27 || tathānyavibhavārthaṃ ca dāpayeddhanasaṃcayaṃ | ācāryājñāpratīkṣassyātṝjake hitacintakaḥ || 18.28 || paricāre prasannaśca kiṅkareṣu dayāparaḥ | tīrthaprasādasevī ca nirmālyeṣu kṛtādaraḥ || 18.29 || iti lakṣaṇasaṃpannāḥ prabhavantyālayārcane | athārcakaḥ pramannātmā pañcakālaparāyaṇaḥ || 18.30 || brāhmemuhūrte codthāya nārāyaṇamanusmareth | kṛtvā sūtroktavidhinā śaucādīni yathāvidhi || 18.31 || snātvā snānavidhānena dhṛtvā dhautāṃbare punaḥ | ūrdhvapuṇḍrāṇi saṃdhārya vidhinā keśavādibhiḥ || 18.32 || dhṛtvā pavitrapadmākṣatulasīmaṇimālikāḥ | dhṛtvobhayapavitre ca tathā sandhyāmupāsya ca || 18.33 || uṣṇīṣeṇa ca pañcāgabhūṣaṇainsuvibhūṣitaḥ | samāpya nityakarmāṇi mahāmantrādikaṃ japan || 18.34 || aruṇaṃ tu japitvaiva nārāyaṇamataḥ paraṃ | praṇamya yantrikāñcaiva karābhyāṃ parigṛhya ca || 18.35 || bāhvośśirasi vā nyasya bhaktyā paramayā yutaḥ | saṃgataḥ paricāraiśca yajamānena sādaraṃ || 18.36 || sarvavādya samāyuktaḥ sarvamaṅgalaśobhitaḥ | kramamāṇaśśanairvidvāndevāgāraṃ prati vrajeth || 18.37 || "pratadviṣṇu'riti procya cālayaṃ paritaḥkramāth | yugmapradakṣiṇaṃ kuryāddeva devamanusmaran || 18.38 || yugmapradakṣiṇaṃ kuryādayugmaṃ tvābhicārikaṃ | āyugmaṃ tu parītyāpi tathāyugmaṃ praṇamya ca || 18.39 || prekṣetodyantamādityaṃ japeddvādaśasūktakaṃ | chāyālaṅghanadoṣantu na tatra syātpradakṣiṇe || 18.40 || devāgāraṃ praviśyaiva tattanmantramanusmaran | dvāradevānpraṇamyātha nirastaṃ rakṣamastrataḥ || 18.41 || gṛhītvā yantrikāṃ caiva "hiraṇyapāṇi' muccaran | kavāṭe tu susaṃyojya "divaṃ' vīti samuccaran || 18.42 || kavāṭodghāyanaṃ kṛtvā praviśedantaraṃ budhaḥ | "ato devā' itiprocya devaṃ vīkṣyapraṇamya ca || 18.43 || paricārakamāhūya dīpānuddīpayetkramāth | praṇavaṃ mantramuccārya tatra kāryaṃ samācareth || 18.44 || trissaṃprahārya pāṇibhyāṃ "śāmyantvi'tyādi coccaran | ādarśaṃ gāśca kanyāśca hastyaśvādīnśubhodayān || 18.45 || brāhmaṇānvedaviduṣo nartakāṃścaiva gāyakān | devasya puratasthsāpya mukhamaṇḍapa evacā || 18.46 || pracchanna paṭamudvāsya kṛtvā nīrājanaṃ tathā | sarvavādyasamāyuktaṃ darśayeddharaye mudā || 18.47 || dhāroṣṇaṃ caiva gokṣīraṃ navanītaṃ saśarkaraṃ | deveśāya nivedyātha kuryādyavanikāṃ punaḥ || 18.48 || "bhūḥ prapadye' samuccārya deveśaṃ praṇamenmuhuḥ | "paraṃ raṃ'hīti mantreṇa śayanasthaṃ śriyaḥpatiṃ || 18.49 || "bhūrasī bhū'riti procya jīvasthāne niveśayeth | tasminkāletu ye bhaktyā sevante puruṣottamaṃ || 18.50 || teṣāṃ puṇyaphalaṃ vaktuṃ na śakyaṃ tridaśairapi | tataśśiṣyaṃ samāhūya vinayānvitamādarāth || 18.51 || sammārjanādikarmāṇi gurustasmai samādiśeth | "ava dhūti'miti procya garbhagehādi sarvataḥ || 18.52 || mārjanyā mārjayecchiṣyaḥ prādakṣiṇyakrameṇa vai | pāṃsvādīnparihṛtyāpi prākārāntaṃ ca sarvaśaḥ || 18.53 || "āśā'sviti samuccārya gomayenopalepayeth | pañcagavyaistu saṃprokṣya raṅgavallīssamācareth || 18.54 || "ā mā vājasya' mantreṇa yathoktena vidhānataḥ | sarvaṇyapi ca pātrāṇi śodhayetsumanorame || 18.55 || to yasaṃgrahaṇārthaṃ tu niyuktaḥ pūjakena tu | ghaṭamādāya śiṣyastu "duhatāṃ diva'muccaran || 18.56 || nadītaṭākakūpānāṃ pūrvālābhe paraṃ vrajeth | upasthāya jalaṃ smṛtvā jāhnavīṃ lokapāvanīṃ || 18.57 || "ājyamabhigṛhṇā'mīti cāppavitreṇa vāsasā | gṛhītvotpūtamādhāvaṃ gāyatrīmuccaranpunaḥ || 18.58 || alaṅkṛtyaghaṭaṃ samyakkṣoṃenācchādya tanmukhaṃ | gaje śirasi vā kṣiptvā sarvavādyasamāyutaṃ || 18.59 || punarālayamāviśya kṛtvā caiva pradakṣiṇaṃ | somaṃ rājānamuccārya garbhagehe tu dakṣiṇe || 18.60 || vinyasecca tataḥ kuṃbhaṃ tripādopari śobhite | elośīrādicāhṛtya gandhadravyaṃ yathāvidhi || 18.61 || dadyādarcakahaste tu gṛhītvā tattu pūjakaḥ | pūrṇakuṃbhe tu nikṣipyatoyaṃ tadadhivāsayeth || 18.62 || alābhe kuśadūrvairvā tulasīdalamiśritaiḥ | abhimṛśya tataḥ kuṃbha "midamāpaśśivā'iti || 18.63 || sūtroktavidhinā kṛtvā puṇyāhaṃ vidhivattadā | "śuci vo havya'mantreṇa saṃbhārānprokṣayetkramāth || 18.64 || śodhayitvātu nirmālyaṃ "naśyastu jagatā'miti | "ahameveda'muktvā tu pīṭhapuṣpaṃ ca śodhayeth || 18.65 || "pūtastasya' samuccārya vedimadbhissuśodhayeth | dhruvasya pādapuṣpastu viṣṇugāyatriyā tathā || 18.66 || pañcabhirmūrti mantraiśca datvā devaṃ praṇamya ca | devanirmālyaśeṣeṇa viṣvaksenaṃ vibhūṣya ca || 18.67 || anyannirmālyamādāya śucisthāne'psu vā kṣiveth | pūjanārthāṃśca saṃbhārānyathāśakti susaṃbhareth || 18.68 || tatassamāhito bhūtvāsaṃbhārārcanamārabheth | tattatthsāneṣu pātrāṇi yathārhaṃ sthāpayedbudhaḥ || 18.69 || snānārthamagnikoṇe syādarghyarthaṃ nairṛte'pi ca | pādyārthaṃ vāyudeśe syādācamārthamatheśake || 18.70 || śuddhyarthamekaṃ madhye tu pañcapātramidaṃ kramāth | tripādopare nikṣipte viśāle tāmrabhājane || 18.71 || "agniśśu'cīti mantreṇa sthāpayecca hariṃ smaran | kuryācca pātrasaṃskāraṃ śoṣaṇādi yathāvidhi || 18.72 || uddhariṇyāṃ gṛhītvātu praṇavena jalaṃ tadā | nikṣipya tulasīṃ tasyāṃ puṣpaṃ vā dhāraṇaṃ careth || 18.73 || vārikuṃbhamukhe brahmā tadadho rudra īritaḥ | varuṇastu jale dhyeyastathai vāvāhanaṃ careth || 18.74 || tripāde candramāvāhya cādityaṃ cordhvabhājane | vasiṣṭhasomayajñāṅgāninduṃ mandraṃ krameṇavai || 18.75 || āgneyādikrameṇaiva pañcapātreṣu cāhvayeth | karpūrośīrakaṃ caiva gandhānelālavaṅgakaṃ || 18.76 || snānadravyamidaṃ proktaṃ snānapātre tunikṣipeth | viṣṇuparṇaṃ padmadalaṃ dūrvāṃ śyāmākameva ca || 18.77 || prādyadravyāṇisaṃpādya pādyapātre tu nikṣipeth | kuśākṣatatilavrīhiyavamāṣāṃstathaiva ca || 18.78 || priyaṅgūṃścaiva siddhārthānarghyapātre tu nikṣipeth | elośīralavaṅgādiṃ stakkolānīti ca kramāt, || 18.79 || kṣipedācāmapātre tu śuddhatoye tataḥkramāth | puṣpāṇi gandhānvinyasyedyathālābhamathāpivā || 18.80 || alābhetattaduccārya tulasīṃ vā vinikṣipeth | "dhārā'sviti ca mantreṇa pātrāṇyadbhiḥ prapūrayeth || 18.81 || "idamāpaśśivāḥ' procya surabhimudrāṃ pradarśya ca | pātrābhimantraṇaṃ kuryāddasadigbandhanaṃ careth || 18.82 || viṣṇugāyatrīmuccārya tatrakāryaṃ samācareth | ghaṇṭāyāṃ caiva brahmāṇaṃ nāde vedānsamarcayeth || 18.83 || tajjihvāyāṃ ṣaḍāsyastusūtrenāgāntsamarcayet ūrdhvevīśaṃ ca śaṅkhārī pārśvayostasyacārcayeth || 18.84 || nāle caiva mahādevamiti ghaṇṭādhidevatāḥ | tripādasyottaresthāpya vimalantu patadgrahe || 18.85 || varuṇaṃ śaṅkhakukṣau tu mūle tu pṛthivīṃ tathā | dhārāyāṃ sarvatīrthāṃśca śaṅkhe candraṃ samarcayeth || 18.86 || uddhariṇyāṃ ca pānīyapātre somamathārcayeth | āsane dharmamāvāhyaplote tvaṣṭārameva ca || 18.87 || aṃbare sūryamāvāhya cottarīye niśākaraṃ | bhūṣaṇe ṣaṇmukhaṃ caiva yajñasūtre niśākaraṃ || 18.88 || puṣpe pullaṃ tathā gandhe mukhavāse ca medinīṃ | akṣate kāśyapaṃ dhūpe bṛhaspatimadhāhvāyeth || 18.89 || dīpe śriyaṃ ghṛte sāmataile pitṝntsamarcayeth | upadhāne tathāchatre pāduke śeṣamarcayeth || 18.90 || yantrikāyāṃ ca mārtāṇḍaṃ siddhārthe somamarcayeth | kuśāgre jāhnavīṃ caiva tileṣu pitṛdevatāḥ || 18.91 || taṇḍule ravimāvāhya dadhni cāvāhayedyajuḥ | kṣīre'tharvāṇamāvāhya madhuparke ṛcaṃ tathā || 18.92 || mātrāyāṃ śarvamāvāhya haviḥpātre divākaraṃ | haviṣṇu padmagarbhaṃ ca pānapātre niśākaraṃ || 18.93 || upahārādipātreṣu divākaramathārcayeth | jyeṣṭhāmāvāhya mārjanyāṃ nartakeśarvamarcayeth || 18.94 || gāyake sāmavedaṃ ca nandīśaṃ vādaker'cayeth | pāñcajanyaṃ ca śaṅkhe tu gaṇikāsvapcarastsriyaḥ || 18.95 || garuḍaṃ paricāreṣu samāvāhya tataḥ kramāth | anukteṣu tu dravyeṣu viṣṇumāvāhya kārayeth || 18.96 || tattaddravyādhipe smṛtvātattaddravyasamīpataḥ | tattaddravyadharatvena caturbhirvigrahairyajeth || 18.97 || tattatkarmasu kāle vai yathārhamupayojayeth | tatkāle pyatha vāvāhyatasminkarmaṇi yojayeth || 18.98 || tator'cakaḥ prasannātmādhyātvātmānaṃ janārdanaṃ | devasya dakṣiṇebhāge kūrmapīṭhe samāhitaḥ || 18.99 || biṃbārhaṃ saṃsthito vāpi samāsīno'tha vā punaḥ | dhyātvā dhyānavidhānena japtvācāryapalaṃparāṃ || 18.100 || yogaśāstroktamāgenṇa prāṇāyāmādikaṃ careth | bhūtaśuddhiṃ vidhāyādau nyāsānanyāntsamācareth || 18.101 || akārādikṣakārāntamakṣarāṇi yathāvidhi | sarvatra sandhiṣu nyasya brahmanyāsaṃ samācareth || 18.102 || "brahma brahmantarātme'ti hṛdayaṃ cābhimarśayeth | "dyaurdyaira'sīti coccārya mūrdhānaṃ cābhimarśayeth || 18.103 || "śikhe udvartayā'mīti spṛśeccaiva śikhāṃ tathā | "devānāmāyudhai'ruktvā kavacaṃ bandhayettataḥ || 18.104 || "nārāyaṇāya vidmaha' iti daśadigbhandhanaṃ careth | "sudarśanama'bhītyuktvā dakṣiṇe tu sudarśanaṃ || 18.105 || "ravipā'miti vāme ca śaṅkhaṃ ca bibhṛyātkare | "sūryosi ca dro'sī'tyuktvā netrayordakṣavāmayoḥ || 18.106 || sūryācandramasoścaiva maṇḍale sannyasedbudhaḥ | "ahuraṇyaṃ vidhiṃ yajñaṃ brahmāṇaṃ devendra'mityapi || 18.107 || aṅguṣṭhādikaniṣṭhāntaṃ karanyāsaṃ samācareth | "antarasminnima'iti brahmāṇaṃ ca hṛdi nyaseth || 18.108 || prāṇānāyamya saṃkalpya tithivārādikīrtayeth | tato mantrāsanaṃ vidvānsaṃkalpya ca yathāvidhi || 18.109 || "pratadviṣmussavata'iti iti ta"thāstvāsana'mityapi | puṣpadabhankuśeṣvekaṃ pīṭhānte cāsanaṃ dadeth || 18.110 || "viśvādhikānā'mityuktvā svāgataṃ tu samācareth | "mano'bhimantā'mantreṇa deveśamanumānya ca || 18.111 || "trīṇi pa'deti mantreṇa dadyātpādyaṃ padadvaye | "āmāvājasya'mantreṇa spṛśyamaghaṃnypradāya ca || 18.112 || devasya dakṣiṇe haste spṛśyaṃ ssṛśyāghanymucyate | "śannodevī'riti procya dadyādācamanīyakaṃ || 18.113 || "devasya'tveti mantreṇa cādarśaṃ darśayettataḥ | annādyāya samuccārya dantadhāvanamācareth || 18.114 || hiraṇmayaṃ vā raupyaṃ vā dantakāṣṭhaṃ ṣaḍaṅgulaṃ | jauduṃbaraṃ vā saṃpādya yathālābhaṃ samācareth || 18.115 || "idaṃ bra'hmeti mantreṇa jihmāśodhanamācareth | "yanme garbhe'samuccārya gaṇḍūṣaṃ kṣālanaṃ tathā || 18.116 || "śannodevī'riti procya dadyādācamanaṃ tataḥ | "vicakrame' namuccārya mukhavāsaṃ pradāpayeth || 18.117 || pūrvavastraṃ visṛjyaiva paridhāpyānyavāsasā | grīvāyāḥ pṛṣṭhataḥ kuryādavakuṇṭhanamādarāth || 18.118 || keśānvikīrya mantrajño vāmabhāge ca susthitaḥ | "uvānahā'viti procya purastātpādukenyaseth || 18.119 || "bhūḥprapadye' samuccārya praṇamya jagatāṃ patiṃ | "para bra'hmeti mantreṇa samādāya tu kautukaṃ || 18.120 || svastisūktaṃ tato japtvā "pratadviṣṇu'riti bruvan | snānapīṭhe susaṃsthāpya pādyamācamanaṃ dadeth || 18.121 || ato devādimantraistu tailamālipya mūrdhani | tathaiva viṣṇugāyatṣā sarvāṃgāṇyanulepayeth || 18.122 || "parilikhita'miti mantreṇa sarvāṅgamapi śodhayeth | āmlena khaṇḍaśīkena śarkarābhiryathocitaṃ || 18.123 || alāśodhanaṃ kuryācchrīpatrāmalakāṃbunā | śālipiṣṭena gandhādyairaṅgaśodhanamācareth || 18.124 || viśadaṃ śodhayitvātu saṃsnāpyoṣṇena vāriṇā | "vārīścatasra'ityuktvā śuddhodairabhiṣecayeth || 18.125 || "namo varuṇa'ityuktvā gokṣīrairabhiṣecayeth | "bhūrānilaya'mantreṇa snāpayedgandhavāriṇā || 18.126 || "agnimīle'samuccārya madhunā snānamācareth | "sīnīvā'līti mantreṇa hāridrodakasecanaṃ || 18.127 || tattaddravyāntare caiva bhavecchuddhodakāplapaḥ | punargandhodakenaiva "gandhadvārā' mudīrya ca || 18.128 || snāpayeddevadeveśaṃ tūryaghoṣapurassaraṃ | caturvedādimantraiśca śuddhodaissnāpayetpunaḥ || 18.129 || "mitrassuparṇa'ityuktvā vimṛjya plotavāsanā | pūrvavastraṃ visṛjyaipa parīdhāpya tathetarath || 18.130 || pādyamācamanaṃ dadyātpūrvoktena vidhānataḥ | praṇamya devadeveśaṃ datvāpuṣbāñjaliṃ tataḥ || 18.131 || "bhūrasi bhū'rityuccārya jīvasthāne niveśayeth | "trirdeva'mantramuccārya dṛśyāghanyntu samarpayeth || 18.132 || tataḥprokṣya dhruvasthānaṃ gāyatrīmantramuccaran | "saṃyuktameta'duccārya dhruvakautukayontataḥ || 18.133 || saṃbandhārthaṃ nyasetkūrcaṃ kautukāgraṃ vidhānataḥ | gāyatṣā dhruvapīṭhantu prokṣya śuddhena vāriṇā || 18.134 || "viṣṇave nama'ityuktvā devadevamanusmaran | dhruvasya pādayormadhye puṣpanyāsaṃ samācareth || 18.135 || prāgādi ca nyasettatra pādakṣiṇyakrameṇa vai | caturthyantena puṣpāṇipuruṣaṃ satyamacyutaṃ || 18.136 || aniruddhamiti rocya mahādikṣu caturṣu ca | āgneyādi tathā nyanyedvidikṣu ca krameṇa vai || 18.137 || kapilaṃ caiva yajñaṃ ca nārāyaṇaṃ puṇyameva ca | prathamāvaraṇaṃ caitaddvitīyāvaraṇe tataḥ || 18.138 || pūrvoktena krameṇaiva vārāhaṃ nārasiṃhakaṃ | vāmanaṃ trivikramaṃ caiva subhadraṃ ca tataḥ paraṃ || 18.139 || īśitātmānamityuktvā sarvodvahamataḥ paraṃ | sarvavidveśvaraṃ ceti samabhyarcyedbahirmukhān || 18.140 || tṛtīyāvaraṇe tattaddigīśāṃśca samarcayeth | śrīphūmyormūrtimantraiśca devyorapi samācareth || 18.141 || evaṃ dhruvasya pīṭhe tu puṣpanyāsa udāhṛtaḥ | atha kautukapīṭhe tu pūrvoktena krameṇa vai || 18.142 || prācyāṃ subhadramāvāhya hayātmakamataḥ paraṃ | rāmadevaṃ puṇyadevaṃ sarvaṃ caiva sukhāvahaṃ || 18.143 || saṃvahaṃ suvahaṃ ceti prathamāvaraṇer'cayeth | dvitīyāvaraṇe tadvanmitra matriṃ śivaṃ tataḥ || 18.144 || viśvaṃ sanātanaṃ caiva sanarthanamataḥ paraṃ | sanatkumāraṃ sanakamarcayecca bahirmukhān || 18.145 || tṛtīyāvaraṇe tadvallokapālāntsamarcayeth | praṇavādi namo'ntaṃ syādarcanaṃ nyāsa ucyate || 18.146 || ekādaśabhiraṣṭābhirupacāraistathārcayeth | tatra devyośca vidhinā dhruvatevyorivācareth || 18.147 || mārkaṇḍeyaṃ bhṛguṃ caiva devadakṣiṇavāmayoḥ | brahmāṇaṃ śaṅkaraṃ tadvadbhittipārśve samarcayeth || 18.148 || deveśābhimukhānetānyathāvidhi samarcayeth | dvārārcanaṃ samārabhya śiṣyaḥ kuryādgurūditaḥ || 18.149 || dvāre dvāre dvāradevāndvārapālāntsamarcayeth | vimānapālānlokeśāṃstathā caiva'napāyinaḥ || 18.150 || parivārāṃstathānyāṃśca viṣṇubhūtāntameva ca | tattannāmnā samabhyarcya "bhūrānilaya' mantrataḥ || 18.151 || dvāraprakṣālanaṃ kṛtvā dakṣiṇe madhyavāmayoḥ | dharmaṃ jñānamathaiśvarya māvāhya susamarcayeth || 18.152 || sarvatra dvāravāme tu rakṣārthaṃ śāntamarcayeth | tato yavanikāṃ kuryāddvāre kṣoṃādinirmitāṃ || 18.153 || striyaśśūdrāntu patitāḥ pāṣaṇḍā vedanindakāḥ | devatāntara bhaktāśca pāparogādipīḍitāḥ || 18.154 || abhiśastāśca ye pāpāśśāstreṣu tu vininditāḥ | pūjākāle tu nārhanti sevituṃ harimavyayaṃ || 18.155 || dhyānamāviśya tatkāle pūjakassusamāhitaḥ | ātmasūktaṃ japitvaiva sākṣānnārāyaṇo bhaveth || 18.156 || viṣṇuṃ vyāpinamātmāna makhaṇḍānandacinmayaṃ | rukmābhaṃ raktanetrāsyapāṇipādaṃ sukhodvahaṃ || 18.157 || kirīṭahārakeyūrakuṇḍalāṅgadabhūṣitaṃ | śaṅkhacakradharaṃ devaṃ varadābhayacihnitaṃ || 18.158 || śrīvatsāṃkaṃ mahābāhuṃ kaustubhodbhāsitorasaṃ | śukapiñchāṃbaradharaṃ pralaṃbabrahmasūtriṇaṃ || 18.159 || divyāyudhaparīvāraṃ divyabhūṣāvibhūṣitaṃ | devībhyāṃ parivāraiśca sevyamānaṃ jagatpatiṃ || 18.160 || dhyāyetsannihitaṃ biṃbe nārāyaṇamanāmayaṃ | yathāberaṃ tathā thātvā nyāsakarma tataścareth || 18.161 || suvarbhuvarbhūrityuktvā mūrdhni nābhau ca sādayoḥ | biṃbasya vyāhṛtīrnyasyedvyāhṛtinyāsa ucyate || 18.162 || pādayorantare pīṭhe yakāraṃ ca tatonyaseth | akāraṃ hṛdayenyasya cādibījaṃ tataḥpunaḥ || 18.163 || āveṣṭya praṇavenaitānpraṇāmaṃ punarācareth | puṣpagandhākṣatairyuktaṃ śuddhodairabhipūritaṃ || 18.164 || praṇidhiṃ caurdhvamuddhṛtya dīpāddīpamivakramāth | "idaṃ viṣṇuriti'procya "cāyātu bhagavā'niti || 18.165 || praṇavātmakamavyaktaṃ divyamaṅgalavigrahaṃ | dhruvātpraṇidhitoye tu kūrcevāvāhayeddhariṃ || 18.166 || tadvyāptaṃ to yamādāya kautukasya tu mūrdha ni | praṇavena samāsrāvya kūrcevāvāhayedguruḥ || 18.167 || mūrtimantrāntsamuccārya tatra kāryaṃ samācareth | devyau caiva tathāvāhya samyagabhyarcayedbudhaḥ || 18.168 || tathaivāvāhayedvidvānvidhinā cotsavādiṣu | kaitukādbaliberasya kecidāvāhanaṃ viduḥ || 18.169 || alaṅkārāsanaṃ paścātsaṃkalsya ca yathāvidhi | asanaṃ mantravaddadyāddeveśamanumānayeth || 18.170 || pādyamācamanaṃ cāpi dadyātpūrvoktamantrataḥ | "tejovatkyāva'vamantreṇa vastraṃ kṣoṃādicārpayeth || 18.171 || "bhūto bhūteṣu' mantreṇa bhūṣaṇaiśca vibhūṣya ca | "somasya tanūra'sītyuktvādhārayeduttarīyakaṃ || 18.172 || aṣṭākṣareṇa mantreṇa cordhvapuṇḍraṃ ca dhārayeth | "agniṃ dūtami'ti procya yajñasūtraṃ samarpayeth || 18.173 || "tadviṣṇoriti mantreṇa puṣpādyaiḥ pūjayettataḥ | mūrtimantrāntsamuccārya keśavādibhireva vā || 18.174 || aṣṭottaraśataistadvadaṣṭottarasahasrakaiḥ | anantainānmabhiḥ pūjyo'nantanāmā bhavānhariḥ || 18.175 || "tadviprāsa' iti procya candanenānulepayeth | "paromātra'yetyuccārya dhūpamāghrāpayettataḥ || 18.176 || "viṣṇoḥ karmāṇi' mantreṇa dīpaṃ tasmai pradarśayeth | "trirdeva'iti mantreṇa dadyādaghaṃ ca pūrvavath || 18.177 || upacāreṣu sarveṣu priyamaghaṃnyharessmṛtaṃ | tasmānnivedayeddhīmānmadhupakonpamaṃ śubhaṃ || 18.178 || acamanantu tasyānte pūrvamantreṇa kārayeth | droṇataṇḍulamādāya tadardhaṃ pādamevavā || 18.179 || taṇḍulārthatilairyuktaṃ mukhavāsaphalānvitaṃ | gṛhītvā kāṃsyapātretu devasyāgre nidhāya ca || 18.180 || daśanyeddevadevasya "somaṃ rājāna'muccaran | devārpitaistu nirmālyaiḥ pūjayitvār'cakaṃ tataḥ || 18.181 || "ghṛtātpa'rīti mantreṇa daśanyitvākaraṃ hareḥ | arcakāya pradeyaṃ syānmātrādānamiti smṛtaṃ || 18.182 || bahuśo dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāddānasādguṇyasiddhaye | "devasya'tveti mantreṇa parigṛhya tadarcakaḥ || 18.183 || upayuñjyātkuṭuṃbārthe sa hi dāyaharo hareḥ | devadravyovabhoge tu yaśśāstraidonṣa īritaḥ || 18.184 || vaikhānasānāṃ taddoṣā nāsti devaprasādataḥ | praṇamya devadeveśaṃ mantrairvedādisaṃbhavaiḥ || 18.185 || strotraiśca vividhaintsutvā pāde puṣpāñjaliṃ kṣipeth | daśanyedvividhākārāndīpānmantreṇa tatra tu || 18.186 || kuṃbhadīpaṃ samādāya devāgre tu vinikṣipeth | vārāhaṃ nārasiṃhaṃ ca cāmanaṃ ca trivikramaṃ || 18.187 || daleṣvabhyarcya vidhinā dīpe lakṣmīṃ samarcayeth | vartikāyāṃ śriyaṃ caiva dhūme'bhyarcyabhavaṃ tathā || 18.188 || prokṣyopacārairabhyarchya puṣpagandhādibhiḥ kramāth | "śubhrā jyoti'riti procya karābhyāṃ parigṛhya ca, || 18.189 || pradakṣiṇaṃ trivāraṃ tu darśayanbhrāmayeddhariṃ | sarvavādyasamāyuktaṃ taṃ dīpaṃ parigṛhya ca || 18.190 || śiṣyo vā gaṇikā vāpi devāgāraṃ parītya ca | visṛjeccaiva taṃ dīpaṃ pṛṣṭhe yūthādhipasya ca || 18.191 || taddīpadarśanānnṝṇāmāyuśśrīputrasaṃvadaḥ | saṃbhavanti na sandeho viṣṇornī rājanaṃ hī tath || 18.192 || citraiścavālavyajanaistatkāle vījayedguruḥ | darbaṇaṃ cāmaraṃ chatraṃ vyajanaṃ caturaṅgakaṃ || 18.193 || nṛttaṃ gītaṃ ca vādyaṃ ca vaiṣṇavaṃ mantramuccaran | devasya darśayitvātu stotraṃ vedaiḥkramāccareth || 18.194 || tathā nānāvidhaistotraiśśrāvayedacyutaṃ hariṃ | anuktaṃ caiva yatsarvamūhayitvā samācareth || 18.195 || śrībhūmyohṛndaye nyasya tattadbījākṣaraṃ pṛthak | tatsūktābhyāṃ ṣoḍaśopacārairabhyarcayetkramāth || 18.196 || utcavādeśca pūrvoktaṃ sarvamarcanamācareth | tatobhojyānanaṃ caiva saṃkalpya ca yathāvidhi || 18.197 || ghṛtaṃ madhu guḍaṃ caiva payo dadhi samanvitaṃ | prasthamātraṃ tu saṃgrāvyāṃ madhupakanmihocyate || 18.198 || "yanmadhuneti mantreṇa madhupākaṃ nivedayeth | paścādācamanaṃ datvāśiṣyaṃ kārye niyojayeth || 18.199 || "athāvanīda'mantreṇa śodhayitvā sthalaṃ tataḥ | maṇḍalaṃ caturaśraṃ ca kārayetbaricārakaḥ || 18.200 || haviḥ pātrāṇi saṃśodhya ravimabhyarchya teṣu vai | abhighārya ghṛtenaiva havistatra tu nikṣipeth || 18.201 || "amṛtopastaraṇama'sītyatra kāryaṃ samācareth | upadaṃśādikaṃ tatra guḍaṃ dadhi phalāni ca || 18.202 || nikṣipya viṣṇugāyatṣā pṛthakpātreṣvasaṃkaraṃ | "yatte susīma' mantreṇa goghṛtenābhighārya ca || 18.203 || devasyāgre tu nikṣipya tripādeṣu yathāvidhi | havirarpaṇakāle tu na sevyo harirucyate || 18.204 || tasmādvaikhānasānhitvā brāhmaṇā anyasūtriṇaḥ | na viśeyustathānye ca tatkāle viṣṇumandiraṃ || 18.205 || kavāṭaṃ bandhayetpaścātghaṇṭānādaṃ ca kārayeth | tūryaghoṣādikaṃ kuryānmṛḍuvādyapriyo hariḥ || 18.206 || tator'cakaḥ prasannātmā devadevamanusmaran | haviḥpātreṣu tulasīṃ nikṣipyāṣṭākṣareṇa tu || 18.207 || puṣpairabhyarcya saṃprokṣya praṇavaiḥ pariṣicya ca | abhimṛśyānnasūktena surabhimudrāṃ pradarśya ca || 18.208 || "tadasya priya'mityuktvā haviruṣṇaṃ nivedayeth | "subhūssvayaṃbhūṃ'tyuktvā apūpaṃ ca nivedayeth || 18.209 || pṛthukādīni cānyāni "viśvabheṣaja'mantrataḥ | apakvāni ca vastūni sarvamaṣṭākṣareṇa tu || 18.210 || "idaṃ viṣṇu'ssamuccārya pānīyaṃ svādu śītalaṃ | nivedayitvā gaṇḍūṣaṃ pādyamācamanaṃ dadet, || 18.211 || "ghṛtātba'rīti mantreṇa mukhavāsaṃ pradāpayeth | viṣṇugāyatrīmuccārya dadyātpuṣpāñjaliṃ tataḥ || 18.212 || nityāgnikuṇḍe chullyāṃ vā pariṣicya ca pāvakaṃ | caruṇājyena juhuyāsmūrtimantraiḥkramādbudhaḥ || 18.213 || devyādibhyastathā hutvā vaiṣṇavaṃ ca yajetkramāth | puṣpanyāsoktadevebhyaḥ pāṣandānāṃ tathaiva ca || 18.214 || trikāleṣūttamaṃ proktamadhamaṃ prātarevahi | prātarmadhyāhnayoścaiva madhyamaṃ homalakṣaṇaṃ || 18.215 || rakṣedagnimavicchinnamaśakto yaśca rakṣitaṃ | samidhyātmani vāropya praṇīyāharaharyajeth || 18.216 || tatoyātrāsanaṃ vidvānsaṃkalpya vidhinā budhaḥ | prokṣyālaṅkṛtya cādāya rathaṃ vā caturantaraṃ || 18.217 || baliberaṃ samāropya sarvālaṅkārasaṃyutaṃ | "rathantaraṃ' samuccārya tatra kāryaṃ samācareth || 18.218 || "yogeśaṃ paraṃbrahmāṇaṃ paramātmānamityapi | bhaktavatsala'mityuktvā mūrtimantraistathā hariṃ || 18.219 || nārācarajjvā nudṛḍhaṃ bandhayedrahasikramāth | "viṣṇustvā'miti mantreṇa pādau sṛṣṭvā namenmuhuḥ || 18.220 || "somaṃ rājāna'muccārya chatraṃ mūrdhani dhārayeth | "marutaḥ paramā'tmeti pārśvayoścāmare dadeth || 18.221 || "vāyupa'rīti mantreṇa vyajanairvījayeddhariṃ | tathānyaissumahāhainśca yuktodivyaparicchadaiḥ || 18.222 || ghaṇṭāraveṇa saṃyuktaṃ śaṅkhabherīnināditaiḥ | bherīmṛdaṅgapaṇavanissālaiḥ kāhalairapi || 18.223 || mardalairdivyavādyaiśca layaśrutisamanvitaiḥ | upatiṣṭhejjagadyoniṃ nārāyaṇamanāmayaṃ || 18.224 || śiṣyamāhūya tatkāle soṣṇiṣaṃ sottarīyakaraṃ | ūrdhvepuṣpaṃ ca sannyasya prokṣayitvā ca mantrataḥ || 18.225 || tasyoṣṇīṣoparisthāpya balipātraṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ | alaṅkṛtya ca mālyādyaiḥpūjayettākṣanyvatsmareth || 18.226 || vāhayitvā baliṃ tena balipātreṇa caiva hi | sarvadvāreṣu sarvatra puṣpanyāsoktamāgantaḥ || 18.227 || pūrvāntamuttarāntaṃ ca nikṣipettu baliṃ kramāth | toyaṃ puṣpaṃ baliṃ toyaṃ catvārastatra vigrahāḥ || 18.228 || tato devaṃ samānīya kramamāṇāśśanaiśsanaiḥ | vāhakā vāhayeyustaṃ rathaṃ sarvaṅgasundaraṃ || 18.229 || krameṇa namrakāyastu kṣipecchiṣyo baliṃ kramāth | baliṃ datpāgrato gaccheddevena saha vā pṛthak || 18.230 || tato devaṃ kramānnītvā prādakṣiṇyakrameṇa vai | tatkāle tu balirdeya statkramastupravakṣyate || 18.231 || maṇikaṃ ca tatassandhyāṃ pradhamadvārapālakau | tāpasaṃ siddhidaṃ caiva dvitīya dvārapālakau || 18.232 || nyakṣendrāvantarāle ca yathāvidhi samarcayeth | prathamāvaraṇadvāre kiṣkindhaṃ tīrdhameva ca || 18.233 || dditīyāvaraṇadvāre gaṇeśaṃ śeṣamarcayeth | tṛtīyāvaraṇadvāre śaṅkhapadmanidhī tathā || 18.234 || tuhiṇaṃ ca balindaṃ ca caturthāvaraṇe tathā | pañcamāvaraṇe caiva khaḍgaṃ śāṅkhaṃ samarcayeth || 18.235 || ṣaṣṭhe cāvaraṇa śaṅkhacakracūḍau samarcayeth | caṇḍaṃ tathā pracaṇḍaṃ ca saptamāvaraṇer'cayeth || 18.236 || sopānamadhye śrībhūtaṃ garuḍaṃ ca samarcayeth | havīrakṣakamagniṃ ca āgneyyāṃ samyagarcayeth || 18.237 || vimānadakṣiṇe pārśve vivasvantaṃ yamaṃ tathā | nairṛtyāṃ vādya'rakṣaṃ ca nirṛtiṃ ca samarcayeth || 18.238 || paścime mitramabhyarcyettathā varuṇameva ca | vāyavyāmarcayeccaiva puṣpeśamarutau tathā || 18.239 || uttarasyāṃ tu kṣattāraṃ kuberaṃ ca samarcayeth | īśānaṃ bhāskaraṃ caiva tathaiśānye samarcayeth || 18.240 || bhūtapīṭhe samabhyarcya cakraṃ caiva dhvajaṃ tathā | śaṅkhaṃ yūthādhipaṃ caiva akṣahantaṃ tathārcayeth || 18.241 || pīṭhasya dakṣiṇe bhāge "ye bhūtā' iti mantrataḥ | bhūtayakṣapiśācebhyo baliśeṣaṃ tu nirvapeth || 18.242 || pādau prakṣālya cācamya tatra kāryaṃ samācareth | nṛttageyādiyuktaṃ tu divyastotraissamanvitaṃ || 18.243 || pradakṣiṇatrayaṃ kṛtvā bhrāmayitvā jagadguruṃ | sopānamadhye saṃsthāpya rajjubandhaṃ visṛjya ca || 18.244 || jayaśabdaistathāmantrairdadyānnī rājanaṃ tataḥ | tato devaṃ samādāya svasthāne tu niveśayeth || 18.245 || viṣṇusūktaṃ samuccārya praṇāmaṃ muhurācareth | dadyātpuṣpāñjaliṃ caiva dvādaśāṣṭaṣaḍakṣaraiḥ || 18.246 || pauruṣaṃ sūktamuccārya praṇavaṃ ca samuccaran | mukhavāsaṃ samarpyaiva śaktito dakṣiṇāṃ dadeth || 18.247 || tataḥpatadgrahāttīrthamādāyaiva tu pūjakaḥ | triḥpibenniyato bhūtvā tulasīmapi bhakṣayeth || 18.248 || pratyūṣaśca prabhātaśca madhyāhnaścāparāhmakaḥ | sāyaṅkālo niśīthaśca pūjākālāntu ṣaṭsmṛtāḥ || 18.249 || prātaḥkālercanaṃ kuryājjapahomābhivṛddhaye | rājarāṣṭrābhivṛddhyarthaṃ madhyāhnārcanamiṣyate || 18.250 || sāyaṅkāler'canaṃ caiva sarvasasyābhivṛddhaye | uṣaḥkālār'canaṃ proktaṃ prajāpaśuvivṛddhaye || 18.251 || aparāhṇārcanaṃ caiva daityanāśanahetave | ardharātrār'canaṃ proktaṃ catuṣpādabhivṛddhaye || 18.252 || evaṃ ṣaṭkālapūjāyāṃ phalamuktaṃ viśeṣataḥ | ṣaṭkālaṃ vā trikālaṃ vā dvikālaṃ kālameva vā || 18.253 || pūjanaṃ devadevasya tvaihikāmuṣmikapradaṃ | ṣaṭkāla pūjane kuryādādāvāhanaṃbudhaḥ || 18.254 || tathāntya velārcanāyāṃ kuryādudvāsanaṃ paraṃ | upasandhyāsu deveśamāsanādyaṣṭavigrahaiḥ || 18.255 || samabhyarcya havirdadyādvinā homaṃ baliṃ tathā | puṣpanyāsaṃ ca homaṃ ca parivārārcanaṃ baliṃ || 18.256 || nityayātrotsavaṃ caivetyupasandhyāsu varjayeth | trikālamarcane'nyatra mnapanaṃ prātareva hī || 18.257 || prokṣaṇaṃ cānyakāle tu mantreṇetyāha pūjanaṃ | śiṣyāṇāmapyabhāve tu varṣādyupahatau tathā || 18.258 || tathā vādyādyabhāve vā balikāle samāgate | tadā devāntsamāvāhya dvārāgre nikṣipedbaliṃ || 18.259 || sūryastvāmantramuccārya kavāṭaṃ bandhayettataḥ | madhyāhne caiva sāyāhne kāle kāle tathācareth || 18.260 || tathaivodghaṭayetkāle sarvaṃ pūrvavadarcanaṃ | puṣpaṃ dvārārcitaṃ śodhya punardvāre samarcayeth || 18.261 || dhruvapīṭhetu puṣpāṇi na śodhyāni punaḥpunaḥ | tāni puṣpāṇyanuddhṛtya tadūrdhve nyāsamācaret, || 18.262 || sāyārcane tu tāni syuninrmālyāni na cānyataḥ | kautukādyarcitaṃ puṣpamādāya vidhinā budhaḥ || 18.263 || pīṭhe pārśve nidhāyānyairarcayettu navairnavaiḥ | antyavelārcanānte tu saṃkalbya śayanāsanaṃ || 18.264 || vimucya vastramālyādīnsūkṣmavastraṃ samarpya ca | abhyarcya puṣbagandhādyairdevadevaṃ śriyaḥpatiṃ || 18.265 || sarvauṣadhivimiśraṃ ca kaṣāyaṃ toyameva ca | nivedya devadevasya mukhavāsaṃpradāpayeth || 18.266 || "yadvaiṣṇava'miti procya mṛduvādyairmanoramaiḥ | divyopadhānasahite divyālaṅkāraśobhite || 18.267 || pariṣkṛte vitānādvairdivyadhūpaiḥ sudhūpite | mahāhānstaraṇopete śayane śāyayeddhariṃ || 18.268 || śrībhūmyau ca samādāya tanmantrābhyāṃ kramādguruḥ | śāyayeddevapāśenvtu "dhruvanta'iti coccareth || 18.269 || "aricitassuṣṭutaścāsi suparṇagaruḍadhvaja | cakrapāṇe mahābāho yatheṣṭaṃ vasa oṃ namaḥ' || 18.270 || iti mantraṃ samuccārya bhaktyā paramāyā yutaḥ | prātarāvāhitāṃ śaktiṃ dhruvabere'varopayeth || 18.271 || pradakṣiṇaṃ praṇāmaṃ ca kṛtvā mantreṇa deśikaḥ | stutvā puruṣasūktena viṣṇugāyatriyā tathā || 18.272 || vyāpakatrayamantraiśca tathā "viṣṇornukā'dibhiḥ | "ato devā'dibhirmantrairmantrairanyaiśca vaiṣṇavaiḥ || 18.273 || ekākṣarādisūktaiśca dvādaśāṣṭaṣaḍakṣaraiḥ | muhuḥpuṣpājaliṃ datvākṣāmayeddoṣasaṃcayaṃ || 18.274 || atha vakṣye viśeṣeṇa pūjanaṃ cautsavādiṣu | brahmasthānaṃ kautukasya pūrvameva samīritaṃ || 18.275 || pāśanvyoḥkautukasyātha sthāpayetsnāpanautsavau | uttare kautukasyaiva baliberasya saṃsthitiḥ || 18.276 || garbhālayasya saṃkoce tvatha vā mukhamaṇḍape | antarāle'tha vā sthāpya pūjayetsnāpanautsavau || 18.277 || snāpanautsavayoḥkuryātpūrvoktārcanamuttamaṃ | āsanādyupacārāṃśca kalpayetṣoḍaśātha vā || 18.278 || trayodaśopacāraiśca śāntaṃ samyaksamarcayeth | navopacārairabhyarcyedanapāyigaṇāṃstathā || 18.279 || dvāradevāndvārapālānlokapālāṃstathaiva ca | aṣṭopacārairabhyarcyenmūrtimantraiḥ samācareth || 18.280 || itarānparīvārāṃśca yajetṣoḍaśavigrahaiḥ | tathaiva pākalakṣmyāśca dvāralakṣmyāśca kārayeth || 18.281 || śrīvatsalakṣmyāśca tathā devena saha cācareth | avatārapratiṣṭhāyāṃ dhruvarcāṃ vātha kārayeth || 18.282 || trivikramapratiṣṭhāyāṃ dhruvārcāmarcayettataḥ || 18.283 || iti śrīvaikhānase bhagavacchāstre bhṛguproktāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prakīrṇādhikāre'ṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ <19> athaikonaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ bhagavadarcanam ata ūrdhvaṃ dhruvārcāyāṃ arcanaṃ saṃpravakṣyate | mūrdhādi pīṭhātsannyastapuṣpādīnyapi śodhayet || 19.1 || yogavīrārcanaṃ syāccettrikālaṃ snānamācareth | prātarmadhyāhnayorvātha yogapīṭhedhruvār'canaṃ || 19.2 || bhogameva dhruvārcāyāṃ prātarmadhyāhna yorapi | trikālaṃ vātha saṃsnāpya dhruvārcāyāṃ viśeṣataḥ || 19.3 || vastrādīnyapi saṃśodhya puṣpanyāsaṃ ca pūrvavat| śivādīnarcayitvātu pādapīṭhe samantataḥ || 19.4 || tathāsanādyaissarvaiśca trisaṃdhyaṃ cārcayedbudhaḥ | ardhayāme tu pūrvāntamarcayitvā ca pūrvavat || 19.5 || havirni vedayeccaivānuktamasyacca pūrvavath | āvāhanavisargau tuna kuryāditi śāsanaṃ || 19.6 || atha vakṣyer'canāntetu vidhānaṃ prati karmaṇāṃ | sauvarṇamuttamaṃ pātraṃ rājataṃ madhyame bhaveth || 19.7 || adhamaṃ tāmrapātraṃ tu trividhaṃ pātra mucyate | tritālamuttamaṃ proktaṃ dvitālaṃ madhyamaṃ bhavet || 19.8 || adhamaṃ tvekatālaṃ syāttrividhaṃ pātravistaraṃ | vistāreṇa samākhyātaṃ tayormadhyamamadhyamaṃ || 19.9 || tasya madhye tribhāgaikaṃ karṇikāṃgulamucchrayaṃ | pareto'ṣṭadalaṃ kuryātkarṇikocchrayamānataḥ || 19.10 || dvyaṅgulaṃ mūlanāhaṃ syāttadagraṃ tvardhanāhakaṃ | kiñcitphalāṃbujākāramagraṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ || 19.11 || dviprasthataṇḍulaiḥ pakvamannaṃ tatraiva nikṣipet| abhighārya ghṛtenaiva aṣṭāṃgulasamunnataṃ || 19.12 || daśāṅgulaṃ vā utsedhaṃ dvādaśāṃgulamevavā | tatpātrañca samādāya kautukāgre nidhāya ca || 19.13 || kautukācchaktimādāya cārcayedaṣṭavigrahaiḥ | "parabrahmāṇa mityuktvā paramātmānamityapi || 19.14 || bhaktavatsalaṃ yogeśaṃ' caturmūrtibhirarcayeth | prātaḥpuṣpabaliṃ kuryānmadhyāhnennabaliṃ tathā || 19.15 || sāye tvarghyabaliṃ kuryātpūrvameva pracoditaṃ | taṇḍulaiḥ kuḍubaiścāpi yathālābhamathāpi vā || 19.16 || śrutaṃ cārghyabaliṃ kuryātpuṣbaṃ tu caturaṅgulaṃ | śiṣyamāhūya tatkāle soṣṇīṣaṃ sottarīyakaṃ || 19.17 || śiṣyaṃ garuḍa vatsmṛtvā pātramuddhṛtyatatra vai | "udutya'miti mantreṇa śiṣyastacchirasi nyaseth || 19.18 || pradakṣiṇaṃ tataḥ kuryātkuryācchabdaravairyutaṃ | vitānachatrasaṃyuktaṃ piñchacāmarasaṃyutaṃ || 19.19 || dhūpadīpasamāyuktaṃ śanaiḥkuryātpradakṣiṇaṃ | pradakṣiṇatrayaṃ kṛtvā praviśedālayaṃ bhudhaḥ || 19.20 || bhūtapīṭhāntare tiṣṭhedgṛhṇīyāttu tadarcakaḥ | kautukāgretu sannyasya oṅkāreṇa niveśayet || 19.21 || balyagraṃ khaṇḍayitvātu seneśāya nivedayeth | taccheṣaṃ sodakaṃ caiva bhūtapīṭhe tu nikṣipet|| 19.22 || utsavaṃ
