kartukāmaścettrisaṃdhiṣvevamuttamaṃ | sāyaṃ prātarmadhyamaṃ syātsāyaṃ caivādhamaṃ bhavet|| 19.23 || baliṃ ca baliberaṃ vā kārayediti ke ca na | balyarthaṃ klaptadevasya cordhvamānamudāhṛtaṃ || 19.24 || mahāberasya hastena caikaviṃśatikāṃgulaṃ | saptadaśāṅgulaṃ vidyāddvādaśāṃgulameva vā || 19.25 || śreṣṭhamadhyakaniṣṭhāni trividhaṃ mānamācareth | arcāberatribhāgai kamuttamapratimābhaveth || 19.26 || tanmānasya daśāṃśena tvekonaṃ madhyamaṃ bhavet | madhyamasya daśāṃśena tvekonamadhamaṃ bhavet || 19.27 || mahato mūlaberasya mukhāyāmaṃ praśasyate | balyarthaṃ pratimāṃ kuryātsarveṣāṃ sthāpanaṃ bhavet || 19.28 || sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ tāmraṃ śreṣṭhamadhyamagauṇataḥ | ratnajapratimāṃ kuryānmānonmānaṃ na vidyate || 19.29 || uṣṇīṣaṃ golakaṃ jñeyaṃ śiromānaṃ trimātrakaṃ | keśāntārcā samaṃ bhāgaṃ saṃgamātpuṭasūtrakaṃ || 19.30 || puṭasūtrāddhanuparyantamekamekantu bhāgaśaḥ | galamardhāṅgulaṃ vindyānmātrārdhaṃ grīvamucyate || 19.31 || hikkāhṛdayaparyantaṃ mukhaṃ mātrādhikaṃ bhaveth | hṛdayaṃ nābhi tathaivoktaṃ tadadhastāttu tatsamaṃ || 19.32 || ūrū ca dvimukhāyāmaṃ golakotsedhamiṣyate | caraṇaṃ jānumānaṃ ca kālāyapurato param? || 19.33 || hikkāsūtrādadhastāttu bāhudvimukhanetrakaṃ | prakoṣṭhaṃ mukhabandhaṃ ca mukhamardhādhikaṃ bhavet| 19.34 || maṇibandhāṅgulasyāgre mukhayāmaṃ praśasyate | caturbhujaṃ ca kṛtvā tu mānamevamudāhṛtaṃ || 19.35 || .........vakuryātpadmākāraṃ tu golakaṃ | atha vakṣye viśeṣeṇa haviṣpākaṃ vidhānataḥ || 19.36 || paktvā vittānusāreṇa havīṃṣyapi ca kalpayeth | alpe mahati vā tulyaṃ phalamāḍhyadaridrayoḥ || 19.37 || nivedayitvā deveśaṃ kalyāṇaṃ kārayedbudhaḥ | avadatvā? ghṛtaṃ yattu kalyāṇamaśubhāyavai || 19.38 || alābhe caiva sarveṣāṃ vrīhīṇāṃ taṇḍulāṃ ḥstathā | śatadvayaṃ pañcaviṃśadvrīhibhiḥ pūritaṃ tu yath | śuktimātramiti khyātaṃ mānaṃ tenaiva kārayeth || 19.40 || taddvayaṃ tilamityuktaṃ prakuñcaṃ syāttiladvayaṃ | prasṛtistaddvayaṃ proktaṃ kuḍubaṃ prasṛtidvayaṃ || 19.41 || añjali staddvayaṃ proktaṃ prasthaṃ syādañjalidvayaṃ | pātraṃ prasthadvayaṃ proktamāḍhakaṃ taddvayaṃ bhaveth || 19.42 || caturāḍhakasaṃyuktaṃ droṇamityabhidhīyate | droṇadvayaṃ bhavetkhārī bhāraṅkhārīdvayaṃ bhavet|| 19.43 || droṇataṇḍulasaṃyuktamuttamaṃ havirucyate | tadardhaṃ madhyamaṃ proktantadardhamadhamaṃ bhaveth || 19.44 || uttamottamamityuktamaṣṭadroṇaintu taṇḍulaiḥ | adhikaṃ yadbhavettasmātproktaṃ sarvaṃ mahāhaviḥ || 19.45 || tadardhaistaṇḍulaiḥ siddhaṃ madhyamaṃ havirucyate | ṣaḍdroṇaistaṇḍulaiḥ siddhaṃ haviruttamamadhyamaṃ || 19.46 || droṇahīnaṃ bhavettasmāduttamādhamamucyate | madhyamottamamityuktaṃ caturdreṇaistu taṇḍulaiḥ || 19.47 || droṇatrayaṃ bhavedyatra kṛtaṃ madhyamamadhyamaṃ | madhyamādhamamityuktaṃ droṇadvayakṛtaṃ haviḥ || 19.48 || droṇena taṇḍulenaiva nivedya'madhamottamaṃ | tasya madhyamamityuktamāḍhakadvaya sammitaṃ || 19.49 || āḍhakena tu saṃyukta madhasūdhamamucyate | taṇḍulānāḍhakārdhaṃ tu devīnāṃ tu prakalpayet || 19.50 || caruprasthadvayaṃ proktaṃ havirāḍhakamucyate | prasthaṃ kuḍubasaṃyuktaṃ piśācānāṃ balirbhavet || 19.51 || gandhavarṇarasairjuṣṭāḥ pragrāhyāstaṇḍulāstathā | prakṣālya taṇḍulānsamyakniṣbīḍya ca punaḥpunaḥ || 19.52 || catuḥ prakṣālanaṃ kṛtvā "prajāsthā'līti mantrataḥ | "ūrjasva'tīti mantreṇa pātre prakṣipya taṇḍulān || 19.53 || chullyāmāropayetpaścā "dviṣṇave juṣṭa'mityapi | "vācaspa'tīti mantreṇa havissvinnantu pācayet || 19.54 || dhūmagandharasaṃ svinnamatipakvaṃ ca śītalaṃ | keśakīṭāpaviddhantu tyajetparyuṣitaṃ tathā || 19.55 || mudgaṃ caiva mahāmudgaṃ kūṭasthaṃ rājamāṣakaṃ | kadalī panasaṃ caiva kūśmāṇḍaṃ bṛhatī tathā || 19.56 || kandamūlaphalānyanye sārāḍhyā upadaṃśakāḥ | guḍaṃ dadhi samāyuktamājyayuktaṃ......... || 19.57 || haviḥkṛtvā caturbhāgamūrdhvabhāge nivedayeth | adhastādekabhāgena homārthaṃ balaye tathā || 19.58 || yadaṃśaṃ pātrasaṃśiṣṭaṃ pūjāyaiva ca nirmitaṃ | sauvarṇe rājate pātre kāñcye tāmre nivedayet || 19.59 || agni kāryāvaśiṣṭaṃ ca baliśiṣṭaṃ ca yaddhaviḥ | tatsarvaṃ pūjakāyaiva proktamevaṃ manīṣibhiḥ || 19.60 || dvitīyāvaraṇe proktamāgneyyāṃ pacanālayaṃ | arcakasya gṛhe vāpi pācayitvā nivedayet || 19.61 || praṇidhiṃ cājyasthālīṃ ca prokṣaṇīpātrameva ca | arghyapradānapātraṃ ca kuḍubena prapūritaṃ || 19.62 || haviḥpātrapramāṇantaṃ balipātrapramāṇataḥ | pānīyadānapātraṃ ca kāṃsyaṃ śuktijameva vā || 19.63 || hiraṇmayaṃ vā raupyaṃ vā yadhāśobhamalaṅkṛtaṃ | tāṃbūladāne pyevaṃ syātsauvarṇaṃ kāṃsyameva hi || 19.64 || dapanṇaṃ ca pradātavyaṃ dhruvānasasamaṃ bhaveth | āvāhanārthapraṇithiṃ prasthamātra prapūritaṃ || 19.65 || kaluṣaṃ kṛmiśaivālayuktaṃ sūtravivarjitaṃ | gandhavarṇarasairjuṣṭamaśucisthānamāśritaṃ || 19.66 || paṅkāśmadūṣitaṃ caiva sāmudraṃ palvalodakaṃ | agrāhyamudakaṃ grāhyamebhirdeṣairvivarjitaṃ || 19.67 || uttamaṃ triguṇairadbhissānaṃ cāthamamucyate | abhiṣeko nadībhnantu madhyame madhyamaṃ baveth || 19.68 || uśīracandanopetaṃ yajjalaṃ pādyamucyate | elālavaṅgatakkolajātīphalasamanvitaṃ || 19.69 || āpa ācamanīyārthamuśīrāmayacandanaiḥ | āpaḥkṣīrakuśāgrādi yavasiddhārthataṇḍulaiḥ || 19.70 || tilavrīhi samāyuktairarghya maṣṭāṅga mucyate | candanaṃ cāguruścaiva kuṅkumaṃ gandha ucyate, || 19.71 || ekaṃ dvayaṃ trayaṃ vāpi karbūreṇa catuṣṭayaṃ | uśīracanṭanopetaṃ ghṛtayuktaṃ ghṛtāplutaṃ || 19.72 || kiñcitkarbūrasaṃyuktaṃ dhūpamityucyate budhaiḥ | goghṛtena kṛtaṃ yattu dīpamuttamamucyate || 19.73 || caturaṅgulamāyāmaṃ rājasaṃ dīpameva hi | dīpaṃ tattṣaṅgulāyāmaṃ madhyamaṃ dīpamucyate || 19.74 || adhamaṃ tu bhaveddīpamaṅguladvayasammitaṃ | kāpilena gṛtenāpi kṛtaṃ karbūravartikaṃ || 19.75 || dīpaṃ viṣṇupriyaṃ proktaṃ sarvasiddhipradāyakaṃ | tāmasaṃ tu bhaveddīpaṃ māhiṣeṇa tu sarpiṣā || 19.76 || vṛkṣabījodbhavasnehadīpaṃ paiśācamucyate | tāmasaṃ vāpi paiśācamayogyaṃ dīpamucyate || 19.77 || kṣoṃaṃ kārpāsajaṃ vastraṃ vakṣabhedāṅgasaṃbhavaṃ | daśahastāyataṃ caiva vistāraṃ tu dvihastakaṃ || 19.78 || manoharaṃ tu suślakṣṇaṃ viśeṣaṃ vastramucyate | berāyāmārdhamānena vastravistāra mucyate || 19.79 || vistārāṣṭaguṇāyāmaṃ sadaśaṃ tu salakṣaṇaṃ | mayūrapiñchaiḥkuryāttu catustālaṃ tu vistṛtaṃ || 19.80 || adhomukhaṃ tu kartavyamata ūrdhvamukhaṃ tathā | pañcāratnipramāṇeva daṇḍassyādadhamaṃ tathā || 19.81 || adhikaṃ dvādaśāṅgulyaṃ madhyamecottamepi vā | evaṃ piñchaṃ samākhyātaṃ chatralakṣaṇamucyate || 19.82 || ṣaṭtānaṃ chatravistāramuttamaṃ samudāhṛtaṃ | madhyamaṃ pañcatālaṃsyācca tustālamathādhamaṃ || 19.83 || mauktikaṃ tu bhavecchatraṃ vastreśāpi hitaṃ tathā | vastreṇa vā tathā kuryāttālapatramathāpi vā || 19.84 || chatraṃ tvadhomukhaṃ proktaṃ daṇḍaṃ piñchasya daṇḍavath | suvarṇaratnasaṃyuktaṃ kuryādābharaṇādikaṃ || 19.85 || mukuṭaṃ kuṇḍalaṃ caiva hāraṃ kaiyūrakaṃ tathā | kaṭakaṃ kaṭisūtraṃ ca puṣpaṃ vai hāranūpure || 19.86 || kuryādudarabandhaṃ ca ratnahāraṃ ca mekhalāṃ | hāraṃ ca karṇapuṣpaṃ ca pratimāyā yathārhakaṃ || 19.87 || cāmarai ścāmaraṃ kuryātpiñchairvāpi mayūrajaiḥ | daṇḍaṃ haktapramāṇaṃ syādbāladaṇḍapramāṇakaṃ || 19.88 || hemaratnamayaṃ daṇḍaṃ tāratāmramayaṃ tathā | atha vā dārudaṇḍaṃ syānmayūrapiñchaṃ ca yojayeth || 19.89 || evaṃ tu cāmaraṃ proktaṃ pracchannapaṭamucyate | kṣoṃakārpāsasaṃyuktaṃ dvāramānantu kārayeth || 19.90 || atha vakṣye viśeṣeṇa sahasradhārāvidhikramaṃ | sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ vāpi tāmraṃ vāpi svaśaktitaḥ || 19.91 || uttamaṃ ṣoḍaśāṅgulyaṃ madhyamaṃ dvādaśāṃgulaṃ | aṣṭāṃgulaṃ tadadhamaṃ yathāśakti ca kārayeth || 19.92 || etairaṅgulibhissamyakbhramīkṛtya ca candravath | bhāgaṃ bhittyunnataṃ proktaṃ golakaṃ vā viśeṣataḥ || 19.93 || sīmāvṛttaṃ tu vistāramaṣṭāṅgulamiti smṛtaṃ | karṇi kāyāmavistāraṃ golakaṃ tu yavonnataṃ || 19.94 || madhye ratnaṃ suvarṇaṃ vā yathā śakti samarpayeth | karṇikāmabhitaḥ kuryāddalānyaṣṭa susaṃgataṃ || 19.95 || paritaṣṣoḍaśadalaṃ dvātriṃśatkarṇikaṃ bahiḥ | catuṣṣaṣṭisamāyuktaṃ dalaṃ bāhye prakalpayeth || 19.96 || dale yavadvayaghanaṃ rekhāmapi ca kārayeth | sahasrasuṣirairyuktaṃ samānoktaṃ ca kārayeth || 19.97 || ṣoḍaśadvādaśāṣṭābhiraṅgulyāyāmavistṛtaṃ | mālaṃ taddhastavistāraṃ śaṅkhāntarasamīkṛtaṃ || 19.98 || padmākṛtiṃ ca kṛtvā tu tau ca nālasamāyutau | śeṣaṃ yuktyā prakurvīta jalanirgamanaṃ budhaḥ,, || 19.99 || sarvasaindaryasaṃyuktaṃ tathākāraṃ ca kārayeth | prakṣālya pañcagavyena śodhanīyena śodhayeth || 19.100 || devālayasya purito gomayenopalipya ca | thānyarāśiṃ samāstīrya vastraṃ copari vinyaseth || 19.101 || uttare vāstuhomaṃ ca paryakniṃ caiva pūrvavath | ācāryaṃ pūjayettatra navavastrāṅgulīyakāḥ, || 19.102 || tantrendumaṇḍalaṃ dhyātvā padme padmanidhiṃ tathā | śaṅkhe śaṅkhanidhiṃ tadvadāvāhyaiva samarcayeth || 19.103 || puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā tu dakṣiṇāṃ ca dadetpunaḥ | biṃbaśuddhiṃ ca kṛtvātu mantreṇaivābhiṣicya ca || 19.104 || devadevaṃ samabhyarcya havistatra nivedayeth | evaṃ vai kṛtapātrāṇi devārthaṃ ca pradāpayeth || 19.105 || tasya kāyakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tatkṣaṇādeva naśyati | sarvadoṣopaśamanaṃ viṣṇubhaktivivardhanaṃ || 19.106 || iti śrīvaikhānase bhagavacchāstre bhṛsuproktāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prakīrṇādhikāre ekānaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ <20> atha viṃśo'dhyāyaḥ atha viṃśo'dhyāyaḥ rakṣādīpavidhiḥ ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi rakṣādīpavidhikramaṃ | sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃvāpi tāmraṃvāpi svaśaktitaḥ || 20.1 || dvātriṃśadaṅgulaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ madhyamaṃ pādahīnataḥ | adhamaṃ viṃśadaṅgulyaṃ samavṛttantu kārayeth || 20.2 || aṣṭadikṣu ca madhyeca caturdikṣu ca vā tathā | kevalaṃ karṇikāṃ vātha karṇikāyāntu vistṛtaṃ || 20.3 || tadardhamunnataṃ vindyādgaṇḍāyāmaṃ ṣaḍaṅgulaṃ | dvyaṅgulaṃ tu parīṇāhaṃ tadūrthve bhāgavistṛtaṃ || 20.4 || tadardhaṃ vistṛtotsedhaṃ dīpabātraṃ prakalpya ca | alabheśālipiṣṭaṃ vā gomaye vā samāhareth || 20.5 || tattatthsāne tu vinyasya pātresaṃyojayettataḥ | āḍhakaṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā piṇḍārdhaṃ ca caruṃpaceth || 20.6 || hāridracūrṇa saṃyuktaṃ pātre prakṣipya mantravith | ājyena srāvya saṃmṛjya muṣṭimātraṃ dṛḍhīkṛtaṃ || 20.7 || daśapiṇḍāṃ stadardhaṃ vā sākṣate ca samāhareth | jalena kuṃbhamāpūrya sarvagandhasamāyutaṃ || 20.8 || kuśakūrcānvinikṣipyapallavairapi bhūṣayeth | aṣṭamaṅgalasaṃyuktaṃ pādyācamanasaṃyutaṃ || 20.9 || puṣpagandhasamāyuktaṃ dhūpadīpārghya saṃyutaṃ | pṛdhakpātre samāhṛtya devadevaṃ ca pūjayeth || 20.10 || śaṅkhadhvanisamāyuktaṃ vaṃśadhvanisamāyutaṃ | bherīmṛdaṅgasuṣiravādyaghoṣasamāyutaṃ || 20.11 || stotradhvanisamāyuktaṃ svaktisūktasamanvitaṃ | dāsībhiścātha vā bhaktaissvahastopari dhārayeth || 20.12 || pradakṣiṇaṃ śanairgatvā devālayamupāvrajeth | ācāryaṃ pūjayitvātu devadevaṃ praṇamyaca || 20.13 || rakṣādīpaṃ samādāya "śriye jāta' iti bruvan | biṃbamūrdhni tu saṃyojyatriḥ pradakṣiṇamācareth || 20.14 || dikpiṇḍaṃ tu visṛjyaiva prokṣayitvā ca mantravith | pradakṣiṇaṃ praṇāmaṃ ca kārayedaṣṭamaṅgalaiḥ, || 20.15 || pādyamācamanaṃ datvāgandhapuṣpādibhiryajeth | mukhavāsaṃ ca datvātu stutimantraiśca vaiṣṇavaiḥ || 20.16 || samālabhyaiva hastābhyāṃ puṣpadūrvāṅkurākṣataiḥ | pādepuṣpāñjaliṅkuryātkuryāddevasya mantrataḥ || 20.17 || ālayāttu bahirgatvā pīṭhapārśvetu nikṣipeth | kautuke baliberepi snāpane pyautsave'pi ca, || 20.18 || prādurbhāve ca sarveṣāmāvirbhāve tathaiva ca | evameva tu kṛtvā tu bhrāmayitvā vicakṣaṇaḥ, || 20.19 || cakravīśāmitādīnāmindrādīnāṃ tathaiva ca | darśanaṃ bhrāmaṇaṃ caivamācarecchāstravittamaḥ || 20.20 || mohādajñānataḥ kuryātsarvahānirbhaviṣyati | sāyāhne catripūjānte cotsavānte ca nityaśaḥ || 20.21 || evameva vidhānena kārayeduttamaṃ viduḥ | sarvaśāntikaraṃ cāpi sarvakaṃpatsamṛddhidaṃ || 20.22 || dāridṣādivināśena sarvānkāmanavāpnuyāth | ataḥparaṃ pravakṣyāmi śibikānāṃ tu lakṣaṇaṃ || 20.23 || mātrāṅgulena vākuryācchibhikādīnvidhānataḥ | āvṛtaṃ tadardhavistāramuttamaṃ tuvidhīyate || 20.24 || tatṣaḍaṅgulahīnantu madhyamantuprakīrtitaṃ | vistārādhyardhapādena ?ayāmadviguṇaṃ bhaveth || 20.25 || uttamādhamamadhyānāṃ śibikāvistaro bhaveth | tribhāgaikasya bhāgaṃ syāccaturbhāgaikabhāgikaṃ || 20.26 || pañcabhāgaikabhāgaṃ syādvistārasya ghanaṃ bhaveth | taccaturbhāgamevaṃ syādekaikaṃ vamanaṃ bhaveth || 20.27 || śeṣabhāgaṃ tu padmoktaṃ talāyukti viśeṣataḥ | śibikāvistṛtaṃ caivaṃ bhāgaikaṃ bhāgameva ca || 20.28 || taccaturbhāgamevoktaṃ bhittyutsedhaṃ vidhīyate | dvitalaṃ tritalaṃ caiva gulikāphalakābhaveth || 20.29 || gulikāpādatalotsedhaṃ madhyordhvatalavatsamaṃ | caturbhāgaikamevantu navabhāgaikameva vā || 20.30 || aṅgulaṃ cāṅgulārthaṃ ca ūrthvapaṭṭyā ca saṃyutaṃ | ataḥparaṃ pravakṣyāmi rathādīnāṃ vidhikramaṃ || 20.31 || pañcaṣaṭsaptatālaṃ vā cāṣṭatālamathāpi vā | vistārāyamamevaṃ syādutsedhaṃ dviguṇaṃ bhaveth || 20.32 || maṇḍapadvārayuktaṃ vā kūṭākāramathāpi vā | adharādharamāyāmaṃ rathāyāmatrayaṃ bhaveth || 20.33 || chatrasyāyāmavistārādutsedārdhapramāṇataḥ | evaṃ tu parikalpyaiva śibikāyāmamucyate || 20.34 || rathāyāmasamaṃ vāpi pādahīnamathārthakaṃ | vistāraṃ tattribhāgai kamāyāmaṃ cocchrayaṃ bhaveth || 20.35 || vistārārdhasamutsedhaṃ vistārārthādhikāyataṃ | śayanaṃ saṃprakalpyaiva pūrvoktenaiva dāruṇā || 20.36 || sarvālaṅkārasaṃyuktaṃ sarvasaindaryasaṃyutaṃ | śilpaśāstroktamārgeṇa śilpibhiḥ kālayedbudhaḥ || 20.37 || pañcagavyaissusaṃśodhya vāstuhomaśca hūyatāṃ | paryagni caiva kṛtvātu kalaśaissnāpayettataḥ || 20.38 || maṇḍape vā prapāyāṃ vā sthaṇḍile vātra vinyaseth | navairvastraissamāveṣṭya puṇyāhamapi vācayeth || 20.39 || jaupāsanāgnikuṇḍaṃ ca kārayitvā vidhānataḥ | āghāraṃ pūrvavatkṛtvā kuṃbhapūjāṃ samācareth || 20.40 || vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktaṃ ca tattaddevāṃśca mūrtibhiḥ | vyāhṛtyantaṃ ca hutvā tu antahomaśca hūyate || 20.41 || yānādiṣu ca tanmadhye tattaddevāṃ stathaiva ca | āvāhyaiva samabhyarcya devadevaṃ praṇamya ca || 20.42 || pādyādyarghyāntamabhyarcya havissamyaṅnivedayeth | sarvālaṅkārasaṃyuktaṃ sarvavādyasamanvitaṃ || 20.43 || yānādiṣu samāropya "pratadviṣṇu'riti bruvan | grāmaṃ vā pyālayaṃ vāpi pradakṣiṇamadhācareth || 20.44 || mandiraṃ saṃpraviśyaiva svesvesthāne niveśayeth | evaṃ yaḥkurute bhaktyā vaiṣṇavaṃ padamāpnuyāth || 20.45 || ataḥparaṃ pravakṣyāmi prapāmaṇḍapalakṣaṇaṃ | maṇḍapaṃ trividhaṃ jñeye vimānasamavistṛtaṃ || 20.46 || ardhaṃ pādaṃ tu pādaṃ vā hīnantu trividhaṃ bhaveth | pramukhe tasyasopānamālayārdhamiti smṛtaṃ || 20.47 || pūrvetu snapanārthāya maṇḍapaṃ saṃprakalpayeth | ṣoḍaśastaṃbhayuktaṃ vā dvādaśastaṃbhasaṃyutaṃ || 20.48 || aiśānye vā prakurvīta snapanārthaṃ prakalpayeth | prathamāvaraṇe vātha dvitīyāvaraṇe'tha vā || 20.49 || ekādaśena hastena samaṃ samyakprakalpayeth | navahastaṃ saptahastaṃ pañcahastamiti tridhā || 20.50 || prathamāvaraṇe bāhye maṇḍapantu vidhīyate | āsthānavṛttageyādidarśanārthaṃ prakalpayeth || 20.51 || pūrvavatpramukhe kuryādyathāvibhavavistaraṃ | yajamānasya hastena dvihastantu vivardhayeth || 20.52 || pūrvavatstaṃbhasaṃyuktaṃ yathāyogyaṃ prakalpayeth | tatbūrvadiśi śālāyāṃ nṛttārthantu vidhīyate || 20.53 || viṣkaṃbhaṃ navahastaṃ vā āyāmaṃ dviguṇīkṛtaṃ | yajamānecchayā tatra dvihastantuvivardhayeth || 20.54 || ayādilakṣaṇaṃ vakṣye yajamānānukūlataḥ | hastaṃ pādaṃ tadardhaṃ vā vistārāyādisaṃyutaṃ || 20.55 || tathaiva nūnaṃ kṛtvā tu ayādīnlakṣayedbudhaḥ | śilābhiriṣṭakābhirvā hastocchrayasamaṃ talaṃ || 20.56 || dvitalaṃ vā prakurvīta tālaṃ samyakprakalpayeth | śailajaṃ dārusāraṃ vā staṃbhamāhṛtya yatnataḥ || 20.57 || vṛttaṃ vā caturaśraṃ vā ṛjuṃ vakravivarjitaṃ | staṃbhānāṃ viṃśatiṃ gṛhya bāhyastaṃbhaṃ pragṛhya ca || 20.58 || tanmadhye dvādaśastaṃbhaṃ pūrvavatkārayedbudhaḥ | staṃbhāyāmaṃ yathāyogaṃ kṛtvā tatra vicakṣaṇaḥ || 20.59 || dvitālaghana saṃyuktaṃ staṃbhamānena svastikaṃ | stalatyordhve vibhajyaiva samaṃ vandatyaprakalpayeth || 20.60 || tasyāmeva tu staṃbhārthaṃ pādaṃ saṃsthāpya svastikaṃ | dṛḍhaṃ kṛtvā tadūrdhveta staṃbhaṃ saṃsthāpya vai budhaḥ || 20.61 || dvyaṅgulaṃ ca bhavairvātha vedikāṃ kārayedbudhaḥ | nānālaṅkārasaṃyuktaṃ nānācitrasamanvitaṃ || 20.62 || uttaraṃ tatsamaṃ kṛtvā bodhiketu suyojayeth | staṃbhādūrdhvantu saṃsthāpya tadūrdhve prastaraṃ nyaseth || 20.63 || abhlantarottarādūrdhve'biṣṭakādhānapādayoḥ | bālottaraṃ yathāyogyaṃ sthāpayetsudṛḍhaṃ kramāth || 20.64 || tadbilvako yathāmārgaṃ yogyaṃ tatpadmamucchrayaṃ | evaṃ lakṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ darśanīyaṃ ca kārayeth || 20.65 || yajamānecchayātattanmaṇḍapena sahaiva tu | ṣoḍaśastaṃbhasaṃyuktaṃ dvādaśastaṃbhamevavā || 20.66 || bhaktiyuktaṃ prakalpyaiva prapāṃ yuktyaiva kārayeth | apare dvārasaṃyuktaṃ pūrvavatstaṃbhameva vā || 20.67 || kavāṭaṃ tatra vā kuryāccheṣaṃ yaktyaiva kārayeth | śilpaśāstroktamārgeṇa śilpibhiḥ kārayedbudhaḥ || 20.68 || maṇḍapasya samāptautu aṅkurānarpayetkramāth | śuddhyarthaṃ vāstuhomaṃ ca puṇyāhaṃ caiva kārayeth || 20.69 || brāhmaṇānbhojayetpaścāttaddeśamupalakṣayeth | carodaye ca nakṣatre sthirarāśiṃ pragṛhya ca || 20.70 || maṇḍapasya tu madhye vai dhānyapīṭhāni kalpayeth | pratiṣṭhoktakrameṇaiva kuṃbhanyāsāti kārayeth || 20.71 || paścime gārhapatyāgnāvāghāraṃ juhuyātkramāth | hotā hautrakrameṇaiva hautraṃ tatra praśaṃsayeth || 20.72 || tattaddevasya cāvāhya juṣṭākāraṃ hutaṃ careth | śrīsūktaṃ vaiṣṇapaṃ caiva vaiṣṇavaṃ caikaviṃśatiḥ || 20.73 || indrādilokapālānāṃ pratyekaṃ juhuyātkramāth | tattatsthānetu kūrce vā sthaṇḍile vā samarcayeth || 20.74 || prabhūtaṃ tu nivedyaiva droṇandroṇārchameva vā | ācāryasyārcakādīnāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ ca dadetkramāth || 20.75 || sauvarṇairutpalaiḥ puṣpairalaṅkuryātprapāṃ tataḥ | padmairvākumudairvātha puṣpairanyaissvaśaktitaḥ || 20.76 || devadevamalaṅkṛtya vastramālyādibhiḥ punaḥ | prapāṃ saṃyojya deveśaṃ dhyānenaiva tu sannayeth || 20.77 || deveśaṃ sthāpayettatra pādyādyairarcayetkramāth | mahāhaviḥ prabhūtaṃ vā yathāśakti nivedayeth || 20.78 || evaṃ yaḥ kurute bhaktyā viṣṇuloke mahīyate iti śrīvaikhānase bhagavacchāstre bhṛguproktāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prakīrṇādhikāre viṃśo'dhyāyaḥ <21> anthaikaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ viśeṣārcanam athātassaṃpravakṣyāmi viṣṇupañcadināni ca | śravaṇaṃ dvādaśī śukle kṛṣṇe cārdhe ca dvādaśī || 21.1 || pūrṇimā cāpyamāvāsyā pañcaitāni dināni vai | pūrvoktena vidhānena aṅkurānarbayetkramāth || 21.2 || baddhvā pratisaraṃ tatra pūrvarātrautu śāyayeth | prātassandhyārcanāntetu snāpanoktakrameṇavai || 21.3 || samabhyarcya nivedyaiva pūrvasthāne niveśayeth | mārgaśīrṣākhyamāse tu pūrvapakṣe viśeṣataḥ || 21.4 || prātassandhyāvasānetu pūrvamāsthānamaṇḍape | saṃsthāpya caturo vedānkrameṇādhyāpayetsadā || 21.5 || pūjayeddevadeveśaṃ saptaviṃśativigrahaiḥ | ekādaśīmupopyaiva mahāpātakanāśinīṃ || 21.6 || tataḥprabhāte dvādaśyāṃ snātvāsnānavidhānataḥ | mṛṇmayāni tu bhāṇḍāni purāṇāni parityajeth || 21.7 || mṛṣṭasiktopalepādyaiśśodhayitvā yathārhakaṃ | snāpanoktakrameṇaiva snāpayitvā yathāvidhi || 21.8 || āsanādibhirabhyarcya pāyasaṃ ca nivedayeth | pānīyācamanaṃ datvā mukhavāsaṃ tataḥparaṃ || 21.9 || puruṣasūktena saṃstūya gkāmaṃ caiva pradakṣiṇaṃ | dhāmapradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā jīvasthāne niveśayeth || 21.10 || saṃvatsarer'cane hīne nityanaimittikādiṣu | tatsarvaṃ pūrṇamityāhurdvāśīpūjane kṛte || 21.11 || pauṣe tu pūrṇimāyāṃ vai viṣṇupañcadinoktavath | arcayitvātu deveśaṃ gavyaṃ kṣīraṃ nivedayeth || 21.12 || so'pi saṃvatsaraphalaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ | māghamāse punarvasvo rāghavo'jāyata svayam, || 21.13 || tattastasyāmapoṣyaiva rāmaṃ vā viṣṇumeva vā | grāmaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā snāpayitvā nivedayeth || 21.14 || tilapadmavidhiṃ vakṣye śruṇudhvaṃ munipuṅgavāḥ | māghamāse tu pañcamyāṃ pūrvapakṣe viśeṣataḥ || 21.15 || pūrvarātrai tu deveśamarcayitvā yathāvidhi | havīṃṣyapi nivedyaiva baddhvā pratisaraṃ punaḥ || 21.16 || pūrvavacchāyayitvaiva rātriśeṣaṃ nayetkramāth | prabhāte devamuddhāpya kalaśaissnāpayetpunaḥ || 21.17 || maṇḍapaṃ vātha kūṭaṃ vā prapāṃ vātha yathocitaṃ | gomayenopalipyaiva pañcavarṇairalaṅkṛtaṃ || 21.18 || tasminsaṃsthāpya deveśaṃ praṇamyaivānumāsya ca | pramukhe dhānyarāśau tu dvihastāyatavistṛte || 21.19 || kṛṣṇājinaṃ samāstīrya navavastressamāstareth | tadūrdhvetu vikīryaivaṣaḍdroṇaṃ tilameva hi || 21.20 || droṇatrayaṃ dvaye vāpi maṇḍalākālavattathā | aṣṭabhiścadalairyuktaṃ tilapadmaṃ samālikheth || 21.21 || triṇiṣkena tadardhena niṣkamātreṇa vā punaḥ | svarṇapadmaṃ ca kṛtvātu tilapadme tu vinyaseth || 21.22 || āḍhakaiśśālidhānyaiśca pūrṇapātrāṇi ṣoḍaśa | indrādīśānaparyantaṃ śālirāśyupari nyaseth || 21.23 || aḍhakaṃ tailamāhṛtya tadardhañca ghṛtaṃ tathā | paścime dadhimannyasya devadevaṃ praṇamya ca || 21.24 || ātmasūktaṃ ca japtvātu pūjayedaṣṭavigrahaiḥ | praṇamya devadevāya padmamadhyetu pūrvavath || 21.25 || prācyādi puruṣādīṃśca caturmūrtibhirāhvayeth | ekādaśopacāraiśca pūjayitvā yathārhakaṃ || 21.26 || indrādyaiśāntamāvāhya degdevānarcayettata | "atodevā'disaṃyuktaṃ viṣṇusūktaṃ japetpunaḥ || 21.27 || biṃbe devaṃ samāropya cānyānudvāsayetkramāth | yajamāno'tha tatkāle dadyādācāryadakṣiṇāṃ || 21.28 || viṣṇubhaktiyutaṃ śāstaṃ dayādyātmaguṇairyutaṃ | vedapārāyaṇaparaṃ sarvāvayavasaṃyutaṃ || 21.29 || vipramāhūya tatkāle devasya niyato'grataḥ | dhyātvā deveśamācāryo devadevasya sannidhau || 21.30 || tilapadmaṃ dadettasmai sarvalokahitāya vai | stotrairgeyaiśca vādaiśca stutvā devaṃ samarcayeth || 21.31 || devaṃ yāne samāropya sarvālaṅkārasaṃyutaṃ | devālayaṃ parītyaiva jīvasthāne niveśayeth || 21.32 || eve yaḥkurute bhaktyā viṣṇave paramātmane | sarvānkāmānavāpnoti vaiṣṇavaṃ lokamaśnute || 21.33 || phālgune māsi phalgunyāṃ śriyā sārthaṃ janārdanaṃ | snāpayitvotsavaṃ kṛtvā samabhyarchya nivedayeth || 21.34 || caitremāsi tathā caitṣāṃ kuryāddamanakotsavaṃ | pūrvasminneva divase rātripūjāvasānake || 21.35 || bhaddhvā pratisaraṃ tatra deveśāya nivedayeth | vasastaṃ kāmamabhyarcya pāyasānnaṃ nivedayeth || 21.36 || desasya dakṣiṇe pārśve mālāṃ damanakīṃnyaseth | prabhāte devamuddhāpya snāpayitvār'cayettathā || 21.37 || devasya puṣpamantrābhyāṃ dadyādbhakti samanvitaṃ | sarveṣāṃ parivārāṇāṃ dadyāttanmantramūrtibhiḥ || 21.38 || grāmaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā saṃsthāpyāsthānamaṇḍape | samabhyarcya nivedyaiva mukhavāsaṃ dadettataḥ || 21.39 || vaiśākhyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ vai snāpayitvā samarcayeth | jyeṣṭhe tu snāpayeddevaṃ navavastraṃ pradāpayeth || 21.40 || so'pi saṃvatsaraphalaṃ prāpnuyādeva mānavaḥ | arghyadānaṃ praśastaṃ syāddevasyāṣāḍhamāsake || 21.41 || śrāvaṇe māsi sakṣatre śravaṇe tu viśeṣataḥ | utsavasnapanādīni pūrvavatkārayedbudhaḥ || 21.42 || ataḥparaṃ pravakṣyāmi jayantyutsavalakṣaṇaṃ | jayantī śrāvaṇe māsi kṛṣṇapakṣe'ṣṭamī śubhā || 21.43 || rohiṇīsahitā jñeyā sarvapāpaharā tithiḥ | tasyāṃ jāto jacagannātho jagatpālana kāṅkṣayā || 21.44 || candrasyodayakāletu madhyarātre svalīlayā | tasminvai divase kṛṣṇamarcayitvā prayatnataḥ || 21.45 || utsavaṃ kārayedyastu viṣṇossālokyatāṃ vrajeth | aṣṭamī rohiṇīyuktā rahitāvā vicakṣaṇaiḥ || 21.46 || aviddhaiva sadā grāhyāsaptamyā sarvadā tidhiḥ | ādityodayavelāyāṃ kalāmātrāṣṭamī yadi || 21.47 || sātithissakalā jñeyā niśīthavyāpinī bhaveth | nāgaviddhā yathā nandā varjitā śravaṇānvitā || 21.48 || tathāṣṭamīṃ pūrvaviddhāṃ sarkṣāṃ vāpi parityajeth | aviddhaivāṣṭamī grāhyā tāṃ supuṇyāmupāvaseth || 21.49 || rohiṇīsahitā kṛṣṇā māsi bhādrapade'ṣṭamī | ardharātrādadhaścordhvaṃ galayā vāpi pūrvavath || 21.50 || jayantī nāma sā proktā sarvapāpapraṇāśinī | tasmāttu divasātpūrvaṃ navame vātha saptame || 21.51 || pañcame vā tṣahe'vāpi vidhivā cāṅkurārpaṇaṃ | pūrvedyureva śarvaryāṃ rātripūjāvasānake || 21.52 || baddhvā pratisaraṃ tatra śayane śāyayeddhariṃ | tasyāṃ tithāvardharātre kṛṣṇamevaṃ viśeṣataḥ || 21.53 || puṣpāñjaliṃ tataḥ kuryācchriyā yukto janārdanaḥ | bhūmibhārāpahārāya lokejāto jagatpatiḥ || 21.54 || iti saṃcintayeddevaṃ vaiṣmavaṃ mantramuccaran | sarvālaṅkārasaṃyuktaṃ maṇḍapaṃ ca pradakṣiṇaṃ || 21.55 || purastānmadhyame vāpi cāsthāne vāpyalaṅkṛte | tanmadhye viṣṭare sthāpya devadevaṃ praṇamya ca || 21.56 || tailaṃ haridracūrṇaṃ ca kalaśānsaṃprapūrya ca | sthaṇḍile vinyasettatra devadevaṃ samarcayeth || 21.57 || tailenābhyañjanaṃ kṛtvā cūrṇenodyartanaṃ careth | nādeyaṃ gandhatoyaṃ ca puṣpodaṃ cākṣatodakaṃ || 21.58 || kuśodakaṃ tu saṃbhṛtya kalaśānpañca vinyaseth | "ato devā'dibhirmantraissnāpayetpuruṣottamaṃ || 21.59 || pādyādyarṅyāntamabhyarcya devadevaṃ praṇamya ca | "hiraṇyagarbha' ityuktvāgavāṃ kṣīraṃ nivedayeth || 21.60 || mukhavāsaṃ ca datvaiva praṇāmaṃ ca tataścareth | niveditaṃ tu tatkṣīraṃ vandhyāputrapradaṃ bhaveth || 21.61 || pītvāprasūte putraṃ ca āyuṣmantaṃ balānvitaṃ | nītvā ghṛtaṃ ca tailaṃ ca mukhavāsayutaṃ tathā || 21.62 || devasya darśayitvā tu brāhmaṇebhyaḥ pradīyatāṃ | devadevamalaṅkṛtya bhaktānāmāttacetasāṃ || 21.63 || yathā vai yajamānasya tathā priyakaraṃ bhudhaiḥ | sarvavādyasamāyuktaṃ sarvālaṅkārasaṃyutaṃ || 21.64 || grāmaṃ vāpyālayaṃ vāpi pradakṣiṇamathācareth | ālayaṃ saṃpraviśyaiva kalaśaissnāvayedbudhaḥ || 21.65 || ācāryadakṣiṇāṃ datvā sodakaṃ devasannidhau | prabhūtaṃ tu nivedyaiva mukhavāsaṃ dadetpunaḥ, || 21.66 || evamevaṃ tathā kuryādutsavaṃ prativatsaraṃ | bhuktimuktipradamidamṛṣibhiḥ parīkīrtitaṃ || 21.67 || apare'tha dine vāpi kārayedutsavaṃ bhudhaḥ | yadyanmantrakriyālopo vaiṣṇavairhūyate tathā || 21.68 || ekasminvatsare hīne devadevaṃ praṇamya ca | snapanaṃ pañcaviṃśadbhiḥ kalaśaiśśuddhamānasaiḥ || 21.69 || śāntihomaṃ ca hutvātu puṇyāhamapi vācayeth | utsavaṃ dviguṇaṃ kuryāddakṣiṇāṃ ca svaśaktitaḥ || 21.70 || śrāvaṇe dvādaśīyoge māpi bhādrapade tathā | saṃvatsarārcādoṣasya śāntyarthaṃ keśavasya tu || 21.71 || asminmāse viśeṣeṇa pavitrāropaṇaṃ hareḥ | sarvadoṣopaśamanaṃ sarvakāmābhivṛddhidam, || 21.72 || māse'smīnnārabhetaiva śravaṇavratamuttamaṃ | tribhirvarṣaistribhirmāsairupoṣya ca mahatpalaṃ || 21.73 || āśvayujamāse cāśvyarkṣe deveśaṃ snāpayettataḥ | arghyadānaṃ praśastaṃ syāddevadevasya śārjiṇaḥ || 21.74 || athātaḥ kṛttikādīpadānalakṣaṇamucyate | kārtikyāṃ pūrṇimāyāntu yadṛkṣantu pravartate || 21.75 || tadṛkṣaṃ dīpaṛkṣaṃ syātkālāpekṣā na vidyate ravyastamayavelāyāṃ | dīpāropaṇamācareth || 21.76 || devasya sannidhau staṃbhe devālayasamocchraye | adhike vā mahādīpaṃ mahāsnehaṃ prakalpayeth || 21.77 || tripādaṃ vā tadhardhaṃ vā dīpadaṇḍaṃ samāhareth | veṇuṃ vā kramukaṃ vāpi tālaṃ vā nālikerakaṃ || 21.78 || madhūkaṃ tintriṇīkaṃ cetyanyaissāradrumaistathā | śatāṣṭadīpasaṃyuktaṃmuttamottamamucyate || 21.79 || utme madhyamaṃ dīpaṃ | śatasaṃkhyākramaṃ viduḥ | uttamādhamadīpaṃ syānnavatirdvyadhikā tathā || 21.80 || madhyamottamamuktaṃ syādaśītiścaturastathā | madhyame madhyamaṃ caiva ṣaṭsaptatirathocyate || 21.81 || madhyamādhamadīpantu aṣṭaṣaṣṭiriti smṛtaṃ | adhamottamadīpantu ṣaṣṭisaṃkhyāṃ vadantihi || 21.82 || dvipañcāśatpradīpāṃśca kuryādadhamamadhyame | adhamādhamamevedaṃ catvāriṃśatpradīpakaṃ || 21.83 || aśaktānāṃ yathāśakti dīpaṃ tatraiva yojayeth | daṇḍetu suṣire yojyaṃ caturdikṣu krameṇa vai || 21.84 || bhūtapīṭhasya pūrvetu dīpasthānaṃ vidhīyate | "padmakośapratīkāśa' iti śrutyāmudāhṛtaṃ || 21.85 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena padmaṃ kuryātsalakṣaṇaṃ | vistārāyāmatulyaṃ syāccatustālapramāṇataḥ || 21.86 || golakāṅgulamutsedhaṃ caturaśraṃ prakalpayeth | tatraiva śālibhi stiryakpadmamaṣṭadalānvitaṃ || 21.87 || tanmadhye tālamātreṇa samavṛttaṃ sakarṇikaṃ | ekāṅgulasamutsedhaṃ tatraivopari taṇḍulaiḥ || 21.88 || sati padmaṃ samutphullaṃ navavastraṃ samāstareth | puṣpaṃ tasyopari nyasya kalbayetpadmamaṇḍalaṃ || 21.89 || daleṣvabhyarcya ca vasūnmadhye dharmaṃ samarcayeth | ālayābhimukhe kuryātprapāṃ caivātisundaraṃ || 21.90 || āsthānamaṇḍape vāpi kalpayetpadmamaṇḍalaṃ | sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ tāmraṃ mṛṇmayaṃ vāsvaśaktitaḥ || 21.91 || śarāvaṃ prasthasaṃpūrṇaṃ samāhṛtya vicakṣaṇaḥ | kiñcitkarpūrasaṃyuktaṃ picuvartisamanvitaṃ || 21.92 || gavyaṃ ghṛtaṃ samādāya sthāpayetpadmamadhyame | ācāryassuprasannātmā navavastrottarīyakaḥ || 21.93 || "śriyaijā'teti mantreṇa dīpasyoddīpanaṃ careth | pratīcyāṃ padmamadhyetu śriyaṃ dhyātvā samāhvayeth || 21.94 || ekādaśopacāraiśca pūjayitvā samāhitaḥ | śrīdevīṃ manasā dhyātvā śrīsūktaṃ ca samuccaran || 21.95 || dīpamādāya hastābhyāmapsarobhirviśeṣataḥ | dīpānanyāntsamādāya to yadhārāsamanvitaṃ || 21.96 || geyadhvanisamāyuktaṃ nṛttavādyasamanvitaṃ | pradakṣiṇaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā garbhāgāraṃ praveśayeth || 21.97 || depasya dakṣiṇe pārśvesthāpayenmantravittamaḥ | devadevaṃ samānīya maṇḍale sthāpya cātvaraḥ || 21.98 || kuryāddaśopacārāṃśca samabhyarcyedvidhānataḥ | "śrīye jā'teti mantreṇa dīpānuddīpayedbudhaḥ || 21.99 || garbhageheca sopāne prāsāde mukhamaṇḍape | prāsādaśikhare vāpigrīvāyāṃ caraṇe'pi ca || 21.100 || prākāreṣu ca sarvatra tathaiva snapanālaye | puṣpasaṃcayadeśe ca dvāre cāsthānamaṇḍape || 21.101 || anyeṣvapi ca sarvatra dīpānuddīpayetkramāth | kārpāsatūlaṃ saṃbaddhya śarāveṣughṛtena vai || 21.102 || pūrvoktenaiva mantreṇa coddīpanamathācareth | nṛttageyādivādyaiśca ghoṣayitvā prayatnataḥ || 21.103 || taccharāvasthadīpaṃ ca balipīṭhasya paścime | adhidevaṃ samārādhya nikṣipeddīpamaṇḍape || 21.104 || "śubhrājyoti'riti procya daṇḍrāgre'nyāṃśca nikṣipeth | nivedya bahūdhā devaṃ pṛthukādīnviśeṣataḥ || 21.105 || bhakṣyāṇi guḍamiśrāṇiprabhūtaṃ ca mahāhaviḥ | grāmaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā sarvālaṅkārasaṃyutaṃ || 21.106 || punardevaṃ samādāya jīvasthāne niveśayeth | so'pi saṃvatsaraphalaṃ prāpya gacchetparaṃ padaṃ || 21.107 || grahaṇārādhanam athātassaṃpravakṣyāmi sūryasomoparāgayoḥ | arcanādividhiṃ samyakdevadevasya śārṅgiṇaḥ || 21.108 || sūryagrahe caturyāmaṃ triyāmaṃ tu vidhugrahe | nāśnanti havyakavyāni devatāḥ pitarastathā || 21.109 || ālaye tu hareḥ pūjāṃ na tyajanti maharṣayaḥ | havirnivedanaṃ hitvāpūjāṃ sarvāṃ samācareth || 21.110 || grahaṇe vartamānetu snāpayetpuruṣottamaṃ | koṭiyajñaphalaṃ prāpya brahmaloke mahīyate || 21.111 || grastāstagrahaṇe kuryātsnapanaṃ tu pare'hani | tathā grastodaye kuryāditi śātātapo'bravīth || 21.112 || sarvadhā varamāne tu grahaṇesnapanaṃ careth | grahaṇaṃ saṃkramo hasticchāyā ca viṣuvādikaṃ || 21.113 || yugādi va mādyāstu puṇyakālāḥ prakīrtitāḥ | niṣethaḥ kathitaḥ prājñairhavirdāsavadutsave || 21.114 || nityārcanaṃ cotsavaṃ ca snapanātpūrvamācareth | snāpayitvā hṛṣīkeśaṃ havirdānaṃ praśasyate || 21.115 || vāstuśuddhiṃ sadā kuryādgrahaṇe candrasūryayoḥ | purāṇāni ca bhāṇḍāni tyaktvānyāni samāhareth || 21.116 || kuśāgrāṇāṃ samutkṣepādvāsasāṃ śuddhiriṣyate | apakvānāṃ ca vastūnāṃ na pakvaṃ parigṛhṇate || 21.117 || adṛśyamuparāgantu noparāgaṃ pracakṣate | dīkṣitasya tathānyasya snānaṃ syātsparśamokṣayoḥ || 21.118 || yāvānādyantakālassyāttāvatākīrtayeddhariṃ | maunī japādikaṃ kuryādūrdhvapuṇḍradharaśśuciḥ || 21.119 || saptavātāhataṃ vastramārdraṃ dhṛtvā na doṣabhāk | grahaṇe bhagavatsevā sarvāśubhavināśinī || 21.120 || dadyāddhānāni śaktyā vai sakāmo harimandire | tadanantaṃ bhavetsākṣī yatrānanto harissvayaṃ || 21.121 || prabhūtaṃ tu nivedyātha bhuñjīyāttadanantaraṃ | rātrau śrāddhaṃ prakurvīta grahaṇe tannadoṣakṛth || 21.122 || dūṣite tūktakāle tu tasyāpagama eva ca | viparīte mahāndoṣa iti śāstravido viduḥ || 21.123 || na niśīthātparaṃ śrāddhamāpatsvapi vidhīyate | snānamāśaucināṃ nityaṃ te'pi dānaṃ ca kurva || 21.124 || na japo na tapasteṣāmaśuddhā mokṣaṇe punaḥ | yadā rāśyantaraṃ rāśeḥ kāle saṃkramate raviḥ || 21.125 || tadā tu puṇyakālassyātsnapanādyatra kārayeth | kaṭakeviṃśatiḥ pūrvaṃ makare viṃśatiḥ pare || 21.126 || puṇyāntu ghaṭikāḥ proktā statra grahaṇavaccareth | yadāstamayavelāyāṃ saṃdhyāyāṃ saṃkramoraveḥ || 21.127 || pūrve'hṇi puṇyakālassyādaparāhṇātparassmṛtaḥ | ardhāstamita āditye tathā cār'dhodite sati || 21.128 || pāścātyapūrvaghaṭīkāstisrassaṃdhyā prakīrtitāḥ | uparāge'pi kuryādvai utsave'vabhṛthaṃ hareḥ || 21.129 || vidhugrahe niśāṃ sarvāmahorātraṃ ravigrahe | tyajecchubhe tadā kuryānnaiva dīpotsavaṃ hareḥ || 21.130 || paścānniśīthādgrahaṇe dīpaṃ dāsyanti ke ca na | aviddheparvaṇi proktaṃ dīpadānaṃ śubhāvahaṃ || 21.131 || grahaṇe'pi bhaveddīpamaviddhā pūrṇimā na ceth | aparvaṇyarpitaṃ dīpaṃ hanti puṇyaṃ purātanaṃ || 21.132 || māsarkṣeṣvanyapuṇvarkṣe viṣṇupañcadine tathā | arcanārthāya devasya kālo madhyāhna ucyate || 21.133 || kāmye tu sumuhūrte syātpūjanaṃ nānyadhā caret iti śrīvaikhānase bhagavacchāstre bhṛguproktāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prakīrṇādhikāre ekaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ <22> atha dvāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ snapanam athātassnapanāgāraṃ pramukhe cottare tathā | aiśānyāṃ vā viśeṣaṇa prapāṃ vā maṇḍapantu vā || 22.1 || vitānopari saṃvītaṃ laṃbamānaṃ pariṣkṛtaṃ | staṃbhāntsaṃveṣṭya vastraiśca dukūlaistāntavairapi || 22.2 || muktādāmasamāyuktaṃ pūrṇakuṃbhasamanvitaṃ | satvaṃ rajastamaścaiva aiśvaryaṃ cādhidaivataṃ || 22.3 || caturvedādikairmantraistoraṇāṃsthsāpayetkramāth | ubhayoḥ pārśvayoścaiva kadalīkramukānvitaṃ || 22.4 || pūrvāstamuttarāntaṃ ca ṣaṭsūtraṃ saṃprasārya ca | kalpayedāyatasamaṃ padānāṃ pañca viṃśatiṃ || 22.5 || madhyebrāhmaṃ padaṃ hitvā caryārdhaṃ parito'ṣṭa ca | pūrvādi catvāri padaṃ dvārārthaṃ parikalpayeth || 22.6 || śiṣṭāṃśca dvādaśapadāndravyanyāsārthamāhareth | madhyeśvabhrantu kartavyamaupāsanavidhānataḥ || 22.7 || madhyenimnaṃ ca kṛtvā tu tālamātrapramāṇataḥ | śvabhrasya madhyame caiva bilvajaṃ phalakaṃ nyaseth || 22.8 || tatpramāṇādhikaṃ pīṭhaṃ paritaścaturaṅgulaṃ | madhyehitvā pratiṣṭhāpya dvivedisahitaṃ kramāth || 22.9 || tataḥpāvanamārgeṇa jalaṃ gacchedudaṅmukhaṃ | maṇḍapāttu bahisthsāne jalasthānaṃ tu khānayeth || 22.10 || ācchādya kadalīpatraiḥ padmapatrairathāpi vā | hāridraiścātha patrairvāpatraiḥ kramukajaistu vā || 22.11 || "atodevā'dimantreṇa kuśadarbhāṃntu śodhayeth | yāvacchvabhrapramāṇantu tāvatkṛtvāsamāhareth || 22.12 || hastamātraṃ tathāyāme prokṣaṇārthaṃ tu kūrcakaṃ | mārjanārthantu kūrcaṃ ca ṣaḍaṅgulamiti smṛtaṃ || 22.13 || pañcabhirvātribhirvātha dvādaśāṃgulamāyataṃ | kalaśārthaṃ tu kurvīta yathākalaśasaṃkhyayo || 22.14 || taṇḍulairvrīhibhiścaiva satilaiścatrivedikaṃ | vrīhyardhaṃ taṇḍulaṃ proktaṃ tadardhaṃ ca tilānapi || 22.15 || uttamaṃ droṇamityuktaṃ madhyamaṃ tu tadardhakaṃ | adhamaṃ cāḍhakaṃ caiva paṅktiṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ, || 22.16 || samyakdagdhvātu kalaśānabhinnāntsaṃpragṛhya ca | śarāvāṇāṃ pramāṇaṃ tu kuḍubaṃ samudāhṛtaṃ || 22.17 || ṣaṭprasthamātraṃ karakaṃ kuṃbhaṃ tu droṇameva ca | "devasya'tveti kalaśānkuṃbhādīntsaṃpragṛhya ca || 22.18 || yavāntaraṃ tu tantūnāṃ saṃveṣṭya kalaśānapi | pūrvarātrau viśeṣeṇa deveśaṃ saṃpraṇamya ca || 22.19 || samabhyarcya nivedyaiva mukhavāsaṃ dadettataḥ | pūrvoktena vidhānena baddhvāpratisaraṃ tataḥ || 22.20 || śayanaṃ sopadhānaṃ ca kālayitvātu pūrvavath | śayane śāyayeddevamuttarācchādanaṃ careth || 22.21 || nṛttairgeyaiśca vādyaiśca rātriśeṣaṃ nayetkramāth | tataḥ prabhāte dharmātmā yajamānayuto guruḥ || 22.22 || śvabhramadhye pratiṣṭhāpya kūrcāntsamyaṅnyasetkramāth | jayādīrapi tatraiva caindrādyaiśāntamarcayeth || 22.23 || paṅktīśamarcayetpūrvaṃ nīlavāruṇamadhyame | viṣvakcenaṃ samabhyarcya someśānāntarepi ca || 22.24 || lokapālāntsamabhyarcye dvigrahairdaśabhistribhiḥ prāgdravyāṇi | nadītire mṛdaṃ gṛhya sasyaṅe tretaṭākake || 22.25 || darbhamūle ca saṃgṛhya gajadante tathaivaca | gośruṅge karkaṭāvāse valmīkasya tu madhyame || 22.26 || mahīṃ devīmanujñāpya tāścāhṛtya pṛthakpṛthak | ātapenātha saṃśoṣya viśvāmitrānparihraseth || 22.27 || śarāveṣu mṛdaṃ caiva pūrayityā pṛthakpṛthak | indrādīśānaparyantaṃ pradakṣiṇavaśena tu || 22.28 || "udutya'miti mantreṇa prathamaṃ sannyasenmṛdaḥ | mṛdupasnānamekaṃ tu aiśānyāṃ vipyasettadā || 22.29 || aśvadthena palāśena bilvena khadireṇa vā | kuryādaṣṭāṃgulotsedhaṃ caturaśraṃ samastataḥ || 22.30 || mūlaṃ ṣaḍaṅgule cāgrāttṣaṅgulaṃ samudāhṛtaṃ | anena vā mṛdā vāpi kuryādvai parvatānkramāth || 22.31 || himavānūrjavānvindhyo vidūro vedaparvataḥ | mahendraśca puraścandraśśataśruṅgāśca parvatāḥ || 22.32 || eṣāṃ varṇastathaivoktaḥ kuryādvarṇena saṃyutān | śvetaṃ pītaṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ ca raktaṃ vai śvetameva ca || 22.33 || pītaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ ca raktaṃ ca kramādvarṇa udāhṛtaḥ | prāgādīśānta metāṃśca "idaṃ viṣṇu'riti nyaseth || 22.34 || śailānāṃ cāpyupasnāmekamīśānyagocaraṃ | śālivrīhiyavā mudgatilamāṣa priyaṅgavaḥ || 22.35 || godhūmaścaṇakastilvomasūraścādthasī tathā | kuluddhamāṣakāścaiva ṣaṣṭirniṣpāva eva ca || 22.36 || etānyāhṛtya dhānyāni śarāveṣu pṛthakpṛthak | prakṣipya tāṃśya saṃpūrṇānkramāddvau dvaunyakettathā || 22.37 || indrādīśānaparyantaṃ "śukranta' iti mantrataḥ | nyasedekamupasnānaṃ dhānyānāmagnidiśyapi || 22.38 || śarāvāṇāmalābhe tu kalaśeṣu pṛthakpṛthak | "soma oṣadhīnā'mucchārya pūrvavaccāṃkurānapi || 22.39 || yamanīlāntare cāpi śarāvetu suvinyaseth | aṅkurāṇāmupasnānamekamatraiva vinyaseth || 22.40 || parvatārthaṃ samaṃ proktavṛkṣairyatnena vā mṛdā | maṅgalāni prakuryācca dārupakṣāṇyanukramāth || 22.41 || śrīvatsaṃ pūrṇakuṃbhaṃ ca bherīmādarśanaṃ tathā | matsyayugmāṃkuśaṃ śaṅkhamāvartamiti cāṣṭavai || 22.42 || śrīvatsaṃ tattu rukmābhaṃ ghaṭoraktābha ucyate | raktāṃ bherīṃ suvarṇābhaṃ tasya pārśve'sitaṃ?tathā || 22.43 || ādarśanaṃ ca śvetaṃ syādvṛttaṃ candravadiṣyate | matsyayugmaṃ tathā śvetamūrdhvānanamitīritaṃ || 22.44 || aṅkuśasya tu daṇḍaṃ ca raktaṃ kṛṣṇaghṛṇīyutaṃ | śaṅkhaṃ śaṅkhanibhaṃ proktaṃ raktamāvartamiṣyate || 22.45 || saptāṅgulasamutsedhameṣāṃ pīṭhaṃ dvigolakaṃ | yathā vṛkṣaistathā kuryātpañcavarṇairmṛdā tadhā || 22.46 || evaṃ lakṣaṇamuddiṣṭaṃ śeṣaṃ yuktyā samācareth | pradakṣiṇakrameṇaiva caindrādīśāntamarcayeth || 22.47 || dikṣvaṣṭasu mahādikṣu tattaddvārasya dakṣiṇe | "śaṃ sā niyaccha'tvityuktvāmaṅgalānyatra vinyaseth || 22.48 || maṅgalānāmupasnānamendrādyecaikamevahi | evaṃ prakaraṇaṃ proktaṃ kalaśānāṃ............ || 22.49 || dvādaśa pradhānadravyāṇi pañcagavyakramaṃ vakṣye devasya snapanaṃ prati | kapilāyā varaṃ kṣīraṃ śvetāyā dadhi cocyate || 22.50 || raktavarṇāghṛtaṃ grāhyaṃ kṛṣṇāyā gośśakṛdbhaveth | mūtraṃ tu nīlavarṇāyāḥ pañcagavyamiti smṛtaṃ || 22.51 || prasthapādaṃ ghṛtaṃ caiva dviguṇaṃ dadhi saṃyutaṃ | gṛhītvā triguṇaṃ kṣīraṃ gomayantu caturguṇaṃ || 22.52 || ṣaḍguṇaṃ caiva gomūtraṃ pañcagavyayutaṃ kramāth | apātitaṃ tu gomūtraṃ patitaṃ gomayaṃ bhaveth || 22.53 || dhāroṣṇaṃ kṣīramādāya sadyastsaptaṃ ghṛtaṃ bhaveth | aśuktaṃ dadhi gṛhṇīyādetatsarvatra lakṣaṇaṃ || 22.54 || "gāṅgeyaṃ' mantramuccārya gomūtraṃ pūrvamāhareth | tatparaṃ tu śakṛdgrāhya "mīśāna'miti mantrataḥ || 22.55 || "hiraṇyapāṇi'mityuktvā paya ādāya nikṣipeth | "iṣe tve'ti dadhi yañjyādghṛtaṃ "cāyanta' ityapi || 22.56 || ityevaṃ pañcabhirmantraiḥ pañcagavyaṃ samāhareth | etadāḍhakapūrmantu kalaśedṛśyate pṛthak || 22.57 || sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ tāmraṃ kāṃsyaṃ mṛṇmayameva vā | dvādaśāṃgulavistāraṃ ṣoḍaśāṃgulanāhakaṃ || 22.58 || dvyaṅgulaṃ saṃbharetkaṇṭhaṃ mukhaṃ pañcāṅgula bhaveth | pakvabiṃba phalākāraṃ khaṇḍasbhuṭītavarjitaṃ || 22.59 || evaṃ kalaśamādāya pañcagavyaiḥprapūrya ca | "rudramasya'miti procya nyasedīśānagocare || 22.60 || āḍhakārdhaghṛtenaiva saṃpūrṇaṃ kalaśaṃ tathā | "ghṛtapratīka' ityuktvā i dreśānāntarenyaseth || 22.61 || kalaśaṃ madhusaṃyuktaṃ sukuśaiḥ pūritaṃ tathā | "madhu vā'teti mantreṇa indrāgnyorantare nyaseth || 22.62 || na śuktaṃ dadhi gavyaṃ ca? saṃpūrṇakalaśaṃ tathā | "dadhi krāvṇna' ityukvā āgneyyāṃ dadhi vinyaseth || 22.63 || sadyo dugdhaṃ payogrāhya makṣataiḥ pūritantathā | "aṇoraṇīyā' nityuktvā yamāgnyormadhyame nyaseth || 22.64 || uśīrāgaruparṇairvā saṃyuktaṃ candanena vā | śuddhokena saṃgṛhya kalaśaṃ paripūritaṃ || 22.65 || yamanīlāntare tatra "apsara'ssviti vinyaseth | vrīhimāṣayavairyuktaṃ sarṣapañcākṣataṃ viduḥ || 22.66 || tūryaghoṣasamāyuktaṃ miśritaṃ cākṣatodakaṃ | tatrākṣatodakenaiva saṃpūrṇaṃ kalaśaṃ tataḥ || 22.67 || "imā oṣadhaya' ityuktvā nyasennī le'kṣatodakaṃ | kadalīmātuluṅgāmra panasernālikerakaiḥ || 22.68 || ārdrādibhiḥ phalaiścānyairyathālābhaṃ samāhṛtaiḥ | phalairardhāṃśasaṃyuktaṃ śeṣaṃ toyena pūritaṃ || 22.69 || phalodakamiti proktaṃ kalaśaṃ saṃprasāthitaṃ | nīlavāruṇayormadhye "somaṃ rā'jeti vinyaset, || 22.70 || kuśāgrairatha vā dūrvairakṣataiśca samanvitaṃ | kuśodakamiti proktaṃ kalaśaṃ tena pūritaṃ || 22.71 || varuṇodānayormadhye "yatassva'miti vinyaseth | vajraṃ nīlaṃ pravālaṃ ca śaṅkhajaṃ śuktijaṃ tathā || 22.72 || etāni pañcaratnāni tato maratakaṃ tathā | vaiḍūryaṃ puṣyarāgaṃ ca gomedhikamiti kramāth || 22.73 || ratnodakamiti proktaṃ kalaśaṃ tena pūritaṃ | vāyavye sannyasedvidvā"nato devādi'muccaran || 22.74 || yathālābhaṃ tathā ratnasuvarṇasahitaṃ kramāth | vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktaṃ ca puruṣasūktayutaṃ japeth || 22.75 || tathābhimantritaṃ toyaṃ japyodakamiti smṛtaṃ | kuberodānayormadhye "brahmā devānā'miti nyaseth || 22.76 || phalānte tu vitunnāssyuroṣadhyassamudāhṛtāḥ | sarvauṣadhisamāyuktaṃ sarvauṣadhyudakaṃ bhaveth || 22.77 || taryāṃśeṣu gṛhītaṃ ca kalaśaṃ pūrṇamaṃbhasā | someśānāstarecaiva "citraṃ devānā'miti nyaseth || 22.78 || eṣāṃ pratyekamekaṃ tu kalaśaṃ śuddhavāriṇā | gṛhītvā tadupasnānaṃ vāmapārśvetu vinyaseth || 22.79 || upasnāne tu kalaśā"nato devā'dinā nyaseth | evaṃ pradhānakalaśāścaturviṃśatirīritāḥ || 22.80 || anudravyāṇi nandyāvartaṃ ca padmaṃ ca tulasī viṣṇuparṇikā | bilvaṃ ca karavīraṃ ca padmaṃ kumudameva ca || 22.81 || aṣṭavai puṇyapuṣpāṇi grāhyāṇi tu yathākramaṃ | divāśuddhaṃ tu bilvaṃ ca kapidthaṃ bilvavanniśi || 22.82 || karavīraṃ divā śuddhaṃ niśi sitaṃ? tathā śuci | śarāveṣu samāhṛtya puṣpāṇi tu pṛthakpṛthak || 22.83 || "imāssumanasa' iti mantreṇa yamanīlāntare nyaseth | tasyopasnānamekantu tatpārśve kalaśaṃ nyaseth || 22.84 || śrīveṣṭakaṃ yavaṃ mudgamuśīraṃ caiva ratnakaṃ | tathā masūraṃ damanaṃ jātīphalayutaṃ tathā || 22.85 || lavaṅgaṃ ca samāhṛtya cūrṇayitvākrameṇa vai | samārādhyaiva taccūrṇaṃ śarāveṣu ca pūrayeth || 22.86 || paṅktīśāddakṣiṇe cūrṇaṃ "vandyo na'iti vinyaseth | eṣāmalābhe cūrṇānāṃ grāhyamailādicūrṇakaṃ || 22.87 || upasnānaṃ tu tatpārśve tvekaṃ vai kalaśaṃ nyaseth | aśvadthasya madhūkasya khadirasya vaṭasya ca || 22.88 || vañjulāsanayoścāpi citravṛkṣasya ca tvacaḥ | hṛtvolūkhalamadhye ca "udutya'miti vinyaseth || 22.89 || ukta carmaṇyalābhe tu aśvadthasya vidhīyate | kaṣāyaṃ parikalpyaiva "ye te śata'miti bruvan || 22.90 || varuṇodānayormadhye kaṣāyakalaśaṃ nyaseth | upasnānaṃ tu tatpārśve ekaṃ vai kalaśaṃ nyaseth || 22.91 || siṃhī ca nakulavyāghranandādityaṃ ca puṣkaraṃ | dūrvā ca sahadevī ca pāṭhā sāhvayameva ca || 22.92 || evaṃ vanauṣadhīrgṛhya somavāyvontu madhyame | upasnānaṃ tu tatpārśve ekaṃ vai kalaśaṃ nyaseth || 22.93 || nadītaṭākakūpānāṃ palvalasya ca vāribhiḥ | pṛthaksaṃpūrya kalaśāṃścaturastu samāhareth || 22.94 || tasyaikaṃ kalaśaṃ pārśve upasnānaṃ tu vinyaseth | hareṇukaṃ ca sthauṇeyaṃ patraṃ vyāghranakhaṃ tathā || 22.95 || parṇāgaruṃ ca dyāmākaṃ kacoraṃ ceruvālakaṃ | māñcī jātiphalailāṃśca lavaṅgaṃ candanaṃ tathā || 22.96 || karpūraṃ ca balośīrasthiranāradameva ca? | kastuṃburuṃ tathānyāni sugandhīni śucīni ca || 22.97 || prāṇyaṅgaṃ ca purīṣaṃ ca varjayitvā samāhareth | eteṣāmapi yaccūrṇaṃ sūkṣmamutpīḍya kalpitaṃ || 22.98 || sarvagandhamiti proktaṃ śarāveṣu prapūrayeth | nyase"ttrātāra'mityeva yakṣarājeśamadhyame || 22.99 || tattatpārśvenyasetteṣāmupasnānaṃ tathaiva ca | navasya snigdhavarṇasya hāridrasya prakalpayet, || 22.100 || cūrṇaṃ tu kalaśe kṣiptvā saṃpūrṇaṃ kalaśaṃ careth | paṅktīśasyaiva pārśvetu "sinī vā'līti vinyaseth || 22.101 || tasya pārśve nyasedekamupasnānantu pūrvavath | pālāśadūrvāpāmārganandyāvartadalāni ca || 22.102 || karavīrasya patrāṇi kuśapatrāṇi caiva hi | mūlagandhārthamāhṛtya tasya pārśve nyasedbudhaḥ || 22.103 || śuddhodakalaśaṃ sthāpyedupasnānaṃ ca pūrvavath | vastrayugmaṃ navaṃ sūkṣmaṃ kṛtaṃ kārpāsatantunā || 22.104 || plotārthantu samāhṛtya śuddhapātre tu nikṣipeth | viṣṇugāyatriyā sthāpya yakṣarājeśamadhyame || 22.105 || plotapārśvenyasettāni "brahmajajñāna'mityapi | jātiṃ hiṅgulikaṃ caiva añjanaṃ ca manaśśilāṃ || 22.106 || gorocanaṃ ca girikamiti dhātūntsamāhareth | etāni cūrṇayitvātu śarāveṣu pṛthakpṛthak || 22.107 || prakṣipya "jātave'deti nyasettatraiva pūrvavath | ekādaśānukaraṇe kalaśāṃścaiva pūrayeth || 22.108 || ahataṃ ca sumākṣmaṃ ca vastrayugmamakhaṇḍitaṃ | vastraṃ yajñopavītaṃ ca pavitraṃ bhūṣaṇādikaṃ || 22.109 || evamādīni saṃgṛhya someśānāntare nyaseth | vinyasya kalaśāṃścaiva tathā cūrṇānpṛthakpṛthak || 22.110 || vastrairāveṣṭya tāntsarvānpunaḥkūrcāni nikṣipeth | utkūrcaṃ vāpyadhaḥkūrcaṃ prāgagraṃ vodagagrakaṃ || 22.111 || vinyasya teṣu kūrcāni śarāve rapidhāya ca | praṇamya devadeveśaṃ dravyārcasamathārabheth || 22.112 || tataścaryāpadānteṣu jayādyapsarasor'cayeth | jayāṃ ca vijayāṃ vindāṃnandakāṃ puṣṭikāmapi || 22.113 || kumudvatīmutpalakāṃ viśokāṃ ca samarcayeth | prāgādivedyāḥ paritaḥ paṅktau paṅktīśamarcayeth || 22.114 || viṣvaksenaṃ tataḥ paścādindrādīṃśca samarcayeth | dravyadevārcanam mṛddevatā tu bhūdevī parvateśastu pāvakaḥ || 22.115 || vāyurvaidhānyadevassyādgaruḍā oṃkuradevatā | maṅgalādhipatiśśakraḥpañcagavyādhipaśśivaḥ || 22.116 || tathaiva viśvedevāśca upasnānādhidevatāḥ | sāmavedo ghṛteśassyādupasnāne tu vatsarāḥ || 22.117 || ṛgvedo madhudevassyādupasnāne tu vāyavaḥ | yajurvedo dadhīśo'bhūdupasnā kapardinaḥ || 22.118 || kṣīre tvadharvavedaśca upasnāne'śvinau tathā | gandhodake ṣaḍṛtavo marutastadanantare || 22.119 || akṣatode viśvamūrtirupasnāne bṛhaspatiḥ | somaḥ phalodakeśassyādanantastadanantare || 22.120 || kuśodake ca munaya upasnāne tu takṣakaḥ | viṣṇūratnodakeśassyādgandharvāstanadantare || 22.121 || mantroratnodakeśassyādupasnānetu puṣpajāḥ | sarvauṣadhyudake bhānurupasnāne'psarogaṇāḥ || 22.122 || puṇyapuṣpeṣu dhātāraṃ cūrṇeṣvapyanapāyinaṃ | varuṇaḥ kaṣāyadevassyāttīrthe caiva jagadbhuvaḥ || 22.123 || vanauṣadhīśo rudro'bhūcchinīvālī haridrake | upasnāni tu rākā syātsarvagandhe śatakratuḥ || 22.124 || brahmāṇaṃ mūlagandhetu plotavastre purandaraṃ | dhātuṣvapi ca durgāṃ ca tattaddravyadharaṃ smaran || 22.125 || trayodaśopacāraiśca mūrtimantrairathār'cayeth | upasnāneṣu cānyeṣu varuṇaṃ ca tathār'cayeth || 22.126 || ācārya pūjayitvātu vastrairābharaṇaistathā | śiṣyaṃ ca pūjayetpaścādyajamānassvaśaktitaḥ || 22.127 || tato guruḥprasannātmā deveśaṃ saṃpraṇamya ca | aṣṭopacārairabhyarcya snapanāvasaraṃ tataḥ || 22.128 || vijñāpya haraye samyakpaścātkāryaṃ samācareth | "rakṣasva tva'miti procya dravyadevaṃ praṇamya ca || 22.129 || śiṣyastunamrakāyassannācāryājñāṃ pratīkṣate | ājñāpayedguruśśiṣyaṃ "harasveda'miti bruvan || 22.130 || tattaddravyaṃ samādāya śiṣyastasmai nivedayeth | adbhiḥprokṣya samādāya taddravyaṃ gururatvaraḥ || 22.131 || pvaṇavaṃ tu samuccārya tatra kāryaṃ samācareth | lalāṭāntaṃ samuddhṛtya devadevaṃ praṇamya ca || 22.132 || taddravyeṇa sakṛttrirvā deveśasya pradakṣiṇaṃ | taddravyanāma saṃyojya tanmantrānte tu kārayeth || 22.133 || "ato devā'ditimantreṇa devadevaṃ praṇamya ca | viṣṇuṃ ca puruṣaṃ satyamacyutaṃ cāniruddhakaṃ || 22.134 || evaṃ mantraṃ samuccārya tatra kāryaṃ samācareth | kriyānte pātramādāya pūrvasthāne niveśayeth || 22.135 || snapanaprayogaḥ "ekākṣareṇa' mantreṇa prokṣyaṃ gṛhya pradakṣiṇaṃ | kūrcenādāya saṃsrāvya mūrdhnivai snāpayenmṛdā || 22.136 || "viśve nimagna'ityuktvāparvatena pradakṣiṇaṃ | dhānyena snāpayeccaiva "prāṇaprasūti'muccaran || 22.137 || "vitatya bāṇa'mityuktvā aṅkuraireva cār'cayeth | "tvaṃ ya'jñeti ca mantreṇa maṅgalaiśca pradakṣiṇaṃ || 22.138 || "vasoḥ pavitra'mityuktvā pañcagavyābhiṣecanaṃ | "vārīścatasra'ityuktvā sarvopasnānamācareth || 22.139 || "agna āyāhi' mantreṇa ghṛtenaivābhiṣe cayeth | "agnimīleti mantreṇa madhunaivābhiṣecayeth || 22.140 || dadhmābhiṣecayetpaścā"diṣe tve'ti samuccaran | "śanno devīra'bhītyuktvā kṣīreṇaivābhiṣecayeth || 22.141 || "abhi tvā śūra'ityuktvā snāpayedgandhavāriṇā | "imā oṣadhaya'ityuktvā snāpayedakṣatodakaiḥ || 22.142 || "japanda'tveti cocchārya phalodaiścābhiṣecayeth | "catvā'rīti ca mantreṇa kuśodaiścābhiṣecayeth || 22.143 || "tatpuruṣā'yeti mantreṇa ratnodaiścābhiṣecayeth | "pūta sta'nyeti mantreṇa japyodairabhiṣecayeth || 22.144 || "catvāri śruṃgetyuccārya saryauṣadhyudakaiścareth | "dhātā vidhā'tetyuccārya puṇyapuṣpairathārcayeth || 22.145 || "ṛco yajūṃṣi' mantreṇa cūrṇena snāpayedguruḥ | "sa eṣa deva' uccārya udvarteta kaṣāyakaiḥ || 22.146 || "sa sarvavettā'mantreṇa tīrthodeścābhiṣecayeth | "sāmaiśca sāṃga'mityuktvā mārjayecca vanauṣadhīḥ || 22.147 || hāridracūrṇaissaṃsnāpya "ato devā' iti bruvan | "tvaṃ strīpumā'nityuccārya lepayetsarvagandhakaiḥ || 22.148 || snāpayeduṣṇatoyena "āpo hi'ṣṭheti coccaran | nityasnānoktamārgeṇa śuddhodairabhiṣecayeth || 22.149 || tattaddravyābhiṣekānte snānavastraṃ visṛjya ca | dhautaṃ samarpayeccaiva pūjayedaṣṭavigrahaiḥ || 22.150 || "mitrassuvarṇa'ityuktvā plotena parimṛjya ca | vastrādyaissamalaṅkṛtya pūrvoktenaiva kārayeth || 22.151 || "tvaṃ bhūrbhuvastvaṃ'mantreṇa mūlagandhena mārjayeth | "buddhimatā'mityuccārya cālaṅkuryācca dhātubhiḥ || 22.152 || pādyamācamanaṃ dadyādālayasya pradakṣiṇaṃ | svastisūktādisūktaṃ ca japtvācaivātha kārayeth || 22.153 || arcāsthāne tu saṃsthāpya pūjayitvoktamārgataḥ | mahāhāviḥ prabhūtaṃ vā yathāśakti nivedayeth || 22.154 || niṣkādhikaṃ suvarṇaṃ ca savatsāmapi gāṃ tathā | gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dadyātsnāpakānāṃ tathaiva ca || 22.155 || tatrānyakarmakartṝṇāṃ yathāśaktyāca dakṣiṇāṃ | dadyātkarmaphalaṃ prāpya yajamāno'tha bhaktimān || 22.156 || snapanāyattamuddiṣṭadhānyadravyāṃbarāṇi ca | pātrāṇi ca tathānyāni snapanānte dhṛtāni ca || 22.157 || nivedayitvā gurave praṇamecca muhurmuhuḥ | dhruvārcanā yadi syāttu pramukhe snapanaṃ careth || 22.158 || vitānastaṃbhaveṣṭādipūrvavatkārayettataḥ | pañcahastābhedeṣu paṅktiṃ kuryādvidhānataḥ || 22.159 || madhye kubhaṃ ca snyasya arcayitvā ca pūrvavath | dhruvapīṭhasya paritaḥ kūrcayuktaṃ caturdiśaṃ || 22.160 || jayādīrarcayitvātu mṛdādīnpūrvavatkramāth | tatpātraṃ saṃpragṛhyaiva pāṇibhyāṃ kṣālanaṃ careth || 22.161 || atha vā pātramādāya pūrayitvātu sannyaseth | dravyaṃ prati viśeṣeṇa pūrayitvār'cayetkramāth || 22.162 || pādyaṃ cācamanaṃ puṣpaṃ gandhaṃ dhūpaṃ tathaiva ca | dīpamarghyaṃ tathācāmamarcayitvāṣṭavigrahaiḥ || 22.163 || devadevaṃ namaskṛtya pradakṣiṇamathācareth | devasya puratastiṣṭheddravyamādāya pāṇinā || 22.164 || gauśṛṅgāgraṃ samuddhṛtya pūrvoktavidhinā kramāth | punaḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā pūrvasthāne tu vinyaseth || 22.165 || dhruveṇābhyastare caiva biṃbairanyaissahaivatu | pūrvamuktaṃ dhruvārcā cetsnapanaṃ samyagācareth || 22.166 || yathoktenaiva mārgeṇa yathāvidhi samarcayetcatvāriṃśath || 22.167 || gavyaṃ śrutaṃ dadhi madhu kṣīre syādratna toyakaṃ || 22.168 || japyaṃ dvādaśaitānsamāhṛtya || 22.169 || ntu upasnānamekaṃ hāridra madhyamottamaṃ || 22.170 || upasnānavi mādhamaṃ caiva snapanaṃ tu vidhīyate || 22.171 || stathā kuryātkalaśaistu caturdaśaiḥ || 22.172 || madhyame madhyamaṃ caiva madhyamādhama vidhīyate || 22.173 || saptabhiḥ kalaśaiḥ madhyamaṃ teṣāṃ ṣaḍbhiḥ kala || 22.174 || dhamamucyate caturdaśaiḥ || 22.175 || gavyaṃ ghṛtaṃ kṣīramakṣa pasnānaṃ tathaiva ca || 22.176 || etai daśaitānkalasyācetkra? ta || 22.177 || pūrvoktenaiva kalaśasyaceth || 22.178 || dikṣaṣṭa gavyaistu aindre ghṛtami || 22.179 || myegandhodakaṃ tathā payo tyāṃ vāruṇyāmakṣatodakaṃ || 22.180 || soṃye japyodakaṃ kramātvyastusaptabhiḥ kalaśaiḥ || 22.181 || catriṣaṭyoṇasthalaṃ saptabhiḥ kalaśoktavath || 22.182 || navakoṣṭhantu tatra vai ma bhaśca kuśāṃbhasā || 22.183 || japyā vinyasetevamevaṃ yeth || 22.184 || dakṣiṇāyanakāletu uttarāyaṇakāletu paścāth || 22.185 || ye tu saṃprāpte tatsūryeṃdūparāgeṣu snapanaṃ devadevasya kṛtvā ta || 22.186 || iti śrīvaikhānase bhagavacchāstre bhṛguproktāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prakīrṇādhikāre dvāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ <23> athatrayoviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ utsavacakram ataḥparaṃ pravakṣyāmi pūrvoddiṣṭaṃ sudarśanaṃ | sudarśanasya coddiṣṭaṃ pramāṇaṃ ca viśeṣuḥ || 23.1 || mahāberasya mānena navāṅgulamiti smṛtaṃ | tasya vṛttaṃ samuddiṣṭamarāścaiva tu tṣaṅgulaṃ || 23.2 || vṛttaṃ paṭṭasya vistāramekāṅgulamudāhṛtaṃ | tanmadhye cārakūṭaṃ syādekāṃgulamudāhṛtaṃ || 23.3 || arā dvādaśa uddiṣṭā etaccakrasya vai tathā | adhamaṃ mārgamālokya proktametatpramāṇakaṃ || 23.4 || tatra madhyaṃ pramāṇantu vakṣyāmi śruṇutādarāth | mahāberasya hastena dvādaśāṃgulamucyate || 23.5 || tadvṛttaṃ tasya hastena dvādaśāṃgulamucyate | vṛttaṃ tasya samuddiṣṭamārakūṭaṃ dviyaṅgulaṃ || 23.6 || vṛttapaṭṭasya vistāramekāṃgulamudāhṛtaṃ | aṣṭau ca caturaṅgulyā? duddiṣṭāśca samāsataḥ || 23.7 || arāṣṣoḍaśa uddiṣṭāścakrasyaiva tu madhyame | kūrmaṃ vāpyatha siṃhaṃ vā padmaṃ vāpyatha kālayeth || 23.8 || adhastādyogadaṇḍaṃ ca ekāṅgulamudāhṛtaṃ | ubhayoḥ pādayoścaiva siṃhenaiva tu kārayeth || 23.9 || āyasenaiva vā kuryāddāruṇā vā tathaiva ca | sarvatra suṃdaraṃ kuryātsajānana? vidhīyate || 23.10 || etallakṣaṇamudgiṣṭaṃ cakrasyaiva pramāṇataḥ | madhūcchiṣṭena vidhinā kuryādvai tatra tatra tu || 23.11 || vidadhyāddeva devasya heti pravaramuttamaṃ | pramāṇaṃ ca tu sarvatra tattribhāgaṃ viśeṣataḥ || 23.12 || sthāpanāṃ mūrtimantraṃ ca cakrasya śruṇutarṣayaḥ | athātassaṃpravakṣyāmi vaiṣṇavaṃ cakramuttamaṃ || 23.13 || trividhaṃ cakramuddiṣṭaṃ brahmaṇā parameṣinā | kālacakraṃ vīracakraṃ sahasravikacaṃ kramāth || 23.14 || karoddhṛtaṃ vīracakraṃ devasya mukhamānataḥ | sarvājināṃ samūhanta bajaṃ khatrayamantataḥ? || 23.15 || devasya mukhamānaṃ syāddvādaśāṣṭāracihnitaṃ | jvālāpañcakasaṃyuktaṃ karāgre dakṣiṇe careth || 23.16 || mayaṃ mahīmayaṃ divyamaṣṭāraṃ dvādaśārakaṃ | ebhirmantraissamabhyarcya rakṣārthaṃ mokṣaśāntaye || 23.17 || kālacakraṃ pravakṣyāmi autsavaṃ sarvaśāntidaṃ | dhruvaberamukhāyāmaṃ dviguṇāyāmavistṛtaṃ || 23.18 || vṛttaṃ ca ṣaḍguṇaṃ proktaṃ kṣatāntaṃ tatsuvṛttakaṃ | vṛttasya paṭṭavistāraṃ triyaṅgulamiti smṛtaṃ || 23.19 || ṣaḍaṅgulasamāyāmamārakūṭaṃ tu tṣaṅgulaṃ | yavā kārakarā jñeyā ubhayatra praveśatā || 23.20 || arakūṭe'tha siṃhaṃ vā makaraṃ vātha padmakaṃ | jvālātrikaṃ vā kartavyaṃ jvālāpañjakameva vā || 23.21 || śatāṣṭāraṃ niṃśatiṃ vā uttame samyagācareth | catuṣpañcadvipañcāśanmadhyame samudāhṛtaṃ || 23.22 || dvātriṃśadvā caturviṃśadadhame saṃprayojayeth | evaṃ syātkālacakrantu utsavārthaṃ prakalpayeth || 23.23 || cakrādhastāttathā nālaṃ dvādaśāṃgulamācareth | cakradviguṇadaṇḍantu khadiraṃ cāsanaṃ bhaveth || 23.24 || yājñikairatha vā vṛkṣaiḥ kārayedatra śāsanaṃ | ṣaḍaṅgulāyatavistārāṃ phalakāṃ saṃprakalpayeth || 23.25 || vṛttaṃ vā caturaśraṃ vā laṃbadāmasamāyutaṃ | triyaṅgulasamutsedhaṃ saṃdhayettarikopari || 23.26 || tadadhastāttu tāṭiṃ ca kuṃbhalaṃbakasaṃyutaṃ | aṣṭāṃgulasamutsethaṃ kārayediti śāsanaṃ || 23.27 || antassuṣirasaṃ kṛtvā?daṇḍāgre cādha eva vā | kūradaṇḍena saṃyojya phalakophalapadmakaṃ || 23.28 || latā prasthataraṃ vāpi kārayediti śāsanaṃ | padmaṃ tu tṣaṅgunāyāmaṃ vistāramadhikāṃgulaṃ || 23.29 || pālikopari siṃhau dvāvubhayoḥ pārśvayoścareth | cakraṃ saṃvahamānau tau yāvattatra ca kālayeth || 23.30 || tayormānaṃ samuddiṣṭaṃ pañcāṃgulamiti smṛtaṃ | daṇḍamadhyena kuryāttaddaṇḍamūle ṣaḍaṅgulaṃ || 23.31 || pīṭhaṃ ṣaḍaṅgulotsedhaṃ caturaṅgulameva vā | vṛttaṃ vā caturaśraṃ vā sarojadalakarṇayuk || 23.32 || ṣāḍhaśāṃgulamāyāmaṃ vistāraṃ saṃprakīrtitaṃ | karṇikāmadhyame nālamaṣṭāṃgula samāyutaṃ || 23.33 || nāladaṇḍena saṃyojya bandhayedaṣṭabandhanaiḥ | hāravatsudṛḍhaṃ kuryādavakramṛjusaṃyutaṃ || 23.34 || evaṃ kṛtvā yathāmārgaṃ sthāpanaṃ samyagācareth | sahasravikacaṃ cakraṃ puruṣākāramācareth || 23.35 || raktābhaṃ nīlavarṇaṃ ca navatālena mānataḥ | dvibhujaṃ mukuṭodbandhaṃ cakracūlinamācareth || 23.36 || sudarśanaṃ tathā cakraṃ sahasravikacaṃ tathā | anapāyinamityevaṃ mūrtimantraissamarcayeth || 23.37 || śatadhāraṃ kālacakraṃ sarvāsuravimardanaṃ | sarvavighnaharaṃ ceti kālacakraṃ samarcayeth || 23.38 || kālacakraṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvāsuravināśanaṃ | ṣaṭṭriṃśadaṅgulaṃ vāpi ṣaṭpañcāśacchatāṣṭakaṃ || 23.39 || vistārāyāmatomānamuttamādhamamadhyamaṃ | mānāṃgulena tadgrāhyaṃ takṣakaṃ vartulaṃ bhaveth || 23.40 || sahasrārā aṣṭaśataṃ triśataṃ ṣaṣṭimeva vā | arāḥkrameṇa saṃyuktā uttamādhamamadhyamāḥ || 23.41 || caturviṃśattathā jvālāṣṣoḍaśa dvādaśātha vā | daśasaptāṅgulaṃ pañca vṛttaṃ paṭṭasya saṃyutaṃ || 23.42 || cakraprabhehakaṃ bhāgaṃ pīṭhaṃ padmakamācareth | daṇḍādīni vinā tasya padmaṃ pīṭhasyayojayeth || 23.43 || etaduktaṃ mahaccakraṃ sarvāriṣṭavināśanaṃ | cakrasya sthāpanaṃ mārgaṃ pravakṣyāmi tapodhanāḥ || 23.44 || aṅkurānarpayitvātu kārayedakṣimocanaṃ | tathādhivāsanaṃ kṛtvā gavyānāmadhivāsanaṃ || 23.45 || yāgaśālāṃ tathā kṛtvā bhūṣayettoraṇānvitaṃ | śayyāvediṃ ca tanmadhye cādhyardhāyāmavistṛtaṃ || 23.46 || tatturyāṃśodayāṃ vediṃ kṛtvā tāṃ caturaśrakaṃ | prācyāmāhavanīyaṃ ca kuṇḍamaupāsanāgnivath || 23.47 || prācyāṃ tu snānavediṃ ca kṛtvācaiva vicakṣaṇaḥ | athādhivāsitaṃ cakramādāyevābhiṣicya ca || 23.48 || agniṃ saṃsādhya pūrvoktaṃ kuṃbhaṃ saṃsāthayetpunaḥ | cakrasyābhimukhe kuṃbhaṃ dhānyapīṭhoparikramāth || 23.49 || sannyasya tu gururdhīmānyaditaṃ bhāvayettathā | grāmaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā śālāyāṃ sthāpayettathā || 23.50 || hṛtpadmamadhye cakreśaṃ dvibhujaṃ prāṃjalīkṛtaṃ | raktābhaṃ kṛtavastrābhaṃ dhyātvāsamyakprapūrya ca || 23.51 || tasmātkuṃbhe samāvāhya pūrvoktamabhipūjya ca | vedyāṃ saṃsnāpya taccakraṃ kalaśaisnāpayettadā || 23.52 || samala kṛtya vaktrādyairdhānyapīṭhoparikramāth | sannyasya kuṃbhaṃ saṃyuktaṃ baddhvā pratisaraṃ tataḥ || 23.53 || śāyayitvā tathā cakraṃ hautraṃ samyakpraśaṃsya ca | cakrāṅgānyāyadhāṃgāni mūrtimantrānpracakṣate || 23.54 || paścādagniṃ paristīrya vaiṣṇavairmantra saṃyutaiḥ | "bhūmānano'gre vandyāna'hutvā gāyatrisaṃyutaṃ || 23.55 || śatamaṣṭottaraṃ hutvā rātriśeṣaṃ vyapohya ca | snātvā prabhāte pūrvoktaṃ cakramādāya pūrvavath || 23.56 || grāmaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā kuṃbhenāsādayettathā | maṇḍape dakṣiṇe pārśve kṛtapīṭhe viśeṣataḥ || 23.57 || ratnaṃ nikṣipya pūrvoktamantreṇa sthāpayettadā | cakramantrau susannyasya bījānsannyasya pūrvavath || 23.58 || kuṃbhācchaktiṃ tathāvāhya pūjayedāsanādibhiḥ | pāyasādyairni vaidyātha guruṃ samyakprapūjayeth || 23.59 || iti śrīvaikhānase bhagavacchāstre bhṛsuproktāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prakīrṇādhikāre trayoviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ <24> atha caturviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ utsavaḥ ataḥparaṃ pravakṣyāmi deveśasyotsavakramaṃ | varṣadaṃ sarvalokasya śāntidaṃ sarvapuṣṭidaṃ || 24.1 || rājñāṃ vijayadānāya śatrūṇāṃ nāśahetave | vyādhidurbhikṣaśā ntyarthamutsavaṃ kārayedbudhaḥ || 24.2 || kālaśraddhānimittārthā(khyā)utsavāstrividhāssmṛtāḥ | māsetu yasminkasmiṃśchitpratisaṃvatsaraṃ careth || 24.3 || ekasminsamayecaiva sa tu kālotsavo bhaveth | iṣṭamāse dine ceṣṭe śraddhayā kriyate tu yaḥ || 24.4 || sa tu śraddhotsavojñeya stasmātkālotsavo guruḥ | bhayapradanimitteṣu tathānāvṛṣṭikādiṣu || 24.5 || kriyate tatra śāntyarthaṃ sa nimittotsavassmṛtaḥ | pratiṣṭhādivase tīrthaṃ prati saṃvatkaraṃ caret, || 24.6 || kālotsava itijñeyaśśāntyarthaṃ saprakīrtitaḥ | rājarāṣṭrābhivṛddhyarthaṃ rājñāṃ caivābhivṛddhaye || 24.7 || atmanaścaiva putrāṇāṃ kuryādukteṣu maṅgalaṃ | rājño janmadine caiva yassa śraddhotsavo bhaveth || 24.8 || adbhutādyudbhaveśāntissatu naimittikotsavaḥ | grāmādau cotsavassyāccetkrameṇaivaṃ tu kārayeth || 24.9 || sarvaduḥkhārtiśāntyarthamādau kālyutsavaṃ careth | anveṣāṃ krūradevānāṃ śiṣṭabhūtagaṇasya ca || 24.10 || śāntyarthaṃ kārayetpaśchāstroktaṃ śaṅkarotsavaṃ | viśastrigaṇasāntyarthaṃ soṃyamārgeṇa vāstuṣu || 24.11 || cakraseneśa saṃyuktaṃ kuryāddurgotsavaṃ punaḥ | sarveṣāmapi devānāṃ munīnāmapi sarvaśaḥ || 24.12 || pitṝṇāṃ ca grahāṇāṃ ca tatpatnīnāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ | dvijānāmapi śāntyarthaṃ lokānāmapi sarvaśaḥ || 24.13 || puṣṭyarthaṃ kārayetpaścāddeveśasyotsavaṃ kramāth | anyadhā cedvināśassyātsarveṣāṃ ca na saṃśayaḥ || 24.14 || tasmātpariharedvidvāngrāmādautaṃ viśeṣataḥ | viṣuvāyanabhūparkṣapratiṣṭhākartṛbheṣu ca || 24.15 || grahaṇemāsanakṣatre viṣṇupañcadineṣu ca | utsavasyāntadivase teṣu tīrthaṃ prakalpayeth || 24.16 || eteṣvekaṃ parigrāhyaṃ yajamānasya cecchayā | viṣuve cāyane caiva grahaṇe somasūryayoḥ || 24.17 || tattatkāle prakurvīta tīrthasnārantu nānyadhā | anyarkṣeṣvatha pūrvāhṇemadhyāhne vā guṇānvite || 24.18 || ekasminneva māsetu yadi tīrthadinadvayaṃ | tayorantyadine tīrthamiti pūrvajadarśanaṃ || 24.19 || tadeva yadi sūryasya viddhaṃ cetsaṃkramādibhiḥ | varjanīyaṃ tathā pūrvaṃ praśastamabhidhīyate || 24.20 || vāradvayānuṣakte cettithau syāttupare tathā | adhimāsaḥ parityājyaḥ kālotsavavidhauhareḥ || 24.21 || arkavārarkṣa saṃyogassarvadā saṃpraśasyate | śravaṇadvādaśīyogassarvakarmaphalapradaḥ || 24.22 || yogāśca supraśastāssyussiddhāmṛtavarāhvayāḥ | tithidvayānuṣaktaṃ ce'nnakṣatraṃ syātpare'hani || 24.23 || parasmindivase syāccedyāvacca daśanāḍikāḥ | hīnaṃ cetpūrvadivase saṃkalpyāvabhṛthaṃ careth || 24.24 || uttamaṃ tu trisaptāhaṃ madhyamaṃ syāccaturdaśa | navāhaṃ vāthasaptāhaṃ adhamaṃ paricakṣate || 24.25 || triguṇānyutsavāhāni kṛtvādau ghoṣaṇaṃ careth | madhyame dviguṇādau syādutsavādi dine'dhame || 24.26 || athavāvabhṛthātpūrvamekaviṃśatike dine | dhvajasyārohaṇaṃ kṛtvā sarvamutsavamācareth || 24.27 || rāhudarśanasaṃkrāntyoḥ snānaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ niśāsvapi | kriyāṃ samāpya madhyāhne rātraucetsakalaṃ budhaḥ || 24.28 || tāvatkālaṃ vinodeva nītvā tattīrthamācareth | pakṣantrayodaśāhaṃ vā dinānyekādaśa kramāth || 24.29 || navāhaṃ vātha saptāhaṃ pañcāhamatha vā punaḥ | tridinaṃ dvidinaṃ caiva kuryādekāhameva vā || 24.30 || na dhvajārohaṇaṃ kuryāttṣahādautu viśeṣataḥ | utsavasya dinādautu ghoṣaye dvidhipūrvakaṃ || 24.31 || ghoṣaṇādivasātpūryaṃ kālayedaṅkurār'paṇaṃ | dhvajadaṇḍaṃ tatovakṣye viprādīnāṃ yathākramaṃ || 24.32 || veṇuṃ ca jātivṛkṣaṃ ca caṃpakaṃ kramukaṃ tathā | dhvajadaṇḍārthamāhṛtya sarveṣāṃ kramukaṃ tu vā || 24.33 || anyairvāśubhavṛkṣairvākārayediti ke ca na | caturviṃśāṅgulaṃ nāhaṃ dhvajadaṇḍamathottamaṃ || 24.34 || tasmāttu dvyaṅgulaṃ hīnaṃ dhvajadaṇḍantu madhyamaṃ | viṃśatyaṅgulanāhe tadadhamaṃ daṇḍamucyate || 24.35 || yathālābhaparīṇāhamavakraṃ parigṛhya ca | dhvajadaṇḍamṛjuṃ kurvādvimānasamayāyataṃ || 24.36 || vimānasyādhikaṃ kuryātpādahīna mathār'dhakaṃ | adhyarthaṃ vādhipādaṃ vā mūlādagraṃ kramātkṛśaṃ || 24.37 || veṇukaṃ yadi saṃgrāhyaṃ bhūtavedāṃgulāyataṃ | ṣaḍaṅgulaparīṇāhaṃ veṇudaṇḍaṃ susaṃsthitaṃ || 24.38 || tanmadhye dviyamaṃ hitvā tanmadhye valayaṃ dṛḍhaṃ | tāladvayamathāyāmaṃ yamamātrantu vistṛtaṃ || 24.39 || utsedhaṃ bhāgamuddiṣṭaṃ dārubhiryājñikaistuvā | taccaturthāṃśakaṃ kṛtvā mūle'gredvyaṃśakantyajeth || 24.40 || madhye dvyaṃśaṃ tu kartavyaṃ suṣiradvayasaṃyutaṃ | śakalāni trīṇiyojya mūlamadhyāgrataḥkramāth || 24.41 || prakṣālyamūlamantreṇa tanmantraiḥprokṣaṇaṃ careth | daśadarbhayutaṃ kūrcamagrecaiva tu yojayeth || 24.42 || darbhamālāntarāveṣṭya daṇḍocāśvadthapatrayuk | madhyāṅguliparīṇāhaṃ daṇḍadviguṇamāyataṃ || 24.43 || daṇḍāgre tatra saṃyojya rajjuṃ tatraiva bandhayeth | saṃvyapohya catustālaṃ pṛṣṭhe yūdhādhipasyatu || 24.44 || khānayitvā dhvajasthānaṃ tritālaṃ gāḍhayeva ca | medinīṃ tu samabhyarcya ratnaṃ bījāni ca kṣipeth || 24.45 || sthāpayitvā dhvajaṃ tatra dhvajamantreṇa mantravith | devadevaṃ samīkṣyaiva yaṣṭiṃ tatpra mukhe nyaseth || 24.46 || dhvajadaṇḍamṛjuṃ kuryāddṛḍhaṃ tatraiva kārayeth | mūlaṃ tritālamutsedhaṃ tadadhyardhantu vistṛtaṃ || 24.47 || tadūrdhve ratnimātrantu sāṣṭapatraṃ sakarṇikaṃ | śuddhakārpāsavastrantu samāhṛtya navaṃ dṛḍhaṃ || 24.48 || uttamaṃ ṣoḍaśaṃ hastaṃ madhyamaṃ tithihastakaṃ | adhamaṃ caturdaśaṃ hastaṃ trividhaṃ vastramucyate || 24.49 || pañcatālaṃ catustālaṃ tritālaṃ vistṛtaṃ kramāth | agraṃ pādaṃ viditvā tu mukhaṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ tathaiva ca || 24.50 || caturbhāgaṃ paṭaṃ kuryādekabhāgaṃ śiro bhaveth | vīśasthānaṃ dvibhāgaṃ tu pucchamekāṃśamucyate || 24.51 || madhyamasyāgramūlaṃ ca yaṣṭiṃ samyakprayojayeth | tanmadhye tu likhedvīśaṃ pañcavarṇairalaṅkṛtaṃ || 24.52 || dhruvaberasya kaṇṭhāsta muttame cottamaṃ bhaveth | adhame'ntyantu nābhyantaṃ tayormadhyeṣṭadhā bhaveth || 24.53 || ekai magathamāntaṃ ca navadhā mānamucyate | dhvajadaṇḍasya vīśasya ṣaṭśubhāni nirīkṣayeth || 24.54 || yajamānānukūle ca nakṣatre ca viśeṣataḥ | navārdhatālamānaṃ vā navatālamathāpi vā || 24.55 || atibhaṅgaṃ nataṃ caiva bhaṅgatrayasamanvitaṃ | vāmapāde samākuñcya dakṣiṇaṃ saṃprasārya ca || 24.56 || kiñcitsaṃkucitaṃ pīṭhātparṣṇīpārśvaṃ samuddhṛtaṃ | pakṣadvayasamāyuktaṃ karaṇḍamukuṭānvitaṃ || 24.57 || śyāmaṃ śvetaṃ tathā kṛṣṇaṃ raktaṃ pītaṃ tathaiva tu | etaistu pañcabhirvarṇairanurūpaistu śobhanaiḥ || 24.58 || garuḍaṃ prāñjaliṃ kuryātkiñcitkaṃ prekṣayedbudhaḥ | bhūṣaṇairaṣṭanāgaiśca vāmahaste tvanantakaḥ || 24.59 || vāsukiryajña sūtrantu kaṭīsūtrantu takṣakaṃ | hāraṃ karkoṭakaṃ caiva padmaṃ dakṣiṇakarṇake || 24.60 || mahāpadmaṃ vāmakarṇe śaṅkha ca śirasi kramāth | gulikaṃ dakṣiṇe haste kramātsarvavibhūṣaṇaṃ || 24.61 || mūrdhnaścopari kartavyaṃ śvetachatraṃ tu sundaraṃ | pārśvayorubhayoścāpi cāmaradvaya saṃyutaṃ || 24.62 || pādapārśvadvayecaiva dīpadvaya samanvitaṃ | pūrṇakuṃbhaṃ tayormadhye likhitvā tu viśeṣataḥ, || 24.63 || tasyādhasśaṅkhacakre ca samālikhya viśeṣataḥ | muktādāmādyalaṅkṛtya pārśvayoḥ kadalīkṛtaṃ || 24.64 || pūrvasminneva divase kṛtvā nayanamokṣaṇaṃ | devālayasyābhimukhe prapāyāṃ maṇḍapetha vā || 24.65 || pañcavarṇairalaṅkṛtya vitānastaṃbhaveṣṭanaiḥ | śālirāśiṃ ca kṛtvaiva tatpaṭantu susannyaseth || 24.66 || vāstuhomaṃ tataḥkṛtvā paryagnīkaraṇaṃ careth | puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvaiva prokṣayetpañcagavyakaiḥ || 24.67 || aiśānyāmagnikuṇḍe tu cauvāsana vidhānataḥ | āghāraṃ vidhivaddhutvā vaiṣṇavaṃ ca suhūyate || 24.68 || haimapātrasthavarṇena haimatūlyā viśeṣataḥ | tanmantraṃ ca samuccārya nayanonmilanaṃ careth || 24.69 || aṅgahomaṃ tataḥkṛtvā darśanīyaiśca darśayeth | viṣṇusūktaṃ ca hutvātu tathā puruṣasūktakaiḥ || 24.70 || vyāhṛtyaṃntaṃ ca hutvātu tataḥ kuṃbhaṃ pragṛhyaca | tantunā pariveṣṭai va kūrcayuktaṃ sahākṣataṃ || 24.71 || vadanvai viṣṇugāyatrīṃ gāyatrīṃ garuḍasya ca | "iṣe tvorjye'tvādi japan"āpa undantvi'ti kramāth || 24.72 || tataḥ puruṣasūktaṃ ca mantrānapi ca vaiṣmavān | kūrcenaiva tu tattoyamabhimṛśya samāhitaḥ || 24.73 || tadaṃbunā kuśāgreṇa prokṣaṇaiḥ prokṣaṇaṃ careth | apo hiraṇyavarṇābhiḥ pavamānādibhistribhiḥ || 24.74 || "śanno devī'rabhītyuktvā puruṣasūktena vaiṣṇapaiḥ | śuddhyarthaṃ prokṣayitvā tu puṇyāhamapi vācayeth || 24.75 || pariṣicya pāvakaṃ paścāttanmantreṇa suhūyatāṃ | sāyamarcāvasāne tu kuṃbhapūjāṃ samācareth || 24.76 || kalaśaissaptabhiḥ prokṣya baddhvāpratisaraṃ tataḥ | aṇḍajādīni pañcaiva dhānyānyāstīrya vastrayuk || 24.77 || śayane śāyayeccaiva devavāde śirastathā | hautraṃ praśaṃsya tatkāle hotā hautrakrameṇa vai || 24.78 || vainateyasya mantreṇa tanmūrtyāvāhanaṃ careth | mūrtimantraissamāvāhya nirupyājyāhutīryajeth || 24.79 || "śatadhāraṃ kadā'vīti vīśamantramudāhṛtaṃ | tathādvādaśaparyāyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ ca suhūyatāṃ || 24.80 || vyāhṛtyantaṃ ca kṛtvā tu rātriśeṣaṃ vyapohya ca | āgneyyāṃ nyasya bheryāṃ ca nandikeśvaramāhvayeth || 24.81 || punaḥ prabhāte dharmātvāsnātmāsnānavidhānataḥ | muhūrte samanuprāpte hṛdi bījākṣaraṃ nyaseth || 24.82 || kuṃbhācchaktiṃ samāvāhyacār'cayitvā vidhānataḥ | puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvaiva samabhyarca vivedayeth || 24.83 || agniṃ prajvālya tanmantrairjuhuyāddaśaśaḥkramāth | antahomaṃ vācayitvaiva samabhyarcya nivedayeth || 24.84 || upalipya paṭaṃ paścātpañcavarṇairalaṅkṛtaṃ | dhūpadīpairalaṅkṛtya śālipīdhaṃ prakalpayeth || 24.85 || caturaśraṃ samaṃ kṛtvā vistāraṃ caikabhāgakaṃ | śālyardhaṃ taṇḍulaṃ proktaṃ tadardhaṃ tilamāhareth || 24.86 || cakraṃ paścimato nyasya dhānyapīṭhopari sthitaṃ | tasyaivottarataḥ pārśveviṣvaksenaṃ tathaiva ca || 24.87 || dhānyapīṭhe susaṃsthāpya garuḍaṃ paścimāmukhaṃ | nyasya bherīṃ ca pārśve yaṣṭiṃ kaṭāhetu prakṣipedbalimuttamaṃ | mudganiṣpāvatilvāṃśca lājāpūpaupragṛhya ca || 24.94 || kaṭāhe tu susannyasya śiṣyastaṃ śirasā vaheth | abhivandya dhvacaṃ pūrvamādāya samalaṅkṛtaṃ || 24.95 || rathe vā śibikāyāṃ vā mantreṇāropya maṅgalaiḥ | saha puṣpaṃ baliṃ pātre saṃgṛhyānugataṃ punaḥ || 24.96 || cakravīśāmitānpaścānnāthavadgamayettadā | ācāryaḥ purato gatvā sarvavādyasamāyutaṃ || 24.97 || | devebhyo dakṣiṇe paścā drākṣanebhyaśca paścime || 24.103 || nāgebhyaścottare cātha ūrdhvāyāṃ diśi cakramāth | "ye bhūtā'iti mantreṇa pūrvaṃ dadyājjalaṃ punaḥ || 24.104 || puṣpaṃ baliṃ tathādhāvaṃ nagarādau tu gadyaiśca praśaṃsyopāṃśunā budhaḥ | tattanmantraṃ samuccārya ghoṣayetpaṭahādibhiḥ || 24.116 || "priyatāṃ bhagavānviṣṇussarvalokeśvaro hariḥ | brahmeśābhyāṃ ca sahitaścotsave naḥ prasīdatu || 24.117 || devāśca ṛṣayassarve pitaraśca grahādayaḥ | viṣṇulokagatāssarvenānālokanivāsinaḥ || 24.118 || sarvenye devatāssarvāḥ parivāragaṇaissaha | viśve te viṣṇuyāge'rsmi samāgacchantu sādarāḥ || 24.119 || havyaṃ baliṃ samādāya bhuñjantu śubhadāyinaḥ' | ityuktvā ghoṣayetsaṃdhau cakrasyābhimukhe punaḥ || 24.120 || brahmādyānsvasvatālaiśca ghoṣayedvādakaḥ punaḥ | balimevaṃ ca nirvāpya || 24.128 || striyassatbutrakāmā stadaśnīyurbhaktisaṃyutāḥ | āyaṣmantaṃ balārogyavantaṃ dāntaṃ sulakṣaṇaṃ || 24.129 || buddhimantaṃ yaśovantaṃ prasūyeyussutaṃ dhruvaṃ | (tatantu toṣayedvīśaṃ || 24.149 || dhvajasyārohaṇaṃ rātrāvapi kurvanti ke ca na | utsavāraṃbhadivasāttatra ye grāmavāsinaḥ || 24.150 || anyakāryasamāsaktāna gaccheyusthsalāntaraṃ | gaccheyuratha vā tīrthe devānāṃ caiva patnīśca tattatpārśve samarcayeth || 24.161 || skando vighnaśca durgā ca jyeṣṭhā caiva sarasvatī | tadālaye baliṃ dadyātprākāre cottare'pi vā || 24.162 || parivāroktadeśe tu rohiṇyo mātarastathā | ṛṣipatnīśca tāssapta ṛṣibhissaha cār'cayeth || 24.163 || siddhānvidyādharāṃścaiva garuḍagandharvakinnarān | kipūruṣāṃścāraṇāndevānmahādikṣu samarcayeth || 24.164 || bhūtebhyaścātha || 24.166 || utsavārthaṃ viśeṣeṇa saṃbhārānāharettataḥ | rathaṃ ca śibikāṃ caiva yantraḍolādikāṃstathā || 24.167 || kārayitvā ca śilpoktaṃ dīpānanyānpragṛhya ca | bheryādīnyapi vādyāni ca || 25.23 || viṣvaksenaṃ samādāya yānamāropya nāthavath | ācāryaḥ puratogacche "dviṣṇurmā'miti coccaran || 25.24 || cakrasya paścādgaccheyurācāryeṇa samanvitāḥ | ācāryassādhanairyukto diśaṃ gatvā saśiṣyakaḥ | grāmadevālayādārādārāme'tra manorame || 25.29 || nadītaṭākatīre vā sīmāmanatilaṅghya ca | prārdhya bhūdevatāmantrai śśuddhe deśe mṛdaṃ hareth || 25.30 || vīśāmitau ca cakraṃ ca sthāpayetprāṅmukhānbudhaḥ | prāṅmukhaścopalipyaiva vṛttākāraṃ samullikheth || 25.31 || tatra sthānaṃ ca saṃprokṣya "dadhi krāvṇṇa'uccaran | bhūrūpaṃ tu likhitvaiva "bhūmirbhū'mneti ca bruvan || 25.32 || ūrdhvavaktrāṃ ca śayitāmaiśānyāṃ nyastamaulikāṃ | devīṃ mahīṃ tāmabhyarcya prokṣaṇaiḥ prokṣaṇaṃ careth || 25.33 || ekādaśopacāraiśca mūrtimantraissamarcayeth | puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvātu medinyādi samuccaran || 25.34 || khanitre śeṣamabhyarcya vastrādyaissamalaṅkṛte | lalāṭe sarvadoṣaghnaṃ bāhvorbahusukhapradaṃ || 25.35 || stanadvaye vayovṛddhirjaṭhare sarvasaṃpadaḥ | adhobhāge mṛdaṃ tasyā nāhareta kadācana || 25.36 || evaṃ saṃkalpya manasā medinyādi tadā bruvan | "tvāṃ khanā'mīti mantreṇa vārāhaṃ manasā smaran || 25.37 || ubhābhyāñcaiva hastābhyāṃ khanitreṇa khanedbudhaḥ | mahīṃ devīmanujñāpya khanitvā tālamātrakaṃ || 25.38 || apohyaiva ca tatsarvaṃ tadadhasthsāṃ mṛdaṃ hareth | vaiṣṇavaṃ mantramuccārya tatrakāryaṃ samācareth || 25.39 || pātramadhye susannyasya pūrvavacchirasinyaseth | paścāddevīṃ samudvāsya cāpaṭaṃ tatra pūrayeth || 25.40 || śirasā dhārayitvātu purastāccakraśāntayoḥ | grāmaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā devālayamupāvrajeth || 25.41 || pūrvasminnuttare pārśve vāṃkurānarpayettadhā | cakrādīnabhiṣicyaiva havissamyaṅnivedya ca || 25.42 || svesvesthāne tu saṃsthāpya paścādyāgaṃ samārabheth | alayābhimukhe vāpi dakṣiṇe vā manorame || 25.43 || yamapāvakayormadhye pāvakāṃśe'tha vā careth | aiśānyāṃ vātha vā kecitsomeśānāntare tathā || 25.44 || kalpayedyāgaśālāṃ ca pratiṣṭhoktavidhānataḥ | vediṃ tanmadhyame paṅktau vedimānena kārayeth || 25.45 || pratiṣṭhādyardhamānaṃ vā ratnimātrodayaṃ kramāth | pañcāgnīnkalpayeddhīmānutsave cottame tathā || 25.46 || tretāgnīnkalpayedvidvānmadhyame cotsavekramāth | adhamaṃ yadi cetsabhyaṃ kalpayetpūrvavatsudhīḥ || 25.47 || tretāgnikalpanaṃ yatra pradhānaṃ gārhapatyakaṃ | ubhayoranyayossabhyaṃ pradhānaṃ kalpayettathā || 25.48 || bhūmiyajñeva sarvatra śodhayecca yathāvidhi | devaṃ devyau samādāya snānaśvabhre gurūttamaḥ || 25.49 || "paraṃ raṃ'heti mantreṇa sthāpayecca viśeṣataḥ | nityasnānoktamārgeṇa snāpayitvā hariṃ paraṃ || 25.50 || āsthāne viṣṭaraṃ nyasya tadūrdhve vastramāstareth | devaṃ devyau samādāya śvetavastrairvibhūṣya ca || 25.51 || kuṇḍalāṃgadahārādibhūṣaṇairapi bhūṣayeth | śvetamālyairalaṅkṛtya śvetagandhānulepanaiḥ || 25.52 || pavitraṃ cottarīyañca gatvā devaṃ praṇamya ca | rājavaccopacārādīnācareddeśikottamaḥ, || 25.53 || navakubhāropaṇam pūrvoktavidhinā dhīmānnava kuṃbhānpragṛhyaca | "indraṃ naro na'ityuktvātantunā veṣṭayettathā || 25.54 || vedyāmuparipūrvoktadhānyānyāstīrya mantravith | catussūtrairnavapadaṃ kṛtvā kuṃbhāṃśca vinyaseth || 25.55 || kuṃbhānadbhiḥ ppapūryaiva kuśakūrcākṣatādikān | maṅgalānyāyudhaṃ ratnaṃ pratikuṃbhaṃ pṛthakpṛthak || 25.56 || gāyatṣā caiva nikṣivya madhyakuṃbhe viśeṣataḥ | dvyaṅgulena pramāṇena srugādīnyapi pūrvavath || 25.57 || hānakenaiva kṛtvā tu viṣṇusūktena nikṣipeth | āveṣṭya vastrayugmena sarvānapi pṛthakpṛthak || 25.58 || vedyā madhastātpūrvetu vīśaṃ vai paścimāmukhaṃ | sannyasya dakṣiṇe paścāccakraṃ caivottarāmukhaṃ || 25.59 || paṅktīśaṃ prāṅmukhaṃ paścātpaścime cottare'tha vā | dakṣiṇābhimukhaṃ śāntaṃ sthaṇḍilopari sannyaseth || 25.60 || abhāve garuḍādīnāṃ sthāne tatra ca tatra ca | kuṃbhāntsannyasya tanmadhye dhyātvaivāvāhayetkramāth || 25.61 || yāvattīrthāvasānaṃ syāttāvatkuṃbhetu pārṣadān | sāyaṃ prātarviśeṣeṇa pūjayedvidhivatsudhīḥ || 25.62 || paścātsabhyāgnikuṇḍe tu vidhināghāra mācareth | uttarābhimukha stiṣṭhankururvedyāstu dakṣiṇe || 25.63 || prāṇāyāmaṃ tataḥkṛtvā pūrvavaddhyānamācareth | pradhānakuṃbhamadhye tu viṣṇuṃ devyau ca sānvayau || 25.64 || dhruvādāvāhayenmantrī prāgādiṣu yathākramaṃ | puruṣaṃ kapilaṃ satyaṃ yajñamacyutameva ca || 25.65 || nārāyaṇaṃ cāniruddhaṃ tataḥ puṇyaṃ samarcayeth | taṃ rukmavarṇaṃ raktāsyaṃ raktanetraṃ sukhodvahaṃ || 25.66 || kirīṭahārakeyūralaṃbayajñopavītinaṃ | kaustubhodbhāsitoraskaṃ śrīvatsāṃkaṃ caturbhujaṃ || 25.67 || dakṣiṇenaikahastena bhaktānāmabhayapradaṃ | vāmenāpyanyahastena svakaṭyāmavalaṃbitaṃ || 25.68 || parābhyāṃ tu karābhyāṃ tu śaṅkhacakradharaṃ paraṃ | śukapiñchāṃbaradharaṃ viṣṇuṃ praṇavarūpiṇaṃ || 25.69 || taptahāṭakasaṃkāśāṃ padmapatrāyatekṣaṇāṃ | tisṛbhiḥpuṣpacūḍūbhirlalāṭopari śobhitāṃ || 25.70 || sapadmavāmahastāntāṃ kakṣyābaddhaghanastanīṃ | prasāritetarakarāṃ prasannendunibhānanāṃ || 25.71 || śrīvatsāṃkitabījāntāṃ phālgunecottarodbhavāṃ | viṣṇordakṣiṇapārśvasthāṃ haṃsaniryākhyavāhinīṃ || 25.72 || vāmabhāge mahīṃ śyāmāṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāṃ | vaiśākhe revatījātāṃ dadhatīṃ dakṣiṇe'ṃbujaṃ || 25.73 || prasāritetarakarāṃ prasannendunibhānanāṃ | mahācātakamārūḍhāṃ lakṣnīpūrvākṣarānvitāṃ || 25.74 || puruṣaḥ prāṅmukho'cchābhaḥ pītavāsāścaturbhujaḥ | śaṅkhacakradharaśśrīmānsarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ || 25.75 || varado'bhayadaḥ prācyāṃ śrībhūmisahito hariḥ | kapilaḥ prāṅmukho'cchābho raktavastro'ṣṭabāhuyuk || 25.76 || dakṣiṇenaikahasteva bhaktānāmabhayapradaḥ | anyaiścakrāsihalabhṛtsarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ || 25.77 || vāmenāpyanyahastena svakaṭyāmavalaṃbya ca | anyaiśsaṃkhadhanurdaṇḍadharassuṃdara vigrahaḥ || 25.78 || āgneyyāṃ diśi gāyatṣā sāvitṣā ca yuto hariḥ | satyoyāmyamukhaśśrīmānañjanābhaścaturbhujaḥ || 25.79 || śaṅkhacakradharasyoṃyassarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ | varado'bhayadassādhūraktavāsā mahāhanuḥ || 25.80 || devībhyāṃ dhṛtipauṣṇībhyāṃ yuto yāmyadiśi prabhuḥ | yajñaḥ paścimadigvaktrastaptacāmīkaraprabhaḥ || 25.81 || saptahastaścatuśśruṅgo raktavāsā dviśīrṣakaḥ | śaṅkhacakrājyapātrasruksruvānupabhṛtaṃ juhūṃ || 25.82 || bibhrattripādo nairṛtyāṃ devassvāhāsvadhāyutaḥ | acyutaḥ paścimāśāsyaḥ kanakābhaścaturbhujaḥ || 25.83 || śaṅkhacakradharaśśrīmānsarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ | varado'bhayadassākṣī sarvakarmaphalapradaḥ || 25.84 || yuktaḥpavitrīkṣoṇībhyāṃ pratīcyāṃ śyāmalāṃbaraḥ | nārāyaṇaḥ paścimāsyassphaṭikābhaścaturbhujaḥ || 25.85 || śaṅkhacakradharaśśrīmānsarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ | varado'bhayadaśśyāmāṃbaraśśrīvatsacihnitaḥ || 25.86 || saṃyutaḥ kamalelābhyāṃ vāyavyāṃ jagatāṃ patiḥ | aniruddha udīcyāsyaḥ pravālābhaścaturbhujaḥ || 25.87 || anantotsaṃga āsīnaḥ puṣpāṃbaradharo hariḥ | śaṅkhacakradharaśśrīmānsarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ || 25.88 || dadhatsvadakṣiṇe vāme pramodādāyinīṃ mahīṃ | varado'bhayado deva udīcyāṃ sarvasiddhidaḥ || 25.89 || puṇyaḥprāgānanaśśrīmāṃ staruṇādityasannibhaḥ | śrīvatsavakṣā nityaśrīssarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ || 25.90 || caturbhujaśśaṅkhacakravaradābhayacihnitaḥ | śvetavastrottarīyopavītādyaissamalaṅkṛtaḥ || 25.91 || indirādharaṇīnāthariśānyāṃ puṇyapūruṣaḥ | etāndevānsamāvāhya samabhyarcyāṣṭavigrahaiḥ || 25.92 || vīśānasāyipaṅktīśaśāntāndikṣvarcayetkramāth | sāyaṃ prātarvinā kuṃbhairdevaṃ vīśāmitaissaha || 25.93 || vedyāmeva pratiṣṭhāpya pūjayediti ke ca na | hotrapraśaṃsanam hotā paścātpradhānāgnau hautraśaṃsanamācareth || 25.94 || pratiṣṭhoktakrameṇaiva tadālayagatānsurān | avāhya tatkrameṇaiva nirupyājyāhutīryajeth || 25.95 || pariṣicya pāvakaṃ paścādvaiṣṇavaṃ juhuyātkramāth | vedyāntu paścime vātha vāyavyāṃ vā viśeṣataḥ || 25.96 || sthiṇḍilaṃ kalpayitvātra cāstaredaṇḍajādikān | yajamānasamāyukto gururdevaṃ praṇamya ca || 25.97 || kusumāñjali mutsṛjya "pratadviṣṇuṃ'riti bruvan | devībhyāṃ saha deveśamādāya sthaṇḍilopari || 25.98 || prāṅmukhaṃ caiva saṃsthāpya pūjayedaṣṭavigrahaiḥ | utsavapratimābhāve snāpane vā viśeṣataḥ || 25.99 || snapanasyāvyabhāve tu kautuke cācarettu vā | kautuke yadi ceddevyau naivādāya tathā careth || 25.100 || nādarennityavaikalyaṃ visargāvāhane tathā | ācaredutsavaṃ vidvānnityārcāntu yathākramaṃ || 25.101 || kuryāccennityavaikalyaṃ sarvanāśo bhaveddhruvaṃ | snāpayedyadi cedvidvānmadhyame cotsavasya tu || 25.102 || snapane yadi saṃprāpte kautuke snapanaṃ careth | snāpanapratimābhāve snapanaṃ yadi cotsave || 25.103 || saṃprāste snapane cātra kautuke cotsavaṃ vinā | acaredeva sāṃkaryaṃ nācaredubhayorapi || 25.104 || utsave vartamāne tu kautuke snapanaṃ yadi | saṃbhaveduktakāle tu karmaṇī dve samācareth || 25.105 || purāpravṛttakārye tu doṣo nānena saṃbhaveth | kātuke cedyathai kāgnau bahukarmavadācareth || 25.106 || gṛhe tretāgni vannityaṃ praṇīyāropaṇaṃ vinā | snāpanotsavabhede tu kautukena dinaṃ dinaṃ || 25.107 || arohaṇaṃ yadi bhaveddruve tatkarma pūrvataḥ | āvāhya karmamāmante tathā sāye visarjayeth || 25.108 || pātra rāvāhanaṃ nityamarcanādau viśeṣataḥ | visargaṃ sāyamarcānte kautuke tu yathā tathā || 25.109 || tathaivautsavadīkṣānte samāvāhya dhruvātsudhīḥ | visargaṃ nācarenmadhye dīkṣāntetu samācareth || 25.110 || arcanānte viśeṣeṇa puṇyāhamapi vācayeth | hemapātre tu sauvarṇaṃ kautukaṃ taṇḍulopari || 25.111 || sannyasya pūrvavaddhīmānbandhayeddakṣiṇekare | kuṃbhāndevyauca cakrādīnsamābaddhya samarcayeth || 25.112 || pariṣicya pāvakaṃ paścādvaiṣmavaṃ viṣmusūktakaṃ | juhuyātpauruṣaṃ sūktaṃ śrībhūsūkta samanvitaṃ || 25.113 || dinasaṃdhyādhidaivatyaṃ tithivārarkṣadaivataṃ | tathā māsādhidai vatyamabdadai vatyameva ca || 25.114 || tadālayagatānāṃ ca juhuyānmūrtibhiḥ kramāth | vyāhṛtyantaṃ pradhāne syāttata āhavanīyake || 25.115 || nṛsūktaṃ dakṣiṇāgnau ca vaiṣṇavaṃ tathā || 25.116 || avasathye mahīsūktamekākṣaramato yajeth | juhuyātpaiṇḍarīkāgnā "vato devādi' vaiṣṇavaṃ || 25.117 || viṣṇusūktaṃ puruṣasūktaṃ "yaddevādi'samanvitaṃ | pāramātmika mantrāṃśca brāhmamaindraṃ ca vāruṇaṃ || 25.118 || juhuyādviṣṇugāyatṣā śvetābjaṃ ca ghṛtāplutaṃ | aṣṭottaraśataṃ caiva sarvadoṣopaśāntaye || 25.119 || ekāgnimatha vādhāya juhuyādadhamādhamaṃ | sabhya homaṃ ca pūrvoktaṃ vaiṣṇavādi vidhānataḥ || 25.120 || athotsavādhidaivatyaṃ viśeṣeṇa pravakṣyate | brāhmamārṣaṃ tathā raudramaindraṃ soṃyaṃ ca vaiṣmavaṃ || 25.121 || sarvadaivatyayāmye ca vāruṇaṃ ca navāhnike | āgneyaṃ prājāpatyaṃ ca kauberaṃ vaighnameva ca || 25.122 || śrīdaivatyaṃ ca koṃāramādityaṃ raudrameva ca | daurgamaindraṃ tathā yāmyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ skāngameva car || 25.123 || iśānyaṃ soṃyamityetattithidaivatyamucyate | tattaddvāre tu juhuyānmatrairdvārādhipocitaiḥ || 25.124 || tathā nakṣatradaivatyaṃ juhuyādvidhinā budhaḥ | trisaṃdhiṣu hunedaindraṃ sauraṃ bārhaspataṃ kramāth || 25.125 || māsarkṣādhipadaivatyaṃ māsadaivatyamucyate | yāmyaṃ ca vaiṣṇavaṃ soṃyaṃ brāhmaṃ bārhaspataṃ tathā || 25.126 || soṃyamaindraṃ vāruṇaṃ ca śeṣāgnyādityabhautikaṃ | mārutaṃ bhṛgudaivatyaṃ vāruṇaṃ vaighnameva ca || 25.127 || raudraṃ kauberakaṃ tvāṣṭraṃ maitraṃ koṃārameva ca | sāvitrīṃ śrīdaivatyaṃ caiva gaurīdaivatyameva ca || 25.128 || ādityaṃ paitṛkaṃ caivāditi daivatyameva ca | yogadaivatyametatkyājjuhuyādvidhinā budhaḥ || 25.129 || aindraṃ ca prājāpatyaṃ ca maitramāryamaṇaṃ tathā | bhūta śrīyāmyadaivatyaṃ bhārgavaṃ vṛṣadaivataṃ || 25.130 || kauberaṃ vāyudaivatyaṃ juhuyātkaraṇeṣu vai | devebhyaḥ pitṛbhyaśceti pakṣayośśuklakṛṣṇayoḥ || 25.131 || sauraṃ cāndraṃ ca juhuyātkramādayanayordvayoḥ | "madhuśca mādhava'śceti juhuyādṛtuṣu kramāth || 25.132 || viṣṇuḥ prajāpatiśśūlī vighneśassapta carṣayaḥ | aṣṭau lokādhipāḥ pañca bhūtā viśvaṃbharādayaḥ || 25.133 || vasavo'ṣṭau ca rohiṇyassapta śrīścaṇḍikā guhaḥ | sūryassomaścirañjīvī kāśīvīśapurardarāḥ || 25.134 || cakraśśānto gururbhoṃabudhaśukraśanaiścarāḥ | haviḥpālo hyanastaśca gaṅgā jyeṣṭhā ca mātaraḥ || 25.135 || prabhavādi kramādete vijñeyā vatsarādhipāḥ | tathotsavādhidaivatyaṃ tithivārarkṣadaivataṃ || 25.136 || caturdaivatyamātrantu juhuyāditi ke ca na | palāśabilvaśāmīlanya grothoduṃbarāstathā || 25.137 || aśvaddhakhadirapla kṣabrahmavṛkṣāḥ kramādime | samidhāṃ grāhya vṛkṣāntu parṇamaśvadthameva vā || 25.138 || padmaṃ ca bilvapatraṃ ca karavīraṃ kumudaṃ tathā | nandyāvartaṃ ca tulasī tathaiva sthalapaṅkajaṃ || 25.139 || viṣṇukrāntāravinde tu puṣpāṇyetānyanukramāth | alābhe tulasīṃ vātha karavīraṃ ca paṅkajaṃ || 25.140 || mudgaṃ niṣpāvakaṃ caiva kuluddhaṃ māṣayeva ca | tilānapūpānlājāṃśca yavānsaktūnyathākramaṃ || 25.141 || balidravyāṇi coktāni sarvābhāve tu maudgikaṃ | evameva vidhānena dvikālaṃ homamācareth || 25.142 || prātassaṃdhyāvasānetu sāyamarcāvasānake | homaṃ kṛtvā baliṃ dadyāddvikālaṃ cotsavaṃ careth || 25.143 || utsavabhramaṇaṃ vakṣye devadevasya śārṅgiṇaḥ | balinirvāpaṇānte tu sāyaṃ prātarviśeṣataḥ || 25.144 || devadevamalaṅkṛtya vastrādyairbhūṣaṇaiśśubhaiḥ | sugandhipuṣpamālābhirgandhairapi manoharaiḥ || 25.145 || rathe vā śibikāyāṃ vā vīśaskandhe'pi vā tathā | gajāśvāṃdolikādau vā vāhane
