samalaṅkṛte || 25.146 || "ahameveda'mantreṇa devamāropya niścalaṃ | aṣṭopacārairabhyarcya lājāpūpādikāṃstathā || 25.147 || saṃkkṛtānguḍasaṃmiśrānnivedya mukhavāsakaṃ | datvā vādyaissamāyuktaṃ sarvālaṅkārasaṃyutaṃ || 25.148 || dāsībhirvādakaiśyaiva nṛttageyasamanvitaiḥ | brāhmaṇairvedavidbhiśca samāyuktaṃ śanaiśsanaiḥ || 25.149 || dhvajaiścatrairātapatraistoraṇaiśca tathaiva ca | saṃbhṛtaiḥ saṃyutaṃ cānyaissarvaiśśṛṅgāralakṣmabhiḥ || 25.150 || vālavyajanahastābhirdāsībhiḥ pārśvayordvayoḥ | vījyamānaṃ viśeṣeṇa tathā bhaktavarairapi || 25.151 || vāhaye yurdvijā devaṃ brāhmaṇā vedapāragāḥ | dīpairudagrairbahubhiḥ pariṣiktairghṛtādinā || 25.152 || parassahasraissarvatra dīpayecca śatāvaraiḥ | vipraistrayīmadhīyānairjapastutiparāyaṇaiḥ || 25.153 || nṛtyatā gāyatā māpi gāṇikyena susevitaṃ | vīṇādivādibhiścaiva vandibhiśca tathā paraiḥ || 25.154 || ṣaḍjādigītanipuṇairvādyavādakakovidaiḥ | gadyaṃ padyaṃ tathā miśraṃ pathadbhistsotramujjvalaṃ || 25.155 || vai taṇḍikaistathā jalpairnipuṇairvādaśikṣitaiḥ | tathā tattvakathāniṣṭhaiḥ padārdhajñaiśca tārkikaiḥ || 25.156 || mīmāṃsakairyājñikaiśca chāndasaissāṃkhyakovidaiḥ | yogajñaiśca purāṇajñaiśśābdikaistattvavedibhiḥ || 25.157 || mauhūrtikaiśca gaṇaśaḥparasparajīgīṣubhiḥ | tattacchāstrokamārgeṇa prameyaṃ ca bahusthitaṃ || 25.158 || uccairbruvāṇairvidvadbhiḥ pañcakālaparāyaṇaiḥ | vāsudevasya māhātmyaṃ kathayadbhiścasāttvikaiḥ || 25.159 || śāstreṣu naipuṇaṃ sarvaṃ pradarśayitumudyataiḥ | devasya purataḥpṛṣṭhe pārśvataścasthitairjanaiḥ || 25.160 || senayā sarvato dikṣu caturaṅgabalāḍhyayā | devasya pārśvayoḥ pūrde lākṣārañjitamaskaraiḥ || 25.161 || yatrairdārumayaiścitraiḥ pakṣyākārairitastataḥ | devatākṛtiyantraiśca tathā yantrairgajādibhiḥ || 25.162 || niṣādibhissamārūḍhaisstrībhiśca bharatoditaiḥ | mārgairbahuvidhairnṛttaṃ darśayantībhiradbhutaṃ || 25.163 || lekhāyantraistsriyārūḍhairyantrairanyaistathā vithaiḥ | gatāgatāni kurvāṇairanuyātaṃ samākulaiḥ || 25.164 || śanairnayejjagannāthaṃ yathāśakti samanvitaiḥ | ārabhyāvaraṇādādyādeṣā parivṛtirbhaveth || 25.165 || devena sārthamācāryo yānamāruhya tatra tu | rakṣārthaṃ devadevasya dhyāyannupaviśeddhariṃ || 25.166 || arcakaśca tathāsīnassamyagarcanamācareth | ārohaṇe gajendrasya devadevaṃ viśeṣataḥ || 25.167 || vastrābharaṇapuṣbādyairalaṅkṛtya yathārhakaṃ | deveśaṃ pūrvamāropya hastenādāyacāṃkuśaṃ || 25.168 || niṣīdedgajapṛṣṭhe tu deśikassvayamatvaraḥ | arcakaśchatramādāya tathā devasya dhārayeth || 25.169 || toyadhārāṃ puraskṛtya kuryādbhramaṇamācarāth | grāmaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kuryādbaliryena padhā kṛtaḥ || 25.170 || tatkāle devamāyāntaṃ bhaktā bhāgavatā janāḥ | spagṛhaprāṃgaṇe caiva pratyudthāya punaḥpunaḥ || 25.171 || praṇamya copahārāṃśca dadyurbahuvidhānbahūn | patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ pūgaṃ nāgavallīdalānyapi || 25.172 || dakṣiṇāṃ ca viśeṣeṇa yathāśakti yathāruci | nīrājanādi kuryuśca bālavṛddhāturāstadā || 25.173 || tapobhirbahubhirgamye svayameva parātpare | bhaktānukaṃpayā deve spagṛhadvāramāgate || 25.174 || ko na nandati mūḍhātmā tasya kā niṣkṛtirbhaveth | tatkāle cārpitaṃ dravyaṃ yadapakvaṃ pragṛhya ca || 25.175 || āmantraṃ tu nivedyaiva bhagavatpriyamācareth | upahāreṣu tatrārdhaṃ gṛhṇīyādbhāgamarcakaḥ || 25.176 || nāgavallīdalaṃ puṣpaṃ kramukaṃ dakṣiṇādikaṃ | sarvamarcakasarvasvaṃ gṛhṇīyādarcakassvayaṃ || 25.177 || tatkāle bhaktinamrebhyassaṃprāptebhyaśca sannidhiṃ | bhagadatpādukāṃ dadyācchirasi śraddhayā guruḥ || 25.178 || śirasā dhāraṇe martyaisspṛṣṭidoṣo na vidyate | na nayetpādukāṃ viṣṇordūrīkṛtya tu sannidhiṃ || 25.179 || na gṛhadvārasīmāntaṃ nayettāṃ gṛhiṇāṃ guruḥ | iṣṭaṃ rājagṛhe strībhiḥ pādukādhāraṇaṃ yadi || 25.180 || dehalīmanatikramya neyāttāṃ dīpikānvitāṃ | tadā dīpaistathānyaiśca rājārhaiśca paricchadaiḥ || 25.181 || neyā syātpādukā viṣṇoḥ praṇidhissā yato hareḥ | tassannidhimatikramya pūjakastu na jātu cith || 25.182 || ādānāyopahārāṇāṃ prayāyādgṛhiṇāṃ gṛhān | nāpi kāryāntarāsaktaḥ pañcahastānati krameth || 25.183 || eṣa śreṣṭhopacārassyādyatassammānyate hariḥ | evaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ nītvā nivartetālayaṃ prati || 25.184 || gopurāgretu deveśaṃ kṛtvā devonmukhaṃ kramāth | arghyapādyādinābhyarcya nivedya pṛthukādikaṃ || 25.185 || dhāmapradakṣiṇaṃ nītvā punarāviśya cālayaṃ | avaropya ca deveśaṃ sthāpya cāsthānamaṇḍape || 25.186 || pādyamācamanaṃ datvā mukhavāsaṃ pradāya ca | kautukaṃ tu visṛjyaiva śuddhodaissnāpayetprabhuṃ || 25.187 || vimṛjya plotavastreṇa samalaṅkṛtya pūrvavath | kautukaṃ punarābaddhya haviḥpaścānnivedayeth || 25.188 || kuryādrājopacārāṇi sa hi rājā jagatprabhuḥ | vinodaṃ kārayeccaiva nṛttagītādibhirbahu || 25.189 || tataḥ praṇamya deveśaṃ pūrvasthāne niveśayeth | prathame'hani sāyetu kartavyamidamīritaṃ || 25.190 || dvitīyāhaḥprabhṛtyeva sāyaṃ prātaśca nityaśaḥ | nityārcanānte dviguṇamarcayecca nivedayeth || 25.191 || kuṃbhadevānsamārādhya dhvajadevārcanaṃ careth | homaṃ baliṃ ca datvātu kārayedutsavaṃ tathā || 25.192 || tṛtīye pañcaye'vāhni prātassyādgaruḍotsavaḥ | ṣaṣṭhe'hani tu madhyāhne devībhyāṃ sahitaṃ hariṃ || 25.193 || pīṭhamadhye samāropya samabhyarcyāṣṭavigrahaiḥ | jalakuṅkumamādāya kārayedutsavaṃ tathā || 25.194 || navavastrādikaṃ datvā pṛthukāni nivedya ca | datvā tāṃbūlamācāmamarcayedrājavatprabhuṃ || 25.195 || saptame prātararcānte kuryātsaptarṣipūjanaṃ | vṛṇuyādṛtvijassaptatadācāryapurassarān || 25.196 || dhyātvā saptarṣivattāṃstu svarṇaṃ gāmājyameva ca | taṇḍulodakakuṃbhādīndūrvāgraṃ kramukaṃ tathā || 25.197 || dadyātprabhūtaṃ tebhyantu brāhmaṇebhyaḥ pṛthakpṛthak | tatsāyaṃ ca viśeṣeṇa kṛṣṇagandhānulepanaṃ || 25.198 || sadyaḥ pratisaraṃ baddhvā devāgre sthaṇḍilaṃ careth | kṛṣṇāguru samādāya sarvavādyasamāyutaṃ || 25.199 || grāmaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā sthaṇḍilopari vinyaseth | puṇyāhaṃ vidhivatkṛtvā śriyamāvāhya tatra ca || 25.200 || saṃskṛtya vidhivadgandhānsamabhyarcya hariṃ tataḥ | "gandhadvāre'ti mantreṇa sarvāṅgaṃ lepayedguruḥ || 25.201 || devyādīnāṃ tathā kuryāttattanmantrairyathāvidhi | taccheṣagandhaṃ bhaktyaiva bhaktebhyo dāpayedguruḥ || 25.202 || tadgandhadhāraṇānnṝṇāṃ bhadeyussarvasaṃpadaḥ | sāyamarcāvasāne tu rathayātrāṃ samācareth || 25.203 || aṣṭame divase prāpte samāpte prātarutsave | alaṅkṛtya tu deveśaṃ mṛgayotsavamācareth || 25.204 || madhyāhne devadevasya jalakrīḍotsavaṃ careth | prapāṃ kṛtvā vidhānena nadyādīnāṃ taṭe budhaḥ || 25.205 || vitānādyairalaṅkṛtya jalakrīḍārthamaṇṭapaṃ | biṃbādhyardhāyatāmardhavistārāṃ biṃbadaghnikāṃ || 25.206 || jaladroṇīmathācchidrāṃ nyasya lohamayīṃ ghanāṃ | nādeyādbhissamāpūrva "dhārāsvi'ti ca mantrataḥ || 25.207 || elācandanakarbūraiḥ kuṅkumenādhivāsayeth | kalhāraketakīpuṣpairuśīrāgurubhistathā || 25.208 || āstīrya navavastrāṇi "vedāha'miti mantrataḥ | "puṇyatīrthaṃ śivaṃ puṇyaṃ devāvāsa'miti bruvan || 25.209 || adhidevaṃ samāvāhya vigrahairaṣṭabhiryajeth | maṇḍape paścimārdhe tu viṣṭare sottarachade || 25.210 || devadevaṃ samāsthāpya śakunasūktaṃ samuccaran | navavastrottarīyādyairalaṅkṛtya manoharaṃ || 25.211 || pādyādibhissamabhyarcya sthāpagaissahito guruḥ | "bhūḥ prapadye'ti mantreṇa devadevaṃ praṇamya ca || 25.212 || "paraṃ raṃhe'ti mantreṇa devamādāyacādarāth | "pratadviṣṇustsavata'iti jaladroṇyāṃ niveśya ca || 25.213 || indrādī śca jayādīśca taṇḍulaiḥkjptamaṇḍale | samāvāhya samabhyarcyejjaladroṇyabhito guruḥ || 25.214 || "apo hi ṣṭhā'di mantrāṃ strīnanuvākāntsamuccaran | "idamāpaśśi'vetyuktvā "āpo vā ida'muccaran || 25.215 || abhimantṣa jaladroṇyāṃ devadevaṃ praṇamya ca | pauruṣaṃ sūktamuccārya viṣṇusūktaṃ ca vaiṣṇavaṃ || 25.216 || "iṣe tvorje'tvādi japan"bhūrānilaya' ityapi | maṅjayitvā jaladroṇyāṃ devaṃ prākchirasaṃ hariṃ || 25.217 || adhivāsyatu yāmārdhaṃ yāmadvayamathāpi vā | "paraṃ raṃ'heti mantreṇa tata uddhṛtyavai punaḥ || 25.218 || alaṅkṛtya ca vastrādyairyathārhaṃ paripūjya ca | yānamāropya deveśaṃ grāmamālayameva vā || 25.219 || pradakṣiṇaṃ kramānnītvā sarvālaṅkālasaṃyutaṃ | grāmavīthyāmupahṛtamupahālamagṛhya ca || 25.220 || punarālayamāviśya saṃsthāpyāsthānamaṇḍape | sugandhitailenābhyajya devaṃ saṃsnāpya pūrvavath || 25.221 || jīvasthāne samāsthāpya samabhyarcya nivedayeth | tadrātrāvutsavāntetu devaṃ devīyutaṃ hariṃ || 25.222 || pratiṣṭhoktavidhānena baddhvā pratisaraṃ tataḥ | adhivāsavidhānena śayane śāyayedguruḥ || 25.223 || prabhāte devasutthāpya pādyādyarghyāntamarcayeth | tasmintīrthadine prātarhemādyaṃ prātarutsavaṃ || 25.224 || kṛtvā havirvinā devamabhyarcyāsthānamaṇḍape | pramukhe garuḍaṃ paścāddakṣiṇe cakrameva ca || 25.225 || amitaṃ cottaredhīmāndhānyapīṭhopari nyaseth | nityapūjāṃ havirdānaṃ dhruvabere samācareth || 25.226 || pūrvālaṅkṛtavastrādīnvisṛjyaiva prayatnataḥ | anyavastrāṇicācchādya yathārhaṃ bhūṣya bhūṣaṇaiḥ || 25.227 || aṣṭopacārairabhyarcya devaṃ cakrādidevatāḥ | vrīhibhisthsaṃḍilaṃ kṛtvā dvihastāyatavistṛtaṃ || 25.228 || ulūkhalaṃ ca musalaṃ sthāpya vastreṇa saṃyutaṃ | tayorīśau krameṇaiva brahyeśāvarcayedbudhaḥ || 25.229 || pātre haridrāṃ saṃgṛhya sinīvālīmathār'cya ca | ulūkhale haridrāṃ ca tanmantreṇa vinikṣipeth || 25.230 || gṛhītvā vaiṣṇavairmantrairācāryo musalaṃ tathā | viṣṇusūktaṃ samuccārya kiñcittadavaghātayeth || 25.231 || bhaktairvā devadāsībhiścūrṇīkṛtya viśeṣataḥ | ekasminvādvayorvātha triṣu vā kalaśeṣuvai || 25.232 || gandhoṣitaṃ ca vādailamāḍhakaṃ parigṛhyaca | pidhāya ca pidhānaiśca sthaṇḍilopari vinyaseth || 25.233 || ācchādya navavastreṇa somaṃ taile samarcayeth | sinīvālīṃ ca taccūrṇe cakrādīṃśca prapūjayeth || 25.234 || devamabhyarcya puṇyāhaṃ vācayanvaiṣṇavaṃ guruḥ | saṃsrāvya mūrthni tattailaṃ "vedāha'miti mantrataḥ || 25.235 || hāridracūrṇaissaṃsnāpya cakrādīnsnāpayettataḥ | tacchiṣṭaṃ dhārayanbhaktassarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 25.236 || atha yāne samāropya devaṃ cakrādibhissaha | cūrṇotsavamimaṃ kṛtvā tīrthotsavamathācareth || 25.237 || devakhātaṃ yadi phavettīrthaṃ tatra praśasyate | nadyāditīre saṃsthāpya devībhyāṃ saha vā vinā || 25.238 || cakrādīnpūrvavatsthāpya pramukhe sthaṇḍilaṃ careth | dravyeṇāpūrva kalaśāngāyatrīmantramuccaran || 25.239 || madhye siddhārthakaṃ nyasya prācyāṃ syādakṣatodakaṃ | dakṣiṇe gandhatoyaṃ syātpaścime tu kuśodakaṃ || 25.240 || japyodakaṃ cottare syādvidiśāsu ca madhyataḥ | upasnānāni vinyasya kramāttadadhipānguruḥ || 25.241 || ādityānapsarasaśca kāśyapaṃ ca guruṃ tathā | ṛtūṃśca marutaścaiva munīṃ stakṣakameva ca || 25.242 || mantrānvidyādharāṃścaiva krameṇāvāhyacārcayeth | "pūtasta'syeti mantreṇa "imā oṣadhaya'ityapi || 25.243 || "abhi tvā śūra'"catvāri'"pūtastanye'ticakramāth | kalaśaiḥ pañcabhissnāpyatattaddravyāntare kramāth || 25.244 || "vārīścatasra'ityuktvā copasnānaṃ samācareth | śiṣṭābhiḥ kalaśādbhiśca cakrādhīnabhiṣicya ca || 25.245 || praviśya tu jalaṃ tatra varuṇaṃ cārcayetkramāth | hastābhyāṃ cakramādāya devaṃ bhaktaissamanvitaḥ || 25.246 || ācāryaḥ prathamaṃ tīrthe cakraṃ ssṛṣṭyāvagāhayeth | nābhidaghnajale tatra jalamadhye tu susthitaḥ || 25.247 || cakraṃ devaṃ hṛdi sthāpya hastābhyāṃ dhārayandṛḍhaṃ | "ye te śataṃ' samuccārya prāṅmukho vāpyudaṅmukhaḥ || 25.248 || nimajjayettadā cakraṃ sarvavādyayutaṃ guruḥ | janāssarve ca tattīrthe snātvā vigatakalmaṣāḥ || 25.249 || bhaveyuraśvamedhasya phalaṃ ca samavāpnuyuḥ | tatastīre pratiṣṭhāpya viṣṭare cakramuttame || 25.250 || kuryādavabhṛthasnānaṃ śuddhasnānoktamārgataḥ | tato visṛjya vastrādīndevaṃ cānyairvibhūṣya ca || 25.251 || tatraiva nasasnāṃbhārānsaṃbhṛtya vidhinā guruḥ | devībhyāṃ saha deveśaṃ snāpayetpūrvavatprabhuṃ || 25.252 || alaṅkṛtya viśeṣeṇa kuryādarghyāntapūjanaṃ | paścāddevaṃ samādāya sarvālaṅkārasaṃyutaṃ || 25.253 || śākunaṃ sūktamuccārya nītvā grāmaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ | devālayaṃ praviśyāthasthāpya cāsthānamaṇḍape || 25.254 || pādyādibhissamabhyarcya vedānadhyāpayetkramāth | muhuḥpuṣpāṃjaliṃ datvājīvasthāne niveśayeth || 25.255 || cakrādīnapi cādāya tattatthsāne niveśya ca | puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvātu prokṣaṇeḥ prokṣaṇaṃ careth || 25.256 || nityapūjaṃ samāpyaiva havirdadyādviśeṣataḥ | yāgaśālāṃ samāsādya hutvāgniṣu ca vaiṣṇavaṃ || 25.257 || kuṃbhasthāṃ śaktimādāya dhruvabere'varopayeth | antahomaṃ ca hutvāgniṃ nityakuṇḍepraṇīya ca || 25.258 || tadrātrau nityahomānte baliṃ datvā ca pūrvavath | paścāccakraṃ vinā dadyādbaliṃ śuddhānna kalpitaṃ || 25.259 || pūrvoktenaiva mārgeṇa sarvatra balimācareth | caityasthāne prapāyāṃ tu utyāne vṛkṣamūlake || 25.260 || taṭāke nirjhare kūpavāpīvalmīkapārśvake | śmaśāne'nyatra devāgre vīthyanteṣu ca nikṣipaseth || 25.261 || punarālayamāviśya snātvā cāpyagnisannidhau | dhvajamūlaṃ samāsādya sarvavādya samāyutaṃ || 25.262 || dhvacāvarohaṇaṃ kuryāddhvajamatraṃ samuccaran | taddhvajaṃ tu samādāya prādakṣiṇyakrameṇa vai || 25.263 || parītya mandiraṃ paścātpraviśyābhyantaraṃ punaḥ | devasya pādamūle tu nyasya puṣpāñjaliṃ dadeth || 25.264 || kṣamāmantraṃ samuccārya daṇḍavatpraṇamedbhuvi | phalaśrutiḥ evaṃ yaḥ kurute bhaktvā viṣṇorutsavamādarāth || 25.265 || sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā sarvānkāmānavāpya ca | ante vimānamāruhya viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati || 25.266 || puṣpayāgaḥ ataḥparaṃ pravakṣyāmi puṣpayāgaṃ sukhāvahaṃ | dvitīyadivase tīrthātpuṣpayāgaṃ samācareth || 25.267 || śāntidaṃ puṣṭidaṃ ceti kāmyadaṃ ca tridhā bhaveth | prātarmadhyāhnāparāhṇāḥ kramātkālāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || 25.268 || nyūnaṃ vāpyadhikaṃ caitaddoṣopaśamanāya vai | āsthānamaṇḍape vātha snapanālaya eva vā || 25.269 || caturdiśaṃ caturhastaṃ gopayenopalipya ca | pañcaviṃśatpadaṃ kṛtvā ṣaṭsūtraiḥ prāgudgagataiḥ || 25.270 || madhye nanapade padmaṃ sāṣṭapatraṃ sakarṇikaṃ | ratnadhānyādikairvāpi taṇḍulairvrīhibhistilaiḥ || 25.271 || bahisteṣu padeṣvagre vīśamekatra pūjayeth | dakṣiṇe cakramabhyarcya paṅktīśaṃ paścime tathā || 25.272 || udīcyāṃ śāntamabhyarcya śeṣeṣu ca padeṣu vai | pūjādravyāṇi saṃbhṛtya pratyekaṃ vinyasedbudhaḥ || 25.273 || daleṣvaṣṭasu padmasya suvarṇaśakalopari | lokapālāntsamabhyarcya vastropari yathādiśaṃ || 25.274 || niṣkatrayasuvarṇeva kalpite karṇikopari | ādityamaṇḍalaṃ tatra rājate candramaṇḍalaṃ || 25.275 || tasminsuvarṇarūpe tu vahni maṇḍalamarcayeth | viṣṭaraṃ tatra saṃsthāpya tadantargatapaṅkaje || 25.276 || tatra devaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya yāvaddivasamutsavaṃ | tāvatkṛtvassamabhyarchya saptaviṃśativigrahaiḥ || 25.277 || tatra pūjāvasānetu tattatpuṣpāñjaliṃ dadeth | paṅkajaṃ tulasī bilvaṃ karavīramathotpalaṃ || 25.278 || nandyāvartaṃ ca kumudamapāmārgaṃ tathaiva ca | viṣṇukrāntaṃ ca dūrvāṃ cakramādetānyanukramāth || 25.279 || evaṃ puṣpājaliṃ datvā ṛtvijassahatairguruḥ | nṛttairgeyaiścavādyaiśca caturvedastavairapi || 25.280 || parātparataraṃ pāraṃ guhyādguhyataraṃ guruṃ | sarvavedārthasāraṃ taṃ dvādaśāṣyākṣaraṃ tathā || 25.281 || japanto viṣṇugāyatrīṃ śatamaṣṭottaraṃ tataḥ | dadyuḥ puṣpāñjali bhaktyā devadevasya pādayoḥ || 25.282 || pañcāgniṣvatha vāgnīṃstrīnpaiṇḍarīkamathāpi vā | devasya paritaḥ kuryāduttamādikrame kramāth || 25.283 || uttame sabhyakuṇḍe tu madhye tvāhavanīyake | hautrapraśaṃsanaṃ kuryāttadālayagatāntsurān || 25.284 || āvāhyājyaṃ nirūpyaiva tatkrameṇāhutīryajeth | vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktaṃ ca samyagghutvā viśeṣata || 25.285 || tataścāhavanīyāgnau nṛsūktaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ yajeth | dakṣiṇāgnau viṣṇusūktaṃ śrīsūktaṃ ca yajetkramāth || 25.286 || juhuyādgārhapatyāgnau gāyatrīṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ(vaṃ)tataḥ | āvasaddhye tu juhuyātsūktamekākṣarādikaṃ || 25.287 || ājyena samidhā tattaddhavirbhedaiśca hūyatāṃ | etaduttamamuddiṣṭaṃ madhyamaṃ tu pravakṣyate || 25.288 || yathālābhapramāṇena pūrvoktārdhena vā hareḥ | padmamaṇḍaladevānāṃ kārayetpratimādikaṃ || 25.289 || tattaddinārcanānte tu śuddhānnaṃ vā nivedya ca | sarvārcānte pañcahavirdadyādityāha pūrvajaḥ || 25.290 || caturvedādighoṣaṃ ca caturdikṣu prakalpayeth | abjahomaṃ krameṇaiva juhuyānmantra vittamaḥ || 25.291 || puṣpanyāsakrameṇaiva sarvavidyeśvarāntakaṃ | abhyarcya prathamaṃ paścātpaṣpayāgokta pūjanaṃ || 25.292 || kṛtvā yathālābhahavirbhakṣyāṇi vividhāni ca | nivedya mukhavāsānte parivārabaliṃ kṣipeth || 25.293 || ityevaṃ madhyame proktaṃ pravakṣyāmyadhame punaḥ | vinā diśādibhirbhedairhemaiśca pṛthagarcanaiḥ || 25.294 || maṇḍale devamāropya pūjayitvā yadhāvidhi | havīṃṣi pañca coktāni nivedya ca tataḥ paraṃ || 25.295 || dadyātpuṣpāṃjaliṃ mantraissamastadivasoditaiḥ | jānvantaṃ ca tathorvantaṃ kaṭyantaṃ ca samarcayeth || 25.296 || nābhyantaṃ ca stanāntaṃ ca bāhyastamiti cakramāth | grīvāntaṃ ca lalāṭāntaṃ maulyastamiti cakramāth || 25.297 || tattatpūjāvasānetu havissamyaṅni vedayeth | utsavājñātadoṣāṇāṃ prāyaścittamidaṃ smṛtaṃ || 25.298 || atassarvaprayatnena puṣpayāgaṃ samācareth | dvādaśārādhanam kuryādyathoktavidhinā dvādaśārādhanaṃ tathā || 25.299 || dadyādācāryapūrvebhyo dakṣiṇāṃ vidhivattataḥ | ekaviṃśatiniṣkantu dadyādācāryadakṣiṇāṃ || 25.300 || padārthināṃ ca sarveṣāṃ tadardhaṃ syātpṛthakpṛthak | gobhūmibhyāṃ viśeṣeṇa datvācāryaṃ prasādayeth || 25.301 || ācāryassuprasannātmā sarvāgniṣu yathākramaṃ | antahomaṃ samāpyaiva devadevaṃ praṇamya ca || 25.302 || jīvasthāne pratiṣṭhāpya deveśaṃ samyagarcayeth | brāhmaṇānbhojayeccaiva pradadyādbhūridakṣiṇāṃ || 25.303 || puṣpayāgotsavaḥ prokto devadevasya śārṅgiṇaḥ | śāntikādividhāne tu kuryādaṅkurapūrvakaṃ || 25.304 || evaṃ yaḥkurute bhaktyāpuṣbayāgaṃ hareḥ priyaṃ | sarvānkāmānavāpyaiva sarvaiśvaryamavāpya ca || 25.305 || sarvānśatrūnvijitvaiva prajāpaśusamanvitaḥ | ante vimānamāruhya viṣṇusāyujyamāpnuyāth || 25.306 || iti śrīvaikhānase bhagavacchāstre bhṛguproktāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prakīrṇādhikāre pañcaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ <26> atha ṣaḍviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ prāyaścittam ataḥparaṃ pravakṣyāmi bhūparīkṣādiniṣkṛtiṃ | nyūne'tirikte vyāghāte prāyaścittaṃ samācareth || 26.1 || prāyodoṣassamuddiṣṭaścittaṃ tasya nivāraṇaṃ | prāyaścittaṃ samākhyātaṃ kuryātkarmasamṛddhaye || 26.2 || prāyaścittamakurvāṇassati doṣe vinaśyati | tasmātsarmaprayatnena kuryādyatnena niṣkṛtiṃ || 26.3 || ālayasya ca nirmāṇaṃ pūjādyāstatra yāḥkriyāḥ | asmācchāstrādatikramya niṣphalāḥprabhavantihi || 26.4 || taddoṣaśamanāyaiva mahāśāntipurassaraṃ | sarvāḥkriyāḥkrameṇaiva punaśśāstroktavaccareth || 26.5 || yacchāstravidhimutsṛjya kriyate kāmakārataḥ | noktaṃ dadyātphalaṃ karma pratyutānarthadaṃ bhaveth || 26.6 || śilpaṃ ca jyotiṣaṃ vāstu tada'nye cāgamāḥ pare | tāvatā hi pramāṇaṃ syādyāvadetena nāntaraṃ || 26.7 || vaikhānasamidaṃ śāstra manyaśāstrānapekṣitaṃ | praṇivāyābjajaḥ pūrvaṃ sarvaśāstrārthasaṃgrahaṃ || 26.8 || mohādajñānato vāpi vicikitsāpadeṣu yaḥ | śāstrānta rānurodhena śāstrametadvimānayeth || 26.9 || sa yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ yāvadābhūtasaṃplavaṃ | tasmānniṣkāsya taṃ mūḍhaṃ śāstroktaṃ samyagācareth || 26.10 || yadāgacchedbahirdvāraṃ bhūmiṃ samyakparīkṣituṃ | apatedantarāyaścetprāyaścittaṃ hunedbudhaḥ || 26.11 || japecca vaiṣṇavaṃ vaighnaṃ śataśaḥ punarācareth | durdarśane japetsauraṃ hunetpūrvoktavadbudhaḥ || 26.12 || durvākye tu śrute brāhmaṃ japetsārasvataṃ tathā | tatkāle kalahe caiva śoṇitaprasrave tathā || 26.13 || agnidāhādike caiva vaiṣṇavaṃ soṃyasaṃyutaṃ | vaiṣvaksenaṃ tathā saudarśanaṃ gāruḍameva ca || 26.14 || laukikāgnau huneddhyātvā devaṃ paścātsamācareth | bhūparīkṣaṇakāle tu yadi pāṃsukṣayo bhaveth || 26.15 || pūrṇāhutiṃ ca juhuyāttathā mindāhutī budhaḥ | parīkṣitā yadā bhūmiḥ pūrvamevānyavartmanā || 26.16 || aupāsanāgnimādhāya vyāhṛtyantaṃ tu vaiṣṇavaṃ | juhuyāddaśaśaḥ kuryāttataḥ karmāṇi mantrataḥ || 26.17 || vṛṣabhasyāṅgahānautu karṣaṇe doṣaśāntaye | raudraṃ brāhmaṃ ca juhuyāttato'nyaṃ vṛṣamāhareth || 26.18 || halādīnāṃ tu nirmāṇe yajñavṛkṣetaraiḥ kṛte | tathā pramāṇahīne ca juhuyādvaiṣṇavaṃ tathā || 26.19 || soṃyaṃ caiva tathāgneyaṃ prājāpatyaṃ ca deśikaḥ | rajjabhede vāruṇaṃ ca sītābhedeśriyaṃ tathā || 26.20 || dātrabhede tu juhuyājjyeṣṭhāmantraṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ | ṛṣibhede tu vāyavyaṃ kṣiṇīye vāsavaṃ tathā || 26.21 || yuge nāgaṃ pratode tu yāmye vyāhṛtisaṃyutaṃ | kapālāsthituṣāṅgārakeśavalmīkakharparāḥ || 26.22 || dṛṣṭāḥkarṣaṇakāle cettadvyapohyāvilaṃbitaṃ | abhyukṣya pañcagavyena soṃyāgneyau hunetkramāth || 26.23 || tatra cedarcane hīne śāntavīśānapāyināṃ | vaiṣṇapaṃ juhuyāttattaddaivatyaṃ cār'cayetpunaḥ || 26.24 || bījāvāpanahīne tu juhuyādvaiṣṇavaṃ tathā | soṃyaṃ hutvā ca vāyavyaṃ punarbījāni vāpayeth || 26.25 || gavāṃ nivedane hīne vaiṣṇapaṃ cāmitaṃ huneth | gāruḍaṃ cakramantraṃ ca daśaśassusamāhitaḥ || 26.26 || palālabhārānāhṛtya gogaṇebhyo nivedayeth | padadevabalau hīne hunettanmantrapūrvakaṃ || 26.27 || vaiṣṇavaṃ brāhmamaindraṃ ca yāmyaṃ vāruṇameva ca | kauberaṃ ca kramāddhutvā baliṃ tatra samarpayeth || 26.28 || brahmapadmakriyāhānau vaiṣṇavabrāhmavāruṇān | bhūdaivatyaṃ ca juhuyātpunaḥ kāryaṃ samācareth || 26.29 || dikpharicchedahīne tu digdaivatyaṃ ca vaiṣṇavaṃ | sauraṃ caiva punarhutvā kuryāddiksādhanaṃ tataḥ || 26.30 || vimānārthaṃ yadā bhūmiḥkhanyate tatra saṃbhave | śarkarāśalyaloṣṭādau vaiṣṇavaṃ brāhmameva ca || 26.31 || pañcabhūtādhidai vatyaṃ vyāhṛtīśca hunetkramāth | hīne'dhike vā māne tu śīlāyā iṣṭakasya vā || 26.32 || vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktaṃ ca hutvā vidhivadācareth | viparyāse tu vinyāse digdaivatyaṃ ca vaiṣṇavaṃ || 26.33 || hutvā yathoktavatkṛtvājapedvedādikānmanūn | ratnanyāsavihīne tu hunettadadhipānmamān || 26.34 || viṣṇusūktantato hutvā ratnanyāsaṃ samācareth | garbhanyāsavihīne tu vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktakaṃ || 26.35 || hutvā śrībhūmi daivatyaṃ garbhanyāsaṃ punaścareth | pramāṇahīne tu vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktakaṃ || 26.36 || sauraṃ soṃyamathāgneyaṃ yajetkuryādvidhāvataḥ | nirmāṇakāle dravyāṇāṃ sthāpane saṃkareṇavai || 26.37 || viparyāse ca saṃprāpte vaiṣṇavaṃ juhu yātkramāth | tattatthsānādhidaivatyaṃ hutvā vidhivadācareth || 26.38 || anuktadeśe nyāse ca viṣṇusūktaṃ ca pauruṣaṃ | hunecchrībhūmidaivatyaṃ tattatthsāne niveśayeth || 26.39 || apramāṇe śilāyāṃ vā tathā mūrdheṣṭakādiṣu | juhuyānniṣkṛtiṃ vidvānādyeṣṭakavidhānataḥ || 26.40 || sthūpikīle tadādhāre pramāṇaparivarjite | alābhe coktadārūṇāṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ soṃyapāvake || 26.41 || bhūdaivatyaṃ ca hutvā tu vidhinā kālayedbudhaḥ | vimāne nirmite paścātsudhākarmaṇyakalpite || 26.42 || vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktaṃ ca sūktaṃ pauruṣameva ca | hunecchrībhūmidaivatyaṃ vidhinā punarārabheth || 26.43 || āgneyaṃ bhūmidaivatyaṃ hutvā kāryaṃ samācareth | hīne dhāmnaḥkavāṭādau dhātrādīnjuhuyācca ṣaṭh || 26.44 || vaiṣṇavaṃ śrīmahīmantrānhutvā nirmāpayetpunaḥ | prākāre gopure hine doṣo bhūyānmahattaraḥ || 26.45 || vaṃśahānirdviṣadvṛddhirarthanāśo mahadbhayaṃ | śāntehine mahāpatsyātkulaṃ cotsīdati dhruvaṃ || 26.46 || bhūtapīṭhavihīne tu dhanadhānyāyuṣāṃ kṣayaḥ | kūpārāmahaviśśālapuṣpasaṃcayavāṭikāḥ || 26.47 || snānapānīyaśālā ca tathaivāsthānamaṇḍapaṃ | nṛttagītaprapāścaivaṃ maṇḍapādāvanirmite || 26.48 || saṃpadyeta mahāndoṣaḥ kṛtaṃ syādakṛtaṃ punaḥ | tasmātsarvaprayatnena kārayecchaktito budhaḥ || 26.49 || vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusuktaṃ ca pauruṣaṃ sūktameva ca | hutvā śrībhūmidaivatyaṃ tattaddaivatyameva ca || 26.50 || yathoktaṃ tu prakurvīta vittaśāṭhyaṃna kārayeth | prathameṣṭakāṃ samārabhya sthūpikīlāvasānake || 26.51 || ānuktānāṃ ca doṣāṇāmiyaṃ syātsarvaniṣkṛtiḥ | ālayātpuratovātha dakṣiṇe vā manorame || 26.52 || śucau deśe pratiṣṭhāpya padmāgnau juhuyātkramāth | vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktaṃ ca pauruṣaṃ sūktameva ca || 26.53 || hunecchrībhūmidai vatyamaṅga homaścahūyate | sthūpyādyupānaparyantavimānāṅgāni nāmataḥ || 26.54 || "dadbhyassvā'hādi juhuyādbrāhmaṃ raudraṃ vināyakaṃ | āgneyaṃ durgāsūktaṃ ca prājāpatyaṃ ca hāvayeth || 26.55 || samāpite vimāne tu dhanalobhādinā punaḥ | dhruvaberaṃ vinākṛtvā kautuke sthāpite yadi || 26.56 || ābhicārikametatsyādrāja rāṣṭravināśanaṃ | taddoṣaparihārārthaṃ mahāśāntiṃ tṣahaṃ careth || 26.57 || vaiṣṇavāṃśca susaṃpūjya bhojayedbrāhmaṇānbahūn | "kṣama'sveti namaskṛtya devadevaṃ tu kautukaṃ || 26.58 || bālālaye pratiṣṭhāpya dhruvaberaṃ samācareth | dhruvārcāberamatha vā kṛtvā sthāpanamācareth || 26.59 || vimānasya samāptau tu māsādūrdhvaṃ tu tatra vai | dhruvasthāpanahīne tu vaiṣṇavaṃ juhuyāttataḥ || 26.60 || viṣṇusūktaṃ tathā raudramaindramāgne yameva ca | vāruṇaṃ bārhaspatyaṃ ca śrībhūdaivatyameva ca || 26.61 || śāntiṃ hutvā vidhānena dadyādācāryadakṣiṇāṃ | brāhmaṇānbhojayitvaiva pūjayitvā tu vaiṣṇavān || 26.62 || dhruvaberaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya vidhinā samyagarcayeth | evaṃ māsadvaye'tīte dviguṇaṃ niṣkṛtirbhaveth || 26.63 || māsatraye tu triguṇamevamāvatsaraṃ bhaveth | saṃvatsare vyatīte tu doṣo bhūyānmahattaraḥ || 26.64 || saptāhaṃ tu mahāśāntiṃ hutvābjāgnau vidhānataḥ | brāhmaṇānbhojayetpaścādvidhinā sarvamācareth || 26.65 || saptavarṣeṣu saptāhaṃ prathamādikrameṇa vai | kecidicchanti munayassaptāhāntamidaṃ careth || 26.66 || ata ūrdhvaṃ karṣaṇādi punassaṃskāramācareth | jalādhivāsanātpūrvamaṅgahānau dhruvasyatu || 26.67 || vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktaṃ ca sūktaṃ pauruṣameva ca | hunecchrībhūmidaivatyaṃ "dadbhyassvāhā'dikaṃ tathā || 26.68 || ācāryadakṣiṇāṃ dadyādberaṃ samyakparīkṣayeth | saṃdhānayogyaṃ saṃdadhyātpunaḥ kāryaṃ samācareth || 26.69 || śaktaścennūtanaṃ beramāhṛtya tu samācareth | śilāgrahaṇasaṃskāramakṛtvā śilpinā kṛtaṃ || 26.70 || beramādāya juhuyācchāntiṃ vaiṣṇavamantrataḥ | bhūmau pidhāya tadberaṃ vāstuhomaṃ samācareth || 26.71 || paryagnipañcagavyābhyāṃ beraṃ saṃśodhya yatnataḥ | paritaḥ pūrvavadgatvā baliṃ devaṃ samarcya ca || 26.72 || paścātsamantrakaṃ kṛtvāvidhinā sthāpayedbudhaḥ | jalādhivāsanādarvākthsāpanātpūrvameva ca || 26.73 || devasya devyādīnāṃ vā aṅgahānirbhavedyadi | vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktaṃ ca pauruṣaṃ sūktameva ca || 26.74 || śrīsūktaṃ ca mahīsūktaṃ brāhmaṃ raudraṃ tathaiva ca | munyormantramathānyeṣāṃ tattanmatraṃ suhūyatāṃ || 26.75 || saṃdhānayogyaṃ saṃdadhyādayogyaṃ vidhivattyajeth | saṃdhāya vānyaṃ cāhṛtya punasthsāpanamācareth || 26.76 || sthāpite tu mahābere māsādūrdhvamasaṃskṛte | abjāgnau vaiṣṇavaṃ caiva viṣṇusūktaṃ tathaiva ca || 26.77 || sūktaṃ tu pauruṣaṃ hutvā śrībhūdaivatyameva ca | brāhmaṃ raudraṃ pārṣadaṃ ca hutvā kāryaṃ samācareth || 26.78 || māsadvaye tu dviguṇaṃ trimāse triguṇaṃ bhaveth | saṃvatsarāntamevaṃ syāttadante sthāpayetpunaḥ || 26.79 || atīte dvādaśe varṣe karṣaṇādi punaḥ kriyāḥ | śilāsaṃgrahaṇādyanyatkṛtvā sthāpanamācareth || 26.80 || atha vakṣye karṣaṇādau punassaṃskāra mācareth | tṛṇagulmalatādīni śodhayetpūrvamālaye || 26.81 || kuryācchileṣṭakādāruprakṣepaṇavidhiṃ kramāth | sudhāvarṇānulepādīnsamāpya gurutvaraḥ || 26.82 || alayasyottare kuryādvāstuhoṃaṃ yathāvithi | puṇyāhaṃ vācayedvidvānparyagniṃ caiva kārayeth || 26.83 || pañcagavyaissamabhyukṣya tatassaṃkarpya karṣaṇaṃ | ālayābhimukhe kṛtvā vrīhibhisthsaṃḍilaṃ budhaḥ || 26.84 || śāntānapāyinau vīśaṃ cābhyarca ca nivedayeth | suvarṇena halaṃ kṛtvā garbhāgārādi sarvaśaḥ || 26.85 || gṛhītvā dakṣiṇe haste mantrairviṣṇornukādibhiḥ | karṣayitvā yathoktāni bījānyāhṛtya deśikaḥ || 26.86 || abhyukṣya somamabhyarcya viṣṇugāyatrimuccaran | abhimantṣa tato bījān"somaṃ rājāna'muccaran || 26.87 || sarvatra vāpanaṃ kuryāddūrvādīṃścāharettṛṇān | āstīryopari tā ntṛrvānsūktaṃ gaudānikaṃ punaḥ || 26.88 || uccārya gogaṇebhyastānnivedya ca pradāpayeth | ālayaṃ tu susaṃśodhya brahmādīnāṃ dadedbaliṃ || 26.89 || droṇaistadardhairvā paktvā taṇḍulaissaghṛtaṃ caruṃ | pūrvaṃ toyaṃ tataḥ puṣpaṃ baliṃ to yaṃ samarpayeth || 26.90 || punassaṃśodhayeddhāma śāntihomapurassaraṃ | tattatsaṃskārahomaṃ ca hutvā kuryātkriyāstataḥ || 26.91 || ādyeṣṭakārthamāsādya kuṇḍamaupāsanaṃ budhaḥ | vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktaṃ ca pauruṣaṃ sūktameva ca || 26.92 || degdaivatyaṃ ca juhuyāddevaṃ dhyāyansamāhitaḥ | japedvedādimantrāṃstu saṃspṛśyādyeṣṭakāsthalaṃ || 26.93 || kṛtvāntaḥ pariṣekaṃ ca pariṣicyānalaṃ punaḥ | garbhanyāsārthamāgūrya vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktakaṃ || 26.94 || puruṣasūktaṃ ca śrīsūktaṃ mahīsūktaṃ tathaiva ca | degdaivatyaṃ ca juhuyā"nnāgarājāya'setyapi || 26.95 || "sarvaratnebhya'ityuktvā "sarvadhātubhya'ityapi | "sarvabījebhya'ityuktvā"sarvalohebhya'ityape || 26.96 || "nadībhyaḥpātālebhya'śca "nāgebhyo'juhuyāttataḥ | "diggajebhyo viṣṇave' ca svāhāntaṃ juhuyātkramāth || 26.97 || tata ābhyantaradvāradakṣiṇantaṃbhadakṣiṇe | medinīṃ tu samabhyarcya japetsūktaṃ tu pauruṣaṃ || 26.98 || medinyādīṃstato japtvātattatthsāvaṃ spṛśedbudhaḥ | kṛtvāntaḥ pariṣekantu tatra kāryaṃ samācareth || 26.99 || naṣṭe garbhe ca hutvaivaṃ saṃpādya sthāpayetpunaḥ | anyaiṣṭakārthaṃ juhuyādvaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktakaṃ || 26.100 || puruṣasūktaṃ ca hutvātu juhuyādvidhinā budhaḥ | vimānapāladaivatyaṃ japanvedādikānmanūn || 26.101 || vimānasyopariṣṭāttu sthūpikīlādadhastathā | japanvaiviṣṇusūktaṃ ca kuryāccaivābhimarśanaṃ || 26.102 || dhruve pramāṇahīne ca paristīrya ca pāvakaṃ | dhruvasthāpanavaddhutvā ratnanyāsoditānmanūn || 26.103 || japetthsāpanasūktaṃ ca navīkṛtya prayatnataḥ | kautukādīṃśca kṛtvaiva pratiṣṭhāṃ kārayedbudhaḥ || 26.104 || naṣṭe dhruve punaḥkuryādutkṛṣṭadravyanirmitaṃ | atha vā vūrvavatkṛtvā sthāpayedvidhinātvaraḥ, || 26.105 || narairvṛṣairmṛgādyairvāberamutpāṭitaṃ yadi | ahīnāṅgaṃ tu saṃgṛhya śuddhyarthamadhivāsayeth || 26.106 || jalādhivāsaṃ kṛtvā tu tatthsāne vidhinā budhaḥ | ratnanyāsaṃ ca kṛtvaiva pratiṣṭhāṃ punarācareth || 26.107 || anyālayādapahṛtamaniṣpannakriyaṃ tathā | śilāberaṃ yadi syāttadbhūmau samyakpidhāya ca || 26.108 || vidhināhṛtya saṃskāryaṃ kṛtvā sthāpanamācareth | śilpinā vithipūrvaṃ tu kṛtaṃ belaṃ tathā careth || 26.109 || yathāvidhi yathāsthānaṃ sthāpitaṃ doṣavarjitaṃ | beraṃ na cālayedyasmādrājarāṣṭravināśanaṃ || 26.110 || taddoṣaśamanārthāya padmāgnau juhuyātkramāth | saptāhaṃ tu mahāśāntiṃ kuryādbrāhmaṇabhojanaṃ || 26.111 || dadyātsuvarṇaṃ gāṃ bhūmiṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ punarācareth | avidhijñairathācāryairṛtvigbhisthāpagaistathā || 26.112 || sthāpitaṃ beramājñāya cālayitvā yathāvidhi | vidhijñaisthpāpanaṃ vidvānkārayedatvaraṃ tathā || 26.113 || vidhijñaisthsāpitaṃ beramajñānāccālitaṃ yadi | śāntiṃ hudvā vidhānena vidhijñaisthsāpayetpunaḥ || 26.114 || nadītaṭākapāthodhipravāhairvātyayādha vā | daivātpracālite tatra vimāne vā dhruve'pi vā || 26.115 || bhūmau pidhāya tadberaṃ nirmāya punarālayaṃ | acalaṃ sthāpayedberaṃ śāstroktenaiva vartmanā || 26.116 || sāpāye tu sthale tasminsannikṛṣṭe sthale careth | grāmādau vā vivikte vā pradeśe sumanorame || 26.117 || vimānaṃ sudṛḍhaṃ kṛtvā devamādāya tatra vai | sarvaiśca pārṣadairyuktaṃ saṃsthāpya vidhinār'cayeth || 26.118 || grāmādīnāmabhāve tu śatadaṇḍātparaṃ tataḥ | vimānaṃ vistṛte deśe kṛtvā saṃsthāpya cārcayeth || 26.119 || rājārāṣṭrāntaraṃ jitvā beramāhṛtya yatnataḥ | svarāṣṭresthāpituṃ cecchedyadi grāmaṃ vidhāya ca || 26.120 || tadvāstvaṅgālaye beraṃ vidhinā sthāpya cārcayeth | apauruṣālayābhyāśe vimānaṃ pauruṣaṃ yadi || 26.121 || kartumicchettadā kuryāttatprākārāntare punaḥ | bhūśuddhyādīnvinā kṛtvā prākāraṃ pratimādikaṃ || 26.122 || pratiṣṭhāpyār'cayettasya mūlasthānār'canaṃ phalaṃ | pramādādathavā daivā dālaye snapanālaye || 26.123 || āsthānamaṇḍape pākasthānaprākārayorapi | govuresnānapānīyaśālādau vahnidūṣite || 26.124 || mahāvātahate'kasmādaśanyādihate tathā | pāramātmikamabjāgnāvīṅkārādīṃstathā huneth || 26.125 || vicchinnaṃ mindāhutīcaiva āgneyaṃ vyāhṛtīstathā | punaranyannavaṃ kṛtvā pratiṣṭhāṃ kārayetkramāth || 26.126 || śilāgrahaṇa kāle vā tadā dārugrahe'pi ca | kriyāṅgīne viparyāse vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktakaṃ || 26.127 || mindāhutī ca vicchinnaṃ vyāhṛtyantaṃ hunedbudhaḥ | dvārastaṃbhe bhuvaṅgādau hīne māne'gnidūṣite || 26.128 || jīrṇe vā kṛmidaṣṭe vānupayuktaṃ tyajedbudhaḥ | anyamāhṛtya vidhinā saṃyojyaiva ca pūrvavath || 26.129 || nityāgnau vaiṣṇavaṃ soṃyamāgneyaṃ śāntimācareth | garbhanyāsārthamathavā pīṭhanyāsārthameva vā || 26.130 || ratnānāmapyalābhe tu suvarṇaṃ tatra nikṣipeth | viṣṇusūktaṃ tu juhuyātprāyaścittaṃ tu tadbhaveth || 26.131 || dhātūnāṃ pāradaṃ prāktamalābhapraṇidhintu tath | pāradaṃ tatra nikṣipya brāhmaṃ raudraṃ ca niṣkṛtiḥ || 26.132 || yavā bījapratinidhirmudgānvā tatra nikṣipeth | vāyavyaṃ vaiṣmavaṃ ceti juhuyāttatra niṣkṛtiḥ || 26.133 || dhruvabelasya nirmāṇe śūlagrahaṇakarmaṇi | sthāpane vā viparyāse brāhmaṃ raudraṃ ca vaiṣṇavaṃ || 26.134 || vāhṛtyantaṃ ca hutvaiva vidhinā yojayetpunaḥ | apramāṇe vimāne tu beraṃ mānavivarjitaṃ || 26.135 || ajñānātsthāpitaṃ cettadrājarāṣṭravināśakṛth | taddoṣaśamanārthaṃ ca mahāśāntiṃ hunedbudhaḥ || 26.136 || tadvimānaṃ ca tadberaṃ sthāpayedvidhivatpunaḥ | tattadberoktaśūlānāṃ pramāṇaṃ yadi hīyate || 26.137 || pūrṇaṃ kṛtvā vaiṣṇavaṃ ca pauruṣaṃ sūktameva ca | "dadbhyassvā'hetyaṅgahomaṃ hutvātu sthāpayetpunaḥ || 26.138 || snehacūrṇakaṣāyādau hīne yogaviparyaye | rajjubandhāṣṭabandhādau śarkarālepane tathā || 26.139 || tathā mṛdālepane ca paṭācchādanakarmaṇi | bhūṣādau kramahīne vā varṇādīnāṃ vyatikrame || 26.140 || vaiṣṇavaṃ brāhmaraudrāgnimahābhūtāthipāṃstathā | prājāpatyaṃ vyāhṛtīśca hutvā vidhipadācareth || 26.141 || mahāberaṃ cārdhacitraṃ mṛṇmayaṃ naiva kārayeth | sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ tāmraṃ śailaṃ dāravamevavā || 26.142 || ratnajaṃ vārdhacitrastu kuryādberaṃ salakṣaṇaṃ | kṛtrimeṇāpyanuktena varṇenālepitaṃ punaḥ || 26.143 || beraṃ prakṣālya nirvāsavāriṇā parimārjyaca | vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktaṃ ca hutvābjāgnau jayādikān || 26.144 || paścādyathoktavarṇena yathārhamanulepayeth | dhravaberaṃ sudhāyukta miṣṭakākalpitaṃ tathā || 26.145 || duṣṭadravyakṛtaṃ vātha sthāpitaṃ cābhicārikaṃ | tacchīghramapahāyeva padmāgnau vaiṣmavaṃ tathā || 26.146 || viṣṇusūktaṃ pauruṣaṃ ca śrībhūdaivatyameva ca | yaddevādīṃstathā brāhmaraudrapāvakavāruṇān || 26.147 || sarvadaivatyamantrāṃśca pāramātmikameva ca | mahāśānti ca hutvaitāṃ sarvadoṣavināśinīṃ || 26.148 || paścatsaṃskṛtya vidhivadberaṃ saṃsthāpya cārcayeth | vṛttalohārakūṭādyairanuktadravyasaṃbhavaiḥ || 26.149 || nirmitaṃ kautukaṃ beramabhicārāya kalpate | taddoṣaśāntyai padmāgnau mahāśāntiṃ samācareth || 26.150 || beraṃ salakṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā vidhinā sthāpayetpunaḥ | kautukaṃ sthitamāsīnamatha vā kārayedbudhaḥ || 26.151 || śayānaṃ nācaredārṣaṃ yathāvasthitamarcayeth | nirduṣṭe kautukādau tu pūjyamāne tu vigrahe || 26.152 || naiva praveśayedberamutkṛṣṭadravyakalpitaṃ | nikṛṣṭadravyajaṃ cāpi pūjyamānaṃ na saṃtyajeth || 26.153 || arcyamāne kautukādau virūpe varṇavarjite | yuktevā jharjhurādyaiśca dhruveśaktiṃ samarpya ca || 26.154 || navīkṛtya punarbiṃbaṃ saṃśodhya sthāpayetpunaḥ | kautukaṃ cedarcyamānaṃ daivādrājādibhirhṛte || 26.155 || taddeśaśuddhiṃ kṛtvaiva mahāśāntiṃ puroditāṃ | kṛtvā nyasyātra ratnaṃ vā suvarṇaṃ kūrcameva vā || 26.156 || dhruvādvā hṛdayādarka maṇḍalādvā vidhānataḥ | devamāvāhya tatkāle paścādberaṃ yathāvidhi || 26.157 || pūrvadravyeṇa votkṛṣṭadravyeṇāpi prakalpayeth | kālāpekṣāmakṛtvaiva pratiṣṭhāṃ pūrvavaccareth || 26.158 || madhūcchiṣṭakriyāhīnaṃ beramādāya vaiṣṇavaṃ | śāntiṃhutvā raudrasaurapāvakānpunarācareth || 26.159 || anyālaye sthāpitaṃ tu dhruvaṃ kautukameva vā | anyālaye sthāpayeccenmahāśāntiṃ hunedbudhaḥ || 26.160 || vaiṣṇavāṃntu susaṃpūjya brāhmaṇānbhojayedbahu | tattatthsāne tu vidhinā saṃsthāpyārcana mācareth || 26.161 || grāmādīnāmālayasya nāśeberaṃ tu tadgataṃ | anyasminnālaye sthāpya yathārhaṃ tu samarcayeth || 26.162 || kṛte tu pīṭhasaṃghāte bere tvavanate kramāth | dakṣiṇādi bhavenmṛtyurarthanāśo'bhivardhanaṃ || 26.163 || putrahāni stundabhede dhyānyānāṃ tu vināśanaṃ | uraśchidrer'thanāśaśca kṛśe kārśyaṃ bhajennaraḥ || 26.164 || sthūle ca mahatīvyādhirdīrghe'nāyuṣyameva ca | hrasve'durbhikṣamāpnoti nyūnādhikyasamudbhave || 26.165 || anyeṣvaṅgeṣu hānissyācchāstroktaṃ samyagācareth | dhruvasya sthāpanādarvākprākpratiṣṭhāvidhestathā || 26.166 || anuktaniṣkṛtiṃ vakṣye kāpilena ghṛtena vai | padmāgnau vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktaṃ suktaṃ ca pauruṣaṃ || 26.167 || śrībhūdaivatyamantrāṃśca juhuyādvyāhṛtīrbunaḥ | tattatkarmapunaḥ kuryādanyathā niṣphalaṃ bhaveth || 26.168 || iti śrīvaikhānase bhagavacchāstre bhṛguproktāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prakīrṇādhikāre ṣaḍviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ <27> atha saptaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ prāyaścittam ācāryasyartvijāṃ caiva pūjakasya viśeṣataḥ | yathoktavaraṇe hīne śāntiṃ kuryādyathāvidhi || 27.1 || abjāgnau tu mahāśāntiṃ daśavāraṃ hunettataḥ | yathoktaṃ varaṇaṃ kṛtvā paścātkarma samācareth || 27.2 || aṅkurārpaṇakāle tu brahmādīnāmathār'cane | havirnivedane vāpi hīne śāntiṃ samācareth || 27.3 || taddaivatyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ ca hutvābhyarcya nivedayeth | aṅkurārpaṇahīne tu vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktakaṃ || 27.4 || puruṣasūktaṃ ca brāhmaṃ ca vyāhṛtīśca hunettathā | punarapyaṅkurānkṛtvā paścātkāryaṃ samācareth || 27.5 || kṛtvāṃkurārpaṇaṃ paścānnācaretkarma cettataḥ | rājarāṣṭravināśassyānmahāśāntiṃ samācareth || 27.6 || "kṣama'sveti praṇamyaiva punaraṅkuṃmācareth | akṣyunmeṣāttu pūrvaṃ cetpīṭhasaṃghātakarmaṇi || 27.7 || alābhe caiva ratnānāṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktakaṃ | sūktaṃ tu pauruṣaṃ brāhmaṃ soṃyaṃ caiva tu vyāhṛtiḥ || 27.8 || hutvā suvarṇaṃ bahuśa stattatthsāne vinikṣipeth | akṣyunmeṣaṇakāle tu gavādīnāmasaṃbhave || 27.9 || darśanadravyarūpāṇāṃ yathālābhaṃ pragṛhya ca | tattaddravyādhidaivatyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ juhuyātkramāth || 27.10 || tattaddravyaṃ ca saṃpādya vidhivaddarśayetpunaḥ | akṣyunmeṣaṇahīne vā rāhusaurodaye'tha vā || 27.11 || andhakecaiva nakṣatre kṛte caivākṣimocane | sarvanāśo bhavettasmādvaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktakaṃ || 27.12 || navagrahādimantrāśca hutvākṣyunmīlanaṃ careth | pañcagavyādiṣu dravyeṣvadhivāse vivarjite || 27.13 || hutvā vaiṣṇavamārṣañca viṣṇusūktaṃ tathaiva ca | jalādhivāsaṃ triyahamekāhaṃ vāpi kālayeth || 27.14 || yajñālaye mahāvedyāṃ kṛtāyāmapramāṇataḥ | anyadeśakṛtāyāṃ vā vihīnāyāṃ ca śobhanaiḥ || 27.15 || tattaddeśādhidaivatyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktakaṃ | śrībhūdaivatyaṃ ca hutvaiva yathoktaṃ punarācareth || 27.16 || dhruvaberākṣimokṣānte yadi beraṃ na śodhayeth | viparīte'pi vā hutvā vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktakaṃ || 27.17 || puruṣasūktaṃ raudramārṣaṃ vāruṇaṃ ca punaścareth | agnikuṇḍānyavidhinā kṛtānyālakṣya satvaraṃ || 27.18 || brāhmaṃ soṃyamathāgneyaṃ vidhinā kārayettataḥ | apramāṇeṣu kūrcādiṣvājyapātra sruvādiṣu || 27.19 || mindāhutī ca sāvitraṃ vyāhṛtīśca hunedbadhaḥ | pañcāgniṣu yathāsthānaṃ prokṣaṇollekhane kṛte || 27.20 || mathitāgnāvalābhe tu prāpya cācāryamandiraṃ | atha vā śrotriyāgārādāhṛtyāgniṃ samācareth || 27.21 || nidhāya gārhapatyegnimāghāraṃ juhuyādbudhaḥ | vaiṣṇavaṃ bhūmidaivatyamāgneyaṃ ca hunetkramāth || 27.22 || tamagniṃ vardhayitvātu dakṣiṇāgnau praṇīya ca | tata āhavanīyāgnāvāvasadhye tataḥ paraṃ || 27.23 || sabhye padmānale caivaṃ kramātpraṇayanaṃ careth | viparīte praṇayane tattanmantravivarjite || 27.24 || vaiṣṇavaṃ pāvakaṃ brāhmaṃsoṃyaṃ hutvā punaścareth | tattadagniṣu cāghārātpūrvaṃ teṣāmathāntarā || 27.25 || nagacchedyadi gacchettu tattaddikpāladaivataṃ | vaiṣṇavaṃ pāvakaṃ ceti prāyaścittaṃ hunaitkramāth || 27.26 || utpanne mathitāgnau tu śānte tatra pramādataḥ ādau praṇayanādarvāgathavāgniṣu sarvaśaḥ śāntiṃ yathoditāṃ kuryādagni sūktaṃ sahasraśaḥ) | taṇḍulairekajātīyairdviprasthaiḥ pācayeccaruṃ gavyaṃ ca navanītaṃ ca laukikānalasaṃskṛtaṃ || 27.27 || saṃskārakāle saṃskuryāttadagniṃ mantravattadā | ājyasthālyāmatha carau makṣikādiḥ patedyadi || 27.28 || tadvyapohyānyadādāya prājāpatyaṃ ca pāvakaṃ | vaiṣṇavaṃ ca hunedājye tvalabdhe nūtane pūnaḥ || 27.29 || vyapohya doṣaṃ taṃ darbhairuddīpyotpūya cācareth | āghārite'gnau naṣṭe tu "ayaṃ te yoni' muccaran || 27.30 || āropayecca samidhaṃ tadbhasmani yathārhataḥ | "udbuddhya'sveti nikṣipya vidhinā laukike'nale || 27.31 || vicchinnaṃ mindāhutī ca vaiṣṇavaṃ vyāhṛtipūrvakaṃ | paristarādidravyāṇāṃ dāhe bhede'tha nāśane || 27.32 || punastattacca saṃyojya mahāvyāhṛtipūrvakaṃ | āgneyaṃ mindāhutī ca vaiṣṇavaṃ ca hunedbudhaḥ || 27.33 || pātre'nukte sruvaṃ pātraṃ gṛhṇīyāddhomakarmaṇi | havirviśeṣe'nu ktetu ghṛtaṃ vā saghṛtaṃ caru || 27.34 || dravye pramāṇahīne tu kāpilena ghṛtena vai | vaiṣṇavaṃ viṃśatirhutvā paścātkāryaṃ samācareth || 27.35 || prāyaścittānale'nukte chullyāṃ nityānale'pi vā | kriyāhīne viparyāse mantrāṇāṃ saṃkare'pi vā || 27.36 || vaiṣṇavaṃ vyāhṛtīścaiva vyāhṛtyantaṃ hunetkramāth | puṇyāhahīne puṇyāhamantrāndvādaśaśo japeth || 27.37 || vāstuhomavihīne tu tanmantrāndaśaśo huneth | prāyaścittaviśeṣe yadyanukte vaiṣṇavaṃ tataḥ || 27.38 || viṣṇusūktaṃ pauruṣaṃ ca sūktaṃ hutvā samācareth | ratnapratinidhī rukmaṃ dhātūnāṃ pāradaṃ tathā || 27.39 || bījānāṃ ca yavāḥ proktāḥ pūrvālābhe parassmataḥ | ratnānāṃ praṇidhiṃ gṛhya vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktakaṃ || 27.40 || digdaivatyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ ca dhātūnāmatha tatparaṃ | bījānāṃ praṇidhiṃ gṛhya vāyavyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ tathā || 27.41 || hune dviṃśativāraṃ tu pratyekaṃ doṣaśāntaye | vastrelakṣaṇahīne vā yukte chedādinā tataḥ || 27.42 || tattyaktvānyaṃ samāhṛtya śrīdaivatyaṃ ca vaiṣṇavaṃ | aṇḍajādidvalabdheṣu vastraṃ pratyekamāhareth || 27.43 || vaiṣṇavaṃ śrībhūdaivatyaṃ hutvā kāryaṃ samācareth | pramāṇahīneṣu punastoraṇādiṣu cātvaraḥ || 27.44 || pṛthagdvārādhidaivatyaṃ juhuyādviṃśatiṃ budhaḥ | darbharajjvāṃ vihīnāyāṃ hunaidārṣaṃ ca vaiṣṇavam, || 27.45 || kuṃbhe pramāṇahīne vā doṣayukte'pi vā tathā | vastrābhyāṃ varṇacihnaiśca hīne nātravaseddhariḥ || 27.46 || yatnena tāni nikṣipya vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktakaṃ | puruṣasūktaṃ brāhmaṃ ca munimantrāṃśca pāvakaṃ || 27.47 || juhuyāddaśakṛtvantu viprāṇāṃ bhojanaṃ careth | ācāryadakṣiṇāndadyātsaphalaṃ bhavati dhruvaṃ || 27.48 || bhinne tu sādhite kuṃbhe vaiṣṇapaṃ viṣṇusūktakaṃ | puruṣasūktaṃ brāhmamaindramāgneyaṃ cārṣameva ca || 27.49 || hutvā viṃśatikṛtvantu dadyādācāryadakṣiṇāṃ | brāhmaṇānbhojayitvaiva saṃpūjyaiva ca vaiṣmavān || 27.50 || anyatkuṃbhaṃ samāhṛtya pūrvavatsādhayedbudhaḥ | spṛṣṭe tu sāthite kuṃbhe patitaiḥ kukkuṭādibhiḥ || 27.51 || tadvyapohyāryadādāya pūrvavatsādhayettathā | vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktaṃ ca puruṣasūktaṃ tathaiva ca || 27.52 || brāhmaṃ sauramathāgneyamaṣṭādhikaśataṃ yajeth | ācāryadakṣiṇāṃ dadyādvaiṣṇavānpūjayedvidhiḥ || 27.53 || sparśaduṣṭe tathā bere snapanaṃ śāstrataścareth | pūrvoktāṃ niṣkṛtiṃ kṛtvā paścātkāryaṃ samācareth || 27.54 || nruvādīnāmalābhetu sruveṇaiva huneddhaviḥ | śvakukkuṭādyaissaṃspṛṣṭe kuṇḍe taṃ taṃ vyapohya ca || 27.55 || kuṇḍaṃ tu pūrvavatkṛtvā kṛtvāghāraṃ yathāvidhi | āgneyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ pañcavāruṇaṃ mūlahomakaṃ || 27.56 || śataśo juhuyātkuryādbrāhmaṇānāṃ ca bhojanaṃ | alābhe samidhāṃ kṛhya pālāśīrvaṭasaṃbhavāḥ || 27.57 || āgneyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ brāhmaṃ hutvākāryaṃ samācareth | darbhānkuśānvā samidho māsātītānpragṛhya ca || 27.58 || vāruṇaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ brāhmaṃ soṃyamāgneyameva ca | ādityaṃ juhuyāccaiva doṣa śāntirbhavettathā || 27.59 || dadhi kṣīraṃ gṛhītaṃ cedājaṃ māhiṣameva vā | vaiṣṇavaṃ brāhmamāgneyaṃ sauraṃ ca vyāhṛtīrhuneth || 27.60 || anuktadeśādānītā mṛdo vā vālukāstathā | agnikuṇḍārthamāhṛtya vāruṇaṃ vaiṣṇave huneth || 27.61 || ārdraṃ sadhūmaṃ durgandhaṃ lepayuktaṃ sakaṇṭakaṃ | jantuyuktaṃ kṣipedvahnāvindhanaṃ tatparityajeth || 27.62 || anyatprakṣipya cāgneyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ vyāhṛtīrhuneth | vastrādidravye darbheṣu prapāyāṃ kūṭa eva vā || 27.63 || dagdhāyāmagninā brāhmaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ saurameva ca | āgneyaṃ vaiṣṇavamiti pratyekaṃ daśaśo huneth || 27.64 || kalaśanyāsaracanāviparyāne tu vaiṣṇavaṃ | paṅktīśadaivatyaṃ ca hunettataśśāstravadācareth || 27.65 || snapane tu viparyāne berasya juhuyādbudhaḥ | pañcavāruṇamantrāṃśca vaiṣṇavaṃ ca yathāvidhi || 27.66 || śayane cedviparyāso vaiṣṇavaṃ śrīmahīmanūn | kalaśasnānaśayane pratyekaṃ daśaśo huneth || 27.67 || hīne vā viparīte vā tatra hautrapraśaṃsane | brāhmaṃ munīndramantrāṃścahunetpāriṣadāmapi || 27.68 || avāhanādāvarcāyāṃ viparīte vivarjite | vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktaṃ ca brāhmaṃ raundraṃ huneddaśa || 27.69 || sarveṣāmuktahomānāṃ viparīte vivarjite | padmāgnau vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktaṃ sūktaṃ ca pauruṣaṃ || 27.70 || śayānamuddhareddevamakāle cāpyamantrakaṃ | hutvā śrībhūmidaivatyaṃ catuṣkṛtvantu śāyayeth || 27.71 || hīne cādhyayane sārasvatamaṣṭādhikaṃ śataṃ | prāyaścittaṃ ca hutvaiva yathāśāstraṃ samācareth || 27.72 || yathālābhaṃ ca gṛhṇīyādalābhe ṣoḍaśartvijāṃ | tantreṇa kārayetsarvameṣa śāstravidhissmṛtaḥ || 27.73 || pratiṣṭhāyāmutsavevā tathānyacchubhakarmaṇi | kurvatāṃ tu puraścaryāmācāryasya rtvijāṃ tathā || 27.74 || āsnānāddīkṣitānāṃ tu nāśaucaḥparikīrtitaḥ | mohādanuṣṭhitāśaucāḥpatantinarake'śucau || 27.75 || gṛhṇīyā tsaṃskṛtāṃstānvā punaranyānathāpi vā | ācārya sthsāpakādīṃstu bhartsanādikamācaran || 27.76 || vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktaṃ ca sūktaṃ pauruṣameva ca | brāhmaṃ sārasvataṃ hutvā tānanujñāpya cācareth || 27.77 || ācāryadakṣiṇākāle'tīte hutvā tu vaiṣṇavaṃ | munimantrañca juhuyātpṛthagaṣṭottaraṃ śataṃ || 27.78 || yathoktadakṣiṇāṃ dadyādarthalobhaṃ na kārayeth | brāhmaṇānāmannadāne vihīne śāntimācareth || 27.79 || triyahaṃ tu mahāśānti staddoṣavinivāriṇī | hantyalpadakṣiṇo yāgaḥ phalaṃ dadyātsadakṣiṇaḥ || 27.80 || yajñasya dakṣiṇā jīvastasmādyatnena pālayeth | iyaṃ tātkālikījñeyā bhūmimagre pradāpayeth || 27.81 || arcakasyārcanārdhaṃ ca kuṭuṃbārthaṃ viśeṣataḥ | bhūmibhogamakalpyaiva mahāśāntiṃ samācareth || 27.82 || asaṃkalpitavṛttistu devāvāso na vardhate | arcakaḥ praṇidhiryasmādrājño rāṣṭrasya kalpate || 27.83 || tasmātsamāhitaḥ kuryādyathā pūjā na lupyate | āpadyapi ca kaṣṭāyāṃ pūjāmetāṃ na lopayeth || 27.84 || yadaiva lupyate pūjā yena kenāpi hetunā | agrer'cakamiyāddoṣa ārdrameṣo'parādhyati || 27.85 || tasmāddāyena bhūmyādi sthiradānena sādaraṃ | rūḍhādhikāra evāgre pravartetār'caner'cakaḥ || 27.86 || yasmādarcanahīne tu rājarāṣṭrādisaṃkṣayaḥ | tadgrāmavāsinastasmādrājā rāṣṭragatā api || 27.87 || bhagavatpūjanāheto rupakuryuḥ prayatnataḥ | ārdrāparādho bhavati yasmāddoṣeṣu pūjakaḥ || 27.88 || taṃ vṛttikarśitaṃ dṛṣyvā rājā ca grāmavāsinaḥ | sukhitaṃ taṃ tathā kuryuryathā devastathārcakaḥ || 27.89 || datvṛttimadhikāṃ cāpina śaṅkeyurasūyavaḥ | yathārhamupayuñjīransvaśaktiṃ tatsukhāya vai || 27.90 || pratiṣṭhānte tu vidhivadarcake tvaprakalpite | āsurī sā bhavedarcā kartā naivāpnu yātphalaṃ || 27.91 || devena sārthamuddiṣṭaṃ yatkulaṃ pūjakasya tu | tadatikramya pūjāṃ tu kārayeditareṇa ceth || 27.92 || rauravaṃ narakaṃ yāti kartā kārayitā ca yaḥ | tasmā tsarvaprayatnena śāstroktaṃ paripālayeth || 27.93 || śvaḥ kāryamadya kurvīta pūrvāhṇe cāparāhṇikaṃ | na hi pratīkṣate mṛtyuḥ kartavyo dharmasaṃgrahaḥ || 27.94 || na tya ktavibhavo jātu bhavecca vibhave sati | yathāśakti prakurvīta vibhavāṃśca na lobhayeth || 27.95 || alābhe kautukādīnāṃ suvarṇaṃ nyasya vaiṣmavaṃ | viṣṇusūktaṃ nṛsuktaṃ ca vāyavyaṃ digadhīśvaraṃ || 27.96 || sabhye'ntahomahīne tu vaiṣṇavaṃ pāvakaṃ tathā | vyāhṛtīśca hunedvidvāndaśakṛtvassamāhitaḥ || 27.97 || agnigrahaṇahīne tu hutvā pūrvoktaniṣkṛtiṃ | śrotriyāvasathādagnimāhṛtyāghāravūrvakaṃ || 27.98 || nityahomaṃ ca juhuyāttataḥ prabhṛti cācareth | dhruvādāvāhayedyasmātkautukādi caturṣvapi || 27.99 || pramādātkuṃbhatīrthena teṣāmāvāhane kṛte | "iṣetve'tyādinā snāpya śīghraṃ śuddhena vāriṇā || 27.100 || anumānya ca deveśaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktakaṃ | juhuyātpauruṣaṃsūktaṃ dhruvādāvāhayetpunaḥ || 27.101 || athanityārcanāyāntu prāyaścittaṃ pravakṣyate | sūryodayācca madhyāhnātpūrva mastamayādapi || 27.102 || kavāṭodghāṭane hīne nityāgnau vā mahānane | vaiṣṇavaṃ dhātrādidaivatyaṃ hutvā dauvārikaṃ tathā || 27.103 || śīghramudghāṭayeddvāraṃ devadevaṃ praṇamya ca | amantrakamathānyairvā kavāṭodghāṭane kṛte || 27.104 || pūrvoktaṃ juhuyācchāntiṃ japeddvādaśasūktakaṃ | mārjanādiṣu hīneṣu nirmālyecāpyaśodhite || 27.105 || vaiṣṇavaṃ vāruṇaṃ hutvā vāyavyaṃ śāntameva ca | yathāvatkārayetsarvaṃ mantreṇaiva punarguruḥ || 27.106 || dravyapratinidhistoyamalābhe tena cācareth | devasya snapane hīne vaiṣṇave vāruṇaṃ huneth || 27.107 || "apo hi'ṣṭhādibhirmantraissnāvayenniṣkṛtirbhaveth | paśnānnityaṃ prakurvīta snānaṃ nityārcanoditaṃ || 27.108 || aśaktausnāpane prokṣyaṃ mantreṇa kuśavāribhiḥ | vastrādīṃśca vyapohyaiva dhautavastraṃ samarpayeth || 27.109 || nityaṃ snānamaśakyaṃ cedviṣṇupañcadineṣu vai | snāpayeddevadeveśamiti kecidvadantihi || 27.110 || dhruvapīṭhetu nirmālyaṃ saṃśodhya punareva ca | puṣpanyāsaṃ prakurvīta dhruve nityārcanaṃ bhaveth || 27.111 || puṣpanyāsaṃ vinākuryātkautukasyārcanaṃ yadi | vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktaṃ ca puruṣasūktaṃ tadhaiva ca || 27.112 || hutvā ca viṣṇugāyatrīṃ puṣbanyāsaṃ kramāccareth | saṃbandhakūrcahīnetu vaiṣṇavaṃ munimantrakaṃ || 27.113 || hutvāsannyasya kūrcaṃ tu paścātkāryaṃ samācareth | dhātrādyarcanahīne tu taddaivatyaṃ savaiṣṇavaṃ || 27.114 || hutvārcayeddhātṛmukhāntathā pariṣadaḥ kramāth | upacāraviparyāse "kṣama'nveti praṇamya ca || 27.115 || anumānyārcayeddevaṃ hīne caiva tu vigrahe | taddevatāmanuṃ japtvā vaiṣṇavaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ || 27.116 || punastadupacārādi pūjaye tsarvavigrahaiḥ | uktadravye ṣvalabdheṣu puṣpaṃ toyamathākṣataṃ || 27.117 || gṛhītvā caiva tatsarvaṃ dhyātvā devaṃ samarcayeth | arcākāle'nyakālaṃ vā smaye vā mūṣikādibhiḥ || 27.118 || marutā vāpi vicchinnamajasraṃ dīpamādarāth | dviguṇaṃ tu samuddīpya sauraṃ raudraṃ ca pāvakaṃ || 27.119 || vaiṣṇavaṃ ca tathāhutvā punararcanamācareth | tatkāle sarvadīpānāṃ nāśe doṣo mahattaraḥ || 27.120 || devaṃ śuddhodakaissnāpya kuśodairabhiṣicya ca | pūrvoktāṃ niṣkṛtiṃ hutvā dviguṇaṃ tu nidevayeth || 27.121 || bahudīpeṣucaikasminnaṣṭe tenana duṣyati | mantrāṇāṃ skhalane mūrtyāpraṇavena sahācareth || 27.122 || arcākāle yavanikāhīne caiva prajāpatiṃ | vaiṣṇapaṃ caiva hutvā tu paṭaṃ kṛtvār'cayetpunaḥ || 27.123 || vedadūṣaka pāṣaṇḍa pāparogānvitairjanaiḥ | pratilomādibhirlmecchairantyajātibhireva ca || 27.124 || tatkāle darśane hutvā vaiṣṇavaṃ brāhmameva ca | raudraṃ ca pāvakaṃ hutvā vyāhṛtīśca tator'cayeth || 27.125 || yadi cāvaraṇādbāhye pañcāśaddaṇḍakāntare | manuṣyāṇāṃ mṛtissyāttaduddhṛtyaivārcayeddhariṃ || 27.126 || naivārcanaṃ havirdānaṃ tataḥ pūrvaṃ samācareth | dhruvakautukayoḥ kuryātpuṣpanyāsāvasānakaṃ || 27.127 || paścātkālātyaye śāntiṃ hutvā dviguṇamarcayeth | ekakālārcane hīne dvitīye dviguṇaṃ careth || 27.128 || tṛtīye triguṇaṃ kuryādekāher'cāvivarjite | vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktaṃ ca puruṣa sūktaṃ tathaiva ca || 27.129 || hunecchrībhūmidaivatyaṃ dvyahe tu dviguṇaṃ bhaveth | tṣahe triguṇamevantu dvādaśāhāntamācareth || 27.130 || atīte dvādaśāhetu saṃdhāyaupāsanānale | vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktaṃ ca puruṣasūktaṃ tathaiva ca || 27.131 || ālaye pariṣaddeva mantrānhutvā ca śaktitaḥ | kalaśaissnāpya deveśamabhyarcya havirarpayeth || 27.132 || māsaṃ hīner'cane kuryādālayābhimukhe guruḥ | sabhyāgnau vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktaṃ sūktaṃ ca pauruṣaṃ || 27.133 || hutvā śrībhūmidaivatyaṃ sarvadaivatyameva ca | kalaśairaṣṭabhiśca tvāriṃśadbhissnāpayeddhariṃ || 27.134 || viśeṣeṇa havirdadyāddvitīyedviguṇaṃ tathā | tṛtīye triguṇaṃ caivaṃ vatsarānantu vardhayeth || 27.135 || atīte vatsare caivaṃ padmāgnau saptavāsaraṃ | mahāśāntiṃ tu hutvaiva kṛtvā vaiṣṇavapūjanaṃ || 27.136 || brāhmaṇānbhojayitvaiva śatāṣṭakalaśaiḥ punaḥ | saṃsnāpya devadeveśaṃ punasthsāpana mācareth || 27.137 || akṣyunneṣādhivāsau tu punasthsāpanakarmaṇi | hitvānyatsakalaṃ karma pūrvavattu samācareth || 27.138 || havirhīne janāssarvetadgrāmasthāssamīpagāḥ | pīḍitāḥ kṣutpipāsādyairbhaveyurvyādhitā api || 27.139 || tasmādatiprayatnena havissamya ṅnivedayeth | hīne haviṣyeka kāle dvitīye dviguṇaṃ bhaveth || 27.140 || tṛtīye triguṇaṃ kuryādekasmindivase gate | vaiṣṇavaṃ śrīmahīmantrānmūrti homaṃ tathā huneth || 27.141 || devaṃ śuddhodakaissnāpya prabhūtaṃ tu nivedayeth | sopadaṃśamapakvaṃ ca śītaṃ paryuṣitaṃ tathā || 27.142 || pātrāntareṣvanikṣiptaṃ sāvaśeṣaṃ ca laṅghitaṃ | vivṛtaṃ srāvitaṃ caiva vikṛtaṃ dṛṣṭi dūṣitaṃ || 27.143 || aprokṣitamathāspṛṣṭa magṛhītamamudritaṃ | havirnivedayeccettu vaiṣṇavaṃ śrīmahīmanūn || 27.144 || āgneyaṃ vāruṇaṃ caiva vāyavyaṃ daśaśo huneth | dviguṇaṃ tu punaḥkṛtvā prabhūtaṃ tu nivedayeth || 27.145 || nivedya cāśumispṛṣṭaṃ devaṃ saṃsnāpya mantrataḥ | vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇugāyatrīṃ trayastriṃśatkramāddhuneth || 27.146 || juhuyādvidhināśāntiṃ prokṣaṇairapi prokṣayeth | puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvaiva dviguṇaṃ cārcanaṃ haviḥ || 27.147 || vrīhyaṅgāratuṣairyukteśarkarādivimiśrite | nivedite tu haviṣi mantreṇāṣṭākṣareṇa tu || 27.148 || vaiṣṇapyā caiva gāyatṣā mantraissaṃstūya vaiṣṇavaiḥ | "kṣama'svetyanumānyaiva praṇamayaiva ca yācayeth || 27.149 || makṣikādyairjantubhiśca keśādyairapi dūṣite | nivedite tu haviṣi śuddhodaissnāvyavai hariṃ || 27.150 || vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktaṃ ca śrībhūdaivatyameva ca | aṣṭottaraśataṃ hutvā dviguṇaṃ tu nivedayeth || 27.151 || mahāhaviṣi caitaintu saṃyukte tatra dūṣitaṃ | puruṣāśanamātraṃ tu vyapohya tadanantaraṃ || 27.152 || bhasmāṃbhasākuśai "rāpo hiraṇya pavamāna'kaiḥ | prokṣya devaṃ susaṃprārdhya tadgṛhītvā nivedayeth || 27.153 || pūrvamarkodayātpakva mupadaṃśamatho haviḥ | koṣṇaṃ cedarpayetprātararcanāntena doṣabhāk || 27.154 || pūrva mastamayātpakvaṃ tathā sāyaṃ nivedayeth | asaṃskṛtaṃ tu tāṃbūlaṃ lepakeśānvitaṃ tathā || 27.155 || jantuspṛṣṭaṃ nivedyaiva vaiṣṇavaṃśrīmahīmanun | hutvā saṃskṛtya tāṃbūlaṃ punaranyannivedayeth || 27.156 || arcanāṃgeṣu cānyeṣu padārtheṣvevameva hi | dūṣiteṣvadha hīneṣu tasya tasyādhidaivataṃ || 27.157 || mantraṃ sa vaiṣṇavaṃ hutvā punaranyaissamarcayeth | alābhe caiva sarveṣāṃ puṣpaṃ toyaṃ pragṛhyaca || 27.158 || saṃkalpyaiva pratinidhiṃ tattatsmṛtvā samarcayeth | nityahome vihīnetu vaiṣṇavaṃ daśaśo huneth || 27.159 || yathoktahomaṃ dviguṇamācarettadanantaraṃ | agnisaṃrakṣaṇe'śaktā "vayante yo'nimuccaran || 27.160 || samidhyāropayetkuṇḍātpaścātsaṃsthāpya laukike | nyasya "copāvaro'hetipratyahaṃ juhuyātkramāth || 27.161 || surarṣimanujānāṃ tu balaṃ yasmātpṛvardhate | tasmādbalissamākhyātastadarthaṃ pratyahaṃ hariṃ || 27.162 || uktadravyeṣu cāvāhya triṣu kāleṣu deśikaḥ | abhyarcya bhrāmayedevamaśaktaḥ kartumuttamaṃ || 27.163 || yathoktapātre nikṣipya balidkavyantu kevalaṃ | tasyopari yathoktaṃ tu baliberaṃ ca vinyaseth || 27.164 || śirasā dhārayanpātraṃ trirdvirvā sakṛdeva vā | dene tataḥ parīyācca devāgāraṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ || 27.165 || atha hitvā balidravyaṃ śibikādau gaje'thavā | aropya yāne vidhivatkārayecca pradakṣiṇaṃ || 27.166 || prātarbhramaṇahīne tu vaiṣmavaṃ saurasoṃyakaṃ | prājāpatyaṃ ca juhuyāddhīne coktapradakṣiṇe || 27.167 || vaiṣṇavaṃ gāruḍaṃ hutvā balibhramaṇamācareth | hīne prātarbalau kuryānmadhyāhne dviguṇaṃ baliṃ || 27.168 || tathā hīne ca madhyāhne rātrau triguṇamācareth | ekāhe tu balau hīne nityāgnau vā mahānane || 27.169 || vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktaṃ ca puruṣasūktaṃ tathaiva ca | digdaivatyaṃ ca hutvā tu pradakṣiṇanuthācareth || 27.170 || devālaṅkārahīne tu śrīdaivatyaṃ yajedbudhaḥ | chatrapiñchādyalābhe tu vāruṇaṃ juhuyāttathā || 27.171 || alābhe cāmarādīnāṃ vāyavyaṃ caiva hūyate | dīpālābhe pāvakaṃ ca vyāhṛtyantaṃ yajettrayaṃ || 27.172 || dvyahe tu dviguṇaṃ kurvāttṣahe triguṇameva ca | dvādaśāhāntamevaṃ syāddvādaśāhe gate tataḥ || 27.173 || aupāsanāgnimādhāya vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktakaṃ | puruṣasūktaṃ ca śrībhūmidaivatyaṃ brāhma meva ca || 27.174 || raudraṃ digdevatāmantraṃ hutvaiva bhramaṇaṃ careth | māne'tīte tu padmāgnau vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktaṃ || 27.175 || nṛsūktaṃ pāramātmīkamīṅkārādīṃ stadālaye | pariṣaddevamantrāṃśca hutvā bhramaṇamācareth || 27.176 || dvimāse dviguṇaṃ kuryāttrimāse triguṇaṃ careth | vardhaye dvatsarāntaṃ cāpyatīte vatsare punaḥ || 27.177 || sabhyaṃ saṃsādhya devābhimukhe vā dakṣiṇe nalaṃ | vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktaṃ ca sūktaṃ pauruṣameva ca || 27.178 || śrībhūmyoścaiva daivatyaṃ sarvadaivatyameva ca | hutvā cāryaṃ ca saṃpūjya balyuddharaṇamācareth || 27.179 || patite'nnabalau bhūmyāṃ bhinne jīrṇe ca pūrvavath | balimāpādya hutvā ca vaiṣṇavaṃ gāruḍaṃ tathā || 27.180 || prājāpatyaṃ tu vidhinā tataḥ kuryātpradakṣiṇaṃ | balyuddharaṇakāle tu vighnaścedāpatettadā || 27.181 || sauraṃ soṃyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ ca hutvā punarathācareth | pātrālābhe haviḥpātraṃ hunaidādāya vaiṣṇavaṃ || 27.182 || pramāṇahīne'nnabalau vaiṣṇavaṃ ca prajāpatiṃ | juhuyāddoṣaduṣṭe tu havirniṣkṛtimācareth || 27.183 || āvāhanaṃ vinā cānnabalau tu bhramaṇekṛte | vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktaṃ ca puruṣasūktaṃ tathaiva ca || 27.184 || hutvā śrībhūmidaivatyaṃ vidhinā bhramaṇaṃ careth | balyagrakhaṇḍe vidhinā śāntāya tvanivedite || 27.185 || vaiṣṇavaṃ mūrtimantraṃ ca hutvaiva daśaśaḥ kramāth | nivedya viṣvakcenāya pradāya mukhavāsanaṃ || 27.186 || punaśca balyuddharaṇaṃ vidhinā kārayettataḥ | akṛte balidāne tu prāśya pādodakaṃ hareḥ || 27.187 || prasādaṃ cāpi saṃprāśya punardviguṇamarcayeth | pravṛttāyāṃ tu pūjāyāṃ havirdānāntameva ca || 27.188 || tīrthaprasādadānaṃ vā pādukāgrahaṇaṃ tathā | naśastamanyathā kṛtvā śāntihomaṃ samācareth || 27.189 || pūjānte pūjakātpūrvamanyastīrthādikaṃ pibeth | prasādaṃ vāpi gṛhṇīyāttatpūjā niṣphalā bhaveth || 27.190 || mahāśāntiṃ tathā hutvā punaḥpūjāṃ samācareth | tīrthaṃ puṣpaṃ tataḥ kṣīraṃ gandhaṃ ca tadanantaraṃ || 27.191 || sarvāṇvapi havīṃṣyatra nāgavallīdalānyapi | yadyanniveditaṃ deve dadyādagrer'cakāya ca || 27.192 || arcakastu harissākṣāccararūpo yatassmṛtaḥ | nitye karmaṇi sarvatra pūjakaṃ pūrvamarcayeth || 27.193 || ācārya marcakaṃ vātha tathā naimittiker'cayeth | yadyavaikhānaso vipraḥ kadāpi harimandire || 27.194 || samicchedagrasanmānaṃ taddevasya vimānanaṃ | yajamāno vipannassyādrājarāṣṭraṃ vinaśyati || 27.195 || ajñānādatha vā mohādācale danyathāyadi | dviguṇaṃ tu samabhyarcya cānyaddviguṇa mācareth || 27.196 || aśucirvāpyanācāraḥ sadāvaikhānasa śśuciḥ | pitā mṛṣyati putrāṇāṃ viśaṅkaṃ doṣasaṃcayaṃ || 27.197 || pitā hi bhagavānviṣṇuputrāssyuḥ pūjakā hareḥ | tasmātteṣu na kupyeta dīrghamāyurjijīviṣuḥ || 27.198 || ataḥparaṃ pravakṣyāmi niṣkṛtiṃ snapanāśritāṃ | nityaṃ naimittikaṃ kāmyaṃ trividhaṃ snapanaṃ bhaveth || 27.199 || viṣuve cāyanadvandve snapanaṃ nityamucyate | candra sūryoparoge yannaimittikamiti smṛtaṃ || 27.200 || śeṣeṣu snapanaṃ yattatkāmyaṃ tu parikīrtitaṃ | nityasnāpanahīne tu vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktakaṃ || 27.201 || puruṣasūktaṃ vāruṇaṃ ca daśakṛtvo hunetpunaḥ | snapanaṃ vidhivatkuryānni tyasnapana niṣkṛtiḥ || 27.202 || grahaṇe snapane hīne pūrvavanniṣkṛtiṃ careth | kāmye ca pūrvavatkṛtvā śuddhodairabhiṣecayeth || 27.203 || anyathā cenmahādoṣo yajamāno vinaśyati | ālayātpurataścaiva uttare vā manorame || 27.204 || uttamaṃ snapanāgāramaiśānyāṃ madhyamaṃ bhaveth | paścime dakṣiṇe caivamadhamaṃ saṃprakīrtitaṃ || 27.205 || āgneyyādiṣu koṇeṣu snapane vaiṣṇavaṃ tathā | viṣṇusūktaṃ nṛsūktaṃ ca digīśānāṃ manuṃ huneth || 27.206 || snapanaṃ kārayetpaścādeṣā vyatyaya niṣkṛtiḥ | saṃdhyākāletu saṃprāpte nimittasnapane tathā || 27.207 || naimittikaṃ samāpyaiva nityapūjaṃ samācareth | anyathā vaiṣṇavaṃ mantraṃ śatavāraṃ japetsudhīḥ || 27.208 || pūrvarātrau pratisare hīne ca śayane tathā | vaiṣṇavaṃ śrīmahīmantrānhutvā saudarśanaṃ tathā || 27.209 || śayyādhivāsanaṃ hitvā bandhayetkautukaṃ punaḥ | emabere kautuke tu kartavye śayanaṃ vinā || 27.210 || baddhvā pratisaraṃ sadyassnapanaṃ samyagācareth | kṛte'ṃkurārpaṇe hīne snapane vaiṣṇapaṃ tathā || 27.211 || soṃyaṃ śrībhūmidaivatyaṃ vaighnaṃ hutvābhiṣecayeth | vināṃkurārpaṇaṃ cātha snāpayediti kecana || 27.212 || pramāṇahīne'dhike vā paṅktau snānāvaṭe'pi ca | vaiṣṇavaṃ bhūmidaivatyaṃ paṅktīśasya manuṃ yajeth || 27.213 || hīne śāntādyarcane ca vaiṣṇavaṃ śāntameva ca | paṅktīśasyārcane hīne tanmantraṃ ca jayādīkān || 27.214 || indrādyarcanahīne tu tanmantraṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ huneth | kalaśeṣvapramāṇeṣu vaiṣṇavaṃ vāyudaivataṃ || 27.215 || āgneyaṃ juhuyānmṛtsu hīnāsvatra ca vaiṣṇavaṃ | bhūdaivatyaṃ ca juhuyānmṛtsu sarvāsvayaṃ vidhiḥ || 27.216 || parvateṣyapramāṇeṣu vaiṣṇavaṃ pāvakaṃ huneth | dhānyeṣu vaiṣṇavaṃ caiva vāyavyaṃ ca hunedbudhaḥ || 27.217 || aṅkureṣu vihīneṣu vaiṣṇavaṃ gāruḍaṃ tathā | juhuyādvyāhṛtīścaiva yathārhaṃ saṃbharetpunaḥ || 27.218 || varṇahīneṣvamāneṣu maṅgaleṣu tu vaiṣṇavaṃ | aindraṃ ca juhuyātkuryādyathārhaṃ saṃbharedapi || 27.219 || pañcagavye mantrahīne vihīne yogakarmaṇi | juhuyādvaiṣṇavaṃ raudraṃ mantreṇaiva suyojayeth || 27.220 || uktapramāṇahīneṣu pañcagavyādiṣu kramāth | pradhāneṣu jalaiḥpūrva dravyādhipamanuṃ tathā || 27.221 || vaiṣṇavenaiva mantreṇa saha hutvā samācareth | prāśanaṃ prokṣaṃ vāpi śāstre'sminyatra codyate || 27.222 || ayameva vidhirjñeyaḥ pañcagavyasya sarvataḥ | sādhite kalaśebhinne tvanyamādāya pūrvavath || 27.223 || āpūryābhyarcya daśaśo vaiṣṇavaṃ juhuyāttataḥ | kalaśānāṃ viparyāme taddhṛtenaiva cāplute || 27.224 || vaiṣṇavaṃ dravyadaivatyaṃ hutvā saṃśodhya tatpunaḥ | śuddhodaissnāpayeccaiva yathāvacca punarnyaseth || 27.225 || kṛte tu kalaśanyāse śvakākādibhireva vā | aspṛśyairvāpi saṃsparśe saṃsādhyānyattu pūrvavath || 27.226 || śāntiṃ vaiṣṇavamantrāṃśca hutvā kāryaṃ samācareth | kṛmikīṭādipatane tattaddravyaṃ parityajeth || 27.227 || anyadādāya juhuyādvaiṣṇavaṃ dravyadaivataṃ | ratnālābhe vaiṣṇavaṃ tu hutvā svarṇaṃ tu nikṣipeth || 27.228 || vastrālābhe vaiṣṇavaṃ ca śrīdaivatyaṃ ca hāvayeth | yathoktasnapane hīne kathaṃ citsnapanaṃ careth || 27.229 || atha vā kārayecchuddhasnapanaṃ vā vidhānataḥ | ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi prāyaścittamathotsave || 27.230 || kālādibhedanteṣāṃ ca lakṣaṇaṃ ca puroditaṃ | puraskṛtya tithiṃ kecitkecinnakṣatrapūrvakaṃ || 27.231 || saṃkalpayantyavabhṛthaṃ varamṛkṣāpavargakaṃ | akṛte niyate kālaṃ kṛte vāniyate tathā || 27.232 || kālotsave mahāndoṣastatra kuryāttuniṣkṛtiṃ | utsavātpūrvamuddisya mahāśāntiṃ tṣahaṃ careth || 27.233 || vijñāpya devadeveśaṃ tataḥ kālotsavaṃ careth | anyathā tu kṛtaṃ kāryamakṛtaṃ syādasaṃśayaṃ || 27.234 || anyasminvāpi māse tu na kuryādyadi cotsavaṃ | eṣa eva vidhiḥ proktaḥ parasminvatsare kṛte || 27.235 || evaṃ trivatsarebhyassyādata ūrdhvaṃ viśeṣataḥ | saptāhantu mahāśāntiṃ kṛtvā tūtsava mācareth || 27.236 || eve dvādaśavarṣāntaṃ tataścasthāpanaṃ punaḥ | tatra devo na ramate yo'sāvutsava daivataṃ || 27.237 || yatra devālaye viṣṇusthsāpyate prathamaṃ tataḥ | tenaiva kārayetsarvamācāryeṇār'cakena ca || 27.238 || tadabhāve tu tatputraiḥpautraistadvaṃśajaistathā | tanniyuktaistadīyairvāpūrvābhāve paraiścareth || 27.239 || anyathā kriyate cettu yajamāno vinaśyati | utsavāhassu hīneṣu prāyaścittaṃ samācareth || 27.240 || vardhayedvaiṣṇavaṃ kāryaṃ hrāsayenna kadā cana | pramādādvāpyaśaktau vā kṛtvā saṃprārthayeddhariṃ || 27.241 || mahāśāntiṃ tu hutvaiva śeṣaṃ kuryātprayatnataḥ | eṣa eva vidhirvṛddhau sa tu śreyo'bhivṛddhidaḥ || 27.242 || yadā tvavabhṛthedaivātkṛte vinimayena tu | asaṃkalpitavatkuryāttatra pūrvokta niṣkṛtiḥ || 27.243 || pramādādbuddhipūrvaṃ vā tattadvelotsavādiṣu | akṛteṣu yathāśāstraṃ kṛtvā tantreṇa vaipunaḥ || 27.244 || mantreṇa vā punassūkṣmaṃ kāle'vabhṛthamācareth | yajñasyāpabhṛtho'ntassyānnotsavastadanantaraṃ || 27.245 || akṛtotsavakāryāṇi yathoktaṃ pūrvamācareth | nityotsavaṃ hareḥ kuryānnityaśrī rnityamaṅgalaḥ || 27.246 || harirnārāyaṇo devo nālaṃ devā stamarcituṃ | ācārye yajamāne vā pūjake'nyapadārthini || 27.247 || naṣṭe sadyastadānyantu varayitvā samācareth | na daivaṃ pratibadhnāti kāryaṃ yatkarma mānuṣaṃ || 27.248 || deveśamanumānyātha mahāśāntiṃ tu padmake | samṛto brahmamedhār'haḥ pūtaṃ tadgātramucyate || 27.249 || sarve padārthinaḥ proktā gurupūrvāḥpadārthinaḥ | grāmāntaraṃ prayāte tu dīkṣāmadhye padārthini || 27.250 || aspṛśyasparśadoṣeṇa surāpānādinā tathā | anuktadoṣairvā duṣṭe rogācchaucādyasaṃbhave || 27.251 || śāvādyāśausayogye vā śavānugamane tathā | vāhane dāhane caiva pretānnaśrāddhabhoktari || 27.252 || śrāddhasya yājake śrāddhaśiṣṭabhoktaribhoktari | doṣassyādvidhinā tatra mahāśāntimathācareth || 27.253 || śrāddhakartiri no doṣa statra dātā bhavetsahi | parānnena mukhaṃ dagdhaṃ hastau dagdhau pratigrahāth || 27.254 || parastrībhirmanodagdhaṃ brahmaśāpaḥ kutaḥ kalau | dīkṣāmadhye nānyadīkṣāṃ garbhadīkṣāṃ vinā careth || 27.255 || vidhure yajamāne tu dīkṣitaḥ puruṣo bhaveth | sadāro vā pyadārovā dīkṣitassyātkalatravān || 27.256 || daṃpatī yajamāno cedayamabhyudayo bhaveth | anagnimatyadāre vā gurau taṃ tu na dīkṣayeth || 27.257 || anyasminpadabhājī syādyathāsaṃbhavamādaraḥ | vaidhuryasaṃbhave tveṣāṃ madhye duṣyanti naiva te || 27.258 || vatsarāśaucamitaraccāśaucaṃ na pravartate | mātāpitrormṛtau yattu proktamabhyudaye punaḥ || 27.259 || dhvajārohaṇahīne tu kṛte niṣphala utsavaḥ | kṛtvaivārohaṇaṃ tasmāddhvajasyotsavamācareth || 27.260 || dhvajasyārohaṇaṃ kṛtvā nācaredyadi cotsavaṃ | ajñānādarthalobhādvāmāse' nyasmintsamācareth || 27.261 || nakuryācceddvitīye tu māse kartā vinaśyati | tasmānniṣkṛtimabjāgnau hutvā tūtsavamācareth || 27.262 || vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktaṃ ca nṛsūktaṃ caiva gāruḍaṃ | dhvājaṃ śāntaṃ ca cakraṃ ca tathaivotsavadaivataṃ || 27.263 || vyāhṛtyantaṃ ca hutvā tu vaiṣṇavānpūjya cācareth | dhvajasya lakṣaṇaṃ vakṣye yena mānena kārayeth || 27.264 || vimānena samaṃ vātha pādenār'dhena vādhikaṃ | pādenārdhena hīsaṃ vā pañcadhāpi prakalpayeth || 27.265 || jayaśrīkīrtivijayamaṅgalākhyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ | ardhahīnaṃ na kurvīta tadevāgatikaṃ bhaveth || 27.266 || tasmāccahīnaṃ naiva syādadhikaṃ syāttu śaktitaḥ | avakramṛjumanyenāsaṃbaddhaṃ kīlitādibhiḥ || 27.267 || ślakṣṇaṃ manoharaṃ dāru gṛhītvākhaṇḍamuttamaṃ | taṃ caturdaśadhā kuryāmmālāgre tena kārayeth || 27.268 || bhāgamekaṃ vihāyāgre tatra kuryāttrimekhalāḥ | mekhalānāmathāyāmastadbhāgena samo bhavet, || 27.269 || tritālavistṛtaṃ kuryāddaṇḍavistṛtameva vā | antaraṃ ca samaṃ teṣāṃ tisraḥ kuryāttu yaṣṭikāḥ || 27.270 || yaṣṭī dve purataḥ kuryātpaścādekā vidhīyate | sarvatra kiṅkiṇīnāṃ tu kuryācchatama śeṣataḥ || 27.271 || paścāccheṣaṃ tridhā kuryāccaturdhā vā dhvajaṃ budhaḥ | aṣṭāśraṃ ca ṣaḍaśraṃ ca caturaśraṃ ca vṛttakaṃ || 27.272 || mūlādārabhya kurvīta caturdhā vihitaṃ dhvajaṃ | tridhā kṛte na kuryāttu ṣaḍaśraṃ śeṣamācareth || 27.273 || ādyaṃ bhāgaṃ tridhā kṛtvā kecidevaṃ prakurvate | śikharaṃ śira ityāhurardhena śikharaṃ bhaveth || 27.274 || pramādātpatitaṃ gṛhya śikharaṃ sthāpayedvidhiḥ | spuṭitevātha bhinne vā biṃbasyoktavadācareth || 27.275 || adhiṣṭite tu śikhare dvijairgṛdhrādibhissakṛth | viṣṭhādikaraṇe vāpi uṣite vā nirantaraṃ || 27.276 || vāstuhomaṃ ca hutvaiva paryagnikaraṇaṃ careth | eṣa eva vidhiḥ prokto vimānaśikharādiṣu || 27.277 || adhiṣṭhānena pādena prastareṇa ca saṃyutaṃ | dhvajamūle tviṣṭakābhirvediṃ kuryānmanoharāṃ || 27.278 || na tāmapyadhitiṣṭheta naro dīrghaṃ jijīviṣuḥ | kiṃ punastatra vaktavyamālayādyavarohaṇe || 27.279 || vimānaṃ viṣṇurūpaṃ syānna tatpādādivā krameth | dhāmapradakṣiṇe pūrvaṃ kuryāttatra namastriyāḥ || 27.280 || na laṅghayeddhvajachāyāṃ pradakṣiṇavidhiṃ vinā | gopurasya vimānasya prākārasyālayasya ca || 27.281 || pramādādatilaṅghyaiva prāṇāyāmaśataṃ careth | śivadṛṣṭiṃ viṣṇuvṛṣṭhaṃ durgāyāḥ pārśvato dṛśaṃ || 27.282 || vighneśasyordhvadṛṣṭiṃ ca tīkṣṇamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ | yāvacchāvatarecchāyā tāvatī doṣabhūmikā || 27.283 || doṣabhūmiṃ parityajya nivāsaṃ parikalpayeth | tyāge saṃpatsamṛddhissyādanyathā viparītakṛth || 27.284 || radhyādibhiryathā bhūyādantaraṃ tanna doṣakṛth | atha vā śatadaṇḍāntaṃ tyaktvānve vasatiṃ jaguḥ || 27.285 || yāvaddhāmāyataṃ dāvatpṛṣṭhaṃ vā mughameva vā | tatodhikaṃ tacca tacca kecidāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ || 27.286 || dhvajaṃ nityamuśantyeke yatraiko hyanavāyiṣu | tatrārohaṇakarmādi necchanti paramarṣayaḥ || 27.287 || autsavaṃ dhvajamāsthāpya tatra kāryaṃ prakurvate | dhvajamekaṃ tu sarvatra kecidāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ || 27.288 || ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi dhvajadaṇḍe tu niṣkṛtiṃ | pramādātpatite bhūmyāṃ dhvaje vātādinā dṛḍhe || 27.289 || abhagne vātha bhagne vā dhvajaṃ tatra pūnaḥ kṣipeth | abhagne taṃ dhvajaṃ gṛhya kṛtvā mantreṇa takṣaṇaṃ || 27.290 || adhivāsādikaṃ kṛtvā tatthsāne sthāpayedbudhaḥ | bhagne dhvaje na sagrāhyastamapsu vidhinā tyajeth || 27.291 || tato'nyaṃ dhvajamādāya sthāpayedavilaṃbitaṃ | corādyairbuddhipūrvaṃ vā pātite pūrvavadvidhiḥ || 27.292 || tatrādhikaṃ prakurvīta śilpibhistakṣaṇaṃ punaḥ | abhagnadhvajavatkuryādanyatpūrvavadatvaraḥ || 27.293 || bhāgenānupayuktasya dhvajasya tyājyataiva hi | duṣṭabhāgasya dānena na kadācitparigrahaḥ || 27.294 || atha vā sudṛḍaṃ gṛhya pratiṣṭhāṃ mahatīṃ careth | duṣṭaṃ bhāgaṃ vyapohyaiva pramāṇaṃ lakṣayetpunaḥ || 27.295 || pramāṇamapramāṇaṃ vā dhvajaṃ nānyena dāruṇā | saṃyutāṃ vardhitāṃ kuryādeṣa sārvatriko vidhiḥ || 27.296 || yantu tāmrādinā kuryāllohena kavacādikaṃ | bālālayaṃ prakalpyaiva tatrakāryaṃ samācareth || 27.297 || sthitameva dhvajaṃ kuryānna tu taṃ cālayetkvacith | dagdhaṃ dhvajaṃ parityajya punaranyaṃ samāhareth || 27.298 || dhvaje'ntyajātibhisspṛṣṭe mahāśāntimathācareth | taissamīpamupetaintu sahasrāhutimācareth || 27.299 || patite vātyayā caivaṃ dhvajasya śikhare tathā | mekhalāsu ca tatsarvaṃ navīkṛtya yathāvidhi || 27.300 || dhvajadaṇḍe tu saṃyojya pratiṣṭhāṃ punarācareth | dhvajasya calane cāpi pramādādvraścane tathā || 27.301 || bhagnābhagna dhvajasyoktaniṣkṛtiṃ tu samācareth | eṣa eva vidhiḥ prokto daṇḍeṣvanveṣu sarvataḥ || 27.302 || aśanyādinipātena dhāmanyantarite yadi | deve naṣṭe dhvaje susthe dhvajasyārādhanaṃ bhaveth || 27.303 || ālayaṃ ca punaḥkṛtvā tamevārādhayeddhvajaṃ | nirīkṣyatrīṇi varṣāṇi devāgāre tvanirmite || 27.304 || tatra devo na ramate taddhvajaṃ tu tyajetsudhīḥ | atha vā yatra kutrāpi pratiṣṭhāpya samarcayeth || 27.305 || atha vakṣye dhvajasthānaṃ yathāśāstraviniścitaṃ | piṭhagopurayormadhye pañcabhāgaṃ prakalpya ca || 27.306 || pīṭhāttyaktyā caturbhāgaṃ pañcame dhvajasaṃsthitiḥ | tatsaṃdhau tu praśastaṃ syādyathā saṃphavamācareth || 27.307 || yadi prākārabāhye syāddhvajaśśāstravadācareth | anuktasthānanihitaṃ taṃ ca śāstravadācareth || 27.308 || aśaktau punaranyaṃ ca prākāraṃ kārayetkramāth | devadṛgviṣayaṃ kuryāddhvajaṃ laivāparokṣayeth || 27.309 || yadā cānyālayairvāpi gopurādibhireva vā | abhyantaraṃ bhaveccettu chidraṃ kuryāttu dṛkpathe || 27.310 || vṛkṣādyaiḥpatitairnaṣṭe cālite'vanate'pi ca | taddhyajaṃ pūrvavatkuryāttrimāsābhyantare'tvaraḥ || 27.311 || kṛmyādibhirvihaṅgairvākoṭarādau kṛte dhvaje | kṛtvā bālālayaṃ paścātsamīkṛtyārcayetpunaḥ || 27.312 || rajjubandhādikaraṇe dhvajasyārohaṇe kṛte | bālālayaṃ na tatra syādvāstuśuddhiṃ samācareth || 27.313 || prākṣayetpañcagavyaistu dhvajamantreṇa hūyate | ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi niṣkṛtāvarcanakramaṃ || 27.314 || uktena vidhinā yatra naṣṭe duṣṭe'pi vā dhvaje | punasthsāpanaparyantaṃ kuryādveṇudhvajaṃ śubhaṃ || 27.315 || atha vā kārayedvidvānsuvarṇarajatādibhiḥ | dhvajaṃ tālonnataṃ sthāpya garbhagehe tu pūjayeth || 27.316 || adhivāsādi tatsarvaṃ pratiṣṭhoktavadācareth | acalo veṇudaṇḍaḥ syādgarbhagehe bhaveccalaḥ || 27.317 || utsavādau tu sarvatra veṇudaṇḍaṃ samācareth | caladaṇḍo veṇudaṇḍa iti syādutsavedvayaṃ || 27.318 || utsavādau pravṛtte tu uktadoṣe tvayaṃ vidhiḥ | dhvajasthaṃ garuḍaṃ tasmādavamucya samāhitaḥ || 27.319 || nītvātu yāgaśālāyāṃ saṃsthāpya tu samarcayeth | veṇudaṇḍaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya sadyastasminprayojayeth || 27.320 || mahāśāntiṃ tathā kuryātsahasrāhutimeva ca | vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇudaivatyaṃ gāruḍaṃ dhvājameva ca || 27.321 || saudarśanaṃ ca kūśmāṇḍānśatamaṣṭādhikaṃ yajeth | tathaiva dīpadaṇḍasya bhavetsarvatra cakramaḥ || 27.322 || dhvaje nāropayeddīpaṃ dīpadaṇḍaḥ pṛthagbhaveth | tatra dīpaṃ samāropya na labhetphalamavyayaṃ || 27.323 || dhvaje dīpaṃ samāropya vaiṣṇavaṃ śataśo yajeth | āpatkalpaṃ pravakṣyanti dhvaje dīpāvarohaṇaṃ || 27.324 || dīpayukte dhvaje naṣṭe pūrvavanniṣkṛtiṃ careth | vīśapratiṣṭhāhīne tu dhvajasyārohaṇe kṛte || 27.325 || vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktaṃ ca nṛsūktaṃ dhvājameva ca | gāruḍaṃ daśaśo hutvā pratiṣṭhāṃ punarācareth || 27.326 || dhvajadevasya cakrasya śāntanandīśayostathā | hīner'cane vaiṣṇavaṃ ca taddaivatyasamanvitaṃ || 27.327 || hutvaiva punarabhyarcya paścātkāryaṃ samācareth | bherītāḍanahīne ca raudraṃ ca vyāhṛtīstathā || 27.328 || hutvā mahāvyāhṛtīśca bherītāḍanamācareth | arcanādiṣu sarvatra yatra ghaṇṭāninādanaṃ || 27.329 || eṣa eva vidhiḥ proktaḥ prāyaścittaṃ samācareth | āropite tu garuḍe hīne caiva nivedane || 27.330 || vaiṣṇavaṃ dhvaṃmetrau ca hutvā gāruḍameva ca | nivedayettudviguṇaṃ "kṣama'svetyanumānayeth || 27.331 || mudgānne tu tathā hīne vaiṣṇavaṃ vāyudaivataṃ | āgneyamīṅkārādīṃśca gāruḍaṃ dhvājameva ca || 27.332 || hutvā yatnena bahuśo maudgikaṃ ca nivedayeth | varṣavātātapaissamyagupaghātādisaṃbhave || 27.333 || viṣṭhādyupahate caiva pakṣiṇāmasakṛtsakṛth | rajjvāditruṭane caiva pramādātpatane'pi ca || 27.334 || pātite buddhipūrvaṃ vā akāle'pyavaropite | śūdrādyairanulomairvā spṛṣṭe dhvajagate paṭe || 27.335 || aśuciṃ śodhayitvānyatsamīkṛtyāsamīkṛtaṃ | utsavādhipadaivatyaṃ ṣaḍvāraṃ juhuyādguruḥ || 27.336 || gāruḍaṃ dhvajamantraṃ ca sahastaṃ caiva hūyatāṃ | tataśśeṣaṃ samāpyeta viparītaṃ na kārayeth || 27.337 || pramādādbuddhipūrvaṃ vā paṭe dagdhe'nyamāhareth | śāntiṃ pūrvoditāṃ kṛtvā pratiṣṭhāṃ punarācareth || 27.338 || avarohaṇamudvāsantaṃ ca mantreṇa kārayeth | avarohaṇahīne tu mantreṇodvāsanaṃ bhaveth || 27.339 || tataśśeṣaṃ prakūrvīta aśaktāvavarohaṇe | apramāṇaṃ paṭaṃ gṛhya mahāśāntiṃ samācareth || 27.340 || punaranyaṃ samādāya karmaśeṣaṃ samācareth | hīne tu cotsavāraṃbhasnapane vaiṣṇavaṃ tathā || 27.341 || viṣṇusūktaṃ nṛsūktaṃ ca vāruṇaṃ caiva hūyate | śuddhodadairabhiṣākassyātprāyaścittavidhissmṛtaḥ || 27.342 || hīne kautukabandhe tu vaiṣṇavaṃ śāntameva ca | saudarśanaṃ ca hutvā tu kautukaṃ bandhayetpunaḥ || 27.343 || yajñāgāre kuṃbhavedyāhīne vāpyadhike'pi vā | vaiṣṇavaṃ pāvakaṃ bhūmidaivatyaṃ ca hunedbudhaḥ || 27.344 || toraṇānāmalābhe tu huneddauvārikānmanūn | hīnāyāṃ darbhamālāyāmārṣaṃ hutvetarāṅkriyāth || 27.345 || alaṅkāravihīne tu śrīdaivatyaṃ tadhā huneth | prātarbaliṃ tu nirvāpya hīne nityotsave tathā || 27.346 || vaiṣṇavaṃ śāntavīśau ca hutvā cotsavadaivataṃ | sāyaṃ kuryādutsavaṃ tu dviguṇaṃ kārayetkramāth || 27.347 || sāyaṃ hīnaṃ tu dviguṇaṃ prātarutsavamācareth | ekakālotsavaścettu kṛtvā kāladvayaṃ baliṃ || 27.348 || sāyāhne cotsavaṃ kuryātkālātīte'pyayaṃ vidhiḥ | digdevatāssamāvāhya prathame'hani pūjayeth || 27.349 || prācyādi balidānaṃ syādīśānāntaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ | devāhvāne vyatyayassyādvyatīhāro'tha vā bhaveth || 27.350 || pūrvoktāṃ niṣkṛtiṃ kṛtvā dviguṇaṃ tu baliṃ dadeth | brahmaṇaśca digīśānāṃ balidānaṃ tu naityikaṃ || 27.351 || adāne niṣkṛtiṃ kṛtvā pūrvoktaṃ ṣaḍguṇaṃ baliḥ | catuṣpathādhidevānāṃ vṛkṣādīnāmathecchayā || 27.352 || prathamāvāhanādarvāgvyatyaye pūrvaniṣkṛtiḥ | prathamaṃ vāstuśuddhissyādya vai dīyate baliḥ || 27.353 || antaṃ śuddhyanti rathyāstāśśurdhyanti samaye punaḥ | akṛtāyāṃ vāstuśuddhau dadyādrathyāsu cedbaliṃ || 27.354 || śāntiṃ kṛtvātu pūrvoktāṃ vāstuśuddhiṃ panarbaliḥ | antaśśace vāstuni tu na balibhramaṇaṃ careth || 27.355 || śavamuddhṛtya paścāttu paryagni karaṇaṃ bhaveth | akāle balidānaṃ syādasuraprītivardhanaṃ || 27.356 || akāle tu baliṃ datvā kāle tu triguṇaṃ baliḥ | balibhramaṇadeśassyāddevasya bhramaṇāya hi || 27.357 || nānyatra caryā devasya laghuprokṣaṇa manyathā | na hi śraddhotsave doṣamuśantyenaṃ sa hītaraḥ || 27.358 || vāstuvṛddhau tathā hrāse grāmasīmānavīkṛtau | anumānya ca deveśaṃ śatāṣṭakalaśāplavaḥ || 27.359 || kṛtvā sīmāṃ viniścitya tataḥ kāryaṃ samācareth | astarā cotsavaṃ kuryātsahasrakalaśāplavaḥ || 27.360 || devatāvāhanaṃ kṛtvā tathaivotsava mācareth | devādīnāṃ balaṃ yasmādvardhate sa balissmṛtaḥ || 27.361 || śvasūkarādibhirduṣṭairnabhakṣyo balirucyate | balibhugvāyasaḥ prokto gomukhyā medhyajantavaḥ || 27.362 || viparīte mahāndoṣastanmantrairhāvayecchataṃ | baliśeṣaṃ na śūdro'dyādarcako baliśeṣabhāk || 27.363 || balāvamantrakaṃ kṣipte saṃkṣipte vidhivarjite | bhakṣite cānulomādyaiḥpūrvoktāṃ niṣkṛtiṃ careth || 27.364 || balau paryuṣite'tyuṣṇe tathā caivānivedite | nivedanātprāgarvāgvādṛṣṭe śūdrādibhirbalau || 27.365 || pūrvoktāṃ niṣkṛtiṃ kṛtvā sarvatra dviguṇaṃ baliḥ | devatāvāhanaṃ yatra deśeprākkriyate tataḥ || 27.366 || tatraiva balidānaṃ syādyāvadudvāsanaṃ bhaveth | maṇḍalaṃ ca jalaṃ kūrcamāhvānādhāra ucyate || 27.367 || rathyāsu balidānāya pīṭhaṃ śailādibhirbhaveth | balidānaṃ tu guptaṃ syānna tatbaśyantyavaidikāḥ || 27.368 || tatthsāvaṃ tu tiraskuryātkāle yavanikādibhiḥ | balipradānahīne tu vaiṣṇavaṃ balirakṣakaṃ || 27.369 || hutvā tu niṣkṛtiṃ kuryādbalidānaṃ punastadā | balidravye'tha vā pātre patite bhūtale tathā || 27.370 || bhinne naṣṭe ca pūrvoktaṃ hutvānyaṃ balimāhareth | balidānaṃ tu kṛtvaiva bhutapīṭhe kṣipettataḥ || 27.371 || baliśeṣamanukte tu sthāne buddhyā tu nirvapeth | vaiṣṇavaṃ cākṣahamanuṃ vaiṣvakcenaṃ ca gāruḍaṃ || 27.372 || saudarśanaṃ ca hutvaiva bhūtapīṭhe bali kṣipeth | havirnivedane hīnehīne ca dviguṇārcane || 27.373 || śāntiṃ ca vaiṣṇavaṃ hutvā tathābhyarcya nivedayeth | yathoktahome hīne tu vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktakaṃ || 27.374 || nṛsūktaṃ ca trayastriṃśatkṛtvo hutvā hunetpunaḥ | cakravīśāmitānāṃ ca kuṃbhasthānāmathāpivā || 27.375 || devānāmarcane hīne vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktakaṃ | nṛsūktaṃ sāntamantrau ca gāruḍaṃ cākrameva ca || 27.376 || hutvā punassamabhyarcya viśeṣeṇa nivedayeth | devālaṅkaraṇe hīne śrīdaivatyaṃ ca vaiṣṇavaṃ || 27.377 || hudvālaṅkāramāsādya vidhīnā bhūṣayedguruḥ | alaṅkāreṣu dravyeṣu niryāsaṃ candanaṃ sumaṃ || 27.378 || taddhitvānyatsamādāya dravyaṃ prakṣālyamantrataḥ | pañcagavyaissamabhyukṣya tenālaṅkāra ucyate || 27.379 || nṛtte geye'tha vā hīne vaiṣṇavaṃ rudradaivataṃ | stotrahīne tathā brāhmaṃ hutvā sārasvataṃ tataḥ || 27.380 || bhaktabṛndaiḥ parivṛtau hīnāyāṃ vāruṇaṃ tathā | vaiṣṇavaṃ śāntadaivatyaṃ hīne picchādike tathā || 27.381 || vaiṣṇavaṃ juhuyāttadvaddhavirakṣamanuṃ tataḥ | yānātkāle yāgaśālāṃ deve na pratigacchati || 27.382 || bhavennityārcanaṃ tatra yatradevo'dhivāsitaḥ | dhruvārcanaṃ yathā pūrvaṃ na tatrāsti vyatikramaḥ || 27.383 || devaṃ pratyāgataṃ dṛṣṭyā punaranyotsavaṃ careth | dinavyapāye kuryācca tatkālaniyatotsavaṃ || 27.384 || atītamutsavaṃ cāpi tantreṇātra samācareth | taddinepyapramādāccedbhūyātkālasya yāpanaṃ || 27.385 || na jahyā devakuryācca tatkālocitamutsavaṃ | atra pramādetu bhavetpūrvoktaiva hi niṣkṛtiḥ || 27.386 || dīkṣito vastramālyādyaiḥ pañcāgārpitabhūṣaṇaiḥ | carennityaṃ viśuddhātmā viparīte tu doṣakṛth || 27.387 || dīkṣāṅgasya tu vastrasya tathā pratisarasya vā | nāśe tatra mahāndoṣastadānyatpunarāhareth || 27.388 || sahasraṃ viṣṇugāyatrīṃ hutvā śāntimathācareth | yāvaddīkṣābhavettāvaddīkṣāṅgasya parigrahaḥ || 27.389 || antetu tadgatāśaktissvayamevāvahīyate | atha vā mocanaṃ kuryādite ke cidvadantihi || 27.390 || tatra pūrṇāhutiṃ kālaṃ pravadanti vipaścitaḥ | pratiṣṭhānte tu sā dīkṣā bhavedutsavasaṃgatā || 27.391 || na tatra dīkṣāsāṃkaryaṃ dvayamekatra cedyadi | anyonyaṃ kalahāyante yadyācāryādayaḥkratau || 27.392 || mahānanarthastatra syātpratibhūrgururatra hi | guruvākyaṃ ca rājājñāṃ samamāhurmaharṣayaḥ || 27.393 || dīkṣite vartamāne tu nānyaṃ tatra praveśayeth | nahyekasminbhavetkārya ācāryadvaya saṃgatiḥ || 27.394 || pramādādbuddhipūrvaṃ vā kalahe kṣatajasrutiḥ | kṣatāni vā bhaveyustaṃ visṛjyānyena kārayeth || 27.395 || na tasya tu bhaveddīkṣā mahāśāntiṃ tu kārayeth | sa dīkṣito bhavedeva pūrvasya pkaṇidhissa hi || 27.396 || yāvadāśaucasaṃkrānti rāśaucetvaśucirbhaveth | punaranyaṃ samādāya śeṣaṃ pūrvavadāyareth || 27.397 || ādau madhye tadhānte ca hīne brāhmaṇabhojane | trivākaṃ tu mahāśāntiṃ hutvā brāhmaṇabhojanam, || 27.398 || dviguṇaṃ kārayeccaiva vaiṣṇavānāṃ tu pūjanaṃ | punāti pūjitassadyaḥ pāpmabhyo vaiṣṇapassakṛth || 27.399 || avaiṣṇavaiśca pāṣaṇḍairūḍhe deve dvanarthakṛth | taddoṣaśāntaye kuryātsahasrakalaśāplavaṃ || 27.400 || avaiṣṇavakṛtāpūjā hanti puṇyaṃ purātanaṃ | yānāttu patite deve śīghramuddhṛtya sādaraṃ || 27.401 || "kṣama'svetyanumānyaiva śuddhodairabhiṣicyaca | vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktaṃ ca nṛsūktaṃ sahitaṃ kramāth || 27.402 || dinādhipasya daivatyaṃ hutvā cotsavamācareth | cakravīśākhamitādīnāṃ biṃbābhāve pṛthakpṛthak || 27.403 || taṇḍuloparipātreṣu kūrceṣvāvāhya mantrataḥ | tattadrūpaṃ tu saṃsmṛtya samabhyarcya vidhānataḥ || 27.404 || hutvā ca tattaddaivatyaṃ paścādutsavamācareth | patane tu tathaiteṣāmuddhṛtyaiva ca pūrvavath || 27.405 || snāpayitvā hunettattaddaivatyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ tathā | yānāttu patite biṃbe hīnāṅge doṣagaurave || 27.406 || padmānale mahāśāntiṃ hutvā taddoṣaśāntaye | dhruvabere samāropya taccaktiṃ vidhinā tataḥ || 27.407 || kautukaṃ snāpanaṃ vātha baliberamathāpi vā | yathārhaṃ samalaṅkṛtya samāvāhya yathāvidhi || 27.408 || samabhyarcyotsavaṃ kuryānna tatrasyādvyatikramaḥ | berāntarasyālābhe tu ratnaṃ vā kāñcanaṃ tathā || 27.409 || nyasya pātre samāvāhya samabhyarcya dine dine | mahāśāntiṃ ca hutvaiva punarutsavamācareth || 27.410 || hīnāṅgaṃ ca punarberaṃ saṃdhānavidhinā punaḥ | saṃdhāya cātvareṇaiva pratiṣṭhāṃ punarācareth || 27.411 || patane gāyagādīnāṃ śrīdaivatyaṃ ca vaiṣṇavaṃ | vādakānāṃ tu patanai brāhmaṃ raudraṃ tathaiva ca || 27.412 || ācāryādīnāṃ tu patane saṃkṣobhe ca tathākṛte | ārṣabhaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ tadvaddhvajādīnāṃ ca pātane || 27.413 || dhvājaṃ ca vāruṇaṃ caiva vāyavyaṃ ca hunedvidhiḥ | varṣadhārāsu vātyāyāṃ vidyudvrajasamāhatau || 27.414 || kāle na cotsavaṃ kuryātkuryāccedvaiṣṇavaṃ tathā | viṣṇusūktaṃ nṛsūktaṃ ca śrībhūdaivatyameva ca || 27.415 || hutvotsavaṃ prakurvīta viparīte tu doṣakṛth | vīthyantare varṣadhārāpraveśe'śanigarjite || 27.416 || tṛṇapāṃsu samāyuktavātasparśe viśeṣataḥ | kalahadhvanisaṃyukte devaṃ saṃsnāpya mantravith || 27.417 || vaiṣṇavaṃ digdaivatyaṃ ca vāruṇaṃ vāyudaivataṃ | yaddevādīṃśca hutvaiva punarutsavamācareth || 27.418 || kalahe rudhirasrāve dāhe cāpyutsave tataḥ | vaiṣṇapaṃ cāgnidaivatyaṃ brāhmaṃ raudraṃ tathaiva ca || 27.419 || taddinādhipadaivatyaṃ juhuyātprārthayeddhariṃ | ālayābhyantare caiva śastrādyairmaraṇe sati || 27.420 || tacchīghramapahāyaiva padmāgnau juhuyāttathā | mahāśāntiṃ taddinādhidaivatyaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ || 27.421 || vīthyāṃ cenmarahaṇādautu tacchīghraṃ tu vyapohya ca | śāntihomaṃ ca hutvaiva punarutsavamācareth || 27.422 || nāḍikāyā athāryākcetpunarutsavamācareth | ālayasyāśītidaṇḍābhyantare tu śave sati || 27.423 || tatrotsavaṃ na kuryāttu kuryāccetsa vinaśyati | tacchīghramapahāyeva prāyaścittaṃ yathoditaṃ || 27.424 || mahāśāntiṃ pārṣadaṃ ca cahutvā cotsavamācareth | lagare vidhireṣassyādgrāmenaiṣa vikalpyate || 27.425 || antaśsavenaiva kuryādutsavaṃ grāmavṛddhaye | dhvajasvārohaṇādurdhvaṃ yāvattīrthadinaṃ bhaveth || 27.426 || anyātsavaṃ śubhaṃ karma kuryāccedābhicārikaṃ | taddoṣaśamanāyaiva vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktakaṃ || 27.427 || nṛsūktaṃ pārṣadaṃ caiva hutvā viprāṃstu bhojayeth | tīrthāhātpūrvarātrau tu hīne kautuka bandhane || 27.428 ||
