śayane vā vaiṣṇavaṃ ca śrībhūdaivatyameva ca | saudarśanaṃ ca hutvānte yathoktaṃ tu samācareth || 27.429 || tīrthasnāne tu kālasyātīte hīne ca vaiṣmavaṃ | vāruṇaṃ skandadaivatyaṃ hutvā cauktaṃ samācareth || 27.430 || dhvajāvarohaṇe hīne tadrātrau dhvājameva ca | gāruḍaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ hutvā deveśaṃ prārthayedguruḥ || 27.431 || avarohaṇakāre tu balau hīne viśeṣataḥ | dhvajadevaṃ susaṃpūjya vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktakaṃ || 27.432 || tadālayasthadevānāṃ mantrāṃścaiva viśeṣataḥ | hutvā deveśamabhyarchya dhvajaṃ samavarohayeth || 27.433 || utsavāntāplavehīne vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktakaṃ | puruṣasūktaṃ jayādīnaśca mūrtimantrāśca hāvayeth || 27.434 || atrānukteṣu doṣeṣu prāyaścittaṃ bhavedidaṃ | vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktaṃ ca nṛsūktaṃ ca tathaiva ca || 27.435 || hūyate viṣṇugāyatrī sarvapāpaprāṇāśini | evamaṣṭāviṃśatirvā śaktāvaṣṭottaraṃ śataṃ || 27.436 || iti śrīvaikhānase bhagavacchāstre bhṛguproktāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prakīrṇādhikāre saptaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ <28> athāṣṭāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ prāyaścittam athāspṛśyasparśanetuprāyaścittaṃ pravakṣyate | sarpamūṣakamaṇḍūkamārjāranakulādiṣu || 28.1 || garbhāgāraṃ praviṣṭeṣu viṇmūtrādivisarjane | vyapohya tatpañcagavyaistathābliṅgābhireva ca || 28.2 || vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇugāyatrīṃ śatamaṣṭottaraṃ japeth | dhruvaṃ cai vādhitiṣṭhatsu viṇmūtrādivisarjane || 28.3 || kṣipraṃ vastreṇa saṃśodya mārjayitvā kuśena ca | "āpo hiraṇyavarṇā'bhiḥ "pāpamānī'bhireva ca || 28.4 || saṃsrokṣya cārcayeddevamanyatā viparītakṛth | sparśetaireva biṃbānāṃ śuddhodaissnāpayedvidhiḥ || 28.5 || udakyayā sūtikayā rajakenāntyajātibhiḥ | prathamāvaraṇe viṣṭe cārcāsthāne ca parṣadāṃ || 28.6 || praviṣṭe cātha saṃspṛṣṭe dārbheṇoddīpya vahninā | hutvā ca vāstu yajñeva pañcagavyaissamukṣya ca || 28.7 || kṛtvā puṇyāhamante tu nityāgnau juhuyāttataḥ | dauvārikamanuṃ caiva dvārapālaṃ ca vaiṣṇavaṃ || 28.8 || bāṅyāvaraṇapakṣe tu mārjanenopalepanaiḥ | prokṣaṇairvāstuyajñeva śuddhirbhavati sarvataḥ || 28.9 || arcākāne tu dṛṣṭeṣu caiteṣu vidhinā hariṃ | saṃsnāpya pañcagavyaintu śuddhodaissnāpya cātvaraḥ || 28.10 || prokṣaṇaiḥ prokṣya hutvā tu pūrvavacchārcayettataḥ | eteṣu saṃpraviṣṭeṣu cālayābhyantare tathā || 28.11 || tatspṛṣṭahaviṣāṃ caiva pramādāttu nivedane | śodhayitvātha taddravyaṃ yathāvidhi viśeṣataḥ || 28.12 || vāstuhomaṃ ca hutvātha paryagnikaraṇaṃ careth | pañcagavyaissamabhyukṣya puṇyāhamapi vācayeth || 28.13 || saṃsnāpya kalaśairdevaṃ hutvā nityānale tataḥ | vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktaṃ ca nṛsūktaṃ raudrameva ca || 28.14 || brāhmaṃ ca śrīmahīsūkte brāhmaṇānbhojayettataḥ | spṛṣṭetu caitairbiṃbeṣu dhruvādiṣu viśeṣataḥ || 28.15 || kṛtvātu pūrvavacchuddhiṃ vāstuhomaṃ ca kārayeth | paryagnipañcagavyābhyāṃ śodhayitvā tataḥparaṃ || 28.16 || saṃsnāpya kalaśairdevamabjāgnau vidhivattadā | mahāśāntiṃ ca hutvaiva pratiṣṭhāṃ punarācareth || 28.17 || śūdrādyairanulomaiśca spṛṣṭaṃ datvā havistataḥ | pañca gavyaiśca śuddhodairdevaṃ saṃsnāpya cādarāth || 28.18 || puṇyāhaṃ kārayetpaśchāddviguṇaṃ tu nivedayeth | mahāpātakibhiścaiva caṇḍālai pulkasādibhiḥ || 28.19 || ālaye saṃpraviṣṭe tu tatspṛṣṭhe vinivedite | saptāhaṃ mahatīṃ śāntiṃ hutvābjāgnau vidhānataḥ || 28.20 || saṃsnāpya kalaśairdevaṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ punarācareth | punaścadhruvabere vā biṃbeṣyanyeṣu mandire || 28.21 || spṛṣṭeṣu pūrvavacchuddhiṃ kṛtvā dviguṇameva ca | hutvā tu mahatīṃ śāntiṃ saṃsnāpya kalaśairvibhuṃ || 28.22 || pratiṣṭhoktakrameṇaiva pratiṣṭhāṃ punarācareth | patite caiva pāṣaṇḍe cānyatantreṇa dīkṣite || 28.23 || praviṣṭe garbhagehe tu vāstuśuddhiṃ vidhāya ca | hutvā tu mahatīṃ śāntiṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ punarācareth || 28.24 || ukteṣveteṣu satataṃ prathamāvaraṇe tathā | dvitīye vā saṃcaratsu māse'tīte viśeṣataḥ || 28.25 || māsamekaṃ mahāśāntiṃ hutvā kṛtvā vidhānataḥ | karṣaṇādi punaḥkṛtvā pratiṣṭhāṃ punarācareth || 28.26 || tathā saṃvatsare'tīte tyaktvā cāvāhanādikaṃ | kautukādīntsusaṃrakṣya garbhāgārādi sarvataḥ || 28.27 || vāsayedgā viśeṣeṇa māse'tīte viśeṣataḥ | sarvatra śuddhiṃ kṛtvātu hutvā māsatrayaṃ tataḥ || 28.28 || mahāśāntiṃ tathā kṛtvā karṣaṇādi punaḥkriyāḥ | bālālayaṃ ca saṃkalpya biṃbaśuddhimāthācareth || 28.29 || jalādhivāsanādyaiśca tathā vittānusārataḥ | aśītyadhikasāhasraissaṃsnāpya kalaśairhariviṃ || 28.30 || brāhmaṇānbhojayitvaiva saṃpūjyāpi ca vaiṣṇavān | bālālaye pratiṣṭhāpya deveśaṃ vidhivattataḥ || 28.31 || ālayaṃ caiva sarvatra navīkṛtya viśeṣataḥ | mahāpratiṣṭhāṃ kṛtvaiva devadevaṃ samarcayeth || 28.32 || etaissaṃsargiṇāṃ sparśe sūtikāktaiva niṣkṛtiḥ | sparśe tatsaṃsargiṇāṃ ca śuddhissyātsnapanādinā || 28.33 || tatassaṃsargiṇāṃ caiva na doṣaḥ parikathyate | aśoṃavaddvijaspṛṣṭahaviṣāṃ ca nivedane || 28.34 || ekāhaṃ tu mahāśāntiṃ hutvā saṃsnāpya caudakaiḥ | puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvaiva pūrvavacca samarcayeth || 28.35 || spṛṣṭeṣu cātha biṃbeṣu kautukādiṣu vā dhruve | pūrvavanmahatīṃ śāntiṃ hutvā saṃsthāpayetpunaḥ || 28.36 || praviṣṭe cālayādbāṅye sarvatra ca yathārhakaṃ | gauravaṃ lāghavaṃ jñātvā sarvamūhyaiva kārayeth || 28.37 || khadyaitapakṣijātādipraveśe cālayāntare | sparśane caiva biṃbānāṃ kṛtvā paryagni pūrvavath || 28.38 || saṃśodya pañcagavyaistu śuddhodairabhiṣicya ca | prokṣaṇaiḥ prokṣyanityāgnau chullyāṃ vā vaiṣṇavaṃ huneth || 28.39 || biṃbādīntatsamīpasthānsaṃśodhyaiva ca pūrvavath | śuddhodaissnāpya puṇyāhaṃ kṛtvoktaṃ homamācareth || 28.40 || pūrvamukteṣu deśeṣu śvādīnāṃ vā nṛṇāmapi | chedane tāḍane caiva raktasrāve mṛtau tathā || 28.41 || tadvyapauhya ca taddeśaśuddhiṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ | vāstuhomaṃ ca hutvaiva kalaśaissnāpya saptabhiḥ || 28.42 || taddoṣaśamanārthaṃ ca mahāśāntiṃ hunettataḥ | abhyarcya pūrvavaddevaṃ havissamyaṅni vedayeth || 28.43 || saṃbhūte tvālayādbāhye kṛtvā paryagni pūrvavath | devaṃ śuddhodakaissnāpya śāntiṃ hutvā vidhānataḥ || 28.44 || saṃpūjya vaiṣṇavāṃścaiva pūrvavatsamyagarcayeth | deveśasya śave dṛṣṭe saṃsnāpya kalaśairhariṃ || 28.45 || vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktaṃ ca pauruṣaṃ juhuyāttataḥ | gajāśvapaśumukheṣu prathamāvaraṇe punaḥ, || 28.46 || mṛteṣu tadvyapohyaiva khanitvā tādṛśaṃ sthalaṃ | vāstuhomaṃ ca hutvā tu śaddhodairabhiṣicya ca || 28.47 || vaiṣṇapaṃ viṣṇusūktaṃ ca pauruṣaṃ juhuyādvidhiḥ | prasvede rudhirasrāve rodane jalpane tathā || 28.48 || hāse dṛṣṭe mahābere satsu dhūmādiṣu svataḥ | ālayābhimukhe'bjāgniṃ sādhayitvātha vaiṣṇavaṃ || 28.49 || viṣṇusūktaṃ nṛsūktaṃ cariṅkārānpāramātmikaṃ | hutvā saṃsnāpya deveśaṃ kalaśaissaptabhiḥ kramāth || 28.50 || samabhyarcya havirdatvā brāhmaṇānbhojya sādaraṃ | vaiṣṇavāṃśca susaṃpūjya dadyādāyāryadakṣiṇāṃ || 28.51 || tṛṇavalmīkakīṭādāvutpanne tatra pūrvavath | śāntiṃ pūrvoditāṃ hutvābhojayitvāpi brāhmaṇān || 28.52 || devaṃ bālālaye sthāpya navīkaraṇamācareth | vimāne tu haṭhādbhinne patite vā vidhānataḥ || 28.53 || śāntiṃ māsatrayaṃ hutvā karṣaṇādi vidhāya ca | bālālayaṃ ca saṃkalpya kṛtvā cāpsvadhivāsanaṃ || 28.54 || biṃbaśuddhiṃ tu kṛtvaiva saṃsnāpya kalaśairhariṃ | aśītyadhikasrāhasrairyathāvibhavavistaraṃ || 28.55 || brāhmaṇānbhojayitvaiva saṃpūjyaiva tu vaiṣṇavān | devaṃ bālālaye sthāpya navīkṛtyālayādikaṃ || 28.56 || sarvatra cāviśeṣeṇa pratiṣṭhāṃ punarācareth | tatrāśanihate caiva makṣikādiphirāvṛte || 28.57 || saṃsnāpya kalaśairdevaṃ pūjāṃ kṛtvā viśeṣataḥ | prabhūtaṃ tu nivedyaiva hutvā śāntiṃ vidhānataḥ || 28.58 || brāhmaṇānbhaujayitvaiva punassaṃdhānamācareth | sthūpikīle vinaṣṭe tu vimānopari saṃsthite || 28.59 || vimānakalpavatkṛtvā punassaṃdhānamācareth | akāśe pratisūryasya darśane vaiṣṇavaṃ tathā || 28.60 || sauraṃ ca daśakṛtvantu hutvābhyarcya viśeṣataḥ | digdāhe vaiṣṇavaṃ digdaivatyamāgneyameva ca || 28.61 || śilāvarṣe vāruṇaṃ ca vaiṣṇavaṃ triścatriṃśatā | akāle śaśinaḥ pūrtaukṣaye vā pratidarśane || 28.62 || mahotpāte ca mahatīṃ hutvā śāntiṃ vidhānataḥ | devaṃ viśeṣato'bhyarca brāhmaṇānbhojayettataḥ || 28.63 || ālayābhyantare bāhyaprākāre vā viśeṣataḥ | raktastrīdarśanecaivaṃ taṃ deśaṃ pariśodhya ca || 28.64 || devaṃ viśeṣato'bhyarcya havissamyaṅnivedayeth | dhruvabere kautukādau spṛṣṭe caiva dhruvoditāṃ || 28.65 || śuddhiṃ jalādhivāsaṃ ca kṛtvā saṃsthāpayetpunaḥ | garbhālaye tu sarpādidarśane tadvyapohya ca || 28.66 || gomayenopalipyaiva gavyairabhyukṣya pañcabhiḥ | aupāsanāgnimādhāya vaiṣṇavaṃ śāntimācareth || 28.67 || puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvaiva brāhmaṇānbhojayettataḥ | sarpādau tu mṛte tatra tadvyapauhyopalipya ca || 28.68 || pañcagavyaintu saṃprokṣya vāstuśuddhiṃ vidhāya ca | saṃsnāpya kalaśairdevaṃ caturviṃśatibhistadā || 28.69 || ekāhaṃ paiṇḍarīkāgnau mahāśāntiṃ vidhāya ca | dhruvādiṣu tu biṃbeṣu muhusspṛṣṭeṣu taistathā || 28.70 || devaṃ śuddhodakaissnāpya mahāśāntiṃ vidhāya ca | puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvaiva viśeṣārcanamācareth || 28.71 || mṛte prāsādabāhye tu tadvyapohya ca pūrvavath | prokṣaṇaiḥ prokṣya ca huneddigdaivatyaṃ ca vaiṣṇadaṃ || 28.72 || pākasthāne gopurādau mṛte sarpe vyapohya ca | upalipya ca nityāgnau vaiṣṇavaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ || 28.73 || tatthsānādhipadaivatyaṃ daśaśo juhuyādvidhiḥ | ālayābhyantare caiva sarpatrāvaraṇe'pi vā || 28.74 || mahāvāte'vivṛṣṭau vā śatrucorādyupaplave | saṃsmāpya kalaśairdevaṃ vāstuhomaṃ vidhāya ca || 28.75 || paryagni pañcagavyābhyāṃ śodhayitvā vidhānataḥ | puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvaiva vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktakaṃ || 28.76 || nṛsūktaṃ śrīmahīmantrānbrāhmaṃ raudraṃ viśeṣataḥ | prājāpatyaṃ ca hutvaiva brāhmaṇānbhojayedvidhiḥ || 28.77 || atha vakṣye viśeṣeṇa bhayarakṣārthaniṣkṛtiṃ | corairamitrairatha vā paracakreṇa saṃkule || 28.78 || lohajapratimānāṃ ca tirodhānaṃ prakalpayeth | śucau deśe sugupte tu khanitvā cāvaṭaṃ ghanaṃ || 28.79 || sikatābhiḥ prapūryaiva kuśānāstīrya copari | avaṭe'bhyarcya bhūdevī "mapo hi'ṣṭheti prokṣya ca || 28.80 || devāgāraṃ praviśyaiva yajamānayuto guruḥ | devadevaṃ praṇamyaiva samabhyarcyānumānya ca || 28.81 || "yāvatkālaṃ bhayaṃ bhūyāttāvadīśa janārdana | hariśyā sahita statra śayīdhā' iti sanmanuṃ || 28.82 || vījñāpya śaktiṃ biṃbasthāṃ dhruvabere'varopayeth | berābhāve tu hṛdaye samāropya vidhānataḥ || 28.83 || "paraṃ raṃha' iti procya pīṭhādādāya cātvaraḥ | "pratadviṣṇu stavata' ityavaṭe nyasya rakṣitaṃ || 28.84 || "yadvaiṣṇava'miti procya prākchiraśśāyayettataḥ | avaṭaṃ sikatābhirvā mṛdā vā pūrva yatnataḥ || 28.85 || acchidraṃ sudṛḍhaṃ kuryādavaṭaṃ parirakṣitaṃ | paścādabhyantaraṃ gatvā devadevaṃ praṇamya ca || 28.86 || grathitaṃ pañcadaśabhirdarbhaiḥ kūrcaṃ pragahya ca | dvādaśāṃguladīrghantu jīvasthāne nidhāya ca || 28.87 || dhruvaberātsamādāya tatkūrcer'canamācareth | bālālayaṃ bhavecchettu arcāpīṭhe viśeṣataḥ || 28.88 || kūrcaṃ sannyasya hṛdayātpraṇidhyāṃ viniveśyaca | kūrcaṃ tu biṃbavatsmṛtvā manasaivākṣarāṇi tu || 28.89 || tattatthsāne tu saṃskṛtya sannyasyāvāhya cārcayeth | snapanādau tu saṃprāpte kuryādabhyukṣaṇaṃ budhaḥ || 28.90 || māsādūrdhvaṃ tu tatkūrcaṃ vyapohyānyaṃ nidhāpayeth | kāle tu biṃbamuddhṛtya saṃśodhyāmlādibhistadā || 28.91 || puṇyāhāntekṛte'spṛśya sparśane tvavilaṃbitaṃ | kṛtvā jalādhivāsādīnaṅkurārpaṇapūrvakaṃ || 28.92 || ālayābhimukhe vāpi dakṣiṇe vā manorame | prapāyāṃ maṇḍapekūṭe yatvābjāgniṃ vidhāyaca || 28.93 || taduttare vāstahomaṃ hutvābiṃbasamīpataḥ | paryagnikaraṇaṃ kṛtvā gavyaissaṃśodhya pañcabhiḥ || 28.94 || abjāgnau paścime bhāge biṃbārdhādhikavistṛtāṃ | bhāgonnatāṃ yathālobhonna tāṃ dhānyairvidhāya ca || 28.95 || vediṃ manoharāṃ caiva vāsāṃsyāstīrya pañca ca | saṃsnāpya kalaśairdivyaiścaturdaśabhireva ca || 28.96 || puṇyāhānte pratisaraṃ baddhvā kautukapūrvakaṃ | berāṇi devīsahitaṃ śāyayecchayane śubhe || 28.97 || avatārāṇāṃ tu śayanaṃ pṛthageva vidhīyate | pariṣicya ca padmāgnau hautraśaṃsanamācareth || 28.98 || deveśasya ca devyāśca avatāragaṇasya ca | dakṣiṇapraṇidhau caiva pārṣadānāmathottare || 28.99 || āvāhya kṛtvā nirvāpaṃ hunedājyāhutīḥkramāth | vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktaṃ ca puruṣasūktaṃ tathaiva ca || 28.100 || gāyatrī vaiṣṇavī caiva dvādaśākṣarameva ca | prājāpatyaṃ mindāhutī vicchinnaṃ juhuyādayaṃ || 28.101 || śāntihoma iti proktā mahāśāntiṃ jaguḥpare | ṣaṇmāne samatīte tu hutvā śāntiṃ viśeṣataḥ || 28.102 || saktulājatilāpūpairājyamiśraistu vaiṣṇavaṃ | viṣṇusūktaṃ ca pratyekaṃ śataśo juhuyādvidhiḥ || 28.103 || śvetaṃ raktaṃ sarojātamalābhe bilvakacchadaṃ | ghṛtāplutaṃ tu vaiṣṇavyā gāyatṣājuhuyāttathā || 28.104 || sarvadaivatyamante ca juhuyātpāramātmikaṃ | enameke mahāśāntihomamācakṣate budhāḥ || 28.105 || paścādapyavatārāṇāṃ tattanmantraṃ viśeṣataḥ | pṛthagaṣṭottaraśataṃ hutvā rātriṃ nayettataḥ || 28.106 || snātvā prabhāte deveśaṃ praṇamya praṇavena tu | bodhayitvābhivandyaiva "karuṇābdhe kṣamasya me || 28.107 || śataṃ sahasramayutamasaṃkhyeyaṃ muhurmuhuḥ | kṛtānāmaparādhānā'miti saṃprārthya bhaktitaḥ || 28.108 || prācīna vastramālyādīndyapohyanyairvibhūṣya ca | sarvavādya samāyuktaṃ śākunaṃ sūktamuccaran || 28.109 || toyadhārāṃ puraskṛtya gacchettu purato guruḥ | sthāpakā devamuddhṛta kṛtvā dhāmapradakṣiṇaṃ || 28.110 || abhyantaraṃ praviśyaiva sthāpayeyuśca pūrvavath | devapādau gurusspaṣṭvā vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktakaṃ || 28.111 || pauruṣaṃ cātmasūktaṃ ca japtvā dhyātvā vidhānataḥ | dhruvādvā hṛdayācchaktiṃ praṇidhyāṃ tu niveśya ca || 28.112 || kṛtvākṣarāṇāṃ vinyāsamāvāhanamathācareth | tadālayagatāṃścaiva devānanyāṃ tsamāhvayeth || 28.113 || puṇyāhaṃ vācayetpaścādyathoktaṃ pūrvamācareth | yajamānopi śuddhātmā dadyādācāryadakṣiṇāṃ || 28.114 || paścādagniṃ paristīrya śāntihomaṃ samācareth | yathāvibhavavistāramutsavaṃ snapanaṃ careth || 28.115 || aśaktassnapanaṃ kuryādanyatsarvaṃ ca pūrvavath | kūrcādāvarcane hīne tanniṣkṛtimathācareth || 28.116 || evaṃ caidvatsa re'tīte punasthsāpanamācareth | avatāraviśeṣasya pṛthakkuryāditītare || 28.117 || teṣāṃ punaḥpratiṣṭhā cettattaddhomaṃ tu ke cana | idthaṃ syādbhayarakṣārthaniṣkṛtissarvasiddhitā || 28.118 || atha vakṣye viśeṣeṇa punarbālālayaṃ budhāḥ | mahābere vimāne ca patite jarite tathā || 28.119 || bhinneṃgahīne nihate vātyayāśaninātha vā | varṇakṣaye sthalabhraṃśe garbhagehasya cānyathā || 28.120 || pīṭhagarbhādināśe vā aspṛśyairvā praveśane | unnatasthāpanecchāyāṃ kuryādbālālayaṃ hareḥ || 28.121 || bālālaye'bhyarcyamāne saṃbhūte sthānasaṃkaṭe | caṇḍālādhiṣṭhite caiva sthānanāśe hradādibhiḥ || 28.122 || anyatra tūcite deśe kṛtvā pūrvoktamārgataḥ | karṣaṇādikriyāssarvā biṃbamānīya cādarāth || 28.123 || pratiṣṭhāpya tu tatraiva kuryānmūlālayaṃ tataḥ | bāhye caiva vimānasya cāṅgopāṅgakṣatau tathā || 28.124 || makṣikātṛṇavalmīkapādapādyairvibhedane | vinā bālālayasthānaṃ śaktiṃ gṛhya vimānagāṃ || 28.125 || tadaṅgadevatānāṃ ca samāropya dhruve punaḥ | navīkṛtya vimānoktapratiṣṭhāṃ punarācareth || 28.126 || akṛtvā devatāropaṃ mahābere viśeṣataḥ | vimānaṃ nādhitiṣṭheta sarvatrāyaṃ vidhissmṛtaḥ || 28.127 || vimānadhruvayornāśe yugapattatraniṣkṛtiḥ | kautukādīnpratiṣṭhāpya vihāya prārthanāmanuṃ || 28.128 || bālālayaṃ prakalpyaiva vidhinā tatra cārcayeth | tasya kāle'pyatīte tu tadā tatra na doṣakṛth || 28.129 || yasyāṅgasya bhaveddhānistatra bālālayaṃ bhaveth | kṛtvā tasya tu saṃskāraṃ yathoktaṃ tatpunaścareth || 28.130 || kautukādivināśe ca doṣayukte dhruve tathā | vimāne ca tathā duṣṭe kṛtvā bālālayaṃ punaḥ || 28.131 || yathālābhena mānena biṃbamāhṛtya dāravaṃ | pratiṣṭhāpyādyataruṇālayoktavidhinā tataḥ || 28.132 || kautukādīṃśca saṃkalpya pratiṣṭhāpyārcayetkramāth | alābhe kautukādīnāṃ doṣayukte tu dārave || 28.133 || biṃbamasyaṃ samāhṛtya pratiṣṭhāpyaiva dāravaṃ | tadberaṃ vidhivattyaktvā kṛtvā mūlālaye punaḥ || 28.134 || vidhinā mūlaberaṃ tu pratiṣṭhāpya samarcayeth | bālālayasya saṃsthānaṃ vakṣye mūlālayasya tu || 28.135 || madhyasūtrāddakṣiṇe ca prathamāvaraṇe tathā | dvitīyāvaraṇe vātha maṇṭapādau manorame || 28.136 || yatrāvakāśastatraivaṃ bālāgāraṃ prakalpayeth | dvitīyāvaraṇādūrdhvaṃ na bālāgārakalpanaṃ || 28.137 || ekādi tu trihastāntaṃ vistāraṃ tu vidhīyate | adhyardhaṃ caiva pādonamutsedhaṃ dviguṇaṃ tu vā || 28.138 || utsedhaṃ pañcadhā kṛtvādhiṣṭhānaṃ caikamaṃśakaṃ | bhittyuccaṃ dvyaṃśamatha ca dvyaṃśaṃ tu śikharaṃ mataṃ || 28.139 || lupopare tṛṇācchannaṃ mṛṇmayaṃ kārayetsudhīḥ | bhittiviṣkaṃbhamānaṃ syānmūlālayasamaṃ tathā || 28.140 || dviguṇaṃ caturguṇaṃ kṛtvā yacchiṣṭaṃ vidhinā kṛtaṃ | nālīgṛhaṃ bhavedvindyāttameva taruṇālayaṃ || 28.141 || maṇḍapādiṣu cedbhittyā saha tasya yathārhakaṃ | nālīgṛhaṃ maṇḍapena pramukhe rahitaṃ tu vā || 28.142 || sahite tu samaṃ kuryāttripādaṃ cārdhameva vā | pūrvāparayutaṃ vātha dakṣiṇottaramāyataṃ || 28.143 || samaṃ vā taruṇāgāraṃ śilpaśāstroktavaccareth | pañcaviṃśatibhāgaṃ tu kṛtvā garbhālayaṃ tataḥ || 28.144 || madhye brāhmaṃ padaṃ caikaṃ parito'ṣṭau tu daivikaṃ | mānuṣaṃ tasya paritaḥ padānyanyāni ṣoḍaśa || 28.145 || kautukaṃ brahmaṇasthsāne sthāpayeduttamaṃ bhaveth | daivike mānuṣe sthāpya madhyamaṃ cādhamaṃ bhaveth || 28.146 || trīṇi tu snapanādīni berāṇi sthāpayetsadā | antyayoreva nānyatra sthānabhedaḥ praśasyate || 28.147 || prāṇasthānetu pīṭhaṃ syādramyamekatrimekhalaṃ | yathālābhāyataṃ tadvadvistāro tsedhasaṃyutaṃ || 28.148 || ratnanyāsavihīnaṃ vā kṛtvā vibhavavistarāth | ālayāgre'tha vā bālāgārāgre pūrvavadbudhaḥ || 28.149 || yāgaśālāṃ tu kṛtvaiva toraṇādīnvidhāya ca | subhṛtyaiva ca saṃbhārānṛtvijovarayetkramāth || 28.150 || śālāmadhye prakalpyaiva śayyāvediṃ manoharaṃ | caturaśrāṃ pādahīnāmardhahīnāṃ viśeṣataḥ || 28.151 || tadbhittyātu samāṃ tatturīyāṃśotsedhasammittāṃ | pañcatrīnathavai kāgniṃ saṃkalpyaiva ca pūrvavat. || 28.152 || paryagni pañcagavyābhyāṃ saṃśodhya vidhinā tataḥ | bālāgāraṃ yajñaśālāṃ puṇyāhamapi vācayeth || 28.153 || hutvāgnikuṇḍeṣvāghāraṃ pradhānāgniṃ samindhya ca | gāyatrīṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ caiva vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktakaṃ || 28.154 || pauruṣaṃ caikākṣarādi śrībhūsūktaṃ ca vāruṇaṃ | pañcamantrānjayānabhyātānānrāṣṭrabhṛtastathā || 28.155 || midāhutī ca vicchinnamṛddhiṃ vaiṣṇavasaṃyutaṃ | pratyekaṃ pratimantraṃ ca hutvāṃ ca samanantaraṃ || 28.156 || śvetābjaṃ viṣṇugāyatṣāghṛtāktaṃ bilvapatrakaṃ | hunedaṣṭottaraśataṃ sarvadoṣavināśanaṃ || 28.157 || rātripūjāvasāne tu devamabhyarcya yatnataḥ | havirnivedya tāṃ śaktiṃ kautukādiṣu saṃgatāṃ || 28.158 || mahābere samāropya kuṃbhamāhṛtya pūrvavath | tantunā pariveṣṭyaiva "śucī vo havya'mantrataḥ || 28.159 || prakṣālyotpavanaṃ kṛtvā "dhārāsvi'ti ca mantrataḥ | adbhirāpūryābhimṛśya "idamāpaśśivā' iti || 28.160 || vastrayugmena cāveṣṭya navaratnādi vinyaseth | uccāryaviṣṇugāyatrīṃ tatra kāryaṃ samācareth || 28.161 || tato'bhyantaramāviśya devāgre dhānyamaṇḍale | sannyasya kuṃbhamāsitvā devāgre tūttarāmukhaḥ || 28.162 || samāhito hariṃ dhyāyanprārthayenmantramuccaran | "anarhametattvadgehaṃ jīrṇaṃ tūrṇaṃ vyapohya ca || 28.163 || kiñcitkālaṃ ca deveśa tvayātra sthīyatāṃ vibho | yāvadvayaṃ navaṃ kṛtvā pratiṣṭhāṃ kārayāmahe || 28.164 || prasādaṃ kuru tāvattvamasmingehe jagatpate' | ityuktvābdamatha dvautrīnsaṃkalpyāvadhimādarāth || 28.165 || devyādisahitaṃ devamāvāhyāṃbhasi kuṃbhake | ācāryaśśirasā kuṃbhaṃ dhārayannagratastviyāth || 28.166 || tadanu sthāpakābiṃbanyādāya snapanāvaṭe | yajñālaye pratiṣṭhāpya caturdaśabhireva ca || 28.167 || kalaśaissnāpya vastrādyairalaṅkṛtya samarcyaca | śayyāvedyāṃ dhānyapīṭhe śayanāni tu pañcavai || 28.168 || āstīrya cātha vāsāṃsi baddhvā pratisaraṃ tataḥ | tathaiva śāyayetkuryāduttarācchādanaṃ punaḥ || 28.169 || pariṣicya pradhānāgniṃ hautraśaṃsanamācareth | kṛtvā cāvāhanādīni hunedagniṣu pūrvavath || 28.170 || pradhānāgnau sruveṇājyamādāyaiva tu vaiṣṇavaṃ | gāyatrīṃ vaiṣṇapaṃ viṣṇusūktaṃ pauruṣameva ca || 28.171 || ekākṣarādisūktaṃ ca śrībhūdaivatyameva ca | trirhutvā sarvadaivatyaparṣadāṃ mantrameva ca || 28.172 || hutvā vyapohya vidhinā rātriśeṣaṃ samāhitaḥ | snātvā prabhāte deveśaṃ praṇamya pramavena tu || 28.173 || vibodhya dakṣiṇāṃ dadyādyajamāno mudānvitaḥ | tato'gniṃ sādhayitvā tu gurussviṣṭakṛtaṃ tathā || 28.174 || pūrṇāhutiṃ ca hutvaiva visṛjyāgniṃ vidhānataḥ | dhārayanśirasā kuṃbhaṃ śākunaṃ sū"ktamuccaran || 28.175 || ācāryaḥ purategacchetthsāpakāstadanastaraṃ | hastābhyāṃ devamādāya sarvavādyasamāyutaṃ || 28.176 || sarvālaṅkārasaṃyuktaṃ to yadhārāpurassaraṃ | ālayaṃ parito gatvā praviśyābhyantaraṃ punaḥ || 28.177 || vihāya sthirarāśiṃ tu sumuhūrteviśeṣataḥ | "pratadviṣṇu'riti procya prāṇapīṭhe hariṃsmaran || 28.178 || pratiṣṭhāpya tu deveśaṃ tasya dakṣiṇavāmayoḥ | śriyaṃ bhuvaṃ ca mantrābhyāṃ tayossaṃsthāpayetkramāth || 28.179 || devapādau spṛśanpaścādviṣṇusūktaṃ japanguruḥ | kṛtvākṣarāṇāṃ nyāsādī "nidaṃ viṣṇuṃ'ti bruvan || 28.180 || kūrcenādāya kuṃbhasthāṃ śakti"māyātu' mantrataḥ | "viṣṇumāvāhayā'mīti kautukasya tu mūrdhavi || 28.181 || "śriyaṃca "hariṇīṃ'ceti devyau dakṣiṇavāmayoḥ | saṃsrāvyāvāhayeddevāṃstataḥ pāriṣadānapi || 28.182 || kautukāddakṣiṇe vāme snapanādīni kautukāth | saṃsthāpya tu samāvāhya tāvatkālaṃ samarcayeth || 28.183 || sthāpakaissaha puṇyāhaṃ kṛtvābhyarcyāsanādibhiḥ | havirnivedya deveśaṃ hutvā homaṃ ca naityikaṃ || 28.184 || baliṃ nirvāpya kurvīta balibhramaṇameva ca | snapanaṃ cotsavādīni pūrvavatkārayetkramāth || 28.185 || bālālayārcane kuryādarcanaṃ tu dhruvārcayoḥ | āvāhanaṃ visargaṃ ca hitvā sarvaṃ samācareth || 28.186 || mahānasādinirmāṇaṃ bālālayavidhau punaḥ | sūlālayoktavatkuryādviparītaṃ na kārayeth || 28.187 || ajñānādarthalobhādvā kālasyātikrame sati | devaṃ viśeṣato'bhyarcyaśāntiṃ vaiṣṇavasaṃyutaṃ || 28.188 || hutvā saṃpūjya pūjyāṃśca yajamāno gurustathā | saṃprārthya devaṃ kālasya cāvadhiṃ jñāpayetpunaḥ || 28.189 || bhaktinamra stataḥkutyācchīghraṅkarmedamādarāth | evaṃ dvādaśavarṣāntaṃ kārayeccha tataḥ paraṃ || 28.190 || na ra meta haristatra tasmā duktaṃ samācareth | aśaktaścettathā kartuṃ bālāgālāntaraṃ punaḥ || 28.191 || saṃkalpyasthāpayettatra viparītakṛdanyathā | dehāddehāntaraprāptau yathā saṃskriyate naraḥ || 28.192 || tathā sthānāntanaprāptau pratiṣṭhāṃ kārayeddhareḥ | prathame'tha dvitīye nā naṣṭe bālālaye'rcite || 28.193 || duṣṭe vā yena kenāpi maṇḍapādau manoramaṃ | deśaṃ tu samalaṅkṛtya saṃśodhya vidhivatpunaḥ || 28.194 || saṃsthāpya kautukādīṃśca samabhyarcyedvidhānataḥ | bālālayaṃ navīkṛtya tadeva tvaritaṃ yathā || 28.195 || vāstuśuddhiṃ ca puṇyāhaṃ kṛtvā saṃsthāpya cārcayeth | ayuktetu tatastasminnidhāyānyatra mandiraṃ || 28.196 || punaḥ pratiṣṭhāmārgeṇa pratiṣṭhāpya samarcayeth || 28.197 || iti śrīvaikhānase bhagavacchāstre bhṛguproktāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prakīrṇādhikāre'ṣṭāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ <29> athaikonatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ prāyaścittam athavakṣye viśeṣeṇa dhruvaberasya niṣkṛtiṃ | tāmrajaṃ śailajaṃ caiva mūrtikaṃ dāravaṃ tviti || 29.1 || cāturvidhyaṃ dhruvasyātra pūrvameva mayoditaṃ | ṣaṇmānasahitaṃ kṛtvāsanālaṃ pādapadmakaṃ || 29.2 || kṛtvā tu tāmrajaṃ biṃbaṃ kautukasyoktavartmanā | kṛtvākṣyunmocanaṃ cādhivāsānsaṃsthāpya cācalaṃ || 29.3 || sthāpayetsaha devyauca śuddhyarthaṃ pratiparvatu | śuddhodairabhiṣicyaiva bhūṣaṇaiśca vibhūṣyaca || 29.4 || puṣpanyāsaṃ ca kṛtvaiva sarvānpariṣadaḥ kramāth | śailāneva prakurvīta yathā śātātapo'bravīth || 29.5 || śailaṃ dhruvaṃ tathā citraṃ citrārdhaṃ vā vidhāya ca | pūrvoktena vidhānena paraṃ saṃskṛtya tatkramāth || 29.6 || devyāvanyāṃśca devāṃśca tadālayagatānapi | taddravyeṇa prakurvīta dhruvaṃ ṣaṇmānasaṃyutaṃ || 29.7 || kṛtvākṣṇośca bhruvostadvadoṣṭhayorubhayorapi | karapādatale caiva nakheṣu mukuṭe'pi ca || 29.8 || bhūṣaṇeṣu vidhānena tattadvarṇena lepayeth | mṛṇmayaṃ dāravaṃ vā cettaddravyeṇaiva devatāḥ || 29.9 || tadālayagatāḥ kuryādanyathā viparītakṛth | atha vā varṇahīnaṃ tu śailaṃ sarvatra kārayeth || 29.10 || ardhacitrasya śailasya hīneṣvaṃ geṣu caiva hi | pratyaṅgeṣu tathopāṅgeṣvaniṣṭaṃ tadbhavediha || 29.11 || bālāgāre'tha tacchaktiṃ nītvā biṃbaṃ samāhareth | bhūmau pidhāya tasyordhve padmāgniṃ parikalpya ca || 29.12 || hutvā ca mahatīṃ śāntiṃ śilāgrahaṇavattathā | tattadaṅgasamutpattiṃ yuktyā takṣṇā tu kārayeth || 29.13 || hīne mahāṅge tadberamayuktaṃ cetsamīkṛtau | tyaktvā tadvidhinā beraṃ punaranyatsamāhareth || 29.14 || beraṃ saṃdhānayogyaṃ yastyajetpāpī bhavetsa hi | vinaṣṭaṃ ca bhavetsarvaṃsaṃdhānaṃ śaktitaścareth || 29.15 || dhruvaberamathār'cāṃ ca kartuṃ pūrvamivadvayaṃ | aśaktaśceddhruvārcāntu kṛtvā caikaṃ svaśaktitaḥ || 29.16 || pratiṣṭhāpyārcayetsamyagiti ke cinmanīṣiṇaḥ | ekaberapratiṣṭhāyāmeṣa eva vidhissmṛtaḥ || 29.17 || aśaktaśceddhruvaṃ beramarcāberamathāpi vā | sahitaṃ rahitaṃ vātha devībhyāṃsthāpya cārcayeth || 29.18 || mṛdālaye brahmasthāne dhruvārcāberamāhareth | taṃ devīsahitaṃ kṛtvā vimānaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ || 29.19 || śailaṃ tu kartumicchecceddevo daivikamāśrayeth | yathā tathā prakalpyaiva vimānaṃ kautukaṃ punaḥ || 29.20 || lohajaṃ jaṅgamaṃ kṛtvā braṅmasthāne samācareth | kautukaṃ śailajaṃ cettu sthāvaraṃ tveva sthāpayeth || 29.21 || laghuberaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya vimāne mṛṇmaye'rcite | kartumiccheddhruvaṃ beraṃ vimānaṃ caiva śailajaṃ || 29.22 || vimānaṃ parikalpyaiva vidhinā hastamānataḥ | devībhyāṃ sahitaṃ devaṃ daivikāṃśe vidhāya ca || 29.23 || pūrvārcitāṃ gṛhītvaiva beraṃ kautukakarmaṇi | tasyottare cautsavādīnpratiṣṭhāpya samarcayeth || 29.24 || pūrvaṃ dhruvārcāberetu arcyamāne mṛdālaye | śilābhiriṣṭakābhirvā vimānaṃ kartumicchayā || 29.25 || rakṣārthaṃ tasya berasya śilpisparśanivṛttaye | kāṣṭhena pañjaraṃ kṛtvā bālāgāraṃ dṛḍhaṃ tataḥ || 29.26 || saṃśodhya śalyaṃ cādhastādyuktyā paramāyā punaḥ | vimānaṃ yugmahastena tadberasya vaśādapi || 29.27 || yathāvibhavavistāraṃ saudhaṃ kṛtvā surakṣayeth | tadberasamamadhyardhaṃ dviguṇaṃ caturaśrakaṃ || 29.28 || adhamaṃ madhyamaṃ tadvaduttamaṃ trividhoditaṃ | kṛtvā tasya caturbhāgaṃ tribhāgaṃ cārdhamevavā || 29.29 || garbhāgāraṃ bhaveccheṣaṃ bhittiviṣkaṃbhameva ca | samaṇṭapaṃ vimānaṃ tu pūrvavatkārayedvidhiḥ || 29.30 || śileṣṭakāvimāne tu vargasyānte parasya vā | kārayenmiśramatha cedaśaktaḥ kartumīdṛśaṃ || 29.31 || adhiṣṭhānasya cordhvaṃ hi yatheṣṭasthānake punaḥ | miśradravyeṇa kuryāttu śaktilobhaṃ na kārayeth || 29.32 || varṇakṣayedhruve doṣasaṃphade sphuṭitādibhiḥ | alpadoṣe'pi vāśaktiṃ dhruvaberasthitāṃ tadā || 29.33 || kuṃbhe'ṃbhasi samāvāhya tatkuṃbhaṃ kautukādi ca | samādāya vidhānena mālikāyāṃ tu maṇḍape || 29.34 || sannyasya kautukādau tu samāvāhya samarcayeth | kāle kuṃbhe samāropya kriyāssarvāssamācareth || 29.35 || atīte dvidine kuṃbhamanyadādāyacātvaraḥ | kuṃbhācchaktiṃ samādāya kuṃbhe'nyasminvidhālataḥ || 29.36 || arcayettridine caivaṃ kuṃbhasaṃśodhanaṃ careth | paścācca varṇalepādīnkṛtvā saṃśodya caivahi || 29.37 || vāstuhomaṃ ca puṇyāhaṃ dhruvaśuddhiṃ ca kārayeth | kuṃbhaṃ biṃbaṃ samādāya praviśyābhyantaraṃ tataḥ || 29.38 || kautukādīnsusaṃsthāpya nyāsādīṃśca vidhāya ca | kuṃbhasthāṃ śaktimādāya dhruvabere'varopayeth || 29.39 || dhruvātpunaḥ kautukādiṣvāvāṅya tu samarcayeth | doṣāṇāṃ goravānmāsādūrdhvaṃ kāletvapekṣite || 29.40 || devaṃ bālālaye sthāpya śodhayenmṛṇmayaṃ punaḥ | yāvacchūlaṃ punaśśailaṃ śilāntaṃ śodhayetkramāth || 29.41 || navaṣaṭpañcamūrtīnāṃ vimāne doṣasaṃyutaṃ | yattalaṃ tattalaṃ gṛhya bālasthānaṃ prakalpya ca || 29.42 || kautukādīnsusaṃsthāpya vidhinā samyagarcayeth | paścāttale tu nirduṣṭe kautukādīnpragṛhya ca || 29.43 || sthāpayitvā punaścaiva vidhināpi samarcayeth | atha vakṣye jīrṇaberaparityāgavidhiṃ kramāth || 29.44 || dhruvasyāṅgavihīne tu tyajettatsadya eva hi | kartrārādhakayorgrāhyamanyathā syānmahadbhayaṃ || 29.45 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena jīrṇaṃ saṃśodhya sarvataḥ | navavastraissamācchādya baddhvā ca kuśarajjubhiḥ || 29.46 || brāhmaṇairvāhayitvaiva nadīṃ sphārāṃ samudragāṃ | aśoṣyaṃ vā jalādhāramanyannītvātha tattaṭe || 29.47 || prapāṃ kṛtvāgnimādhāya caupāsanamatandritaḥ | āghārānte tu juhuyādvaiṣṇavaṃ śataśastataḥ || 29.48 || "dadbhyassvā''hetyaṅgahomaṃ vyāhṛtyantaṃ hunedbhudhaḥ | vastrabandhaṃ vimocyaiva prāṅmukhodaṅmukho guruḥ || 29.49 || vāruṇaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ caiva prakṣipyaiva ca tajjale | snāyātsaṃsmṛtya deveśaṃ dārave tu viśeṣataḥ || 29.50 || dagdhvāgninātha tadbhasma nikṣipettādṛśe jale | devyādīnāṃ parṣadāṃ ca tattanmantraṃ savaiṣṇavaṃ || 29.51 || hunejjalekṣipetpaścāddadyādācārya dakṣiṇāṃ | atha cetkautukādīnā maṅgahānistaducyate || 29.52 || mahāṅgāni śiraḥ kukṣi vakṣaḥ kaṇṭhānpracakṣate | pādauhastau bāhavaścetyaṅgāni pravadantihi || 29.53 || aṅgulyaḥ karṇanāsādyāḥ pratyaṅgāni vidurbudhāḥ | śiraścakraṃ ca pīṭhaṃ ca prabhāmaṇḍalameva ca || 29.54 || upāṅgānyūcire bhūṣaṇāyudhāṃbarapūrvakān | tatropāṅgasya hīne tu kuṃbhaṃ saṃsādhya pūrvavath || 29.55 || āvāhya kuṃbhe tacchaktiṃ biṃbaṃ saṃdhāya pūrvavath | kṛtvā jalādhivāsādīnvāstuhomaṃ vidhāya ca || 29.56 || saṃśodya pañcagavyaiśca kuśodaiśca viśeṣataḥ | saptabhiḥ kalaśaisthsāpya kuṃbhasthāṃ śaktimādarāth || 29.57 || samāvāhya punarbiṃbe vidhinā samyagarcayeth | pratyaṅgahīne tacchaktiṃ mahābere'varopya ca || 29.58 || udhrutya biṃbaṃ saṃprokṣya pañcagavyaiḥ kuśodakaiḥ | tulyalohena saṃdhāya cādhivāsya kuśādiṣu || 29.59 || punaḥ pratiṣṭhāmārgeṇa pratiṣṭhāṃ punarācareth | aṅgahīnetu saṃdhānayogyaṃ saṃdhāya pūrvavath || 29.60 || arcayedanyathā yuktehīne vāpi mahāṅgake | bhūmau pidhāya tadberaṃ tadūrdhve juhuyātkramāth || 29.61 || aṅgahomaṃ mahāśāntimapohyaiva ca taddinaṃ | uddhṛtya biṃbaṃ prakṣālya pañcagavyaiḥ kuśodakaiḥ || 29.62 || triragnau saṃparikṣipya śodhayedāmlavāriṇā | rājataṃ dvissakṛdraukmaṃ dahedagnāviti kramaḥ || 29.63 || kṛtvātenaiva dravyeṇa biṃbaṃ pūrvavaduttamaṃ | punaḥpratiṣṭhāṃ kṛtvaiva kārayedarcanaṃ kramāth || 29.64 || paṭe kuḍye'tha vā likhya bere vidhivadarcite | jīrṇamālokya tacchaktimāropyaivārkamaṇḍale || 29.65 || navīkṛtya punastasminpratiṣṭhāpya samarcayeth | ācāryeṇa ca yenādau karṣaṇādyāḥ kṛtāḥ kriyāḥ || 29.66 || pratiṣṭhā vā kṛtā viṣṇostenaivānyāṃśca kārayeth | nityārcanotsavādīṃśca prāyaścittādikānapi || 29.67 || tadabhāve ca tatputraṃ pautraṃ naptārameva ca | tadvaṃśajaṃ vā tacchiṣyaṃ tanniyuktamathāntataḥ || 29.68 || ācāryasannidhau nānyamācāryaṃ varayetkvacith | varayedyadi rāṣṭrasya rājñaścāpi mahadbhayaṃ || 29.69 || bhavecca niṣphalā pūjā sarvaṃ kāryaṃ vinaśyati | tasmātsarvaprayatnena na kuryādgurusaṃkaraṃ || 29.70 || ajñānādarthalobhādvā kṛte tvācāryasaṃkare | abjānale mahāśāntiṃ hutvā saṃprārthyavai guruṃ || 29.71 || yācayitvā "kṣama''sveti pūjayitvā viśeṣataḥ | panastenaiva tatkarma kārayediti śāsanaṃ || 29.72 || ācāryadīnāmalābhe tu tadrūpaṃ lekhayetpaṭe | tatsannidhau yuktamanyamācāryaṃ varayettathā || 29.73 || ekasminnālaye syāccetsannipātastu karmaṇāṃ | ācāryaṃ saṃpraṇamyaiva tatputrādyairvidhānataḥ || 29.74 || kārayettadalābhetu kārayettantrato guruḥ | pūrvaṃ tu yogamārgeṇa pratiṣṭhāpyārcite punaḥ || 29.75 || devībhyāṃ saha paścāttu kārayetsthāpanaṃ yadi | ābhicārikameva syādrājarāṣṭravināśakṛth || 29.76 || dhruvakautuka saṃyukte pūjyamāne purā tataḥ | vimānadhruvayornāśe brahmasthāne dhruvārcanam, || 29.77 || kautukaṃ cotsavasthāne sthāpayediti ke cana | sthānake cāsanaṃ kuryācchayanaṃ vāpi cecchayā || 29.78 || asaneśayanaṃ kuryātthsānakaṃ na tu kārayeth | śayane nāsanaṃ caiva sthānakaṃ kārayedvidhiḥ || 29.79 || kautukaṃ sthitamāsīna mautsavaṃ kārayettathā | asīnaṃ kautukaṃ kuryātthsitamautsavameva vā || 29.80 || snapanaṃ baliberaṃ ca sthitaṃ sarvatra kārayeth | avatāragaṇasyaiva mūrtīnāṃ pañcakasya ca || 29.81 || anyonyasaṃkareṇaiva sthāpane kautukasya ca | mahattaro bhaveddo, staddoṣaśamavāya vai || 29.82 || hutvā tu mahatīṃ śāntiṃ yathāsthāne tu sthāpayeth | atha vakṣye viśeṣeṇa śāntipañcakakalpanaṃ || 29.83 || narāṇāṃ pāpabāhulyādaparādhaviśeṣataḥ | devāssṛjantyadbhutāni teṣu dṛṣṭeṣu satvaraṃ || 29.84 || kuryācchāntiṃ yathoktāntu viparīte tvanarthakṛth | kartrārādhakayoścaiva rājño rāṣṭrasya vāstuvaḥ || 29.85 || saṃkṣobho jāyate sadyo vināśo bhavati dhruvaṃ | dvādaśāhāntare tasmācchāntiṃ kuryādvidhānataḥ || 29.86 || atīte dvādaśāhetu mahāśāntipurassaraṃ | saṃpūjya vaiṣṇavānśaktyādatvā vai bhūridakṣiṇāṃ || 29.87 || ārabheduttaraṃ karma māse'tīte viśeṣataḥ | saptāhaṃ tu mahāśāntiṃ hutvā vipraśataṃ tathā || 29.88 || bhojayitvā ca deveśamanumānya tu kārayeth | ṣaṇmāse samatīte tu ramate tatra nohariḥ || 29.89 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena kuryācchāntiṃ yathoditāṃ | bhoṃāntarikṣadivyākhyabhedāttrividhamadbhutaṃ || 29.90 || grahayuddhaśca bhedaśca vikāro grahamaṇḍale | sarvagrāsoparāgaśca durbhikṣaścākṣabhedanaṃ || 29.91 || evamādīni divyāni tvadbhutāni pracakṣate | āntarikṣāṇi cārkendvoḥ pariveṣo nirantaraḥ || 29.92 || varṇāntareṇa bāhulyātpariveṣastathāvidhaḥ | rātrāvindradhamardevasadma cākāśamaṇḍale || 29.93 || aśanyulkādipātaśca rāhupucchādidarśanaṃ | nakṣatrapatanaṃ ketordhūmasyendrasya darśanaṃ || 29.94 || gandharvanagarasyāpi darśanaṃ patanaṃ tu vā | pratisūryābjanakṣatradarśanaṃ saṃpracakṣate || 29.95 || bhoṃānyanekathoktāni carasthiravibhedataḥ | deśakālasvabhāvādiviruddhaṃ prasavādikaṃ || 29.96 || pṛṣadaṃśakasarpāśvayonijānāṃ viśeṣataḥ | gonāgamahiṣādyeṣu tiryakṣu jananaṃ tathā || 29.97 || kṛmikīṭapataṅgeṣu viṣkireṣvaṇḍajādiṣu | vivarṇākāravāsādirāśrayādistathālaye || 29.98 || raktastrīdarśanādīni cādbhutāni careṣu tu | divyāni cāntarikṣāṇi teṣāmatrottamottamaṃ || 29.99 || nārāṇi cottamāni syurmāhiṣādyāni madhyamaṃ | sarīsṛpādiṣu bhavānyathamāni vadantihi || 29.100 || rodanaṃ hasanaṃ jalpo jvalanaṃ parivartanaṃ | svedaśca rudhirasrāvaḥ kṛmikīnādisaṃbhavaḥ || 29.101 || akālasphoṭanaṃ dhūmaścāṅgakaṃpanameva ca | svāpanāsvādanecaiva tṛṇavalmīka saṃbhavaḥ || 29.102 || pratimāyāṃ bhaveccettu raktastrīdarśanaṃ tathā | pāṣaṇḍapratilomāntyajātibhiḥ patitaisthathā || 29.103 || sṛgālādibhiraspṛśyaissparśane ca praveśane | sthūṇāvirohaṇe caiva calane parivartane || 29.104 || tathāpasarpaṇe caiva kavāṭaśayanāsane | bhittyāyudhāṃbare tadvadagnihotrādyupaskare || 29.105 || vimāne ca vikāraśca makṣikāvṛkṣapātane | pravartane copasarpe parṇapuṣpaphaleṣu ca || 29.106 || śākhādau viparītasya darśanaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ | raktasrāvo jalasrāvaścādbhutāni sthireṣu tu || 29.107 || teṣu garbhakṛhe caiva pīṭhe caiva bhavāni tu | rājñorāṣṭrasya viprāṇāṃ nāśakāni viśeṣataḥ || 29.108 || kartrārādhakayornāśa iti śātātapo'bravīth | prāsādajāni rājñāṃ syuḥ prāsāde'pi viśeṣataḥ || 29.109 || adhiṣṭhāne ca pāde ca prastare ca gale'pi ca | śikhare ca bhavāni syuḥkṣatriyāṇāṃ krameṇa tu || 29.110 || abhiṣekasya yogyasya yuvarājasya caiva hi | abhiṣiktasya samrājaścātyāhitakarāṇi tu || 29.111 || prathamāvaraṇe vaiśyajātīnāṃ mantriṇāṃ tathā | purohitasya tanmaṇḍalādhipānāṃ mahadbhayaṃ || 29.112 || śūdrajātivipaddhetdvitīyāvaraṇādiṣu | sasyanāśo gajāśvādipaśunāśasca jāyate || 29.113 || purodhasaścāgnikuṇḍe brahmasthāne dvijanmanāṃ | rudrālaye tu sarveṣāṃ nṛpasya tu guhālaye || 29.114 || seneśānāṃ vipattiḥ syādvakratuṇḍālaye tathā | śṣālaye rājapatnīnāṃ durgāsthāne'nyayoṣitāṃ || 29.115 || mātṛsthāne'ntyajātīnāmoṣadhīnāṃ kuberake | nṛpavāhanaśastropajīvināṃ bhāskarālaye || 29.116 || anyadevālaye tattadbhoktānāmapi lakṣayeth | āsthānamaṇḍapasaṅgamaṇḍabaprāṅgaṇeṣu ca || 29.117 || mahānase nṛpāvāse krīḍāsthāne viśeṣataḥ | ācāryayajamānādipadārthinilayeṣu ca || 29.118 || caityavṛkṣādiṣūdbhūtā raktastrīdarśanādayaḥ | valmīkādyāśca phaladāstattaddiśyuktamārgataḥ || 29.119 || bhoṃeṣu devaberārcāpīṭhagarbhagṛhārte | jātādoṣāntu saṃproktā uttamottamasaṃjñitāḥ || 29.120 || uttamāstupunarjātāḥ prākāremukhamaṇḍape | madhyamāḥ prathamāvaraṇe śeṣeṣūktāstathādhamāḥ || 29.121 || tathā rājāṅgaṇe cottamottamāḥ paritastataḥ | aṅkaṇeṣūttamā antarvāstuke madhyamāssmṛtāḥ || 29.122 || adhamā vāstuno bāhye tāratamyamiti smṛtaṃ | divyāntarikṣayornāsti cikitsā śāntiriṣyate || 29.123 || bhoṃeṣu tu careṣvatra nimittaṃ ca nimittinaṃ | deśāntare vāsayitvā śāntintatra samācareth || 29.124 || sthireṣu pratimānāṃ tu rodane hasane tathā | jvalane ca tathā devaṃ saṃsthāpya taruṇālaye || 29.125 || tadberasthāṃ samāropya śaktiṃ tatra vidhānataḥ | śāntiṃ kṛtvā punaḥ kuryātthsāpanaṃ cārcanaṃ kramāth || 29.126 || parivṛttau punasthsāpya kuryācchāntyādi pūrvavath | svede ca rudhirasrāve sarvaṃ rodanavaccareth || 29.127 || kṛmikīṭapataṅgānāṃ kṛṇādīnāmathodbhave | āropya pūrvavacchaktiṃ punassaṃdhāya yuktitaḥ || 29.128 || śāntyādīnācaredevamakālasphoṭanādike | berārcāpīṭhake tadvadālayābhyantarepe ca || 29.129 || valmīkādyudbhave devaṃ saṃsthāpya taruṇālaye | yāvaddoṣaṃ khanitvaiva gavyairabhyukṣya pañcabhiḥ || 29.130 || saṃśodhya sarvaṃ saṃdhāya punasthsāpana mācareth | prāsādabāhye cotpanne vivare viśadīkṛte || 29.131 || peṣayitvā marīcyādijalenāpūrya cāśmanā | ālipya śarkarāṃ kuryācchāntiṃ divyapracoditāṃ || 29.132 || punarapyudite kuryādevameva tuyuktitaḥ | makṣikādarśane tattyadvyapohyatvavilaṃbitaṃ || 29.133 || śodhayitvā tataśśāntimārabheta vicakṣaṇaḥ | aspṛśyaspakśane tadvatkṛtvā śāntiṃ samācareth || 29.134 || sthūṇāvirohaṇādau ca punassaṃdhāya cācareth | haṭhādvṛkṣādhipatine śānti stattyāgapūrvikā || 29.135 || rājāṅgaṇe samutpanne rājānaṃ sabalaṃ punaḥ | veśmāntaraṃ vāsayitvā śāntiṃ kṛtvā yathocitāṃ || 29.136 || abhiṣicya punaryuktedine rāṣṭraṃ praveśayeth | athottamottamasyottamasya syānmadhyamasya ca || 29.137 || adhamasyāpi cāspṛśyasparśanasya yathākramaṃ | krameṇādbhutaśāntistu prabhūtā mahatī tathā || 29.138 || śāntiśśuddhiriti prājñaiḥ pañcadhā śāntirucyate | ālayābhimukhe tadvadaiśānyāṃ cottare'tha vā || 29.139 || parvatāgre taṭākasya tīre vā maṇḍapaṃ prapāṃ | kūṭaṃ vā ṣoḍaśastaṃbhasaṃyuktāṃ sumanoharaṃ || 29.140 || caturhastapramāṇāntastsaṃbhāntarasamāyutāṃ | tānonnatācalāyuktāṃ? kṛtvā madhye vidhānataḥ || 29.141 || kuṇḍaṃ śrāmaṇakoktaṃ tu kṛtvādho dvādaśāṅgulaṃ | khanitvaiva catprācyāṃ dvihastāyata vistṛtaṃ || 29.142 || hastamātrasamutsedhaṃ kṛtvā sthaṇḍilamuttamaṃ | prāgādiṣu caturdhikṣu krameṇāhavanīyakaṃ || 29.143 || anvāhāryaṃ cāvasathyaṃ gārhapatyaṃ ca kārayeth | agneyādiṣu koṇeṣu kuṇḍānyaupāsanāni ca || 29.144 || kṛtvādvāreṣu vidhinā toraṇādi prakalpayeth | pūrmakaṃbhairaṅkuraiśca kadalībhirdhvajairapi || 29.145 || staṃbha veṣṭanakādyaiśca darbhamālābhireva ca | alaṅkṛtya vitānādyairyathāvibhavastaraṃ || 29.146 || sthaṇḍile dhānyarāśiṃ tu kṛtvā tasya ca madhyame | padmamaṣṭadalaṃ kṛtvā taṇḍulaistasya madhyame || 29.147 || sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ tāmraṃ kṛṇmayaṃ vā svaśaktitaḥ | dvātriṃśatprasthasaṃpūrṇaṃ kaṃbhamādāya śāstravath || 29.148 || tantunā pariṣṭyaiva yavāntaramanantaṃ | vastrayugmena saṃveṣṭya bhūṣaṇaiśca vibhūṣya ca || 29.149 || sauvarṇa maṅgalānyaṣṭau tathā pañcāyudhāni ca | varṇacihnāni tādṛṃśi cāhīnānyaṅgulādapi || 29.150 || ratnāni hema rajataṃ tāmraṃ kāṃsyaṃ tathā trapu | sīsāyastīkṣṇukāntāni graharūpāṇi caiva hi || 29.151 || nikṣipyāpūrya toyeva śuddhena tu vidhānataḥ | karpūracandanośīralavaṅgailādikānapi || 29.152 || gandhadravyāṇi cānyāni nyasya cūtādipallavān | tanmukhaṃ tu pidhāneva pidadhyātsadṛśenavai || 29.153 || ācāryamṛtvijaścāpi vṛtvā śāstravidhānataḥ | navavastrottarīyādyaiḥ pañcāṅgārpitabhūṣaṇaiḥ || 29.154 || alaṅkṛtyāgnikuṇḍeṣu hutvāghāraṃ yathoditaṃ | madhye sūryaṃ tathendrādi bhārgavāṅgārakau tathā || 29.155 || mandaṃ guruṃ pāvakādi candrarāhudhvajānbudhaṃ | pradakṣiṇavaśenaiva dhyātvāvāṅyār'cayettataḥ || 29.156 || aṣṭākṣareṇāyutaṃ vā sahasraṃ cāṣṭasaṃyutaṃ | abhimṛśya vidhānena grahayajñoditena vai || 29.157 || hunecca tattaddaivatyaṃ samiccarughṛtaiḥ kramāth | hutvāṣṭottarasāhasraṃ tato vaikhānasānale || 29.158 || ghṛtāplutairbilvadalairaṣṭottara sahasrakaṃ | hunedaṣṭākṣaraṃ nityaṃ tathā bilvasamidghetaiḥ || 29.159 || dūrvāpūpavrīhitilacarulājābjasaktubhiḥ | vaiṣṇavyācaiva gāyatṣā pūrvavajjuhuyādguruḥ || 29.160 || ghṛtenāṣṭākṣareṇaiva sahasraṃ cāṣṭasaṃyutaṃ | hutvānte tu ghṛtenaiva vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktakaṃ || 29.161 || juhuyātpauruṣaṃ sūktaṃ nṛttairgeyaiśca ghoṣayeth | yathādiśaṃ caturvedānnityamadhyāpayetkramāth || 29.162 || kalpasūtramathaukheyaṃ praṇītaṃ guruṇā purā | svādhyāyo yatra yatroktastatrādhyeyaṃ vidhānataḥ || 29.163 || ṛtvigbhyo dakṣiṇāṃ dadyādevaṃ saptāhamācareth | yadi devālaye doṣaḥ kuṃbhapārśvetha sthaṇḍile || 29.164 || devaṃ taṃ sthāpya cābhyarchya nivedya ca mahāhaviḥ | devasyābhimukhe hutvā homamante yathāvidhi || 29.165 || navāhaṃ vātha stāhaṃ utsavaṃ kārayedvidhiḥ | divyāntarikṣayoḥ kuṃbhajalenā plāvayennṛpaṃ || 29.166 || bhoṃeṣu tatthsalaṃ prākṣya śiṣṭatoyena vai nṛpaṃ | tatpatnīṃ cābhiṣiñcecca guruṃ saṃpūjya pārthivaḥ || 29.167 || suvarṇapaśubhūmyādīndadyādṛtvigbhya eva ca | dakṣiṇāṃ bahulāṃ dadyājjīvo yajñasya dakṣiṇā || 29.168 || yadi rājagṛhe doṣaḥ kṛtvā maṇḍapamantike | pūrvavadgrahayajñaṃ ca homaṃ śrāmaṇake'nale || 29.169 || kuṃbhasya sādhanaṃ kṛtvā saptāhānte prabhuṃ tathā | snāpayetkuṃbhatoyena pratiṣṭhāntakrameṇa vai || 29.170 || dakṣiṇāṃ gurupūrvebhyo datvā kṛtvāṃkurār'paṇaṃ | śubhe'nukūle nakṣatre kṛtvā caivābhiṣecanaṃ || 29.171 || praviśetpūrvagehaṃ tu dharmasiddhyaigurūditaḥ | eṣa eva vidhiḥ prokto gṛhiṇāmapi sammataḥ || 29.172 || rājñāṃ parārthavṛttitvātso'tra tu prakṛtīkṛtaḥ | sarvagrāsoparāgādidivyādbhutaśamāyavai || 29.173 || yathāśakti brāhmaṇebhyassvarṇaṃ bhūmiṃ paśūnapi | dadyāttathā viśeṣeṇa dakṣiṇāṃ bhūrisammitāṃ || 29.174 || anāvṛṣṭinivṛttyarthaṃ kuṃbhaṃ saṃgṛhya pūrvavath | sarvatīrthaṃ samāvāhya samabhyarcyāgrato hareḥ || 29.175 || dhyānyapīṭhe tu sauvarṇaṃ padmamaṣṭadalairyutaṃ | hemapātre tu sannyasya devamāvāhya tatra ca || 29.176 || abhyarcya tasya cordhvetu pīṭhe kuṃbhaṃ nidhāya ca | kuṃbhamūle tu suṣiraṃ sūcīmātraṃ vidhāya ca || 29.177 || taddhārayā tvavicchinnarūpayā secayeddhariṃ | samidbhirvaitasībhistu pālāśībhirathāpi vā || 29.178 || aṣṭhottarasahastraṃ tu juhuyātpañjavāruṇaṃ | agnau śrāmaṇake paścāddiśāhomeṣu pūrvavath || 29.179 || aṣṭāttarasahasraṃ tu pratyekaṃ pañcavāruṇaṃ | samidbhirjuhuyādvidvānvaitasībhiryadhāvithi || 29.180 || samidbhiḥ punarājyena vaitasībhiḥ pṛthagghuneth | aṣṭādhikasahasraṃ tu "indraṃ praṇayanta'' mityapi || 29.181 || śrāmaṇāgniṃ vidhāyaikaṃ dakṣiṇe tasya vajriṇaṃ | āvāhya tu samabhyarcya "śacīsahā''yeti homayeth || 29.182 || devaṃ viśeṣato'bhyarcya kārayetsnapanādikaṃ | evaṃ jñātvā vidhānena tattatkarmasu gauravaṃ || 29.183 || tṣahādi triṃśadghasrāntaṃ śrāmaṇāgnau yathāvithi | dine dine pūrayitvā kuṃbhaṃ tenaiva secayeth || 29.184 || sarvānte devamāsnāpya samabhyarcya havirdadeth | karmānte syānmahāvṛṣṭistasmādyatnena kārayeth || 29.185 || atha vā varṣa kāmī vā mokṣārthī paśukāmanaḥ | sarvopadravaśāntyarthī vijayārthī viśeṣataḥ || 29.186 || snapanālayamāsādya alaṅkṛtya ca pūrvavath | karmagauravamājñāya saṃbhṛtya bahudhā payaḥ || 29.187 || pūjayetprathamaṃ yatnādācāryaṃ sahi dhārakaḥ | ācāryassuprasannātmā śvabhrātprācyāṃ tu taṇḍulaiḥ || 29.188 || kṛtvā paṅktiṃ dakṣiṇottarāyatāṃ vipulāntarāṃ | śvabhrāddakṣiṇataḥ kṛtvā kuṇḍaṃ śrāmaṇakasya tu || 29.189 || agnimādhāya kuṃbhāṃ stu nava saṃveṣṭya tantunā | adbhiḥ prakṣālya cotpūya kuśakūrcena cātvaraḥ || 29.190 || kṣīreṇa pūrayitvaiva cotbūtena krameṇa vai | paṅktiṃ nidhāyāpidhānairapidhāyopari kramāth || 29.191 || vastreṇācchādayecchvabhraṃpūjāntebhyarcya vai hariṃ | svastisūktena cānamya saṃsthāpya śvabhramadhyame || 29.192 || arcanoktavidhānena sarvaṃ pūrvanadāyareth | tantunā veṣṭite kṣīraṃ kṛhītvākarake pūnaḥ || 29.193 || viṣṇusūktena "ceṣe''tvetyādyairmantraiḥ kramādguruḥ | tayā saṃsnāpayeddenamuktayo kṣīradhārayā || 29.194 || tathaiva pariṣicyāgniṃ mantrai"rviṣṇornu''kādibhiḥ | "atodevādi''bhistadvadaṣṭārṇa manunā tathā || 29.195 || juhuyādviṣṇugāyatṣā aṣṭādhikasahasrakaṃ | atha vā snapanaṃ yāvattāvadudvartya mantrataḥ || 29.196 || hāridrena tu cūrṇena saṃśodhyāmlādibhistataḥ | gandhodena susaṃsnāpya plotena vimṛjettataḥ || 29.197 || vastrādibhiralaṅkṛtya samabhyarcya vidhānataḥ | pāyasādi havirdadyāddapyādācāryadakṣiṇāṃ || 29.198 || anena sarvānkāmāṃśca labhetāviśayaṃ naraḥ | dhruvaberārcane cettu saṃsnāpya pramukhe ghaṭaṃ || 29.199 || tasmādānīya tatraiva snāpayeduktagauravāth | saptapañcatṣahānyatra kṣīrasnānaṃ prakalpayeth || 29.200 || evaṃ ghṛtābhiṣekaṃ ca kārayetsadṛśaṃ phalaṃ | imāmadbhutāśāntintu kāśyapādyāḥ pracakṣate || 29.201 || atha prabhūtaśāntiṃ tu pravakṣyāmi tapodhanāḥ | pūrvavanmaṇṭapādīni kārayitvā yathāvidhi || 29.202 || viśāhomaṃ cakṛtvaiva śrāmaṇāgnau yathoditaṃ | kuṃbhaṃ saṃsādhya ca prāgvatsaptāhānte viśeṣataḥ || 29.203 || aṣṭottaraśataṃ vāṣṭacatvāriṃśadathātha vā | saṃgṛhya kalaśānāntu samabhyarcya'bhiṣecya ca || 29.204 || devaṃ viśeṣato'bhyarcya havirdadyādayaṃ vidhiḥ | mahāśāntikramaṃ vakṣye vinā kuṃbhasya sādhanaṃ || 29.205 || agnau śrāmaṇake bilvapatrairājyāplutaiḥkramāth | aṣṭādhikasahasraṃ vai hunedaṣṭākṣareṇa tu || 29.206 || ājyena vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktaṃ pauruṣameva ca | hutvā tṣahānte saṃsnāpya śuddhasnapanavartmanā || 29.207 || samabhyarcya havirdadyānmahāśāntiriyaṃ bhaveth | aupāsanāgnāvekāhaṃ hutvā śāntiṃ vidhānataḥ || 29.208 || brāhmaṇānbhojayitvaiva dadyādācāryadakṣiṇāṃ | atha śuddhividhiṃ vakṣye vāstuhomaṃ hunettataḥ || 29.209 || bilvapatrādibhirhutvā pṛthagaṣṭottaraṃ śataṃ | puṇyāhānte guruṃ pūjya bhojayedbrāhmaṇānapi || 29.210 || sarvatratu vikalpena ghaṭasaṃskāramācareth | athātassarvaśāntissyādapamṛtyubhaye tathā || 29.211 || grahakope mahāvyādhau paracakrabhaye tathā | arthabandhuvināśe ca durbhikṣe ca parājaye || 29.212 || abhicārabhaye caiva tāpatrayanipīḍane | viruddhe'cātmanaḥ prāpte sarvaśāntiṃ samācareth || 29.213 || saptāhaṃ vā navāhaṃ vā dvādaśārṇena vai pṛthak | aṣṭottara sahasraṃ tu juhuyādvidhinā kramāth || 29.214 || iti śrīvaikhānase bhagavacchāstre bhṛguproktāyāṃ sihitāyāṃ prakīrṇādhikāre ekonatriṃśo'dhyaḥ <30> athatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ prāyaścittam athavakṣye viśeṣeṇa tantrasaṃkaraniṣkṛtiṃ | vaiṣṇavasyānyatantreṇa saṃkare doṣamādiśeth || 30.1 || grāmasya yajamānasya rājño rāṣṭrasya saṃkṣayaḥ | taddoṣaśamanāyaiva sāṃkaryamapahāya ca || 30.2 || padmāvale vaiṣṇavaṃ ca viṣṇusūktaṃ ca pauruṣaṃ | pāramātmikamīṅkārā dyaṣṭāśītiṃ viśeṣataḥ || 30.3 || aṣṭottarasahasraṃ vā śatamaṣṭottaraṃ tu vā | doṣagauravamuddiśya hutvā pūrvavadācareth || 30.4 || vaiṣṇavaṃ dvividhaṃ śāstraṃ munibhiḥ parikīrtitaṃ | vaikhānasaṃ pañcarātraṃ vaidikaṃ tāntrikaṃ kramāth || 30.5 || vaikhānasaṃ vaidikaṃ syādvaidikairarcitaṃ dvijaiḥ | aihikāmuṣmikaphalapradaṃ soṃyaṃ prakīrtitaṃ || 30.6 || pañcarātramathāgneyamavaidikamatāttvikaṃ | tāpādipañcasaṃskāradīkṣāvadbhissamarcitaṃ || 30.7 || aśrīkaramatha proktaṅkevalāmuṣmikapradaṃ | soṃyaṃ sarvatra saṃpūjyaṃ grāmādiṣu viśeṣataḥ || 30.8 || brāhmaṇānāṃ ca geheṣu soṃye nai vārcayeddhariṃ | āgneyamarcayettadvadavāstvaṅgālaye tathā || 30.9 || parvatādiṣvaraṇyeṣu vivikteṣu sthaleṣuca | viprāvāse janāvāse naiva kuryādanena tu || 30.10 || soṃye vaikhānase mārge yadyāgne yena saṃkaraḥ | pañcarātreṇa saṃprāpto rājā rāṣṭraṃ vinaśyati || 30.11 || taddoṣaśamānāyaiva padmāgnau juhuyātkramāth | mahāśāntiṃ vidhānena saptāhaṃ vā tṣahantu vā || 30.12 || aṣṭādhikaśadaiścaiva saṃsnāpya kalaśaistataḥ | abhyarcya devadeveśaṃ saṃpūjyaiva tu vaiṣṇavān || 30.13 || bhojayitvā brāhmaṇāṃstu kārayetpūrvavartmanā | pañcarātravidhānena pratiṣṭhāpyārcanekṛte || 30.14 || kālenāntarite tasminkuryātsoṃya praveśanaṃ | soṃyatvādrājarāṣṭrāṇāṃ tatsa mṛddhikaraṃ bhaveth || 30.15 || padmānale mahāśāntiṃ hutvādau ca tataḥkramāth | vaikhānasena vidhināvimānaṃ biṃbameva ca || 30.16 || saṃskṛtya cocitaissarvaiskaṃskāraiḥ karṣaṇādibhiḥ | pratiṣṭhāpya tadārabhya sarvaṃ tenaiva cācareth || 30.17 || ālayāśritadevānāṃ parivārasya parṣadāṃ | pūjāyāmapyamukhyāyāṃ saṃkaro naiva sammataḥ || 30.18 || mahātmyaṃ kimuvakṣyāmi śāstrasya mahato'sya vai | nālaṃ devāstrayassendrā ananto'pyupavarṇituṃ || 30.19 || śruṇantu munayassarve śāstramāhātmyamuttamaṃ | yāvacchakti pravakṣyāmi jñātaṃ gurukṛpābalāth || 30.20 || purā caturmukho brahmāsisṛkṣurakhilaṃ jagath | suptodthitaściraṃ kālaṃ prākrāmītsargakarmaṇi || 30.21 || visasmāra yadā dhātā nidrayākrāntamānasaḥ | vedāntsargapradhānāṃstu sṛṣṭirnaivapravartate || 30.22 || cintātura stadā brahmā mūḍhaḥ kartavyakarmaṇi | bahudhā dhyāyamānastuna lebhe kāraṇaṃ svataḥ || 30.23 || svaśaktyā yadvidheyaṃ syātsarvaṃ cakre vimūḍhadhīḥ | na hi tatkāraṇaṃ lebhe vedavismaraṇaṃ tu yath || 30.24 || cirācchintāṃ tu tāṃ tyaktvā svasthacittaḥ prajāpatiḥ | hṛtpadmamadhye puruṣaṃ parameṇa samādhinā || 30.25 || cintayāmāsa vai viṣṇumṛgyajussāmarūpiṇaṃ | tuṣṭāva ca tadā brahmā haripravaṇamānasaḥ || 30.26 || nanāma ca tadā viṣṇuṃ śaṅkhacakragaddharaṃ | arcayāmāsa deveśaṃ pādyādyairvigrahaissamaiḥ || 30.27 || muhurmuhuḥ praṇamyāthamūrthnā devaṃ jagatpatiṃ | nirvyājakaruṇāleśāddevasya vimalāntaraḥ || 30.28 || tuṣṭāvajagadīśānaṃ nārāyaṇamajaṃ vidhiḥ | "jitante puṇḍarīkākṣa namaste viśvabhāvana || 30.29 || namaste'stu hṛṣīkeśa mahāpuruṣa pūrvaja | deśakālaparicchedarahitānanta cinmaya || 30.30 || satyajñānasukhānandasvarūpa parameśvara | pañcavyūha caturvyūhāna ntavyūhātmavigraha || 30.31 || viṣṇo puruṣa satyācyutāniruddha jagatpate | nityamuktajanāvāsaparamavyomanāyaka || 30.32 || śrībhūnīlādisaṃsevya divyamaṅgalavigraha | śaṅkhacakragadāvāṇe bhaktābhayavaraprada || 30.33 || kīrīṭa hāra keyūra kaṭakāṅgadabhūṣita | graiveyakapariṣkāra kaṭīsūtravirājita || 30.34 || tulasīmālikārājadviśālorasthsalāṃcita | pralaṃbayajñasūtrāḍhya kaustubhābharaṇojjvala || 30.35 || sarvalokeśvarācintya śrīvatsakṛtalakṣaṇa | divyāyudhasamāsevya pītāṃbarasuśobhita || 30.36 || nityaniryatnanirandhravisārikaruṇārasa | mandasnitamukhāṃbhoja madhurādharapallava || 30.37 || rukmābha raktanetrāsyapāṇipāda sukhodvaha | subhrūlalāṭasubhaga sunasa svāyatekṣaṇa || 30.38 || vṛttapīnāyatabhuja tanumadhya mahāhano | vilāsavikramākrānta trailokyacaraṇāṃbuja || 30.39 || jñānaśakti balaiśvaryavīrya tejovidhe'nagha | namaste viṣṇave tubhyaṃ puruṣāya namo namaḥ || 30.40 || samassatyasvarūpāya acyutāya namo namaḥ | namo'niruddharūpāya vāsudevāya śārṅgiṇe || 30.41 || namaścidātmane'nanta śāntarūpāya dhanvine | śāsate nirapekṣāya svatantrāyādhikāriṇe || 30.42 || acyutāyāvikārāya tejasāṃ nidhaye namaḥ | pradhāna puruṣeśāya vedavedyāya vedine || 30.43 || namaḥ para vyūharūpa namo vibhavavigraha | antaryāminnamaste'stu namor'cārūpa śāśvata || 30.44 || sahasraśīrṣaṃ puruṣaṃ sahasrākṣaṃ nirañjanaṃ | sahasrapādaṃ trātāraṃ śaraṇaṃ tvāṅgato'smyahaṃ || 30.45 || mātā tvaṃ me pitā tvaṃ me bhrātā tvaṃ me sakhāmama | sarvaṃ tvamasi viśvātmaṃstvayi sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitaṃ || 30.46 || saṃsārasāgaraṃ ghoramanantaṃ kleśabhājanaṃ | tvāmeva śaraṇaṃ pāpya nistaranti manīṣiṇaḥ || 30.47 || na hi te gopya te kiñcinna hyantyaviditaṃ tava | tvaṃ sākṣī dehināmekassarvaṃ vyāpya tvamedhase || 30.48 || na te rūpaṃ na karaṇaṃ kāraṇaṃ nāsti te'nagha | tvaṃ śāstā sarvalokānāṃ sraṣṭāpātā haranhare || 30.49 || ahaṃ bhavaśca te brahmanprasādakrodhajāvubhau | tvatto me mānasaṃ janma prathamaṃ dvijapūjitaṃ || 30.50 || vijñānaṃ tadidaṃ prāptaṃ brahmatvaṃ ca yadārjitaṃ | sarvaṃ tava kaṭākṣasya leśo'yaṃ madhusūdana || 30.51 || tamasākrāntacittasya vismṛtā nigamā mama | avedavihitassargo mayā kartuṃ na śakyate || 30.52 || prasīda parameśāna vedabhikṣāṃ prayaccha me | iti cintayatastasya babhūvāvāvilaṃ manaḥ || 30.53 || tatastubhagavānbrahmā vedarāśimavāptavān | sasmāra nikhilānvedānsāṃgānupaniṣadgaṇaṃ || 30.54 || purāṇanyāyamīmāṃsādharmaśāstrāṇi sarvaśaḥ | catuṣṣaṣṭikalāścaiva vidyāsthānāni yāni ca || 30.55 || antarhitānāṃ khananādvedānāntu viśeṣataḥ | sa vibhuḥ procyate brahmā vikhanā brahmavādibhiḥ || 30.56 || vaikhānasaśca bhagavānprocyate sa pitāmahaḥ | jagatsarvamaśeṣeṇa vedadṛṣṭena vartmanā || 30.57 || prāṇācca cakṣuṣastadvadabhimānācca marmaṇaḥ | hṛdayācchirasaśśrotrādudānādvyānatastataḥ || 30.58 || samānācca tathāpānādṛṣiśreṣṭhānimāndaśa | dakṣaṃ marīcinaṃ nīlalohitaṃ bhṛgumena ca || 30.59 || tathāṃgirasamatriñca pulastyaṃ pulahaṃ tathā | vasiṣṭhaṃ cakratuṃ caiva kramādasṛjadabjabhūḥ || 30.60 || nava brahmāṇa evai te vināsyurnīlalohitaṃ | vedānāṃ vyasanādarpākprāgrūpaṃ militaṃ tu yath || 30.61 || tāntu vaikhānasīṃ śākhāyetānadhyāpayanmuniḥ | nāmnā vikhanasaṃ prāhuryaṃ ca śātātapaṃ tathā || 30.62 || bhṛgvaṅgiromarīcyatripulastyapulahāḥkratuḥ | tathā vasiṣṭhodakṣaśca nava brahmāṇariritā || 30.63 || (nava brāhmāṇa evaite vinyānye nīlalohitam) | ete vikhanasaśsiṣyāśśrutismṛtividhānataḥ | tacchiṣyāstu mahātmāno munayastattvadarśinaḥ || 30.64 || vedānugāni śāstrāṇi cakrurlokahitaiṣiṇaḥ | ke cidgṛhyāṇi vai cakrurgṛhyaśrautātmakāni tu || 30.65 || dharmaśāstrāṇi kecittu purāṇāni ca ke cana | itihāsāṃstathākalpānprocuranye maharṣaya? || 30.66 || ke cidvyākaraṇaṃ kecinnyāyamanye tathetarath | vāṅmayaṃ sakalaṃ sarvaṃ śāstrabaddhaṃ pracakrire || 30.67 || tāntuvākhānasīṃ śākhāṃ svasūtre viniyuktavān | padmabhūḥparamo dhātā tasminnārādhanatrayaṃ || 30.68 || tāntu vaikhānasīṃ śākhāṃ svasūtre viniyuktavān | cakre ṛgādibhedaistu vyasitvā tu pṛthakpṛthak || 30.69 || ādikāle tu bhagavānbrahmātu vikhanā muniḥ | yajuśśākhānusāreṇa cakresūtraṃ mahattaraṃ || 30.70 || varṇāśramācārayutaṃ śrautasmārtasamanvitaṃ | yatsūtrādyantamadhyeṣu bhagavānviṣṇuravyayaḥ || 30.71 || yaṣṭavyo gīyate yasmātsarvasūtrottamaṃ tu tath | vede vaikhānase sūtre yo dharmaḥ parikīrtitaḥ || 30.72 || sarvaissadharmonuṣṭheyo nātra kāryāvicāraṇā | svasūtrasya parityāgādanyasūtrasamāśrayāth || 30.73 || sadyaḥpatati vai viprona vedasya samāśraye | sūtraṃ vaikhānasaṃ yattu vedassaṃpratipadyate || 30.74 || etadvaikhānasaṃ sūtramanyasūtrānapekṣitaṃ | etadvaikhānasaṃ sūtraṃ sarvavedārthasaṃgrahaḥ || 30.75 || vaiṣṇavaṃ sarvaviprāṇāṃ sāmnyamabhidhīyate | vaikhānasasya sūtrasya cāgneśśrāmaṇakasya ca || 30.76 || nārāyaṇasya devasya māhātmyaṃ nāvabudhyate | yathā vedeṣu sarveṣu sāmavedaḥ praśasyate || 30.77 || tathā sarveṣu sūtreṣu sūtrametatpraśasyate | agnirvaikhānasaṃ śāstraṃ viṣṇurvedāścaśāśvatāḥ || 30.78 || gāyatrī vaiṣṇavā viprāssaptaite bahupāvanāḥ | adhīteṣu ca vedeṣu sāṃgeṣu labhate phalaṃ || 30.79 || tatphalaṃ labhate sadyassūtrametatpaṭhandvijaḥ | agnīṣomādayo devā ye yajñāṃśahavirbhujaḥ || 30.80 || te sarve sūtramāśritya cainaṃ gacchanti mādhavaṃ | śārīrāṇyanyasūtrāṇi tathā svargaphalāni ca || 30.81 || vaiṣṇavaṃ sūtrametaddhi sarvasiddhikaraṃ paraṃ | ādyatvātsarvasūtrāṇāṃ vaiṣṇavatvādviśeṣataḥ || 30.82 || mayānuvartitaṃ tadvatkāśyapātrimarīcibhiḥ | yasminneva tu saṃprokte sūtre vikhanasā purā || 30.83 || vanasthānāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ vidhiśśrāmaṇakābhidhaḥ | vānaprasthāstatassvarve yedvijāścānyasūtriṇaḥ || 30.84 || tatsūtravidhyamaṣṭhānātsmṛtā vaikhānasā amī | kiṃ bahūktena vidhinā sarvaṃ vaikhānasaṃ jagath || 30.85 || parasminvyomni yaccār'ke yattejastutrayīmayaṃ | tadvaikhānaḥ paraṃ brahma iti vedādadhīmahi || 30.86 || śāstrametacca sūtraṃ ca sarveṣāmapi jīvanaṃ | ye vaikhānasasūtreṇa saṃskṛtāstu dvijātayaḥ || 30.87 || te viṣṇusadṛśā jñeyāssarveṣāmuttamottamāḥ | vaikhānasānāṃ sarveṣāṃ garbhavaiṣṇavajanmanāṃ || 30.88 || nārāyaṇassvayaṃ garbhemudrāṃ dhārayite nijāṃ | viprā vaikhānasākhyāye tebhaktāstattvamucyate || 30.89 || ekāntinassusattvasthā dehāntaṃ nānyayājīnaḥ | viṣṇoḥpriyatamā loke catvāraḥ parikīrtitāḥ || 30.90 || aśvadthaḥkapilā gāvastulasī vaiṣṇavā dvijāḥ | dvijeṣu brāhmāṇāśśreṣṭhā brāhmaṇeṣu ca caiṣṇavāḥ || 30.91 || vaiṣṇaveṣu paraṃ śreṣṭhā ye vaikhānasasūtriṇaḥ | vaiṣṇavīṃ pratimāṃ loke vipraṃ vaikhānasaṃ tathā || 30.92 || gaṅgāṃ viṣṇupadīṃ dṛṣṭvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate mūlamasyāpi śāstrasya | sārdhakoṭipramāṇataḥ upādiśatsa bhagavānasmabhyaṃ naimiśe vane || 30.93 || iti saṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ mahattvaṃ sūtraśāstrayoḥ | tasmādvaikhānasā viprāssaṃpūjyā bhagavatpriyāḥ || 30.94 || pūjānte snapanānte ca tathānte cotsavasya ca | ācāryamarcakaṃ cāpi sarvānvaikhānasāṃstathā || 30.95 || prathamaṃ pūjayitvaiva paścātkāryaṃ samācareth | yaḥpūjakamanādṛtya vipraṃ vaikhānasaṃ haṭhāth || 30.96 || tīrthaṃ gṛhītuṃ prathamcchetsa patati dhruvaṃ yaḥ | pūjakamanādṛtya vipraṃ vaikhānasaṃ punaḥ || 30.97 || prasādaṃ devadevasya prathamaṃ tu jighṛkṣati | brahmahatyāmavāpnoti tatbūjā niṣpalā bhaveth || 30.98 || yaḥ pūjakamanādṛtya vipraṃ vaikhānasaṃ punaḥ | yādṛśīmapi devāgre vāñchatyapacitiṃ janaḥ || 30.99 || caturvedyapi so viprassadyaścaṇḍālatāṃ vrajeth | tatpūjā niṣphalā ca syādrājarāṣṭraṃ vinaśyati || 30.100 || ṣaṭkālaṃ vā trikālaṃ vā dvikālaṃ kālameva vā | ālaye bhagavatpūjā soṃyena vidhinā kṛtā || 30.101 || sarvasaṃpatkarī sā syājjagatāmiti śāsanaṃ | tatrārcane tu śuddhātmā pūjakaḥ paritoṣitaḥ || 30.102 || tena rājā ca rājyaṃ ca yajamānaśca nānvayaḥ | sarvalokaśca saṃtuṣṭo vardhate brahmatejasā || 30.103 || agraṃ vṛkṣasya rājānomūlaṃ vṛkṣasya pūjakāḥ | tasmānmūlaṃ na hiṃsīyānmūlādagraṃ prarohati || 30.104 || phalaṃ vṛkṣasya rājānaḥ puṣpaṃ vṛkṣasya pūjakāḥ | tasmātpuṣpaṃ na hiṃsīyātpuṣpātsaṃjāyate phalaṃ || 30.105 || devasyaṃ brāhmaṇasvaṃ ca sanmānaṃ pūjakasya ca | yastu na trāyate rājā tamāhurbrahmaghātukaṃ || 30.106 || durbalānāmanāthānāṃ bālavṛddhatapasvināṃ | anyāyaiḥ paribhūtānāṃ sarveṣāṃ pārthivo gatiḥ || 30.107 || rājā pitā ca mātā ca rājā ca paramo guruḥ | rājā ca sarvabhūtānāṃ paritrātā gururmataḥ || 30.108 || dāvāgnidavadagdhānāṃ rājā pūrṇamivāṃbhasā | samudramiva tṛpyanti brāhmaṇā vedavādinaḥ || 30.109 || dahatyagnistejasā ca sūryo dahati raśmibhiḥ | rājā dahati diḍena vipro dahati manyuvā || 30.110 || manyupraharaṇā viprāścakra praharaṇo hariḥ | cakrāttīkṣṇataro manyustasmādviprānna kopayeth || 30.111 || agnidagdhaṃ praroheta sūryadagdhaṃ tathaiva ca | daṇḍyastu saṃpraroheta brahmaśāpahato hataḥ || 30.112 || āpadyapi ca kaṣṭāyāṃ nāvamānyo hi pūjakaḥ | arcakena tu tuṣṭena yaduktaṃ devasannidhau || 30.113 || tadvākyaṃ tu ha rervākyaṃ nāvamānyo hi pūjakaḥ | arcakaṃ kopayedyastu sa hi devasya kopakṛth || 30.114 || deveśaṃ toṣayedyastu sa hi pūjakatoṣakṛth | gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ tathā mālyaṃ tāṃbūlaṃ cākṣatādikaṃ || 30.115 || prasādaṃ cāpi devasya prathamaṃ pūjakor'hati | ṣaḍaṅgaviduṣāṃ caiva kratupravarayājināṃ || 30.116 || vaikhānasaḥ punātyagre goṣṭhīṃ vipraśatasya tu | phalābhisaṃdhirahitaṃ sarvaṃ karmākhilaṃ kṛtaṃ || 30.117 || brahmārpaṇadhiyā kuryātsa bhavedvaiṣṇavottamaḥ | nānyaṃ devaṃ namaskuryānnānyaṃ devaṃ prapūjayeth || 30.118 || arcayetsatataṃ dhyāyennārāyaṇamanāyaṃ | kāyena manasā vācā sa tu vaiṣṇava ucyate || 30.119 || tiryakpuṇḍradharaṃ caiva pāṣaṇḍinamavaiṣṇavaṃ | devāgre pūjaye'nnaiva tadvaiṣṇavavimānanā || 30.120 || abhyarcyā viṣṇubhaktā hi vaiṣṇavā bhagavatpriyāḥ | avaiṣṇavasya pūjā tu teṣāmagre sudāruṇā || 30.121 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena tyajeddūrādavaiṣṇavaṃ | yetu sāmānyabhāvena manyante puruṣottamaṃ || 30.122 || rudrādibhissahājñā nātte'pi jñeyā avaiṣṇavāḥ | nareṣu brāhmaṇāśśreṣṭhā brāhmaṇeṣu vipaścitaḥ || 30.123 || vipaścitsu kṛtadhiyasteṣu kartāra eva ca | kartṛṣu brahmaviduṣo ye hi bhaktājanākdane || 30.124 || viṣṇubhakteṣu sarvatra śreṣṭhā vaikhānasāssmṛtāḥ | tasmātsaṃpūjya sarvādau bhaktyā vaikhānasaṃ dvijaṃ || 30.125 || viṣṇubhaktaṃ tataḥ pūjya yathāvarṇānupūrvyaśaḥ | goṣṭhīṃ samarcayetkāle bhojyāścānye dvijātayaḥ || 30.126 || strīyaḥ pūjyā vidhānena vaiṣṇapyo vaiṣṇavāśrayāḥ | na hi sādhāraṇi sṛṣyirvaiṣṇavīti vicintayeth || 30.127 || janmāntarasahasreṣu tapodhyānasamādhibhiḥ | narāṇāṃ kṣīṇapāpānāṃ kṛṣṇe bhaktiḥ prajāyate || 30.128 || na hyabhāgavatairviṣṇurjñrātuṃ stotuṃ ca tattvataḥ | draṣṭuṃ vā śakyate mūḍhāḥ praveṣṭuṃ kuta eva hi || 30.129 || tadbhaktibhāvitāḥ pūtā narāstadgatacetasaḥ | bhavantivai bhāgavatāste viṣṇuṃ praviśanti ca || 30.130 || aneka janmasaṃsāracite pāpasamuccaye | vārṣiṇe jāyate puṃsāṃ govindābhimukhī matiḥ || 30.131 || pradveṣaṃ yāti govinde dvijānvedāṃśca nindati | yo narastaṃ vijānīyādāsurāṃśasamudbhavaṃ || 30.132 || pāṣaṇḍeṣu ratiḥ puṃsāṃ hetuvādānukūlatā | jāyate viṣṇumāyātaḥ patitānāṃ durātmanāṃ || 30.133 || yadā pāpakṣayaḥ puṃsāṃ tadā devadvijātiṣu | viṣṭau ca yajñapuruṣe śraddhā bhavati niścalā || 30.134 || yathā svalpāna śeṣastu narāṇāṃ pāpasaṃcayaḥ | bhavanti te bhāgavatā niśśreyaśaparā narāḥ || 30.135 || bhrāmyatāmatra saṃsāre narāṇāṃ karmadurgame | hastāvalaṃbano hyeko bhaktikrīto janārdanaḥ || 30.136 || karmaṇā manasā vācā prāṇināṃ yo'nasūyakaḥ | bhāvasaktaśca govinde viṣṇau bhāgavato hi saḥ || 30.137 || yo brāhmaṇāṃśca vedāṃśca nityameva namasyati | na drogdhā paravittādeḥ sahi bhāgavataḥ smṛtaḥ || 30.138 || sarvāndevānhariṃ vetti sarvānlokāṃśca keśavaṃ | tebhyaśca nāsyamātmāvaṃ sa hi bhāgavatassmṛtaḥ || 30.139 || devaṃ manuṣyamanyaṃ vā paśupakṣipipīlikāḥ | tarupāṣāṇakāṣṭhādīnbhūmyaṃbhogaganaṃ diśaḥ || 30.140 || ātmānaṃ cāpi deveśādvyatiriktaṃ janārdanāth | yo na jānāti puṇyātmā sa hi bhāgavatassmṛtaḥ || 30.141 || sarvaṃ bhagavato bhāgo yadbhūtaṃ bhavyasaṃsthitaṃ | iti yo vai vijānāti sa hi bhāgavatassmṛtaḥ || 30.142 || bhavabhītiṃ haratyeṣa bhaktibhāvena bhāvitaḥ | bhagavāniti yadbhāvassa tu bhāgavatassmṛtaḥ || 30.143 || bhāvaṃ na kurute yastu sarvabhūteṣu pāpakaṃ | karmaṇā manasā vācā sa tu bhāgavatassmṛtaḥ || 30.144 || bāhyārthanirapekṣo yo bhaktyā bhagavataḥ kriyāṃ | bhāvena niṣpādayati jñeyo bhāgavato hi saḥ || 30.145 || nārayo yasya susnigdhā na codāsīnavṛttayaḥ | paśyatassarvamevedaṃ viṣṇuṃ bhāgavatassa hi || 30.146 || sutapteneha tapasā yajñairvā bahudakṣiṇaiḥ | tāṃ gatiṃ na narāyānti yāṃ tu bhāgavatā narāḥ || 30.147 || yogacyutairbhāgavataiddevarājaśśatakratuḥ | avāṅnirīkṣyate najrīkimu ye yogapāragāḥ || 30.148 || yajñaniṣpattaye vedā devā yajñapateḥ kṛte | tattoṣaṇāya yatate sa hi bhāgavatassmṛtaḥ || 30.149 || yena sarvātmanā bhaktyā viṣṇau bhāvo niveśitaḥ | yuktatvātkṛtakṛtyatvātsa hi bhāgavatassmṛtaḥ || 30.150 || vratināṃ yajñapuruṣaḥ pūjyo viṣṇurasaṃśayaḥ | strīyaśca svaṃ ca bhartāramṛte pūjyanna daivataṃ || 30.151 || bharturgṛhasthasya sataḥ pūjyo yajñapatirhariḥ | vaikhānasānāmārādhyastapobhirmadhusūdanaḥ || 30.152 || dhyeyaḥ parivrājakānāṃ vāsudevo mahātmanāṃ | evamāśramiṇāṃ viṣṇussarveṣāṃ ca parāyaṇaṃ || 30.153 || na dānairnatapobhiśca prīyate bhagavānhariḥ | varṇāśramācāravatā yathā sa parituṣyati || 30.154 || varṇāśramācāravatā puruṣeṇa paraḥpumān | viṣṇurārādhyate panthā nānyastattoṣakārakaḥ || 30.155 || atrānukteṣu doṣeṣu prāyaścittaṃ pravakṣyate | paiṇḍarīkāgnimāsādya pariṣicya ca pāvakaṃ || 30.156 || ṣaṭkṛtvo vaiṣṇavaṃ tadvaccatuṣkṛtvaśca vyāhṛtīḥ | aṣṭākṣaraṃ cāṣṭakṛtvastathā ca dvādaśākṣaraṃ || 30.157 || hutvā dvādaśakṛtvastu viṣṇusūktaṃ ca pauruṣaṃ | ekākṣarādisūktaṃ ca śrībhūsūktadvayaṃ huneth || 30.158 || devaṃ saṃsnāpya cābhyarcya havissamyaṅni vedayet, | anena vidhinā tatra śāntirbhavati śobhanā || 30.159 || hādoṣeṣu ca punaruktahomaissahaiva tu | pāramātmikamīṅkārādyaṣṭāśītiṃ viśeṣataḥ || 30.160 || hutvā ca sarvadaivatyamaṣṭābhiśca śatairghaṭaiḥ | devaṃ saṃsnāpya cābhyarcya havissamyaṅni vedayeth || 30.161 || iti śrīvaikhānase bhagavacchāstre bhṛguproktāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prakīrṇādhikāre triṃśo'dhyāyaḥ <31> athaika triṃśo'dhyāyaḥ saṃprokṣaṇatrayam atha vakṣyāmi tatroktaprāyaścittasya saṃgrahaṃ | jalasaṃprokṣaṇaṃ caiva laghusaṃprokṣaṇaṃ tathā || 31.1 || mahāsaṃprokṣaṇaṃ ceti prāyaścittaṃ tridhā smṛtaṃ | nimitte samanuprāpte jñātvā gauravalāghavaṃ || 31.2 || vakṣyamāṇakrāreṇa sadyassaṃprokṣaṇaṃ careth | saṃprokṣaṇavidhānasya na kālaniyamassmṛtaḥ || 31.3 || na kuryānmāsanakṣatra tithivārādyavekṣaṇaṃ | tasmānnimitte saṃprāpte sadyassaṃprokṣaṇaṃ careth || 31.4 || deśakālādyavekṣāyā nimitte sati gauravaṃ | bahubereṣu caikasminsthāvare jaṅgame'tha vā || 31.5 || arcanāyāṃ vihīnāyāṃ kālātīte viparyaye | nirmālyapūjane caiva niveditanivedane || 31.6 || ekāhe'pyarcanāhīne nityasnāpanavarjane | balihomādihīneca nityotsavavivarjane || 31.7 || prākārābhyantare prāpte pramādādaśubhe sati | aspṛśyāgamane tatra caṇḍālādyaiḥ praveśane || 31.8 || śvakukkuṭa varāhoṣṭragardabhānāṃ praveśane | udakyayā sūtikayā pāṣaṇḍādyairathāpi vā || 31.9 || kuṇḍagolavratabhraṣṭaturuṣkādipraveśane | anyasūtridvijaisspṛṣṭe mohādajñānato'pivā || 31.10 || mahāvātahate biṃbe saṃsikte varṣabindubhiḥ | viṇmūtrarudhirasrāve bahujalpe ca maithune || 31.11 || evamādinimitte tu jalasaṃprokṣaṇaṃ careth | naivāsaṃprokṣite biṃbe harirvasati niścayaḥ || 31.12 || tasmādbiṃbaviśuddhyarthaṃ saṃprokṣyaiva samarcayeth | doṣādhikye samutpanne laghusaṃprokṣaṇaṃ careth || 31.13 || rāṣṭrakṣobhe ca durbhikṣe tantrasaṃkaradūṣaṇe | śūdrairvāthānulomairvāpāṣaṇḍairbhramitairapi || 31.14 || udakyayā sūtikayā patitairvātha pātakaiḥ | caṇḍālādyaiḥ praviṣṭe ca garbhāgāre viśeṣataḥ || 31.15 || sūtairvā kuṇḍagolādyaistathā devalakādibhiḥ | śvakukkuṭa varāhādyaiḥ praviṣṭe gārdabhādibhiḥ || 31.16 || ulūkagṛdhrakākādyaiḥ praviṣṭe'ntargṛhe tathā | turuṣkādyaiḥpraviṣṭe vā śukraṇoṇitayorapi || 31.17 || viṇmūtrādervisarge vā garbhāgārerdhamaṇḍape | tṣahādūrdhvaṃ vihīne tu pūjane dīpavarjane || 31.18 || eka rātramatikramya devegrāmāntarasthite | āgnidāhe'śanīpāte garbhāgārer'dhamaṇḍape || 31.19 || anyasūtṣarcite biṃbespṛṣṭe vā buddhipūrvakaṃ | anyairanuktairdeṣaiśca laghusaṃprokṣaṇaṃ careth || 31.20 || mahānimitte saṃprāpte mahāsaṃprokṣaṇaṃ careth | dvādaśāhātsamārabhya vatsarāntaṃ vidhānataḥ || 31.21 || hīnāyāmarcanāyāṃ ca nitye naimittike tathā | kriyāhīne viparyāse hīne māsotsavādike || 31.22 || nityasnapanahīne'pi mātrādānavihīnake | balihomādihīne ca saṃprāpte śāstrasaṃkare || 31.23 || evamādiṣu hīneṣu vatsarāntaṃ pramādataḥ | parṣadāṃ parivārāṇāmāśritālayasevināṃ || 31.24 || dhvajārohaṇapūrvaṃ tu kṛte kālotsavādike | viprādimaraṇe prāpte devāgāre viśeṣataḥ || 31.25 || gardabhāśvalulāyoṣṭraśvasūkaramukhe mṛte | gajādimṛganāśe ca devāgāre pramādataḥ || 31.26 || caṇḍālādyantyajātīnāṃ maraṇe vā viśeṣataḥ | śūdrairvāthānulomairvā pāṣaṇḍaiḥ patitādibhiḥ || 31.27 || saṃspṛṣṭe vaiṣṇave biṃbe turuṣkādyairmalimlucaiḥ | spṛṣṭe caṇḍālakādyairvā mahāpātakadūṣitaiḥ || 31.28 || vimāne'śanipāte vā maholkā patane'pi vā | lohito palavarṣe ca vāṃsuvarṣe viśeṣataḥ || 31.29 || bhūkaṃpāccalite biṃbe valmīkasya samudbhave | śithilibhavane vāpi cāṣṭabandhe viśeṣataḥ || 31.30 || jīrṇe staṃbhādipatane devāgārena vīkṛte | agnisparśe ca berasya manuṣyaprasave tathā || 31.31 || suthākarmaṇi sarvatra garbhagehādike punaḥ | biṃbeṣu garbhagehe vā kṛmikīṭādidarśane || 31.32 || hasane rodane caiva bhāṣaṇe ca viśeṣataḥ | svedaśoṇitayorvāpi darśane varṇasaṃkṣaye || 31.33 || vimāne maṇḍape vātha yatra kutrāpi vā hareḥ | devāgāre samutpanne doṣeṣveteṣu vā pṛthak || 31.34 || durbhikṣe rāṣṭrasaṃkṣobhe durnimitteṣu caiva hi | dussvapne bhūmikaṃpe vā pararājādyupadrave || 31.35 || bhūgupte coddhṛte biṃbe ciramanyālaye sthite | atikramya trirātraṃ tu deve grāmāntare sthite || 31.36 || kuṇḍagolakasūtādyairdīkṣitairarcane kṛte | anuktāni ca karvāṇi duritānyadbhutāni ca || 31.37 || dṛṣṭvātu yajamānaśca ye tatparisare janāḥ | grāmasthitā canāścaiva rājā rāṣṭraṃ ca yatnataḥ || 31.38 || jñātvā śāstroktavidhinā doṣajaṃ bhaktitaḥ phalaṃ | mahāsaṃprokṣaṇaṃ kuryānmahādoṣāpanuttaye || 31.39 || mahadoṣeṣu sarvatra mahāśāntirvithīyate | pūrvaṃ sthāpitabiṃbasya na sādhāraṇahetunā || 31.40 || syātpunasthsāpanaṃ tasmānmahāsaṃprokṣaṇaṃ careth | mahāsaṃprokṣaṇavidhernūtanasthāpanasya ca || 31.41 || svalpo bheda iti proktamṛṣibhiḥ kāśyapādibhiḥ | jalasaṃprokṣaṇavidhiṃ pravakṣyāmi tapodhanāḥ || 31.42 || yajamānābhyanujñāto gurussnātvā vidhānataḥ | ālayābhimukhe vāpi dakṣiṇe vā manorame || 31.43 || sthaṇḍile saikate śuddhe puṇyāhāgnimukhātvaraṃ | vāstuhomāvasāne ca doṣaduṣṭaṃ tu yatsthalaṃ || 31.44 || paryagnipañcagavyābhyāṃ saṃskratya vidhinā budhaḥ | biṃbaṃ puruṣasūktena kalaśairabhiṣicya ca || 31.45 || ṣaṭdroṇadhānya rāśau tu pañcakuṃbhānnidhāya ca | vastrayugnena saṃveṣṭya pratimāsteṣu nikṣipeth || 31.46 || nālikerāmrapatrādyairalaṅkṛtya pṛthakghaṭān | pañcasūktaṃ japitvaiva pañcaśāntibhireva ca || 31.47 || pañcamūrtibhirāvāhya samabhyarcyāṣṭavigrahaiḥ | paścādagniṃ paristīrya pañcasūktaṃ hunetsudhīḥ r || 31.48 || iṅkārādīṃśca juhuyādaṣṭāśītimataḥ paraṃ | pañcavāruṇamantraiśca mahāvyāhṛtibhissaha || 31.49 || paścādagniṃ visṛjyaiva gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dadeth | niṣkāhīnasuvarṇaṃ ca vastrābharaṇakuṇḍalān || 31.50 || paścātkuṃbhajalenaiva prokṣayitvā samantrakaṃ | prabhūtaṃ ca nivedyaiva nityārcanamathācareth || 31.51 || anena vidhinā doṣā naśyatyeva na saṃśayaḥ | tadbiṃbe devasānnidhyaṃ bhavedityāha cāṅgirāḥ || 31.52 || etāvāneva saṃprokto jalasaṃprokṣaṇakramaḥ | laghusaṃprokṣaṇaṃ kuryādyajamānena vai guruḥ || 31.53 || yathārhaṃ pūjitaḥ pūrvamāraṃbhadivasādadhaḥ | tṣahe vā dviyahe vāpi kṛtvā caivāṅkurārpaṇaṃ || 31.54 || aupāsanāgnau śvobhūte vāstuhomaṃ vidhāya ca | paryagni pañcagavyābhyāṃ śodhayitvā samantataḥ || 31.55 || abhiṣicya ca deveśamaṣṭottaraśatairghuṭaiḥ | śothayitvā vidhānena vastuvāstuparicchadān || 31.56 || paścātpadmāgnimāsādya kṛtāghāraṃ vidhānataḥ | kuṃbhapūjāṃ tataḥ kuryātsamyakdhyānayuto guruḥ || 31.57 || dvātriṃśatprasthasaṃpūrṇānkuṃbhānāhṛtya śobhanān | tantunā veṣṭayitvā tu toyairāpūrya mantrata || 31.58 || ṣaḍbhāradhānyarośau tu vedyāṃ saptadaśa kramāth | vastrayugmena saṃveṣṭya pratimāsteṣu nikṣipeth || 31.59 || niṣkatrayakṛtāṃstatra nava ratnāni yatnataḥ | ratnālābhe suvarṇaṃ vā pratyekaṃ nikṣipedghaṭe || 31.60 || gandhapuṣpaissamabhyarcya nālikerāmrapallavaiḥ | āyudhaiḥpañcabhistadvattoraṇairaṣṭamaṅgalaiḥ || 31.61 || alaṅkṛtya gururdhīmāntpṛṣṭvā kūrcena tānghaṭān | pañcasūktaṃ pañcaśāntiṃ tato dvādaśasūktakaṃ || 31.62 || sārasvatādisūktaṃ ca diksūktaṃ pañcavāruṇaṃ | svastisūktaṃ japitvaiva tathaivauṣadhisūktakaṃ || 31.63 || navamūrtibhirāvāhya devībhyāṃ saha pārṣadaiḥ | dvātriṃśadvigrahaissamyagabhyarcya tu nivedayeth || 31.64 || paiṇḍarīkāgnimāsādya pariṣicya ca pāvakaṃ | pañcasūktena juhuyādvyāpakatrayamantrataḥ || 31.65 || aṣṭottaraśataṃ tadvadaṣṭāviṃśatireva vā | riṅkārādīṃśca juhuyādaṣṭāśītimataḥ paraṃ || 31.66 || dhātādiṃ mūlahomaṃ ca pañcavāruṇameva ca | hutvā kūśmāṇḍahomaṃ ca pañcavāruṇameva ca || 31.67 || paṅkajairbilvapatrairvā viṣṇugāyatriyā tataḥ | aṣṭottaraśataṃ hutvā paścādagniṃ visarcayeth || 31.68 || paścādguruḥ pūjitassanvastrābharaṇakuṇḍalaiḥ | kuṃbhamādāya śiraso grāmamālayameva vā || 31.69 || pradakṣiṇaṃ parītyātha devadevasya sannidhau | kūrcenādāya tattoyaṃ prokṣayetpañcamūrtibhiḥ || 31.70 || "śucī vo havya'' mantreṇa prokṣayetsarvamandiraṃ | upacāraissamabhyarcya "kṣama''sveti praṇamya ca || 31.71 || mahāhaviḥ prabhūtaṃ vā deveśāya nivedayeth | brāhmaṇānāṃ sahasraṃ ca bhojayedguruṇā saha || 31.72 || gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dadyātsuvarṇaṃ pañcaniṣkakaṃ | pradadyādbhūmimiṣṭāṃ ca pronmiṣatsasyamālinīṃ || 31.73 || daśadānaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā nityārcanamathācareth | evaṃ yaḥ kurute bhaktyā laghusaṃprokṣaṇaṃ hareḥ || 31.74 || viṣṇusānnidhyamāpnoti doṣaśāntiśca jāyate | rājarāṣṭrābhivṛddhiśca jagatpuṣṭikaraṃ bhaveth || 31.75 || laghusaṃprokṣaṇavidhirmayā prakhyāpitaḥ kila | kāśyapādyaiśca munibhirevameva pracoditaḥ || 31.76 || mahāsaṃprokṣaṇa vidhau viśeṣo vakṣyate mayā | jalādhivāsarahitaṃ netronmīlanavarjanaṃ || 31.77 || pratiṣṭhoktavidhānena sarvaṃ pūrvavadācareth | netrayostejane tadvaddṛṣṭidoṣe viśeṣataḥ || 31.78 || jalādhivāsanaṃ kuryādakṣṇorunmīlanaṃ punaḥ | mahāśāntividhānasya viśeṣo'tra prakīrtitaḥ || 31.79 || jaṅgamapratimāssarvā adhivāsapurassaraṃ | prokṣayitvā vidhānena devaṃ pūrvavadarcayeth || 31.80 || mahānimitte saṃprāpte yajamānārthito guruḥ | pratiṣṭhoktadine vidvānṛtvigbhirlakṣaṇānvitaiḥ || 31.81 || vastrairābharaṇaiścāpi pūrvoktamiva bhūṣitaḥ | prokṣaṇādivasātsūrvamaṅkurārpaṇamācareth || 31.82 || dravyāṇyapi susaṃbhṛtya yāgaśālāṃ praviśya ca | kadalīpūgamālādyaiḥ patākādyairalaṅkṛtāṃ || 31.83 || tanmadhyekalpayedvediṃ śayanārthaṃ vidhānataḥ | tasyāstu pūrvadigbhāge kuṃbhavediṃ salakṣaṇaṃ || 31.84 || paritaścāgnikuṇḍāṃśca paiṇḍarīkaṃ ca kārayeth | devālayaṃ ca saṃśodhya mṛṣṭasiktopalepanaiḥ || 31.85 || ācāryassuprasannātmā yajamānārthito muhuḥ | snātvāsnānavidhānena gāyatrīṃ ca sahasraśaḥ || 31.86 || japtvā dvādaśasūktāni puṇyāhamapi vācayeth | vāstuhomaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā kuṇḍe tvaupāsane guruḥ || 31.87 || paryagni pañcagavyābhyāṃ saṃśodhyaiva ca sarvataḥ | gārhapatyādikuṇḍeṣu kramādāghāramācareth || 31.88 || pakvabiṃbasamākāraghaṭānāṃ pañcaviṃśatiṃ | tantunā trivṛtā veṣṭya śodhayitvā sudhūpitān || 31.89 || ādāya mantravaddivyaṃ jalamāhṛtya yatnataḥ | pūtābhiradbhirāpūrya nālikerāmrapallavaiḥ || 31.90 || alaṅkṛtya tathā kūrcairgandhapuṣpākṣatādibhiḥ | yavairvāhrīhibhirvātha vedyāṃ dvādaśabhārakaiḥ || 31.91 || āstīrya teṣu saṃsthāpya pṛthagvastreṇa veṣṭayeth | sauvarṇapratimāstatra pañcaniṣkakṛtāḥ pṛthak || 31.92 || gajakūrmādirūpāṇi navaratnādi ca kṣipeth | dhyānamārgeṇa kuṃbheṣu madhyamādiṣu cakramāth || 31.93 || navamūrtikrameṇaiva mantreṇāvāhayedguruḥ | vedyadhastheṣu kuṃbheṣu ceṃ dādīnaṣṭadikpatīn || 31.94 || āvāhya gandhapuṣpādyaissamabhyarcya nivedayeth | sahasrakalaśaissnāpya snapanoktaprakārataḥ || 31.95 || sauvarṇaṃ kautukaṃ baddhvā pratiṣṭhoktavidhānataḥ | śayyāvediṃ samabhyukṣya pañcatalpānprākalpyaca || 31.96 || śālivrīhiyavaiścāpi ṣaḍbhāraiśca pṛthakpṛthak | tadardhaistaṇḍulaiścātha tadardhaiśca tilaistathā || 31.97 || uparyupari cāstīrya carmajādīnsamāstareth | śayane śāyayedvedyāmautsavaṃ biṃbamuktavath || 31.98 || kūrcādhivāsaṃ kurvīta dhruvamātraṃ yadikramāth | vedānadhyāpayeddikṣu "ṛcāṃ prācī''riti śrutiḥ || 31.99 || gārhapatyādikuṇḍeṣu pratiṣṭhoktavidhānataḥ | ṛtvigbhiḥ kārayeddhomaṃ tattaddaivatyapūrvakaṃ || 31.100 || gurussabhyāgnimāsādya pariṣicya ca pāvakaṃ | pañcasūktaṃ krameṇaiva mahāvyāhṛtipūrvakaṃ || 31.101 || vyāpakatrayamantraṃ ca viṣṇugāyatriyā punaḥ | aṣottaraśataṃ hutvā vyāhṛtyā ca tathaiva ca || 31.102 || tato'bjāgniṃ samāsādya pañcasūktaissahaiva tu | dhātādimūlahomaṃ ca pañcavāruṇasaṃyutaṃ || 31.103 || mahāśāntyuktamantrāṃśca trirāvartya hunettataḥ | kuṃbhavediṃ samāsādya samabhyarcyāṣṭavigrahaiḥ || 31.104 || spṛṣṭvā kūrcena tatkuṃbhānṛtvigbhissaha vai guruḥ | ātmasūktaṃ japitvaiva pañcasūktamataḥ paraṃ || 31.105 || svastisūktaṃ ca daurgaṃ ca rātrimekākṣaraṃ tathā | aṣṭadikpālasūktāni pañcaśāntimataḥ paraṃ || 31.106 || "āpo hiraṇyavarṇā''bhyāṃ pāvamānībhireva ca | japtvā dvādaśasūktaṃ ca tatassabhyānale kramāth || 31.107 || hautrapraśasanaṃ kuryātsarvaṃ hottu pūrvavath | caturmūrtikrameṇaiva sahasrāhutinā saha || 31.108 || "yaddevā''dyaiśca kūśmāṇḍaissarvadaivatyamantrakaiḥ | hutvātu doṣaśāntyarthaṃ lojaistadvattilairapi || 31.109 || sāpūpairviṣṇugāyatṣā hutvākuṇḍeṣu pūrvavath | aṣṭottaraśataṃ tadvadaṣṭāviṃśatireva vā || 31.110 || pariṣegaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā paiṇḍarīke viśeṣataḥ | padmairvā bilvapatrairvā viṣṇugāyatriyā tataḥ || 31.111 || aṣottarasahasraṃ tu ghṛtenāplutya vai huneth | pāramātmikamantraiśca riṅkārādyaiśca yatnataḥ || 31.112 || aṣṭāśītiṃ tato hutvā mahāvyāhṛtipūrvakaṃ | hutvā taddoṣanāśāya rājarāṣṭrābhivṛddhaye || 31.113 || sabhyāgniṃ pauṇḍarīkāgniṃ hitvānyeṣvantahomakaṃ || 31.114 || nṛttagītādivādyaiśca rātriśeṣaṃ nayedguruḥ | prātassnātvā vidhānena kalaśaissnapanaṃ careth || 31.115 || pañcasūktaiśca saṃsnāpya pañcaśāntisamanvitaṃ | paścāddevamalaṅkṛtya suvastrābharaṇādikaiḥ || 31.116 || gandhapuṣpaissugandhaiśca yāpannetramanaḥpriyaṃ | muhūrte samanuprāpte kuṃbhamādāya deśikaḥ || 31.117 || svastisūktaṃ japangrāmamālayaṃ vā pradakṣiṇaṃ | kṛtvā devāgrataḥ kuṃbhaṃ dhyānyapīṭhe niveśayeth || 31.118 || yajamānena śaktyāvai gurussaṃpūjitastadā | kūryādanantaroktāṃśca saṃskārānbhagavatpriyān || 31.119 || vastrerābharaṇaiśśubhraiḥ kuṇḍalaiśca viśeṣataḥ | yajamānassusaṃpūjya paśubhūmyādibhirguruṃ || 31.120 || gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dadyānniṣkāṇāmekaviṃśatiṃ | ṛtvigbhyaśca tathā dadyātsuprīto bhagavānhariḥ || 31.121 || guruḥ paścātsamāvāhya samabhyarcyāṣṭavigrahaiḥ | mahāhavirni vedyaina pāyasāpūpasaṃyutaṃ || 31.122 || sājyaṃ savyañjanaṃ datvā mukhavāsaṃ nivedayeth | puṣpāñjaliṃ tato datvā "kṣaya'' sveti praṇamya ca || 31.123 || sahasraṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca bhojayecchāntihetave | daśadānaṃ viśeṣeṇa devaprītikaṃ bhaveth || 31.124 || evamādvādaśābdāttu pratiṣṭhāmācarettataḥ | punasthsāpanasaṃskārātprāyaścittaṃ na hītarath || 31.125 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena śāstroktaṃ sarvamācareth | evaṃ yaḥkurute bhaktyā viṣṇossaṃprokṣaṇatrayaṃ || 31.126 || pratiṣṭhāphalamāsādya vaiṣṇavaṃ lokamāpnuyāth || 31.127 || iti śrīvaikhānase bhagavacchāstre bhṛguproktāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prakīrṇādhikāre ekatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ <32> athadvātriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ prakīrṇakam ataḥparaṃ pravakṣyāmi jyeṣṭhāyāmutsavakramaṃ | jyeṣṭhe māsi tu saṃprāpte jyeṣṭhānakṣatra saṃyute || 32.1 || viṣṇoreva viśeṣassyātsugandhaṃ tailamāhareth | tailakramaṃ pravakṣyāmi śruṇudhvaṃ munipuṅgavāḥ || 32.2 || yāgaśālāṃ prakalpyaiva sarvālaṅkālasaṃyutāṃ | sabhyaṃ ca paiṇḍarīkaṃ ca kārayitvā salakṣaṇaṃ || 32.3 || taddinasya tu pūrvedyustṛtīye pañcame'pi vā | saptame'hani vā cāpi aṅkurārpaṇamācareth || 32.4 || āghāraṃ vidhivatkṛtvā sarvakāryamadaḥ paraṃ | vedyāstathottare pārśve bhūmyāmapaṭamācareth || 32.5 || catustālapramāṇeva vistāraṃ nimnameva ca | nimnetu vinyasedbhāṇḍaṃ dvidroṇaparimāṇakaṃ || 32.6 || "bhūḥ prati'' ṣṭheti mantreṇa nimne bhāṇḍaṃ sunikṣipeth | malayāgurudārūṇi devadāru tathaiva ca || 32.7 || yāni cātra sugandhīni devayogyāni tāni vai | guggulaṃ ca samāhṛtya mardayitvāsakṛtsakṛth || 32.8 || viṣṇu'gāyatriyā bhāṇḍe tāni dravyāṇi nikṣiveth | śarāveṇa pidhāyātha mṛdā ca parilepayeth || 32.9 || gokarīṣāṇi kāṣṭhāni tasyopari vinikṣipeth | mandāgninā pacettattu yāvattailāgamaṃ bhaveth || 32.10 || tāvatkālaṃ pacedvidvāntailamāhṛtya saṃbhṛtaṃ | vāsitāni tu vastūni parihṛtya tu tatra vai || 32.11 || sugandhidailabhāṇḍaṃ ca dhyānyapīṭhopari nyaseth | pūrvoktenaiva mantreṇa tantunā pariveṣṭayeth || 32.12 || pitṝnsomaṃ tathābhyarcya vanatpatimataḥ paraṃ | taile tasminvidhānena arghyāntamabhipūjayeth || 32.13 || vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktaṃ ca narasūktaṃ tathaiva ca | japtvātu viṣṇugāyatrīmaṣṭottarasahasrakaṃ || 32.14 || ācāryastvarito gatvā sabhyāgnestu samīpataḥ | dvitālavistṛtaṃ vṛttaṃ caturaṅgulamunnataṃ || 32.15 || kūrmākṛtivadākāraṃ bilvādyaiḥ parikalpitaṃ || 32.16 || pratiṣṭhāyāmutsave ca japahomārcanādiṣu | devakāryeṣu sarveṣu tathānyeṣu ca karmasu || 32.17 || kūrmapīṭhaṃ tu gṛhṇīyādanyathā niṣphalaṃ bhaveth | asīnaḥ kūrmapīṭhe tu sabhyāgnau juhuyāttathā || 32.18 || vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktaṃ ca narasūktaṃ tatheva ca | juhuyātsarvadaivatyaṃ pāramātmikameva ca || 32.19 || mahāvyāhṛtibhirhutvā antahomaṃ samācareth | praṇidhyāṃ śaṅkhapātre vā agnimāropayetsudhīḥ? || 32.20 || tailasyālepanātpūrvaṃ dhruvādagniṃ samāhareth | sragvastrakuṇḍalādyaiśca ācāryaṃ pūjayettataḥ || 32.21 || paricārakamāhūya yathārhaṃ pūjya taṃ tataḥ | uṣṇīṣaṃ dhārayitvātaṃ paricārakamūrdhani || 32.22 || sugandhitailabhāṇḍaṃ tu yatnenāpi vinikṣipeth | śanaiśsanaiśca gatvā tu sarvavādyasamanvitaṃ || 32.23 || sarvālaṅkārasaṃyuktaṃ brahmaghoṣasamanvitaṃ | vīthiṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya devasyāgretu nikṣipeth || 32.24 || arghyāntamabhipūjyaiva deveśaṃ saṃpraṇamya ca | vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktaṃ ca narasūktaṃ japetkramāth || 32.25 || tailenālepayeddevamācārya stvaritastathā | devībhyāṃ ca tataḥ paścāttattanmantreṇa lepayeth || 32.26 || sarveṣāṃ parivārāṇāṃ tattanmantraiśca kārayeth | ācāryastvaritogatvā cautsavasya samīpataḥ || 32.27 || "parilikhita'miti mantreṇa kavacaṃ pariśodhayeth | jīrṇe bhinne ca kavace śilpinaina susannayeth || 32.28 || prakṣālya pañcagavyena jalena pariśodhayeth | kṛtvāpi vāstuśuddhiṃ ca yathoktāṃ niṣkṛtiṃ careth || 32.29 || viṣṇornukādimantraiśca saṃdadhyātkavacaṃ tathā | dṛḍhīkṛtya tu pūrvoktaṃ yatnena parikalpayeth || 32.30 || sahasrakalaśairdevaṃ snāpayitvā yathāvidhe | nityapūjāvidhānena devamārādhya pūrvavath || 32.31 || mahāhaviḥprabhūtaṃ vā pāyasaṃ ca nivedayeth | "kṣamasve''ti vadanbhūyaḥ praṇametpuruṣottamaṃ || 32.32 || brahmaghoṣaṃ tataḥ kuryāddadyādācāryadakṣiṇāṃ | dine pakṣe ca māse ca tathā saṃnatsare careth || 32.33 || yadyadrūpaṃ tathādhyāyettattadbiṃbeṣu yojayeth | tasmātsarvaprayatnena biṃbarakṣāṃ samācareth || 32.34 || pavitrāropaṇam atha vakṣye viśeṣaṇa pavitrāropaṇaṃ hareḥ || 32.35 || sarvadoṣopaśamanaṃ sarvayajñaphalapradaṃ | sarvakāmapradaṃ caiva sarvatuṣṭikaraṃ paraṃ || 32.36 || sarvalokasya vṛddhyarthaṃ sarvalokasya śāntidaṃ | yadyanmantrakriyāhīnaṃ dravyahīnaṃ ca yatkṛtaṃ || 32.37 || taddoṣaśamanāyaiva pavitrāropaṇaṃ careth | pavitrāropaṇe hīne yā pūjā niṣphalā bhaveth || 32.38 || saṃkṣobho jāyate tatra tasmādyatnena kārayeth | āṣāḍhe śrāvaṇe māsi proṣṭhapadyāṃ viśeṣataḥ || 32.39 || dvādaśyāṃ śuklapakṣe tu viṣṇupañcadine'tha vā | saṃsarpamadhimāsaṃ ca tithivāraṃ ca śūnyakaṃ || 32.40 || daśamyekādaśīmiśraṃ taddinaṃ ca vivarjayeth | haritithyāṃ ca nirduṣṭe pavitrāropaṇaṃ śubhaṃ || 32.41 || navāhaṃ vātha saptāhaṃ pañcāhamatha vā tṣahaṃ | uktalakṣaṇasaṃpannamācāryaṃ varayetkramāth || 32.42 || ṛtvijo varayettadvacchiṣyāṃśca varayettataḥ | taddinātpūrvarātrau tu deveśaṃ prārthayedguruḥ || 32.43 || "bhagavato bale''neti procya namrāṅgassusamāhitaḥ | pādyādyaiśca viśeṣeṇa devamabhyarcya satvaraḥ || 32.44 || prārthanāsūktamuccārya vedādhyayanamārabheth | parito yāgaśālāyāśśiṣyaiḥ parivṛtoguruḥ || 32.45 || caturṣu dvāradeśeṣu kramātprāgādiṣu svayaṃ | caturvedāndimantrāṃśca śaktyādhyayanamācareth || 32.46 || puṇyāhaṃ ca tataḥ kṛtvā mṛtsaṃgrahaṇamācareth | aṅkurānalpayitvaiva mudgānnaṃ ca nivedayeth || 32.47 || aupāsanāgnikuṇḍe tu āghāraṃ vidhivadyajeth | vāstuhomaṃ ca hutvā tu gavyaṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ || 32.48 || paryagni pañcagavyābhyāṃ yogaśālāṃ viśodhayeth | "tamekanemi'' mityuktvā "āmāvājasya'' ityapi || 32.49 || "tantuntavva''nniti procya "yanmegarbha'' itīrayan | ṣaḍbhiśca vaiṣṇavairmantrairviṣṇugāyatriyā tathā || 32.50 || pavitrāṇi susaṃprokṣya vidhinā pañcagavyakaiḥ | "pratadviṣṇustavata'' iti "idaṃ viṣṇu'' ritīrayan || 32.51 || viṣṇugāyatriyā paścātpavitraṃ saṃpraṇamya ca || 32.52 || uttamaṃ svarṇasūtraṃ ca madhyamaṃ raupyasūtrakaṃ | kārpāsamadhamaṃ gṛhya sarvadoṣavivarjitaṃ || 32.53 || sumaṅgalībhiryugmābhirbrāhmaṇībhirviśeṣataḥ | alābhe kanyakābhirvā nirmitaṃ sūtramuttamaṃ || 32.54 || gṛhṇīyādbiṃbamānena cāṣṭottarasahasrakaṃ | granthayoṃguṣṭhamātrāssyustābhirmālāṃ ca kārayeth || 32.55 || vanamālā samākhyātā viṣṇoḥpriyatamā bhaveth | viṣṇusūktaṃ ca japtvātu "aṇoraṇīyā''niti brurna || 32.56 || prokṣya hāridratoyena "ime dhū'' peti dhūpayeth | caturvedādimantraiśca toraṇādyairalaṅkṛtaṃ || 32.57 || nabhyāgnikuṇḍaṃ kṛtvaiva āghāraṃ vidhivadyajeth || 32.58 || biṃbādhyardhapramāṇena śayyāvediṃ prakalpayeth | tilataṇḍuladhānyaiśca dhānyapīṭhaṃ prakalpya ca || 32.59 || darbhāṃstatra samāstīrya cāṇḍajādīni cāstareth | "pratadviṣṇu''riti procya pavitraṃ sannidhāya ca || 32.60 ||
