pañcamūrtabhirāvāhya samabhyarcya praṇamya ca | japtvā pratisaraṃ mantraṃ dhūpadīpādi darśayet? || 32.61 || "ato devā'' dinā paścāddeveśaṃ prārthayedguruḥ | pādyādibhissamabhyarcya dhūpadīpādidarśayeth || 32.62 || baddhvā pratisaraṃ devaṃ śrībhūmyau ca tathaiva ca | ācāryasyartvijāṃ caiva baddhvāpratisaraṃ tathā || 32.63 || "yadvaiṣṇavaṃ samuccārya pavitraṃ śayanaṃ careth | sūkṣmavastreṇa cācchādya cārpayetpuṣbamakṣataṃ || 32.64 || viṣṇusūktaṃ ca godānasūktaṃ caivātmasūktakaṃ | ekākṣarādisūktaṃ ca vaiṣṇavaṃ sūktameva ca || 32.65 || nṛsūktaṃ rudra sūktaṃ ca durgāsūktaṃ tathaiva ca | sārasvataṃ tathā sūktaṃ rātrisūktamataḥ paraṃ || 32.66 || "ṛtaṃ ca satyaṃ'' japtvaiva "sahasraśīrṣa''meva ca | śrībhūsūktañca japtvaiva kārayeddeśikottamaḥ || 32.67 || daśānāṃ caiva pañcānāṃ sūktānāṃ japa uttamaṃ | madhyamaṃ daśasūktānāṃ pañcānāmadhamaṃ bhaveth || 32.68 || prāgādidikṣu ca tathā vidikṣu ca caturṣvapi | kramācchāntaṃ khagādhīśaṃ cakraṃ śaṅkhaṃ tathaiva ca || 32.69 || vimānapālāṃścāvāhya samabhyarcya viśeṣataḥ | mudgānnaṃ vinivedyaiva praṇāmaṃ muhurācareth || 32.70 || sarvarakṣākaraṃ cakraṃ pavitropari cārcayeth | nivedayettadānnena śāntādīnāṃ baliṃ dadeth || 32.71 || pādau prakṣālya cācamya yathoktena vidhānataḥ | hautraṃ praśaṃsya vidhivadāvāhana mathācareth || 32.72 || juṣṭākāraṃ ca kṛtvā tu juhuyācca yathākramaṃ | hāvayetpañcabhissuktaistattaddaivatyameva ca || 32.73 || vaścādagniṃ visṛjyaiva rātriśeṣaṃ nayedguruḥ | tataḥ prabhāte dharmātmā snātvā snānavidhānataḥ || 32.74 || nityapūjā vidherante deveśaṃ prārthayedguruḥ | aṣṭottaraśatairdevaṃ snāpayetkalaśaistataḥ || 32.75 || alaṅkṛtyaca deveśaṃ dhūpadīpādikaṃ dadeth || 32.76 || audyantam'' itimantreṇa pavitraṃ mūrdhni dhārayan | sarvavādyasamāyuktaṃ to yadhārāpurassaraṃ || 32.77 || pradakṣiṇaṃ śanairgatvādevāgresannidhāyaca | "surya'' ca mantreṇa śatañjaptvā tu pallavaṃ || 32.78 || ācāryassuprasannātmā svātmarakṣāṃ vidhāyaca | viṣṇusūktaṃ samuccārya kaniṣṭhādi ca ropayeth || 32.79 || pādyādyairdevamabhyarcya mukhavāsāntamādarāth | kuṃbhāṃstu saptadaśa ca alaṅkṛtya yathāvidhi || 32.80 || vedyāmāropayetkuṃbhānsvastike sannidhāya ca | śayyāvedi ca tatprācyāṃ sabhyakuṇḍaṃ prakalpyaca || 32.81 || abjāgnikuṇḍamāgneyyāmīśe caupāsasaṃ tathā | aupāsanāgnikuṇḍe tu āghāraṃ vidhivadyajeth || 32.2 || śayyāvedyāstūttare ca trihastāyatavistṛtāṃ | caturaśrāṃ samāṃ kṛtvāyantravediṃ salakṣaṇaṃ || 32.3 || pañcavarṇairviśeṣeṇa yantraṃ vikhya manoharaṃ | atha yantraṃ pravakṣyāmi śruṇudhvaṃ munisattamāḥ || 32.4 || sarvarakṣākarasudarśana yantraḥ - ādau ṣaṭkoṇaṃ vilikhya tanmadhye sādhyanāma vilikhya oṃ kṣrām, hrīm, śrīm, vilikhya, tatpārśvayoḥ, irm, im, iti dṛṣṭibījaṃ, um, ūm, iti śrotrabījaṃ ca vilikhya, ṣaṭkoṇeṣu, sahasrārahuṃ phaṭ iti sudarśanaṣaḍakṣarīṃ vilikhya, koṇasaṃdhau oṃ haṃ laṃ raṃ yam? likhitvā, tadbahirvṛttamaṣṭadalaṃ vilikhya, daleṣu oṃ na ma ssu darśa nā ya iti vilikhya, dalasaṃdhau oṃ ja ya ja ya nṛ siṃ ha iti vilikhya, tadbahirvṛttaṃ ṣodaśadalaṃ vilikhya, dalamadhye oṃ na mo bha ga va te mahā su darśa nāya svāhā iti vilikhya, dalasaṃdhau oṃ huṃ na mo bha ga va te va jra va rā hā ya svā hā iti vilikhya, tadupari vṛttadvayaṃ vṛttadvayamadhye akārādikṣakārāntaṃ mātṛkāvarṇānvilikhya, tadupari bhūpuradvayaṃ catuṣkoṇaṃ vilikhya, caturdvāre oṃ āṃ hrīṃ kroṃ iti vilikhya, tattaddigdevatābījāni likhitvā, laṃ raṃ haṃ ṣaṃ vaṃ yaṃ saṃ śaṃ iti bījaṃ likhitvā, āgneyā dīśānāntaṃ prāṇapratiṣṭhāmantraṃ, mantrarājagāyatrīṃ, yantrarājagāyatrīṃ, cavilikhya, tanmantreṇāvāhyabhyarcya sudarśanamūla mantraṃ daśasahasraṃ japitvā, tadgrāyatṣā taddaśāṃśaṃ japitvā mantrarājaṃ ca daśāṃśaṃ japitvā taddaśāṃśaṃ tarpaṇaṃ taddaśāṃśaṃ homaṃ taddaśāṃśaṃ brāhmaṇabhojanaṃ kārayet. yantradaśāṅgamaḥ - bījaṃ prāṇaṃ ca śaktiśca dṛṣṭirvaśyādikaṃ tathā mantrayantrasya gāyatrī bījasthāpanameva ca bhūtadikpālabījaṃ ca yantrasyāṅgāni vai daśa yantragāyatrīḥ - yantrarājāya vidmahe mahāyantrāya dhīmahi tanno yantraḥ pracodayāt sudarśanagāyatrīḥ - ugraṃ vīraṃ mahāviṣṇuṃ jvalantaṃ sarvatomukhaṃ nṛsiṃhaṃ bhīṣaṇaṃ bhadraṃ matyumṛtyuṃ namāmyaham tatra sarvatrānukramaṇikāsu yantrasyāsya pāṭhodṛśyate mūlagranthetvasya mātṛkākośena dṛśyate tathāpi bahūnāṃ mātṛkākośānāmanupalaṃ bhādasyasthitiratra'śaṅkitāpi niveśyate parastīrya vidhānena pāvakaṃ vidhivadyajeth || 32.82 || lājāpūpai rājya miśrairmūlamantraṃ samuccaran | aṣṭāttaraśatenaiva homayeddeśikottamaḥ || 32.83 || puruṣasūktaṃ ca juhuyāttato dvātriṃśasaṃkhyayā | paścādagniṃ paristīrya "kṣaya''sveti praṇamya ca || 32.84 || evaṃ pratidinaṃ kuryādante devaṃ tu ropayeth | sāyaṃ saṃdhyāmupāsitvā yāgaśālāṃ praviśya ca || 32.85 || sabhyāgniṃ paiṇḍarīkāgniṃ cāsādyāghāramācareth | abjāgnau śāntihomaṃ ca hutvaiva gururatvaraḥ || 32.86 || kuṃbhaṃ vinā mahāśāntihomaṃ ke cidvadantihi | vedyāṃ tu puratastiṣṭhanprāṇāyāmādikaṃ careth || 32.87 || navamūrtibhirāvāhya dikpālānāvahetkramāth | aṣṭopacārairabhyarchya mudgānnaṃ vinivedayeth || 32.88 || pānīyācamanaṃ datvā mukhavāsaṃ dadettataḥ | "āpo vā'' iti mantreṇa pavitraṃ dhārayedghaṭaṃ || 32.89 || "agnāvagni''riti procya pavitraṃ cāgnikuṇḍake | kuṇḍasyaiva tu mānena samalaṅkṛtya pāvakaṃ || 32.90 || "pavitrantu'' iti procya pavitraṃ dhārayedguruḥ | saminthyaiva tu sabhyāgniṃ pariṣicya vidhānataḥ || 32.91 || hautraṃ praśaṃsya vidhivatsamidbhirhāvayedguruḥ | tadālayagatānścaiva devānāvāhayetkramāth || 32.92 || juṣṭākāraṃ tataḥ paścātsvāhākālaṃ tataḥ paraṃ | viṣṇusūktaṃ suhutvā tu puruṣasūktamataḥ paraṃ || 32.93 || caruṃ lājāṃstathāpūpānājyamiśrāṃśca hāvayeth | paścāttu vaiṣṇavairmantraiścatamaṣṭottaraṃ yajerth || 32.94 || iṅkārādīṃstataḥ paścātpāramātmikasaṃyutaṃ | aṣṭāśītiṃ tato hutvā tattaddaivatyameva ca || 32.95 || sarvadaivatyamantrāṃśca dhātādīnpañca vāruṇaṃ | mūlahomaṃ tato hutvā tathānte pariṣicya ca || 32.96 || yāgaśālācaturdvāre caturvedānathoccareth | aiśānyāṃ tu viśeṣeṇa japedaṣṭākṣaraṃ manuṃ || 32.97 || dvādaśākṣaramantraṃ ca gāyatrīṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ tathā | nārāyaṇākhyagāyatrīṃ pāramātmikamityapi || 32.98 || vyāpakatrayasaṃyuktaṃ viṣṇugāyatriyā yutaṃ | tataśca vaiṣṇavaṃ japtvā "yo vā bhū'' teti pañcakaṃ || 32.99 || puṣbāñjaliṃ japitvaiva nyaseddevasya pādayoḥ | nṛttagītādivādyaiśca rātriśeṣaṃ nayedguruḥ || 32.100 || tataḥ prabhāte dharmātmā snātvā saṃdhyāmupāsya ca | yāgaśālāṃ praviśyaiva deveśaṃ prārthayettataḥ || 32.101 || "bhūragnaya'' iti procya vediṃ saṃprokṣya cātvaraḥ | kuṃbhārādhanahomādīnsarvaṃ pūrvavadācareth || 32.102 || kuṃbhamārādhayetpūrvaṃ biṃbapūjā tvanantaraṃ | paścāddhomaṃ prakurvīta balidānaṃ tataḥ paraṃ || 32.103 || evaṃ kuryādvidhānena dinaṃ prati gurūttamaḥ | samāpte tu dine sāyaṃ pūrṇāhuti mathācareth || 32.104 || tadagniṃ triyahādūrdhvaṃ sādhayedagnikuṇḍake? || 32.105 || kuṃbhamādāya śirasā toyadhārāpurassaraṃ | pradakṣiṇaṃ śanairgatvā devāgre sannidhāya ca || 32.106 || "hiraṇya pavamānā'' dyaiḥkuṃbhatoyena prokṣayeth | devamabhyarcya pādyādyaiḥ prabhūtaṃ ca nivedayeth || 32.107 || pānīyācamalaṃ datvā mukhavāsaṃ dadetpunaḥ | kṣamāmantraṃ samuccārya "kṣama'' sveti namenmuhuḥ || 32.108 || yajamāno'pi śuddhātmā bhaktinamrassamāhitaḥ | ācāryaṃ pūjayettatra gandhamāryānulepanaiḥ || 32.109 || pañcāṅgabhūṣaṇaiścaiva dukūlaiśca navaistathā | tato guruḥ prasannātmā prayuñjyādāśiṣastadā || 32.110 || taduktaṃ bhagavatproktaṃ pratigṛhṇīyurādarāth | evaṃ kurvīta pratyabdaṃ pavitrāropaṇaṃ hareḥ || 32.111 || ihaloke sukhībhūtvā sa yāti paramāṃ gatiṃ | priyatāṃ bhagavānviṣṇuḥ prārthanāsūktamucyate || 32.112 || "kanikradā''pimantrāśca śākunaṃ sūktamīritaṃ | "svastino mimī''tetyuktvā svastisūktamiti smṛtaṃ || 32.113 || "śuddhā ime paśava'' iti gosūktaṃ samudāhṛtaṃ | "ṛtaṃ ca satyaṃ'' cetyādi aghamarṣaṇamucyate || 32.114 || "aṇoraṇīyā'' nityuktvāsūktaṃ prokṣaṇamīritaṃ | "apo hiraṇyavarṇāśca pavamāna'' iti trayaḥ || 32.115 || prokṣaṇaṃ sūktamiti tu kecidvaikalpikaṃ jaguḥ | "yā jātā'' iti mantrāśca oṣadhīsūktamucyate || 32.116 || "kṛṇuṣva pāja'' ityādi sūktaṃ pratisarāhvayaṃ | ("atodevā''di ṣaḍbhistu vaiṣṇavaṃ sūktamucyateḥ) || 32.117 || "atodevādi ṣaṇmantrā''ṣ,ḍvaiṣṇavapadāhvayāḥ | "viṣṇornu''kādi ṣaṇmantrā viṣṇusūktamudīritaṃ || 32.118 || "sahasraśīrṣā puruṣa'' iti pauruṣasūktakaṃ | "hiraṇya varṇā'' ityādi śrīsūktaṃ sarvakāmadaṃ || 32.119 || "bhūmirbhūmne''tyādimantrā bhūmisūktamudāhṛtaṃ | "upa śvāsaya'' ityādi dundubhīsūktamucyate || 32.120 || "suparṇo'si garutmā''nityuktaṃ sūktaṃ ca gāruḍaṃ | "hiraṇyagarbha''ityādi brahmasūktamudhṛtaṃ || 32.121 || "indraṃ vo viśvata'' iti indrasūktamihocyate | "agne nayetyā''diṣaḍbhiragnisūktaṃ pracakṣate || 32.122 || "āyātudeva'' ityādiyamasūktaṃprakīrtitaṃ | "namassute nirṛte'' sūktaṃnairṛtamucyate || 32.123 || "astabhnādyāmṛṣabha''iti vāruṇasūktakaṃ | "pīvonnāṃrayi vṛdhassumedhā''iti vāyavaṃ || 32.124 || "adbhyastirodhā''ityādi kauveraṃ sūktamucyate | "stuhi śrutaṃ garta''iti rudrasūktaṃ prakīrtitaṃ || 32.125 || "omāsaścarṣaṇī''tyādi sūktaṃ sārasvataṃ bhaveth | "viśvajitedhana''iti viśvajitsūktamucyate || 32.126 || "rātrī vyakhya''dityādi rātrisūktamudāhṛtaṃ | "jātavedasa''ityādi ṣaḍdurgāsūktamucyate || 32.127 || "ā godānā''diti procyagodānaṃ sūktamucyate | "ekākṣaram'' itiprocya sūktamekākṣarādikaṃ || 32.128 || "ātmātmā parametyādi ātmasūktaṃ prakīrtitaṃ || 32.129 || vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktaṃ ca puruṣa sūktamataḥ paraṃ | śrībhūsūktaṃ ca pañcaitaṃ pañcasūktamihocyate || 32.130 || viṣṇusūktaṃ nṛsūktaṃ ca śrībhūsūktamataḥ paraṃ | ekākṣarādi sūktaṃ ca pañcasūktaṃ jaguḥpare || 32.131 || viṣṇusūktaṃ nṛsūktaṃ ca śrībhūsūktaṃ ca vaiṣṇavaṃ | ekākṣarādisūktaṃ ca viṣṇugāyatriyā sahā || 32.132 || āhatya saptabhiścaitaissaptasūktaṃ samīritaṃ | rudrasūktaṃ dhruvasūktaṃ durgāsūktaṃ tataḥ paraṃ || 32.133 || rātrisūktaṃ tathā sūktaṃ sārasvatamapi kramāth | viśvajitsūktamatha ca sahasraśīrṣamityapi || 32.134 || aghamarṣaṇasūktaṃ ca godānaṃ sūktameva ca | ātmasūktena saṃyuktaṃ daśamūktamudāhṛtaṃ || 32.135 || daśasūktaṃ pañcasūktaṃ kṛtvā saṃhṛtameva ca evaṃ | bhavetpañca daśasūktamiti saṃjñā prabhāṣitā || 32.136 || ataḥparaṃ pravakṣyāmi śruṇudhvaṃ munisattamāḥ | maṇḍalārādhanaṃ nityaṃ puṇyāhaṃ snapanaṃ careth || 32.137 || catpāriṃśaddhinādūrdhvaṃ maṇḍalaṃ dinapañcakaṃ | puṇyāhaṃ vidhivatkṛtvā vrīhibhistaṇḍulopari || 32.138 || navaṃ kalaśamādāya pūrvoktena vidhānataḥ | samabhyarcya japaṃ kuryādbrāhmaṇairbrahmavādibhiḥ || 32.139 || vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktaṃ ca puruṣasūktamataḥ paraṃ | śrībhūsūktaṃ tathā pañcaśāntiṃ caiva pṛthakpṛthak || 32.140 || caturāvartya japtvā tu snāpayeddhruvamacyutaṃ | tathaiva kautukādīṃśca snāpayedvidhinā budhaḥ || 32.141 || dadhyodanaṃ guḍānnaṃ ca pāyasaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ | nivedya devadevasya mukhavāsaṃ pradāpayeth || 32.142 || ācāryadakṣiṇāṃ dadyādṛtvijāṃ ca tathaiva ca | pratiṣṭhādinamārabhya maṇḍalāntaṃ dinaṃ prati || 32.143 || evameva krameṇaiva kārayettu viśeṣataḥ | maṇḍalārdhaṃ tu kuryācchenmadhyamaṃ tatpracakṣate || 32.144 || maṇḍalānte viśeṣeṇa kārayeddvijabhojanaṃ | sabhyāgnikuṇḍaṃ kṛtvaiva puṇyāhamasi vācayeth || 32.145 || āghāraṃ vidhivaddhutvā vaiṣṇavaṃ sūktameva ca | viṣṇusūktaṃ tato hutvā puruṣasūkta samanvitaṃ || 32.146 || śrībhūsūktaṃ samuccārya pañcaśāntimataḥ paraṃ | pāramātmikamīṅkārādyaṣṭāśītiṃ kramāddhuneth || 32.147 || aṣṭākṣaraṃ samuccārya tathaiva dvādaśākṣaraṃ | pūrṇāhutiṃ tato hutvā antahomaścahūyate || 32.148 || saṃsnāpayeccha kalaśairaṣṭādhikaśataiḥkramāth | varṇayuktandhruvaṃ beraṃ prāṅgayet snāpayennatu || 32.149 || dvādaśārādhanaṃ kuryānmadhye madhye vidhānataḥ | grāmaṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya sarvavādyasamanvitaṃ || 32.150 || pakṣirājopari sthāpya rakṣādīpaṃ ca darśayeth | jīvasthāne susaṃsthāpya praṇāmaṃ kārayettataḥ || 32.151 || evaṃ yaḥkurute bhaktyā maṇḍalārādhanaṃ hareḥ | sarvānkāmānavāpyaiva sa yāti paramāṅgatiṃ || 32.152 || iti śrīvaikhānase bhagavacchāstre bhṛguproktāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prakīrṇādhikāre. dvātriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ <33> athatrayastriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ arcāvatāramahattvam atha vakṣye viśeṣeṇa devadevasya śārṅgiṇaḥ | pañcadhāvasthitaṃ rūpaṃ paravyūhādibhedataḥ || 33.1 || anugrahāya lokānāṃ bhaktānāmanukaṃpayā | paravyūhādibhedena devadevaḥ pravartate || 33.2 || ādyena pararūpeṇa vyūhākhyenetareṇa tu | tathāvibhavarūpeṇa nānābhāvamupeyuṣā || 33.3 || antaryāmisvarūpeṇa caturthena tathā punaḥ | arcāvatārarūpeṇa pañcadhāvasthito hariḥ || 33.4 || anaupama manirdesyaṃ punassa bhajate paraṃ | viśvāpyāyanakaṃ kāntyā pūrṇendvayutulyayā || 33.5 || parandhāma parañjyotissarvaśaktimayo'malaḥ | nirdvandvo nirvikalpo'cchonityo'cintyassanātanaḥ || 33.6 || aprameyo nirādyanto dṛśyo'dṛśyo hyatīndriyaḥ | susūkṣmatvādanirdeśyassarvajñassadasadvibhuḥ || 33.7 || ānādimatparaṃ brahma sarvaheyavivarjitaṃ | vyāpi yatsarvabhūteṣu sthitaṃ sadasatoḥ paraṃ || 33.8 || śaṅkhacakragadāpadmadivyāyudhapariṣkṛtaḥ | sahasrādityasaṃkāśe pakame vyomni saṃsthitaḥ || 33.9 || nityamuktaikasaṃbhāvyaścaturbhujadharohariḥ | anyūnānatarigtaissvairguṇaiṣṣaḍbhiralaṅkṛtaḥ || 33.10 || samassamavibhaktāṅgassarvāvayavasundaraḥ | divyairābharaṇairyuktassudhākallolasaṃkulaiḥ || 33.11 || śriyā nityānapāyinyā sevyamāno jagatpatiḥ || 33.12 || pañcadhātu punarvyūhaḥ procyate śrutisammataḥ | devo viṣṇvādibhedeva pañcadhā vyavatiṣṭhate || 33.13 || sa vā eṣa puruṣaḥ pañcadhā pañcātmeti ca śrutiḥ | tathā popūyamānaḥ pañcabhissvaguṇairiti || 33.14 || ādimūrtistu pañcānāṃ viṣṇurbhedāśca tasyatu | catasraḥ puruṣādyāssyurmūrtayo bhinnalakṣaṇāḥ || 33.15 || tadviṣṇośśramāpanudāya caturguṇā''yeti caśrutiḥ | tasmādbrahma catuṣpādityucyate vedavedibhiḥ || 33.16 || pādādardhāttripādācca kevalācchaktibhedataḥ | krameṇa dharmajñānaiśvaryavairāgyākhyairguṇairyutāḥ || 33.17 || bhavantimūrtayastasmāccatasro viṣayairnijaiḥ | cāturātmyādādimūrteścatasrastatramūrtayaḥ || 33.18 || viṣṇuścaiva mahāviṣṇussadāviṣṇuriti kramāth | vyāpī nārāyaṇa iti tannāmāni tataḥkramāth || 33.19 || viṣṇoraṃśastu puruṣo mahāviṣṇostu satyakaḥ | sadāviṣṇoracyutassyādyyāpino'ṃśo'niruddhakaḥ || 33.20 || dharmādibhirbrahmaguṇaiścaturdhābheda īritaḥ | tṛtīyaṃ vibhavākhyantaṃ viśvamantaramadhyamam? || 33.21 || nānākārakriyākartṛ rūpaṃ vakṣye mahātmanaḥ | vibhavā matsyakūrmādyā hayagrīvādayo matāḥ || 33.22 || antaryāmisvarūpaṃ tu turīyamidamucyate | nīvāraśūkavattanvī pītābhā syāttanūpamā || 33.23 || tasyāśśikhāyā madhye paramātmā vyavasthitaḥ | ityuktaśśrutyabhihito hṛdayāṃbujamadhyame || 33.24 || jvalanmahāgnau viśvārcirjvālānte viśvato mukhe | āpādatalacūḍāgraṃ santāpayati santataṃ || 33.25 || śikhā tatra ca pītābhā tanvī nīvāraśūkavath | madhye śikhāyāstasyāśca jyotiḥ prajvalitaṃ mahath || 33.26 || svasaṃkalpaviśeṣeṇa taptajāṃbūnadaprabhaḥ | pītāṃbaradharassoṃyassuprasannaśśucismitaḥ || 33.27 || padmākṣo raktanetrāsyapāṇipādaścaturbhujaḥ | cakraśaṅkhābhayadharaḥ kaṭinyastānyahastakaḥ || 33.28 || śrīvatsāṃko mahābāhussarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ | hṛdi tiṣṭhati sarvātmā śrībhūmibhyāṃ ca pārṣadaiḥ || 33.29 || bhrāmayansarvabhūtāni yantrārūḍhāni māyayā | antaryāmīti vijñeyassarvakāraṇakāraṇaḥ || 33.30 || anyadarcāsvarūpaṃ tu sarvottaraphalapradaṃ | nityamuktopabhogyatvātparavyūhātmanohareḥ || 33.31 || tatkālasannikṛṣṭaikalakṣyatvādvibhavātmanaḥ | viśuddhairyogasaṃsiddhaiścintyatvādantarātmanaḥ || 33.32 || arcātmanyeva sarveṣāmadhikāro niraṅkuśaḥ | viśeṣabhaktihetutvātpratimārādhanaṃ paraṃ || 33.33 || arcāvatārassarveṣāṃ bāndhavo bhaktavatsalaḥ | arcāvatāraviṣaye mayāpyuddeśatastathā || 33.34 || uktā guṇā na śakyante vaktuṃ varṣaśatairapi | vicitrā dehasaṃpattirīśvarāya nivedituṃ || 33.35 || kalpitā brahmaṇā pūrvaṃ hastapādādisaṃyutā | mudhaiva jihvā kṛṣṇeti keśaveti na vakṣyati || 33.36 || mudhā cittaṃ natadgāmi yadanyatkimito'dhikaṃ | sā jihvā yā hariṃ stauti taccittaṃ keśavārpitaṃ || 33.37 || tatkarmacārcanaṃ tasya tadanyattu nirarthakaṃ | sattāmātraṃ paraṃ brahma viṣṇvākhyamaviśeṣaṇaṃ || 33.38 || durvicintyaṃ yataḥpūrvaṃ tatprāptyarthamihocyate | vātormicañcalaṃ cittamanālaṃbanamasthiraṃ || 33.39 || sūkṣmatvādbrahmaṇo'jasya nigrāhyaṃ grāhmadharmaṇaḥ | samyagabhyasyato'jasramupabṛṃhitaśaktimath || 33.40 || janmāntaraśatasyāpi brahmagrāhyeva jāyate | yadyastarāyadoṣeṇa nāpakarṣo vicintyate || 33.41 || yogino yogarūḍhasya tālāgrātpatanaṃ yathā | tadāpnoti paraṃ brahmakleśena mahatāpi ca || 33.42 || janmāntarābhyāsoddhena vijñānena samādhinā | viṣṇvākhyaṃ brahmaduṣprāpaṃ viṣayākrāntacetasā || 33.43 || manuṣyeṇālpasāreṇa tatprāptau sādhanaṃ tvidaṃ | surūpāṃ pratimāṃ viṣṇoḥ prasannavadanekṣaṇāṃ || 33.44 || kṛtvātmanaḥ prītikarīṃ suvarṇarajatādibhiḥ | tāmarcayettāṃ vraṇamettāṃ namettāṃ vicintayeth || 33.45 || viśatyapāstadoṣastu tāmeva brahmarūpiṇīṃ || 33.46 || iti śrīvaikhānase bhagavacchāstre bhṛguproktāyāṃ sahitāyāṃ prakīrṇādhikāre trayastriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ <34> atha catustriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ svayaṃvyaktādi sthānapañcakam ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi sthalapañcakakalpanaṃ | devadevo mahābāhurharirnārāyaṇassvayaṃ || 34.1 || yena yena prakāreṇa āvirāstedharātale | arcāvatārarūpeṇa bhaktasaulabhyahetave || 34.2 || svayaṃvyaktaṃ ca divyaṃ ca saiddhaṃ paurāṇameva ca | pauruṣaṃ ceti kathitaṃ sthalānāṃ pañcakaṃ budhaiḥ || 34.3 || svayaṃvyaktaṃ tu tatproktaṃ yatrāsau harivyayaḥ | svecchayā lokarakṣāye bhūmyāmāvirbhavetsvayaṃ || 34.4 || na tatra devadevasya pratiṣṭhā vidhisammatā | na cāpi karṣaṇaṃ nāpi biṃbaśuddhyādikāḥ kriyāḥ || 34.5 || biṃbena saha deveśassannidhatte yatassvayaṃ | yānadicchā vasedbhūmau tāvatkālaṃ samarcitaḥ || 34.6 || svayaṃvyaktasthale pūjā sarvalokaśubhapradā | svayaṃvyaktasthalānyatra catvāryāsata bhūtale || 34.7 || yatra vaikhānasaṃ śāstramāśritya paramaṃ śubhaṃ | arcayāmo jagadyonimahamanye ca te trayaḥ || 34.8 || marīcirmandhare viṣṇumarcayāmāsa keśavaṃ | sarvadevottamaṃ devaṃ śrīnivāse'trirarcayath || 34.9 || kāśyapo viṣṇvadhiṣṭhāne śubhakṣetre'pyahaṃ bhṛguḥ | yādṛśīvartate pūjā yā biṃbānāṃ ca saṃsthitiḥ || 34.10 || na kiṃ cittāmatikramya pūrvoktāṃ tu samācareth | svayamāvirabhūddevo yatra bhaktānukaṃpayā || 34.11 || kartavyamakhilaṃ tatra tannideśena kalpyate | na vāpyucchāstrakaraṇaṃ pravartayati mādhavaṃ || 34.12 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena pūrvairācaritaṃ careth | anyathā cettu kurvāṇo devāyaivāparādhyati || 34.13 || yanmāyāmohitaṃ sarvaṃ yasyāntaṃ ke'pi no viduḥ | tasya devasya māhātmyaṃ vaktuṃ śaknoti ko bhuvi || 34.14 || yadyadā caritaṃ tatra tatsarvaṃ śāstrameva hi | tatrāpi ca viśeṣo'sti prāyaścittādidarśane || 34.15 || sarvaṃ prāmādikaṃ kuryāttatra śāstraṃ pravartakaṃ | śrutismṛtī ubhetasya paramājñāṃ vadanti hī || 34.16 || svayaṃvyaktasthale pūjā sarvalokaśūbhāvahā | svayaṃ vyakto jagannāthastādātmyena śilādiṣu || 34.17 || svayaṃ bhaktajanābhīṣṭānvicāryaiva prayacchati | na hyatra sādhanāpekṣā svayaṃnyaktastato varaḥ || 34.18 || devaiḥ pratiṣṭhito yatra harirāvirbabhūva hi | taddidyasthalamuddiṣṭaṃ devo divya udīryate || 34.19 || smṛtā devāstrayastriṃśattāvatkoṭīmitā api | sarve te phalakāmāssyurve prapadyante yathā hariṃ || 34.20 || tāṃstathā bhajate devo yato'sau karuṇānidhiḥ | phalārthino yadā devāḥ pratiṣṭhyāpya hariṃ kramāth || 34.21 || samabhyarcya ca saṃprāpya vāṃbhitaṃ tadanantaraṃ | lokānugrahahetorvai tādṛśaṃ devamandiraṃ || 34.22 || cirasthāyi ca saṃkalpya yathārhaṃ samapūjayan | divyasthalasthadevo hi devānāṃ sannidhāpanāth || 34.23 || atyantaṃ puṣṭivaḥ proktassarvaśāntikarassṛtaḥ | divyasthalasthapūjā tu śatayojanavistṛtaṃ || 34.24 || punāti parito deśaṃ nātra saṃdeha iṣyate | divyasthalāni kathitānyasaṃkhyeyāni bhūtale || 34.25 || na hi devāssvayaṃ bhūmāvavatīrya kalau kvacith | pratiṣṭhāṃ devadevasya kurvanti kuhiciddhruvaṃ || 34.26 || divyasthalāni bhūbhāge kalau tu viralāni vai | bhaviṣyanti bahūnyatra luptabūjāni sattamāḥ || 34.27 || divyasthalakṛtā pūjā śāstrasiddhā na saṃśayaḥ | nocchāstraṃ tu pratiṣṭhādi kurvantidivi devatāḥ || 34.28 || devāśca devaloke'pi kṛtvā vaiṣṇavamandiraṃ | ārādhya ca jagannāthaṃ prāpnuvanti phalaṃ bahu || 34.29 || yā tu bhūmitale pūjā tādṛśī divijā na vai | karmabhūmistu saṃproktā bhūmirdyairna hi tatsamā || 34.30 || saṃcintya puṇyaṃ pāpaṃ vā bhūmau lokāntarenarāḥ | gamiṣyantitato jyāyānbhūbhāgassarvakarmasu || 34.31 || tato devāḥ pratiṣṭhāpya cārcayitvā ramāpatiṃ | arcāvatārarūpeṇa svayaṃ tīrṇāḥ punaḥ punaḥ || 34.32 || bhūmisthānakhilānjantūntāryayiṣyantyanugrahāth | ato viprāssadā yajñairdānaiśca tapasā muhuḥ || 34.33 || toṣayiṣyanti devānvai teṣāmānṛṇyahetave | devā nisargaripavo manuṣyeṣu bhavantyapi || 34.34 || ārādhanena devasya copakurvanti mānavān | idameva hareḥ pūjābalaṃ saṃpāditaṃ phalaṃ || 34.35 || sarve'pi sāttvikā yānti tuṣyanti svārjitaiḥ phalaiḥ | na dviṣyanti ripūnvāpi tatro dāharaṇaṃ surāḥ || 34.36 || yathā cyavanadharmā syātsvargassvargāśrito'tha vā | tathādinyasthalāniha na syuśśāśvatikāni tu || 34.37 || divyasthaleṣu sarvatra divyenaivāgamena tu | vaikhānasena pūjāsītsāhi śrautī ca sammatā || 34.38 || prāyaścittocitānyatra nimittāni yadātadā | śāstroktaṃ kārayedeva nānyathā kārayedvidhiḥ || 34.39 || ye tu pūrvārjitaireva tapobhiḥ paramātmani | raktātmānastapassiddhāssaṃkalpya svatapaḥphalaṃ || 34.40 || devadevaṃ jagannāthaṃ nārāyaṇamanāyaṃ | pratiṣṭhāpya kvacidbiṃbe samabhyarcya viśeṣataḥ || 34.41 || ujjīvanāya lākānāṃ pradāsyantīha pūjanaṃ | sa deśassaiddha ityuktassaiddhā tatrārcanocyate || 34.42 || na hi siddhāstapassiddhiṃ kurvanti vibhalāṃ kvacith | yasyānugrahamicchantastapasyantīha sādhavaḥ || 34.43 || yaṃ prasādayituṃ viprā yajñadānādi kurvate | tasyaivārādhanaṃ hitvā kiṃ siddhāssaṃprakurvate || 34.44 || te siddhāste mahātmānaste santa nte tapasvinaḥ | ye svakarmaphalaṃ devaṃ viditvā śrīpatiṃ hariṃ || 34.45 || pratiṣṭhāpya tu tadrūpamarcayanti nirantaraṃ | na hyanyaḥ prāpaṇe heturarcanānmuktihetave || 34.46 || saiddhasthale tu yā pūjā sarvaśāntikarī smṛtā | pañcāśadyojanaṃ tasya paritaḥ pāvayenmahīṃ || 34.47 || siddhapratiṣṭhitā deśā bahavo viditāḥ purā | utpadyante bhaviṣyanti santisiddhā dharātale || 34.48 || saiddhasthalāni bhūyāṃsi bhaviṣyanti ca santi ca | siddhā vaikhānasaṃ śāstramāśrityaiva svanirmitaṃ || 34.49 || devaṃ saṃpūjayantīha tatprāyaḥ pracalatyapi | na hi siddhāḥ prakurvantikiñciducchāstramāpadi || 34.50 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena sarvaṃ siddhāśritasthale | kuryādvaikhānasaṃ śāstramāśritya sakalāḥ kriyāḥ || 34.51 || siddhā jānanti śāstrārthānsiddhā jānanti cāgamān | siddhāssamarcayantyeva vaikhānasavidhānataḥ || 34.52 || yadi siddhāśrito deśaḥpūjyate'nyaiḥ pramādataḥ | rājā taṃ tu vicāryaiva punarvaikhānasaiḥkramāth || 34.53 || satvaraṃ yājayetkṛtvā prāyaścittaṃ yathāvidhi | saiddhameke sthalaṃ prāhurārṣametacca sammataṃ || 34.54 || atha paurāṇiko deśaḥ kathyate yatra yatra vai | gādhā paurāṇikī bhūyāttatpurāṇasthalaṃ mataṃ || 34.55 || ajñātakartṛkāṇyatra smaryante prāyaśo bahu | sthalānīmānitattāni?purāṇāni pracakṣate || 34.56 || purāṇāni tvanantāni sthalāni pṛthivītale | bhavantyatha kalau prāpte lupyante tānyanekaśaḥ || 34.57 || daśayojanaparyantāṃ bhūmiṃ tu paritassakṛth | punāti deśaḥ paurāṇastatra kiṃ cinna hīyate || 34.58 || svayaṃvyaktādayassarve paurāṇāḥ kīrtitā api | svayaṃvyaktādibhedena vyavahārasya darśanāth || 34.59 || purāṇatvaṃ ca teṣāṃ syādanyatpaurāṇamucyate | purāṇasthaladevasya pratiṣṭhā vidhisammatā || 34.60 || pratiṣṭhite tvavidhinā sthare naiva rameddhariḥ | na hi vṛddhāssamarcanti biṃbamucchāstranirmitaṃ || 34.61 || na hi paurāṇike deśe yajamānasya gauravaṃ | arthasya gauravaṃ cāpi darśanīyaṃ mahātmabhiḥ? || 34.62 || yadi paśyedvisūḍhātmā rauravaṃ narakaṃvrajeth | eṣa eva viśeṣassyādanyatsaiddhavadācareth || 34.63 || purāṇasthalapūjā tu śāstradṛṣṭena vartmanā | pramādetu samīkāryāna tena syādvyatikramaḥ || 34.64 || mānuṣaṃ pañcamaṃ proktaṃ sthalaṃ yatra viśeṣataḥ | grāme vā nagare vāpi śāstrokte sumanorame || 34.65 || pratiṣṭāpyārcake viṣṇussarvadeveśvareśvaraḥ | brāhmaṇaiḥ kṣatriyairvaiśyaiśśūdrairvānyairnarottamaiḥ || 34.66 || vaikhānasena śāstreṇa pañcarātreṇa vā punaḥ | mānuṣasthalapūjā tu yojanaṃ paritasthsalaṃ || 34.67 || pāpayettasya tu proktāśaktiranyātu tāvatī | manuṣyāḥ puṇyakarmāṇastatra tatra dine dine || 34.68 || preritā bhagavadbhaktyādhanino nirdhanā api | nirmāya bhagavadgehaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya śriyaḥpatiṃ || 34.69 || arcayanti viśeṣeṇa vaikhānasavidhānataḥ | viśālaḥ pṛthivībhāgaḥ kālo'nādirantakaḥ || 34.70 || śāstraṃ cāpyatigaṃbhīraṃ bhaktāśca bahavo harau | tasmātsarvaprayatnena sarvasyāpyanuśāsanaṃ || 34.71 || proktaṃ vikhanasā pūrvaṃ bhagavacchāstramuttamaṃ | anenaiva prakāreṇa sarvatrārādhayeddhariṃ || 34.72 || bhaktāśca bahudhā śāstraṃ praśaṃsantīdameva hī | taduktenaiva vidhinā kalpayedālayādikaṃ || 34.73 || yathā mānādhikaraṇe mayā proktassa vistaraḥ | yatra vā dṛśyate bhedo bhagavacchāstraśilpayoḥ || 34.74 || śilpaśāstraṃ parityajya bhagavacchāstrataścareth | pradhānametacchāstraṃ syādbhagavadgehakalpane || 34.75 || na tacchāstramanādṛtya kāryaṃ kiṃ citsamācareth | lobhānmohādathājñānācchāstre'sminna dhṛtaṃ careth || 34.76 || atikramyāpi śāstraṃ tatpūjā niṣbhalā bhaveth | yajamāno vipadyeta tasmādatroktamācareth || 34.77 || tenaiva tu vidhānena pratiṣṭhādikamācareth | aihikāmuṣmikaṃ yasmātphaladvayamavāpyate || 34.78 || grāme viṣṇvarcanāhīne viṣṇvarcāhīnaveśmani | tīrthapānaṃ surāpānamannaṃ gomāṃsabhakṣaṇaṃ || 34.79 || devadhāmavihīnaṃ tu śmaśānaṃ grāma ucyate | gṛhaṃ ca cititulyaṃ syādyatra nārādhyate hariḥ || 34.80 || yo mohādatha vālasyādakṛtvā devatārcanaṃ | bhuṅkte sa yāti narakānsūkareṣvasi jāyate || 34.81 || keśavārcāgṛhe yasya na tiṣṭhati śūbhapradā | tasyānnaṃ naiva bhoktavyamabhakṣyeṇa samaṃ hi tath || 34.82 || biṃbaśuddhyādikaṃ kṛtvā śāstroktavidhinā punaḥ | kalānyāsādikaṃ sarvaṃ vidhāya parameśvaraḥ || 34.83 || pratiṣṭhāpyārcyate yatra parito yojanāvadhi | pūyate'nugrahādviṣṇoḥ sa deśo'prākṛtassmṛtaḥ || 34.84 || tatra pārṣadasaṃyuktaśśriyā lakṣmyā samanvitaḥ | yathā ca parame vyomni sannidhatte tathā hariḥ || 34.85 || tatra devāstrayastriṃśatpitaraḥ pannagāśca ye | sādhyā vidyādharā yakṣāssarvā vai devayonayaḥ || 34.86 || sarvasaṃvatsamṛddhissyātparjanyo varṣuko bhaveth | vāyurvāti sukhaṃ tatra sūryastapati tejasā || 34.87 || candramāśśītalairdeśaṃ sevate kiraṇaistathā | bhūmissasyavatī ca syātprasannaṃ ca nabho bhaveth || 34.88 || nakṣatragrahatārāśca prasādābhimukhāssame | rājanvatī prajā ca syātpaśuputrasamanvitā || 34.89 || na vyādhijaṃ bhayaṃ kiṃ cinnāpi jvarakṛtaṃ tathā | na vyālajaṃ bhayaṃ vāpi bhavedatrana saṃśayaḥ || 34.90 || nopaplavo nṛpāṇāṃ vā mṛgāṇāṃ vāpyapāṃ bhaveth | brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāśśūdrāstatra nivāsinaḥ || 34.91 || sve sve karmaṇyabhiratā bhaveyussukhajīvinaḥ | āgnihotrāśca hūyante tapyante'tra tapāṃsi ca || 34.92 || dīyante bhūridānāni yatra devo harispvayaṃ | aprākṛtamimaṃ deśaṃ sannidhānācchriyaḥ pateḥ || 34.93 || prākṛtaṃ yo vadenmūḍhassa yāti narakaṃ dhruvaṃ | aprākṛtamimaṃ devaṃ naro yaścāpanihnute || 34.94 || caṇḍālassa tu vijñeyo niṣkṛtirnāsya dṛśyate | mahāpātakīnāṃ tadvaddṛṣṭaṃ pātakināmapi || 34.95 || upapātakināṃ cāpi prāyaścittaṃ viśeṣataḥ | śāstrāpalāpināṃ naiva prāyaścittaṃ pradṛśyate || 34.96 || yastu sāmānyabhāvena manyate sthalamīdṛśaṃ | brahmahatyāmavāpnoti bhrūṇahatyāṃ tathaiva ca || 34.97 || svarṇasteye ca yatpāpaṃ surāpāne ca yadbhaveth | gurutalpasya gamane yaccapāpamudīritaṃ || 34.98 || vṛṣalīgamane yacca pāpaṃ sarvaṃ tadaśnute | nāsti śāstrātparaṃ jñānaṃ nasyāttasmātpravartakaṃ || 34.99 || tasmāttasyāvamānena sadyaḥ patati dūṣakaḥ | tasmindeśe viśeṣeṇa sarvebhāgavatā harau || 34.100 || devapādodakādīni pītvā yāsyantisadgatiṃ | na hi sarvo'pi sarvatra svayaṃvyaktasthalādikaṃ || 34.101 || gatvaivārādhayedviṣṇuṃ sadā taccāpyasaṃbhavi | ata eva kṛpāsiṃdhurbhagavānbhūtabhāvanaḥ || 34.102 || arcāvatārarūpeṇa grāme grāme gṛhe gṛhe | avatīrya mahābāhurbhaktasaulabhyahetave || 34.103 || arcyate śāstravidhinā tatra kāryona saṃśayaḥ | tasmādaprākṛtaṃ deśaṃ na brūyātprākṛtaṃ naraḥ || 34.104 || na ca sāmānyabhāvena taṃ paśyedyadi paśyati | naśyatyeva na saṃdeha iti śāstraviniścayaḥ || 34.105 || iti śrīvaikhānase bhagavacchāstre bhṛguproktāyāṃ sahitāyāṃ prakīrṇādhikāre catustriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ <35> atha pañcatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ phalaśrutiḥ atha vakṣye viśeṣeṇa kriyāyogaśritaṃ phalaṃ | yastu devālayaṃ dāruśilālohavilekhanaiḥ || 35.1 || kārayenmṛṇmayaṃ vāpi tasyānantaphalaṃ smṛtaṃ | ahanyahani yajñena yajato yanmahatphalaṃ || 35.2 || prāpnoti tatphalaṃ viṣṇoryaḥ kārayati mandiraṃ | kulānāṃ śatamāgāmi samatītaṃ tathā śataṃ || 35.3 || tārayedbhagavadgehamiti buddhiṃ karoti yaḥ | saptajanmakṛtaṃ pāpamalpaṃ vā yadi vā bahu || 35.4 || viṣṇorālayavinyāsaprāraṃbhādeva naśyati | saptalokamayo viṣṇustasya yaḥkurute gṛhaṃ || 35.5 || pratiṣṭhāṃ samapāpnoti sa narassāptalaukikīṃ | praśastadeśe bhūbhāge yo naro bhavanaṃ hareḥ || 35.6 || kārayatyakṣayānlokānsa varaḥ pratipadyate | iṣṭakācayavinyāso yāvadvarṣāṇi tiṣṭhati || 35.7 || tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi tatkartādivi modate | pratimāṃ lakṣaṇavatīṃ yaḥ kārayati mānavaḥ || 35.8 || kesavasya sa tallokamakṣayaṃ pratipadyate | ṣaṣṭiṃ varṣasahasrāṇāṃ sahasrāṇi sa mogate || 35.9 || svargaukasāṃ nivāseṣu pratyekamarisūdanaḥ | tataḥ prayāti vaikuṇṭhaṃ nissamābhyadhikaṃ mahaḥ || 35.10 || pratīṣṭhāpya harerarcāṃ supraśaste niveśane | puruṣaḥ kṛtakṛtyatvānnainaṃ śvo maraṇaṃ tapeth || 35.11 || ye bhaviṣyanti ye'tītā ākalpāḥ puruṣāḥ kule | tāṃstārayati saṃsthāpya devasya pratiyāṃ hareḥ || 35.12 || berapūjā tviyaṃ proktā pūjānāmuttamottamā | atīte yajamāne'pi ciramasyā avasthite || 35.13 || anuśastāḥ kila purā yameva yamakiṅkarāḥ | pāśadhaṇḍadharāḥ krūrāḥ prajāsaṃyamanodyatāḥ || 35.14 || viharadhvaṃ yathānyāyyaṃ niyogo me'nupālyatāṃ | nājñābhaṅgaṃ kariṣyanti bhavatāṃ jantavaḥ kvacith || 35.15 || kevalaṃ ye jagannāthamanastaṃ samupāśritāḥ | bhavadbhiḥ parihartavyāsteṣāṃ nāstyatra saṃsthitiḥ || 35.16 || ye tu bhāgavatā loke taccittāstatparāyaṇāḥ | pūjayanti sadā viṣṇuṃ te vastyājyāḥ sudūrataḥ || 35.17 || yastiṣṭhanyassvapanbhuñjanuttiṣṭhanskhaliteṣu ca | saṃkīrtayati govindaṃ sa vastyājyassudūrataḥ || 35.18 || nityanaimittikairdevaṃ ye yajante janārdanaṃ | nāvalokyā bhavadbhiste tattejo hanti vau gatiṃ || 35.19 || ye dhūpapuṣpavāsobhirbhūṣaṇaiścāpi durlabhaiḥ | arcayanti na te grāhyānarāḥ kṛṣṇāśrayoddhatāḥ || 35.20 || upalepanakartārassammārjanakarāśca ye | kṛṣṇālaye parityājyāsteṣāṃ tripūruṣaṃ kulaṃ || 35.21 || yena cāyatanaṃ viṣṇoḥ kāritaṃ tatkulodbhavaṃ | puṃsāṃ kulaṃ nāvalokyaṃ bhavadbhirduṣṭacakṣuṣā || 35.22 || yenārcā bhagavadbhaktyā vāsudevasya kāritā | narāyutaṃ tatkulajaṃ bhavatāṃ śāsanātigaṃ || 35.23 || bhavatāṃ bhramatāmatra viṣṇusaṃśrayamudrayā | vinājñābhaṅgakṛnnaiva bhaviṣyati naraḥkvacith || 35.24 || yajñā narāṇāṃ pāpaughakṣālanāḥ sarvakāmadāḥ | tathaivejyā jagaddhātussarvayajñamayo hariḥ || 35.25 || sthāpitaṃ pratimā viṣṇossamyaksaṃpūjya mānavaḥ | yaṃ yaṃ kāmayate kāmaṃ taṃ tamāpnotyasaṃśayaṃ || 35.26 || yathā hi jvalano vahnistamohānintadarthināṃ | śītahānintadanyeṣāṃ svedaṃ svedābhilāṣiṇāṃ || 35.27 || karoti kṣudhitānāṃ ca bhojyāṃ pākakriyāṃ śikhī | tathaiva kāmānbhūteśassadadāti yathepsitaṃ || 35.28 || kalpadrumādivahareryadiṣṭaṃ tadavāpyate | yassadāyatane viṣṇoḥ kurute mārjanakriyāṃ || 35.29 || sapāṃsubhumyair? dehasya sarvaṃ pāpaṃ vyapohāti | yāvantaḥ pāṃsukaṇikā mārjyante keśavālaye || 35.30 || varṣāṇi divi tāvante vasatyastamalo naraḥ | ahanyahani yatpāpaṃ kurute viṣayī naraḥ || 35.31 || yo bāhyābhyantaraṃ veśma mārjayetkeśavālaye | sabāhyābhyantaraṃ tasya kāyo niṣkalmaṣo bhaveth || 35.32 || gocarmamātraṃ sammṛjya hanti tatkeśavālaye | sabāhyābhyantaraṃ yacca mārjayedacyutālaye || 35.33 || sabāhyābhyantaraṃ tasya kāyaṃ niṣkalmaṣaṃ viduḥ? | udakābhyukṣaṇaṃ viṣṇoryaḥ karoti satā gṛhe || 35.34 || so'pigacchati yatrāste bhagavānyādasāṃ patiḥ | mṛdā dhātuvikārairvā varṇakairgomayena vā || 35.35 || viṣṇorāyatane nityaṃ yaḥ karotyanu lepanaṃ | pravāte vāti guṇavadvarṣāsvatimanoharaṃ || 35.36 || svanuliptaṃ śūbhākāraṃ svakṛhaṃ labhate naraḥ | pūrṇadhānyahiraṇyādimaṇimuktāphalojjvalaṃ || 35.37 || pratyāsannajalopetaṃ gṛhaṃ prāpnoti śobhanaṃ | sāmantasvajanānāṃ ca sarveṣāmuttamottamaṃ || 35.38 || tadāpnoti gṛhaṃ ramyamupalepanakṛnnaraḥ | yenānulipte tiṣṭanti viṣṇvāyatanabhūtale || 35.39 || brāhmaṇāḥkṣatriyā vaiśyāśśūdrassādhvyastriyastathā | tasya puṇyaphalaṃ vaktuṃ nālaṃ devāssahānugāḥ || 35.40 || apsarogaṇasaṃkīrṇaṃ muktāhālaśatojjvalaṃ | śreṣṭhaṃ sarvavimānānāṃ svargadhiṣṇyamavāpnuyāth || 35.41 || yāvanta stithayo liptā divyābdāṃstāvato naraḥ | tasminvimāne sa narastsrī vā tiṣṭhati śobhane || 35.42 || sraggandhavastrasaṃyuktaḥ sarvabhūṣaṇabhūṣitaḥ | gandharvāpsarasāṃ saṃghaiḥ pūjyamānassa tiṣṭhati || 35.43 || liptā ca yāvatā hastā viṣṇorāyatane mahī | tāvadyojanavistīrṇasvargasthānādhipo bhaveth || 35.44 || pūjyamānassuragaṇaiśśītoṣṇādivivarjitaḥ | manojñagātro viprendraistiṣṭhatyābhūtasaṃplavaṃ || 35.45 || tatkṣayādiha cāgatya viśiṣṭe jāyate kule | atyutkṛṣṭagṛhaṃ prāpya martyaloke'bhivāñchitaṃ || 35.46 || natatra tāvaddāridṣaṃ nopasargona vākaliḥ | na tāvanmṛtaniṣkrāntiryāvajjīvanti sākṣiṇaḥ || 35.47 || viṣṇussamastabhūtāni sasarjaitāni yāni vai | teṣāṃ madhye jagaddhāturatīveṣṭā vasuṃdharā || 35.48 || kṛte sammārjane tasyāstathā caivānulepane | prayāti paramaṃ toṣaṃ viṣṇurbhūrvaiṣṇavīyataḥ || 35.49 || upoṣito naro nārī yaḥkarotyanulepanaṃ | na tasyajāyate bhaṅgo gārhasthye tu kadā ca na || 35.50 || yā ca nārī karotyevaṃ yathāvadanulepanaṃ | nāpnoti sāpi vaidhavyaṃ gṛhabhaṅgaṃ kadā ca na || 35.51 || sarvābharaṇasaṃpūrṇassarvopaskaradhānyavān | gomahiṣyādisaṃbhāgaṃ gṛhamāpnoti mānava || 35.52 || tasmādabhīpsatā samyaggārhasthyaṃ tadakhaṇḍitaṃ | viṣṇorāyatane kāryaṃ sahasai vopalepanaṃ || 35.53 || yaścānulepanaṃ kuryādviṣṇorāyatane naraḥ | so'pi lokaṃ samāsādya modatevai śatakratoḥ || 35.54 || puṣpaprakīrṇamatyarthaṃ sugandhaṃ keśavālaye | upalipte naro datvā na durgatimavāpnuyāth || 35.55 || snānapānāṃbhasāṃ viṣṇoḥ pradānāttatsalokabhāk | snānīyadravyadānena nīrogaḥ prītya modate || 35.56 || kṣoṃādidānādāpnoti paraloke mahatsukhaṃ | ālepanadravyadānātkāmānāpnoti śāśvatān || 35.57 || elākarpūratāṃbūlītailādi sparśanātpukhī | paratreha ca loke syāddīrghakālamasaṃśayaḥ || 35.58 || sarvayajñamayo viṣṇurgavyānāṃ paramassmṛtaḥ | jāyate yeṣu lokeṣu pulakassaṃgamomahān || 35.59 || yeṣu kṣīravahā nadyo hradāḥ pāyasakardamāḥ | tānlokānpuruṣā yāntikṣīrasnānakarā hareḥ || 35.60 || āhgādaṃ nirvṛtiṃ svāsthyamārogyaṃ cārurūpatā | saptajanmānyavāpnoti kṣīrasnānakaro hareḥ || 35.61 || dadhyādīnāṃ vikārāṇāṃ kṣīratassaṃbhavo yathā | tathaivāśeṣakāmānāṃ kṣīrasnāpanato hareḥ || 35.62 || yathā ca vimalaṃ kṣīraṃ yathā nirvṛtikārakaṃ | tathāsya nirmalaṃ jñānaṃ bhavatyatiphalapradaṃ || 35.63 || grahānukūlatāṃ puṣṭiṃ priyaṃ cāpyakhile jane | karoti bhagavānviṣṇuḥkṣīrasnāpanatoṣitaḥ || 35.64 || sarvo'syasnigdhatāmeti dṛṣṭimātprātprasīdati | yassnāpayati devasya ghṛtena pratimāṃ hareḥ || 35.65 || indraprasthe dvijāgṣāṇāṃ sa dadāti gavāṃ śataṃ | gavāṃ śatasya viprāṇāṃ na dattasya bhavetphalaṃ || 35.66 || ghṛtaprasthena tadviṣṇorlabhetsnānopayogināṃ | purā rājarṣibhiḥ prāptā saptadvīpā vasundharā || 35.67 || ghṛtāḍhakena govinda pratimāsnāpanātkila | pratimāsaṃ sitāṣṭamyāṃ ghṛtena jagataḥ patiṃ || 35.68 || snāpayitvā samastebhyaḥ pāpebhyo'pi pramucyate | dvādaśyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ ca gavyena haviṣā hareḥ || 35.69 || snāpanaṃ devadevasya mahāpātakanāśanaṃ | jñānato'jñānato vāpi yatpāpaṃ kurute naraḥ || 35.70 || tatkṣālayati saṃdhyāyāṃ ghṛtena snāpayanhariṃ | ghṛtakṣīreṇa deveśe snāpite madhusūdane || 35.71 || sa gatvāvaiṣṇavaṃ dhāma modate saha sūribhiḥ | srajaṃ baddhvā sumanasāṃ yaḥ prayacchati viṣṇave || 35.72 || sa bhuktvā vipulānbhogānnākapṛṣṭhe virājate | cāmaravyajana chatradānātsvārājyamaśnu te || 35.73 || dānādābharaṇādīnāṃ tejasvī divimodate | dānācca navaratnāvāṃ devasālokyamaśnute || 35.74 || ādarśanapradānena dṛśyassarvairbhaviṣyati | gandhadravya pradānena sugandhirdāyate bhṛveth || 35.75 || dhūpadravyapradānena svasthānaṃ svargiṇāṃ bhaveth | upānahau pāduke ca vāhanaṃ yānameva ca || 35.76 || dadāti yo saṃdayitvā? maṇikāñcanacitritaṃ | sa vimānaṃ tu dutprāpaṃ prāpno tyeva na saṃśayaḥ || 35.77 || alaṅkṛtaṃ bhadrapīṭhaṃ prayacchansarvakāmabhāk | vinatānandanasthānaṃ dhvajamutpādya darśayan || 35.78 || sāmīpyaṃ sahasā viṣṇoryāti sadyo sa saṃśayaḥ | dhvajaṃ ca vādyamutpādya viṣṇusātkurute tu yaḥ || 35.79 || sa divyadundubhi prāyaṃsthānaṃ prāpya virājate | dāsīdāsaṃ tathātmāna mātmīyaṃ ca prayacchali || 35.80 || vāsudevāya dāsyena muktiḥ karatalesthitā | nṛttabhedairgītabhedaistathā vādyairanekathā || 35.81 || śrotavyairapi dṛśyaiśca devadevasya sannidhau | āsīnamupacāraistairye samārādhayantite || 35.82 || pretya divyeṣu lokeṣu pūjyantetairna saṃśayaḥ | dīpaṃ prayacchati naro viṣṇorāyatane hi yaḥ || 35.83 || sadakṣiṇasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnotyasaṃśayaḥ | āhorātramanirvāṇaṃ dīpamāropayennaraḥ || 35.84 || sarvapāpa viśuddhātmā viṣṇuloke mahīyate | dinedine japannāma keśaveti samāhitaḥ || 35.85 || sakṛddadātiyovipraḥpradīpaṃ keśavālaye | jātismaratvaṃ prajñāṃ ca prākāśyaṃ sarvavantuṣu || 35.86 || avyāhatendriyatvaṃ ca samāpnoti na saṃśayaḥ | sarvakālaṃ ca cakṣuṣmānmedhāvī dīpado naraḥ || 35.87 || jāyate narakaṃ cāpi tamassaṃjñaṃ na paśyati | suvarṇamaṇimuktāḍhyaṃ manojñamatiśobhanaṃ || 35.88 || dīpamālākulaṃ divyaṃ vimānamadhirohati | tasmādāyatane viṣṇordadyāddīpaṃ prayatnataḥ || 35.89 || tāṃścadatvānnahīnaste? na ca tailaviyojanaṃ | kurvīta dīpahartāca mūkū'ndho jāyate jaḍaḥ || 35.90 || andhetamasi duṣpāre narake patitānkila | vikrośamānānmanujānvakṣyanti yamakiṅkarāḥ || 35.91 || vilāpairala matrevaṃ kiṃvo vilapite phalaṃ | tathā pramādibhiḥ pūrvamātmātyantamupekṣitaḥ || 35.92 || purvamālocitaṃ naitatkathamante bhaviṣyati | idānīṃ yātanā bhaugāḥkiṃ vilāpaḥ kariṣyati || 35.93 || dehoditāni svalpāni viṣayāścātikarṣakāḥ | etatkona vijānāti yena yūyaṃ pramādinaḥ || 35.94 || janturjanmasahasrebhyo hyekasminmānuṣo yadi | tatrāpyativimāḍhatvātkiṃbhogānabhidhāvati || 35.95 || ko'tibhāro harernāmni jihvayā parikīrtite | varṇite tulyamūletu yadagnirlabhyate sukhaṃ || 35.96 || ato'dhikarolābhaḥ kovaścitai'bhavattathā | yenāyateṣu hasteṣu svātantṣesati dīpakaḥ || 35.97 || mahāphalo viṣṇugṛhe na datto narakāpahāḥ | na vo vilapite kiṃ cididānīṃ dṛśyate phalaṃ || 35.98 || asvātantṣe vilapatāṃ svātantṣe tu pramādināṃ | avaśyaṃpātinaḥ prāṇā bhoktājīvopyaharniśaṃ || 35.99 || dattaṃ calabhate bhoktuṃ kāmayanviṣayāṃstadā | etatsvātantṣavadbhirvo yuktamāsītparīkṣituṃ || 35.100 || idānīṃ kiṃ vilāpena sahadhvaṃ yadupāgataṃ | yadyetadanabhīṣṭaṃ vo yadduḥkhaṃ samupasthitaṃ || 35.101 || yadbhūyo'pi matiḥ pāpe na kartavyā kathaṃ ca na | pāpakarmaṇinirvṛtte'pyajñānādaghanāśanaṃ || 35.102 || kartavyamapyavicchinnaṃ smaradbhirmadhusūdanaṃ | vimānamatividyoti sarvaratnamayaṃ divi || 35.103 || samāpnoti naro datvā pradīpaṃ keśavālaye | haviṣāṃ pāyasādīnāṃ haraye ca nivedanāth || 35.104 || sukhaikarasapūrṇatmā rājate viṣṇusannidhau | bhakṣyapānīyabhojyānāmanyeṣāmapi dānataḥ || 35.105 || śvetadvīpe tatsamīpe vasanti sukhinassadā | bahunātra kimuktena vāsudevārthamādarāth || 35.106 || dadāti vastudānaṃ? yasthsānaṃ prāpnoti cepsitaṃ | karmaṇāṃ mārjanādīnāṃ phalabhogādanantaraṃ || 35.107 || karmaśeṣaiḥ punarjanma karmānuguṇayoniṣu | utkṛṣṭāsvena bhoktāro labhante sukhinassadā || 35.108 || ārāmāṇāṃ taṭākānāṃ prapāṇāṃ ca pravartanāth | viṣṇorālayasāmīpye tatphalaṃ kena varṇyate || 35.109 || supradarśā balavatī citrā dhātuvibhūṣitā | upetā sarvabhūtaiśca śreṣṭhā bhūmirihocyate || 35.110 || tasyāḥ kṣetraviśeṣāśca taṭākānāṃ ca bandhanaṃ | audakāni ca sarvāṇi pravakṣyāmyanupūrvaśaḥ || 35.111 || taṭākānāṃ ca vakṣyāmi kṛtānāṃ cāpi ye guṇāḥ | triṣu lokeṣu sarvatra pūjanīyaḥ pratāpavān || 35.112 || atha vā mitrasadanaṃ maitraṃ mitravivardhanaṃ | kīrtisaṃjananaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ taṭākānāṃ niveśanaṃ || 35.113 || dharmasyārthasya kāmasya phalamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ | taṭākaṃ sukṛtaṃ deśekṣetramekaṃ mahāśrayaṃ || 35.114 || caturvidhānāṃ bhūtānāṃ taṭākamupalakṣayeth | taṭākāni ca sarvāṇi diśanti śriyamuttamāṃ || 35.115 || devā manuṣyā gandharvāḥ pitaro yakṣarākṣasāḥ | sthāvarāṇi ca bhūtāni saṃśrayanti jalāśayaṃ || 35.116 || tasmāttāṃstu pravakṣyāmi taṭāke ye guṇāssmṛtāḥ | yā ca tatra phalāvāptirṛṣibhissamudāhṛtā || 35.117 || varṣākāle taṭāke tu salilaṃ yasya tiṣṭhati | agnihotraphalaṃ tasya phalamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ || 35.118 || śaratkā le tu salilaṃ taṭāke yasya tiṣṭhati | gosahasrasya saṃpretya labhate phalamuttamaṃ || 35.119 || hemantakāle salilaṃ taṭāke yasya tiṣṭhati | sa vai bahusuvarṇasya yajñasya labhate phalaṃ || 35.120 || yasya vai śaiśire kāle taṭāke salilaṃ bhaveth | tasyāgniṣṭomayajñasya bhalamūhurmanīṣiṇaḥ || 35.121 || taṭākaṃ sukṛtaṃ yasya vasantetaṃ mahāśrayaṃ | atirātrasya yajñasya phalaṃ sa samupāśnute || 35.122 || nidāghakāle pānīyaṃ taṭāke yasya tiṣṭhati | vājimedhapalaṃ tasya phalaṃ vai munayo viduḥ || 35.123 || sa kulaṃ tārayetsarvaṃ yasya khāte jalāśaye | gāvaḥ pibanti salilaṃ sādhavaśca narāssadā || 35.124 || taṭāke yasya gāvastu pibanti tṛṣitā jalaṃ | mṛgapakṣimanuṣyāśya so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labheth || 35.125 || yatpibanti jalaṃ tatra styāyante viśramantica | taṭākadasya tatsarvaṃ pretyānantyāya kalpate || 35.126 || durlabhaṃ salilaṃ ceha viśeṣeṇa paratra vai | pānīyasya pradānena prītirbhavati śāśvatī || 35.127 || taṭāke yasya pānīyaṃ pānīyāya jagatpateḥ | tasya puṇyaphalaṃ vaktuṃ nālaṃ devāssahānu gāḥ || 35.128 || taṭāke yasya pānīye sāyaṃ prātardvijātayaḥ | snātvā kurvanti karmāṇi tasya nākesthitirbhaveth || 35.129 || taṭāke yasya devasya snāpanaṃ cādhivāsanaṃ | tasya lokā bhavantyeva pāvanāḥ kṣativarjitāḥ || 35.130 || sarvadānairgurutaraṃ sarvadānairviśiṣyate | pānīyāvāsadānaṃ tu devasyāgre praśasyate || 35.131 || atha vakṣye viśeṣeṇa vṛkṣāṇāmavaropaṇaṃ | sthānarāṇāṃ ca bhūtānāṃ jātayaṣṣaṭprakīrtitāḥ || 35.132 || vṛkṣagulpala tāvallyastvakcārāstṛṇajātayaḥ | etā jātyastu vṛkṣāṇāṃ teṣāṃ rope guṇāstvime || 35.133 || kīrtiśca mānave loke pretya caiva phalaṃ śubhaṃ | labhate nāma loke ca pitṛbhiśca mahīyate || 35.134 || devalokagatasyāpi nāmatasya na naśyati | atīte'nāgate cobhepitṛvaṃ śe'nyatastathā || 35.135 || tārayedvṛkṣarūpī ca tasmādvṛkṣāṃśca ropayeth | tasya putrā bhavantyete pādapā nātra saṃśayaḥ || 35.136 || paralokagatassvargaṃ lokāṃścāpnoti so'vyayān | puṣpaissuragaṇānvṛkṣāḥ phalaiścāpi tathā pitṛn || 35.137 || cāyayā cātithīṃścāpi pūjayanti mahīruhāḥ | kinnaroragarakṣāṃsi devagandharvamānavāḥ || 35.138 || tathā ṛṣigaṇāścaiva saṃśrayanti mahīruhān | puṣpitāḥ phalavantaśca tarpayantīha mānavān || 35.139 || vṛkṣadaṃ putravadvṛkṣāstārayanti paratra tu | patraṃ phalaṃ vā puṣpaṃ vā yasyārāme'varopite || 35.140 || acyutasya padaṃ prāptaṃ lokāstasyācyutā dhruvaṃ | patraiḥphalairvāpuṣpairvā prīyate bhagavānhariḥ || 35.141 || tasmāttaṭāre tadvṛkṣā ropyāśśreyorthinā sadā | putravatparipālyāśca putrāstedharmatassmṛtāḥ || 35.142 || taṭākakṛdvṛkṣaropī iṣṭayajñaśca yo naraḥ | ete svarge mahīyante ye cānye satyavādinaḥ || 35.143 || tasmāttaṭākānkurvīta ārāmāṃścaiva ropayeth | yajecca vividhairyajñaissatyaṃ ca satataṃ vadeth || 35.144 || gobhūhiraṇyadānāni kṛtvācāryāya viṣṇave | arcakāya viśeṣeṇa svargatassukhamedhate || 35.145 || atidānaṃ tu sarveṣāṃ bhūmidānamihocyate | acalā hyakṣayo bhūmissarvānkāmānprayacchati || 35.146 || yastudadyādbhūmidānaṃ devanāmnārcakāyahi | tasyaihikaṃ bhavetpuṇyaṃ tathā pāratrikaṃ bahu || 35.147 || yastu dadyātsvanāmnaiva pūjakāya vasuṃdharāṃ | tasya kāmāḥ prarohanti sarvamaihikamaśnute || 35.148 || devakāryāya vaidadyādyo devāya vasundharāṃ | devanāmnaiva tasya syātkevalāmuṣmikaṃ phalaṃ || 35.149 || brahmārpaṇadhiyā yastu guptaṃ dāsyati kiṃ cana | devāya devakāryāya brāhmaṇāyādhikāriṇe || 35.150 || yāvajjīvati taddānaṃ svargetasya sthitirbhaveth | yaṃ yaṃ kāmaṃ tu manasi kṛtvā yadyacca yor'payeth || 35.151 || taṃ tameva phalaṃ labdhvākartāsammodate ciraṃ | kimalabhyaṃ bhagavati prasanne śrīniketane || 35.152 || ācāryāyārpitā bhūmiratyantaphaladāyinī | tator'cakārpitā dadyādanantaṃ phalamucyate || 35.153 || padārthināmathānveṣāṃ tathānyavibhavasya ca | sarvameva bhaveddattaṃ vasudhāṃ yaḥ prayacchati || 35.154 || phālakṛṣṭāṃ mahīṃ dadyātsabījāṃ sasyamālinīṃ | yāvatsūryakarā loke tāvatsvarge mahīyate || 35.155 || phālakṛṣṭāṃ mahīṃ dadyātsabījāṃ sasyamālinīṃ | yāvatsūryakarā loke tāvatsvarge mahīyate || 35.156 || yaścāpi kurute pāpaṃ puruṣovṛttikarśitaḥ | api gokarṇamātreṇa bhūmidānena śuddhyati || 35.157 || saptahastena vā samyaktriṃśaddaṇḍena vardhanaṃ | sa śatānyeva gokarṇamiti vedavido vidaḥ || 35.158 || jitendrayāya guṇine pūjakāya tapasvine | dadyānmahīṃ bhadettasya phalamakṣayamacyutaṃ || 35.159 || yathāpsu patitassadyastailabinduḥ prarohati | evaṃ bhūmikṛtaṃ dānaṃ sasye sasye prarohati || 35.160 || yathā bījāni rohanti prakīrṇāni mahītale | evaṃ kāmāḥprarohanti bhūmidānasamārjitāḥ || 35.161 || yathā gaurbharate vatsaṃ kṣīriṇī kṣīramutsṛjeth | evaṃ dattāciraṃ kālaṃ bhūmirbharati bhūmidaṃ || 35.162 || ikṣubhissatatāṃ bhūmiṃ yavagodhūmaśādvalaiḥ | yo dadāti naraśreṣṭhassa na pracyavate divaḥ || 35.163 || śubhaṃ bhadrāsanaṃ chatraṃ varāśca varayoṣitaḥ | bhūmidānasya cihnāni phalametanna saṃśayaḥ || 35.164 || āditya vasavo viṣṇurbrahmā somo hutāśanaḥ | śūlapāṇiśca bhagavānabhinandanti bhūmidaṃ || 35.165 || sauvarṇachatrahakmyāṇi vasordhārāśca kāmadāḥ | gandharvāpsaraso yatra tatra tiṣṭhanti bhūmidāḥ || 35.166 || iyameva purā bhūmiḥ pālitā bahubhignṛpaiḥ | anyaiśca bahubhirdattā rājabhissatyasaṃgaraiḥ || 35.167 || yasya yasya yadā bhūmi stasya tasya tadā phalaṃ | bhūmiṃ yaḥ pratigṛhṇāti yaśca bhūmiṃ prayacchati || 35.168 || tāvubhau puṇyakarmāṇau niyatau svargagāminau | dānapālanayormadhye dānācchreyo'nupālanaṃ || 35.169 || dānātsvargamavāpnoti pālanādacyutaṃ padaṃ | svadattāddviguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ paradattānupālanaṃ || 35.170 || bhūmidassvargamāruhya śāsvatīredhate samāḥ | punaśca janma saṃpāpya bhavedbhūmi patirdhruvaṃ || 35.171 || yathā bhūmissadā devī dātāraṃ kurute patiṃ | evaṃ sadakṣiṇā dattākurute gaurjanādhipaṃ || 35.172 || api pāpakṛtaṃ prāpya pratigṛhṇāti bhūmidaṃ | mahīṃ dadatpavitrassyātpuṇyā ca jagatī yataḥ || 35.173 || nāmaiva priyadatteti guhyāmetatsanātanaṃ | tadasyāssatataṃ prītyaikīrtanīyā prayacchatā || 35.174 || tapoyajñāśritaṃ śīlamalobhassatyavāditā | gurudaivatapūjā ca nātikrāmati bhūmidaṃ || 35.175 || bharturniśśreyase yuktā styaktātmādoraṇe hatāḥ | brahmalokagatāssanto nātikrāmantibhūmidaṃ || 35.176 || yathā janitrī kṣīreṇa puṣṇāti svasutaṃ mudā | evaṃ sarvaguṇairbhūmirdātāramanupuṣyati || 35.177 || agniṣṭomādibhiryajñairiṣṭvā vipuladakṣiṇaiḥ | na tatphalamavāpnoti yaddatvā vasudhāṃ punaḥ || 35.178 || mṛtyorhi kiṅkarā daṇḍā hyagnitāpāssudāruṇāḥ | ghorāśca vāruṇāḥ pāśā nopasarpanti bhūmidaṃ || 35.179 || pītaraḥ pitṛlokasthā devaloke divaukasaḥ | santarpayanti dātāraṃ bhūmeḥ prabhavatāṃnaraḥ || 35.180 || ādityā iva dīpyante tejasā di mānavāḥ | ye prayacchanti vasudhāṃ haraye lokasākṣiṇe || 35.181 || kṛśāya kṛśabhṛtyāya vṛttiṃ kṣīṇāya sīdate | devāgrer'pyatu viprāya suśrīrbhavati mānavaḥ || 35.182 || āsphoṭayanti pitaraḥ pranṛtya ni pitāmahāḥ | bhūmido naḥ kule jātassavassantārayiṣyati || 35.183 || sa naḥ kulasya puruṣassano bandhussano guruḥ | sa dātā sa ca vikrānto yo dadāti vasuṃdharāṃ || 35.184 || lokāṃstu sṛjatā pūrvaṃ gāvassṛṣṭāssvayaṃbhuvā | vṛddhyarthaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ tasmāttā mātarassmṛtāḥ || 35.185 || tāstudatvā saurabheyīssvargeloke mahīyate | dhenuṃ datvā suvratāṃ ca sopadhānāṃ payasvinīṃ || 35.186 || savatsāṃ kapilāṃ divyāmācāryāyārcakāya ca | devadevasya tuṣṭyarthaṃ devāya brāhmaṇāya vā || 35.187 || na tasya śakyate vaktuṃ phalaṃ varṣaśatairapi | yāvanti dhenvālomāni vatsāyāśca viśeṣataḥ || 35.188 || tāvadvarṣa sahasrāṇi kāmānduhyeta sā varā | prayacchate yaḥkapilāṃ savatsāṃ kāṃsyajohanāṃ || 35.189 || svarṇaśruṅgīṃ raupyakhurāṃ taistairdravyaguṇaiḥ punaḥ | sā gauḥ kāmadughā bhūtvā dātāramupasarpati || 35.190 || gosahasraṃ tu yo dadyātsarvaratnairalaṅkṛtaṃ | parāṃ vṛddhiṃśriyaṃ prāpya svargaloke mahīyate || 35.191 || daśa cobhayataḥpretya mātā mahapitāmahāḥ | gacchetsukṛtināṃ lokāngāvo datvā yathāvidhi || 35.192 || dāyādyalabdhairyogādyairgāvassampādya yodadeth | tasyāpi cākṣayā lokā bhavantīha paratra ca || 35.193 || yo vā dyūte dhanaṃ jitvāgāvaḥkrītvā prayacchati | sa gacchedvirajānlokāngopradānaphalārjitān || 35.194 || pratigṛhyatu yo dadyādgāvaśśuddhena cetasā | sa gatvā durlabhaṃ sthānamamaraissaha modate || 35.195 || yaścātmavikrayaṃ kṛtvā gāvo dadyādyadhāvidhi | sa gatvā virajānlokānsukhaṃ vasati devavath || 35.196 || saṃgrāme yastanuṃ tyaktvā tvaktvā gāvaḥprayacchati | dehavikraya mūlyāstā śśāśvatāḥ kāmadohanāḥ || 35.197 || jīrṇāṃ caivopabhukrāñca jaradgāṃ śīlavarjitām, | tamaḥ praviśate datvā dvijaṃ kleśena yojayeth || 35.198 || dānayogyā bhavesnaiva kṛśā duṣṭā palāyinī | yuñjyātlkeśaistu yo vipraṃ datvaināṃ tadvṛdhā bhaveth || 35.199 || yuvānaṃ balinaṃ śyāmaṃ halena saha yūthapaṃ | gopatiṃ haraye dadyādbhūriśruṅgamalaṅkṛtaṃ || 35.200 || brāhmaṇānāṃ gavāṃ caiva kulamekaṃ dvidhā kṛtaṃ | ekatra mantrā stiṣṭhanti havirekatra tiṣṭhati || 35.201 || upagamya tu yo dadyādgāvaśśuddhena cetasā | yāvantitāsāṃ romāṇi tāvatsvarge mahīyate || 35.202 || pravakṣyāmi gavāṃlokā yādṛśāyatra saṃsthitāḥ | manojñā ramaṇīyāśca sarvakāmaduhāssadā || 35.203 || puṇyāḥpāpaharāśceva gavāṃ lokā na saṃśayaḥ | atyantasukhinastatra sarvapāpavivarjitāḥ || 35.204 || pramodante mahāsthsāne narā vigatakalmaṣāḥ | tulyaprabhāvā devaiste modante psarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ || 35.205 || gandharvairupagīyante gośaraṇyā na saṃśayaḥ | brāhmaṇāssādhuvṛttāśca dayāvanto'nukaṃpakāḥ || 35.206 || ghṛṇinaśśubhakartāro modantedaivataissaha | yathaiva salile matsyassalilena sahoṣya te || 35.207 || gobhiḥ pāpakṛtaṃ karma dṛḍhameva vyapohyate | mātarassarvabhūtānāṃ prajānāṃ rakṣaṇe kṛtāḥ || 35.208 || brahmāṇā lokasāreṇa gāvaḥpāpabhayāpahāḥ | tānu dattāsu loke'sminkiṃ na dattaṃ bhavediha || 35.209 || deveśāya viśeṣeṇa tatkriyāya tathā punaḥ | pratipādyāssadā gāno bhūtiṃ sbhārāmabhīpsubhiḥ || 35.210 || suvarṇaṃ paramaṃ dānaṃ suvarṇaṃ dakṣiṇā parā | etatpavitraṃ paramametatsvastyayanaṃ mahath || 35.211 || daśapūrvānparānvaṃśyānātmānaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ | apipāpaśataṃ kṛtvā dattaṃ vipriṣu tārayeth || 35.212 || suvarṇaṃ ye prayacchanti narāśśuddheva cetasā | devatāste prayacchanti samastamiti naśśrutaṃ || 35.213 || agnirhi devatāssarvāssuvarṇaṃ ca hutāśanaḥ | tasmātsuvarṇaṃ dadatā dattāssarvāśca devatāḥ || 35.214 || agnyabhāve ca kurvanti vahnisthāne ca kāñcanaṃ | sarvadevapramāṇajñā vedaśrutinidarśanāth || 35.215 || yastvenaṃ jvalayedagnimādityodayanaṃ prati | dadyādvai devamuddiśya sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāth || 35.216 || suvarṇadassarvaloke kāmāniṣṭānavāpnute | virajāṃbarasaṃvītaḥ pariyāti tatastataḥ || 35.217 || vimānenārkavarṇena bhāsvareṇa virājatā | apsarogaṇasaṃkīrṇo bhāsvarastena tejasā || 35.218 || haṃsabarhiṇayuktena kāmagena narottamaḥ | divyagandhavahassvarge parigacchannitastataḥ || 35.219 || tasmātsvaśaktyā dātavyaṃ kāñcanaṃ mānavairbhuvi | vimānenārkavarṇena sa yāti svargamuttamaṃ || 35.220 || na hyataḥ paramaṃ loke sadyaḥ pāpavināśanaṃ | brahmakośasya śuddhasya suvarṇaṃ yaḥ prayacchati || 35.221 || bahūnyabdasahasrāṇi svargeloke mahīyate | iti saṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ svarṇadānaphalaṃ mayā || 35.222 || atha vakṣye viśeṣeṇa phalamannasya dāpanāth | viṣṇave ca śriyai bhūmyai sarvadevebhya eva ca || 35.223 || tanni vedita śeṣasya dānāccārthibhya ādarāth | na śakyate phalaṃ tasya vaktuṃ varṣaśatairapi || 35.224 || tathāpi gīyate yattu vistārātparamarṣibhiḥ | saṃkṣepataḥ pravakṣyāmi annadānārjitaṃ phalaṃ || 35.225 || prasādamamṛtaṃ brūyādannaṃ devaniveditaṃ | tīrthaṃ cāmṛtamityeva devapādodakaṃ vadeth || 35.226 || annameva praśaṃsanti devā ṛṣigaṇāstathā | lokatantraṃ hi saṃjñāśca sarvamanne pratiṣṭhitaṃ || 35.227 || annena sadṛśaṃ dānaṃ na bhūto na bhaviṣyati | tasmādannaṃ viśeṣeṇa dātumicchanti mānavāḥ || 35.228 || annamūrjaskaraṃ loke prāṇāścānne pratiṣṭhitāḥ | annena dhāryate sarvaṃ viśvaṃ jagadidaṃ mahath || 35.229 || annādgṛhasthā lokesminbhikṣavastāpasāstathā | annādbhavanti vai prāṇāḥ pratyakṣaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || 35.230 || kuṭuṃbaṃ pīḍayitvā tu brāhmaṇāya mahātmane | dātavyaṃ bhikṣave cānnamātmano bhūtimicchatā || 35.231 || brāhmaṇāyābhirūpāya yo dadyādannamarthine | vidadhāti nidhiṃ śreṣṭhaṃ pāralaukikamātmanaḥ || 35.232 || śrāntamadhvani vartantaṃ vṛddhamarhamupasthitaṃ | arcayedbhūtimanvicchangṛhastho gṛhamāgataṃ || 35.233 || krodhamutpatitaṃ hitvā suśīlo vītamatsaraḥ | annadaḥ prāpnute bhū yo bhuvi ceha ca yatsukhaṃ || 35.234 || nāvamanyedabhigataṃ na praṇudyātkathaṃ cana | api śvapāke śuni vā na dānaṃ vipraṇaśyati || 35.235 || yo dadyādaparikliṣṭamanna madhvani vartate | śāntāyādṛṣṭapūrvāya samahaddharmamāpnuyāth || 35.236 || pitṝndevānṛṣīnviprānatithīṃśca viśeṣataḥ | yo naraḥprīṇayatyannaistasya puṇyaphalaṃ mahath || 35.237 || kṛtvātipātakaṃ karmayo dadyādanna marthine | brāhmaṇāya viśeṣeṇa na sa pāpena muhyate || 35.238 || brāhmaṇeṣvakṣayaṃ nāmnāṃ śūdre mahatbhalaṃ | annadāmapi śūdre ca brāhmaṇasya viśiṣyate || 35.239 || na pṛcchedgotracaraṇaṃ svādhyāyaṃ deśamena ca | bhikṣito brāhmaṇeneha dadyādannaṃ prayācitaḥ || 35.240 || annadasyānnavṛkṣāśca sarvakāmaphalapradāḥ | bhavanti ceha nāmutranṛpaternātrasaṃśayaḥ || 35.241 || āśaṃsate hi pitarassuvṛṣṭimiva karṣakāḥ | asmākamapi putro vā pautro vānnaṃ pradāsyati || 35.242 || brāhmaṇohi mahadbhūtaṃ svayaṃ dehīti yācate | akāmovā sakāmo vā datvā puṇyamavāpnuyāth || 35.243 || brāhmaṇassarvabhūtānāmatidhiḥ prasṛtāgrabhuk | viprā yamadhigacchanti bhikṣamāṇā gṛhaṃ sadā || 35.244 || satkṛtācca nivartante tadatīva pravarthate | mahābhoge kule pretya janma cāpnoti nityaśaḥ || 35.245 || datvātvannaṃ naro loke yathāsthānamanuttamaṃ | nityaṃ mṛṣṭānnadāyī tu svarge vasati satkṛtaḥ || 35.246 || annaṃ prāṇā narāṇāṃhi sarvamanne pratiṣṭhitaṃ | annadaḥ paśumānputrī dhanavānbhogavānapi || 35.247 || prāṇavāṃścāpi bhavati rūpavāṃśca tathā bhaveth | annadaḥprāṇado loke sarvadaḥ procyate tu saḥ || 35.248 || annaṃ hidatvātithaye brāhmaṇāya yathāvidhi | pradātā sukhamāpnoti daivataiścāpi pūjyate || 35.249 || brāhmaṇo hi mahadbhūtaṃ kṣetrabhūtamihocyate | upyate yatra tadbījaṃ taddhi puṇyaphalaṃ mahath || 35.250 || pratyakṣaprītijananaṃ bhokturdāturbhavatyuta | sarvāṇyanyāni dānāni parokṣaphalavantyuta || 35.251 || annāddhi prasavaṃ yānti ratirannāddhi jāyate | dhakmārthāvannato vidyātroganāśastathānnataḥ || 35.252 || annaṃ hyadbhutamityāha purā kalpe prajāpatiḥ | annaṃ bhuvaṃ divaṃ khaṃ ca sarvamanne pratiṣṭhitaṃ || 35.253 || anna praṇāśe bhidyante śarīre pañca dhātavaḥ | balaṃ balavato'pīha praṇaśyatyannahānitaḥ || 35.254 || āvāhāśca vivāhāśca yajñāścānnakṛte tathā | nivartante viśeṣeṇa brahma cātra pradīyate || 35.255 || annatassarvametaddhi yatkiñcitsthāṇu jaṅgamaṃ | triṣulokeṣu dharmārthamannaṃ deyaṃ tato budhaiḥ || 35.256 || annadasya manuṣyasya balamojo yaśāṃsi ca | āyuśca vardhate tadvatteṣu lokeṣu niścitaṃ || 35.257 || meghādūrdhvaṃ sannidhatteprāṇānāṃ pavanaḥ patiḥ | yacca meghagataṃ vāri śakro varṣati harṣitaḥ || 35.258 || ādatte ca rasānbhoṃānādityassvagabhastibhiḥ | vāyurādityataptāṃśca rasāndevaḥpravarṣati || 35.259 || tadyathā meghato vāri patitaṃ bhavati kṣitau | tadā vasumatī devī snigdhā bhavati bhāvitā || 35.260 || tatassasyāni rohanti yena vartayate jagath | māṃsamedo'sthiśukrāṇāṃ prādurbhāvastataḥ punaḥ || 35.261 || saṃbhavanti tataśśukrātprāṇinaḥ pṛdhivītale | agniṣṭomau hi tacchrakraṃ sṛjataḥ puṣyataśca ha || 35.262 || evamannāddhi sūryaśca pavanaśśukramevaca | eka eva smṛto rāśistato bhūtāni jaṅgire || 35.263 || prāṇāndadāti bhūtānāṃ tejaśca satataprabhaṃ | gṛhamabhyāgatāyātha yo dadyādannamarthine || 35.264 || annadānāddhi yelokāstāṃśruṇudhvaṃ samāhitāḥ | bhavanāni prakāśante divi teṣāṃ mahātmanāṃ || 35.265 || tārāsaṃsthānarūpāṇi nānā staṃbhānvitāni ca | candramaṇḍalaśubhrāṇi kiṅkiṇījālavanti ca || 35.266 || taruṇādityavarṇāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇica | anekaśatabhoṃāni sāṃtarjalacarāṇi ca || 35.267 || vaiḍūryārkaprakāśāni raukmarūpyamayāni ca | sarvakāmaphalāścāpi vṛkṣā bhavanasaṃsthitāḥ || 35.268 || vāpyo vīthyaḥ sabhāḥ kūpādīrghi kāścaiva sarvaśaḥ | ghoṣavantyatha yānāni muktānyatha sahasraśaḥ || 35.269 || bhakṣyabhojyamayāśśailā vāsāṃsyābharaṇāni ca | kṣīraṃ sravanti saritastathā caivānna parvatāḥ || 35.270 || prāsādāḥ pāṇḍurābhrābhāśśayyāśca kanakojjvalāḥ | tānyannadāḥ prapadyante tasmādannaṃ dadetsadā || 35.271 || dadyādadyātsadaivānnaṃ viṣṇave viniveditaṃ | haviḥpātrādi sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ tāmrameva vā || 35.272 || kāṃsyaṃ vāpyatha yo dadyādarghya pātrādikānapi | kalaśānkarakānkuṃbhānanyāṃścaiva paricchadān || 35.273 || śaktilobhamakṛtvaiva tasya puṇyaphalaṃ mahath | sauvarṇānyevayo dadyātsārūpyaṃ labhate phalaṃ || 35.274 || rājatānyatha yodadyātsāmīpyaṃ phalamāpnuyāth | dadyāttāmrāṇi kāṃsyāni sārokyaṃ padameti saḥ || 35.275 || dhvacānvicitrānyo dadyānnānāvarṇa samāyutān | sarveṣāmuttamo bhūtvā kulaketurbhaviṣyati || 35.276 || śvetaṃ vitānaṃ raktaṃ vā kṛṣṇaṃ pītaṃ ca śyāmalaṃ | dukūlenātha paṭṭena tantunānyena vā kṛtaṃ || 35.277 || yo dadyāddevadevasya sa gacchedvaiṣṇavaṃ padaṃ | sopadhānāṃ satalpāṃ ca khaṭvāṃ dadyācca yohareḥ || 35.278 || kuberalokamāsādya tatra sammodate ciraṃ | ātapatraṃ tathā haimaṃ muktādāmavibhūṣitaṃ || 35.279 || haimadaṇḍayutaṃ dadyādindralokaṃ sa gacchati | rājyakāmī tu rājā syātsārvabhoṃo'pi jāyate || 35.280 || mayūracchatradānāttu vāruṇaṃ lokamāpnuyāth | cāmaraṃ hemadaṇḍaṃ ca vyajanaṃ ratnabhūṣitaṃ || 35.281 || kevalaṃ hemadaṇḍaṃ vā bhaktyā śaktyā ca saṃyutaṃ | arpayeddharaye yastu devaloke mahīyate || 35.282 || mayūravyajanaṃ tadvadrukmadaṇḍaṃ ca śaktitaḥ | bhaktyaiva yo harerdadyādvāyuloke mahīyate || 35.283 || vimānaṃ haivasaṃcchannaṃ viṣṇoryaḥ kārayennaraḥ | aśakyaṃ tatphalaṃ vaktuṃ sarvairapi surāsuraiḥ || 35.284 || sauvarmaṃ viṣṇurūpantu yo bhaktyaiva tu kārayeth | tasyāpi yatphalaṃ sarvamanantamiti naśśrutaṃ || 35.285 || maṇḍapaṃ vā prapāṃ vātha ratnamuktopaśobhitaṃ | hemalaṃba? samāyuktaṃ haimastaṃbhapariṣkṛtaṃ || 35.286 || kalpayedviṣṇusālokyaṃ prāpnotyamaradurlabhaṃ | haimaṃ siṃhāsanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ yo bhaktyaivār'payeddhareḥ || 35.287 || siṃhāsanaṃ samāsthāya māhendrīṃ saṃpadaṃ vrajeth | haimīryāśśibikāścaiva raṅgādīnyaśca kārayeth || 35.288 || haimaṃ yānaṃ tathāruhya viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati | aśaktodāravānvātharaṅgādīnśibikāstathā || 35.289 || siṃhāsanaṃ vā yo dadyātsomalokaṃ sa gacchati | yaśca kāṃsyamayīṃ ghaṇṭāṃhṛdyadhvaniyutāṃ dadeth || 35.290 || hṛdyavāksusvaro hṛdyo vāgmī sa tu bhavennaraḥ | śaṅkhabheryādidānena śakraloke sa pūjyate || 35.291 || nṛttageyādibhirvādyairghoṣaṇaṃ kārayettu yaḥ | nartayedapsarobhirvā gāndharvaṃ lokamāpnuyāth || 35.292 || vīṇāveṇuvinādaiśca śaktyā yaḥ pūjayeddhariṃ | bhuktvātramahadaiśvaryaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ padamāpnuyāth || 35.293 || yadyaddravyaṃ mudā yukto dadyāttu haraye naraḥ | tadagre pūjakebhyaśca gurave ca viśeṣataḥ || 35.294 || tatprītyai cetarebhyaśca brāhmaṇebhyo vidhānataḥ | samṛddhiṃ tasya tasyaiva dravyasyāpnotyasaṃśayaṃ || 35.295 || yaṃ kāmayitvā dadyādyattatsarvaṃ sa labhennaraḥ | yadyatkarma tadarthaṃ syātparicaryā ca tasya yā || 35.296 || tasyopacāraṃ yatkarma karoti śraddhayā tu yaḥ | sarvayajñaphalaṃ prāpya nāmīpyaṃ padamāpnu yāth || 35.297 || tasmādatra pratiṣṭhāpya devadevasya mandiraṃ | śaktilobhamakṛtvaiva vibhavānāñcabhaktitaḥ || 35.298 || bahudhā bahulāṃ vṛttiṃ kalpayeccettaduttamaṃ | athār'cane phalaṃ vakṣye viśeṣeṇa madhudviṣaḥ || 35.299 || bhaktyāpradakṣiṇaṃ kurvannityaṃ viṣṇvālaye naraḥ | sāyaṃ prātaśca deveśaṃ namasyannatha cintayan || 35.300 || yaḥ pramāmaṃ muhuḥ kuryātsa tu yajñaphalaṃ labheth | upacāraviśeṣāṇādvakṣyate phalaṃ || 35.301 || dhyānamāvāhanaṃ kṛtvā sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāth | aṣṭāṅgayogamārgeṇa manasā bhāvayanhariṃ || 35.302 || saṃcintya manasā pūrvaṃ pūtakāyo mahāmanāḥ | yaḥ kuryātpūjanaṃ viṣṇostatra devo vaseddhruvaṃ || 35.303 || arcakasya tapoyogātpūjāyā ścātiśāyanāth | ābhirūpyācca biṃbasya sannidheḥ procyate hareḥ || 35.304 || āsanaṃ haraye datvā pratiṣṭhāṃ labhate ciraṃ | svāgatenānumānena yaḥ pūjayati mādhavaṃ || 35.305 || sarvairanumato bhūtvā svāgataṃ so'bhipadyate | pādyamācamanīyaṃ ca samarpya haraye naraḥ || 35.306 || bāhyamābhyantaraṃ yattu pāpaṃ tena vimucyate | nityaṃ puṣpāṇi puṇyāni bhaktyā yastu samarcayeth || 35.307 || sūryakoṭinibhaṃ divyaṃ vimānamadhiruhyasaḥ | viṣṇulokaṃ gatassatyaṃ viṣṇuvanmodate ciraṃ || 35.308 || deveśaṃ puṣpamālādyairalaṅkuryācca yo budhaḥ | tasyānantaphalaṃ prokta mananto bhagavānhariḥ || 35.309 || caṃpakāśokapunnāga jātīmalayapaṅkajaṃ | samarpya devadevāya śubhānāmāśrayo bhaveth || 35.310 || damanośīralāmajjā ketakyutpalamarpayeth | maṅgalaṃ tasya niśchidraṃ bhavedeva na saṃśayaḥ || 35.311 || tulasīmarpayedvidvānpādayorbhaktito hareḥ | sa cāna ntaphalaṃ prāpya modate viṣṇusannedhau || 35.312 || sugandhipuṣpadānena sugandhirjāyate naraḥ | bahupuṣpapradānena bahudhā tuṣyate?hariḥ || 35.313 || bahujātisumānāṃ ca dānena prīyate sa vai | pādayorarpaṇādviṣṇoḥ puṣpāṇāṃ saṃcayaṃ sakṛth || 35.314 || padepade cāśvamedhaphalaṃ prāpnotyasaṃśayaṃ | tulasīṃ mūrthni devasya samarpya madhuvidviṣaḥ || 35.315 || naraḥ pāpādvimucyeta karmaṇā nopalipyate | sarvāṅgeṣvarpayanpuṣpaṃ sarvagasya naro hareḥ || 35.316 || sarvadā sarvalokeṣu kāmacoro bhaviṣyati | alaṅkṛtya phalairdevaṃ puṣpārpaṇaphalaṃ labheth || 35.317 || saṃgandhacandanadravyaṃ karpūrādiyutaṃ tathā | yathārhamarpayedaṅgeślakṣṇaṃ sarvāṅgasundaraṃ || 35.318 || sa naro viṣṇusālokyaṃ prayātyamaradurlabhaṃ | svayamevāhṛtaiḥ puṣpaiḥ pūjayedyastu mādhavaṃ || 35.319 || sa sarvānsamavāpnoti puṣpārpaṇaphalādikān | sarveṣāmapi puṣpāṇāṃ tulasī prītidā hareḥ || 35.320 || tulasīdalamādāya yatra gacchati pūjakaḥ | anugacchati taṃ devo yathā gorvatsalā bhṛśaṃ || 35.321 || pratyahaṃ pūjayedyastu tulasyā garuḍadhvajaṃ | janmamṛtyujarāvyādhimukto muktimavāpnuyāth || 35.322 || maṇikāñcanapuṣpāṇi muktāvaidūryakāni ca | tulasīdaladānasya kalāṃ nār'hanti ṣoḍaśīṃ || 35.323 || sumañjarīdalairyuktaiḥ komalaistulasīdalaiḥ | ye kurvanti hareḥ pūjāṃ te kṛtārthāḥ kalau yuge || 35.324 || śuṣkaṃ paryuṣitaṃ vār'draṃ kāṣṭhaṃ vā tulasīdalaṃ | arcane vāsudevasya lakṣakoṭiguṇaṃ bhaveth || 35.325 || tulasīgrahaṇaṃ śastaṃ viṣṇorarcanahetave | varjyaṃ paryuṣitaṃ puṣpaṃ na varjyaṃ tulasīdalaṃ || 35.326 || varjyaṃ paryuṣitaṃ toyaṃ na varjyaṃ jāhnavījalaṃ | anyatparyuṣitaṃ varjyaṃ na varjyaṃ padmapuṣpakaṃ || 35.327 || śuṣkaiḥ paryuṣitairvāpi kāṣṭhamūlamṛdādibhiḥ | arcanādvāsudevasya mukto bhavati pūruṣaḥ || 35.328 || puṣkarādyāni tīrthāni gaṅgādyāssaritastathā | devā divisthitā ye vaitiṣṭhanti tulasīdale || 35.329 || tāvadgarjanti puṣpāṇi mālatyādīni garvataḥ | yāvanna prāpyate puṇyā tulasī viṣṇuvallabhā || 35.330 || sakṛdabhyarcya govindaṃ tulasyā caiva mānavaḥ | muktibhāgī nirātaṅkaṃ kṛṣṇasyānucaro bhaveth || 35.331 || nākṣatairarcayedviṣṇuṃ na śaṃbhuṃ śaṅkhavāriṇā | nārcayeddūrvayā durgāṃ na tulasyā surāntaraṃ || 35.332 || dalālābhe tulasyāstu patrairārādhayeddhariṃ | patrālābhe śiphābhirvā śiphābhāve śiphālavaiḥ || 35.333 || lavālābhe mṛdā tatra bhaktimānarcayeddhariṃ | harerabhyarcanāyāṃ ca tulasī sādhanaṃ paraṃ || 35.334 || alābhe tulasī ca tannāmagrahaṇaṃ paraṃ | bhagavānaravindākṣassantuṣyati sahasradhā || 35.335 || na padmairnāpi kalhārairna hemakusumairapi | tathā tuṣyati govindo yathaina tulasīdalaiḥ || 35.336 || saṃgṛhya tulasīṃ bhaktyā sarvāniṣṭa | tulasyaiva hareḥ pūjāṃ ye kurvanti sadā bhuvi || 35.337 || tasmāttulasyā sadṛśaṃ sa ca bhūtaṃ na bhāvi ca | tulasīkānanāmodavāpitā yatra mārutāḥ || 35.338 || na tatra dharaṇībhāge caranti yamakiṅkarāḥ | "tulasī tulasī''tyevaṃ nāmānyāvartayantiye || 35.339 || te viṣṇulokamāsādya paśyanti madhusūdanaṃ | darśanācchravaṇātsvarśātsmaraṇātkīrtanādapi || 35.340 || punāti tulasī puṇyā daśapūrvāndaśāvarān | tulasīkānanaṃ yatra yatra vā harikīrtanaṃ || 35.341 || tatraivāste hariśśrīmānśaṅkhacakragadāyudhaḥ | yaḥ pūjayetphalairviṣṇuṃ nupakvairamṛtopamaiḥ || 35.342 || puṇyavṛkṣasamudbhūtaistatphalaṃ kena varṇyate | candanāgurukoṣṭhvādyairbhūpamāghrāpayeccayaḥ || 35.343 || sūryalokaṃ sa gatvaiva yāti viṣṇoḥ paraṃ padaṃ | ghṛtena kāpilenaiva dṛḍhavartiyutaṃ tu yaḥ || 35.344 || darśayeddevadevasya dīpaṃ dṛṣṭimanoharaṃ | so'ndhaṃ naiva praviśati narakaṃ narapuṅgavaḥ || 35.345 || yastu tailena saṃdīptaṃ darśayeddīpamujjvalaṃ | vimānamatividyoti yātyāruhya tamaḥparaṃ || 35.346 || karbūradīpaṃ yo bhaktyā darśayeddharaye naraḥ | tasya pāpāni naśyanti nirlepassa bhaviṣyati || 35.347 || vidhinār'ghyaṃ harerdadyādaṣṭhāṅgaṃ bhaktito naraḥ | candralokaṃ sa gatvaiva yāti viṣṇoḥ paraṃ padaṃ || 35.348 || sugandhi śubhamutpūtaṃ snānatoyaṃ ca yo dadeth | deveśasya viśeṣaṇa sa bhavedvītakalmaṣaḥ || 35.349 || tataśca vāruṇaṃ lokaṃ prāpya tatraiva modate | plotavastrottarīyāṇi viśuddhāni mṛdūni ca || 35.350 || devadevasya datvā tu soṃyaṃ lokamavāpnuyāth | kārpāsamatha ca kṣoṃaṃ kauśeyaṃ rāṅkavaṃ tathā || 35.351 || yathāśakti samarpyaiva phalaṃ cānantamaśnute | kārpāsādrāṅgavaṃ tasmātkau śeyaṃ kṣoṃamityapi || 35.352 || praśastaṃ kathitaṃ vastraṃ yathā śaktyanurūpataḥ | sauvarṇābharaṇānyatra muktāmaṇikṛtāni vā || 35.353 || arpayeddevadevasya bhavedbhūmipatissa hi | jāṃbūnadaṃ śātakuṃbhaṃ hāṭakaṃ vaiṇavaṃ tathā || 35.354 || śruṅgī ca śuktijaṃ caiva jātarūpamataḥ paraṃ | rasaviddhaṃ tathā proktamākarodgatamityapi || 35.355 || proktaṃ bahuvidhaṃ hema pūrvātpūrvātparaṃ paraṃ | pratyuptāni viśeṣeṇa ratnairnāvāvidhairhareḥ || 35.356 || bhūṣaṇānyarpayedbhaktyā mitrāṇyasya navagrahāḥ | rājaśriyaṃ ca bhuktvā nte viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati || 35.357 || upavītaṃ tu yo dadyātsauvarṇaistantubhiḥ kṛtāṃ | dvijottamassyādvijñānī brahmalokamavāpnuyāth || 35.358 || sālagrāmaiśca bahubhirnirmitāṃ mālikāṃ tu yaḥ | arpayeddevadevasya sa viṣṇoryāti sannidhiṃ || 35.359 || lakṣmīḥ priyatamā viṣṇossā hi nityānapāyinī | svasaṃkālpānuviddhā ca śaktissarvātmikā parā || 35.360 || prakṛtermūlabhūtā ca svāminī jagatāṃ satāṃ | lakṣmīpratikṛtiṃ kṛtvā maṇimuktādibhirmunā || 35.361 || ābadhya mālikāyāṃ yo deveśāya samarpayeth | tasya prasannau jāyete daṃpatī jagataḥ patī || 35.362 || mātrāṃ ca devadesya datvā haste viśeṣataḥ | sarvānkāmānavāpnoti carāṃśastarpito hareḥ || 35.363 || madhuparkaṃ harerdadyādbhaktyā prītikaraṃ hareḥ | virajāṃ' barasaṃvītaśśaśāṅkadhavalo mudā || 35.364 || candralokādhipo bhūtvā yāyādviṣṇupadaṃ mahath | havirni vedya devasya pratiṣṭhāphalamaśnute || 35.365 || prabhūtaṃ vinivedyaiva jīrṇoddhāraphalaṃ tathā | pāyasaṃ vinidedyaiva harerbhaktyā viśeṣataḥ || 35.366 || payohradaiśca pitarastṛptimāyānti tasyatu | kṛsaraṃ vinivedyaiva devasya mudito naraḥ || 35.367 || akṣayaṃ pratipadyeta svagṛhe'nnaṃ ciraṃ ciraṃ | gaulyaṃ nivedya devasya prāpnoti guḍaparvatān || 35.368 || mudgānnasya pradānena mudgarāśiṃ samāpnuyāth | yavodanasya donena nīrogo bhavati dhruvaṃ || 35.369 || śuddhānnasya pradānena triśuddhā bhavati prajā | apūpādipradānena manasvī jāyate naraḥ || 35.370 || upadaṃśādidānena nopadaṃśo bhaviṣyati? | sugandhi svādu śuddhaṃ ca pānīyaṃ yo harerdadeth || 35.371 || havirdānaphalasyārdhaṃ phalaṃ samyaksamaśnute | kadalyā nārikelasya cūtasya panasasya ca || 35.372 || phalāni ca nupakvāni bhaktyā śuddhāni yo dadeth | havirdānāccaturbhāgaṃ phalaṃ so'pi samāpnuyāth || 35.373 || karpūrailālavaṅgaiśca tathā jātīphalādibhiḥ | mātuluṅgaphalaiśśuddhaissupakvaiśca yutaṃ tathā || 35.374 || tāṃbūlaṃ kramukairyuktaṃ mukhavāsaṃ ca yo dadeth | sarvaiśvaryamavāpnoti viṣṇulokaṃ ca gacchati || 35.375 || vidhinā balimārādhya kārayedyaḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ | balaṃ balavatāṃ labdhvā viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati || 35.376 || baliṃ seveta yo bhaktyā so'pi yajñaphalaṃ labheth | devasya maṇḍapaṃ kuryādgandhapuṣpaiḥ prapāntuvā || 35.377 || sarvaiśvaryamavāpyaiva nityapuṣpaphalaṃ vrajeth | viṣṇoḥ kathāstu saṃkīrtyastotraiḥ stutvā ca vaiṣṇavaiḥ || 35.378 || śrutvābhaktyā hariṃ dhyāyanviṣṇuloke mahīyate | soṃyānpuṇyānimānviṣṇoścaturo'pyarcanāvidhīn || 35.379 || śrāvayedyo budho bhaktyā tathā yaśśruṇuyādapi | sarvapāpavinirmuktā vaiṣṇavaṃ padamāpnuyuḥ || 35.380 || athotsavādikaraṇe phalaṃ vakṣye madhudviṣaḥ | sakāmānāṃ phalaṃ kāmyamakāmānāṃ paraṃ padaṃ || 35.381 || utsavaṃ tu pravakṣyanti devadevārcanāṃ surāḥ | utsāha utsavaḥ prokto manuṣyāṇāṃ viśeṣetaḥ || 35.382 || udityutkṛṣṭaśabdo'yaṃ savo yajña udāhṛtaḥ | tasmāduttamayajñatvādutsavaḥ paribhāṣyate || 35.383 || vājimedhāstayāgānāṃ tasmāddevotsavo varaḥ | utsavaṃ devadevasya yaḥ kuryātsvakulaṃ svakaṃ || 35.384 || uttārayansvayaṃ viṣṇossa yāti paramaṃ padaṃ | savāduttāraṇaṃ yasmādutsavaḥ parikīrtyate || 35.385 || sa yajño vo narānyuṣmānuttārayati niścayaṃ | iti vedā vadantīti sa utsava udīrya te || 35.386 || vājīmedhasahasreṇa yajato yatphalaṃ bhaveth | yaścotsavena yajate tayostulyaṃ phalaṃ nmṛtaṃ || 35.387 || yāgānāmapi sarveṣāṃ phalamutsavakarmaṇā | devasyāśnuvate sarvaṃ ye yajante saṃśayaḥ || 35.388 || savānutkramate yasmāttasmādutsava uchyate | upakurvanti ye martyā devasyotsavakarmaṇi || 35.389 || karmāṇā manasā vācā te'pi yānti phalaṃ bahu | grāme vā ragare va'pi pattane vā mahotsavaḥ || 35.390 || yatra pravartate viṣṇossaṃpadassanti tatra vai | yatra deśe janapade rāṣṭre vā pyutsavo hareḥ || 35.391 || nāpamṛtyubhayaṃ tatra naināvagrahasaṃbhavaḥ | naiva corādyupahatirna tāpatrayasaṃgatiḥ || 35.392 || dharmaścatuṣpādvarteta kalau tatrādimo yugaḥ | dhārmikaśca bhavedrājā prajā dharmaparāyaṇāḥ || 35.393 || bhavanti sukhinassarve sarvaduḥkhavivarjitāḥ | mahotsave vartamāne yadarthibhyaḥ pradīyate || 35.394 || pānīyamannaṃ vastraṃ vā tatsahasraguṇaṃ bhaveth | puṣpamulaphalairijyā devasyābharaṇādikaiḥ || 35.395 || kriyamāṇā yathāśakti nityānantyāya kalpate | sevante tatra ye devamaharniśamatandritāḥ || 35.396 || teṣāṃ puṇyaphalaṃ vaktuṃ nālaṃ devāssahāsurāḥ | ālepanaṃ mārjanaṃ ca rajaḥ praśamanaṃ tathā || 35.397 || vāribhīrdīpikāropaṃ kṣvelanāsphoṭanādikaṃ | kurvantiye brāhmalokaṃ prayāntyamaradurlabhaṃ || 35.398 || yānaṃ vahanti ye viprāste yānti brahmaṇaḥ padaṃ | rathaṃ vahanti ye cāśvāste'pi yāntisurālayaṃ || 35.399 || chatrādidhāriṇaścāpi modante divi mānavāḥ | ācāryāścārcakāścaiva tathaiva paricārakāḥ || 35.400 || utsave'dhikṛtā viṣṇoḥ prāpnuvanti yathepsitaṃ | ṛco yajūṃṣi sāmāni ye tatrādhīyate janāḥ || 35.401 || te pare vyomni devasya pārśve vartanti nisspṛhāḥ | sarvaśāntikaraṃ sarvaduḥkhotsādanamuttamaṃ || 35.402 || rājño rāṣṭrasya sukhadamāyurārogya vardhanaṃ | prajānāṃ vāsudevasya kalyāṇārādhanaṃ mahath || 35.403 || imaṃ devādayassarve viṣṇorutsavamuttamaṃ | kṛtvā śāśvatikaṃ sthānaṃ prāpnuvantyatidurlabhaṃ || 35.404 || atha vakṣye viśeṣeṇa mahāsnapanajaṃ phalaṃ | yena dravyeṇa deveśaṃ snāpayedyastubhaktitaḥ || 35.405 || taddravyaṃ varthate tasya naśyaṃ tyevāśubhāni tu | rājño rāṣṭrasya taddravyaṃ samṛddhyaiva bhaviṣyati || 35.406 || aśubhāni vinaśyanti śūbhāni prabhavanti ca | nirmāti yaḥprapāṃ viṣṇordevasya nnapanāya vai || 35.407 || tasya nirmīyate gehassvarge svarganivāsibhiḥ | mṛdbhissaṃsnāpanādbhūmissarvasasyānvitā bhaveth || 35.408 || nagaiḥ pradakṣiṇādeva gotrasya sthitirāpyate | dhānyaissaṃsnāpanādviṣṇordhānyānāṃ vṛddhirāpyate || 35.409 || aṅkurairarcanādviṣṇoḥ prajāvṛddhirbhaviṣyati | maṅgalaiḥ pūjanātsarvamaṅgalāni bhavanti vai || 35.410 || snāpanātpañcabhirgavyaiḥ pāpaṃ saśyati sarvadhā | ghṛtena snāpanādbhuyātsāmādhyayanajaṃ phalaṃ || 35.411 || kṣīreṇa snāpayedviṣṇuṃ gāśca kṣīravatīriyāth | madhunā snāpayedviṣṇuṃ madhusyandi bhavedvacaḥ || 35.412 || dadhnā saṃsnāpayeddevamacchaṃ tasya bhavedyaśaḥ | gandhodasnāpanādviṣṇossarvasaṃpadvṛtobhaveth || 35.413 || snāpayedakṣatodaistu prajā tasyākṣatā bhaveth | phalodakasnāpanena śubhānīyātphalāni tu || 35.414 || snāpanāttu kuśodena brahmavarcasamāpnuyāth | ratnodakasnāpanena maṇiratnādi vardhayeth || 35.415 || japyodakasya snānena sarvajāpaphalaṃ labheth | bhavantyoṣadhayassarvāssarvauṣadhyudakāplavāth || 35.416 || puṇyapuṣpārcanenaiva puṇyavānjāyate naraḥ | cūrṇaiśśrīveṣṭakādīnīmarpaṇādvṛddhirāyuṣaḥ || 35.417 || udvartanātkaṣāyeṇa cūrṇenāvāpyate ruciḥ | tīrthodasnāpanenaiva tīrthayātrāphalaṃ bhaveth || 35.418 || vanauṣadhībhissaṃsparśādbhavennityamarogatā | hāridracūrṇasnānena prīto bhavati cācyutaḥ || 35.419 || mārjanātsarvagandhaiśca śrīrbhavatyacalā calā | mārjanānmūlagandhaiśca kulamedheta nityaśaḥ || 35.420 || dhātubhiścāpyalaṅkārāddhātuvṛddhirbhaviṣyati | anyairanuktairvā yastudravyaiḥ snāpanakarmaṇi || 35.421 || upatiṣṭhejjagadyoniṃ phalaṃ prāpnoti vistṛtaṃ | yastu kuryājjaladroṇīṃ snānapīṭhaṃ ca śārṅgiṇaḥ || 35.422 || sa sarvaiḥ pūjyayānantu pīṭhe cātyunna te vaseth | evaṃ yassnapanaṃ viṣṇoḥ kārayecchaktito naraḥ || 35.423 || yathoktānīha labdhvaivaphalāni suciraṃ bhuvi | ante vimāsamāruhya haimaṃ devaiḥ parīvṛtaḥ || 35.424 || kinnarairapsarobhiśca nṛttairgeyaiśca tarpitaḥ | yakṣairvṛto'tha gandharvaistsūyāmāno mudānvitaḥ || 35.425 || sarvalokātparaṃ puṇyaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ lokamāpnuyāth | devadevasya viṣṇostu snapanaṃ bhaktimāṃstu yaḥ || 35.426 || seveta so'pi pāpmabhyo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ | snāpanāntetu deveśasyotsavaṃ yaśca kārayeth || 35.427 || prajāvṛddhiṃ śriyaṃ sphārāṃ samāpnoti viśeṣataḥ | utsavaṃ sevateyastu so'pi yajñaphalaṃ labheth || 35.428 || viṣṇupañcadine yastu deveśaṃ snāpayetprabhuṃ | tasya syānmahatī saṃpatpaśuputrādi sammitā || 35.429 || grahaṇe viṣuve tadvatsaṃkramādiṣu caivahi | anyeṣvapi ca puṇyeṣu kāryeṣu jagataḥ prabhuṃ || 35.430 || snāpayedyaśca seveta phalamāpnoti so'pi saḥ | yaḥ kuryādvaiṣṇavaṃ dhāma bhaktiśraddhāsamanvitaḥ || 35.431 || khaṇḍite sphaṭite dhāmni dūṣite ca sūdhādibhiḥ | samādadhyātpunardhāma sa lokaṃ yāti vaiṣṇavaṃ || 35.432 || corairapahṛte biṃbeyaḥ kuryātpratimāṃ punaḥ | sthāpayedbhakti yuktaśca sa yāti paramāṃ gatiṃ || 35.433 || pramādātpatite biṃbe sphuṭate dūṣite'tha vā | yaḥ sandhāya punaḥ kuryātpritiṣṭhāṃ pūrvavanmudā || 35.434 || tasya taṣyati deveśo varamiṣṭaṃ pradāsyati | śīrṇe jīrṇe tathā bhinne bhūṣaṇādau viśeṣataḥ || 35.435 || navīkṛtyār'payedyastu tasya pāpaṃ praṇaśyati | yānāni rathaṅgādīnyālokya śithilāni vai || 35.436 || samīkṛtya tu yodadyāttāni bhaktyā harennaraḥ | tasya kāyakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tatkṣaṇādeva naśyati || 35.437 || yastu vīkṣya harerarcāṃ patamānāmanādarāth | nardhayeddhanadānena tasya lokā madhudviṣaḥ || 35.438 || sīdatāṃ vṛttihīnānāṃ devasyāghre padārthināṃ | yo dadyāducitāṃ vṛttiṃ sa yamaṃ nopasarpati || 35.439 || yastu devotsavādīni kārayedbhaktisaṃyutaḥ | luptaprāyāṇi tasyā''pi bhavetphalamana ntakaṃ || 35.440 || yaḥ kuryāddevatāgāre luptakāryāṇi sattamaḥ | na tasya kṛtakṛtyatvādamātyā yamakiṅkarāḥ || 35.441 || devārdhe brāhmaṇasyār'the yastyajettanumuttamāṃ | tasya vāso bhavetsvarge cāvadidrāśca turdhaśa || 35.442 || devārthe brāhmaṇasyār'dhe sarvasvaṃ svantyajettu yaḥ | tasya tuṣyati deveśassa tu svārājyamaśnu te || 35.443 || prāyaścittanimittāni saṃbhūtānitu dhāmani | dṛṣṭvā ca śraddhayā yuktoyo devamupatiṣṭhate || 35.444 || tasya tuṣyati deveśaḥ pra hṛṣṭassaṃprasīdati | prāyaścittānyaśeṣāṇi pāpaughadhvaṃsanāya vai || 35.445 || nirdiṣṭāni purākalpe brahmaṇā parameṣṭhinā | lokānugrahaletorvai pavṛtto gururatvaraḥ || 35.446 || narāṇāṃ sīdatāṃ dṛṣṭvā cittavṛttīssudurmalāḥ | prāyaścittavidhānaṃ tu provāca jagatāṃ hitaḥ || 35.447 || na kaścinnācaretkarma śāstroktaṃ sakalaṃ kramāth | tasmātsarvaprayatnena prāyaścittaṃ samācareth || 35.448 || prāyaścittaṃ tu kṛtvaiva ya uktāmācaretkriyāṃ | tasya syāddviguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ matassyādanupālanaṃ || 35.449 || bhaktiśraddhānvito yastu kuryādvā kārayetkramāth | deveśasya pratiṣṭhādi prāyaścittānta satkriyāḥ || 35.450 || tasya puṇyaphalaṃ vaktuṃ na śakyaṃ tridaśairapi | iha loke'khilānkāmānanubhūya sukhaṃ cirāth || 35.451 || dehantejāyate sadyaśśaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ | śrīvatsāṃkaścaturbāhuśśyāmalāṅgassu sundaraḥ || 35.452 || gagane garuḍārūḍhassarva devanamaskṛtaḥ | adityamaṇḍalaṃ bhitvā gatvā śubhrāṃśumaṇḍalaṃ || 35.453 || tato'vatīrya nikhilānlokānapi yathākramaṃ | satyasthaṃ satyarokasthaṃ jagataḥ prabhavāpyayaṃ || 35.454 || tathāśeṣaviśeṣaṃ ca nityānandaṃ nirañjanaṃ | sudhārasasamāsvādatulitaṃ nityatṛptidaṃ || 35.455 || śāśvataṃ tatparañjyotiḥ praviśennātra saṃśayaḥ | atha vakṣye viśeṣeṇa kriyālope ca yatphalaṃ || 35.456 || nirmātumālayaṃ yastu saṃkalpya matimānnaraḥ | pareṇedbodhito bhūyastasmā darthānni vartate || 35.457 || tāvubhau narakaṃ pretya bhavetāṃ duḥkhabhāginau | kartā kārayitā caiva prerakaścānumodakaḥ || 35.458 || sukṛte duṣkṛte caiva vadanti samabhāginaḥ | nirmātumicchayā dhāma devasya madhuvidviṣaḥ || 35.459 || svayaṃ nivartate yastu tasya syānmahatī vipath | saṃkalpya devatāgāraṃ nirmātuṃ yo viśeṣataḥ || 35.460 || ācāryaṃ vṛṇuyānno cettasya kāryaṃ praṇaśyati | ācāryassatataṃ goptā ācāryastu pitā smṛtaḥ || 35.461 || ācāryassarvameveti yo manyeta sa manyate | ārabhya gehanirmāṇaṃ devasya jagataḥ pateḥ || 35.462 || asamāpya tu yo mūḍho nivarte pravilobhataḥ | tasya saṃpadvināśassyātkruddho bhavati cāvyayaḥ || 35.463 || pravṛttāyāṃ pratiṣṭhāyāṃ yena kenāpi hetunā | yaḥ kuryādantarāyaṃ tu tasya puṇyaṃ vinaśyati || 35.464 || yena vighnastadā bhūyāttaṃ hatvāpi na doṣabhāk | yastu śāstroditaṃ karma kurvantaṃ ca padārthinaṃ || 35.465 || śilpinaṃ vivadenmūḍhastasya nāstiphalaṃ kvacith | vivadeta ya ucchāstramācāryeṇa padārthinā || 35.466 || tasyāśubhāni bhūyāṃsi bhaveyurnātra saṃśayaḥ | adhvare vartamāne tu saṃbhārānśāstracoditān || 35.467 || yo na dadyātsa pāpīyānnāpnuyātkarmajaṃ phalaṃ | pratiṣṭhāpya harerbiṃbaṃ yo na satkurute guruṃ || 35.468 || anyānpadārthinaścāpi sa kiñcinnāpnuyātphalaṃ | pratiṣṭhānte tathā nityamavicchinnaṃ tu pūjituṃ || 35.469 || arcakaṃ vṛṇuyānno cedyajamāno vinaśyati | arcakaṃ ca tathācāryamanyāṃścāpi padārthinaḥ || 35.470 || kālāvadhiṃ viniścitya yaḥ karmasu niyojayeth | sa bhavedbrahmahā caiva dhanaṃ tasya vilupyati || 35.471 || dāyarhāṃ kāyedvrattimarcakasya na cedyadi | yajamāno vipadyeta devāvāso naśiṣyati || 35.472 || ācāryamarcakaṃ kuryātsvasthānādyo'varopitaṃ | anyaṃ vā yojayettatra tāvubhau vinaśiṣyataḥ || 35.473 || āpadyapi ca kaṣṭhāyāṃ na kadāpyanyamarcakaṃ | pūrvāvaropaṇādeva niyuñjyāttu kathaṃ cana || 35.474 || ādyārcakasya vaṃśetu jāyante ye mahāśayāḥ | sarve ca kramaśaḥ pūjāṃ kartumarhanti te yataḥ || 35.475 || pitryaṃ bhavati devasya dāyādyaṃ pūjanaṃ svataḥ | tasmāttadvaṃśajānhitvā yadyanyaiḥ kāritār'canā || 35.476 || brahmahatyābhavettasya tatbūjā niṣphalā bhaveth | yastudadyādarcakāya bhṛtyarthaṃ ke valaṃ dhanaṃ || 35.477 || anyadvāpyasthiraṃ vastu na haristena tuṣyati | lobhānmohādathājñānādya ādatter'cako dhanaṃ || 35.478 || vetanārdhaṃ tathā dadyādyajamāno vimūḍhadhīḥ | ubhautaunarakaṃ yāto yādaccandra divākaraṃ || 35.479 || vittārthaṃ pūjayedyastu niyamyāpyavadhiṃ hariṃ | savaidevalako nāma sarvakarma bahirkṛtaḥ || 35.480 || adatvā vasudhāmagre pūjanārtha mathārcake | nirmāti brāhmaṇaṃ bhūyo yajamānastu devalaṃ || 35.481 || nahyasmātpātakaṃ kiñci dbrāhmaṇāyā'parādhyati | alabdhvādevatāgāranirmāṇasadṛśaṃ phalaṃ || 35.482 || brahmaghnatvamanuprāpya vinaśyati na saṃśayaḥ | hartā hārayitā bhūmerdattasya danuśāsinaḥ || 35.483 || tatkiṅkarāṇāmanyeṣāṃ yo mūḍhassa tamovṛtaḥ | saṃbaddho vāruṇaiḥ pāśaiḥ kṛṣyamāṇassamantataḥ || 35.484 || duḥkhito narake bhūyastiryagyoniṣu jāyate | svadattāṃ varadattāṃ vā yo hareta vasundharāṃ || 35.485 || ṣaṣṭirvarṣasahasrāṇi viṣṭhāyāṃ jāyate kṛmiḥ | svadattāddviguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ paradattānu pālanaṃ || 35.486 || paradattāpahāreṇa svadattaṃ niṣpalaṃ bhaveth | anyāyena hṛtā bhūmiranyāyenaina hāritā || 35.487 || harato hārakasyāpi dahatyāsaptamaṃ kulaṃ | pañca kanyānṛte hanti daśa hanti gavānṛte || 35.488 || śatamaśvānṛte hanti sahasraṃ puruṣānṛte | hanti jātānajātāṃśca hiraṇyār'dhe'nṛtaṃ vadan || 35.489 || sarvaṃ bhūmyanṛte hanti no brūyādanṛtaṃ kvacith | vindhyāṭavīṣvatoyāsu śuṣkakojaravāsinaḥ || 35.490 || kṛṣṇasarpāḥ prajāyante devabrahmasvahāriṇaḥ | taṭākānāṃ sahasreṇa hayamedhaśatena ca || 35.491 || gavāṃ koṭipradānena bhūmihartāna śuddhyati | brahmasvaṃ brahmahatyā ca daridrasya ca yaddhanaṃ || 35.492 || gurumitradhanaṃ caiva svargasthamapi pātayeth | brahmasve no matiṃ kuryātprāṇaiḥ kaṇṭhagatairapi || 35.493 || agnidagdhāḥ prarohānti brahmadagdho na rohati | na viṣaṃ viṣamityāhurbrahmasvaṃ viṣamucyate || 35.494 || viṣamekākinaṃ hanti brahmasvaṃ putrapautrakaṃ | brahmasvaṃ praṇayādbhuktaṃ dahatyāsaptamaṃ kulaṃ || 35.495 || vikrameṇa tu bhoktṝṇāṃ daśapūrvāndaśāvarān | lohacūrṇāṃśca cūrṇāṃśca viṣaṃ vā jarayetpumān || 35.496 || brahmasvaṃ triṣu lokeṣu kaḥpumānjarayiṣyati | devasvaṃ brāhmaṇasvaṃ ca lobheno pahinasti yaḥ || 35.497 || sa pāpāttu pareloke gṛdhrocchiṣṭena jīvati | devadravyavināśena brahmasvaharaṇena ca || 35.498 || kulānyakulatāṃ yānti brāhmaṇātikrameṇa ca | sahasrasammitā dhenuranaḍvāndaśadhenavaḥ || 35.499 || daśāvaḍvatsamaṃ yānaṃ daśayānasamo hayaḥ | daśavājisamā kanyā bhūmidānena sā samā || 35.500 || ṣaṣṭirvarṣa sahasrāṇi svarge tiṣṭhati bhūmidhaḥ | ācchettācānumantā ca tānyena narake vaseth || 35.501 || patantyaśrūṇi rudatāṃ dīnānāmavasīdatāṃ | brāhmaṇānāṃ hṛte kṣetre hanyādāsaptamaṃ kulaṃ || 35.502 || sādhubhyo bhūmimākṣipya na bhūmiṃ vindatekvacith | dadaddhi bhūmiṃ sādhubhyo vindate phūmimuttamāṃ || 35.503 || arcakaḥ praṇidhiryasmāddeveśasya jagatpateḥ | sa devo brāhmaṇassādhurmahadbhūtaṃ pracakṣate || 35.504 || tasmāttadarpitāṃ vṛttiṃ naiva śaṅketa buddhimān | tadarcakārpitāṃ bhūmiṃ yo hareta yateta vā || 35.505 || kiṃ punastasya vaktavyaṃ na bhavettasya niṣkṛtiḥ | na vācā śakyate vaktuṃ gatistasya durātmanaḥ || 35.506 || mriyeta sadya evāsau jāyate'tha punaḥ punaḥ | na tasya śaraṇaṃ kvāpi labhyate pāpakarmaṇaḥ || 35.507 || devasye'pi matiṃ kuryātprahmasvaṃ na haretkvacith | prāsādamaṇḍapādīnāṃ bhoktāraḥ kaiṭabhadviṣaḥ || 35.508 || temūḍhamatayaḥ pretya narakeṣu niratyayāḥ | vasanti bhūyo jāyante nīcayoniṣu ca dhruvaṃ || 35.509 ||
