bhūṣaṇacchatravastrādihartā yo durmatirnaraḥ | gale nigalitaḥ pāśaiḥ kṛṣyate nirayeṣu saḥ || 35.510 || vāhanāni ca yānāni vaiṣṇavāni harantiye | mohādvasanti te dīrgha maṅgāranarakodare || 35.511 || pretya bhūyo'pi jāyante gardabhoṣṭrādiyoniṣu | candanādīni vastūni puṣpāṇi surabhīṇyapi || 35.512 || vrajanti svāni viṣṇoste vrajante yāmyayātanām? | anubhūya punarbhūyo jāyante gandhamūṣikāḥ || 35.513 || upānatpādukāpīṭhavāhanāni harantiye | uṣitvā narakeṣvete jāyante phaṇināṃ kule || 35.514 || gobhūhiraṇyavastrādi dhanaṃ viṣṇoḥ parigrahaṃ | āhṛtya ye'nubhuñjante narakeṣu duratyayāḥ || 35.515 || uṣitvā pretya bhūyo'pi jāyante śvādiyoniṣu | sarveṣu narakeṣvevaṃ devabrahmasvahāriṇaḥ || 35.516 || nasanti mūḍhamatayo yāmyaduḥkheṣu yātanāḥ | vāsudevapratikṛterbhedanacchedanādiṣu || 35.517 || vikrīḍādīniyānyeṣu yatante pāpacetasaḥ | ete yānti kramātsarvāsnarakānbhṛśadāruṇān || 35.518 || anyeṣvapyapacāreṣu sthūlasūkṣmeṣu mānavāḥ | kṛtinaḥ pretya narake pacyante duḥkhabhāginaḥ || 35.519 || athanityārcanāyāṃ vai deveśasya viśeṣataḥ | upacārādihāno tu pāpasyedaṃ phalaṃ bhaveth || 35.520 || āsanasya vihīne tu dharmanāśo bhaviṣyati | svāgate buddhināśassyānmūkatvamanumānake || 35.521 || vihīne pādukāyāstu paṅgutvaṃ saṃbhavatyuta | pādyahīne mahānrogaḥ kleśaścāpi bhaviṣyati || 35.522 || danta dhāvanahīne ca duṣṭadanto'bhijāyate | tāṃbūlahīne vidveṣaṃ kuṣṭaṃ tailavihīnake || 35.523 || keśasaṃśodhane hīne galarogo bhaviṣyati | snānadravyavihīne ca snānahīne tathaiva ca || 35.524 || rājayakṣmā bhavedrogaḥ pāpiṣṭhaśca sudāruṇaḥ | plotahīne vātarogo vastrahīne jalodaraḥ || 35.525 || saṃvyānahīne hṛdrogo yajñasūtravihīnake | agnidāhabhayaṃ caiva mandāgnitvaṃ ca jāyate || 35.526 || gandhahīne ca kuṣṭhassyādbhūṣāhīne mahadbhayaṃ | puṣpahīne tvalābhassyāttathā ca kaphasaṃbhavaḥ || 35.527 || (śūdrāhṛtaiḥ krayakrītairarcanaṃ niṣphalaṃ sumaiḥ | araṇyādvāgṛhādvāpi vikrītānyāpaṇāntarāth || 35.528 || ayācitāni puṣpāṇi labdhānyarhāṇi nār'cane | tathā paryuṣitairyāpi jantubhirdūṣitairapi || 35.529 || mlānairaspṛśyasaṃspṛṣṭairdurgandhaiḥ pādalaṅghitaiḥ | pratilomāntyajānītairarcanaṃ tvaphalaṃ bhaveth || 35.530 || uttamaṃ svārjitaṃ puṣpaṃ madhyamaṃ vanyamucyate | adhamaṃ tu krayakrītaṃ pārakyamadhamādhamaṃ || 35.531 || hastānītaṃ paṭānītaṃ svayaṃ patitameva vā | anyārāmodbhavaṃ puṣpaṃ nār'payediti ke cana || 35.532 || ārahare ca śukre ca manvādiṣu yugādiṣu | nāharettulasīpatraṃ madhyāhnātparatastathā || 35.533 || saṃkrāntyāṃ pakṣayorante dvādaśyorniśi saṃdhyayoḥ | tulasīṃ ye vicinvanti te kṛntanti hareśśiraḥ || 35.534 || bhṛgvarkāṃgārake vāre dvādaśyāṃ pañcaparvasu | nāharettulasīpatraṃ nandāyāṃ śravaṇe'pi ca || 35.535 || keśakīṭāpaviddhāni śīrṇaparyuṣitāni ca | bhugnapatraṃ na ca grāhyaṃ kṛmiduṣṭaṃ ca nāhareth || 35.536 || varjayedūrṇanābhena vāsitaṃ yadi śobhanaṃ | sthalajaṃ noddharetpuṣpaṃ chedayejjalajaṃ na tu || 35.537 || niṣiddhairduḥkhadairdevaṃ nār'cayeta kadā cana | na śuṣkaiḥpūjayeddevaṃ kunumairna mahīgataiḥ || 35.538 || na viśīrṇataraiśśiṣṭairnāśubhairnāvikāsibhiḥ | pūtigandhograndhāni hyugragandhāni varjayeth || 35.539 || snānaṃ kṛtvā tu ye ke citpuṣpaṃ gṛhṇanti vaidvijāḥ | devatāstanna gṛhṇantitanna gṛhṇanti mānavāḥ || 35.540 || pitarastanna gṛhṇanti bhasmībhavati kāṣṭhavath | snānaṃ kṛtvātu madhyāhne puṣpāṇi na samāhareth || 35.541 || tebhyaḥkruddho'kṣayaṃ duḥkhaṃ krodhādviṣṇuḥ prayacchati | anyadevār'thasandiṣṭaiḥ pūjayedyo hariṃ prabhuṃ || 35.542 || sa tu tenaiva pāpena maṇḍūko jāyate naraḥ | tatassa narakaṃ yāti yāvadābhūtasaṃplavaṃ || 35.543 || kusumānāṃ nivedyānāṃ gandhamāghrāti yo naraḥ | sa pūti gandhasaṃyuktaḥ kuṣṭhī caiva prajāyate || 35.544 || janmadvayaṃ tu vai mūḍhaśśūdratāṃ yāti mānavaḥ | asūtragrathitaṃ puṣpamasnehāktaṃ tathodanaṃ || 35.545 || avālukāyutaṃ toyaṃ sarvaṃ paryuṣitaṃ bhaveth | etaistu pūjanātsadyo niṣphalāssakalāḥ kriyāḥ || 35.546 || ādarśanavihīne tu kāmilā ca bhaviṣyati | bādhiryaṃ dhūpahīne ca dīpahīne'ndhatāmiyāth || 35.547 || arghyahīne tu devasya kulaṃ bhavati ninditaṃ | madhuparkavihīne ca madhumeho bhaviṣyati || 35.548 || mātrādānavihīne tu sarvanāśo bhaviṣyati | rakṣānīrājane hīne rāṅgasair āvṛtirbhaveth || 35.549 || vedādhyayanahīne tu karmalopo bhaveddhruvaṃ | havirnivedane hīne durbhikṣaṃ bhavati dhruvaṃ || 35.550 || upadaṃśavihīne ca dāridṣaṃ grāmavāsināṃ | nālikeraphale hīne hīne kṣīrādike tathā || 35.551 || vināśassarvasasyānāṃ durbhikṣaṃ ca bhavedhdhruvaṃ | hīne bhakṣyādike caiva vividhe haviṣī prabho || 35.552 || tadgrāmayajamānasya viśeṣeṇāśubhaṃ bhaveth | viniyogakramasyātrahīne pūjaiva naśyati || 35.553 || kāle yavanikāhīne kartā caiva vinaśyati | dvārapūjāvihīne tu taska rādipraveśanaṃ || 35.554 || dvārapālakapūjāyo hīne caurādyupadravaḥ | śāntasya pūjane hīne tathā caivānapāyināṃ || 35.555 || rājño rāṣṭrasya sarvasya vināśassyānna saṃśayaḥ | yajamānasya tatrāpi pararājādyupadravaḥ || 35.556 || pāparogādipīḍā ca bhaviṣyati tathā punaḥ, | sarpavṛścikalūtādyairhāniścaiva bhavedbahu || 35.557 || puṣpanyāser'canehīne nyūne vā mantravarjite, | tadgrāmavāsināṃ caiva rājadveṣo bhaviṣyati || 35.558 || bhūtapīṭhasya pārśve vā dakṣiṇe vā viśeṣataḥ, | bhūtādināgaparyantaṃ balyarcanavihīnake || 35.559 || śākinyādigrahāssarve praviśanti na saṃśayaḥ | śrīdevyā arcane hīne saṃpadāṃ tu bhavetkṣayaḥ || 35.560 || hariṇyarcanahīne ca sthānanāśo bhaviṣyati, | agnipūjāvihīne tu nyūne vā mantravarjite || 35.561 || nivedanājyahīne vā saṃbhavedvarṇasaṃkaraḥ, | varṇāśramādihāniśca brāhmaṇānāṃ vipadbhaveth || 35.562 || pānīyahīne devasya bhavettatra tvavagrahaḥ, | mukhavāsavihīne tu janavidveṣaṇaṃ bhaveth || 35.563 || balidravyavihīne tu nyūne mantravivarjite | balakṣayo janānāṃ syātpitṝṇāṃ patanaṃ bhaveth || 35.564 || puṣpāṃjalivihīne tu rājakopā bhaviṣyati, | praṇāmastutihīne tu sadyo mṛtyurbhaviṣyati, || 35.565 || dhyānahīne kulaṃ hanti nyāsahīne vipadbhaveth | prāṇāyāmavihīne tu paracakrabhayaṃ bhaveth || 35.566 || śaucācāravihīne tu paśuputrādināśanaṃ | biṃbanyāsavihīne tu kalatraṃ tasya naśyati || 35.567 || pradakṣiṇavihīne tu pātakī jāyate naraḥ | nityamarcāvasānetu pūjakācāryayormude || 35.568 || dakṣiṇādānahīne tu sā pūjā niṣphalā bhaveth | rāṣṭrasya yajamānasya rājñaścāpi bhavedbhayaṃ || 35.569 || hīne tu pācakādīnāṃ dakṣiṇādānakarmaṇi | paśuvāhananāśaśca tadgrāme saṃbhavennṛṇāṃ || 35.570 || prātaḥ pūjāvihīne tu tadgrāme'vagraho bhaveth | brāhmaṇānāṃ kriyāhānissarvakarmavināśanaṃ || 35.571 || madhyāhnapūjāhīne tu rāṣṭrakṣobho bhaviṣyati | sāyaṅkālār'cane hīne tadgrāmayajamānayoḥ || 35.572 || arthahāniḥ prajāhānirbhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ | upasaṃdhyārcane hīne karmalopo bhaviṣyati || 35.573 || viṣṇupañcadine caiva hīne snāner'cane tathā | utsave ca viśeṣaṇa yajamānabhayaṃ bhaveth || 35.574 || māsapūjāvihīnetu bhrātṛdveṣo bhaviṣyati | viṣude cāyane caiva hīne tatroktakarmaṇi || 35.575 || grāmasya yajamānasya yaśohānirbhaviṣyati | snapanokte tathānyasmindivase snānavarjite || 35.576 || akāle ca kṛte vāpi bhavetkṣāmabhayaṃ tathā | nityotsavavihīne tu nirānando bhavejjanaḥ || 35.577 || anyasminnarcanadravye vihīne doṣa āpateth | nimitte yadi saṃprāpte snāpayeccenna mādhavaṃ || 35.578 || tasya pāpaphalaṃ naktuṃ na kenāpi hi śakyate | rājño rāṣṭrasya ca bhavetsarvatrātyāhitaṃ dhruvaṃ || 35.579 || gṛhanāśaḥ prapāhīne hīnāyāṃ cāpyalaṅkṛtau | mṛtsuhīnānu nāśassyātsasyānāṃ tu na saṃśayaḥ || 35.580 || parvateṣu vihīneṣu sthairyaṃ tasya vilupyate | dhānyeṣu tu vihīneṣu dyānyanāśo bhavettathā || 35.581 || aṅkurāṇāmabhāve tu prajāhāniśca saṃbhaveth | maṅgaleṣvatha hīneṣu tasya bhūyādamaṅgalaṃ || 35.582 || pañcagavyavihīne tu gohatyā samavāpyate | ghṛtahīne buddhināśo'nāyuṣyaṃ kṣīrahīnake || 35.583 || madhuhīne mahānvyādhirdadhihīne tu saṃjvaraḥ | kṣīrahīne bhavettasya malinā kīrtireva hi || 35.584 || gandhodakavihīne tu durgandho jāyate bhṛśaṃ | akṣatodakahīne tu kṣatistasya prajāyate || 35.585 || phalodakavihīne tu viphalaṃ tasya jīvitaṃ | kuśodakavihīne ca naidheta brahmavarcasaṃ || 35.586 || ratnodakavihīne ca dhanadhyānya vināśanaṃ | abhāve cauṣadhīnāntu vyādhipīḍā bhaviṣyati || 35.587 || upasnānavihīne tu malinaṃ jāyate kulaṃ | uṣṇāṃbhasāmabhove tu bhaveduṣṇaśarīratā || 35.588 || puṇyapuṣpavihine tu pāpīyānjāyate naraḥ | jātīphalādicūrṇasya cābhāve tu vipadbhaveth || 35.589 || kaṣāyacūrṇahīne tu kāntihīno bhavennaraḥ | vanauṣadhīnāṃ cālābhe rogī bhavati niścayaḥ || 35.590 || hāridracūrṇahīne tu gataśrīrjāyate naraḥ | mūlagandhavihīne tu vārdhakyaṃ bhavati dhravaṃ || 35.591 || dhātūnāmapyabhāvetu sirdhāturjāyate naraḥ | plotavastrottarīyāṇāṃ bhūṣaṇānāṃ vihīnake || 35.592 || karmanāśo bhavedeva na tuṣṭati ramāpatiḥ | ācāryasyartvijāṃ tadvadanyeṣāṃ ca padārthināṃ || 35.593 || dakṣiṇādānahīne ca sarvanāśo bhaviṣyati | hīne haviṣi devasya niṣphalaṃ snapanaṃ bhaveth || 35.594 || snapanāntotsave hīne na devaḥparituṣyati | śithilaṃ bhagavadgehaṃ dṛṣṭyā śrutvā ca yonaraḥ || 35.595 || tatkriyā lopitā vāpi sa bhaveddevahā dhruvaṃ | tadgrāmavāsinassarve rājā cānyodhanī punaḥ || 35.596 || śīghraṃ sarvaṃ samīkṛtya pūrvavatpunarācareth | anyathā yadi kuryācchedrājarāṣṭraṃ vinaśyati || 35.597 || dharmasetumimaṃ vindyātsarvasādhāraṇaṃ naraḥ | pālanīyassadā so'yaṃ jagatāṃ yatra saṃsthitiḥ || 35.598 || prāyaścittanimittetu saṃprāpte yastu mūḍhadhīḥ | akṛtvā niṣkṛtiṃ kuryātkārayetkarma cottaraṃ || 35.599 || lobhānmohadathājñānādanādṛtya ca śāsanaṃ | bhagavacchāsanadrohī sa bhavetpātakī janaḥ || 35.600 || pramādināṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ skhalanaṃ niyataṃ yataḥ | niṣkṛtirvihitā pūrvairnatāmaticaretkvacith || 35.601 || brahmādyairapi yaddevairaśakyaṃ pūjanaṃ hareḥ | taduktā niṣkṛtiḥ pūrvairnatāmatipatetkvacith || 35.602 || nimitte yastvakṛtvaiva prāyaścittaṃ yathocitaṃ | nnityaṃ naimittikaṃ kāmyaṃ kuryāttadakṛtaṃ bhaveth || 35.603 || tasmānnimitte saṃprāpte niṣkṛtiṃ sadya ācareth | iti saṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ kriyāyogāśritaṃ phalaṃ || 35.604 || iti śrīvaikhānase bhagavacchāstre bhṛguproktāyāṃ sahitāyāṃ prakīrṇādhikāre pañcatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ <36> athaṣaṭtriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ apacārāḥ apacārāstathā viṣṇordvātriṃśatparikīrtitāḥ | yānairvā pādukairvāpi gamanaṃ bhagavadgṛhe || 36.1 || devotsavādyasevācāpraṇāmaṃ ca tadagrataḥ | ekahastapraṇāmaśca tatpurastātpradakṣiṇaṃ || 36.2 || ucchiṣṭe caiva cāśauce bhagavadvandanādikaṃ | pādaprasāraṇaṃ cāgre tathā paryaṅkabandhanaṃ || 36.3 || śayanaṃ bhojanaṃ caiva mudhābhāṣaṇameva ca | uccairbhāṣā vṛdhājalpo rodanādyaṃ ca vigrahaḥ || 36.4 || nigraho'nugrahaścaiva strīṣu sākūtabhāṣaṇaṃ | aślīlakathanaṃ caivāpyadhovāyuvimokṣaṇaṃ || 36.5 || kaṃbalāvaraṇaṃ caiva varanindā parastutiḥ | śaktau gauṇopacāraścāpyaniveditabhakṣaṇaṃ || 36.6 || tattatkālodbhavānāṃ ca phalādīnāmanarpaṇaṃ | viniyuktāvaśiṣṭasya pradānaṃ vyañjanādiṣu || 36.7 || pṛṣṭhīkṛtyāsanaṃ caiva pareṣāmabhivandanaṃ | guroṃaunaṃ nijastotraṃ devatānindanaṃ tathā || 36.8 || apacārāṃ stu vividhānīdṛśānparivarjayeth | apacāreṣvananteṣu satsvanyeṣu pramādataḥ || 36.9 || "kṣama''svetyarthanaivaigā niṣkṛtirnirupadravā | anyathā yadi kurvāṇaḥpramādātjñānato'thavā || 36.10 || sa yāti narakānghorānsantataṃ bhṛśadāruṇān | yetu smaraṇamātreṇa bhavanti hṛdayacchidaḥ || 36.11 || dvātriṃśannarakāḥ dvātriṃśannarakāste tu kīrtyantebrahmavādibhiḥ | rauravadhvāntaśītoṣṇatāpāṃbujamahāṃbujāḥ || 36.12 || kālasūtro'ṣṭamo hyete narakā iti viśrutāḥ | sūcyagrakālakhaḍgāśca kṣuradhārāṃcabarīṣakāḥ || 36.13 || taptāṃgāramahādāhau saṃtāpaśceti ke cana | bhavantyaṣṭāsu bhībhatkā mahāśabdā bhayānakāḥ || 36.14 || lakṣāpralepamāṃsādanirucchvasanasocchvasāḥ | yugmādriśālmalīlohapradīpakṣutpipāsikāḥ || 36.15 || kṛmīṇāṃ nicayaścaiva rājānaḥ parikīrtitāḥ | lohastambho'tha viṇmūtre tathā vaitaraṇī nadī || 36.16 || tāmisraścāndhatāmisraḥ kumbhīpāko'tha rauravaḥ | mahāpadānugāmī ca rājarājeśvarāhvayaḥ || 36.17 || trayastrīṃśatpuṭeṣvardhaṃ pārthivaṃ cārdhamāyasaṃ | tanmadhye narakā ghorā bahuśastamasi sthitāḥ || 36.18 || teṣāṃ narakabhedānāmaṣṭāviṃśatikoṭayaḥ | eteṣāṃ dāruṇānāṃ tu narakāṇāṃ patisthsitaḥ || 36.19 || kūśmāṇḍa iti vikhyātaḥ pralayārkālanadyutiḥ | karālavadanaḥ kruddho vṛttakoṭaralocanaḥ || 36.20 || ṭaṅkapāṇistathābhūtairbhūtairbhūyobhirāvṛtaḥ | pāpāstveteṣu pacyantenarāḥ karmānurūpataḥ || 36.21 || yātanābhirvicitrābhirāpāpaprakṣayāntakaṃ | prāyaścittojghitā dṛptānijadharmaparāṅmukhāḥ || 36.22 || paradharmaratāścorāḥ patanti narakāgniṣu | mahāpātakinaḥkalpaṃ tiṣṭhanti narakāgniṣu || 36.23 || manvantaraṃ pātakino devabrahmasvahāriṇaḥ | upapātakino martyā devadevāgniyajvanāṃ || 36.24 || dvijagogurudharmāṇāṃ nindakā brahmaṇo dinaṃ | anye caturyugaṃ martyāstadardhaṃ ca narādhamāḥ || 36.25 || tiṣṭhanti narake ghore nijapāpānurūpyataḥ | dyūtastrīviṣayāsaktā ye dharmavikalāḥkhalāḥ || 36.26 || patanti teṣu ghoreṣu narakeṣu narādhamāḥ | na śruṇvanti ca ye mūḍhāssādhūktaṃ dharmagauravaṃ || 36.27 || "pyatyakṣaṃ kena taddṛṣṭaṃ pratyu''teti vadanti ca | kāmalobhābhibhūtāśca biḍālavratinastathā || 36.28 || pāpiṣṭhāḥ karmahīnāśca jihvopasthaparāyaṇāḥ | yatinindāparā ye ca kṣetratīrthādidūṣakāḥ || 36.29 || patanti teṣu te martyāvivaśāḥ pāpabandhanāḥ | ihānubhūyanirdiṣṭamāyurmartyāssvayaṃbhuvā || 36.30 || nimittaṃ kiñcidāsādya vimucyantekalevaraiḥ | labhante te punardebaṃ yātanīyaṃ svakarmajaṃ || 36.31 || tanmātraguṇasaṃpannaṃ sukhaduḥkhopabhogadaṃ | pāpāḥ pāpakṣayo yāvatpacyante narakāgniṣu || 36.32 || āmalaprakṣayādvahnau dhmāyantedhātavo yathā | yāvantojantavassvargabhūpātāleṣu sarvataḥ || 36.33 || tāvanta eva ghoreṣu santyadho narakāgniṣu | aṣṭāviṃśatirevoktāḥ kṣiternarakakoṭayaḥ || 36.34 || saptamasya talasyādho ghoretamasi saṃsthitāḥ | ghorākhyā pradhamākoṭissu ghoratalasaṃsthitāḥ || 36.35 || atighorā mahāghorā ghoraghorā ca pañcamī | ṣaṣṭhī taralatārākhyā saptamī ca bhayāvahā || 36.36 || aṣṭamī kālarātrī ca navamī ca bhayotkaṭā | daśamī tadadhaścaṇṇā mahācaṇḍā tato'pyadhaḥ || 36.37 || caṇḍakolāhalācānyā pracaṇḍānarakādhikā | padmāpadmavatī bhīmā bhīmabhīṣaṇanāyakā || 36.38 || karālā vikarālā ca vajrā viṃśatikāsmṛtā | trikoṇā pañcakoṇā ca sudīrghā parivartulā || 36.39 || saptabhoṃāṣṭabhoṃā ca dīptāyāmeti cāṣṭamī | ityetā nāmataḥ proktā ghorā narakakoṭayaḥ || 36.40 || aṣṭāviṃśatirevaitāḥ pāpānāṃ yātanātmanāṃ | tāsāṃ krameṇa vijñeyāḥ pañca pañcaikanāyakāḥ || 36.41 || pratyekaṃ sarvakoṭīnāṃ nāmatastānnibodhata | rauravaḥ prathamasteṣāṃ rudante yatra dehinaḥ || 36.42 || mahārauravako yatra mahānto'pi rudantica | tamaśśītaṃ yathā coṣṇaṃ pañcādyā nāyakāssmṛtāḥ || 36.43 || sughorassutapastīkṣṇaḥ padmassaṃ jīvanaśśataḥ | mahāmāṃso vilomaśca subhīmaśca kaṭaṅkaṭaḥ || 36.44 || tīvraveṣī karālaśca vikarālaḥ prakampanaḥ | mahāpadmassupadmaśca kālavakraśca garjanaḥ || 36.45 || sūcīmukhassunemiśca khādakassuprapīḍanaḥ | kuṃbhīpākassupākaśca cakrakaścātidāruṇaḥ || 36.46 || aṅgārarāśiphavanamasṛkpūyacahadrastathā | tīkṣṇāyastuṇḍaśakunirmahāsaṃvartakastatā || 36.47 || sutaptābjassulopaśca pūtimāṃso dravatrapu | ucchvāsaśca nirucchvāso sudīrghaḥ kūṭaśālmalī || 36.48 || darīṣṭassumahānādaprabhāvassuprabhāvanaḥ | ṛkṣameṣavṛkāśśalya siṃhavyāghragajānanāḥ || 36.49 || śvasūkarājamahiṣakharameṣahayānanāḥ | grahakuṃbhīranakrāsyāḥ sarpakūrmāsyavāyasāḥ || 36.50 || kṛdhrolūkajalūkāśca śārdūlakapikarkaṭāḥ | gandhakaḥ pūtivakraśca raktākṣaḥ pūtimṛttikaḥ || 36.51 || kaṇadhūmastuṣāgniśca kṛmīṇāṃ nicayastathā | amedhyaścāpratīkāro rudhirānnasyabhojanaṃ || 36.52 || lālābhakṣamabhakṣaśca sarvabhakṣaśca dāruṇaḥ | jaṅkaṭassuvilāsaśca vikaṭaḥ kaṭapūtanaḥ || 36.53 || ambarīṣaḥ kaṭāhaśca kaṣṭā vaitaraṇī nadī | sutaptalohaśayanamekapādaprataptakaṃ || 36.54 || asitālavanaṃ ghoramasthibhaṅgaprapīḍanaṃ | tilātasīkṣuyāntrāṇikūṭapāśapramardanaṃ || 36.55 || mahāchullī suchullī ca taptalohamayī śilā | parvatakṣuradhārākhyaṃ tathā ca malaparvataḥ || 36.56 || mūtraviṣṭhāṃdhakūpeṣu kṣārakūpeṣu pātanaṃ | musalolūkhalaṃ yantraṃ śilāśakalalāṅgalaṃ || 36.57 || tālapatrāsigahanaṃ mahāmaśakamaṇḍapaṃ | sammohano'sthibhaṅgaśca tapuḥśūlamayoguḍaḥ || 36.58 || bahuduḥkhaṃ mahāduḥkhaṃ kaśmalaṃ śamalaṃ malaṃ | hālāhalo nirūpaśca surūpaśca tamo'nugaḥ || 36.59 || ekapādastripādaśca tīvravīciśca rantimaḥ | aṣṭāviṃśatirevaitaiḥ kramaśaḥ pañcakāḥ smṛtāḥ || 36.60 || koṭīnāmānu pūrvyeṇa pañca pañcaiva nāyakāḥ | rauravādyaṃ ca vīryaṃ ca śatamekantu sarvataḥ || 36.61 || catvāriṃśatsamadhikaṃ mahānarakamaṇḍalaṃ | teṣu pāpāḥ prapacyantenarāḥ karmānurūpataḥ || 36.62 || yātanābhirvicitrābhirākarmaprakṣayādbhṛśaṃ | susūḍhaṃ hastayorbaddhvātaptaśṛṅkhalayā narāḥ || 36.63 || mahāvṛṅgaraśākhāsugamyanteyamakiṅkaraiḥ | ḍolitāścātivegena nissaṃjñā yāntiyojanaṃ || 36.64 || antarikṣasthitānāṃ ca lohabhāraśataṃ tataḥ | pādayorbadhyate teṣāṃ yamadūtairmahābalaiḥ || 36.65 || tena bhāreṇa mahatā bhṛśamātāḍitānarāḥ | ākhyāntassvāni karmāṇi tūṣṇīṃ tiṣṭanti vihvalāḥ || 36.66 || tatastaptairagni varṇairlohadaṇḍaissakaṇṭakaiḥ | hanyante kiṅkarairghoraissamartātpāpakāriṇaḥ || 36.67 || tataḥ kṣāreṇa dīptena vahnerapi viśeṣataḥ | samantataḥ pralipyante tāmreṇa ca punaḥ punaḥ || 36.68 || drutenātyantaliptena kṣatāṅgā jarjarīkṛtāḥ | punarvidhāya cāṅgāni śiraḥprabhṛti cakramāth || 36.69 || vārtākavatprapacyante taptataile kaṭāhake | niṣṭhāpūrṇe tathākūpe kṛmīṇāṃnicaye punaḥ || 36.70 || medo'sṛkpūyapūrṇāyāṃ vāpyāṃ kṣipyanti? te punaḥ | bhakṣyante kṛmibhistīvrairlohatuṇḍaiśca vāyasaiḥ || 36.71 || śvabhirdaṃśairvṛkairugrairvyāghraiśca vikṛtairnaraiḥ | pacyante caruvadvāpi pradīptāṅgārarāśiṣu || 36.72 || protāstīkṣṇeṣu śūleṣu narāḥ pāpena karmaṇā | śailapīṭhairathākramya ghoraiḥ karmabhirātmajaiḥ || 36.73 || tilavatsaṃprapīḍyante cakrākhye narake narāḥ | pacyante cātitapteṣu lohabhāṇḍeṣvanekathā || 36.74 || tailapūrṇakaṭāheṣu sutapteṣu punaḥpunaḥ | sardendriyāṇi saṃbaddhya kramātpāpena yātanāḥ || 36.75 || bhavanti ghorāḥ pratyekaṃ śarīre tatkṛtena ca | ye śruṇvanti harernindāṃ teṣāṃ karṇaḥ prapūryate || 36.76 || agninarṇairayaḥkīlaistaptaistāmrādikadrutaiḥ | trapusīsārakūrakūṭādyaiḥkṣāreṇa jatunā punaḥ || 36.77 || sutaptatīkṣṇatailena vajralepena cāntataḥ | kramādāpūryate karṇau? narakeṣu ca yātanāḥ || 36.78 || anukrameṇa sarveṣu bhramantyeteṣu yātanāḥ | ye tu deva gṛhaṃ gatvā tatra sevārthamāgatāḥ || 36.79 || atha vānyatra tadrūpā madamohaparājitāḥ | paradārāṃśca gacchanti lubdhāssnigdhena cakṣuṣā || 36.80 || guroḥkurvanti bhrukuṭīṃ krūranetrāścaye narāḥ | sūcībhiragnivarṇābhisteṣāṃ cakṣuḥ pravidhyate || 36.81 || kṣārādyaiśca kramātsarvairdehe sarvāśca yātanāḥ | sparśalobhena ye mūḍhāssaṃspṛśanti parastriyaḥ || 36.82 || teṣāṃ taptāgnivarṇābhissūcībhirvidhyate karaḥ | tataḥ kṣārādikaissarvaṃ śarīramanulipyate || 36.83 || yātanāśca mahākaṣṭāssarveṣu narakeṣu ca | pareṣvajanti cātyugraṃ pradīptaṃ lohaśālmaliṃ || 36.84 || hanyante pṛṣṭhadeśeṣu punarbhīmairmahābalaiḥ | dantureṇātikuṇṭhena krakacena balīyasā || 36.85 || śilaḥpṛbhṛti pāṭyanteghoraiḥ karmabhirātmajaiḥ | tenatenaiva rūpeṇa hanyante pāradārikāḥ || 36.86 || gāḍhamāliṅgyate nārī jvalantīlohanirmitā | pūrvākālaṃ jvalantaṃ taṃ pūruṣaṃ lohanirmitaṃ || 36.87 || duścāriṇyaḥstrīyo gāḍhamāliṅgantivadanti ca | kiṃ pradhāvasi vegena na te moho'sti saṃprati || 36.88 || laṅghitaste yathā bhartā pāpaṃ bhuṅkṣva tadādhunā | lohakuṃbhe vinikṣiptāḥ sāpidhāne śanaiśśanaiḥ || 36.89 || mṛdvagninā prapacyante svapāpairiva mānavāḥ | ulūkhalādyaiḥ kṣodyante prapīḍyante śilāsu ca || 36.90 || kṣipyante cāndhakūpeṣu daśyante bhramarairbhṛśaṃ | kṛmibhirbhinna sarvāṅgāśśataśo jarjarīkṛtāḥ || 36.91 || sutīkṣṇakṣurakūpeṣu kṣipyante tadanantaraṃ | mahajvāle ca narake pāpāḥ pacyanti sarvataḥ || 36.92 || itastataśca dhāvanti dahyamānāstadarciṣā | pṛṣṭhenānīya jaṅghe dve vinyaste srandhayojite || 36.93 || tayormadhyena cākṛṣya bāhupṛṣṭhena gāḍhataḥ | baddhvā parasparaṃ sarvaṃ sudṛḍhaṃ pāparajjubhiḥ || 36.94 || piṇḍabaddhaṃ daśantyenaṃ bhramārāstīkṣṇalohajāḥ | mānināṃ krodhināṃ caiva taskarāṇāṃ ca dāruṇāḥ || 36.95 || piṇḍabaddhāssmṛtā yāmyamahājvāle ca yātanāḥ | rijjubhirveṣṭitāṃgāśca praliptāḥ kardamena ca || 36.96 || karīṣavatprapacyante mriyante tena tetathā | sutīkṣṇakṣāratoyena karmaśānu śilāsu ca || 36.97 || apāpasaṃkṣayātpāpā ghṛṣyante candanaṃ yathā | śarīrābhyantaragataissantataṃ kṛmibhirnarāḥ || 36.98 || bhakṣyante tīvravadanairādeha prakṣayādbhṛśaṃ | kṛmīṇāṃ nicaye kṣiptāḥ pūtimāṃsasya rāśiṣu || 36.99 || tiṣṭhantyudvignahṛdayāḥ parvatābhyantarārditāḥ | sutaptavajralepena śarīramupalipyate || 36.100 || adhomukhordhvapādāśca vṛtā stapyanti vahninā | vadanāntaḥ pravinyastaṃ suprataptamayoguḍaṃ || 36.101 || te khādanti parādhīnā hanyamānāśca mudgaraiḥ | ye devārāmapuṣpāṇi lobhātsaṃsṛhya pāṇinā || 36.102 || jighranti mūḍhamanaso śirasā dhārayanti ca | āropyate śirasteṣāṃ sutaptairlohaśaṅkubhiḥ || 36.103 || tataḥ kṣāreṇa dīptena tailatāmrādibhiḥ kramāth | śarīre ca mahāghorāścitrā narakayātanāḥ || 36.104 || bahudhotpāṭyate jīhvā ye'satya priyavādinaḥ | saṃdaṃśena sutaptena prapīḍyorasi pādataḥ || 36.105 || midhyāgamapravaktuśca jīhvā cāsya vinirgatā | krośārdhajīhvāvistīrṇairhalaistīkṣṇaiḥ prapāṭyate || 36.106 || nirbhartsayantiye krūrā mātaraṃ pitaraṃ guruṃ | teṣāṃ vajrajalūkābhirmukhamādaśyate yataḥ || 36.107 || tataḥkṣāreṇa tāmreṇa trapuṇā sicyate punaḥ | drutairāpūryate'tyarthaṃ taptalohaiśca tanmukhaṃ || 36.108 || itastataḥ punardhāvanbaddhyate yamakiṅkaraiḥ | ye nindanti mahātmānamācāryaṃ dharmadeśikaṃ || 36.109 || viṣṇubhaktāṃśca sammūḍhāstaddharmaṃ caiha śāśvataṃ | teṣāmurasi kanthe ca jihmāyāṃ dantasandhiṣu || 36.110 || tālunyoṣṭhe ca nāsāyāṃ mūrdhni sarvāṃgasandhiṣu | agnivarṇāssutaptāśca triśikhā lohaśaṅkavaḥ || 36.111 || āropyante subahuśaḥ sthāneṣveteṣu mudgaraiḥ | tataḥ kṣāreṇa taptena tāmreṇa trapuṇā punaḥ || 36.112 || taptalohādibhissarvairāpūryante samantataḥ | yātanāśca mahācitrāśśarīrasyāpi sarvataḥ || 36.113 || niśśeṣanarakeṣvevaṃ bhramanti kramaśaḥ punaḥ | ye gṛhṇanti paradravyaṃ padbhyāṃ vipraṃ spṛśanti ca || 36.114 || devopakaraṇāṃgaṃ ca jñānaṃ ca likhitaṃ kvacith | hastapādāghanaiste ṣāmāpūryante samantataḥ || 36.115 || kṣāratāmrādibhirdhīptairdahyante kramaśaḥ punaḥ | narakeṣu ca sarveṣu vicitrā dehayātanāḥ || 36.116 || bhavanti bahuśaḥ kaṣṭāḥ pāṇipādasamudbhavāḥ | pradattāṃ devadevasya tannāmnā pūjakasya vā || 36.117 || padārdhināmathānyeṣāṃ haṭhādvṛttiṃ harantiye | te vai narakakūpeṣu pacyamānāssvakarmabhiḥ || 36.118 || vrajantiyātanā bhūyo nātiyantiyāmāṅgaṇaṃ | ye devāyatanārāmavāpīkūpamaṭhāṅgaṇaṃ || 36.119 || upadravanti pāpiṣṭhā nṛpāstatra vasanti ca | vyāyāmodvartanābhyaṅgasnānapānānnabhojanaṃ || 36.120 || krīḍanaṃ maithunaṃ dyūtamaśaucādyācaranti ca | te nadhairvividhairghorairikṣu yantrādipīḍanaiḥ || 36.121 || nirayāgniṣu pacyante yāvadācandratārakaṃ | devāyatanaparyante devārāme ca kutracith || 36.122 || samutsṛjanti ye mūḍhāḥpurīṣaṃ mūtrameva vā | teṣāṃ śiśnaṃ savṛṣaṇaṃ hanyate lohamudgaraiḥ, || 36.123 || sūcībhīrnetraparyantairagnivarṇaissakaṇṭakaiḥ | aropyante gude teṣāṃ yāvanmūrdhni vinirgataiḥ || 36.124 || tataḥ kṣāreṇa mahatā tāmreṇa trapuṇā punaḥ | drutenāpūryate gāḍhaṃ gudaṃ śiśnaṃ ca dehināṃ || 36.125 || manassarvendriyāṇāṃ ca yasmāduktaṃ pravartanaṃ | tasmādindriyaduḥkhena jāyate tatsuduḥkhitaṃ || 36.126 || anna pānamadattaṃ yairmūḍhairnāpyanumoditaṃ | dhane satyapi ye dānaṃ na ca yacchanti tṛṣṇayā || 36.127 || atithiṃ cāvamanyante kālaprāptaṃ gṛhāśrame | tejohīnā raṇe baddhā hastapādānadhāritāḥ || 36.128 || vistāritāṃgāśśuṣyanti tiṣṭhantyabdaśataṃ narāḥ | hastapādalalāṭeṣu kīlitā lohaśaṅkubhiḥ || 36.129 || nityaṃ ca vikṛtaṃ vakraṃ kīlakadvayaghāṭitaṃ | kṛmibhiḥprāṇibhiścograirlohatuṇḍaiśca vāyasaiḥ || 36.130 || upadravairbahuvidhairmukhamantaḥ prapīḍyate | jihvā tataḥ prabhinnā ca gāḍhaṃ śṛṅkhalayā punaḥ || 36.131 || tiṣṭanti laṃbamānāśca lohākārāssuvartulāḥ | tataḥ svamāṃsamutkṛṣya tilamātrapramāṇataḥ || 36.132 || khādituṃ dīyate teṣāṃ sūcyagreṇa ca śoṇitaṃ | yathā nirmāṃsatāṃ prāptāḥ kālena bahudhā punaḥ || 36.133 || tataḥ kṣāreṇa dīptena taccharīraṃ pralipyate | bhidyante varṣa dhārābhiśśuṣyante vāyunā punaḥ || 36.134 || punastailena sicyante sutaptena samantataḥ | iti citravidhairghorairmadhyamānāssvakarmajaiḥ || 36.135 || mriyante naiva pāpiṣṭhā yāvatpāpasya saṃkṣayaḥ | tasmātpāpaṃ na kurvīta cañcale jīvite sati || 36.136 || evaṃ kliṣṭā viśiṣṭāśca sāvaśeṣeṇa karmaṇā | tataḥ kṣitiṃ samāsādya jāyante dehinaḥ punaḥ || 36.137 || sthāvarā vividhāḥ krūrāstṛṇa gulmādibheditaḥ | tatrānubhūya duḥkhāni jāyante kīṭayoniṣu, || 36.138 || niṣkrāntāḥ kīṭayonibhyojāyante pakṣiṇaḥ kramāth | saṃkliṣṭāḥ pakṣibhevena bhavanti mṛgajātiṣu || 36.139 || mārgaṃ duḥghamatikramya jāyante paśuyoniṣu | kramādgoyonimāsādya jāyante mānuṣe punaḥ || 36.140 || vyutkrameṇāpi mānuṣyaṃ prāpyate puṇyagauravāth | tato manuṣyatāṃ prāpya tattatpāpānusārataḥ || 36.141 || saṃyutāṃ pāpacihneśca vartante prāṇinastataḥ | devābhigamanam snāto dhṛtordhvapuṇḍraśca prayataśśāntamānasaḥ || 36.142 || avyagraścānyakāryeṣu gṛhītvā śaktitassvayaṃ | phalādīnyupahārāṇi gandhānsumanasastathā || 36.143 || hiraṇyaṃ harimuddiśya yena sarvāḥkṛtā ime | upahārādibhissamyagabhisacchejjagadguruṃ || 36.144 || patraiḥ puṣpaiḥphalairvāpi yathāśakti samarpitaiḥ | ayatnasulabhenāpi toyenāpi sa tuṣyati || 36.145 || pādacāryeva gacchettu devālayamatandritaḥ | aśakto'pyatha vāśakta āḍhyo vā durvidho'dha vā || 36.146 || ādhirājye jagaddhāturadhikārī samassmṛtaḥ | na hi saṃharate jyotsnāṃ candraścaṇḍālaveśmani || 36.147 || na vā saudheṣu samrājāṃ sudhādhārāḥ pravarṣati | bhogāyataname teṣā mekākāraṃ kaleparaṃ || 36.148 || anugṛhṇāti dātā tasya noccānaco vidhiḥ viṣṇupāramyaṃ | devateha parañjyotireka eva paraḥ pumān || 36.149 || sa eva bahudhā loke māyayā bhidyate svayā | viṣṇvākhyassa svayaṃ māyaṃ prakṛtiṃ vyajya sa dvidhā || 36.150 || sthitastridhā ca sattvādiguṇabhedātpratīyate | viṣṇubrahmaśivākhyo'sau sthityutpatyantakṛtsmṛtaḥ || 36.151 || viṣṇvādyā mūrtayastasya dharmajñānādibhedataḥ | catasra eva vijñeyā vedavarṇa yugāśrayāḥ || 36.152 || viṣṇuśca puruṣassatyo hyacyutaśchāniruddhakaḥ | pañcadhopaniṣadbhedānmahābhūtatvamāgataḥ || 36.253 || manaśśrotrādibhiṣṣaḍbhiraṅgaiśca hṛdayādibhiḥ | ṣaḍakṣarātmako nityamṛṣibhiścaiṣa bhidyate || 36.154 || saptavyāhṛtibhirlo kaiśchandobhiḥ kratubhistathā | saptadhā bhidyamāno'sau vijñātavyo vicakṣaṇaiḥ || 36.155 || aṣṭaprakṛtibhiścāsāvaṣṭamūrtibhireva ca | aṣṭākṣaramayo nityamaṣṭadhā caiṣa bhidyate || 36.156 || nārāyaṇo nṛsiṃhaśca varāho vāmanastathā | rāmabrahmendrasūryāśca candrastairna vadhā sthitiḥ || 36.157 || indro'gniśṭa yamaścaiva nirṛtirvaruṇastathā | vāyussomastatheśāno brahmānantaścate daśa || 36.158 || ekādaśendriyairbhinnastathā dvādaśamānapaiḥ | sa trayodaśadhā caiva viśvedevādibhiḥ sthitaḥ || 36.159 || sa caturdaśadhā bhinno manubhiścākṣuṣādibhiḥ | tithibhiḥ pañcadaśadhā bhinno jñeyassu vai prabhuḥ || 36.160 || svaraiṣṣoḍaśadhā bhinnodikkoṇāvāntaraistathā | mūrtyantaraiśca vijñeyo bahudhā tasya vistaraḥ || 36.161 || ekadvitricatuḥpañcaṣaḍādyā viśvato mukhāḥ | mukhabhedāssamākhyātāstasya viśvātmano hareḥ || 36.162 || dvyādayo viśvataḥpāṇerbhujabhedastathā smṛtāḥ | vividhābharaṇā dīrghā vividhāyudhadhāriṇaḥ || 36.163 || mūrdhānaścaiva tasyoktā lasanmukuṭakuṇḍalāḥ | haimordhvapuḍralāvaṇyaprabhavā vakrakuntalāḥ || 36.164 || smerāruṇādharāssoṃyāḥ prasādāmṛtavarṣiṇaḥ | sahasraṃ pauruṣe sūkte pādāścākṣīṇyanekaśaḥ || 36.165 || hiraṇyagarbho'nekātmā vimalaśśyāma eva ca | nīlaḥ pītastathā rakto nānāvarṇaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 36.166 || candrasūryausmṛtau tasya nayane vāmadakṣiṇe | brahmāṇamāhurmūrdhānaṃ keśāṃścāsya vanaspatīn || 36.167 || āsyaṃ vedāśca ye'nantā toyaṃ rudhirameva ca | upajihvā tu tasyoktamupaśrutiśataṃ tathā || 36.168 || bhruvormadhye tathā rudraṃ bhṛguṃ manasi saṃsthitaṃ | rudrā ekādaśa jñe yā stasya kaṇṭhaṃ samāśritā || 36.169 || nakṣatragrahatārāśca dantāssyurmaruto'pi ca | dharmādharmautathordhvādharoṣṭhau tu parikīrtitau || 36.170 || indrāgnī tāluke tasya jihmācaiva sarasvatī | diśaśca vidiśaścaiva śrotrayontasya saṃsmṛtāḥ || 36.171 || vāyuḥprāṇeṣu vijñeyassādhyāścāṃgulayaḥsmṛtāḥ | ṛṣayo romakūpeṣu sāgarā vastigocarāḥ || 36.172 || nadyaśca vasudhā cāsya nāgāśca nalake sthitāḥ | jānusthāvaśvinau devau parvatāścorusaṃsthitāḥ || 36.173 || guhyo'sya guhyakā jñeyā vasavaścorasi sthitāḥ | nakhāgreṣu ca vijñeyā divyā oṣadhayastathā || 36.174 || nāsikāyāḥ puṭau jñeyāvayane dakṣiṇottare | ṛtavo bāhumūle tu māsāḥ karataleṣu ca || 36.175 || lalāṭāgre tathā siddhā bhruvormeghāssavidyutaḥ | yakṣakinnaragandharvā daiteyā dānavāstathā || 36.176 || rākṣasāścāraṇāścāsya jaṭharaṃ samusāśritāḥ | pitaraḥ pretakūśmāṇḍa vetālapramathāstathā || 36.177 || pātālagocarāścāsya pāvayugmaṃ samāśritāḥ | pārśvayostasya vijñeyāḥkriyā vedairabhiṣṭutāḥ || 36.178 || agnihotrādikarmāṇi varṇāśramahitāni ca | svāhāsvadhāvaṣaṭkā rāssarve'sya hṛdaye śritāḥ || 36.179 || nāmnāṃ śataṃ sahasraṃ vā tathānantaṃ paṭhantiyath | anantānantarūpasya yathāyogaṃ samanvitaṃ || 36.180 || mūrtayaścāsya sarvāstāssaṃkhyātītāḥ prakīrtitāḥ | devādīnāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ mūrtayastatra saṃśritāḥ || 36.181 || tasmādanantansaṃproktaḥ puṃsūkte tadudīritaṃ | "sahasraśīrṣā puruṣassahasrākṣassahasrapāt'' || 36.182 || brāhmaṇā mukhate yasya kṣatriyā yasya bāhutaḥ | ūruto yasya vai jātā vaiśyāśceti narā bhuvi || 36.183 || candramā manaso jātaścakṣuṣormihirastathā | mūkhādindrastathāgniśca prāṇādvāyurajāyata || 36.184 || nābhyāyasyāntarikṣaṃ ca śiraso dyaurajāyata | padbhyāṃ bhūmirdiśaśśrotrādyasya devasya saṃbabhau || 36.185 || tamīdṛśaṃ mahāviṣṇumaprameyamanāmayaṃ | tatprasādādṛte jñātuṃ vaktuṃ vā naiva śakyate || 36.186 || sarvadevamayo viṣṇuḥ sarve devāstadātmakāḥ | aśeṣaṃ vāṅmayaṃ cedaṃ lokālokaṃ carācaraṃ || 36.187 || vaiṣṇavyā vyāpyate śaktyā vāyunevadiśo'ntaraṃ | sarve viṣṇumayādevāssarvaśāstreṣu kīrtitāḥ || 36.188 || ādhārādheyabhāvena dvedhāsa vyāpya tiṣṭhati | sarvabhūtahitāyaiva niṣkalassakalaḥsthitaḥ || 36.189 || niṣkalassakalaścaivaṃ jñeyo viṣṇussanātanaḥ | sarvataḥpāṇipādaṃ tatsarvato'kṣiśiromukhaṃ || 36.190 || sarvataśśrutimalloke sarvamāvṛtya tiṣṭhati, | sarvendriyaguṇābhāsaṃ sarvendriyavivarjataṃ || 36.191 || asaktaṃ sarvabhṛccaiva nirguṇaṃ guṇabhoktṛ ca | avibhaktaṃ ca bhūteṣu vibhaktamiva ca sthitaṃ || 36.192 || bhūtabhartṛca tadjñeyaṃ grasiṣṇu prabhaviṣṇu ca | jyotiṣāmapi tajjyotistamasaḥ paramucyate || 36.193 || jñānaṃ jñeyaṃ jñānagamyaṃ hṛdi sarvasya viṣṭhitaṃ | taccādyo jagatāmīśaḥ pareśaḥ parameśvaraḥ || 36.194 || parāvarasvarūpeṇa viṣṇussarvahṛdi sthitaḥ | sthūlasūkṣmaparatvena tridhā ca bhagavānsthitaḥ || 36.195 || prabhaviṣṇurmahāviṣṇussadāviṣṇuḥ smṛtaśca saḥ | ātmā sa hyantarātmā ca paramātmā ca saṃsmṛtaḥ || 36.196 || vairājaṃ laiṅgikaṃ caiva bahirantaśca sarvaśaḥ | śabdādiścinmayaṃ rūpaṃ jāgratsvapna suṣuptigaṃ || 36.197 || mantrānusvāranādeṣu trayamanveṣayedbudhaḥ | vede ca bhagavacchāstre sāṃkhye yoge tathaiva ca || 36.198 || dharmaśāstre purāṇe ca munibhirdevamānuṣaiḥ | paṭhyate nikhilairnityaṃ viśvaṃ viṣṇumayaṃ jagath || 36.199 || yacca bhūtaṃ bhaviṣyacca vartamānaṃ tu kiṃ cana | indriyāṇīndriyārthāśca bhūtāntaḥ karaṇāni ca || 36.200 || avyaktaṃ triguṇā māyā vidyā dharmādayastathā | niyatiśca kalā kālaḥ sarvamanyacca tanmayaṃ || 36.201 || viṣṇureva paro devassarva bhūteṣvavasthitaḥ | sarvabhūtāni caivācau na tadastīha yanna saḥ || 36.202 || devāsurādayo martyāḥ paśavaśca sarīsṛpāḥ | taruvallītṛṇauṣadhyo mahābhrāśanividyutaḥ || 36.203 || śailābdhisaridārāmanagarāṇi sarāṃsi ca | lokāścāna ntakālo'gni pretāvāsoragālayāḥ || 36.204 || saptabhūrādayo brāhmaśaivavaiṣṇavasaṃjñitāḥ | sarve ca viṣṇunaikena vyāptāssarvātmanātmanā || 36.205 || varāho bhārgavassiṃho rāmaśrīdharavāmanāḥ | aśvikṛṣṇau ca dikṣveṣāṃ lokairaṇḍaṃ sahākhilaṃ || 36.206 || yaccānuktamaśeṣeṇa viṣṇoretā vibhūtayaḥ | viśvavyāpitayevaiṣa viṣṇurvṛddhairudhīritaḥ || 36.207 || purusaṃjñeśarīre'sminśayanātpuruṣaḥ smṛtaḥ | satyaśchābādhitārthatvānnityatvātsa prakīrtitaḥ || 36.208 || acyuto'cyavanādeva sa hariḥ samadīritaḥ | aniruddhastathā proktassarvasmādanirodhanāth || 36.209 || vasanāstarvabhūteṣu vāsudevatvamīyivān | ādimūrtessamākṛṣṭaḥ smṛtassaṃkarṣaṇaḥ prabhuḥ || 36.210 || pradyumno dyumna pṛṣṭhatvāttridhāmā dhāmabhistribhiḥ | vaikuṇṭhāmalavarṇatvādvaikuṇṭhaśṭāyamucyate || 36.211 || līyete pralaye tvasminkeśāvityeṣa keśavaḥ | naranārīprakartṛtvānnarāṇāṃ cāyanādayaṃ || 36.212 || nārāyaṇo naroddhānāmayanatvādapāñca saḥ | mādhavo madhuṣūtpattyā dhavatvādvā śriyaḥsmṛtaḥ || 36.213 || govindatīti govindo gāvo vindanti yaṃ tathā | asuraṃ madhunāmānaṃ hantīti madhusūdana || 36.214 || tribhiḥsvairvikramairvyāpto jagadeṣa trivikramaḥ | vāmano vrāsvatāyogācchrīdharo vahanācchriyaḥ || 36.215 || hṛṣīkasyendriyasyeśo hṛṣīkeśa udīritaḥ | padmaṃ nābherabhūdyapya padmanābhastatasmmataḥ || 36.216 || udarālambi dāmāsyetyukto dāmodaro hariḥ | uttamaḥ puruṣoyasmāduktassa puruṣottamaḥ || 36.217 || vilomendriyagamyatvātprocyate sa tvadhokṣajaḥ | ardhamardhaṃ larassiṃho narasiṃhā udāhṛtaḥ || 36.218 || janārdanassa pāpiṣṭhānjanānardayatīti saḥ | indrasyāvarajo bhūta upendraḥ procyate hariḥ || 36.219 || haraṇātsarvapāpānāṃ harirnāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ | karṣaṇātpāparāśīnāṃ kṛṣṇassarvātmako hariḥ || 36.220 || rudro rodayate tasmātbrahmā bṛṃhaṇakarmaṇā | indraśca paramaiśvaryādvahanādvahnirucyate || 36.221 || yamassaṃyamanātpuṃsāṃ varaṇādvaruṇastathā | vāyurvānātsavātsomariśaśceṣṭe janeṣu yaḥ || 36.222 || ādityo'ditiputratvāccandraścandayate yataḥ | ityevaṃ guṇavṛttyohyaiḥ śabdereko'pyanekathā || 36.223 || śrutibhiḥ procyate brahma viṣṇvākhyaṃ jātu netarath | tasyeśvarasya caiśvaryātsarvametatpravartate || 36.224 || seśvaraṃ hi jagatsarvaṃ bhavennānīśvaraṃ kvacith | tanmayatvena govinde nyastasarvabharā narāḥ || 36.225 || tadyājīno mahābhāgāstaranti bhavavāridhiṃ | taṃ prasādhayituṃ yatnaḥ kāryassarātmanā naraiḥ || 36.226 || bhaktinamrassadā gacchetsarvo'pi jagataḥ patiṃ | taddevasya priyaṃ bhūyādyatassammānanaṃ tu tath || 36.227 || tasya sannihito devo yasya citte janārdanaḥ | dānena tapasā nānyaistyasya tuṣṭobhaveddhariḥ || 36.228 || āruhya śakaṭaṃ gacchedyo viṣṇormandiraṃ naraḥ | nārī vā bālako vātha vṛddha ātura eva vā || 36.229 || tasya puṇyaphalaṃ nāsti pretya yugyaśca jāyate | ye vāhayanti tānmartyānnarā vā prāṇinaśca ye || 36.230 || te yāsyanti padaṃ viṣṇoryasmātpādaca rāstu te | ye vāhayanti jantūṃstānste'pimūḍhāḥ patanti vai || 36.231 || yastodayati tāneva gamane mūḍhacetanaḥ | sa yāmīryātanāḥ prāpya todyate yamakiṅkaraiḥ || 36.232 || punaḥ paśutvamāpannastodyate paśubhirnaraiḥ | yo vā bhṛtakadānena vāhanena tu mānavaḥ || 36.233 || vāhayatyatha voheta so'pi yāsyati durgatiṃ | apāre durgasaṃsāre karmabaddhe viśeṣataḥ || 36.234 || svīyaṃ karma samutsṛjya patanti narake'śucau | tataḥpaśutvamāpannāściraṃ tiṣṭhanti bhūtale || 36.235 || pādukāmadhiruhyāpi yo devālayamāprajeth | sa paśurjoyate pretya rogī cehaprajāyate || 36.236 || pādukāṃ vāhanaṃ cāpi yo'dhiṣṭhitya vimūḍhadhīḥ | praṇāmaṃ haraye kuryātta sya dūrataro hariḥ || 36.237 || devadarṇanamuddiśya naivedaṃ vidha āvrajeth | ayatnādgamane jāte'pyavaruhya ca vāhanāth || 36.238 || pādukādi vimucyaiva samupaspṛśya vāriṇā | praviśetprayato bhūtvā prākāraṃ prathamaṃ punaḥ || 36.239 || na viśeddhāma devasya yādatā vāhanādibhiḥ | tādṛśaṃ puruṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā yathāśaktyavabodhayeth || 36.240 || ādyastveṣo'pacārassyādyatnahāryobhavettataḥ | śmaśānamadhye gatvātu yo gaccheddevatāgṛhaṃ || 36.241 || saptajanmakṛtātpuṇyāttatkṣaṇānmucyate naraḥ | sārgālīṃ yonimāśritya pasejjanmatrayaṃ tataḥ || 36.242 || daridrāścaiva mārkhāśca bhaviṣyanti trijanmakaṃ | anyadevagṛhaṃ gadvāhyasnātvā yo vrajedgṛhaṃ || 36.243 || devadevasya mohāttu tasya pāpaṃ mahādbhaveth | gṛhādgṛhaṃ tathā gadvā bhikṣārthī kṣudhitassvayaṃ || 36.244 || bhikṣāmalabdhvā kutrāpi daridro jāyate naraḥ | catvāri caiva janmāni teṣāmante ca yo budhaḥ? || 36.245 || caṇḍālayoni māpnoti janmāni daśa pañca ca | atra codāharantīmaṃ viśeṣaṃ kāśyapādayaḥ || 36.246 || sarvadevamayo viṣṇussarvavedamayo hariḥ | tasyātiriktaṃ no kiñcidviśeṣastatra vakṣyate || 36.247 || sarve'pyadhikṛtā loke tattatkarmānurūpataḥ | ābrahmastaṃbaparyantaṃ jagadantarvyavasthitāḥ || 36.248 || tasmādeva jagatsarvaṃ sargakāle prajāyate | tasminneva punastacca pralaye saṃpralīyate || 36.249 || yaḥ varaḥ prakṛteḥ proktaḥ purāṇaḥ puruṣo'vyayaḥ | sa eva sarvabhūtātmā nara ityabhidhīyate || 36.250 || narājjātāni tattvāni nārāṇīti pracakṣate | tānyeva cāyanaṃ yasya sa tu nārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ || 36.251 || nārāyaṇaḥ paraṃ brahma tattvaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ paraḥ | viṣṇvādibhistathā kecidvāsudevādibhiḥ pare || 36.252 || saṃjñābhedairmahātmānassadaivārādhayantitaṃ | sarvatra paripūrṇasya sarvadhā sarvavastuṣu || 36.253 || na jātu labhyate kiñcidyenāvyāptaṃ tu kiṃ cana | tasmāttasminsamāropya sarvaṃ deveśvareśvare || 36.254 || upāsanaṃ bhavedyattu tadbhaveducitaṃ budhaiḥ | anyatra taṃ samāropya yadi copāsanaṃ bhaveth || 36.255 || tadbhavedanyadevārcā tasmātparimitaṃ phalaṃ | ye'pyanyadevatābhaktāyajante śraddhayo'nvitāḥ || 36.256 || yajante te'pi deveśaṃ tamevāvidhi pūrvakaṃ | anye te brahmarudrendrāstadādyā devatāssmṛtāḥ || 36.257 || vaiṣṇavā avatārāśca ye tu śāstroditāḥ purā | paramārthe na bhidyante nānyatvaṃ syātparasparaṃ || 36.258 || viṣṇvālayādathaikasmādanyaviṣṇvālayasya tu | tatsthānāṃ daivatānāṃ vā nānyatvaṃ jātu saṃbhaveth || 36.259 || atha śāstravidhirbhinno yatra nāpyupalabhyate | tatrānyatvaṃ vijānīyānna cecchecchāstrasaṃkaraṃ || 36.260 || hariṃ devaṃ tu saṃsevya vāhanasthaṃ dvijottamaḥ | yadanyaṃ sedate vīthyāṃ tatkāle vāhanasthitaṃ || 36.261 || so'pi pāpamavāpnoti viṣṇudhyānena śuddhyati | deveśasyotsavo yatra grāme vā nagare'pi vā || 36.262 || parvatāgre mahānadyāstīre durgāṭavīṣuvā | tatra gacchennaro bhaktyā sevetotsavamādarāth || 36.263 || saha puttressahāmātyaissarvaiḥ parijanairvṛtaḥ | vaiṣṇavaṃ kratudeśantu gatvā seveta mānavaḥ || 36.264 || yathār'hamupayuñjīta svaśaktiṃ tatkriyāsu ca | śrutvā devotsavāraṃbhaṃ paṅgūbhāvena yo naraḥ || 36.265 || tiṣṭhetsa janmasāhasraṃ paṅgureva bhaviṣyati | tadbhavedviphalaṃ janma bhūbhārastasya jīvitaṃ || 36.266 || deveśasyotsave samyagvartamāne mahāphale | yo'nyatra vyāpṛtastatra na gaccheddurmanā naraḥ || 36.267 || na tasya niṣkṛtiḥ proktā sa pāpī narakaṃ vrajeth | anāhūto'dhvaraṃ gacchettathā gurukulaṃ vrajeth || 36.268 || yo'dhvaraṃ gantukāmo'tra pratīkṣetārṅgaṇādikaṃ | tanya pūrvārjitaṃ puṇyaṃ tatkṣaṇādeva naśyati || 36.269 || devotsavaṃ tu yo martyo yatamānaṃ tu sevituṃ | vārayedyena kenāpi hetunā sa tu durmatiḥ || 36.270 || aphalassaphalo vāpi patatyeva na saṃśayaḥ | viṣṇupañcadine vāpi puṇyāheṣvitareṣvapi || 36.271 || upoṣitastu śrutvaiva deveśasyotsavaṃ haṭhāth | tatkṣaṇādyo na gacchettu tasya pāpaṃ mahadbhaveth || 36.272 || khaṭvāmāsthāya yaśśete vartamāne tadutsave | āsīnasthsita evātra sa yāmīryātanā vrajeth || 36.273 || deveśābhimukhaṃ gatvā na kuryādyo namaskriyāṃ | sa pāpiṣṭhataro loke niṣkṛtirnāsya vidyate || 36.274 || utkramiṣyanti yatprāṇāḥ prāṇade samupasthite | pratyudthānābhivādābhyāṃ punastānpratipādayeth || 36.275 || sarveṣāṃ prāṇabhūto'sau bhagavānhariravyayaḥ | prāṇinaścetanāssarve prāṇyekaḥ prāṇado'paraḥ || 36.276 || anyathā cenmahādoṣaḥ saṃkṣuphyante ca mānavāḥ | ekahastapraṇāmena yatpāpaṃ na tadanyataḥ || 36.277 || hastau dvau nirmitau dhātrā kiṃ tena sukṛtaṃ bhaveth | prāñjalīkṛtya hastautu yāceta madhusūdanaṃ || 36.278 || ya ekenaiva hastena praṇamenmandadhīrhariṃ | tasyahasto bhavedekaḥ paścājjanmaśatairapi || 36.279 || iha vai jāyate paṅgū rogī caiva na saṃśayaḥ | kimidaṃ bahulaiścitraiḥ karaṇairdehakalpanaṃ || 36.280 || yadyekaikaṃ na cettasya kaiṅkaryāyopayujyate | kiṃ svādhīnena hastena svādhīnaṃ karma sevituṃ || 36.281 || aśaknu vānāssvātantṣahatāḥ pāpahatā hatāḥ | ekahastapraṇāmastu parihāryo viśeṣataḥ || 36.282 || praṇataṃ caikahastena yastu pratyabhivādayeth | tāvubhau narakaṃ yātastayoryasmātsamāgamaḥ || 36.283 || devatāstādṛśaṃ mūḍhaṃ śapanti ca viśaṅkitāḥ | purastādyastu devasya kuryādātmapradakṣiṇaṃ || 36.284 || ātmanā sa bhavedvāpassa druhyedātmane budhaḥ | purastāddevabiṃbe tu devyamaṅgalavigrahe || 36.285 || vartamāne tvanādṛtya na hyanyasya pradakṣiṇaṃ | yatra mānasikārcā syāttacca mānasikaṃ bhaveth || 36.286 || antaryāmī ya evāste hṛdaye niṣkalo hariḥ | sa eva sakalo bhūtvā biṃbe yatsannidhāpitaḥ || 36.287 || tasmātsakalapūjāyāṃ naiva kuryādvyatikramaṃ | na kadāpi bhavetprājña ucbhiṣṭassveṣu karmasu || 36.288 || viṇmūtraṃ pathi kṛtvātu śaucaṃ yāvanna cācareth | ucchiṣṭastāvadeva syādanarhassarvakarmasu || 36.289 || nakharomāṇi yaścaiva keśāsthīni tathaiva ca | kṣipettu devatāgāre sa bhavedbrahmahā naraḥ || 36.290 || mākṣikīṃ yonimśritya jāyate mriyate punaḥ | sapta janmāni tatraiva vrajennarakamastataḥ || 36.291 || tāṃbūlaṃ carvitaṃ yastu prakṣipeddevamantire | sa yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ yāvadābhūtasaṃplavaṃ || 36.292 || tato mukto mahāpāpī śunako'parajanmani | saṃsthitastrīṇi janmāni vasatyeva na saṃśayaḥ || 36.293 || niṣṭhīvanakaro yastu mandire madhuvidviṣaḥ | kṛmibhakṣye patedghore narake pāpakṛnnaraḥ || 36.294 || śleṣmātakatarurbhūtvā jāyate janmapañcakaṃ | mūtrayenmandire yastu keśavasya vimūḍhadhīḥ || 36.295 || sa mūtragartanarake patatyeva hyavākchirāḥ | tasmānmuktasturaktādiniṃbakadrumamāsthitaḥ || 36.296 || janiṣyati na sandehassaptajanmasu saukarīṃ | purīṣaṃ vātra kurvīta yo naro bhagavadgṛhe || 36.297 || sa yāti narakānghorānparyāyeṇaikaviṃśatiṃ | tato muktastu pāpātmā viṣṭhāyāṃ jāyate kṛmiḥ || 36.298 || samīpe mandirasyāpi sakṛnmūtraṃ karoti yaḥ | sa tiṣṭhedraurave ghore varṣāṇāmayutaṃ śataṃ || 36.299 || tato'pi manujo mukto grāmasūkarajātitāṃ | grāme janmaśataṃ prāpya viṣṭhābhūsūkarastathā || 36.300 || yastu retovisargaṃ ca kṛtvā kāmādakāmataḥ | asnāto devatāgāramiyātsadyassa naśyati || 36.301 || yo yatra devatāgehe dantadhāvanamācareth | tathā nirlekhayejjihvāṃ sa pāpī naśyati dhruvaṃ || 36.302 || tailenābhyaktasarvāṅgaḥ kaṣāyodvartitastathā | yo naraḥpraviśedgehaṃ devasya paramātmanaḥ || 36.303 || sa yāti gṛhagodhātvaṃ navajanmāni pañca ca | anugamya yathā pretaṃ yāti devālayaṃ tu yaḥ || 36.304 || ārādhitumathecchedvāsa gacchennarāyutaṃ | balibhugyonitāṃ yāti janmāni subahūni vai || 36.305 || bharaṇaṃ tu tathā kṛtvā mṛtakasya viśeṣataḥ | mandiraṃ na praveṣṭavyaṃ praviṣṭastu praṇaśyati || 36.306 || cāṇḍālīṃ yonimāśritya janmakṛnnava pañca ca | bhaviṣyati tathā bhūyaḥ pṛthakkrūro'tha niṣṭhuraḥ || 36.307 || bhuktvāśrāddhaṃ paragṛhe yāyādviṣṇugṛhantu yaḥ | arcayedvā viśeṣeṇa caṭako jāyate khalaḥ || 36.308 || tatra janmaśataṃ prāpya tato godhāvapurgataḥ | chāyāmākramya yo mohādyāti viṣṇostu mandiraṃ || 36.309 || pradakṣiṇamakurvanvā yastiṣṭhenmatipūrvakaṃ | so'pyucchiṣṭobhavenmūḍhastasya pāpaphalaṃ tvidaṃ || 36.310 || tiṣsetsa kānane śūnye kaṇṭakairbahubhirvṛtaḥ | phalapuhpādihīnaśca śmaśāne? śūnyavṛkṣatāṃ || 36.311 || yajña sūtramadhaḥkṛtya karṇe kṛtvā viśeṣataḥ | apasavyaṃ ca dhṛtvaiva dhṛtvā caiva nivītavath || 36.312 || na gaccheddevatāgāraṃ na vā muktaśikho naraḥ | akacchaḥ pucchakacchaśca nagnaḥ kaupīnamātṛdhṛk || 36.313 || riktahastaśśūnyaphālastyaktasaṃvyāna eva ca | khādannapi ca tāṃbūlamupahārādi bhakṣayan || 36.314 || devālayaṃ viśennaiva tasya pāpaṃ mahadbhaveth | durācāro hi puruṣo nehāyurvindate mahath || 36.315 || trasyanti cāsya bhūtāni tathā paribhanantica | tasmādācāravāneva kuryādvaivaidikīḥ kriyāḥ || 36.316 || api pāpaśarīrasya ācāro hantyalakṣaṇaṃ | ācāralakṣaṇo dharmaḥ santaścāritralakṣaṇāḥ || 36.317 || sādhūnāṃ ca yathāvṛttametadācāralakṣaṇaṃ | apyadṛṣṭaṃ śravādeva puruṣaṃ dharmacāriṇaṃ || 36.318 || svāni karmāṇi kurvāṇaṃ taṃ janāḥ kurvate priyaṃ | ye nāstikā niṣkriyāśca guruśāstrātilaṅghinaḥ || 36.319 || adharmajñā durācārāste bhavantigatāyuṣaḥ | viśīlā dharmamaryādā nityaṃ saṃkīrṇamaithunāḥ || 36.320 || alpāyuṣo bhavantīhanarā nirayagāminaḥ | loṣṭhamardī tṛṇacchedī nakhakhādī ca yo naraḥ || 36.321 || nityocchiṣṭassaṃkusuko nehayurvindate kvacith | viṣṇusthānasamīpasthānviṣṇusevārthamāgatān || 36.322 || śvapacānpatitānvāpi spṛṣṭvā na snānamācareth | utsave vāsudevasya yaḥsnāti sparśaśaṅkayā || 36.323 || svargasthāḥ pitarastasya patanti narake'śucau | pibetpādodakaṃ viṣṇorgurūṇāṃ vā viśeṣataḥ || 36.324 || tatra nācamanaṃ kuryāttadvatsome dvijottamaḥ | anyadevārthasandiṣṭhaiḥ pūjayeyuśca ye hariṃ || 36.325 || saptajanmāni pañcāpi muḍūkatvaṃ vrajanti te | janmadvayantu vai mūḍhāśśūdratāṃ yānti te narāḥ || 36.326 || kusumānāṃ nivedyāhaṃ gandhamāghrāti yo naraḥ | sa pūtigandhasaṃyuktaḥ kuṣṭhī caiva bhaveddhruvaṃ || 36.327 || tadante trīṇi janmāni tādṛśāni bhavantyuta | jātakaṃ mṛtakaṃ vāpi yasyāśaucaṃ vidhīyate || 36.328 || anarhassarvakarmabhyo sa neyāddevatā gṛhaṃ | puṃprasūtau smṛtaṃ pūrvaissāpiṇḍyaṃ saptapūruṣaṃ || 36.329 || kanyakājanane tadvatsāpiṇḍantu tripūruṣaṃ | vratināṃ satriṇāṃ tadvadyatīnāṃ brahmacāriṇāṃ || 36.330 || nāśaucaḥ kathyate prājñairyathā śātātapo'bravīth | vratasaṃkalpamātreṇa vratitvaṃ vratino bhaveth || 36.331 || vṛtamātrastathartvikca satre satrī prakīrtitaḥ | kāṣāyadaṇḍamātreṇa yatitvañca yatermataṃ || 36.332 || upanīto vasenmā vā tathā gurukule kramāth | brahmādhyeti nacādhyeti brahmacārī kumārakaḥ || 36.333 || rājājñākāriṇāṃ tadvadrājñāṃ ca snātakasya car | idṛśānāmathānyeṣāmatrāstarbhāvariritaḥ || 36.334 || na kuryācca namaskāraṃ naiva pratyabhivādayeth | nār'payedupahārāṃśca tīrthādīnnāpi sevate || 36.335 || āśaucī brāhmaṇo yastu mohāddevaṃ prapūjayeth | saptajanmasu dāridṣamatyantaṃ samavāpnuyāth || 36.336 || śvānayoniśataṃ prāpya tataścaṇḍālatāmiyāth | yobhuktvā devatāgāre nikṣipyocchiṣṭamatra tu || 36.337 || gacchedanyatra vā prāsyātsopi mūḍho vipadyate | yastu devagṛhadvāre prasārya caraṇau kvacith || 36.338 || śete nidrāti sammohātsa yāti narakāyutaṃ | punaśca janma saṃprāpya nīcayoniṣvanekaśaḥ || 36.339 || yātanāścānubhūyeva daurbrāhmaṇyaṃ vrajettu saḥ | yastu devagṛhe mūḍhaśsayīta madamohitaḥ || 36.340 || tatrocchiṣṭanidhānena bhṛśaṃ niśśvāsamārutaiḥ | durgandhī jāyate martyojāyate janmapañcakaṃ || 36.341 || tatassūkaratāṃ prāpya janmāni nava pañca ca | kliśyate bahubhiḥ kaṣṭairna śayīta harergṛhe || 36.342 || upadhānādisahitaṃ ya stalpamadhitiṣṭhati | devālaye viśeṣeṇa prākāre vāpi mūḍhadhīḥ || 36.343 || sa bhaveddurbhagaścaiva sarpayauniṣu jāyate | sapta pañca ca janmāni tato mānuṣatāṃ vrajeth || 36.344 || śayīta devatāgehe vyādhito yastu durmatiḥ | sa bhaveddurmanā dīno pretya ceha ca janmani || 36.345 || yaḥstriyā sahito mūḍhaśśayīta bhagavadgṛhe | sa bhavedduritaṣṣaṇḍassaptajanmāni pañca ca || 36.346 || yogibhiryogasiddhyarthamabhyasyante viśeṣataḥ | āsanāni tvasaṃkhyāni devāgāre na cācareth || 36.347 || mantrayogaparaistadvallayayogaparāyaṇaiḥ | haṭhayogibhiretāni kriyante rājayogibhiḥ || 36.348 || svastikaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ siddhaṃ siṃhāsanaṃ tathā | savyaṃ khūlaṃ sukhaṃ caiva gomukhaṃ garuḍaṃ tathā || 36.349 || mayūraṃ matsyamatsyendraṃ maṇḍūkaṃ mudgaraṃ mṛgaṃ | kuñjaraṃ kukkuṭaṃ nāgaṃ kāṣṭhaṃ kraiñcaṃ ca kūrmakaṃ || 36.350 || khaḍgaṃ ca kāmadahanaṃ vaiyāghraṃ veṇukāsanaṃ | yonyāsanaṃ vāsakaṃ ca dhīraṃ padmāsanaṃ tathā || 36.351 || vārāhaṃ caiva paryaṅkaṃ patagāsanameva ca | tripadaṃ hastikarṇaṃ ca hemamardhāsanaṃ tathā || 36.352 || ityādīnā māsanā nāmaśītiśca turuttarā | anyāni śāstrasiddhāni yāni santi viśeṣataḥ || 36.353 || tānyāsthāyi tu devāgreno patiṣṭheta buddhimān | bhuñjīyāddevatāgāre yaḥ pāpassa tu durmanāḥ || 36.354 || kukṣirogārdito bhūtvā janmāni daśa pañca ca | tatassṛgālatāṃ prāpya pateddhi narake'śucau || 36.355 || yo vā mūḍhamatirmohātkārayeddvijabhojanaṃ | devāgāre viśeṣeṇa sa bhavennindito janaḥ || 36.356 || garbhāgāre cāntarāle tathā caivārdhamaṇḍape | mahāmaṇḍapamadhye ca nānnamadyādviśeṣataḥ || 36.357 || annaṃ pātre vinikṣipya puṭapatrādinirmite | āpośanaṃ tu kṛtvaiva yadadyādbhojanaṃ tutath || 36.358 || na devatāprasādasya gṛhītasyāñjalau tathā | na caivāpośanaṃ kuryātkuryāccettadasammataṃ || 36.359 || yastu pānīyapātrāṇi pītānyatra tu vinyaseth | sa gacchennarakānkrūrānyāvanta udabindavaḥ || 36.360 || pātre tiṣṭhanti śaradastāvatīrnātra saṃśayaḥ | niveditaṃ tu devasya devasyāgre viśeṣataḥ || 36.361 || pradadyāttu krameṇaiva varṇāśramavidhānataḥ | aśnantibhaktāssarve'pigṛhītvaivāṃjalau punaḥ || 36.362 || brahmaṇyadevamuddiśya puruṣaṃ brāhmaṇapriyaṃ | nārāyaṇamanādyantaṃ viṣṇuṃ sarveśvareśvaraṃ || 36.363 || brāhmaṇānbhojayedyastu karmasādguṇyasiddhaye | tathā niṣkṛtiniṣpattyaiśāstroktena vidhānataḥ || 36.364 || kārayennoktadeśeṣu kadāpi dvijabhojanaṃ | yastvannaṃ dāpayedvipro dvijebhyo bhaktisaṃyutaḥ || 36.365 || niveditaṃ tu devasya saṃtuṣṭyaisvasya tasya ca | tasya tuṣyati deveśa ādātā tu vipadyate || 36.366 || dātustu sakalaṃ pāpaṃ manovākkāyakarmabhiḥ | bahuśassaṃcitaṃ pūrvamādātā samavāpnuyāth || 36.367 || prasādo'pihi devasya parapākaruciṃ naraṃ | na jātu pāvayennaiva pāvayetpāvayenna tu || 36.368 || yadṛcchālābhasaṃtuṣṭaṃ yathā bhaktavaraṃ tathā | mahimānaṃ prasādasya yo'vajānāti mūḍhadhīḥ || 36.369 || tena bhuktaṃ bhavetpāpaṃ dātureva na saṃśayaḥ | ayutaṃ brāhmaṇānāntu tarpayitvātu yatphalaṃ || 36.370 || tatphalaṃ naśyati kṣipramucchiṣṭasya kaṇena tu | athānnavikrayedoṣaḥ kathyate vidhivittamaiḥ || 36.371 || annavikrayiṇaḥ pāpā vrajanti yamayātanāḥ | pretya sṛgālatāṃ yānti nava janmāni pañca ca || 36.372 || yastvannaṃ bhagavadgehe vikrīṇāti viśeṣataḥ | caṇḍālo jāyate pretya kṣudhitaśca carenmuhuḥ || 36.373 || vikrīṇate tu ye viprā vāṇijye dattacakṣuṣaḥ | ye'pyannamupahārādi cetaraddevamandire || 36.374 || te'pi yānti mahāghoraṃ narakaṃ bhṛśadāruṇaṃ | yatra naivabhaveṣyanti pālīyāyodabindavaḥ || 36.375 || kaṇamannasya vāna syāttapyante tatra te janāḥ | ye gṛhītvā tadannādi bhuñjate kṣudhitā janāḥ || 36.376 || upakurvantiye vā tānucyante'bhakṣyabhojanāḥ | annaṃ prāṇā manuṣyāṇāṃ sarvamanne pratiṣṭhitaṃ || 36.377 || annaṃ brahmātmakaṃ vindyādvindyādannamayīṃ tanuṃ | annaṃ vikrīṇate ye tu prāṇavikrayiṇaḥ smṛtāḥ || 36.378 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena tyajettatkraya vikrayau | na kuryāddevatā gehe'bhyudayaṃ śrāddhabhojanaṃ || 36.379 || kuryānna cāpi śrāddhādīnvihāyāpi dvijāśanaṃ | tasmātsarvaprayatnena nāśnīyāddharimandire || 36.380 || mudhā saṃbhāṣate yastu praviśya harimandiraṃ | sa nidhiṃ puratassiddhaṃ tyaktvā bhikṣati kākiṇīṃ || 36.381 || yastu saṃbhāṣate vyarthaṃ devālayamupāśritaḥ | siddhamannaṃ parityajya bhikṣāmaṭati durjanaḥ || 36.382 || yanmuhūrtaṃ kṣaṇaṃ vāpi paramātmāna cintyate | sā hānistanmamahacchidraṃ sā bhrāntissā tu vikriyā || 36.383 || dasyubhirmuṣiteneva dagdheneva davāgninā | vyādhibhiḥpīḍiteneva cākṛṣṭeneva mṛtyunā || 36.384 || bhītenevottamarṇena dharṣiteneva rājabhiḥ | magneneva mahāsiṃdhau hateneva ca vātyayā || 36.385 || saṃpiṣṭeneva pāṣāṇairākrandedyassa mucyate | santyanekā pradeśāśca samayāśca viśeṣataḥ || 36.386 || lokayātrāviniṣpattyai dehayātropayoginaḥ | tasmāddevagṛhaṃ gatvā naro nānyaparo bhaveth || 36.387 || yatprasaṃge harernāma tanmamahattvaṃ ca nāpyate | sa sarvo'pi mudhā proktomithyetyeke vadantitaṃ || 36.388 || na hi devasya purataḥ kvacidapyanṛtaṃ vadeth | satyasvarūpī bhagavānsatyaṃ tasmaina gūhayeth || 36.389 || satyameva paraṃ brahma satyameva paraṃ tapaḥ | satyameva paro yajñassatyameva paraṃ śrutaṃ || 36.390 || satyaṃ deveṣu jāgarti satyaṃ dharmataroḥ phalaṃ | tapoyajñaśca puṇyaṃ ca devarṣipitṛpūjanaṃ || 36.391 || ādyo vidhiśca vidyā ca sarvaṃ satye pratiṣṭhitaṃ | satyaṃ yajñantathā vedāssatyā devī sarasvatī || 36.392 || vratacaryā tathā satyamoṅkārassatyameva ca | satyena vāyurāvāti satyenār'kaḥ prakāśate || 36.393 || dahatyagniśca satyena yāyātsatyena sadgatiṃ | parjanyo dharaṇībhāge satyenāpaḥ pravarṣati || 36.394 || svādhyāyassarvavedānāṃ sarvatīrthāvagāhanaṃ | satyaṃ tu vadato loke tulitaṃ syānna saṃśayaḥ || 36.395 || aśvamedhasahasraṃ ca satyaṃ ca tulayā kṛtaṃ | aśvamedhasahasrāttu bhārassatye viśiṣyate || 36.396 || satyena devāḥ prīṇanti pitaro brāhmaṇāstathā | satyamāhuḥparaṃ dharmaṃ satyamāhuḥ paraṃ padaṃ || 36.397 || satyamāhuḥ paraṃ brahma tasmātsatyaṃ na lobhayeth | ye satyaniratāssatyaśapathāssatyavikramāḥ || 36.398 || mahatmāno muniśreṣṭhāste parāṃ siddhimāpnuvan | daivataissaha modante svarge satyaparāyaṇāḥ || 36.399 || apcarogaṇasaṃkīrṇairvimānaissaṃcaranti ca | vaktavyaṃ ca sadā satyaṃ na satyādvidyate paraṃ || 36.400 || agodhe vimale śuddhe satyatīrthe śucihrade | snātavyaṃ manasā yuktaistatsnānaṃ paramaṃ smṛtaṃ || 36.401 || devārthe vā parārthe vā putrārthe vā''tmane tathā | ye'nṛtaṃ nābhibhāṣante te svargaṃ yāntimānavāḥ || 36.402 || yassatyavādī puruṣo nānṛtaṃ paribhāṣate | saṃprāpya virajānlokānuṣitvā śāśvatīssamāḥ || 36.403 || bhagavadbhaktimuktānāṃ jāyate śrīmatāṃ kule | sākṣiṇassantisarvete devatā bhāskarādayaḥ || 36.404 || parīkṣante ca sarvāsu daśāsu puruṣaṃ sadā | na vācyamanṛtaṃ tasmātprāṇaiḥ kaṇṭhagatairapi || 36.405 || ye'nṛtaṃ bruvate mūḍhāśśapathāni ca kurvate | devāgāre viśeṣeṇa te praṇaśyanti sānvayaṃ || 36.406 || punarjanmaśataṃ yānti kīṭaḍayoniṣvanekaśaḥ | gītavāditranṛttādīnpuṇyākhyānakathāśca ye || 36.407 || lopayantyatha pāruṣyairmandire madhuvidviṣaḥ | te yānti narakaṃ pāpā jāyante nīcayoniṣu || 36.408 || tathā te'pi durātmāno gārdabhīṃ yonimāpnuyuḥ | tathānte krūrā nava janmāni pañca ca || 36.409 || anibaddhapralāpānye kurvate devamandire | te'pi tittiritāṃ bhūtvā jāyante janmapañcakaṃ || 36.410 || devabhāṣāṃ parityajya deśabhāṣāsu yo naraḥ | stuvīta devatāgehe devasyāgre viśeṣataḥ || 36.411 || tasya doṣomahānāśu naiva pūjāphalaṃ bhaveth | asārāṇi tu śāstrāṇi bhūyāṃsi pṛthivītale || 36.412 || yatra devasya mahātmyakathanaṃ na prapañcyate | teṣu śāstreṣu ye jātāśśāstrārthāśca viśeṣataḥ || 36.413 || vādāśca prativādāśca saṃskārāssarva eva hi | citraśilpā na saṃdeho narastena na mucyate || 36.414 || sā vidyā yā hariṃ stauti sā kriyā yattadarcanaṃ | yā nyā yadanyadakhilaṃ duṣṭodarkā hi jīvikā || 36.415 || na hi devagṛhaṃ gatvā śāstrārthairnī rasairnaraḥ | muhūrtaṃ kṣapayetkālaṃ taddevasya vimānanā || 36.416 || viśālaṃ vāṅmayaṃ sarvaṃ sṛṣṭvā sraṣṭā hariḥ prabhuḥ | tadantassaṃpraviśyaiva vācyavācakabhedataḥ || 36.417 || vijñānāya manuṣyāṇāṃ vijñānaghanavigrahaḥ | sadopakurute yasmātsarve bhaktavarāḥ sadā || 36.418 || sarvā vāco vimucyānyāścintayānāśca sādaraṃ | tanmahattvakathāgandhadaridraṃ vācanaṃ tathā || 36.419 || pāṭhanaṃ lekhanādyaṃ ca naiva kuryādgṛhe hareḥ | sa bhavedakṣaradroṅī yastu kuryādvyatikramaṃ || 36.420 || druhyetsa vāṅmayāyāpi tasmādyuktataro bhaveth | yastu devagṛhaṃ gatvā roditi praṇayādyathā || 36.421 || duḥkhitaḥ stauti vā devaṃ tatsyānmānasikaṃ malaṃ | nirvāṇaparamaṃ sthānaṃ mlānena manasā tu yaḥ || 36.422 || sevate sa na jānāti tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padaṃ | nārī vā puruṣo vāpi gatvā devagṛhaṃ kvacith || 36.423 || na rodetpātayennāśru naivānyaṃ rodayedapi | yāvantyaśrūṇi rudatāṃ pateyurdevamandire || 36.424 || tāvantyabdasahasrāṇi te vasanti yamālaye | anubhūya punastatra yātanāstīvracodanāḥ || 36.425 || prāpya tittiritāṃ kālaṃ vasiṣyanti ciraṃ bhuvi | naivātra hiṃsāṃ kurvīta prāṇināṃ duḥkhadāṃ kvacith || 36.426 || ahiṃsā vaidikaṃ karma dhyānamindriyanigrahaḥ | tapo'tha guruśuśrūṣā dharmadvārāṣṣaḍīritāḥ || 36.427 || ahiṃsāpāśrayaṃ dharmaṃ dānto vidvānsamācareth | trīdaṇḍaṃ sarvabhūteṣu nidhāya puruṣaśśuciḥ || 36.428 || kāmakrodhau ca saṃyamya tataḥ siddhimavāpnu te | ahiṃsakāni bhūtāni daṇḍena vinihantiyaḥ || 36.429 || ātmanassukhamanvicchansa pretya na sukhī bhaveth | ātmopamastu bhūteṣu yo vaibhavati pūruṣaḥ || 36.430 || tyaktadaṇḍo jitakrodhassa pretya sukhamedhate | sarvabhūtātmabhūtasya sarvabhūtāni paśyataḥ || 36.431 || muhyanti mārge devāśca hyapadasya padaiṣiṇaḥ | na tatparasya saṃdadhyātpratikūlaṃ yadātmanaḥ || 36.432 || eṣa sāṃgrāhiko dharmaḥkāmādanyaḥ pravartate | prakhyāpane ca dāne ca sukhaduḥkhe priyāpriye || 36.433 || ātmauvamyena puruṣaḥ pramāṇamadhigacchati | ṛṣayo brāhmaṇā devāḥ praśaṃsanti viśeṣataḥ || 36.434 || ahiṃsālakṣaṇaṃ dharmaṃ vedaprāmāṇyadarṇanāth | karmaṇā na naraḥ kurvanhiṃsāṃ jātu vicakṣaṇaḥ, || 36.435 || vācā ca manasā caiva tato duḥkhātpramucyate | caturvidheyaṃ nirdiṣṭā hyahiṃsā brahmavādibhiḥ || 36.436 || ekaikato'pi vibhraṣṭā na bhavennātra saṃśayaḥ | yathā sarvaścatuṣpādvai tribhiḥ pādairna tiṣṭhati || 36.437 || tathaiveyaṃ viśeṣeṇa kāraṇaiḥ procyate tribhiḥ | yathā nāgapade'nyāni padāni padagāmināṃ || 36.438 || sarvāṇyevāpidhīyante padajātāni kaiñjare | evaṃ lokeṣvahiṃsā tu nirdiṣṭādharmataḥ purā || 36.439 || na hyatassadṛśaṃ kiñcidihaloke paratra ca | yatsarveṣviha bhūteṣu dayāhiṃsātmikā tu yā || 36.440 || na bhayaṃ vidyate jātu narasyeha dayāvataḥ | dayāvatāmime lokāḥ paratrāpi tapasvināṃ || 36.441 || abhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyo yo dadāti dayāparaḥ | abhayaṃ sarvabhūtāni dadatīti jagau śrutiḥ || 36.442 || kṣataṃ ca patitaṃ caiva skhalitaṃ klinnamāhataṃ | sarvabhūtāni rakṣanti sameṣu viṣameṣu ca || 36.443 || nainaṃ vyālamṛgā ghnanti na piśācā na rākṣasāḥ | mucyate bhayakāleṣu mokṣayedyo bhaye parān || 36.444 || prāṇadānātparaṃ dānaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati | na hyātmanaḥ priyakaraṃ kiṃ cidastīha niścitaṃ || 36.445 || aniṣṭaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ maraṇaṃ nāma kathyate | mṛtyukāle hi bhūtānāṃ sadyo jāyeta vepathuḥ || 36.446 || vyādhijanmajarāduḥkhairnityaṃ saṃsārasāgare | jantavaḥ parivartante maraṇādudvijanti ca || 36.447 || garbhavāseṣu pacyante kṣārāmlakaṭukai rasaiḥ | mūtrasvedapurīṣāṇāṃ paruṣairbhṛśadāruṇaiḥ || 36.448 || jātāścāpyavaśāstatra chidyamānāḥ punaḥ punaḥ | hanyamānāśca dṛśyante vivaśā ghātukā narāḥ || 36.449 || kuṃbhīpākeca pacyantetāṃ tāṃ yonimupāgatāḥ | ākramya māryamāṇāśca trāsyantyanye punaḥ punaḥ || 36.450 || nātmano'sti priyatamaḥ pṛthivīmanusṛtya ha | tasmātrāṇeṣu sarveṣu dayāvānātmavānbhaveth || 36.451 || yena yena śarīraṇa yadyatkarmakaroti yaḥ | tena tena śarīraṇa tattatphalamupāśnute || 36.452 || ahiṃsā paramo dharmastathāhiṃsā paro damaḥ | ahiṃsā paramaṃ dānamahiṃsā paramaṃ tapaḥ || 36.453 || ahiṃsā paramo yajñastathāhiṃsā paraṃ phalaṃ | ahiṃsā paramaṃ mitramahiṃsā paramaṃ sukhaṃ || 36.454 || sarvayajñeṣu vā dānaṃ sarvatīrtheṣu vā plutaṃ | sarvadānaphalaṃ vāpi naitattulyamahiṃsayā || 36.455 || ahiṃsrasya tapo'kṣayyamahiṃsro jayate sadā | ahiṃsrassarvabhūtānāṃ yathā mātā yathā pitā || 36.456 || tasmādahiṃsrassatatamupavāsa vrataṃ careth | phalamaṅgirasāproktamupavāsasya vistarāth || 36.457 || trirātraṃ pañcarātraṃ vā saptarātramathāpi vā | dhānyānyapi na hiṃseta yassa bhūyādahiṃsakaḥ || 36.458 || nāśnāti yāvato jīvastāvatpuṇyena yajyate | āhārasya viyogena śarīraṃ paritapyate || 36.459 || tapyamāne śarīre tu śarīre cendriyāṇi tu | tiṣṭhanti svavaśe tasya nṛpāṇāmiva kiṅkarāḥ || 36.460 || niruṇaddhīndriyāṇyeva sa sukhī sa vicakṣaṇaḥ | indriyāṇāṃ nirodhena dānena ca damena ca || 36.461 || narassarvamavāpnoti manasā yadyadicchati | evaṃ mūlamahiṃsāyā upavāsaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 36.462 || kāmānyānyānnaro bhaktyā manasecchati mādhavāth | vratopavāsanātprītastānprayacchatyasau hariḥ || 36.463 || māse māse tathaikasminnekasminniyataṃ careth || 36.464 || upavāsavratamidaṃ tasyānantaṃ phalaṃ bhaveth | ekādaśyāṃ nirāhārassaṃpūjya harimavyayaṃ || 36.465 || tatpādasalilaṃ tadvattulasīṃ ca tadarpitāmā | pītvā ca bhakṣayitvā ca upavāsavrataṃ careth || 36.466 || upavāsadine yastu tīrdhaṃ śrītulasīyutaṃ | na prāśnīyādvimūḍhātmā rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajeth || 36.467 || na hi devagṛhaṃ gatvā vivadeta naraḥ kvacith | na tatsthānaṃ vivādasya tasmāttaṃ dūrata styajeth || 36.468 || mano'navasthitaṃ yasya sa nālaṃ pūjitaṃ hariṃ | yasyaiva nirmalaṃ cittaṃ sor'hassarveṣu karmasu || 36.469 || rāgādyapetaṃ hṛdayaṃ vāgaduṣṭānṛtādinā | hiṃsādirahitaḥ kāyaḥ keśavārādhane trayaṃ || 36.470 || rāgādidūṣite cittaṃ nāspadaṃ kurute hariḥ | na badhnāti padaṃ haṃsaḥ kadācitkardamāṃbhasi || 36.471 || na yogyā mādhavaṃ stotuṃ vāgduṣṭā cānṛtādinā | tamaso nāśanāyālaṃ meghacchannona candrayāḥ || 36.472 || hiṃsādidūṣitaḥ kāyaḥ prabhavennārcane hareḥ | janacittaprasādāya yathā kāśastamovṛtaḥ || 36.473 || manodoṣavihīnānāṃ na doṣassyātkathaṃ ca na | anyathāliṅgyate kāntā snehena duhitānyathā || 36.474 || yateśca kāmukānāṃ ca yoṣidrūbe'nyathā matiḥ | aśikṣayaiva manasaḥ prāyo lokaśca vañcyate || 36.475 || lāletyudvijate loko vaktrāsava iti spṛhā | viśuddhaiḥ karaṇaistasmādvrajeddevagṛhaṃ naraḥ || 36.476 || vivādaḥ krodhajo yasmāttasmāttaṃ parivarjayeth | kruddhaḥ pāpaṃ na kuryātkaḥ kruddho hanyādgurūnapi || 36.477 || kruddhaḥ paruṣayā vācā narassādhūnadhikṣipeth | sādhusajjanasantāpaḥ sādhūnāṃ ca vimānanā || 36.478 || dahatyāsaptamaṃ tasya kulaṃ nātra vicāraṇā | vācyāvācyaṃ prakupito na vicānāti karhi cith || 36.479 || nākāryamaste kruddhasya nāvācyaṃ vidyate kvacith | yassamutpatitaṃ krodhaṃ kṣamayā tu nirasyati || 36.480 || yathoragastvacaṃ jīrṇāṃ sa vai puruṣa ucyate | te mānyāḥpuruṣaśreṣṭhāḥ kṣamayā krodhamuddhitaṃ || 36.481 || nirvāpayante ye nityaṃ dīptamagnimivāṃbhasā | parāpavādaṃ na brūyānnāpriyaṃ ca kadā cana || 36.482 || na manyuḥ kaścidutpādyo mahatāṃ devasannidhau | svayaṃ dattāvadhānastu devakārye viśeṣataḥ || 36.483 || manyeta bhagavatsarge svātmānaṃ cāpyakiñcanaṃ | sa eva bhagavāndevassarvajñaḥ sarvaśaktiyuk || 36.484 || sarveśassarvavitsarvonigrahānugrahe rataḥ | tasmānnānyasya jātvasti śaktiḥ krodhaprasādayoḥ || 36.485 || iti saṃcintya bhūyo'pi sarveṣvapi ca jantuṣu | bhagavatsannidhau sthitvā ānṛśaṃsyaṃ prayojayeth || 36.486 || yadyadbhāvi bhavadbhūtaṃ vidyāttattasya ceṣṭhitaṃ | yadyahaṅkāramāśritya svātantṣamadamohitaḥ || 36.487 || nigrahe'nugrahe vāpi śaktiṃ svasyāvabodhayeth | sa yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ na daivaṃ tasya mṛṣyati || 36.488 || tathā strīṇāṃ viśeṣaṇa tyājyā syādatisaṃgatiḥ | devatāmandiraṃ prāpya kāleṣvanyeṣu vā tathā || 36.489 || āyuryaśastapohāniḥ puṃsāṃ strīṣvatisaṃgināṃ | puruṣeṣvatisaktānāṃ tulyā sā yoṣitāmapi || 36.490 || kulīnā rūpavatyaśca nāthavatyaśca yoṣitaḥ | maryādāsu sa tiṣṭhanti sa doṣaḥ strīṣu garhitaḥ || 36.491 || na strībhyaḥ paramanyadvai pāpīyastaramasti vai | striyo hi mūlaṃ doṣāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || 36.492 || samājñātānṛddhimataḥ pratirūpānva śesthitān | patīnantaramāsādya nālaṃ nāryaḥ parīkṣituṃ || 36.493 || asaddharmastvayaṃ strīṇāṃ prāyeṇa hi bhavedbhuvi | pāpīyaso narānyadvai tyaktalajjā bhajantitāḥ || 36.494 || strīyaṃ hi yaḥ prārthayate sannikarṣaṃ ca gacchatir | iṣacca kurute sevāṃ tamevecchanti yoṣitaḥ || 36.495 || anarthitvānmanuṣyāṇāṃ bhayātparijanasya ca | maryādāyāmamaryādāḥ strīyastiṣṭhanti bhartṛṣu || 36.496 || nāsāṃ kaścidagamyo'stināsāṃ vayasi saṃsthitiḥ | rūpavantaṃ virūpaṃ vā pumānityeva bhuñjate || 36.497 || na bhayānnāpyanukrośnānnār'thahetoḥ kathaṃ ca na | na jñātikulasaṃbandhāttsriyastiṣṭhanti bhartṛṣu || 36.498 || yauvane vartamānānāṃ mṛṣṭābharaṇavāsasāṃ | nārīṇāṃ svairavṛttīnāṃ spṛhayanti kulastrīyaḥ || 36.499 || yāśca śasvadbahumatā rakṣyante dayitāḥstrīyaḥ | api tāḥ saṃprasajjante kubjāndhajūvāmanaiḥ || 36.500 || paṅguṣvanyeṣu kuṣṭheṣu ye cānye kutsitā narāḥ | strīṇāmagamyo loke'sminnāsti kaśchidihodyate || 36.501 || yadi puṃsāṃ gatistatra kathaṃ cinnopapadyate | apyanyonyaṃ pravartantena hi tiṣṭhanti bhartṛṣu || 36.502 || duṣṭhācārāḥ pāparatā asatyā māyayā vṛtāḥ | adṛṣṭabuddhibahulāḥ prāyeṇetyavadhāryate || 36.503 || alābhātpuruṣāṇāṃ hi bhayātparijanasya ca | vadhabandhabhayāccāpi svayaṃ guptā bhavanti tāḥ || 36.504 || calasvabhāvā dussevyā durgrāhyā bhāvatastathā | prājasya puruṣasyeva yathā bhāvāstathā strīyaḥ || 36.505 || nāgnistṛpyati kāṣṭhānāṃ nāpagānāṃ mahodadhiḥ | nāntakassarvabhūtānāṃ na puṃsāṃ vāmalocanāḥ || 36.506 || rahasyamidamanyacca vijñeyaṃ sarvayoṣitāṃ | dṛṣṭvaiva puruṣaṃ hyanyaṃ yoniḥ praklidyate striyāḥ || 36.507 || kāmānāmapi dātāraṃ kartāraṃ mānasāntvayoḥ | rakṣitāraṃ na mṛṣyanti svabhartāramasatstriyaḥ || 36.508 || na kāmabhogānvipulānnālaṅkārārtha saṃcayān | tathaiva bahumanyante yathā ratyāmanugrahaṃ || 36.509 || antakaḥ śamano mṛtyuḥ pātālaṃ baḍabāmukhaṃ | kṣuradhārā viṣaḥ sarpo vahnirityekataḥ striyaḥ || 36.510 || etā hi svīyamāyābhirvañcayantīha mānavān | na cāsāṃ mucyate kaścitpuruṣo hastamāgataḥ || 36.511 || gāvo navatṛṇānīva gṛhṇantyetā navaṃ navaṃ | śaṃbarasya ca yā māyā yā māyā namucerapi || 36.512 || baleḥ kuṃbhīnaseścaiva tāssarvāyoṣito viduḥ | hasantaṃ prahasantyetā rudantaṃ prarudanti ca || 36.513 || apriyaṃ priyavākyaiśca gṛhṇate kālayogataḥ | yadi jihmā sahasraṃ syājjīvecca śaradāṃ śataṃ || 36.514 || ananyakarmā strīdoṣānanuktvā nidhanaṃ vrajeth | uśanā veda yacchāstraṃ yacca veda bṛhaspatiḥ || 36.515 || strībuddhyā na viśiṣyeta surakṣyā na bhavantitāḥ | anṛtaṃ satyamityāhussatyaṃ cāpi tathānṛtaṃ || 36.516 || iti yāstāḥ kathaṃ rakṣyāḥ puruṣairdurbharāḥ striyaḥ | saṃpūjyamānāḥ puruṣairvikurvanti mano nṛṣu || 36.517 || apāstāśca tathā sadyo vikurvanti manaḥ striyaḥ | na ca strīṇāṃ kriyāḥ kāściditi dharmo vyavasthitaḥ || 36.518 || nirindriyā hyaśāstrāśca strīyo'nṛtamiti śrutiḥ | śayyāsanamalaṅkāramanna pānamanāryatāṃ || 36.519 || durvāgarbhavaṃ ratiṃ caiva dadau strībhyaḥ prajāpatiḥ | na tāsāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ śakyaṃ kartuṃ puṃsāṃ kathaṃ cana || 36.520 || api viśvakṛtā caiva kutastu puruṣairiha | vācā ca vadhabandhairvā kleśairvā vividhaistathā || 36.521 || na śakyā rakṣitāṃ nāryastā hi nityamasaṃyatāḥ | avidvāṃsamalaṃloke vidvāṃsamapi vā punaḥ || 36.522 || pramadāhyutpathaṃ netuṃ kāmakrodhavaśānugaṃ | nātaḥ paraṃ hi nārīṇāṃ vidyate ca kadā cana || 36.523 || yathā puruṣa saṃsargaḥ parametatphalaṃ viduḥ | ātmacchandena vartante nāryo manmathacoditāḥ || 36.524 || na ca dahyanti gacchantyaḥ sutaptairapi pāṃsubhiḥ | nānilo'gnirna varuṇo na cānye tridaśāntathā || 36.525 || priyāḥ strīṇāṃ yathā kāmo ratiśīlā hi yoṣitaḥ | sahasrekila nārīṇāṃ prāpyetaikā kadā cana || 36.526 || tathā śatasahasreṣu yadi kācitpativratā | naitā jānanti pitaraṃ na kulaṃ na ca mātaraṃ || 36.527 || na bhrātṝnna ca bhartāraṃ na ca putrānna devarān | līlāyantyaḥ kulaṃ ghnanti kūlānīva saridvarāḥ || 36.528 || strīṣvāyāsasametasya ye puṃsaśśakrabindavaḥ | na te sukhāya mantavyāḥ svedajā iva bindavaḥ || 36.529 || kṛmibhistudyamānasya kuṣṭhinaḥ pāmanasya vā | kaṇḍūyanāgnitāpābhyāṃ yatsukhaṃ strīṣu tadviduḥ || 36.530 || yādṛśaṃ vidyate saukhyaṃ kaṇḍūpūyavinirgame | tādṛśaṃ strīṣu vijñeyaṃ nādhikaṃ tāsu vidyate || 36.531 || granthestu vedanā yadvatsphuṭitasya nivartane | tadvatstrīṣvapi vijñeyaṃ na saukhyaṃ paramārthataḥ || 36.532 || varcomūtravisargāttu sukhaṃ bhavati yādṛśaṃ | tādṛśaṃ strīṣu vijñeyaṃ nādhikaṃ tāsu vidyate || 36.533 || na cāṇumātramapyeve sukhamasti vicārataḥ | tathā devotsavādīnāṃ sevā tāsāṃ niṣidhyate || 36.534 || na hi svatantrato yoṣijjātu gacchetsthalāntaraṃ | na hi nirmimate vṛddhā līlayā devamandirān || 36.535 || kāmukānāṃ vilāsārthaṃ tasmādyuktataro bhaveth | anugacchetpitā bhrātā bhartā putro'tha vā yadi || 36.536 || tadā devagṛhaṃ yāyānnānyathā jātu kāminī | dhyāyato viṣayānpuṃsassaṃgasteṣūpajāyate || 36.537 || saṃgātsaṃjāyate kāmaḥ kāmātkrodho'bhijāyate | krodhādbhavati sammohassammohātsmṛtivibhramaḥ || 36.538 || smṛtibhraṃśādbuddhināśo buddhināśātpraṇaśyati | balavānindriyagrāmo vidvāṃsamapikarṣati || 36.539 || tasmātstrīyā bhavedvidvānnātisaktaḥ kathaṃ cana | tasmātstrīṣu na kartavyaḥ prasaṃgo devatākṛhe || 36.540 || tathaiva paradārebhyo manaḥ prahiṇuyānna ca | paradārā na gantavyā narairṛddhimabhīpsubhiḥ || 36.541 || na hīdṛśamanāyuṣyaṃ loke kiṃ cana vidyate | yādṛśaṃ puruṣasyeha paradāraniṣevanaṃ || 36.542 || tādṛśaṃ vidyate kiñci danāyuṣyaṃ nṛṇāmiha | yāvanto romakūpāḥ syuḥ strīṇāṃ gātreṣu nirmitāḥ || 36.543 || tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi narakaṃ paryupāsate | atisaṃgaṃ tyajettasmādyoṣitāṃ devamandire || 36.544 || yairasabhyaḥ padairarthaḥ padenaikena vā tathā | gamyate kathanaṃ tādṛgaślīlaṃ parivarjayeth || 36.545 || aślīlakathanāccaiva bhavedudvejanaṃ nṛṇāṃ | bhaktānāṃ bhagavadgehe bhaveccittamathāvilaṃ || 36.546 || nivarteta manastatra niviṣṭaṃ paramātmani | tasmādaślīlamābhāṣṭa naraḥ pāpaparo bhaveth || 36.547 || sa tu caṇḍālatāṃ prāpya jāyate janmanāṃ śataṃ | artona praviśedgehaṃ devasya paramātmanaḥ || 36.548 || vāyubhūte śarīre'sminvāyusaṃcārakarmaṇi | malavāyuvisargastu devagehe viśeṣataḥ || 36.549 || pātayetpuruṣaṃ satyamapi vedāntapāragaṃ | tasmādapānagandhasya visargaṃ naiva cācareth || 36.550 || atha vāyunirodhetu vyādhikopo bhaviṣyati | tasmādvāyuvisargaṃ tu kuryādevāvicārayan || 36.551 || iti devagṛhaṃ gantuṃ vyādhito naiva cārhati | tathā kuṣṭhī viśeṣeṇa pāparogārditāssame || 36.552 || udvīkṣituṃ ca deveśaṃ mandire madhusūdanaṃ | arcituṃ sevituṃ cāpi dātuṃ dravyacayaṃ tathā || 36.553 || nārhantiyasmāttatsaktaṃ pāpaṃ sāṃkrāmikaṃ bhaveth | yadyanyathā bhavetsadyassa pāpī saṃprajāyate || 36.554 || janmāni nava pañcāpi jāyate malabhukkṛmiḥ | yadā viśedgṛhaṃ viṣṇossevārdhaṃ madhuvidviṣaḥ || 36.555 || kṛtvopavītavatsamyaguttarīyaṃ manoharaṃ | seveta devadevaśamupavītaḥ sadā śuciḥ || 36.556 || kañcukenāvṛtāṅgastu na gaccheddharimandiraṃ | naivābhivādanaṃ kuryānnābhivādyaḥ sa uccate || 36.557 || uṣṇīṣī na ca seveta naiva pāṇau dhṛtāyudhaḥ | vastreṇācchādya dehantukambalenetareṇa vā || 36.558 || yogacchedvaiṣṇavaṃ dhāma yo vāpi praṇameddhariṃ | śvitrī saṃjāyate mūḍho navajanmāni pañca ca || 36.559 || kṣoṃādibhirvā saṃvīto yo naraḥpraṇameddhariṃ | caṇḍālayonitāṃ yāti nava janmāni pañca ca || 36.560 || na jātu tvamitabrūyādāpannopi mahattaraṃ | tvaṅkāro vā vadho veti vidvatsu na niśiṣyate || 36.561 || paranindā parasyaiva puṃso nindā bhaviṣyati | paranindā ca śāstrasya parasya tu vinindanaṃ || 36.562 || paranindā bhavetkrodhātkrodhātsadyo vinaśyati | nindayā vai pareṣāṃ tu ninditāste punassmṛtāḥ || 36.563 || tasmānnidāṃ pareṣāṃ tudevāgre parivarjayeth | tathā parastutiṃ caiva vidhinā saṃtyajennaraḥ || 36.564 || paraḥ parātmā puruṣaḥ purāṇaḥ procyate tu yaḥ | tadagre'nyasya devasya na stutiṃ stāvayennaraḥ || 36.565 || yastu sarveśvarādanyamadhikaṃ tasya cāgrataḥ | pūjayedyadi manyeta pūjārhaṃ vāsa naśyati || 36.566 || sarvaṃ jagacca tasyaiva svarūpaṃ paramātmanaḥ | tathāpi tattadrūṣeṇa tāratamyajuṣā punaḥ || 36.567 || pūjyate bhagavānbhaktaistatra śāstroditā gatiḥ | tasmāddeveśvarādanyadyatkiñcitthsāṇu jaṅgamaṃ || 36.568 || pūjārhaṃ vidyate vastu taddhāmani viśeṣataḥ | tasmātpūjāṃ stutiṃ cānyāmitareṣāmasaṃśayaṃ || 36.569 || tyajeddevagṛhe yastu sukhaṃ manyeta jīvituṃ | śaktau satyāṃ viśeṣeṇa yastulobhādinā naraḥ || 36.570 || gauṇairarcayate viṣṇamupacārairudīritaiḥ | na tasya vidyate puṇyaṃ sa tūcchāstraṃ vravartate || 36.571 || yāvatā kīrtyateśāstre phalamāḍhyadaridrayoḥ | tattacchaktyarpitaireva yathārhaṃ ca dhanādikaiḥ || 36.572 || yathā tuṣyatideveśo muktāhāreṇa bhūbhujāṃ | tathaiva tulasīdāmnā durvidhasyāpi tuṣyati || 36.573 || tasmātkurvīta yatnena śaktilobhaṃ na jātu cith | anyathā yadi kurvāṇaḥ phalaṃ naiva prapadyate || 36.574 || pretya mārjāratāṃ prāpya jāyate janmapañcakaṃ | viṣaṃ prāśnāti sammūḍho yassvasmai pacate naraḥ || 36.575 || yo'dyādannaṃ kaṇaṃ vāpi yadviṣṇoraniveditaṃ | sa bhavedbrahmahābhūyaḥ sa bhuṅktepūyaśoṇitaṃ || 36.576 || yatpibecca yadaśnīyātyaccajighrecca dhārayeth | anuliṃpecca yattattannivedyāgre madhudviṣe || 36.577 || tanniveditaśeṣaṃ tu bhuñjīyādvopayojayeth | viṣṇorniveditaṃ yastu na bhuṅkte manujādhamaḥ || 36.578 || kalpakoṭiśatenāpi niṣkṛtirnāsya vidyate | niveditaṃ tu yadviṣṇorbhaktebhyastasya dāpanāth || 36.579 || prīyatbhagavāndevastatparastu bhavennaraḥ | niveditaṃ yadi brūyāducchiṣṭamiti mandadhīḥ || 36.580 || sa tu durgatimāsādya vindate yamayātanāḥ | vibhūtiṃ samupāśritya yasyānantasya śāśvataṃ || 36.581 || samṛddhā dharaṇī seyaṃ saśailavanakānanā | yā ca bhūyāṃsi loke'sminnutpādayati santataṃ || 36.582 || oṣadhīrnikhilā stadvatpuṣpāṇi ca phalāni ca | tasyānṛṇyasyahetorvaiya teta vidhinā naraḥ || 36.583 || yastu nār'payate viṣṇostattatkālodbhavāni tu | sasyāni cauṣadhīstadvatphalāni kusumāni ca || 36.584 || saṃbhṛtāni yathāśakti sabhavedbrahmahnaraḥ | navāni kāle jātāni sasyādīni viśeṣataḥ || 36.585 || dhyāyanti devadeveśamabhigantuṃ yatanti ca | kadarthayantoye mūḍhāsteṣāmabhyarthanaṃ paraṃ || 36.586 || audāsīnyena tiṣṭhanti svayaṃ vāpyupayuñjate | teyāntinarakānghorānkṛtaghnā yāntiyānbahūn || 36.587 || śapantyauṣadhayassarvāstasmādbhaktyā viśeṣataḥ | navaṃ sasyaṃ phalaṃ puṣpaṃ dadhikṣīraṃ ghṛtaṃ madhu || 36.588 || yadarhamarpaṇe sarvamagre tasmai samarpayeth | lobhānmohādathājñānādya ucchiṣṭaṃ nivedayeth || 36.589 || deveśāya viśeṣeṇa sa bhavetpātakī naraḥ | ucchiṣṭa manyadevasya yo devāya nivedayeth || 36.590 || so'pi caṇḍālatāṃ prāpya naśyedeva na saṃśayaḥ | niveditaṃ tu devasya ya ucchiṣṭena yojayeth || 36.591 || devānāmita reṣāṃ vā manuṣyāṇāmathāpi vā | sa pāpī janmasāhasraṃ śvānayoniṣu jāyate || 36.592 || na hi devagṛhaṃ gatvā pṛṣṭī kṛtyāsanaṃ careth | devābhimukha eva syādbhaktassarvātmanānaraḥ || 36.593 || na pṛṣṭhaṃ darśayejjātu devāgre hitacintakaḥ | pārśvatastu caranneva nivartetālayaṃ prati || 36.594 || naivānyaṃ praṇamejjātu praviśya harimandiraṃ | sa hi sarveśvara śśeṣī yastatrāste ramādhavaḥ || 36.595 || pūjārhaśca praṇāmārhaḥ pūjārhastatra netaraḥ | yastathā praṇamenmūḍhassa yāti narakāyutaṃ || 36.596 || caṇḍālayonimāsādya bhajate yātanā muhuḥ | yastu devagṛhaṃ prāptānvaiṣṇavānbhagavatpriyān || 36.597 || ācāryamṛtvijaścātha pūjakānparicārakān | nār'cayenmaunamāsthāya sa vinaśyati sānvayaḥ || 36.598 || yadiṣṭaṃ yājakebhyassyātpūraṇāyeva tasyatu | bhaktāḥ paricareyuśca viśeṣādgrāmavāsinaḥ || 36.599 || anyathā cenmadoṣassarveṣāṃ ca vipacadbhaveth | atmānaṃ yo viśeṣeṇastautyahaṅkāra bhāvidaḥ || 36.600 || anādṛtya gurūndaivamanibaddhaṃ ca saṃpadeth | avalīptona jānāti doṣamātmani saṃgataṃ || 36.601 || kulavidyātapassampatpramukhairgarvite naraḥ | na sukhaṃ na ca saubhāgyaṃ yenātmāntūyate svayaṃ || 36.602 || tasmādātmastutiṃ kṛtvā naraḥ patati niścayaṃ | tato janmaśataṃ prāpya mṛgayonau viśeṣataḥ || 36.603 || jāyate mriyate'bhīkṣṇaṃ tasya pāpaṃ mahadbhaveth | yasdevagṛhaṃ gatvā vāñchatyapacitiṃ janaḥ || 36.604 || sa tu tittiritāṃ yāti navajanmāni pañca ca | deveśasyatu sevārthaṃ varṇānāmānupūrvyaśaḥ || 36.605 || adhikāraḥ samākhyātastatkramaṃ na vimānayeth | viśanti garbhagehetu ye vaikhānasasūtriṇaḥ || 36.606 || garbhāgāre praveṣṭavyo na hyavaikhānasaḥ kvacith | antarāle tathā yeṣāṃ sthānaṃ tattu pravakṣyate || 36.607 || anye dvijāśca tiṣṭhanti yathā syādāśramakramaḥ | te dvijāstatstrīyaścāpi sevante tatra saṃgatāḥ || 36.608 || kṣatrajātā viśeṣaṇa sthitvā caivār'dhamaṇḍape | deveśamabhisevante tadīyā yāśca yoṣitaḥ || 36.609 || saṃgatāśśūdrajātāśca pratilomabhavāścaye | mahāmaṇḍapamāsthāya sevante puruṣottamaṃ || 36.610 || anulomabhuvaścaivaye cānye mlecchajātayaḥ | gopurādbāhyataḥ sthitvā sevante mandiraṃ hareḥ || 36.611 || tāratamyamidaṃ jñātvā seveta satataṃ hariṃ | devatānindanaṃ kuryādyassa pāpīna mucyate || 36.612 || anyadevasamaṃ yastu manyate puruṣottamaṃ | caṇḍālayonitāmeti nava janmāni pañca ca || 36.613 || apahnutya punardevāṃ staddravyādi harettu yaḥ | sa bhaveddevahā satyaṃ jāyate śvādiyoniṣu, || 36.614 || tiraskṛtya tathā devānbhagavacchāstrameva ca | karmāṇi svecchayā kuryātso'pi syāddevahā naraḥ || 36.615 || kathāyāṃ kathyamānāyāṃ devasya madhuvidviṣaḥ | anādṛtya ca ye yānti te narāḥ pāpakāriṇaḥ || 36.616 || toyahīne'tiraudre ca vane vai śūnyavṛkṣatāṃ | jāyante saptajanmāni tataścaṇḍālatāṃ yayuḥ || 36.617 || deveṣu goṣu vipreṣu devāgāreṣu caiva hi | vahennaivādhipatyaṃ yannāsāvṛddhimavāpnuyāth || 36.618 || doṣāśca bahulā stasminnādhipatye smṛtā budhaiḥ | kāmato'kāmataścāpi sarvaṃ tasya viceṣṭitaṃ || 36.619 || pāpāyaiva bhavettasmādbhūtikāmastu taṃ tyajeth | sevārthināṃ sakāśāttu balātkāreṇa yaḥ prabhuḥ || 36.620 || gṛhṇīyāttukaraṃ sadyaḥ patetsa saha tena ca | devasya sannidhau bhaktairbhaktyāyattu samarpyate || 36.621 || patraṃ phalaṃ vā mūlaṃ vā svarṇaṃ vāsāṃsi cetarath | dāyādyamarcakānāṃ tu yo mohādapanihnute || 36.622 || svayaṃ vāpyupayuñjīta sa pāpī narakaṃ vrajeth | viśrāṇayanti haraye yadbhaktā bhaktibhāvitāḥ || 36.623 || tannāmnā pūjakāneva jānanti phalabhāginaḥ | sthirajaṅgamayoḥ pūjā yatassampāditā bhaveth || 36.624 || tasmādbhagavato nāmnā dattaṃ yaddevamandire | vihāyābharaṇādīni vāsāṃsyanyatparicchadaṃ || 36.625 || devālaṅkārayogyāni mūlyavanti viśeṣataḥ | arcakā eva gṛhṇīyuḥ pratibadhnīta netaraḥ || 36.626 || yastvadhīkāragarveṇa devāgāramupāśritaḥ | akāle sevituṃ cecchetso'pi yāsyati durgatiṃ || 36.627 || atha vā sevituṃ cecchetkāraṇenāpi kena cith | ukteṣveva tu kāleṣu seveta matimānnaraḥ || 36.628 || antyārcanāvasāne yatkavāṭo badhyate tataḥ | punarudghāṭanaṃ yāvatpratyūṣe ca bhaviṣyati || 36.629 || tāvannaiva hariṃ sevedakālassa viśeṣataḥ | pratyūṣādyantyakālāntapūjane'pi tu mantrataḥ || 36.630 || tattatkāle kavāṭasya bandhane vihite'pi ca | na tadā tāvatī hāniravabaddhe'pyamantrakaṃ || 36.631 || athār'canārhakālepi bhaktānāṃ sevanāya tu | akālā bahavaḥ proktāstathā yavasikoditā || 36.632 || tasmādakālasevāṃ tu vidhinā parivarjayeth | viṣayākrāntacittānāṃ viṣṇvarcanamakurvatāṃ || 36.633 || karmabhūmau nṛṇāṃ janma karmāpi vibhalaṃ dhruvaṃ | yo gurau mānuṣaṃ bhāvaṃ śilābhāvaṃ ca daivate || 36.634 || mantreṣu jīvikābhāvaṃ hiṃsābhāvaṃ makheṣu ca | pūjakeṣu ca pūjāyāṃ nīrasaṃ bhāvameti saḥ || 36.635 || sarvadhā ninditavyo hi jīvitaṃ tasya niṣphalaṃ | kṣamāmantraḥ atha vakṣye viśeṣaṇa kṣamāmantravidhiṃ paraṃ || 36.636 || apacāreṣu sarveṣu yaṃ japtvā mucyate naraḥ | aparādhaḥ kṛto yena jānatā svavaśena saḥ || 36.637 || kṣamāmantrasahasrasya jāpenāpi na mucyate | kṣamāmantrastvaśeṣāghadhvaṃsanakṣama ucyate || 36.638 || "nārāyaṇa namaste'stu namo bhaktaparāyaṇa | namo namo namaste'stu namaste'stu namo namaḥ || 36.639 || ajñānādarthalobhādvā rāgāddveṣātpramādataḥ | aparādhaḥ kṛto yastaṃ kṣamasva puruṣottama || 36.640 || saṃdhyayośca divā rātrau jāgratsvapnasuṣuptiṣu | aparādhaḥ kṛto yastaṃ kṣamasva puruṣottama || 36.641 || kāyena manasā vācā sarvairvāpi samuccitaiḥ | aparādhaḥ kṛto yastaṃ kṣamasva puruṣottama || 36.642 || tiṣṭhatā prajatā caiva śayyāsanagatena ca | aparādhaḥ kṛto yastaṃ kṣamasva puruṣottama || 36.643 || snāsyatā japatā vāpi yajatā juhvatā mayā | aparādhaḥ kṛto yastaṃ kṣamasva puruṣottama || 36.644 || bhujatā dhyāyatā nūnaṃ viṣayānupasevatā | aparādhāḥ kṛtā ye tānkṣamasva puruṣottama || 36.645 || mayā vā majjanairvāpi mama bandhubhirevavā | aparādhaḥ kṛto yastaṃ kṣamasva puruṣottama || 36.646 || rājñā vā tadamātyairvā rājabhṛtyairathāpivā | aparādhaḥ kṛto yastaṃ kṣamasva puruṣottama || 36.647 || ācāryeṇār'cakenāpi bhaktairvāparicārakaiḥ | aparādhaḥ kṛto yastaṃ kṣamasva puruṣottama || 36.648 || gāyakairnartakairvātha vāditrāṇāṃ ca vādakaiḥ | aparādhaḥ kṛto yastaṃ kṣamasva puruṣottama || 36.649 || praṇavādivisargāntaṃ kriyāsu vidhipūrvakaṃ | amantramarcane doṣaṃ kṣamasva puruṣottama || 36.650 || uddhānācchayanā ntantu kriyāsu vividhāsu ca | śraddhālopakṛtaṃ doṣaṃ kṣamasva puruṣottama || 36.651 || kaśśaknotyarcituṃ devaṃ tvāmanādyantamavyayaṃ | tasmādajñānacaritaṃ kṣamasva puruṣottama || 36.652 || prārthaye devadevaṃ tvāṃ prasīda bhagavanmayi | prasīdatu raṃ mahyaṃ tava vakṣaḥsthalālayā || 36.653 || iśānā jagato devī mātā nityānapāyinī | prasīdantu surāḥ sarve prasādādyuvayormayi || 36.654 || svastyastu kṛpayāsmākaṃ yuvayoḥ suprasannayoḥ | upacārāpadeśena kṛtānaharaharmayā || 36.655 || apacārānimāntsarvānkṣamasva puruṣottama | iti vijñāpayedbhūyo bhaktisādhvasabhāvitaḥ || 36.656 || tadarthanātparaṃ prītaḥ prasīdati khagadhvajaḥ | kṣamāmantramimaṃ deyānna cāśuśrūṣave kvacith || 36.657 || guhyādguhyatamo gopyassarvadā gurubhiḥ sadā iti śrīvaikhānase bhagavacchāstre bhṛguproktāyāṃ sihitāyāṃ prakīrṇādhikāre ṣaṭtriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ <37> atha saptatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ triyugadharma prapañcaḥ atha vakṣye laghūktena yugadharmāṃstataḥ paraṃ | kṛtaṃ tretā dvāparaśca kaliśceti caturyugaṃ || 37.1 || kṛtameva ca kartavyaṃ tasminkāle yadīpsitaṃ | na tatradharmāḥsīdanti na ca kṣīyantivai prajāḥ || 37.2 || tataḥ kṛtayugaṃ proktamanvarthena guṇena vai | na tasminyugasaṃsargevyavāyo nendriyakṣayaḥ || 37.3 || nānūyā nāpi ruditaṃ na darpo na ca paiśunaṃ | na vigraho na vidveṣona mithyā nāpi vañcanaṃ || 37.4 || na bhayaṃ na ca santāpo na lobho na ca mānitā | tadā jyotiḥparaṃ brahma vaikhānasamanāmayaṃ || 37.5 || yā gatiryogināmekā hyapunarbhavakāṅkṣiṇāṃ | viṣṇussarvātmako devaḥ śuklo nārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ || 37.6 || antaryāmiṇi tasmiṃstu sarvalokamaye harau | svayaṃ śuklatvamāpanne sarvamacchaṃ bhaviṣyati || 37.7 || brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāśśūdrāśca bhagavatparāḥ | svakarmaniratāssarvebhavanti manujāḥ kṛte || 37.8 || samāśramaṃ samācāraṃ satyabhūtaṃ taporataṃ | vijñānabharitaṃ sarvaṃ jagadbhavati santataṃ || 37.9 || eka vedasamāyuktā ekadharmavidhikriyāḥ | pṛthagdharmāstveka vedā dharmamekamanuvratāḥ || 37.10 || caturāśramayustena karmaṇā kālayoginā | akāmabhalasaṃyogāḥ prāpnuvanti parāṃ gatiṃ || 37.11 || kṛte yuge catuṣpādaścāturvarṇyasya śāśvataḥ | etatkṛtayugaṃ nāma traiguṇyaguṇavarjitaṃ || 37.12 || tatastretāyugaṃ nāma yatra dharmastrī pādbhaveth | raktatāṃ tu samabhyeti harirnārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ || 37.13 || satyapravṛttāśca narāḥ dānadharmaparāyaṇāḥ | yajante vividhairyajñairnārāyaṇamanāmayaṃ || 37.14 || brāhmaṇādyāssvadharmeṣu pravartante nirantaraṃ | yato dharmapade vṛddhā dvāparaṃ pratipedare || 37.15 || yugaṃ saṃśīnadharmatvāddvāparaṃ paricakṣate | viṣṇuḥ pītatvamabhyeti vedaścāpi vibhajyate || 37.16 || dvipādbhavati vaidharmo dvāpare samupasthite | dvivedāścaikavedāśca nirvedāśca tathā pare || 37.17 || vibhinnaśāstraniṣṭhāśca bhavanti vividhakriyāḥ | prajā dānaparā bhūtvā dānaṃ śaṃsanti santataṃ || 37.18 || rājasaṃ bhāvamāśritya rājasī bhavati prajā | sattvātpracyavamānānāṃ vyādhayo bhṛśadāruṇāḥ || 37.19 || atyāhitāni cānyāni bhaveṣyantyadharottaraṃ | kālasya hrasvatāyogāccaturthaṃ syādyugaṃ kaliḥ || 37.20 || pratyakṣarūpadhṛgdevo na kalau dṛśyate yataḥ | kṛtādiṣviva tenaiva
