triyugaḥ kalirucyate || 37.21 || padenaikena vai dharmaḥ pravarteta kalau yuge | tasmiṃstu samanuprāpte na dharmassaṃpravartate || 37.22 || tāmasaṃ yugamāsādya hariḥ kṛṣṇatvameti ca | yaḥ kaścidatra dharmātmā kriyoyogarato bhaveth || 37.23 || naraṃ dharmaparaṃ dṛṣṭvā sarve'sūyāṃ prakurvate | varṇāśramāśritācārāḥ praṇaśyantina saṃśayaḥ || 37.24 || vratācārāḥ praṇaśyanti dhyānayajñādayastathā | upadravā janiṣyanti hyadharmasya pravartanāth || 37.25 || asūyāniratāssarve daṃbhācāraparāyaṇāḥ | prajāścālpāyuṣassarve bhaviṣyantikalau yuge || 37.26 || sarvedharmāḥ praṇaśyanti kṛṣṇe kṛṣmatvamāgate | yasmātkalirmahāghorassarvapāpasya sādhakaḥ || 37.27 || brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāśśūdrā dharmaparāṅmukhāḥ | ghore kaliyuge prāpte dvijā vedaparāṅmukhāḥ || 37.28 || vyājadharmaparāssarve vṛdhāhaṅkāra dūṣitāḥ | sarvamākṣipyate nityaṃ naraiḥ paṇḍitamānibhiḥ || 37.29 || ahamevādhika iti sarvo vivadate janaḥ | adharmalolupāssarve tathā caiva dvijātayaḥ || 37.30 || atastvalpāyuṣassarve bhaviṣyanti kalau yuge | alpāyuṣṭvānmanuṣyāṇāṃ na vidyāgrahaṇaṃ bhaveth || 37.31 || vidyāgrahaṇaśūnyatvādadharmassaṃpravartate | vyutkrameṇa prajāssarvā mriyante pāpatarparāḥ || 37.32 || brāhmaṇādyāstathā varṇāssaṃkīryante parasbaraṃ | kāmakrodhaparā mūḍhā vṛdhāhaṃ kārapūritāḥ || 37.33 || baddhavairā bhaviṣyanti parasparavadhepsavaḥ | janāssarve dayāhīnā dākṣiṇya parivarjitā || 37.34 || śūdratulyā bhaviṣyanti tapassatyavivarjitāḥ | uttamā nīcatāṃ yānti nīcāścottamatāṃ tathā || 37.35 || rājāno dravyaniratā lobhamohaparāyaṇāḥ | dharmakañcukasaṃvītā dharmavidhvaṃsakāriṇaḥ || 37.36 || yo yo'śvarathanāgāḍhyassa sa rājā bhaviṣyati | kiṅkarāśca bhaviṣyanti śūdrāṇāṃ cadvijātayaḥ || 37.37 || mlecchāśca yunādyāśca pālayanti vasuṃdharāṃ | anāvṛṣṭibhayātprāyo gaganādattacakṣuṣaḥ || 37.38 || bhaviṣyanti narāssarve sadā kṣudbhayakātarāḥ | kalau narābhaviṣyanti svalpabhāgyā bahuprajāḥ || 37.39 || pativākyamanādṛtya sadānyagṛhatatparāḥ | duśśīlā duṣṭaśīleṣu kariṣyanti spṛhāṃ striyaḥ || 37.40 || paruṣānṛtabhāṣiṇyo dehasaṃskāra varjitāḥ | vācālāśca bhaviṣyantikalau prāpte sadā striyaḥ || 37.41 || nagareṣu ca grāmeṣu prākārāṭṭādikānjanāḥ | corādibhayabhītāśca kāṣṭhayantrāṇi kurvate || 37.42 || durbhikṣakarapīḍābhiratīvopadrutā janāḥ | godhūmānnayavānnāḍhyāndeśānprāpsyanti duḥkhitāḥ || 37.43 || svakāryasiddhiparyantaṃ snihyantyanyeṣu mānavāḥ | bhikṣavaścāpi mitrādisnehasaṃbandhayantritāḥ || 37.44 || annopādhinimittena śiṣyāngṛhṇanti sarvataḥ | ubhābhyāmapi hastābhyāṃ śiraḥkaṇḍūyanaṃ striyaḥ || 37.45 || kurvantyo bhartṛmukhyānāmājñāṃ bhetsyantyānādṛtāḥ | pāṣaṇḍālāpaniratāḥ pāṣaṇḍijanasaṃginaḥ || 37.46 || bhaviṣyanti yadā viprā stadā vṛddhimiyātkaliḥ | alpodakāstathā meghā alpasasyā vasuṃdharā || 37.47 || alpakṣīrāstathā gāvaḥ kṣīrātsarpirna jāyate | ekavarṇā bhaviṣyanti varṇāścatvāra eva ca || 37.48 || nāsti varṇāntaraṃ tatralayaṃ yāsyanti mānavāḥ | santassīdantyasantaśca vilasantisamantataḥ || 37.49 || maitrī parajane bhūyādvairaṃ ca svajane bhaveth | putrāḥ pitṛṣu jīvatsu mriyante ca tadagrataḥ || 37.50 || kalau kākiṇike'pyarthe vigṛhya tyaktasauhṛdāḥ | tyakṣyantihi priyānprāṇānhaniṣyanti svabāndhavān || 37.51 || pāṣaṇḍapracuredharme dasyuprāyeṣu rājasu | cauryānṛtavṛdhāhiṃsānānāvṛttiṣu vai nṛṣu || 37.52 || śūdraprāyeṣu varṇeṣu chāgaprāyeṣu goṣu ca | kariṣyanti tathā śūdrāḥ pravrajyāliṅginau'dhamāḥ || 37.53 || kāṣāyaparinītāśca jaṭilā bhakmadhūsarāḥ | aśaucāvakramatayaḥ parapākānnajīvinaḥ || 37.54 || devadvijanivāseṣu pūjāmicchanti pāpinaḥ | bhaviṣyanti durātmānaḥ śūdrāḥ pravrajitāstathā || 37.55 || utkoca jīvinastatra mahāpāparatāstathā | bhaviṣyantyatha pāṣaṇḍāḥ kāpālā bhikṣavodhamāḥ || 37.56 || dharmavidhvaṃsaśīlānāṃ dvijanāṃ rājavallabhāḥ | śūdrā dharmānpravakṣyanti pravrajyāliṅgino'dhamāḥ || 37.57 || gītavādyaparā viprā vedavādaparāṅmukhāḥ | bhaviṣyanti kalau prāpte śūdramārga pravartinaḥ || 37.58 || hartāro na ca dātārobhaviṣyanti kalau yuge | viśvāsahīnāḥ piśunā vedadevadvijātiṣu || 37.59 || asaṃskṛto ktivaktāro rāgadveṣaparāstathā | paramāyuścateṣāṃ syāttadā varṣāṇi ṣoḍaśa || 37.60 || pañcame vāthaḥvaṣṭhe vā varṣekanyā prasūyate | sartpavarṣāṣṭavarṣāśca prasūyante tathā narāḥ || 37.61 || svakarmatyāginassarve kṛtaghnā bhinnavṛttayaḥ | yācakāḥ piśunāścaiva bhaviṣyanti kalau yuge || 37.62 || parāvamānaniratā ātmastutiparāyaṇāḥ | parasvaharaṇopāyacintakāḥ sarvadā narāḥ || 37.63 || nindāṃ kurvanti satataṃ pitṛmātṛkuleṣu tu | vadanti vācā dharmāṃśca cetasā pāpalolupāḥ || 37.64 || chādayanti prayatnena svadoṣaṃ pāpakarmajaṃ | apāpe duṣkṛtaṃ samyagvivṛṇvanti narādhamāḥ || 37.65 || dharmamārgapravaktāraṃ tiraskurvanti pāpinaḥ | bhaviṣyanti kalau prāpti rājāno mlecchajātayaḥ || 37.66 || dvijāśca kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrāścānyāśca jātayaḥ | atyantakāminassarve saṃkīryante parasparaṃ || 37.67 || na śiṣyo na guruḥ kaścinna putro na tathā pitā | na bhāryā na patistatra bhavitā sarvasaṃkaraḥ || 37.68 || kalau ca te bhaviṣyanti dhanāḍhyā api yācakāḥ | rasavikrayiṇaścāpi bhaviṣyanti kalau yuge || 37.69 || dharmapatnīṣu yacchanti patayo jāralakṣaṇaṃ | dviṣyanti pitaraṃ putrā guruṃ śiṣyādviṣanti ca || 37.70 || patiṃ ca vanitā dveṣṭi kalau prāptena saṃśayaḥ | lobhābhibhūtamanasassarve duṣkarmaśālinaḥ || 37.71 || parānnalolupā nityaṃ bhaviṣyanti dvijātayaḥ | parastrīniratāssarve paradravyaparāyaṇāḥ || 37.72 || martyāmiṣeṇa jīvanti duhantaścāpyajāvikān | sarittīreṣu kuddālairopayiṣyanti cauṣadhīḥ || 37.73 || atyalpāni phalānyāsāṃ bhaviṣyanti kalau yuge | veśyālāvaṇyaśīleṣu spṛhāṃ kurvanti yoṣitaḥ || 37.74 || dharmavighnā bhaviṣyanti striyaśca puruṣeṣu ca | na kanyāṃ yācate kaścinna ca kanyāprado naraḥ || 37.75 || kanyā varāṃśca chandena grahīṣṭanti parasparaṃ | prāyaśaḥ kṛpaṇānāṃ ca bandhūnāṃ ca tadhā dvijāḥ || 37.76 || sādhūnāṃ vividhānāṃ ca vittānyapaharanti ca | na yakṣyanti na hoṣyantina tapasyanti vai janāḥ || 37.77 || naiva dāsyanti dānādi nār'cayiṣyanti vā hariṃ | na dharme niviśiṣyanti hetuvādakathāśrayāḥ || 37.78 || apātreṣveva dānāni kurvanti ca tathā narāḥ | kṣīropādhinimittena goṣu prītiṃ prakurvate || 37.79 || na kurvanti tathā viprāḥ snānaśaucādikāḥ kriyāḥ | akālakarmaniratāḥ kūṭayuktiviśāradāḥ || 37.80 || devanindāparāścaiva vipranindāparāstathā | tyaktapuṇḍraśikhāsūtrāścariṣyantidvijātayaḥ || 37.81 || viṣṇubhaktiparaṃ na syānmanaḥ kasyāpi jātu cith | devapūjāparaṃ dṛṣṭvā sarve parihasanti ca || 37.82 || śāstroditāśca ye devāḥparivārā madhudviṣaḥ | tānparityajya mohena narāḥ kālabalātkṛtāḥ || 37.83 || hetuvādaparāndevānkariṣyantyaparāṃ stadā | nirbadhnanti dvijāneva karārthaṃ rājakiṅkarāḥ || 37.84 || nādriyante dvijānanye kalau pāpasamākule | dānayajña japādīnāṃ vikrīṇante phalaṃ dvijāḥ || 37.85 || pratigrahaṃ ca kurvante caṇḍālāderapi dvijāḥ | śūdrastrīmaṅganiratā vidhavāsaṃgalolupāḥ || 37.86 || rajassvalānāṃ voḍhāro bhaviṣyanti kalau yuge | śūdrānna pānaniratāḥ śūdraprāyā bhavanti ca || 37.87 || aṭṭaśūlājanapadāḥ śivaśūlāścatuṣpathāḥ | pramadāḥ keśaśūlinyo bhaviṣyanti kalau yuge || 37.88 || kuhakāśca janāstatra hetuvādaviśāradāḥ | pāṣaṇḍino bhaviṣyanti tiṣṭantyāśramanindakāḥ || 37.89 || na ca dvijātiśuśrūṣāṃ sarvadharmanivartinīṃ | gṛhaprāyeṣvāśrameṣu yogiprāyeṣu bandhuṣu || 37.90 || tataśchānudinaṃ dharmassatyaṃ śaucaṃ dayā kṣamā | kālena balinā sarvaṃ naśyatyāyurbalaṃ smṛtiḥ || 37.91 || vīttameva kalau nṝṇāṃ janmācāraguṇodayaṃ | dāṃpatye'bhirucirheturmāyaiva vyavahārake || 37.92 || dharmanyāyavyavasthānāṃ kāraṇaṃ balameva hi | strītvamevopabhoge svādvipratve sūtrameva hi || 37.93 || liṅgamevāśramakhyātāvanyāyo vṛttikāraṇaṃ | avṛttau cāpi daurbalyaṃ pāṇḍitye cāphalaṃ vacaḥ || 37.94 || svīkāra eva codvāhe snānamevāśucau smṛtaṃ | udaraṃbharitā svārthesatyatve dhārṣṭyameva hi || 37.95 || dākṣye kuṭuṃbabharaṇe yaśorthe dharmasevanaṃ | itthaṃ kaliyuge prāpte dharmassarvo'pi jīryate || 37.96 || yadā māyānṛtaṃ tandrā nidrā hiṃsā viṣāyanaṃ | śoko moho bhayaṃ dainyaṃ sa kalistāmasaḥsmṛtaḥ || 37.97 || yadāyadā satāṃ hānirvaidikānāṃ dvijanmanāṃ | tadā tadā kaliṃprāptamavabuddhyeta paṇḍitaḥ || 37.98 || aho duḥkhamahoduḥkhamahoduḥkhamaho mahath | svarūpamatibhīmasya saṃsārasya sudurbharaṃ || 37.99 || viṇmūtrapūyakalite garbhavāse nipīḍanāth | aśucāvatibhībhatse duḥkhamatyantadussahaṃ || 37.100 || duḥkhaṃ ca jāyamānānāṃ gātrabhaṅgādipīḍane | vātena preryamāṇānāṃ mūrchanāyātibhītidaṃ || 37.101 || bālake nirvivekānāṃ bhūtadaivātmasaṃbhavaṃ | yauvane vārdhake caiva maraṇe cāti dāruṇe || 37.102 || ekauttaraṃ mṛtyuśataṃ dehe jñeyaṃ pratiṣṭhitaṃ | tatraikaḥ kālasaṃjñaḥ syāccheṣāstvāgantukāḥsmṛtāḥ || 37.103 || ye cātrāgantukāḥ proktāste tu śāmyanti bheṣajaiḥ | japahomapradānaiśca kālamṛtyurna śāmyati || 37.104 || vividhā vyādhayaśśastraṃ sarpādyāḥ prāṇinastathā | viṣāṇi cābhicārāśca mṛtyordvārāṇi dehināṃ || 37.105 || nauṣadhaṃ na tapo dānaṃ na mantrāna ca bāndhavāḥ | śaknuvanti naraṃ trātuṃ kālamṛtyuprapīḍitaṃ || 37.106 || rasāyanatapojapyayogasiddhairmahātmabhiḥ | kālamṛtyurapi prāpto jīyate'nalasairnaraiḥ || 37.107 || nāsti mṛtyusamaṃ duḥkhaṃ nāsti mṛtyusamaṃ bhayaṃ | sadbhāryāṃ putramitrāṇi rājyaiśvaryasukhāni ca || 37.108 || ābaddhāni ca vairāṇi mṛtyussarvaṃ vināśayeth | yadduḥkhaṃ maraṇe jantorna tasyeha samaṃ kvacith || 37.109 || maṇḍūka iva sarpeṇa grasyate mṛtyunā jagath | bāndhavaiśca pariṣvaktaḥ priyaiśca parivāritaḥ || 37.110 || niśśvapandīrghamuṣṇaṃ ca mukhena pariśuṣyatā | caturṣvanteṣu khaṭvāyāḥ parivṛtya mūhurmuhuḥ || 37.111 || sammūḍhaḥ kṣipate'tyardhaṃ hastapādamitastataḥ | khaṭvāyā vāñchate bhūmiṃ bhūmeḥ khaṭvāṃ tato mahīṃ || 37.112 || vivastrastyaktalajjaśca mūtraviṣṭhāpariplutaḥ | yācamānaśca salilaṃ śuṣkakaṇṭhāsyatālukaḥ || 37.113 || cintayānaścavittāni kasyaitānimṛtemayi | nakhāgraiśca spṛśanbhūmiṃ kālapāśena karṣitaḥ || 37.114 || mriyate paśyatāmeva gale khurakhurāyate | jīvastṛṇajalūkāvaddehāddehaṃ viśedasau || 37.115 || saṃprāpyottaravaṃśe ca tanuṃ tyajati paurvikīṃ | dehabhedena yaḥ puṃsāṃ viyogaḥ karmasaṃkṣayāth || 37.116 || maraṇaṃ tadvinirdiṣṭaṃ na nāśaḥ paramārthataḥ | jāyate mriyate caivaṃ karmabhiḥ svayamārjitaiḥ || 37.117 || śītoṣṇatṛṣṇākṣudrograjvarādiparivāritaḥ | sarvadaivapumānāste yāvajjanmānta saṃsthitiḥ || 37.118 || duḥkhātiśayabhūtaṃ hi yadante nāsukhaṃ nṛṇāṃ | tasyopamānaṃ naivāsti kāryeṇaivānu mīyate || 37.119 || kṛṣyamāṇasya puruṣairyadyamasyātidussahaṃ | duḥkhaṃ tatsaṃsmṛtiṃ prāptaṃ karoti mama vepathuṃ || 37.120 || tataścaiva punastasya yonisaṃkramaṇe ca yath | garbhasthasya ca yadduḥkhamatidussahamulbaṇaṃ || 37.121 || punaśca jāyamānasya bālyayauvanajaṃ ca yath | duḥkhānyetānyanantāni saṃsārāntaravartibhiḥ || 37.122 || puruṣairanubhūyante sukhabhrāntivimohitaiḥ | na vai sukhakalā kācidatrāstyatyantaduḥkhade || 37.123 || saṃsārasaṃkaṭe saṃgamupetānāṃ kadā cana | viṣayāsaktamanasassatataṃ pāmarā janāḥ || 37.124 || na matiṃ kurvate viṣṇau sarvalokeśvareśvare | athāpi nātra bibhyanti vaiṣṇavā bhagavatpriyāḥ || 37.125 || viṣṇudhyānaparāssanto viṣvarcanaparāyaṇāḥ | te viṣṇusadṛśā jñeyā na hi tānbādhate kaliḥ || 37.126 || māyeyaṃ vaiṣṇavī bhūyaḥ pātayetprāṇinastadā | dustarāpi bhavetsādhyā yairnyastaṃ mādhavemanaḥ || 37.127 || asaṃtyajya ca gārhasthyamataptvā catathā tapaḥ | chinatti vaiṣṇavīṃ māyāṃ keśavārādhane rataḥ || 37.128 || viṣayānavirodhena sevamāno'pi mādhavaṃ | arcayānastarantyenāṃ viṣṇumāyāṃ duratyayāṃ || 37.129 || yata evamato labdhvāśarīraṃ karmasādhanaṃ | śubhaṃ karmaiva kartadyaṃ tatprasādāya mānavaiḥ, || 37.130 || prasādite'sminsarveṣāṃ svavarṇāśramakarmabhiḥ | sarvehastagatāḥ kāmā muktiścānte karasthitā || 37.131 || kāryārthā mūrtayastasya lokakalyāṇakārakāḥ | atassākārameveṣṭvā bhaktyemaṃ siddhimāpnuyāth || 37.132 || idaṃ ca śāstramālaṃbya pūjayedviṣṇumavyayaṃ | yaddhyānaṃ kevalaṃ proktaṃ śāstre kvacidanāśrayaṃ || 37.133 || na tatrendriyadaurbalyātkarmasthasyādhikāritā | yathā giritaṭāgrasthavanaspatiphalecchayā || 37.134 || upāye vartate'śrāntastathāsau yatnamācareth | sarvatra kramavānyatnaḥkāryo naicchaiva kevalā || 37.135 || tatkāyavāṅmanoyogaiḥkramādicchetparāṃ gatiṃ | nirākāretu yā bhaktyā pūjeṣṭā dhyānameva vā || 37.136 || ramaṇīyamivābhāti tadanarthasya kāraṇaṃ | sthūlabhāvaprasaṃdīni janmanāsyendriyāṇi tu || 37.137 || sūkṣmāccha na prapadyante cirācca kimutācirāth | na ca rūpaṃ vinā dovo dhyātuṃ kenāpi śakyate || 37.138 || sarvarūpanivṛttā hi buddhiḥ kutrāsya tiṣṭhati | nivṛttāglāyate buddhirnidrayāhi parīyate || 37.139 || tasmādvidvānupāsīta buddhyā sākālameva taṃ | astitasya parokṣaṃ taditi kiñcidanusmareth || 37.140 || sarvadhākāramuddiṣṭaṃ na parityajya paṇḍitaḥ | paraṃ devamupāsīta muktaye vā phalāyavā || 37.141 || bhaktyākṛtenārcanena tuṣṭodevaḥ prajāpateḥ | pūjādyanugrahāyā'dāvāvirbhūtaścaturbhujaḥ || 37.142 || tasmāttenaiva rūpeṇa hriyā lakṣmyā samāyutaḥ | dhyeyassevyor'caniyaśca sadā nārāyaṇo budhaiḥ || 37.143 || sākāre'sminkṛtā pūjā stutirvā dhyānameva vā | vidhinā śāstradṛṣṭena tasminneva kṛtā bhaveth || 37.144 || tadevārādhanaṃ viṣṇoravajñātaṃ viśeṣataḥ | khyāpanārthaṃ kalau kaścidbhaviṣyati mahāmatiḥ || 37.145 || dharmaglāniradharmasya vṛddhiryāvadbhaviṣyati | tāvavbhartā mahāviṣṇuḥ sṛjatyātmānamātmanā || 37.146 || śrīnivāse janāvāne śrīnivāsaḥ svayaṃ hariḥ | śrīnivāsassamākhyāto bhūmāvavatariṣyati || 37.147 || utpatsyamāna evāsau bhrājamānassvatejasā | jagadāvaraṇaṃ krūraṃ tamaḥ puñjaṃ haniṣyati || 37.148 || pañcahāyana evātha prāptasarvakalākulaḥ | saṃskṛto'khilasaṃskārairbrahmavarcasasevitaḥ || 37.149 || sarvalokeśvaraṃ devaṃ śrīnivākaṃ śriyaḥ patiṃ | caturbhujamudārāṅgaṃ divyābharaṇabhūṣitaṃ || 37.150 || śrīvatsāṃkaṃ mahābāhuṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharaṃ | kirīṭamukuṭopetaṃ varadābhayacihnitaṃ || 37.151 || haimordhvapuṇḍralāvaṇyalasadvadanapaṅkajaṃ | vaikhānasairmahābhāgairarcyamānaṃ nirantaraṃ || 37.152 || kṛtāspadaṃ kaliyuge tadīyaṃ kuladaivataṃ | "arāyi kāṇa'' ityādyaiśśrutivākyairabhiṣṭutaṃ || 37.153 || "rayiḥ kakudmā''nityādyairmantrairvaikhānasaiḥ paraiḥ | ijyamānaṃ viśeṣeṇa vividhaiḥ pāramātmikaiḥ || 37.154 || kalyāṇaguṇasaṃpūrṇaṃ divyamaṅgalavigrahaṃ | svayaṃvyaktaṃ parañjyotiḥ paraṃ brahma parātparaṃ || 37.155 || vidhinā śāstradṛṣṭena devamārādhayiṣyati | prasādasumukho devassvātmabhūte śiśau svayaṃ || 37.156 || avanamya ca mūrdhānaṃ gṛhīṣyati gale srajaṃ | divyaiḥprasannairgrathitāṃ kusumaistulasīdalaiḥ || 37.157 || svayaṃ sārdhaṃ kumāreṇa havīṃṣi ca bhujiṣyati | saṃtuṣṭena kumāreṇa prārthitaḥ karuṇānidhiḥ || 37.158 || vaikhānasairmahābhāgairupetaiḥ saha mandire | havīṃṣyaśiṣyatyadhyakṣaṃ kumāraṃ sāntvayiṣyati || 37.159 || arcāvatāramahātmyaṃ lokebhyaḥkhyāpayiṣyati | devor'cakaparādhīnaḥ sarvaṃ tebhyaḥ kariṣyati || 37.160 || tathā sammānitaḥ premṇā śrīnivāsena sādaraṃ | yajñairbahuvidhairanyairyajñeśaṃ saṃyajiṣyati || 37.161 || viśāle bahusaṃskārasaṃkule vasudhātale | sthāpayiṣyati viṣṇvarcāṃ grāme grāme gṛhe gṛhe || 37.162 || purāṇi ca janāvāsā gṛhāṇi gṛhiṇāṃ tathā | mandirairindireśasya sundarairnatibhandhuraiḥ || 37.163 || maṇḍitāni bhaviṣyanti jagattattvaṃ bhajiṣyati | ita ācārya nirdeśa itaśśiṣyopasarpaṇaṃ || 37.164 || ihaiva gṛhiṇāṃ bhūyaḥ prasaṃga iha mantraṇaṃ | acāryavaraṇaṃ ceha śilpināmiha mārgaṇaṃ || 37.165 || iha prastarasaṃgrāha iha dārugrahastathā | iha diksāthanaṃ caiha vasudhāsaṃparīkṣaṇaṃ || 37.166 || ito maṅgalaghoṣaśca itaḥpuṇyāhavācanaṃ | ita ādyeṣṭakānyāsa ito mūrdheṣṭakāvidhiḥ || 37.167 || itaśśūlagrahaśceta ito vairajjubandhanaṃ | itaśca mṛtsnāsaṃskāra ito varṇavilekhanaṃ || 37.168 || ito madhūcchiṣṭavidhirito'laṅkārakalpanaṃ | ito dhvajasya nirmāṇamito bhaktasamāgamaḥ || 37.169 || itaḥpratiṣṭhāsaṃkalpa nāto nayanamokṣaṇaṃ | ito'dhivāsanaṃ ceto prabhūtabalidāpanaṃ || 37.170 || ito'gnimanthanaṃ ceto homa ānandavardhanaḥ | iha gītaṃ nṛttamiha vādyaṃ śrutimanoharaṃ || 37.171 || iha pratiṣṭhā devasya iha ca dvijabhojanaṃ | iha kālotsavaśceha dhanuṣi prātarutsavaḥ || 37.172 || mudgānnasya guḍānnasya prasādasya nivedanaṃ | adyottiṣṭhati vaikuṇṭhaḥ śayitaḥ kṣīrasāgare? || 37.173 || adya vratasyāpavargo saṃśitassa bhuvo hareḥ | adya vaivāhikaṃ devyāvratānte lokamaṅgalaṃ || 37.174 || adya pauṣī pūrṇimāhocādya caikādaśī śubhā | adya devasya kuryanti snapanaṃ kalaśaiśśataiḥ || 37.175 || adya dāśarathirjāto dvādaśī māghasaṃbhavā | adya cātā jaganmātā phālgune revatī tithau || 37.176 || adyakurvanti devasya damanotsavamīśvarāḥ | caitramāsasta devasya mahāprītikaraḥ kila || 37.177 || kurvanti manujādhīśā vasante divyamutsavaṃ | jalakrīḍotsavo hyadya caitrayātrā hareḥkvacith || 37.178 || ketakīmālatījātīmallikādolikotsavaḥ | gandhotsavo'dya kriyate paurṇamāsī kadā dinaṃ || 37.179 || kadā caikādaśī puṇyā kadā vā dvādaśītidhiḥ | kadā nṛsiṃhassaṃjātaḥ smṛtamadyatrayodaśī || 37.180 || vaiśākhe śuklapakṣe tu kriyate vārṣikotsavaḥ | kadā bhavetpaurṇamāsī kriyate candrikotsavaḥ || 37.181 || kadā jyeṣṭhotsavo bhūyātkadā vā pūrṇimā śubhā | prapotsavaḥ kadā bhūyādāṣāḍhī ca bhaviṣyati || 37.182 || kadā ca śravaṇaṃ bhūyānnakṣatraṃ yatra mārutiḥ | rāmasevādhuraṃ dhṛtvā jātassākṣānmahāmatiḥ || 37.183 || kadā ca śrāvaṇī bhūyādyatra nārāyaṇo hariḥ | svātmānaṃ janayāmāsa lokakalyāṇahetave || 37.184 || vaikhānasaṃ vikhanasaṃ viriñcamiti yaṃ viduḥ | kadā bhādrapado māsastatra caikādaśī bhaveth || 37.185 || kadā vā dvādaśī bhūyātsarvapāpa praṇāśinī | tiladhenuṃ pradāsyanti yatra devasya sannidhau || 37.186 || kadāśvino bhavenmāsastatrāpi daśamī śubhā | aśvayātrā harerbhūyādanuyāsyāmahe hariṃ || 37.187 || kadā bhavedamāvāsyā yasyāṃ sa narakohataḥ | kadā vā kārtikomāso bhaviṣyati haripriyaḥ || 37.188 || dīpāropo bhavettatra kadā vā kārtikī śubhā | kadāyugādaya stadvatpuṇyakālā viśeṣataḥ || 37.189 || kadā bhaviṣyati hare rathayātrā mahātmanaḥ | kadā vā gajayātrā syātkadā vīśādhirohaṇaṃ || 37.190 || kadā bhramati deveśo grāmavīthiṣu sundaraṃ | kadā labhiṣṭati harestīrthaṃ paramapāvanaṃ || 37.191 || kadā prasādaṃ devasya kaṇasyāpi labhiṣyati | kadā śaṅkharathāṅgādidivyalāñchanalāñchitā || 37.192 || pādukā devadevasya saṃskariṣyati me śiraḥ | kadā vā tulasīṃ puṇyāmarpitāṃ tasya pādayoḥ || 37.193 || aśnāmi śirasā caiva dhārayiṣyāmi vaiṣṇavīṃ | kadā vā puṇyapuṣpāṇāmekaṃ devasamarpitaṃ || 37.194 || śirasā dhārayiṣyāmi jighrāmi bhahugandhavath | devadevasya drakṣyāmi kadā sarvāṅgasuṃdaraṃ || 37.195 || āpādamauliparyantaṃ lāvaṇyamadhuraṃ vapuḥ | ityādikāḥ kathāstatra bhaviṣyanti prajāsu ca || 37.196 || sarve dharmaparāssarve nārāyaṇa parāyaṇāḥ | arcane vāsudevasya bhaviṣyanti ratā narāḥ || 37.197 || ityeva kālaṃ kāleyaṃ gururujjīvayiṣyati | śrīnivāsaṃ śriyovāsamarciṣyati ciraṃ bhuvi || 37.198 || pāṣaṇḍopaplutaṃ dharmamuddhariṣyati vaiṣṇavaṃ | idaṃ ca bhagavacchāstraṃ cirasthāyi kariṣyati || 37.199 || sarvatantrasvatantro'sau bahūngrandhānpraṇeṣyati | asaṃkhyebhyaśca śiṣyebhyastattārthamupadekṣyati || 37.200 || dharmavyavasthāṃ kṛtvaivaṃ kalāvatibhayaṅkare | sameṣyati paraṃ sthānaṃ tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padaṃ || 37.201 || yugānte ca punarnāmaharernaiko gṛhīṣyati | tadā harirmahāvīraḥ kalkī nāma bhaviṣyati || 37.202 || adharmanidhanaṃ kṛtvā dharmaṃ saṃsthāpayiṣyati | harerdivyāvatārāṇāmavatārakathāmimāṃ || 37.203 || yaḥ paṭhecchruṇuyādvāpi so'pi yāsyati sadgatiṃ | dhanyāste puruṣaśreṣṭhā durante bhavasāgare || 37.204 || ye nāmāpi kalau viṣṇossmariṣyintyavyayātmavaḥ | dhyāyankṛtayuge viṣṇuṃ tretāyāṃ dāpare yajan || 37.205 || yattatphalamavāpnoti kalau smaraṇamātrataḥ | harerharati pāpāni nāmasaṃkīrtitaṃ sakṛth || 37.206 || pāṣaṇḍabahule loke kalāvatibhayaṅkare | tannāmakīrtayedyastu taṃ vidyātkṛtināṃ varaṃ || 37.207 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena bhaktyā paramayā yutaḥ | samūrtārādhanaṃ kuryānnānyathā muktimāpnuyāth || 37.208 || nāthamādyaistu navabhiradhyāyairīḍyate kramāth | bhūparīkṣādikarmāṇi vimānānāṃ ca kalpanaṃ || 37.209 || vividhānāṃ ca berāṇāṃ nirmāṇavidhivistaraḥ | daśame nāṃkurāropaḥ paścāddvābhyāmudīritaḥ || 37.210 || pratiṣṭhā vidhiratyanta phalado jagataḥ pateḥ | paścāddaśāvatārāṇāṃ caturbhiḥ procyate vidhiḥ || 37.211 || tathā saptadaśe cokta ādimūrti vidhistataḥ | aṣṭādaśer'canaṃ sāṃgamuktaṃ madhuvidāriṇaḥ || 37.212 || dvābhyāmuktastato pūjādravya saṃgrahaṇa kramaḥ | ekaviṃśe viśeṣārcāvidhissamyagudīritaḥ || 37.213 || dvāviṃśesnapanaṃ coktaṃ trayoviṃśe viśeṣataḥ | vidhirutsavacakrasya prokto dvābhyāmathotsavaḥ || 37.214 || tataśca ṣaḍbhiradhyāyaiḥ prāyaścittasya vistaraḥ | proktastataśca dvātriṃśe saṃkīrṇaṃśā udīritāḥ || 37.215 || arcāvatāramahimā trayastriṃśe prakīrtitaḥ | svayaṃvyaktādibhedaśca catustriṃśe prakāśitaḥ || 37.216 || pañcatriṃśe tu saṃproktaṃ kriyāyogāśritaṃ phalaṃ | ṣaṭtriṃśetvapacārāśca kathitā devakopanāḥ || 37.217 || kalidharmāśca saṃproktāssaptatriṃśe viśeṣataḥ | saptatriṃśadbhiradhyāyairevaṃ gurukṛpābalāth || 37.218 || ṣaḍbhiḥ sahasraiḥ ślokaistu kriyāṅgamupavarṇitaṃ || 37.219 || ityārṣe śrīvaikhānase bhagavacchāstre bhṛguproktāyāṃ caturviṃśatsahānrikāyāṃ sahitāyāṃ prakīrṇādhikāre saptatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ iti śrīmati prakīrṇādhikāre kriyāpādaḥ śrī vikhanasamahāgurave namaḥ śrautasmārtādikaṃ karma nikhilaṃ yena sūtritaṃ tasmai samastavedārthavide vikhanase namaḥ jayatyātmeśvarosni dradhyāna saudhapriyātithiḥ śrīmatpatrapurīvāsaḥ śrīrāmassītayā gṛhī śrīrāmacandrāya namaḥ
